articles.title: Failure of the mean-field Hartree approximation for a bosonic many-body system with non-Hermitian Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 非厄米哈密顿量玻色子多体系统平均场哈特里近似的失效
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2244 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2244 Mean-field Hartree theory is a central tool for reducing many-body dynamics to an effective one-particle evolution. This approximation has been employed when the Hamiltonian governing the many-body dynamics is not Hermitian. Indeed, non-Hermitian Hamiltonians model particle gain/loss or the evolution of open quantum systems between consecutive quantum jumps. Furthermore, the validity of the Hartree approximation for generic non-Hermitian Hamiltonians lies at the basis of a quantum algorithm for nonlinear differential equations. In this work, we show that this approximation can fail. First, we consider the most general bosonic mean-field Hamiltonian with two-body interactions and we prove that, for non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, the Hartree equation does not capture the correct second time derivative of the one-particle marginal state at t=0 in the thermodynamic limit. Then, we analytically solve a model of N bosonic qubits with a purely anti-Hermitian Hamiltonian, compute the limit for N→infty of the one-particle marginal state and show that it does not agree with the solution of the non-Hermitian Hartree equation. We further show that there exists an initial condition such that the exact one-particle marginal state undergoes a finite-time transition to a mixed state, a phenomenon that is completely absent in the case of Hermitian Hamiltonians. Finally, we simulate a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian with real spectrum and show that, also in this case, there are initial conditions for which the Hartree equation does not reproduce the correct one-particle marginal state in the limit N→infty. Our findings challenge the validity of the mean-field Hartree approximation for non-Hermitian Hamiltonians, and call for additional conditions for the validity of the mean-field regime to model the dynamics of particle gain and loss and the open-system dynamics in bosonic many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 平均场哈特里理论是简化多体动力学为有效单粒子演化的核心工具，常用于非厄米哈密顿量系统。本研究证明了该近似在非厄米哈密顿量下可能失效。作者首先证明了在热力学极限下，哈特里方程无法准确捕捉单粒子边际态在t=0时的二阶时间导数。随后，通过解析求解一个具有纯反厄米哈密顿量的N个玻色子量子比特模型，进一步证实了其结果与非厄米哈特里方程的解不一致。
authors: Matias Ginzburg, Simone Rademacher, and Giacomo De Palma

articles.title: A Symmetry-Enabled Direct Quantum Protocol for Many-Body Green’s Functions
articles.title_zh: 对称性增强的多体格林函数直接量子协议
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2245 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2245 We present a symmetry-enabled direct quantum protocol for computing many-body Green's functions, a central tool for studying strongly correlated quantum systems. Our protocol relies only on native time evolution and straightforward measurements available on current hardware platforms. By exploiting parity symmetry—satisfied by a broad class of Hamiltonians in condensed matter physics and quantum chemistry, including the Fermi–Hubbard and Heisenberg models—we introduce a tailored quench spectroscopy scheme that recovers both the real and imaginary parts of two-point time correlators, from which Green's functions can be reconstructed via efficient classical signal processing. We further develop a tailored symmetric quantum Gibbs sampler that prepares parity-resolved (symmetric and antisymmetric) thermal states, enabling finite-temperature extensions within the same framework. Finally, we show that the same symmetry-based measurement primitive extends naturally to out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). Our results provide a practical route to estimating symmetry-resolved dynamical correlators on near-term and early fault-tolerant quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了一种利用对称性计算多体格林函数的直接量子协议，该协议仅依赖于现有硬件上的原生时间演化和简单测量。通过利用宇称对称性，研究人员引入了一种定制的淬火光谱方案，可恢复两点时间关联函数的实部和虚部。此外，该工作还开发了一种对称量子吉布斯采样器，以实现有限温度下的扩展，并表明该对称性测量原语可自然扩展到时间反序关联函数。
authors: Changhao Yi and Cunlu Zhou

articles.title: Scalable Neural Wave Functions via Information Mixing and Hierarchical Network Architectures
articles.title_zh: 基于信息混合与分层网络架构的可扩展神经波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Numerically simulating quantum many-body systems is one of the central challenges in modern physics, as the exponential growth of the Hilbert space with system size renders large-scale exact solutions intractable. Over the past decade, generative artificial neural networks have emerged as powerful wave function ansätze that have powered advances in finding ground state representations, reconstructing quantum states from data, and modeling dynamics in quantum many-body systems. While recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are computationally efficient, the recurrent nature can limit their capacity to capture long-range correlations. Transformer models with their underlying self-attention mechanism excel at capturing these long-range correlations, but incur increased computational requirements, restricting applications to small physical systems. In this work, we address these limitations by exploring the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) mixer model as a wave function ansatz. By mixing information globally and locally through the system via a computationally lightweight mixing strategy, this architecture promises to combine the ability to capture long-range correlations with low computational costs. We benchmark the model on finding ground state representations of two-dimensional quantum many-body systems in various phases of matter and investigate the behavior of representational accuracy and computational efficiency for different physical system sizes. By comparing its performance to RNNs and transformer models with single-site and patched input definitions, we demonstrate that the MLP mixer architecture performs competitively with state-of-the-art network models. We further show that a hierarchical combination of this model with the transformer model outperforms other state-of-the-art architectures for large-scale quantum systems, opening new avenues for investigating quantum phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟量子多体系统面临希尔伯特空间指数增长的挑战。该工作探索了多层感知机（MLP）混合器模型作为一种波函数拟设，旨在克服循环神经网络（RNNs）在捕获长程关联方面的局限性以及Transformer模型的高计算成本。通过计算轻量级的信息混合策略，该架构有望结合捕获长程关联的能力，为大规模量子多体系统模拟提供可扩展的解决方案。
authors: Faith Oyedemi, Stefanie Czischek

articles.title: Transversal syndrome extraction: A unifying construction for measuring the error syndromes of any stabilizer code
articles.title_zh: 横向纠错子提取：一种用于测量任意稳定子码错误纠错子的统一构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant syndrome extraction is fundamental to stabilizer-code-based quantum error correction, yet existing general protocols incur substantial costs in either circuit depth or width. In this work, we design ancilla stabilizer states for a general transversal circuit to construct a family of fault-tolerant syndrome-extraction gadgets that interpolate between Shor and Steane syndrome extraction for any stabilizer code. The result is a configurable trade-off between circuit depth and width.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错纠错子提取是基于稳定子码的量子纠错的基础，但现有通用协议在电路深度或宽度上成本高昂。该工作为通用横向电路设计了辅助稳定子态，构建了一系列容错纠错子提取装置。这些装置可以在Shor和Steane纠错子提取之间进行插值，适用于任何稳定子码，从而实现了电路深度和宽度之间的可配置权衡。
authors: Miles D. Gorman

articles.title: FVQKD: A Formal Verification of Quantum Key Distribution Security in Rocq
articles.title_zh: FVQKD：Rocq中量子密钥分发安全性的形式化验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD), whose security is derived from quantum mechanics rather than computational assumptions, is moving into standardization and commercial deployment. Yet its security guarantees rest on technically delicate proofs checked by hand. Formal verification closes this gap, establishing a two-factor assurance: unconditional security from physical principles, and machine-checked proofs against reasoning errors. We present FVQKD, a Rocq library for machine-checking QKD security proofs. Its first result is a complete, end-to-end machine-checked proof of composable, finite-key security for BB84. The mechanization reconstructs the complete proof infrastructure from first principles, including the smooth entropy framework, the entropic uncertainty relation, and the Quantum Leftover Hash Lemma. It uncovers necessary side conditions that the published argument leaves unstated, one of which reveals a missing proof branch, and it grounds the information-theoretic bound in a formal semantics of protocol execution, which the pen-and-paper analysis lacks. The proof is entirely admit-free, relying only on the Rocq kernel and standard foundational axioms. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end formal verification of a QKD security proof. Built on MathComp, MathComp-Analysis, and CoqQ, the development provides quantum-information infrastructure designed for reuse across broader QKD variants and quantum cryptography applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全性依赖于量子力学原理，但其证明过程复杂且易出错。该工作提出了FVQKD，一个用于机器验证QKD安全证明的Rocq库。它首次实现了BB84协议可组合、有限密钥安全性的完整端到端机器验证证明。该机械化证明从第一性原理重建了完整的证明基础设施，并揭示了现有手写证明中未说明的必要条件和缺失的证明分支，为协议执行的信息论界限提供了形式化语义基础。
authors: Ruixuan Deng, Zhengfeng Ji, Jiayu Zhang, Li Zhou

articles.title: Time-reversal-based quantum metrology in a central-spin architecture: from SATIN to butterfly echo
articles.title_zh: 中心自旋架构中基于时间反演的量子计量学：从SATIN到蝴蝶回波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate quantum-enhanced time-reversal-based metrology using the central spin model, in which a single ancilla spin of magnitude Sₘ̊ cₑₙ mediates interactions between N bath spins through a star-graph topology. We demonstrate that the SATIN (Signal Amplification Through Time-reversal Interaction) echo protocol can be implemented in this setup to achieve a Fisher information of N²/e with the collective łangle J_yångle readout, corresponding to a 4.34,dB offset from the Heisenberg limit. Furthermore, we establish that this platform provides a pathway to perform the butterfly echo protocol by conjugating each evolution step with a random collective bath rotation, thereby achieving axis-agnostic Heisenberg-scaled sensing. Crucially, with a small N-independent number of random steps, the butterfly echo reaches a Fisher information of N²/4 (6,dB below the Heisenberg limit) for any unknown encoding axis, with the plateau gain tracking the Haar limit. Finally, we demonstrate that the central-spin magnitude Sₘ̊ cₑₙ provides a powerful knob to reduce the optimal protocol timescale without altering the metrological ceiling or the circuit depth required to reach isotropy. The proposed scheme is relevant to cavity QED and NMR quantum processors, where the central spin architecture arises naturally.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用中心自旋模型，探索了量子增强的时间反演计量学。研究表明，SATIN回波协议可在该设置中实现，达到接近海森堡极限的费舍尔信息。此外，该平台还可实现蝴蝶回波协议，通过随机集体浴旋转共轭每个演化步骤，实现轴无关的海森堡尺度传感。中心自旋的大小提供了一个有效旋钮，可在不改变计量上限或电路复杂性的情况下缩短最佳协议时间尺度。
authors: Aditya Kumar, Sayan Choudhury

articles.title: A simple proof of unitary parallelization via port-based teleportation
articles.title_zh: 基于端口的隐形传态实现酉并行化的简单证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Port-based teleportation (PBT) is a variant of quantum teleportation that does not require corrections on the teleported state: starting with N shared EPR states, Alice can teleport a qudit to Bob by performing a measurement on her system and informing Bob which of his N `ports' to retrieve the state, up to infidelity decaying with N. Existing quantum circuits of PBT rely on representation theory tools and the mixed Schur transform. In this note, we report an elementary efficient circuit for PBT, which has depth øperatornamepolylog(N,d). As a corollary, this gives a simple proof that all n-qubit unitaries can be parallelized to øperatornamepoly(n) depth, recovering a recent result due to Nehoran--Slote--Yuen and OpenAI.
articles.abstract_zh: 端口隐形传态（PBT）是一种无需对隐形传态态进行校正的量子隐形传态变体。该文提出了一种基本且高效的PBT电路，其深度为多对数(N,d)。作为一个推论，这提供了一个简单的证明，表明所有n量子比特酉算符都可以并行化到多项式(n)深度，从而重现了最近的研究成果。
authors: Anurag Anshu, Quynh T. Nguyen

articles.title: Noise redistribution by stabilizer codes: an organizing view of concatenated three-qubit codes
articles.title_zh: 稳定子码的噪声再分配：一种串联三量子比特码的组织视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an organizing framework for concatenated quantum error correction based on the observation that the syndrome projection of a stabilizer code reshapes the noise channel in a code-determined manner. For any stabilizer code, one level of QEC maps the physical noise to a block-diagonal logical channel whose diagonal Pauli weights are fixed by the code geometry. Coherences between different syndrome classes vanish, and no physical Pauli twirl is required to reach this block-diagonal form. Concatenation can then be viewed as the iteration of the same redistribution step: the dominant logical error after one level selects the code used at the next. We instantiate the framework with the two smallest stabilizer codes, the bit-flip and phase-flip codes, and apply it to amplitude damping. The redistribution rules give the concatenation protocol C₂₍hatσ_y) C₁₍hatσₓ₎, whose ideal-recovery fidelity scales as fₗ₌₁₋mathcal O(γ²⁾. Solving the crossover condition Fₗ>Fₗ₋₁ in the ideal-gate limit yields a critical damping parameter γ_capprox0.30; in terms of the initial channel fidelity, f=1-1.72755γ². Under the same ideal-recovery assumption, we compare the overall gate accuracy rate with that of the five-qubit code. The scope of the framework, in particular for coherent and correlated noise, is stated explicitly.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了一个串联量子纠错的组织框架，其核心思想是稳定子码的纠错子投影以代码决定的方式重塑噪声信道。对于任何稳定子码，一级量子纠错将物理噪声映射到块对角逻辑信道。串联可视为相同再分配步骤的迭代，即一级后的主导逻辑错误选择下一级使用的代码。该框架通过比特翻转和相位翻转码进行了实例化，并应用于振幅阻尼，给出了串联协议C₂₍hatσ_y) C₁₍hatσₓ₎，其理想恢复保真度随γ²缩放。
authors: Long Huang

articles.title: Reset-Enhanced Dissipative Quantum Metrology
articles.title_zh: 重置增强的耗散量子计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31249v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum metrology is ultimately shaped not only by measurements, but also by the dissipative dynamics that prepare and maintain the probe. Nevertheless, a general mechanism for enhancing both steady-state and transient precision in open quantum systems has been lacking. Here we show that adding a simple reset channel provides such a mechanism: reset acts as a minimal dissipative control that can enhance metrological precision without modifying the intrinsic Hamiltonian or applying continuous coherent driving. We derive a unified quantum-Fisher-information (QFI) reset-rate response identity, showing how reset enhances steady-state and transient estimation while revealing a sharp transient distinction. For static-parameter estimation in diagonal dynamics, reset leaves the leading short-time QFI unchanged; for the separate task of elapsed-time estimation, it generates an immediate drift contribution that can scale quadratically with the reset rate in the short-time limit. For frequency estimation, the enhancement is instead dominated by a genuinely quantum eigenvector contribution. These results establish reset as a simple dissipative resource for open-system quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计量学受测量和耗散动力学共同影响，但缺乏一种普遍增强开放量子系统稳态和瞬态精度的机制。该工作表明，添加一个简单的重置通道可提供此机制，作为一种最小耗散控制，能在不修改哈密顿量或施加连续相干驱动的情况下提高计量精度。研究推导了统一的量子费舍尔信息（QFI）重置率响应恒等式，揭示了重置如何增强稳态和瞬态估计，并建立了重置作为一种简单耗散资源的地位。
authors: Silan Li, Qingjun Tong, Ruicheng Bao

articles.title: Automating quantum circuit optimization with AI agents
articles.title_zh: 利用AI智能体自动化量子电路优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compiling quantum algorithms for real devices involves hard optimization problems that can decide whether an algorithm runs at scale. We present a general method for solving such problems with AI agents, with every result certified. It builds on autoresearch loops, in which agents iteratively improve programs against a fixed evaluator and which have recently improved quantum cryptanalysis circuits, and adds two elements: a frozen, exact verifier certifies every result, and this verifier, together with the challenge around it, is built by an agent that formulates the problem with a researcher and validates the verifier against a solved case, deliberately broken solutions and published results before any solution exists. The method applies to any optimization problem whose solutions can be verified exactly and efficiently. We apply it to three compilation problems in quantum simulation, namely fermion-to-qubit encoding, Hamiltonian layout and unitary synthesis. In each, the agents improved substantially on published or standard constructions, reducing the cost being optimized by up to 73% at the largest sizes tested and outperforming a state-of-the-art optimizer for fermion-to-qubit encodings. Every submission is a program accompanied by its agent's notes, so the ideas behind each improvement are recorded in human-readable form; later agents built on them, and we describe them here. These results open the way to automated, certified discovery across quantum circuit design and beyond.
articles.abstract_zh: 将量子算法编译到实际设备涉及复杂的优化问题。该文提出了一种利用AI智能体解决此类问题的通用方法，并对每个结果进行认证。该方法基于自研究循环，并引入了冻结的精确验证器来认证结果，以及由智能体构建验证器和挑战。该方法适用于任何可精确高效验证解决方案的优化问题，并在费米子到量子比特编码、哈密顿量布局和酉合成等量子模拟编译问题中取得了显著改进，将优化成本降低了高达73%。
authors: Marcos Crichigno, Steve Flammia

articles.title: One-shot entanglement generation and distillation via Petz recovery and binary hypothesis testing
articles.title_zh: 基于Petz恢复和二元假设检验的一次性纠缠生成与蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How much entanglement can two distant laboratories share when their connection is noisy? We relate this question to deciding which of two quantum hypotheses is present. Our one-shot bounds apply to entanglement generation over a quantum channel and to one-way entanglement distillation from a shared state. We use Cheng's trace inequality to bound the infidelity of a Petz decoder in terms of a binary hypothesis testing cost. Applying the inequality before averaging over codes reduces the error analysis to computing a second moment of random subspaces. The proof covers every integer target dimension and treats rank-deficient states explicitly. A corollary expresses the achievable entanglement through hypothesis-testing coherent information, with a single logarithmic error slack and exact integer rounding. We also prove an error-preserving conversion from entanglement generation codes to entanglement transmission codes: the target dimension decreases by only a constant factor at fixed error, and the decoder is the original decoder followed by local processing. Consequently, for both entanglement generation and entanglement transmission, arbitrary pure reference-input states yield the same coherent-information rate, second-order Gaussian correction at the original error tolerance, and explicit achievable logarithmic remainder. For commuting testing hypotheses, the logarithmic remainder improves to a constant. These results give a direct route from binary distinguishability to explicit recovery guarantees and finite-resource quantum communication rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文探讨了在噪声信道下两个实验室能共享多少纠缠的问题，并将其与判断两种量子假设中的哪一种存在联系起来。研究提出了适用于量子信道上的纠缠生成和共享态单向纠缠蒸馏的一次性界限。通过使用Cheng的迹不等式，将Petz解码器的失真度与二元假设检验成本联系起来。该工作还证明了纠缠生成码到纠缠传输码的误差保持转换，从而为纠缠生成和传输提供了统一的理解。
authors: Matthew Can, Mark M. Wilde

articles.title: Problem-aware sampling for bias and variance reduction in randomised Hamiltonian simulation
articles.title_zh: 随机哈密顿量模拟中用于减少偏差和方差的问题感知采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Randomised quantum simulation algorithms such as qDRIFT reduce circuit depth by replacing deterministic product formulas with stochastic compilations, but achieving high accuracy can require many steps. In vanilla qDRIFT, Hamiltonian terms are sampled with probabilities proportional to their coefficient magnitudes. We propose StateDRIFT, a variant of qDRIFT which optimises its sampling distribution to estimate time-evolved quantities using knowledge of the initial state and target observable, with a provable truncation bound that keeps qDRIFT's guarantees. The distribution at each depth is chosen by solving an optimisation problem targeting bias and/or variance. StateDRIFT can significantly reduce the bias and variance of estimators, and hence circuit depth, which we test on short-time dynamics of lattice models and molecules under Jordan-Wigner up to 18 qubits. For example, with BeH2 StateDRIFT can reduce the number of two-qubit gates required to achieve a given accuracy from 11,201 to 983. StateDRIFT involves measuring observables and commutators on the initial state, so we propose two practical ways to estimate these: classical surrogates such as tensor networks, and classical shadows, which recover most or all of the saving from exact oracles in the systems tested.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机量子模拟算法如qDRIFT通过随机编译减少电路深度，但高精度通常需要大量步骤。该文提出了StateDRIFT，一种qDRIFT的变体，它利用初始态和目标可观测量的知识优化采样分布，以估计时间演化量。StateDRIFT通过解决针对偏差和/或方差的优化问题来选择每个深度的分布，从而显著减少估计器的偏差和方差，进而降低电路深度。该方法在多达18个量子比特的晶格模型和分子短时动力学中得到了验证，显示出显著的门数减少。
authors: Brian Coyle, Jonathan H. Fetherolf, Antonio Márquez Romero, Stefano Scali, Giuseppe Buonaiuto, Josh Kirsopp

articles.title: Screening strongly correlated materials in solid oxide cells with quantum simulation
articles.title_zh: 利用量子模拟筛选固体氧化物电池中的强关联材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop an end-to-end framework for assessing a quantum-computing application in industrial materials science: the screening of strongly correlated oxygen-electrode materials for SOFCs and SOECs. We formulate the materials problem in terms of interface observables including oxygen-vacancy formation energies, vacancy migration barriers, and electronic conductivity. We describe how these observables can be obtained using a diagrammatic GW-based embedding, either GW+DMFT or self-energy embedding theory (SEET), applied to a DFT-screened shortlist. The atomistic electrode/electrolyte interface defines the electronic structure problem from which the correlated impurity models are constructed. Quantum impurity solvers would provide the finite-temperature impurity Green's functions required by the embedding. The computational challenges that classical solvers may encounter as the interacting active space grows, together with the polynomial scaling of quantum Hamiltonian simulation for efficiently represented discretized models, open an opportunity for quantum advantage. We identify the benchmarks needed to assess this opportunity through convergence of vacancy and migration energetics and comparison with the best applicable classical solvers. We provide illustrative logical qubit counts and identify the thermal state preparation, simulation, measurement, and repeated-solve costs needed for a complete resource assessment. We connect microscopic observables to macroscopic engineering metrics using a continuum model for mixed ionic--electronic conducting oxygen electrodes that couples oxygen surface exchange, solid-state oxygen transport, electrode microstructure, and finite electrode thickness. Finally, we estimate the potential worldwide business value of improved electrode materials under SOFC and SOEC deployment scenarios informed by public technical targets and electrolyser deployment data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文开发了一个端到端框架，用于评估量子计算在工业材料科学中的应用，即筛选用于SOFCs和SOECs的强关联氧电极材料。研究将材料问题表述为界面可观测物，并描述了如何通过基于GW的嵌入方法获得这些可观测物。随着相互作用活性空间的增长，经典求解器面临计算挑战，而量子哈密顿量模拟的多项式缩放为量子优势提供了机会。该工作还确定了评估这一机会所需的基准。
authors: Ouns El Harzli, Jelle Bor, Linde Wester, Leonid Zhukov, Hanl Park, Jean-François Bobier, Matt Langione, Antonino Marco Saitta, Jonathan Owens, Richard Hart, Yudong Cao, François Jamet

articles.title: What does quantum parameter estimation estimate? A no-go result for true quantity values
articles.title_zh: 量子参数估计到底估计了什么？关于真实量值的一个“不可能”结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We examine the conditions under which quantum parameter estimation is compatible with the concept of a ``true'' quantity value: a unique value of the estimated quantity that exists prior to and independently of measurement. While quantum parameter estimation typically assumes that the quantity to be estimated is a parameter, we argue that this assumption can be lifted, opening the way to a more general formulation of estimation that may apply even in situations where the quantity to be estimated is no longer a parameter, but instead a quantum variable susceptible to quantum fluctuations. We identify three assumptions that characterize the way estimation is often presented in the quantum metrology literature, namely, as a procedure for inferring an unknown ``true value", which is assumed to be unique and to exist prior to and independently of measurement. Using our more general framework, we prove a no-go theorem showing that the preceding assumptions are jointly incompatible with two further assumptions: the completeness of the quantum state (no `hidden variables'), and the presence of entanglement between the probe systems and the system under measurement. We note that the presence of such entanglement is a generic prediction of standard quantum theory. Consequently, if one is not willing to accept hidden variables, nor willing to modify standard quantum theory by introducing a new physical mechanism that destroys entanglement at some scale or regime, then a realist account of estimation is ultimately impossible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子参数估计与“真实”量值概念的兼容性，即被估计量在测量之前独立存在的唯一值。研究发现，量子计量学中常用于推断未知“真实值”的三个假设，与量子态的完备性（无隐变量）以及探测系统与环境之间的纠缠这两个假设是共同不兼容的。这一“不可能”定理挑战了量子参数估计中关于真实量值的传统理解。
authors: Jacques L. Pienaar, Eran Tal, Asya Ciftci

articles.title: Strongly Regular Graph Construction via Quadratic Binary Optimization
articles.title_zh: 通过二次二元优化构建强正则图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30142v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Strongly regular graphs, hereafter SRGs, are highly structured combinatorial objects of central interest in algebraic graph theory and quantum information, whose explicit construction becomes rapidly intractable as the number of vertices grows; Conway's still unresolved 99-graph problem is an emblematic example. The matrix equation defining SRGs is quadratic in the binary edge variables, so the natural penalty enforcing it, a sum of squared residuals, is quartic and lies outside quadratic unconstrained binary optimization, known as QUBO. We prove a considerably stronger obstruction, namely that no quadratic function of the edge variables has the labeled SRGs as its exact set of global minimizers, except for three degenerate families given by the perfect matchings, the cocktail-party graphs and the pentagon. In particular, we formally establish that the 99-vertex graph of Conway's problem cannot be obtained from any QUBO over the edge variables without auxiliary variables. Guided by this theorem we develop two complementary algorithms. The first operates within pure QUBO, solves the degenerate families exactly, and beyond them works as a generate--prune--verify pipeline whose output is a reduced set of candidates certified by a polynomial-time classical test. The second solves the full problem by quadratizing this quartic penalty through Rosenberg auxiliary variables, whose number grows as Θ(N³⁾ with the number of vertices N. We test the pure-QUBO route under simulated annealing on all feasible families with at most 18 vertices and the auxiliary-variable route on representative targets up to 16 vertices, and tabulate the algebraically feasible parameter sets for graphs with at most 49 vertices.
articles.abstract_zh: 强正则图是代数图论和量子信息中的重要组合对象，但其显式构建随着顶点数量增加迅速变得难以处理。本文证明，除了三种退化族外，没有二次边变量函数能将标记的强正则图作为其全局最小值的精确集合。特别是，康威的99顶点图不能通过纯QUBO从边变量获得。基于此定理，作者开发了两种互补算法，其中一种在纯QUBO框架内精确解决了退化族问题。
authors: D. Osorio, P. Andagana, V. González, J. Czartowski, D. Goyeneche

articles.title: Discrete time liquids
articles.title_zh: 离散时间液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30266v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Discrete time crystals exhibit robust subharmonic oscillations, spontaneously breaking the discrete time-translation symmetry of a periodic drive. Since their emergence, the question of whether other types of temporal many-body order can exist has attracted considerable attention. Here we identify discrete time liquids -- a new form of spatiotemporal order characterized by short-range temporal coherence as a result of time-solitons. We study a two-dimensional spin system coupled to a finite-temperature cavity, whose fluctuations provide a noisy, approximately periodic drive with only finite temporal coherence. Remarkably, the spins nevertheless form a metastable state with robust period-doubled dynamics over an extended parameter regime. Unlike a time crystal, this state has only finite temporal coherence: individual trajectories stochastically switch between the two symmetry-related temporal configurations of the period-doubled response. We identify these switches as time-solitons: topological defects in temporal order that preserve local period doubling while destroying long-range temporal coherence, thereby producing the time liquid state. We propose a minimal model which reproduces the distribution of temporal correlations of the many-body system, suggesting a general description of the time liquid as a time crystal with a finite density of time-solitons. Because these solitons can occur at arbitrary times, ensemble averaging restores continuous time-translation symmetry, raising the intriguing possibility that discrete time liquids can exist in thermal equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散时间晶体展现出鲁棒的次谐波振荡，而本文识别出一种新的时空序形式——离散时间液体。这种液体以短程时间相干性为特征，由时间孤子引起。研究发现，在噪声驱动下，二维自旋系统仍能形成具有鲁棒倍周期动力学的亚稳态。与时间晶体不同，时间液体具有有限的时间相干性，其个体轨迹在两种对称相关的倍周期响应配置之间随机切换，这些切换被识别为时间孤子。
authors: Zuo Wang, Paul M. Schindler, Marin Bukov, Marios H. Michael

articles.title: Non-adiabatic Optimisation via Localisation-Delocalisation Transitions
articles.title_zh: 通过局域化-离域化转变实现非绝热优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30301v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The promise of efficiently solving classical optimisation problems on quantum computers is tantalizing. As many such problems can be mapped to approximating the ground state of spin-glasses, paradigmatic models for studying many-body localisation, it is natural to ask if some of the intuition coming from quantum statistical mechanics can help guide the construction of novel quantum optimisation algorithms. In this work, we discuss how continuous reverse quantum annealing crossing a many-body localisation transition can be accelerated by considering the density of Landau-Zener crossings as the system is quenched. We provide an interpretation of this behaviour in terms of an effective Fokker-Planck equation for the success probability of the algorithm. This interpretation suggests an improvement in the required annealing time as a function of the system size N, which goes from O(m̊ poly(N)) to O(1) for reference states with non-vanishing energy density. We show that the continuous dynamics can be Trotterised with a number of steps that remains modest as system size increases, making it appealing for near-term devices. For the resulting circuit implementation, we provide a quantitative strategy for determining the parameters of the time-dependent Hamiltonian. We compare the performance of our digitised algorithm, which we call FRIO, against that of the QAOA for finding the ground state of spin-glass problems, in particular the SK model. The numerical results suggest that with suitably selected circuit parameters which can be efficiently found using thermalizing dynamics, FRIO almost always outperforms the conventional QAOA ansatz with pre-optimized angles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了如何通过跨越多体局域化转变的连续逆向量子退火来加速优化过程。通过考虑朗道-齐纳交叉点的密度，研究发现算法的成功概率可以通过有效的福克-普朗克方程来解释。这种方法有望将所需的退火时间从O(poly(N))改进到O(1)，对于近期的量子设备具有吸引力。
authors: Ryan Smith, Sabrina Yue Wang, Filippo Maria Gambetta, Raul A. Santos

articles.title: Extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity in the hole-doped Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 空穴掺杂Hubbard模型中条纹序与超导电性之间的极端竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30321v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The two-dimensional Hubbard model was originally proposed as the minimal model of uniform d-wave superconductivity in the cuprate high-temperature superconductors, but recent calculations with relevant parameters in a realistic doping regime have often found other ground states. Further, uncertainty remains over such results due to the intrinsic bias of different computational methods. Here we address this uncertainty through state-of-the-art neural tensor network and neural backflow state simulations, enabled by large-scale GPU computation, that together reach an unprecedented variational accuracy on lattices with up to 1024 sites. At 1/8 doping in the pure Hubbard model, as well as with next-nearest-neighbor hopping relevant to the hole-doped cuprates, we reveal a near degeneracy among a low-energy uniform d-wave state, superconducting stripes, and non-superconducting stripe states on the milli-t energy scale. Our work rebalances the narrative that the Hubbard model supports a single dominant order in relevant parameter regimes towards a picture of extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维Hubbard模型曾被认为是铜酸盐高温超导体中均匀d波超导的最小模型。本文通过先进的神经网络张量网络和神经回流态模拟，揭示了在1/8掺杂的纯Hubbard模型中，低能均匀d波态、超导条纹态和非超导条纹态之间存在毫电子伏特能量尺度的近简并性。这项工作表明，Hubbard模型在相关参数区域内并非支持单一主导序，而是条纹序与超导电性之间存在极端竞争。
authors: Ao Chen, Johnnie Gray, Si-Jing Du, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan

articles.title: Hierarchical Reduction of Invariant Subspaces: From Fragmentation to Many-Body Scars
articles.title_zh: 不变子空间的层次化约：从碎裂到多体疤痕态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30597v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate a hierarchy of invariant Hilbert-space structures connecting Hilbert-space fragmentation, partial solvability, and quantum many-body scars. For spin chains with fragmented spin-1/2 subspaces and their local deformations, we show, using the spin-1 XXC chain as a representative example, how successive local deformations reduce extensive irreducible-string fragmentation through an implicitly embedded spin-1/2 invariant space and ultimately to a single scar tower, connecting the XXC, perturbed XXC, and spin-1 XY scar models. Through the intermediate embedded space, local dynamics couples states from distinct frozen irreducible-string sectors and selects a new decomposition into representations, from which smaller invariant spaces can be retained. We also establish a rigidity constraint on isolating nonsymmetric towers and a constructive correspondence that transfers a reduction between locally realizable representations of the embedded dynamics. The latter demonstrates that the reduction hierarchy can be transferred through a unitary transformation within the embedded subspace, yielding an exact scar tower built on a Néel reference state without requiring unitary equivalence of the full Hamiltonians.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了连接希尔伯特空间碎裂、部分可解性和量子多体疤痕态的不变希尔伯特空间结构的层次。以自旋-1 XXC链为例，展示了连续的局部形变如何通过隐式嵌入的自旋-1/2不变空间，将广泛的不可约字符串碎裂最终约化为单个疤痕塔。研究还建立了隔离非对称塔的刚性约束，并证明了约化层次可以通过嵌入子空间内的酉变换进行转移，从而产生基于Néel态的精确疤痕塔。
authors: Chihiro Matsui

articles.title: Predictive electronic feedback control for narrow-linewidth lasers
articles.title_zh: 用于窄线宽激光器的预测性电子反馈控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31396v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Narrow-linewidth lasers are essential for various key atom-laser interaction processes and optical setups in quantum coherent control, quantum precision measurement, and quantum information science. The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) technique is the standard method for the frequency-stabilization of narrow-linewidth lasers, but the inherent time delay in its feedback loop inevitably induces excessive phase noise, commonly known as servo bumps. Previous solutions primarily rely on additional optical components outside the electronic feedback control loop. Here, we propose and implement a generic method based on the Smith predictor to address the time-delay issue entirely within the electronic part of the PDH feedback control loop. We systematically demonstrate its capability to suppress phase noise and reduce servo bumps by adding only a single Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) controller to the loop. This class of methods is demonstrated to be conceptually concise with minimal hardware overhead, effective in practice, and holds potential for a wide variety of future applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 窄线宽激光器在量子相干控制和精密测量中至关重要，但Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) 技术的固有时间延迟会引入过多的相位噪声。本文提出并实现了一种基于史密斯预测器的通用方法，在PDH反馈控制回路的电子部分完全解决了时间延迟问题。通过仅增加一个FPGA控制器，该方法能有效抑制相位噪声并减少伺服峰，具有概念简洁、硬件开销小且实际效果显著的优点。
authors: Jiatian Liu, Xuan Qi, Xiayang Fan, Shenchao Jin, Yuan Sun

articles.title: Computational reach of machine learning models is independent of untrained quantum resources
articles.title_zh: 机器学习模型的计算能力与未经训练的量子资源无关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2309.13967v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper proves that if an untrained quantum circuit is used as a resource in a machine learning model, then on average no resource quantum circuit is better than any other that can achieve the same set of computational effects. The paper also proves a supporting theorem that even if certain mild idealisations are omitted, the average quantum advantage remains negligible at best. These results cast serious doubt on several proposals to use untrained quantum circuits in machine learning models: at best such claims should be substantiated empirically, as this paper proves there is no a priori theoretical reason to suppose that introducing an untrained quantum circuit will increase performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，在机器学习模型中使用未经训练的量子电路作为资源时，平均而言，任何能实现相同计算效果的量子电路都不会比其他电路更好。即使省略某些温和的理想化条件，平均量子优势也至多微不足道。这些结果对使用未经训练的量子电路于机器学习模型的提议提出了严重质疑，表明引入未经训练的量子电路并无先验理论依据能提升性能。
authors: Steven Herbert

articles.title: Operator quantum singular value transformation: Spectral mapping, design and topological invariants
articles.title_zh: 算子量子奇异值变换：谱映射、设计与拓扑不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2401.09007v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) provides a unifying framework for quantum algorithms by applying the polynomials of quantum signal processing (QSP) to block-encoded matrices. We connect this framework with spectral analysis, design and topological protection in condensed matter physics. Extending QSVT beyond matrices to possibly infinite-dimensional operators (operator QSVT), we establish the following. First, it transforms every block of the operator by the QSP polynomials; no singular value decomposition is needed. Second, a spectral mapping theorem determines the full spectrum of the QSVT operator, including continuous spectra, from the embedded operator through the QSP polynomial, allowing spectral analysis without translation invariance. Third, the spectral mapping turns QSP into spectral design: the QSP phases can stretch, fold and separate the bands and place the eigenvalues. Finally, the kernel sectors that conventional QSVT usually sets aside carry a topological index, invariant under the choice of QSP phases, local perturbations and gap-preserving deformations, which guarantees topologically protected states. These results unify two quantum walks: Szegedy's walk from quantum algorithms and the split-step walk from condensed matter physics. Their kernel sectors encode the graph's Euler characteristic and the difference of bulk winding numbers, respectively. For the split-step walk, QSP breaks chiral symmetry but not the topological protection, and can move the protected state into a continuous band to form a bound state in the continuum (BIC).
articles.abstract_zh: 量子奇异值变换（QSVT）通过将量子信号处理（QSP）多项式应用于块编码矩阵，为量子算法提供了一个统一框架。本文将QSVT扩展到可能无限维的算子，建立了算子QSVT的谱映射定理，无需奇异值分解即可确定算子的完整谱。谱映射将QSP转化为谱设计，QSP相位可以拉伸、折叠和分离能带并放置特征值。此外，传统的QSVT通常忽略的核空间携带一个拓扑指数，保证了拓扑保护态的存在。
authors: Chusei Kiumi, Yohei Tanaka, Akito Suzuki

articles.title: Sparse SYK quantum batteries: Boosting quantum efficiency by reducing complexity
articles.title_zh: 稀疏SYK量子电池：通过降低复杂性提升量子效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.17679v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the context of energy storage at the nanoscale, exploring the notion of quantum advantage implies walking on the thin line at the boundary between quantum mechanics and thermodynamics, which underpins our conventional understanding of battery devices. With no classical analogue, the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model has emerged in the last years as a promising platform to boost charging and storage efficiency thanks to its highly-entangling dynamics. Here, we explore how the robustness of this setup by considering the sparse version of the SYK model, showing that, as long as chaos is not completely broken, reducing its complexity may lead to more efficient quantum batteries amplifying the charging power.
articles.abstract_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型因其高度纠缠的动力学，已成为提升纳米尺度能量存储效率的平台。本文研究了稀疏版SYK模型的鲁棒性，发现只要混沌未完全破坏，降低其复杂性反而能带来更高效的量子电池，从而放大充电功率。这为设计更实用的量子电池提供了新思路。
authors: Giovanni Sisorio, Alberto Cappellaro, Luca Dell'Anna

articles.title: Meta-learning of Gibbs states for many-body Hamiltonians with applications to Quantum Boltzmann Machines
articles.title_zh: 多体哈密顿量吉布斯态的元学习及其在量子玻尔兹曼机中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.16373v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The preparation of quantum Gibbs states is a fundamental challenge in quantum computing, essential for applications ranging from modeling open quantum systems to quantum machine learning. Building on the Meta-Variational Quantum Eigensolver framework proposed by Cervera-Lierta et al. and a problem-driven ansatz design, we introduce two meta-learning algorithms: Meta-Variational Quantum Thermalizer (Meta-VQT) and Neural Network Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT) for efficient thermal state preparation of parametrized Hamiltonians on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. Meta-VQT utilizes a fully quantum ansatz, while NN Meta-VQT integrates a quantum--classical hybrid architecture. Both use collective optimization over a finite set of training parameter values to prepare approximate Gibbs states at held-out parameter values within the sampled parameter domain. We validate our methods on Transverse Field Ising Models (TFIM) with up to eight qubits and on a two-qubit Heisenberg model with all field terms. Within these finite-size benchmarks, the trained models accurately prepare thermal states at test points inside the training interval. For the six and eight qubit cases of TFIM, meta-learned parameters when combined with appropriately designed ansatz serve as warm-start initializations, significantly outperforming random initializations in the optimization tasks. Furthermore, a 3 qubit Kitaev ring example showcases our algorithm's effectiveness across finite-temperature crossover regimes. Finally, we apply our algorithms to train a Quantum Boltzmann Machine (QBM) on a 2-qubit Heisenberg model with all field terms, achieving enhanced training efficiency, improved Gibbs state accuracy, and a 30-fold runtime speedup over existing techniques such as variational quantum imaginary time (VarQITE)-based QBM highlighting the practicality of meta-algorithm-based QBMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子吉布斯态的制备是量子计算中的一个基本挑战。本文基于元变分量子本征求解器框架，提出了两种元学习算法：Meta-VQT和NN-Meta VQT，用于在NISQ设备上高效制备参数化哈密顿量的热态。这些算法通过对有限训练参数值集进行集体优化，能在采样参数域内为未见参数值制备近似吉布斯态。研究在横场伊辛模型和海森堡模型上验证了方法的有效性。
authors: Ruchira V Bhat, Rahul Bhowmick, Avinash Singh, Krishna Kumar Sabapathy

articles.title: Distillation of supersinglet states
articles.title_zh: 超单态的蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.20962v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce an entanglement distillation (purification) protocol for supersinglet states composed of N qubits. The supersinglet state we target is a total spin zero state with zero spin variance, and has a fully entangled structure involving all qubits. In our distillation protocol, three copies of an initial spin zero state are measured in the local total spin basis such that a higher fidelity supersinglet state is generated upon postselection. The initial state can be prepared using conventional Bell state distillation methods distributed in a way to target the supersinglet symmetries. The protocol uses only local operations and classical communications, and is suitable for long-distance applications such as quantum clock synchronization and cryptography, and avoids a high dimensional Schur transform such that it can be used for tasks such as quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于N量子比特超单态的纠缠蒸馏（纯化）协议。该协议通过测量三个初始自旋零态的局部总自旋基，在后选择后生成更高保真度的超单态。该协议仅使用局部操作和经典通信，适用于量子时钟同步和密码学等长距离应用，并避免了高维舒尔变换，可用于量子计量等任务。
authors: Saeed Ahmad, Shuang Li, Jonathan Raghoonanan, Kaixuan Zhou, Valentin Ivannikov, Tim Byrnes

articles.title: Imaginary-time-enhanced feedback-based quantum algorithms for universal ground-state preparation
articles.title_zh: 虚时间增强的反馈式量子算法用于通用基态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13044v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Preparing ground states of strongly correlated quantum systems is a central goal in quantum simulation and optimization. The feedback-based quantum algorithm (FALQON) provides an attractive alternative to variational methods with a fully quantum feedback rule, but it fails in the presence of spectral degeneracies, where the feedback signal collapses and the evolution cannot reach the ground state. Using the Fermi-Hubbard model on lattices up to 3x3, we show that this breakdown appears at half-filling on the 2x2 lattice and extends to both half-filled and doped configurations on the 3x3 lattice. We then introduce an imaginary-time-enhanced FALQON (iFALQON) scheme, which inserts short imaginary-time evolution steps into the feedback loop. This proposed method suppresses excited-state components, escapes degenerate subspaces, restores monotonic energy descent and improves ground-state convergence across the tested fillings. We further benchmark its performance against existing methods, showing improved results for iFALQON, demonstrating the potential of hybrid real-imaginary-time feedback dynamics for ground-state preparation in strongly correlated quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 基态制备是量子模拟和优化的核心目标。反馈式量子算法（FALQON）在存在谱简并时会失效，导致无法达到基态。本文引入了一种虚时间增强的FALQON（iFALQON）方案，通过在反馈循环中插入短虚时间演化步骤来抑制激发态成分并逃离简并子空间。该方法恢复了单调能量下降并改善了基态收敛性，在基态制备中展现了混合实虚时间反馈动力学的潜力。
authors: Thanh Nguyen Van Long, Lan Nguyen Tran, Le Bin Ho

articles.title: Hall's Exact Uncertainty Relation and the Geometry of Krylov-Space Operator Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 霍尔精确不确定关系与克雷洛夫空间算符动力学的几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20359v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Krylov representations of operator dynamics encode two inequivalent motions: probability transport along the discrete Krylov chain and motion of the normalized amplitude vector on the associated sphere. We lift Hall's exact uncertainty relation to Liouville space and show that, for the fixed Krylov-basis measurement, its classical Fisher information locally attains the quantum Fisher information. The amplitude vector therefore follows an exact constant-speed spherical trajectory. We construct its moving frame, identifying the first Lanczos coefficient with the speed and the higher coefficients with successive bending. Geodesic curvature controls the leading departure from Mandelstam-Tamm saturation. Separately, we compare cumulative and pointwise bounds on Krylov-index transport, which depends on the full Lanczos sequence.
articles.abstract_zh: 算符动力学的克雷洛夫表示编码了两种不等价的运动。本文将霍尔精确不确定关系提升到李ouville空间，并证明在固定的克雷洛夫基测量下，其经典费雪信息局部达到量子费雪信息。因此，振幅矢量遵循精确的匀速球面轨迹。研究还构建了其动坐标系，并将第一个Lanczos系数识别为速度，更高阶系数识别为连续弯曲，测地曲率控制着偏离Mandelstam-Tamm饱和的主要程度。
authors: Mohsen Alishahiha, Souvik Banerjee

articles.title: Structured Unitary Tensor Network Representations for Circuit-Efficient Quantum Data Encoding
articles.title_zh: 用于电路高效量子数据编码的结构化酉张量网络表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.16266v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Encoding classical data into quantum states is a central bottleneck in quantum machine learning: many widely used encodings are circuit-inefficient, requiring deep circuits and substantial quantum resources, which limits scalability on quantum hardware. In this work, we propose tensor network-based quantum data encoding (TNQE), a circuit-efficient framework built on structured unitary tensor network (TN) representations. TNQE first represents each classical input via a TN decomposition and then compiles the resulting tensor cores into an encoding circuit through two complementary core-to-circuit strategies. To make this compilation trainable while respecting the unitary nature of quantum operations, we introduce a unitary-aware constraint that parameterizes TN cores as learnable block unitaries, enabling them to be directly optimized and directly encoded as quantum operators. The proposed TNQE framework enables explicit control over circuit depth and qubit resources, allowing the construction of shallow, resource-efficient circuits. Across a range of benchmarks, TNQE achieves encoding circuits as shallow as 0.04× the depth of amplitude encoding, while naturally scaling to high-resolution images (256 × 256) and demonstrating practical feasibility on real quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 将经典数据编码为量子态是量子机器学习中的一个关键瓶颈，现有编码方法通常电路效率低下。本文提出了一种基于张量网络（TN）的量子数据编码（TNQE）框架，该框架利用结构化酉张量网络表示。TNQE通过将张量核编译成编码电路，并引入酉感知约束，使TN核可学习并直接优化。该框架能够显式控制电路深度和量子比特资源，从而构建浅层且资源高效的电路。
authors: Guang Lin, Toshihisa Tanaka, Qibin Zhao

articles.title: Many-body localization
articles.title_zh: 多体局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12464v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an introductory review of nonergodic dynamics in interacting many-body quantum systems, focusing on the phenomenon of many-body localization (MBL). We describe aspects of MBL and summarize the evidence for a crossover from the ergodic to the MBL regime in finite systems, using the paradigmatic XXZ model as an example. We then broaden the scope to other models to illustrate the generality of the phenomenon. We briefly touch on the largely unexplored relation between MBL and quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对相互作用多体量子系统中的非遍历动力学进行了介绍性综述，重点关注多体局域化（MBL）现象。文章描述了MBL的各个方面，并总结了有限系统中从遍历到MBL区域交叉的证据，以XXZ模型为例。此外，还探讨了MBL与其他模型的普遍性，并简要提及了MBL与量子计算之间尚未充分探索的关系。
authors: Jakub Zakrzewski

articles.title: Rigorous error bounds for dissipative thermal state preparation from weak system-bath coupling
articles.title_zh: 弱系统-浴耦合下耗散热态制备的严格误差界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03011v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Thermal state preparation is a central challenge in the simulation of quantum many-body systems. Yet, provably efficient algorithms for this task were only introduced recently [Chen et al. Nature 646, 561 (2025)]. These algorithms are based on dissipative Lindbladian evolution which exactly fixes the thermal state. Controlled and efficient digital simulation of this evolution, although possible in principle, remains out of reach for present-day quantum hardware. Subsequent work has therefore focused on analog approximations of the proposed Lindbladians via `collision models' with relatively modest requirements -- a resettable bath of ancilla qubits whose couplings to the system can be tuned in time-dependent fashion -- while still admitting rigorous fixed-point error bounds. Existing rigorous approaches, however, do not exploit the fact that these constructions generically implement not only the desired Lindblad dynamics, but also an additional unitary evolution generated by the system Hamiltonian which may aid convergence to the thermal state [Lloyd and Abanin arXiv:2506.21318 (2025)]. Here, we show that this unitary contribution does indeed tighten the fixed-point error bound and demonstrate that it is rigorously controlled by the system-bath coupling strength J, scaling as J². This demonstrates that the effect of the spurious `Lamb shift' term generated by the system-bath interaction can be controlled by tuning J. We clarify the role, previously observed, of a randomized implementation in suppressing possible resonances of the drive with the many-body spectrum, and bound the additional variance that this randomization imposes on observables. Finally, we numerically study aspects of the protocol which are relevant for its practical realization, such as the mixing time.
articles.abstract_zh: 热态制备是量子多体系统模拟中的核心挑战。最近提出的算法基于耗散Lindbladian演化，但其数字模拟对现有量子硬件仍难以实现。现有严格方法未充分利用系统哈密顿量产生的额外酉演化对收敛的潜在帮助。本文旨在展示这种酉贡献如何影响耗散热态制备的误差界限，并提供更严格的分析。
authors: Christopher Ong, S. A. Parameswaran, Benedikt Placke, Dominik Hahn

articles.title: Faster matrix product state preparation by exploiting symmetry-induced block-sparsity
articles.title_zh: 利用对称性诱导的块稀疏性加速矩阵乘积态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28489v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Matrix product states (MPS) serve as a key tool for studying quantum systems from chemistry and condensed-matter physics, making their preparation on quantum computers an important task in interfacing classical and quantum simulation. Many systems of interest have U(1)-symmetries induced by particle number and spin projection conservation, allowing to restrict the MPS tensors to be of block-sparse form, a property widely used in the implementation of classical algorithms such as the density matrix renormalization group. We reduce the cost of fault-tolerantly preparing block-sparse MPS within the standard ancilla-assisted linear-depth approach by implementing row and column permutations that transform the block-sparse matrices into block-diagonal form. These block-diagonal unitaries are then implemented via unitary synthesis, with the cost being determined by the size of the largest block. In this context, we modify the unitary synthesis approach of Berry et al. in order to reduce the Toffoli cost for real-valued unitaries by a factor of sqrt2. In numerical benchmarks, we achieve Toffoli cost improvement factors of 10 - 30 compared to the state-of-the-art for MPS of various molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 矩阵乘积态（MPS）是研究量子系统的关键工具，其在量子计算机上的制备至关重要。本文通过利用U(1)对称性导致的MPS张量块稀疏性，提出了一种降低容错制备块稀疏MPS成本的方法。通过行和列置换将块稀疏矩阵转换为块对角形式，并修改酉合成方法以减少Toffoli门成本。数值基准测试显示，该方法可将Toffoli门成本降低10-30倍。
authors: Felix Rupprecht, Sabine Wölk

articles.title: Bounding Classical and Quantum Correlations in Bayesian Networks with Quasiprobabilities
articles.title_zh: 贝叶斯网络中经典和量子关联的准概率界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.23372v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bell's theorem reveals that quantum theory is in tension with classical causal reasoning and, in particular, the notion of local causality. This is now understood as a particular example of non-classicality in the study of correlations in (Bayesian) networks with both unobserved and observed nodes: the correlations are probability distributions over the observed nodes. There is a great deal of work aiming to understand the bounds on quantum and classical correlations in such networks and one approach is to consider outer approximations to the former. Along these lines, we consider quasiprobabilistic models for Bayesian networks, which can be seen as classical models but the probability distributions involving unobserved nodes are "replaced" with quasiprobabilities that respect normalisation but not positivity. We denote the set of correlations resulting from these models as the quasi set. Such models have a history in the study of Bell-type non-classicality where it has been shown that they can produce all non-signalling correlations. We show a generalisation of this result for a broad class of networks, which motivates a conjecture that the quasi set recovers the so called nested Markov model. Our work utilises a connection to tensor network decompositions, which may be of independent interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔定理揭示了量子理论与经典因果推理的张力。本文通过引入贝叶斯网络中的准概率模型，来研究经典和量子关联的界限。这些模型将涉及未观测节点的概率分布替换为尊重归一化但不尊重正性的准概率。研究表明，对于一类广泛的网络，这些模型可以产生所有非信号关联，从而推广了现有结果。
authors: Paul Becsi, Matty J. Hoban

articles.title: Fault-Tolerant Logical Operations and Efficient State Preparation in Modular Quantum Architectures with Noisy Interfaces
articles.title_zh: 模块化量子架构中带噪声接口的容错逻辑操作与高效态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27204v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modular quantum computing is a leading paradigm for scaling quantum computation beyond the resource limitations of monolithic devices. In this architecture, multiple quantum processing units (QPUs), employing identical or distinct qubit modalities, are interconnected via shared entanglement. Here, we investigate how errors at module interfaces and within individual QPUs affect fault-tolerant computation when qubits are encoded using the rotated surface code. Going beyond the logical-memory benchmark, we perform circuit-level simulations of fault-tolerant nonlocal CNOT gates implemented via lattice surgery between QPUs connected by noisy Bell pairs, and analyze the resulting logical error rates. Our results show that interfaces can tolerate noise up to an order of magnitude higher than intra-QPU noise, with only a minor reduction in the fault-tolerance threshold. We further develop an efficient protocol for preparing distributed fault-tolerant logical GHZ states, reducing ancilla overhead, time, and nonlocal Bell-pair consumption. We show that ancilla minimization in this setting is equivalent to a vertex-cover problem on an associated graph, and introduce a polynomial-time heuristic algorithm for finding low-overhead solutions. Our results provide quantitative evidence that distributed quantum error correction can enable scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computation in modular architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 模块化量子计算是扩展量子计算规模的重要范式。本文研究了在旋转表面码编码下，模块接口和QPU内部错误如何影响容错计算。通过电路级模拟，结果表明接口可以容忍比QPU内部噪声高一个数量级的噪声，且对容错阈值影响甚微。此外，本文还开发了一种高效协议，用于制备分布式容错逻辑GHZ态，显著减少了辅助比特开销、时间和非局域贝尔对消耗。
authors: S. Siddardha Chelluri, Riccardo Mengoni, Tom Darras, Julien Laurat, Eleni Diamanti, Ioannis Lavdas

articles.title: Integral representations of quantum Rényi divergences on von Neumann algebras
articles.title_zh: 冯诺依曼代数上量子Rényi散度的积分表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21214v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove an integral representation of the α-z Rényi divergences for normal states on arbitrary von Neumann algebras. Along each ray z=cα, the divergence is a positive average of relative entropies evaluated in a canonical family of escort states. For orders α above one, we require the divergence to be finite, whereas for orders below one support inclusion suffices. An explicit boundary correction removes the lower-order support assumption. The proof uses a compatible weighted Haagerup L^p scale and applies outside the data-processing region. For faithful density matrices, we express the derivative of the escort relative entropy with respect to the Rényi order in terms of a nonnegative fluctuation quantity. Differences of order-one derivatives of the divergence give quantum Fisher information and Wigner-Yanase skew information. For faithful bipartite density matrices, we also express optimized conditional α-z entropies at orders above one as averages of ordinary conditional entropies. Further applications concern coherent-state divergences in quantum field theory and the optimizing order for the strong converse exponent in hypothesis-testing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了任意冯诺依曼代数上正规态的α-z Rényi散度的积分表示。沿每条射线z=cα，该散度是规范伴随态中相对熵的正平均值。对于α大于1的阶数，要求散度有限；对于小于1的阶数，支持包含性即可。该证明利用兼容的加权Haagerup L^p尺度，并适用于数据处理区域之外。
authors: Tanay Kibe, Pratik Roy

articles.title: Exact Resource Laws for Passive Wavelength Routing in Entanglement Networks
articles.title_zh: 纠缠网络中无源波长路由的精确资源定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29911v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entanglement-based networks provide a scalable framework for multiuser quantum communication by passively routing spectrally correlated photon pairs across interconnected nodes. Several wavelength-allocation schemes have already been demonstrated experimentally, but these designs do not yet provide a general way to determine how spectral use, receiver load, repeated connections, fan-out, and optical loss constrain one another. Motivated by a field-deployed four-node network, we formulate wavelength assignment as an exact resource-optimization problem on the network connectivity graph. We consider uniquely paired wavelength channels and require that no user receive both channels of a pair. For one-sided fan-out, we obtain an exact optimization for arbitrary networks, and closed-form resource laws for complete networks and for networks with one excluded partner per user. Allowing both conjugate wavelengths to fan out changes the resource landscape. In complete networks, a balanced binary hierarchy uses the minimum number of spectral layers among nonredundant assignments while reducing the maximum receiver wavelength load to a quantity that grows logarithmically with the number of users. For eight users, the source-cost ordering depends on splitter transmission: changing the transmission can change which architecture requires less pair generation. We formulate a BBM92 rate model for evaluating the corresponding architectures. For a single continuous-wave broadband source, the occupied wavelength pairs are generated with fixed relative weights, while detector singles and accidental coincidences couple the link rates. The same resource laws can therefore be evaluated using the measured parameters of the hardware that implements the network.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于纠缠的网络通过无源路由光谱相关的光子对，为多用户量子通信提供了可扩展框架。本文将波长分配公式化为网络连通图上的精确资源优化问题，以确定光谱使用、接收器负载等如何相互制约。研究考虑了单侧扇出和共轭波长扇出的情况，并为完整网络和具有特定排除伙伴的网络导出了闭式资源定律。
authors: Ekta Panwar, Gilberto Borges, Saeid Salari, Kartik Kakade, Samgeeth Puliyil, Peter Rapčan, Mario Ziman, Djeylan Aktas

articles.title: Impossible to conjugate or reflect an unknown quantum state via a unitary evolution
articles.title_zh: 通过酉演化无法共轭或反射未知量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11536v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The no-cloning theorem, the no-deleting theorem, and other no-go theorems play a crucial role in quantum mechanics and quantum information. In this paper, we show that it is impossible to conjugate or reflect an unknown quantum state or conjugate or reflect the bit-flip (the phase-flip) of an unknown state via a universally unitary evolution. We also indicate that the partial conjugating operations are not anti-unitary and it is impossible to universally partially conjugate an unknown state via a unitary evolution. We compute the fidelities of the optimal physical approximations to conjugating and conjugating the bit-flip and phase-flip operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 无克隆定理等禁行定理在量子力学中至关重要。本文证明了通过普适酉演化无法共轭或反射未知量子态，也无法共轭或反射未知态的比特翻转（或相位翻转）。研究还指出部分共轭操作并非反酉的，且无法通过酉演化普适地部分共轭未知态。文章计算了共轭以及共轭比特翻转和相位翻转操作的最佳物理近似的保真度。
authors: Dafa Li

articles.title: Exact few-magnon Bethe scars of the non-integrable alternating Heisenberg chain
articles.title_zh: 非可积交替海森堡链的精确少磁子贝特疤痕态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.14017v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Exact solutions of quantum lattice models serve as useful guides for interpreting physical phenomena in condensed matter systems. Prominent examples of integrability appear in one dimension, including the Heisenberg chain, where the Bethe ansatz method has been widely successful. Recent work has noted that certain non-integrable models harbor quantum many-body scar states, which form a superspin of regular states hidden in an otherwise chaotic spectrum. Here we consider one of the simplest examples of a non-integrable model, the alternating ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic (bond-staggered) Heisenberg chain, a close cousin of the spin-1 Haldane chain and a spin analog of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, and show the presence of exponentially many zero-energy states. We highlight features of the alternating chain that allow treatment with the coordinate Bethe ansatz (with important modifications), and surprisingly, for a non-integrable system, we find simple compact expressions for zero-energy eigenfunctions for a few magnons, including solutions with fractionalized particle momentum. These states exhibit wavefunction scarring similar to that of single-particle states in chaotic billiards. We discuss a general numerical recipe to diagnose the existence of such generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) scar states and also provide exact analytic expressions for their entanglement. We conclude by conjecturing a picture of magnon pairing which may generalize to multiple magnons. Our work opens the avenue to describe certain eigenstates of partially integrable systems using the GBA.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子格点模型的精确解对理解凝聚态物理现象至关重要。本文研究了非可积的交替铁磁-反铁磁海森堡链，并发现其中存在指数级数量的零能量态。研究表明，该交替链的特性允许通过坐标贝特拟设（经重要修改）进行处理。令人惊讶的是，对于一个非可积系统，本文找到了少数磁子零能量本征函数的简洁紧凑表达式，这些态展现出波函数疤痕特性。
authors: Ronald Melendrez, Bhaskar Mukherjee, Marcin Szyniszewski, Christopher J. Turner, Arijeet Pal, Hitesh J. Changlani

articles.title: Spin-resolved microscopy of ⁸⁷Sr SU(N) Fermi-Hubbard systems
articles.title_zh: ⁸⁷Sr SU(N) 费米-哈伯德系统的自旋分辨显微镜研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05478v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum-gas microscopes provide direct access to the phases of the Hubbard model, bringing microscopic insight into the complex competition between interactions, SU(2) magnetism, and doping. Alkaline-earth(-like) fermions extend this spin-1/2 paradigm by realizing higher symmetries and giving access to SU(N) Hubbard models, with rich phase diagrams to be unveiled. Despite its fundamental interest, a microscopic exploration of SU(N) quantum systems has remained elusive. Here we report the realization of a quantum-gas microscope for fermionic ⁸⁷Sr. Our imaging scheme, based on cooling and fluorescence on the narrow intercombination line at 689 nm, enables spin-resolved single-atom detection. By implementing a spin-selective optical pumping protocol, we determine the occupation of each of the 10 spin states in a single experimental realization, a crucial capability for probing site-resolved magnetic correlations. We benchmark our method by observing single-particle Larmor precession across the full spin-9/2 ground-state manifold and use numerical simulations of SU(N) Fermi-Hubbard chains, incorporating the measured detection fidelities, to demonstrate its capability to resolve many-body spin correlations. Our results establish ⁸⁷Sr quantum-gas microscopy as a powerful approach to study exotic magnetism in the SU(N) Fermi-Hubbard model, and provide a new detection tool for studies in quantum simulation, computation, and metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子气体显微镜为研究哈伯德模型提供了直接途径。本文报道了为费米子⁸⁷Sr实现量子气体显微镜，该成像方案基于689 nm窄线宽跃迁的冷却和荧光，实现了自旋分辨的单原子探测。通过自旋选择性光泵浦协议，研究人员能够确定单个实验中10个自旋态的占据情况，这对于探测位点分辨的磁关联至关重要。
authors: Carlos Gas-Ferrer, Antonio Rubio-Abadal, Sandra Buob, Leonardo Bezzo, Jonatan Höschele, Leticia Tarruell

articles.title: Nature of the bosonic edge phase in a double quantum spin Hall insulator
articles.title_zh: 双量子自旋霍尔绝缘体中玻色子边缘相的性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Field-theoretic analysis has predicted that the edge of a double quantum spin Hall insulator (DQSHI) can undergo an interaction-driven transition from a phase with fermionic edge modes into one with only bosonic modes. All single-fermion edge excitations are gapped in this bosonic edge phase, but fermion pairs remain gapless, leading to distinct experimental signatures. We numerically simulate the interacting DQSHI edge and verify the existence of the bosonic edge phase. This calculation requires an explicit bulk embedding of the DQSHI edge, due to its mixed anomaly between charge and S^z conservation. We hence employ segment DMRG on an infinite two-dimensional cylinder, where the DQSHI bulk is modeled in terms of two copies of the spin-up lowest Landau level, combined with their time-reversed counterparts. We find that interactions can open a single-fermion gap at the DQSHI edge while fermion pairs remain gapless, matching the predictions for the bosonic edge phase. We find the scaling of the single-fermion gap with interaction strength to be consistent with field-theoretic calculations, and discuss the relevance of the bosonic edge phase to twisted homobilayers of WSe₂ and MoTe₂. We elaborate on the methodological extension of the segment geometry used here to other topological phases with edge anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 场论分析预测双量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（DQSHI）的边缘可能经历相互作用驱动的相变，从费米子边缘模式转变为纯玻色子模式。本研究通过数值模拟相互作用的DQSHI边缘，验证了玻色子边缘相的存在。结果表明，相互作用可以在DQSHI边缘打开单费米子能隙，而费米子对保持无能隙，这与玻色子边缘相的预测相符。
authors: Andreas Feuerpfeil, Ronny Thomale, Trithep Devakul, Nicolas Regnault, Julian May-Mann

articles.title: Nonlinear Canonical Transformations for Studying Spin-1/2 Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 用于研究自旋-1/2哈密顿量的非线性正则变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly correlated quantum systems, including frustrated spin lattices, remain challenging for conventional coupled-cluster methods because their ground states often exhibit strong multireference character and symmetry breaking. Although multireference and symmetry-projected coupled-cluster theories are promising, they are not yet black-box methods and require system-specific development. The XXZ and J₁₋J₂ spin models provide demanding benchmarks. Spin-BCS-based coupled-cluster methods may require high excitation ranks to recover the exact ground-state physics in strongly correlated regimes. We introduce a nonlinear spin-fermion-spin (SFS) transformation designed to map a strongly correlated spin Hamiltonian into a new spin Hamiltonian whose ground state is more accurately described at the mean-field level. For a representative SFS transformation, we identify a compact Clifford circuit that maps transformed product states to circuit-dressed, generally entangled states in the original representation. The transformed Hamiltonian can then be treated using broken-symmetry mean-field theory and post-mean-field methods. Benchmarks for the XXZ and J₁₋J₂ Hamiltonians show that spin mean-field theory in the transformed representation reduces the energy error relative to conventional spin-BCS mean field. The spin-BCS-based coupled-cluster calculations for the one-dimensional XXZ model provide substantially improved accuracy relative to the corresponding untransformed methods. In 2D, the accuracy of the transformed mean-field solutions depends on the site ordering and boundary conditions, as nonlocal strings can appear. These results show that exact transformations of operator representations can serve as many-body preconditioners for mean-field and low-rank coupled-cluster approximations to strongly correlated spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 强关联量子系统对传统耦合簇方法构成挑战。本文引入了一种非线性自旋-费米子-自旋（SFS）变换，旨在将强关联自旋哈密顿量映射到一个新的自旋哈密顿量，其基态可以在平均场水平上更准确地描述。该变换后的哈密顿量可以使用破对称平均场理论和后平均场方法进行处理。
authors: Swarnamoy Ghosh, Thomas M. Henderson, Gustavo E. Scuseria

articles.title: String Order in Quench Dynamics as a Probe of Quantum Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 淬火动力学中的弦序作为量子相变的探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the anisotropic XY chain in a transverse field by introducing a global string order parameter and examining its equilibrium behavior and its quench dynamics from a fully polarized initial state. The corresponding string operator is defined as the product of local projected spin operators over the entire chain. The nonequilibrium order parameter is the long-time average of the logarithm of the string-operator expectation value per site after the quench.For the ground state, its field derivative is singular on the Ising critical lines; after the quench, the steady-state response also records the field boundaries and the anisotropy transition. We derive analytically the nonanalytic behavior of the order parameter at the quantum critical lines. Our results reveal a hidden nonlocal order underlying this paradigmatic model of conventional quantum phase transitions. They also connect measurable spin populations with equilibrium and dynamical topological structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过引入全局弦序参数，研究了横向场中的各向异性XY链的平衡行为和从完全极化初始态的淬火动力学。研究发现，基态的场导数在伊辛临界线上是奇异的；淬火后，稳态响应也记录了场边界和各向异性转变。这些结果揭示了传统量子相变这一范式模型中隐藏的非局域序。
authors: H. P. Zhang, Z. Song

articles.title: Symmetry-Preserving Local Representation for Short-Range Interaction in Complex Materials
articles.title_zh: 复杂材料中短程相互作用的对称性保持局部表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30726v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modeling short-range interactions in highly disordered materials remains challenging due to the immense configuration space and the disruption of local symmetry in truncated theoretical models. Here, we propose a symmetry-preserving local representation framework that strictly enforces topological continuity and translational invariance via boundary passivation. Applied to high-entropy alloys, this approach autonomously unravels the nonlinear ligand effects modulating local reactivity and accurately captures coverage-dependent many-body interactions without explicit periodic expansion. By resolving the conflict between localized chemical environments and extended periodic boundaries, this framework not only reduces computational complexity by an order of magnitude but also provides a physically transparent paradigm for deciphering short-range order in complex condensed matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟高度无序材料中的短程相互作用面临挑战。本文提出了一种对称性保持的局部表示框架，通过边界钝化严格执行拓扑连续性和平移不变性。该方法应用于高熵合金，能够自主揭示调节局部反应性的非线性配体效应，并准确捕捉覆盖度依赖的多体相互作用。
authors: Hao Cheng, Tong Yang, Hao Wu, Haokai Hong, Zhongrui Wang, Shu Ping Lau, Wanyu Lin, Kay Chen Tan, Ming Yang

articles.title: Anyon Chern bands of opposite sign and reversed drift
articles.title_zh: 符号相反且漂移方向反转的任意子陈带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The elementary charged excitations of fractional quantum Hall states are anyons. Without continuous translation symmetry, they acquire a dispersion and richer dynamics. We study the Laughlin quasihole at filling 1/3 in a periodically modulated magnetic field, a common model of fractional Chern insulators in two-dimensional materials. From the microscopic wave functions, we derive the commutator of its guiding-center coordinates, set by a many-body Berry curvature that governs its wave packets. A modulation with two flux quanta per unit cell splits the quasihole band into bands with Chern numbers 6 and -3; such opposite signs are generic as long as a weak modulation opens a gap between the anyon bands. In the C=-3 band, the quasihole drifts against E×B, although the magnetic field has the same sign everywhere. Perturbation theory in the modulation explains these results, and large-scale Monte Carlo calculations confirm them. Anyon bands thus acquire their own topology, which controls anyon motion and may shape the phases of itinerant anyons.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数量子霍尔态的基本带电激发是任意子。本研究在周期性调制磁场中研究了填充因子为1/3的Laughlin准空穴。结果表明，每个晶胞两个磁通量量子的调制将准空穴带分裂为陈数分别为6和-3的能带，这种相反的符号是普遍存在的。在C=-3能带中，准空穴的漂移方向与E×B方向相反。
authors: Zhenyu Xiao, Minxuan Wang, Shinsei Ryu

articles.title: Fit-error corrected auxiliary master equation approach for low-temperature nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory
articles.title_zh: 低温非平衡态动力学平均场理论的拟合误差校正辅助主方程方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The auxiliary master equation approach (AMEA) is a nonperturbative impurity solver for steady-state nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). It replaces the physical hybridization function by that of a small auxiliary open quantum system, whose parameters are fitted to reproduce it, and then solves the resulting many-body problem essentially exactly. AMEA's accuracy is thus limited by the quality of this fit: since the fastest-varying part of the hybridization is set by the distribution function, whose Fermi edges sharpen at low temperature, the fit tends to overestimate the temperature, especially for weak reservoir coupling. For the auxiliary hybridization itself, however, AMEA's self-energy is essentially exact. We correct for the fit error by estimating, via an approximate solver applicable to arbitrary hybridization functions, the ratio between the self-energies of the physical and auxiliary hybridizations, and using it to extend AMEA's self-energy from the auxiliary to the physical case. This fit-error correction becomes exact whenever either the fit or the approximate solver is exact. We benchmark the scheme using the nonequilibrium Kajueter-Kotliar iterated perturbation theory (IPT), generalized here to spin-polarized solutions, as the approximate solver; other approximate solvers, such as the noncrossing approximation, can be used as well. Applied to an Anderson impurity model with a spin-polarized bath, and within DMFT to a Hubbard layer weakly coupled to two metallic reservoirs, the correction largely removes the spurious heating from the AMEA fit and from insufficient thermalization by the reservoirs, while preserving the correct description of the Mott insulator, which IPT alone cannot fully recover.
articles.abstract_zh: 辅助主方程方法（AMEA）是一种用于稳态非平衡动力学平均场理论（DMFT）的非微扰杂质求解器。该方法的精度受限于拟合质量，尤其在低温下拟合容易高估温度。本文通过估计物理和辅助杂化函数自能之比来校正拟合误差，从而将AMEA的自能从辅助情况扩展到物理情况。
authors: Sebastian Alois Fuchs, Enrico Arrigoni, Tommaso Maria Mazzocchi

articles.title: Sign-problem-free Bosonic Auxiliary Field Quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 无符号问题玻色子辅助场量子蒙特卡洛方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The sign problem poses a fundamental barrier to numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations, severely hindering our understanding of quantum many-body physics across disciplines ranging from condensed matter to particle and nuclear physics. Geometrical frustration makes this barrier especially acute for interacting bosons. Here, we develop a bosonic auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (BAFQMC) method and rigorously prove that time-reversal symmetry and reflection positivity each provide a general sufficient condition for sign-problem-free simulations. Crucially, under either criterion, BAFQMC evades the sign problem even on frustrated lattices where conventional world-line and stochastic-series-expansion methods fail. Benchmarking our approach on a two-flavor Bose-Hubbard model on the triangular lattice yields excellent quantitative agreement with finite-temperature exact diagonalization. By establishing unifying principles to solve the sign problem in BAFQMC, our work substantially expands the reach of unbiased, numerically exact simulations for frustrated bosonic matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 符号问题是数值精确量子蒙特卡洛模拟的根本障碍，尤其对于相互作用的玻色子。本文开发了一种玻色子辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（BAFQMC）方法，并严格证明时间反演对称性和反射正性各自提供了无符号问题模拟的通用充分条件。BAFQMC方法即使在传统方法失效的受挫晶格上也能避免符号问题。
authors: Yin-Kai Yu, Zhong-Chao Wei, Zi-Xiang Li

articles.title: Monodromy Defects of 3D Wilson-Fisher Criticality on the Fuzzy Sphere
articles.title_zh: 模糊球面上三维Wilson-Fisher临界性的单值缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monodromy (twist) line defects arise as the boundaries of topological symmetry surfaces, which are among the simplest non-trivial conformal defects with direct realizations as magnetic vortex in quantum magnets, as Wilson and t Hooft lines of gauge theories, and as the replica twist operators in quantum information theory. However, their interacting dynamics remains difficult to characterize non-perturbatively. Here we design a way to realize the monodromy boundary conditions in the fuzzy-sphere regularization by threading a symmetry-selective Aharonov-Bohm flux through the two poles of the sphere. We apply this construction to the Z₂ twist of the 3D Ising conformal field theory (CFT), π-twist of the 3D O(2) CFT and three inequivalent monodromies of O(3) (centre twist, z-axis π-twist and the reflection).
