Any quantum algorithm with T-depth D_T can be executed by consuming 12D_T or fewer resource states. We benchmark the fault-tolerant preparation of the resource states for several two-level concatenations of the [[k+4,k,2]] H codes and the Hamming [[15,7,3]] code. In particular, we find that the concatenated cultivation offers at least one order of magnitude spacetime reduction compared to cultivation in the surface code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子架构，可在高码率代码中实现可寻址和并行通用的容错逻辑操作。该架构通过容错制备和消耗多种逻辑K量子比特CSS稳定器态和全局魔术态来实现逻辑注入。研究利用Flag-at-origin协议制备稳定器资源态，并采用级联培养协议制备全局魔术态。这些资源态通过Steane-QEC或Knill-QEC隐形传态装置消耗，同时执行量子纠错。基准测试结果表明，级联培养协议在时空开销上比传统培养协议至少减少了一个数量级。
authors: Joseph Sullivan, David Amaro, Michael A. Perlin

articles.title: Engineering Low-Latency, High-Throughput Quantum Decoders on NVIDIA GPUs
articles.title_zh: 在NVIDIA GPU上设计低延迟、高吞吐量的量子解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28867v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We design and optimize a quantum error correction (QEC) decoder for NVIDIA GPUs, combining Relay belief propagation, a state-of-the-art message-passing algorithm, with order-zero ordered statistics post-processing. Our implementation uses CUDA Graphs to control GPU execution, stops updates for converged samples, and collects unresolved samples in queues for post-processing. We optimize sparse traversal through coalesced message accesses, prefetching, and register reuse, and accelerate binary post-processing with warp-level collectives. In addition, mixed FP16-FP32 arithmetic and INT8 quantization reduce message storage and traffic while retaining accuracy using accumulators at higher precision. We evaluate surface, hypergraph product, and bivariate bicycle code workloads on NVIDIA A100 and GH200 data-center GPUs and a commodity RTX 5080. On the bivariate bicycle code at error probability 0.003, INT8 halves amortized decoding time relative to independently tuned FP32 with a negligible logical error rate increase on RTX 5080. With independent syndrome batches submitted back-to-back to concurrent decoder instances, RTX 5080 delivers 91% of GH200's highest measured throughput with an 8.9x shorter median submission-to-correction latency. The combination of performance optimization, mixed precision, INT8 quantization, and concurrent decoder instances opens a path toward QEC decoder clusters built from commodity GPUs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文设计并优化了一种用于NVIDIA GPU的量子纠错（QEC）解码器，该解码器结合了Relay信念传播算法和零阶有序统计后处理。实现中利用CUDA Graphs控制GPU执行，并通过优化稀疏遍历和加速二元后处理来提高效率。此外，混合FP16-FP32算术和INT8量化减少了消息存储和流量，同时保持了精度。在双变量循环码上，INT8量化将摊销解码时间减半，且逻辑错误率增加可忽略不计。
authors: Stefano Markidis, Luca Pennati, Ivy Peng

articles.title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
articles.title_zh: Mamba量子本征求解器（MQE）：一种用于量子化学可扩展基态模拟的选择性状态空间模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting molecular electronic structure using Quantum Computing approaches is a challenge in Computational Chemistry. Traditional Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQEs) are typically hindered by optimization challenges. The alternative Generative Quantum Eigensolver (GQE) mitigates this by reformulating ground-state search as discrete sequence generation, but its Transformer backbone suffers from quadratic computational complexity, bottlenecking scalability for larger molecules. To address this, we introduce the Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (Mamba-QE), which replaces the Transformer with a Selective State Space Model (SSM) to process operator sequences with linear O(L) complexity. Additionally, we integrate a distance-conditioned mechanism enabling the direct prediction of complete potential energy surfaces (PES). Evaluated on the H₂ molecule, Mamba-QE reproduces Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) reference energies well within chemical accuracy, achieving an energy error below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha across 16 geometries with zero variational violations. Mamba-QE maintains high expressive power while establishing a robust, scalable foundation for quantum simulations of complex molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了Mamba量子本征求解器（Mamba-QE），旨在解决传统变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的优化挑战和生成量子本征求解器（GQE）的二次计算复杂度问题。Mamba-QE用选择性状态空间模型（SSM）取代了Transformer，实现了线性O(L)复杂度的算子序列处理。此外，它还集成了距离条件机制，可以直接预测完整的势能面。在H₂分子上的评估显示，Mamba-QE在化学精度内很好地重现了全组态相互作用（FCI）参考能量，为可扩展的基态模拟奠定了基础。
authors: G. X. A. Petronilo, M. R. Araújo, Erico S. Teixeira, Clebson Cruz

articles.title: From Traveling Waves to Synthetic Gauge Fields: A Field-Free Route to Superconducting Diode Effect
articles.title_zh: 从行波到合成规范场：实现超导二极管效应的无场路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29865v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The superconducting diode effect requires the forward and reverse bias currents to differ, a scenario achieved via inversion and time-reversal symmetries broken together. The latter, and the more crucial one, is inevitably achieved by a magnetic field. Here, we show that a spatio-temporally driven chemical potential of the form, μⱼ₍ₜ₎₌μ+Vo̧s(ømega t+kd j), achieves both at once. Applied to a helical Shiba chain, the drive transmutes a traveling Peierls phase via generating an odd-in-momentum term, equivalent to an imaginary next-nearest-neighbour Haldane-like hopping in real space. Remarkably, the protocol is spin-blind, which renders the time-reversal breaking via a synthetic gauge flux rather than an effective Zeeman field. The rectification is odd in the drive wavevector, with exact zeros at kd=nπ and an analytical optimum at kd=2π/3. It is however, even in the exchange coupling, J and persists even at J=0. Furthermore, the rectification scales inversely with the pair-breaking gap, yielding approximately 50% rectification in the topological phase and 10% in the trivial phase. Symmetry breaking is thus drive-controlled, allowing it to be switched on, tuned, and reversed without an external magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导二极管效应通常需要同时打破反演对称性和时间反演对称性，后者通常通过磁场实现。本文提出了一种通过时空驱动化学势实现这两种对称性破缺的方法。该驱动在螺旋Shiba链中产生一个与动量奇偶相关的项，等效于实空间中虚的次近邻Haldane型跳跃。值得注意的是，该方案是自旋无关的，通过合成规范通量而非有效塞曼场实现时间反演对称性破缺。整流效应与驱动波矢呈奇函数关系，并在拓扑相中实现约50%的整流，在平庸相中实现10%的整流。
authors: Latu Kalita, Koustav Roy, Bilal Tanatar, Saurabh Basu

articles.title: Tight Bounds on the Randomized Communication Complexity of Vector-in-Subspace
articles.title_zh: 子空间中向量的随机通信复杂度的紧密界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30052v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that the randomized communication complexity of Vector-in-Subspace in mathbb Rⁿ with error at most 1/3 is Θ(sqrt n). Alice holds a unit vector u and Bob holds an n/2-dimensional subspace H; they must distinguish uin H from uin H^perp. An exact one-way quantum protocol uses O(łog n) qubits, making the problem a geometric example of an exponential quantum advantage over interactive classical communication. Our lower bound matches Raz's O(sqrt n) upper bound, improves the Ømega(n¹/³) lower bound of Klartag and Regev, and removes the total-rank restriction in Grupel's Ømega(sqrt n) result. The proof establishes a Gaussian moment bound over complete rectangle partitions. A complex Gaussian representation yields a vanishing even moment whose cancellation is preserved when averaging over the partition. We control the signed conditional moments around a real center by decomposing conditional Gaussian measures into fixed coordinates and sub-Gaussian components. Combining this estimate with spherical harmonic analysis gives the communication lower bound.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在误差至多为1/3的情况下，实数空间Rⁿ中子空间中向量问题的随机通信复杂度为Θ(sqrt n)。Alice持有一个单位向量u，Bob持有一个n/2维子空间H，他们需要区分u是否在H中或在H的补空间中。一个精确的单向量子协议仅使用O(log n)量子比特，展示了相对于交互式经典通信的指数级量子优势。本文的下界与Raz的O(sqrt n)上界相匹配，改进了Klartag和Regev的Ω(n¹/³)下界，并消除了Grupel的Ω(sqrt n)结果中的总秩限制。
authors: Chengu Wang

articles.title: Classification of Kirkwood-Dirac positivity-preserving unitaries
articles.title_zh: Kirkwood-Dirac正性保持酉变换的分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.11784v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Kirkwood-Dirac (KD) quasiprobability distributions are increasingly used across quantum information science, yet their computational significance remains unclear. We classify unitary dynamics that preserve KD positivity and connect this structure to classical simulation. In contrast to the discrete Wigner setting, we show that KD positivity preservation, stochastic evolution of quasiprobabilities, and preservation of total non-positivity do not coincide. We identify three classes of positivity-preserving unitaries: type I gates, which are exactly the KD-stochastic unitaries; type II gates, which are non-stochastic yet preserve total non-positivity by permuting and conjugating KD entries; and, for Fourier-conjugate bases in dimension d=pq, type III gates, which preserve KD positivity but can change the total non-positivity of non-real distributions. The classification is complete for Haar-random bases and for Fourier-conjugate dimensions d=p^k and d=pq, with p, q distinct primes. Adapting the sampling algorithm of Pashayan et al. [PRL 115, 070501], we simulate all of these positivity-preserving circuits efficiently on KD-positive inputs; type III gates, however, create a sharp distinction between real inputs, which remain efficiently simulable, and non-real inputs, whose sampling overhead can grow exponentially. Consequently, for d=pq no resource theory can both treat the KD total non-positivity as a monotone and admit every efficiently simulable positivity-preserving unitary as a free operation.
articles.abstract_zh: Kirkwood-Dirac (KD) 准概率分布在量子信息科学中应用日益广泛，但其计算意义尚不明确。本文对保持KD正性的酉动力学进行了分类，并将其结构与经典模拟联系起来。研究识别出三类正性保持酉变换：I型门（KD随机酉变换）、II型门（非随机但通过置换和共轭KD条目保持总非正性）以及III型门（保持KD正性但可改变非实数分布的总非正性）。该分类对于Haar随机基和傅里叶共轭维度d=p^k和d=pq（p, q为不同素数）是完备的。
authors: Jkedrzej Burkat, Sergii Strelchuk

articles.title: Macroscopic quantum coherence and entanglement in mechanical systems
articles.title_zh: 机械系统中的宏观量子相干性和纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.08324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The notion of a macroscopic quantum state must be pinned down in order to assess how well experiments probe the large-scale limits of quantum mechanics. However, the issue of quantifying so-called quantum macroscopicity is fraught with multiple approaches having varying interpretations and levels of computability and measurability. Here, we introduce two measures that capture independent macroscopic properties: i) extensive size, measuring the degree of coherence in position or momentum observables relative to atomic-scale units, and ii) entangled size, quantifying the number of entangled subsystems. These measures unify many desirable features of past proposals while having rigorously justified interpretations from quantum information theory in terms of coherence and multipartite entanglement. We demonstrate how to estimate them and obtain lower-bounds using experimental data from micro-mechanical oscillators and diffracting molecules. Notably, we find evidence for genuine multipartite entanglement of 10⁵ to 10⁷ atoms in recent mechanical superposition states.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了评估实验对量子力学大尺度极限的探测程度，宏观量子态的概念需要明确界定。本文引入了两种独立捕捉宏观特性的度量：扩展尺寸（衡量位置或动量可观测量的相干程度）和纠缠尺寸（量化纠缠子系统的数量）。这些度量统一了以往提案的许多优点，并从量子信息理论角度对相干性和多体纠缠进行了严格解释。研究展示了如何利用微机械振荡器和衍射分子的实验数据来估计这些度量并获得下限。值得注意的是，在最近的机械叠加态中发现了10⁵到10⁷个原子的真实多体纠缠证据。
authors: Benjamin Yadin, Matteo Fadel

articles.title: The Quantum Channels of the Compton Scattering of an Entangled Pair of Photons
articles.title_zh: 纠缠光子对康普顿散射的量子信道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.04077v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Compton scattering of an entangled pair of photons is studied. Using the resulting reduced density matrix, we demonstrate how to derive the Kraus operators for the interaction from the underlying fundamental theory, quantum electrodynamics. The normalization of the final density matrix of the entangled photons after the interaction is crucial to obtaining the correct probabilities and correlations. The reduced density matrix of the photon, which does not participate in the interaction directly, remains unchanged. It indicates that quantum effects in quantum sensing using an entangled photon pair can be observed only through the correlations or superposition of the entire pair. We relate our results to the Stokes parameters for determining polarizations and investigating the entangled states of photons from electron-positron annihilation in astrophysical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了纠缠光子对的康普顿散射，并利用约化密度矩阵，从量子电动力学这一基本理论推导了相互作用的Kraus算符。研究强调了相互作用后纠缠光子最终密度矩阵归一化的重要性，以获得正确的概率和关联。未直接参与相互作用的光子的约化密度矩阵保持不变，表明使用纠缠光子对进行量子传感的量子效应只能通过整个光子对的关联或叠加来观察。
authors: Chih-Yu Chen, C. D. Hu, Yeu Chung Lin

articles.title: Entanglement Dimensionality of Continuous Variable States From Phase-Space Quasi-Probabilities
articles.title_zh: 基于相空间准概率的连续变量态纠缠维度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.02743v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The dimensionality of entanglement, quantified by the Schmidt number, is a core resource for quantum information processing. While its certification is well-established in finite-dimensional systems, many platforms harnessing high Schmidt numbers are natively continuous-variable (CV) systems, which are usually truncated to a finite subspace before canonical discrete-variable techniques are applied. For those instances, a core question is whether directly utilizing a genuinely CV toolbox leads to better and more robust characterisations. We answer this question by introducing Schmidt-number witnesses built directly from correlations and covariances of phase-space observables, accessible through characteristic- or Wigner-function measurements. They hold for arbitrary mixed states, including non-Gaussian ones, and only require correlations along a slice of phase space. We show that this direct estimation is more robust and versatile than first discretizing the system and using canonical discrete variable techniques. Moreover, we apply our method to certify arbitrarily-large Schmidt numbers of a bound-entangled Gaussian state. These results motivate genuine CV methods for characterizing high-dimensional entanglement across CV quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠维度（由Schmidt数量化）是量子信息处理的核心资源。本文通过引入直接从相空间可观测量的关联和协方差构建的Schmidt数判据，解决了连续变量（CV）系统中纠缠维度认证的挑战。这些判据适用于任意混合态，包括非高斯态，并且仅需要沿相空间切片的关联。研究表明，这种直接估计方法比先离散化系统再使用经典离散变量技术更鲁棒和通用。此外，该方法成功认证了束缚纠缠高斯态的任意大Schmidt数。
authors: Shuheng Liu, Jiajie Guo, Matteo Fadel, Qiongyi He, Marcus Huber, Giuseppe Vitagliano

articles.title: Evolutionary BP+OSD Decoding for Low-Latency Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 用于低延迟量子纠错的演化BP+OSD解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.18273v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) for fault-tolerant quantum computing requires a balanced decoding solution that offers high performance, low complexity, and low latency. However, the de facto standard - belief propagation (BP) combined with ordered statistics decoding (OSD) - suffers from excessive iterations in the BP stage and high complexity in the OSD stage. To address these challenges, we propose an evolutionary BP (EBP) decoder optimized via a differential evolution (DE) algorithm. By leveraging the gradient-free nature of DE, we enable end-to-end optimization of the EBP+OSD structure to maximize overall performance. In addition, a multi-objective selection rule is introduced to suppress frequent OSD activation, significantly reducing complexity overhead. Simulation results on surface codes and quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes demonstrate that EBP+OSD simultaneously achieves both superior decoding performance and substantially lower complexity compared to conventional BP+OSD, particularly in stringent low-latency regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算中的量子纠错（QEC）需要兼顾高性能、低复杂度和低延迟的解码方案。针对传统信念传播（BP）结合有序统计解码（OSD）方案的迭代过多和复杂度高的问题，本文提出了一种通过差分演化（DE）算法优化的演化BP（EBP）解码器。该方法实现了EBP+OSD结构的端到端优化，并引入多目标选择规则以抑制OSD频繁激活，显著降低了复杂度。仿真结果表明，EBP+OSD在表面码和量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码上均实现了优越的解码性能和显著降低的复杂度。
authors: Hee-Youl Kwak, Seong-Joon Park, Hyunwoo Jung, Jeongseok Ha, Jae-Won Kim

articles.title: High Fidelity Single-NV Qubit Quantum State Tomography by Photoelectric Readout
articles.title_zh: 通过光电读出实现高保真度单NV量子比特量子态层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond is one of the advanced candidates for solid-state quantum computing at room temperature and has proven to be competitive in terms of gate fidelity and the availability of quantum error correction codes. Ambient solid-state qubits may therefore provide quantum computing architectures as an alternative to current solutions. The NV center has an associated electronic spin that is conventionally read out via photoluminescence. As an alternative, the electrical readout is not limited by the confocal resolution of quantum microscopes, which is required in the development of NV-based quantum processors to establish a scalable individual single-spin readout on the order of a few nanometers (necessary for strong dipole-dipole coupling). In this work, the performance of photoelectric readout versus traditional optical readout is investigated to perform Quantum State Tomography measurements on a single NV center. A state fidelity of 0.995 ± 0.006 is achieved using photoelectrical spin-state readout for state reconstruction, comparable to simultaneous optical measurements. We report photocurrent signal delays, which significantly slow down the photocurrent tomography. We develop a model describing their origin, and propose strategies for their mitigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心是室温固态量子计算的先进候选者之一。本文研究了光电读出与传统光学读出在对单个NV中心进行量子态层析成像测量时的性能。结果显示，使用光电自旋态读出进行态重建实现了0.995 ± 0.006的态保真度，与同步光学测量结果相当。光电读出不受共焦分辨率限制，为开发基于NV的量子处理器中可扩展的单自旋读出提供了替代方案。
authors: Boo Carmans, Michael Petrov, Milos Nesladek

articles.title: Spin Kerr-cat qubits
articles.title_zh: 自旋克尔猫量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19687v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The use of noise-robust qubit encodings provides a way of extending the lifetime of quantum information at the hardware level. In this work, we introduce the spin Kerr-cat encoding, which leverages a sweet spot near a clock transition in the spectrum of quadrupolar nuclei (having spin I≥ 1) to achieve a suppression of charge and magnetic noise leading to qubit dephasing. The basis states of the spin Kerr-cat qubit are given by the two lowest levels of a Z₂₋ₛymmetric nuclear-spin Hamiltonian and are well approximated by spin cat states for sufficiently high asymmetry parameters. For nuclei in highly asymmetric electric-field gradients, the nuclear spin could therefore be initialized in the spin-Kerr-cat subspace using SU(2) rotations and measurement rather than full SU(2I+1) control. We calculate the dephasing time of the spin Kerr-cat qubit under a model of 1/f noise, as well as relaxation of the qubit due to breaking of the Z₂ symmetry by charge-noise-induced fluctuations of the quadrupolar tensor. Using measured parameters for antimony ({}¹²³Sb) donors in silicon, we estimate that second-scale T₂^* times could be achieved with this encoding, with bitflips and leakage occurring on significantly longer timescales. We propose a two-qubit gate acting on spin Kerr-cat qubits and electron-spin qubits, enabled by adiabatically moving an electron on and off the donor potential. Based on numerical simulations, we estimate that with an enhancement of measured quadrupolar couplings by a factor of approx 2, a gate fidelity exceeding 99% could be achieved for spin Kerr cats encoded in {}¹²³Sb, with a gate time under 100 ns. By entangling the nuclear spin with an electron spin in this way, the spin Kerr-cat qubit could then be measured using a Pauli spin blockade readout of the electron.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作引入了一种自旋克尔猫编码，利用四极核（自旋I≥1）谱中时钟跃迁附近的“甜点”来抑制电荷和磁噪声导致的量子比特退相干。这种编码的基态由Z₂对称核自旋哈密顿量的两个最低能级构成，在高不对称参数下可近似为自旋猫态。研究计算了在1/f噪声模型下自旋克尔猫量子比特的退相干时间，并估计在硅中锑（¹²³Sb）施主中可实现秒级的T₂*时间。
authors: Z. M. McIntyre, Daniel Loss

articles.title: Demonstration of tripartite cat states in two distinct classes of entanglement
articles.title_zh: 两种不同纠缠类别的三方猫态的演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12317v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entanglement is a cornerstone of quantum mechanics and an essential resource for quantum computation, communication, and metrology. While bipartite entanglement is extensively studied, genuine multipartite entangled states remain largely inaccessible in the continuous-variable domain. Here, we experimentally realize continuous-variable tripartite entangled cat states of the two distinct classes with fundamentally inequivalent properties, namely GHZ-cat and W-cat states, encoded across three microwave resonators coupled to an ancillary superconducting transmon. We develop one-to-all conditional controls on the three oscillators by fully utilizing three energy levels of the transmon to generate these states in a single piece of hardware and employ an efficient subspace tomography protocol for state reconstruction. We obtain measurement-corrected state fidelities of 0.83±0.02 for GHZ-cat and 0.70±0.02 for W-cat, both exceeding the thresholds for genuine multipartite entanglement, with the W-state certification further supported by an optimized fully decomposable witness directly computed with the reconstructed density matrix. We validate the distinct entanglement classes by experimentally demonstrating that pairwise entanglement is present in the W-cat state but absent in the GHZ-cat state. Our technique for the on-demand generation and characterization of inequivalent classes of tripartite continuous-variable entanglement provides a testbed for studying multipartite bosonic entanglement and its robustness to loss, and a building block for future quantum information processing with multipartite bosonic codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验实现了连续变量三方纠缠猫态的两种不同类别：GHZ猫态和W猫态，它们编码在三个微波谐振器中，并耦合到一个辅助超导跨蒙量子比特。研究利用跨蒙量子比特的三个能级，在单个硬件中生成了这些状态，并采用高效子空间层析成像协议进行状态重建。实验获得了GHZ猫态0.83±0.02和W猫态0.70±0.02的测量校正态保真度，均超过了真实多方纠缠的阈值。
authors: May Chee Loke, Jonathan Schwinger, Kehui Yu, Yingshan Zhang, Amon M. Kasper, Tanjung Krisnanda, Yvonne Y. Gao

articles.title: Microscopic study of topological phase transitions: Percolation point of view
articles.title_zh: 拓扑相变的微观研究：渗流视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26707v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate microscopic mechanisms underlying decoherence-induced transitions between topologically ordered states. As a first case study, we analyze the color code using topological entanglement negativity (TEN) and a disorder parameter associated with 1-form symmetry. We interpret these quantities as first- and zeroth-dimensional simplicial homological objects, respectively, and show that the transition can be understood in terms of decoherence percolation. To resolve its local structure, we introduce quasi-local TEN (QLTEN), which visualizes the spatial distribution of local topological properties and the growth of decohered regions. We further introduce explosive percolation (EP), corresponding here to biased decoherence that suppresses the formation of large decohered clusters. As a second case study, we consider the toric code on a triangular lattice under external-field-type decoherence. Numerical results show that QLTEN faithfully captures the emergence of Higgs regions and the survival of logical qubits. Although global TEN, QLTEN clusters, and string operators are strongly correlated in both models, the color code and toric code respond differently to EP patterns. This difference indicates that a universal microscopic description of decoherence-induced topological phase transitions remains challenging even for closely related systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从微观层面研究了退相干诱导的拓扑有序态之间相变的机制。研究以颜色码为例，利用拓扑纠缠负度（TEN）和与1-形式对称性相关的无序参数，将相变解释为退相干渗流现象。为解析其局部结构，引入了准局部TEN（QLTEN）来可视化局部拓扑性质的空间分布和退相干区域的增长。数值结果表明，QLTEN能准确捕捉希格斯区域的出现和逻辑量子比特的存活。
authors: Keisuke Kataoka, Ikuo Ichinose

articles.title: Constructing and characterising anharmonic potentials in a harmonic oscillator
articles.title_zh: 谐振子中非谐势的构建与表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02405v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Continuous-variable quantum systems offer a natural platform for quantum information processing and analogue quantum simulation of real-world processes. Realising these applications, however, requires anharmonic potentials with programmable functional forms, which are challenging to engineer on demand. Here, in a superconducting harmonic oscillator coupled to a transmon qubit, we construct programmable non-Gaussian phase gates e⁻ⁱV⁽hatX⁾, corresponding to the impulsive action of an anharmonic potential V(hatX), and characterise them by reconstructing their corresponding force pointwise. Using bosonic quantum signal processing, we compile target potentials into modular circuits of qubit rotations interleaved with a fixed conditional-displacement primitive. We first demonstrate a cubic phase gate whose cubic nature is jointly validated by the resulting non-Gaussian states and the force reconstructed pointwise from the gate's action on coherent probe states. We then construct a family of double-well potentials and use the reconstructed force to witness the double-well topology and tunable asymmetry. Finally, we engineer an approximate Morse potential and obtain its force profile using position-compressed probes, which extend reliable reconstruction towards the steep repulsive wall. These results establish a programmable route to constructing the potential landscape of quantum harmonic oscillators and a practical method for reconstructing its spatial structure, providing a building block for quantum simulation of anharmonic dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在与跨蒙量子比特耦合的超导谐振子中，构建了可编程的非高斯相位门，其对应于非谐势V(hatX)的脉冲作用。研究通过逐点重建相应的力来表征这些相位门。利用玻色子量子信号处理，将目标势编译成量子比特旋转与固定条件位移原语交错的模块化电路。实验演示了立方相位门和一系列双势阱，并通过重建的力验证了其特性。
authors: Clara Yun Fontaine, Mansi Somani, Kehui Yu, May Chee Loke, Jonathan Schwinger, Pak-Tik Fong, Ni-Ni Huang, Adrian Copetudo, Mustafa Bakr, Hoi-Kwan Lau, Tanjung Krisnanda, Yvonne Y. Gao

articles.title: Energetic Costs of Subspace Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 子空间量子纠错的能量成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03825v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum error correction acts as an entropy pump, transferring noise-induced uncertainty from a protected quantum system into syndrome information stored in an auxiliary memory. Repeated operation requires this memory to be cleared which unavoidably contributes to the energetic cost of error correction. Here, we characterise this contribution for subspace quantum error-correcting codes and identify how it depends on the joint structure of the code, the noise, and the representation of the retained syndrome information. Starting from the Knill--Laflamme conditions, we construct an effective syndrome state whose von Neumann entropy sets a lower bound on the ideal work required to maintain a reusable syndrome register. Projective syndrome readout generally generates additional entropy, and we quantify the resulting gap through measurement inefficiency. We then specialise to stabiliser codes under independent local Pauli noise and analyse two classical levels of syndrome representation. At the level of abstract error labels, degeneracies among single-qubit errors reduce the leading-order entropy of processed recovery labels. At the parity-check level, lower-weight checks reduce the marginal entropy generated by individual measurement outcomes in the low-noise regime. We identify the additional burden associated with retaining and separately erasing these outcomes as a bit-level inefficiency, and illustrate both costs for the five-qubit, Steane, generalised Shor, and rotated surface codes. Our results establish a hierarchy of syndrome-memory energetic costs and identify the code, noise, and measurement structures that control the ideal thermodynamic burden of subspace quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错将噪声引起的不确定性从受保护的量子系统转移到存储在辅助存储器中的综合征信息。本文研究了子空间量子纠错码的能量成本，并确定其如何依赖于编码、噪声和综合征信息表示的联合结构。研究从Knill-Laflamme条件出发，构建了一个有效综合征态，其冯诺依曼熵设定了维护可重用综合征寄存器所需理想功的下限。
authors: Jakub Czartowski, Felix C. Binder

articles.title: Comment on "InAs-Al hybrid devices passing the topological gap protocol", Microsoft Quantum, Phys. Rev. B 107, 245423 (2023)
articles.title_zh: 对“InAs-Al混合器件通过拓扑能隙协议”一文的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.19560v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The topological gap protocol (TGP) is presented as "a series of stringent experimental tests" for the presence of topological superconductivity and associated Majorana zero modes. Here, we show that the TGP, "passed" by Microsoft Quantum [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)], lacks a consistent definition of "gap" or "topological", and even utilises different code when applied to theoretical simulations compared to experimental data. Furthermore, the outcome of the TGP is sensitive to the choice of magnetic field range, bias voltage range, data resolution, and cutter voltage pair (junction transparency) -- data parameters that, in PRB 107, 245423 (2023), vary significantly, even for measurements of the same device. As a result, the core claims of PRB 107, 245423 (2023) are based on unexplained measurement choices and inconsistent definitions. In particular, this means the claim by Microsoft Quantum in PRB 107, 245423 (2023) that their devices have a "high probability of being in the topological phase" is not reliable and should be revisited. In light of this, subsequent studies that are based on tuning up devices via the TGP should also be revisited.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评论了微软量子团队在Phys. Rev. B 107, 245423 (2023)中提出的拓扑能隙协议（TGP）。评论指出，TGP缺乏对“能隙”或“拓扑”的一致定义，且在理论模拟和实验数据应用中使用了不同的代码。TGP的结果对磁场范围、偏置电压范围等数据参数的选择敏感，导致原论文的核心主张基于未解释的测量选择和不一致的定义，因此其关于器件处于拓扑相的声明不可靠。
authors: Henry F. Legg

articles.title: Mixed-State Topology in One-Dimensional Open Floquet Systems
articles.title_zh: 一维开放Floquet系统中的混合态拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25248v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the non-equilibrium topology of the steady state of a periodically driven, dissipative Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain using the ensemble geometric phase (EGP) φEGP, a generalisation of the Zak phase to mixed states. The coupling to thermal reservoirs is treated microscopically within Floquet-Born-Markov theory without the rotating-wave approximation. We classify the steady state rather than the generator of the dynamics, using its purity spectrum as the analogue of a band structure. We show that, within the EGP framework, the Z×Z structure of isolated chiral-symmetric Floquet SSH systems generally does not carry over to the steady state. Instead, the steady state carries a single invariant whose type is set by an underlying symmetry. When this symmetry holds, the invariant is Z₂₋ᵥₐₗᵤₑd, with quantised φEGP=±π/2 at all times and finite temperatures. The EGP can switch within a driving period, tracking the presence of edge modes in the open-boundary purity spectrum and thereby establishing a bulk-boundary correspondence. The fraction of each period spent in the nontrivial regime varies continuously with the driving frequency, and the switching disappears if the dependence of the dissipator on the drive is neglected. When the symmetry is broken, φEGP is no longer quantised, but its winding over a drive period T defines an invariant ν_T in mathbb Z, with no purity-spectrum bulk-boundary correspondence. We propose that its changes signal temperature- and frequency-driven topological phase transitions. Our formalism extends to general quadratic fermionic systems with linear bath couplings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用系综几何相（EGP）研究了周期性驱动、耗散的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链稳态的非平衡拓扑。研究表明，在EGP框架下，孤立手性对称Floquet SSH系统的Z×Z结构通常不会延续到稳态。相反，稳态带有一个由潜在对称性决定的单一不变量。当该对称性成立时，不变量为Z₂值，且在所有时间和有限温度下EGP量化为±π/2。
authors: Görkem D. Dinc, Alexander Schnell, Andy M. Martin

articles.title: Adaptive Entangled Neurons in the Brain and Natural Intelligence Simulations for Artificial General Intelligence
articles.title_zh: 大脑中的自适应纠缠神经元与自然智能模拟对通用人工智能的启示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09226v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding the brain's mechanisms is crucial in neuroscience, particularly for simulating natural intelligence and advancing artificial general intelligence (AGI). Liu et al. (2024) and Deco et al. (2025) propose that quantum entanglement may underlie the synchronization of millions of neurons, introducing the Liu-Chen-Ao (LCA) hypothesis of entangled nerve fibers. However, directly testing this idea remains challenging. Here we employ a nonlocal many-body wave equation, introducing a generalized probability-wave framework to model collective behaviors among adaptive, interacting agents, particles, or neurons. This approach enables testable eigenmodes, offering an indirect means of examining the LCA hypothesis by observing patterns in collective trading behaviors. These patterns, rooted in behavioral psychology, are thought to mirror the internal brain's decision-making and underlying mechanisms. Our analysis of Chinese intraday stock market data shows that adaptive entangled game modes explain 82%-94% of decision patterns, sharply contrasting neoclassical finance predictions assuming independent rational agents. Additionally, 2-12% of actions adapt to news, events, and environmental changes, marked by rapid equilibrium shifts, while truly independent behaviors make up less than 5%. These results empirically support the LCA hypothesis and underscore the need to simulate the brain's mechanisms and generate adaptive, entangled modules for AGI. They also expose the shortcomings of conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs) that depend on vast, opaque parameters. By combining ANN-based AI with probability-wave-based entangled brain simulations, machine learning enables the creation of human-like processing units (HPUs). Such HPUs promise more efficient and robust AGI, particularly for embodied intelligence and robotics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子纠缠可能作为数百万神经元同步基础的刘-陈-敖（LCA）纠缠神经纤维假说。研究采用非局部多体波方程，引入广义概率波框架来模拟自适应、相互作用的智能体或神经元之间的集体行为。通过分析中国日内股票市场数据，发现自适应纠缠博弈模式能解释82%-94%的决策模式，这与假设独立理性代理的新古典金融预测形成鲜明对比。
authors: Haochen Li, Xinshuai Guo, Jingdong Ouyang, Wei Zhang, Leilei Shi

articles.title: Theory of the intrinsic optical anomalous Hall responses in time-reversal symmetry breaking superconductors
articles.title_zh: 破时间反演对称超导体中本征光学反常霍尔响应的理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining the symmetry of the Cooper pairing in superconductors is a central challenge in condensed matter physics. Time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) is among the most distinctive symmetry-breaking pattern of a superconductor. An important subset of TRSB pairing states, including the topological pₓ₊ᵢₚ_y pairing, is expected to exhibit the optical anomalous Hall effect. However, the microscopic ingredients that enable the Hall response and their underlying organizing principle in clean superconductors remain unelucidated. Here, we develop a unified theory for TRSB multiband superconductors possessing inversion symmetry, and establish their intrinsic optical Hall response as fundamentally a quantum-geometric phenomenon. We distinguish unitary and nonunitary TRSB states. Diagrammatically, we identify two classes of processes: single-electron tunneling and Cooper-pair tunneling. Both involve at least one interband tunneling event driven by the interband velocity-which is closely tied to the interband Berry connection. We rigorously prove that interband pairing is a prerequisite for unitary states to generate intrinsic Hall response, whereas it is not absolutely needed for nonunitary states. In nonunitary states with intraband pairing alone, the Hall effect can arise through single-electron tunneling, provided spin-orbit coupling is present. An effective theory obtained by integrating out the hole degrees of freedom reproduces these results and shows how pairing may endow electrons with effective Berry curvature. Finally, through symmetry analysis, we show that intrinsic resonances near the superconducting gap edge are allowed in nonunitary states but forbidden in unitary states. Our work thus establishes quantum geometry as a unifying principle for the intrinsic Hall response in superconductors and provides a guide for distinguishing different candidate TRSB pairings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为具有反演对称性的破时间反演对称（TRSB）多带超导体建立了统一理论，并将其本征光学霍尔响应确立为一种基本的量子几何现象。研究区分了幺正和非幺正TRSB态，并从图示上识别出单电子隧穿和库珀对隧穿两类过程。研究严格证明了带间配对是幺正态产生本征霍尔响应的先决条件。
authors: Jia-Long Zhang, Wen Huang

articles.title: Characterizing universal topological phases beyond spatial embedding
articles.title_zh: 超越空间嵌入的普适拓扑相表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although Hamiltonians govern wave-matter interactions, conventional characterizations of topological phases of matter require more than the Hamiltonian alone, relying on global invariants defined on closed reciprocal-space manifolds or local commutation relations with position operators. This spatial dependence precludes a unique characterization of topological phases on an abstract platform, whose Hamiltonian can be defined independently of its spatial embedding. Here we establish a framework for characterizing universal topological phases, grounded in the invariance of topological features under arbitrary Hamiltonian-preserving deformations. We construct a Hamiltonian-based spatial embedding that groups a system's constituents according to their connectivity. This embedding, which reproduces the results of conventional topological diagnostics in established systems, enables a coherent extension of topological phases to complex networks using the Hamiltonian alone, further highlighting exceptional robustness in small-world networks. Our results reshape the conceptual foundations of topological physics by decoupling topological characterization from prescribed physical platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个表征普适拓扑相的框架，其基础是拓扑特征在任意哈密顿量保持形变下的不变性。研究构建了一种基于哈密顿量的空间嵌入，根据系统的连通性对其组成部分进行分组。这种嵌入使得仅使用哈密顿量就能将拓扑相连贯地扩展到复杂网络，并揭示了小世界网络中卓越的鲁棒性。
authors: Sunkyu Yu, Xianji Piao, Namkyoo Park

articles.title: Ubiquitous topological materials protected by hidden partial symmetries
articles.title_zh: 隐藏部分对称性保护的普遍拓扑材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetries play a crucial role in protecting the topological phases of insulators, ensuring the robustness of their surface states against perturbations. Traditionally, these symmetries have to be obeyed by the system as a whole, which is a rather strong constraint. In this work, we demonstrate that topological effects can also be realized through a substantially weaker form of symmetry that we coin emphpartial latent symmetries. For these, invariance is required only at certain energy scales of an effective Hamiltonian, rather than for the object as a whole. Applying this idea, we construct weak-symmetry versions of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger and Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes models. These weak-symmetry models behave in many aspects just like their conventional brethren---in particular, they host robust edge states---, though the corresponding topological invariants are only emphapproximately quantized. We conclude this work by experimentally realizing Hermitian and non-Hermitian versions of such approximate topological insulators and probe their edge states. Overall, given the ubiquity of symmetry in all areas of physics and engineering, we foresee our work to serve as a cornerstone for exploring how conventional, strong symmetry requirements can be replaced by weak-symmetry ones.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了拓扑效应可以通过一种较弱的对称形式——“部分潜在对称性”来实现，即仅在有效哈密顿量的特定能量尺度上要求不变性。研究构建了Su-Schrieffer-Heeger和Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes模型的弱对称版本，这些模型表现出与传统模型相似的特性，包括鲁棒的边缘态，尽管相应的拓扑不变量仅是近似量化的。最后，实验实现了此类近似拓扑绝缘体的厄米和非厄米版本并探测了其边缘态。
authors: Lumen Eek, Xuelong Chen, Malte Röntgen, Wenlong Gao, Cristiane Morais Smith

articles.title: The Spectroscopic Atlas of Excitonic Complexes in hBN-Encapsulated S-TMD Monolayers: From Excitons to Oxcitons and Beyond
articles.title_zh: hBN封装S-TMD单层中激子复合物的光谱图集：从激子到氧激子及更远
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) encapsulation has transformed the optical spectroscopy of semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers (MLs) by suppressing extrinsic disorder and enabling the resolution of an increasingly complex hierarchy of excitonic states. This Review provides a spectroscopy-oriented framework for understanding and identifying excitonic complexes in hBN-encapsulated Mo- and W-based MLs and their alloys. The discussion covers bright and dark excitons, Rydberg states, charged excitons, biexcitons, phonon-assisted replicas, and higher-order Fermi-sea many-body states, including hexcitons and oxcitons, with an emphasis on the experimental signatures that distinguish them. Particular attention is given to the combined use of photoluminescence and absorption-related spectroscopy, electrostatic gating, polarization analysis, excitation-power and temperature dependences, magnetic fields, and time-resolved measurements to establish microscopic assignments. The role of alloying as an additional degree of freedom for engineering the excitonic hierarchy, spin-valley configuration, and magneto-optical response is also highlighted. By organizing the rapidly expanding phenomenology around experimentally accessible fingerprints rather than individual material systems, this Review aims to provide a practical and broadly applicable guide for identifying, comparing, and engineering excitonic states in high-quality two-dimensional semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本综述提供了一个面向光谱学的框架，用于理解和识别hBN封装的Mo基和W基过渡金属二硫化物单层及其合金中的激子复合物。讨论涵盖了亮激子、暗激子、里德堡态、带电激子、双激子、声子辅助复本以及更高阶的费米海多体态，包括六激子和氧激子。综述强调了区分这些激子复合物的实验特征，并特别关注了结合多种光谱技术和外部条件来建立微观归属。
authors: Maciej R. Molas

articles.title: Room-temperature near-infrared optical readout of triplet spin states integrated in carbon nanotubes towards quantum sensing
articles.title_zh: 碳纳米管中三重态自旋态的室温近红外光学读出及其在量子传感中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optically addressable electron spin qubits that function at room temperature and under ambient conditions are essential for advancing quantum sensing. Solid state defect platforms offer robust spin-photon interfaces but lack precise defect positioning and electronic tunability. Molecular spin qubits enable bottom up chemical design yet suffer from limited photostability. Here, we introduce para-halophenyl (-Cl, -Br and -I) quantum defects in (6,5) single wall carbon nanotubes that trap triplet excitons with a spin-photon interface that is operable under ambient, room temperature conditions. These defects were shown to emit in the near infrared within the biological transparency window, and their placement on the nanotube surface provides nanoscale proximity to target environments. The deep optical traps formed by the defects yield exceptional photostability. Here, we demonstrate optical initialization and readout of these triplet states at room temperature, provide proof of principle sensing of paramagnetic molecules, and highlight potential for on chip detection. Together, these results establish SWCNT defects as a promising new platform for future quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在(6,5)单壁碳纳米管中引入了对卤苯基量子缺陷，这些缺陷能在室温和环境条件下捕获三重态激子，并提供自旋-光子界面。这些缺陷在生物透明窗口内发射近红外光，并具有出色的光稳定性。作者展示了这些三重态的室温光学初始化和读出，并验证了其对顺磁分子的传感能力，为片上检测提供了潜力。
authors: J. Alejandro de Sousa, Ilias Vandevenne, Jana Nikolić, Tuur Boonen, Etienne Goovaerts, Sofie Cambré

articles.title: Charge Density Wave transient states induced by ultrashort hard X-ray pulses
articles.title_zh: 超短硬X射线脉冲诱导的电荷密度波瞬态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interaction of quantum systems with ultrashort laser pulses may lead to transient states far from equilibrium. Among these, Charge Density Wave (CDW) systems offer very rich non-equilibrium physics when submitted to ultrashort optical excitations in the infrared regime. In this Letter, we show that CDW systems pumped by ultrashort x-ray pulses excite the system in very different way. The x-ray pump, 6000 times more energetic than a laser pulse, pumping and probing the whole bulk system simultaneously, drives CDW systems in a novel reversible out of equilibrium state. The successive CDW states observed in the NbSe₃ system with respect to the arrival of x-ray pulses follow a non-thermal kinetic path. It is characterized by a change in 2k_F wavevector, correlation lengths and electronic gap, as well as a change of dimensionality, all of this takes place within a very long recovery time ranging from 450ns to 0.01s. Several scenarios are proposed, including transient nucleation and recombination of charged topological objects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了超短X射线脉冲对电荷密度波（CDW）系统的激发效应，发现其与红外激光激发方式显著不同。X射线泵浦将CDW系统驱动至一种新型可逆的非平衡态，NbSe₃中观察到的CDW态遵循非热动力学路径。该瞬态表现出2k_F波矢、关联长度、电子能隙和维度变化，并具有长达450ns至0.01s的恢复时间。
authors: D. Ghoneim, E. Bellec, L. Ortega, V. L. R. Jacques, A. A Sinchenko, P. Wzietek, U. Boesenberg, K. Kazarian, J. Moeller, J. D. Moore, A. Rodriguez-Fernandez, R. Shayduk, A. Zozulya, A. Madsen, D. Le Bolloc'h

articles.title: Stabilizing and detecting electron fractionalization in the Hofstadter-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中电子分数化的稳定与探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent progress in correlated Chern insulator physics in moiré systems, we investigate the half-filled triangular-lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard model and its electron fractionalization. Among various competing non-magnetic states, increasing the orbital flux stabilizes and broadens the U(1)₂ chiral spin liquid phase in the Mott regime. In this exotic regime, the electron is fractionalized into gapped spinons and gapped chargons, whose effective bands are linked to the orbital flux. The convolution of the narrow spinon bands with the gapped chargon excitations produces rich and discernible structures in the electron spectral function and the density of states. These results not only identify the orbital flux as a control parameter for the detailed patterns of electron fractionalization and the nature of the Mott transition, but also provide the key spectral characteristics for the angle-resolved photoemission and scanning tunneling studies of the relevant systems, linking the free-particle band topology to intrinsic topological order in the correlated regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了半填充三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中的电子分数化现象。结果表明，增加轨道磁通能稳定并拓宽莫特区域中的U(1)₂手性自旋液体相，其中电子分数化为有能隙的自旋子和电荷子。这些发现不仅揭示了轨道磁通作为电子分数化和莫特转变的关键控制参数，也为角分辨光电子发射和扫描隧道显微镜研究提供了重要的光谱特征。
authors: Jiahao Yang, Zeyu Han, Gang v. Chen

articles.title: Generalized Coordinate Bethe Ansatz and Quantum Integrability of the Time-Dependent Massive Thirring Model
articles.title_zh: 时变有质量Thirring模型的广义坐标Bethe Ansatz与量子可积性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29998v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a generalized coordinate Bethe-ansatz framework for the massive Thirring model with an explicitly time-dependent fermion mass. Unlike the generalized Bethe ansatz for chiral quantum field theories, where particle transport acts in internal spin spaces and leads to quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations, the present construction acts directly on particle coordinates and physical rapidities. Its central new feature is a rapidity lattice. Because the time-dependent mass couples right- and left-moving components already in the one-particle sector, a fixed-rapidity block is not closed under spatial winding. Periodicity therefore requires all sectors generated by the finite shift β→β-p. Particle exchange relates amplitudes on this lattice through scalar analytic difference equations of Ruijsenaars type, whose solutions determine the complete time-dependent many-body wavefunction. Consistency of the coordinate construction also selects an exponential evolution of the bare mass, providing a new realization of the time dependent integrability-renormalization group correspondence. In the static limit, the rapidity-lattice construction reduces to the conventional massive-Thirring Bethe equations. Through the massive-Thirring/sine Gordon equivalence, the result also connects this exact quantum construction to the generalized space-time dependent Lax formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为具有显式时变费米子质量的有质量Thirring模型开发了一个广义坐标Bethe Ansatz框架。该方法直接作用于粒子坐标和物理快度，其核心新特征是快度格点。时变质量导致快度格点上的振幅通过Ruijsenaars类型的标量解析差分方程关联，其解决定了完整的时变多体波函数。该坐标构造的一致性还选择了裸质量的指数演化，为时变可积性-重整化群对应提供了一个新实现。
authors: Parameshwar R. Pasnoori

articles.title: Spatiotemporal spin transport from first principles
articles.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的时空自旋输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.07745v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Manipulating spin for quantum information and spintronic devices requires quantitative prediction of quantum transport over long time and length scales. We introduce a computational framework for first-principles density-matrix quantum transport within the Wigner function formalism that facilitates spin dynamics and transport simulations, while accounting for electron-phonon scattering at device length scales. This allows us to elucidate the impact of realistic spin-orbit fields, such as Rashba and persistent spin helix, on coherent spin transport in several materials, as well as the transition to incoherent transport with increasing strength of electron-phonon scattering. We identify three distinct regimes of incoherent spin transport corresponding to the free induction decay, Dyakonov-Perel and Elliott-Yafet regimes of spin relaxation, and find a scattering-strength-independent spin diffusion length within the Dyakonov-Perel regime. With applied magnetic fields, spin transport in this regime is sensitive to scattering strength and leads to asymmetric Hanle curves that probe the internal spin-orbit field of the material.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个基于Wigner函数形式的第一性原理密度矩阵量子输运计算框架，用于模拟自旋动力学和输运，并考虑了电子-声子散射。该框架揭示了Rashba和持久自旋螺旋等自旋-轨道场对材料中相干自旋输运的影响，以及随着电子-声子散射增强向非相干输运的转变。研究识别了非相干自旋输运的三个不同弛豫机制，并在Dyakonov-Perel机制中发现了一个与散射强度无关的自旋扩散长度。
authors: Mayada Fadel, Joshua Quinton, Mani Chandra, Mayank Gupta, Aron W. Cummings, Yuan Ping, Ravishankar Sundararaman

articles.title: Topological and Trivial Valence-Bond Orders in Higher-Spin Kitaev Models
articles.title_zh: 高自旋Kitaev模型中的拓扑与平庸价键序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.07415v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the quantum phases of higher-spin Kitaev models using tensor network methods. Our results reveal distinct bond-ordered phases for spin-1, spin-tfrac32, and spin-2 models. In all cases, we find translational symmetry breaking with unit cells being tripled by forming valence-bond orders. However, these three phases are distinct, forming plaquette order, topological dimer order, and non-topological dimer order, respectively. Our findings are based on a cross-validation between variational two-dimensional tensor network calculations: an unrestricted exploration of symmetry-broken states versus the detection of symmetry breaking from cat-state behavior in symmetry-restricted states. The origin of different orders can also be understood from a theoretical analysis. Our work sheds light upon the interplay between topological and symmetry-breaking orders as well as their detection via tensor networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用张量网络方法研究了高自旋Kitaev模型的量子相。结果揭示了自旋-1、自旋-3/2和自旋-2模型中存在不同的键序相，均表现出通过形成价键序导致晶胞三倍化的平移对称性破缺。这些相分别形成了面序、拓扑二聚体序和非拓扑二聚体序。研究工作阐明了拓扑序与对称性破缺序之间的相互作用，以及通过张量网络对其进行探测的方法。
authors: Xing-Yu Zhang, Qi Yang, Philippe Corboz, Jutho Haegeman, Yuchi He

articles.title: Observation and Control of Spontaneous Magnon Emission from Spin Ensembles in 2D Hexagonal Boron Nitride
articles.title_zh: 二维六方氮化硼自旋系综中自发磁振子发射的观测与控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20996v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid systems consisting of color centers and magnetic materials provide an appealing solid-state platform for advancing the burgeoning quantum technological revolution. Exploring novel coupling mechanisms between optically active spin defects and quantum degrees of freedom is directly relevant in this context. Here, we report observation and control of spontaneous magnon emission from boron-vacancy centers in 2D hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) to a proximal ferrimagnet in the near-zero temperature limit. The spontaneous magnon emission process is overshadowed by thermal magnon effect as temperature increases, reflecting the crossover from a spontaneous-emission-dominated magnon reservoir to a thermally occupied spin bath where absorption and stimulated processes restore balance. By increasing the spin defect density, we further present that spontaneous magnon emission into a common spin bath could help establish magnon-mediated correlations in dense hBN spin ensembles. Our results are quantitatively captured by theoretical modeling, bringing insights into understanding qubit-magnon coupling, correlated spin dynamics, and many-body physics of color centers in the quantum regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了在接近零开尔文温度下，二维六方氮化硼（hBN）中硼空位中心向邻近亚铁磁体自发发射磁振子的观测与控制。随着温度升高，自发磁振子发射被热磁振子效应掩盖。研究还发现，增加自旋缺陷密度，自发磁振子发射进入共同自旋浴有助于在密集hBN自旋系综中建立磁振子介导的关联。这些结果为理解量子比特-磁振子耦合、关联自旋动力学和多体物理提供了见解。
authors: Ling-Jie Zhou, Jayakrishnan M. P. Nair, Senlei Li, Thomas Poirier, Yiran Zhao, Zelong Xiong, Sumedh Rathi, Jingcheng Zhou, Zhigang Jiang, Hailong Wang, James H. Edgar, Benedetta Flebus, Chunhui Rita Du

articles.title: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
articles.title_zh: 镁化合物的紧束缚与机器学习势能结合模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25853v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种结合密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）与机器学习原子间势能（MACE）的镁基系统模型（DFTB+MACE）。该模型用多体MACE势能取代了传统的对势排斥势。该模型在MgO-CO2吸附系统、水团簇分子动力学和MgO声子谱计算中表现出相对于传统DFTB的更高精度，且计算成本适中，并能提供大多数机器学习势能无法提供的电子结构。
authors: Jiwen Yu, Arash A. Mostofi, Andrew Horsfield

articles.title: Entropy functional theory for inhomogeneous fluids
articles.title_zh: 非均匀流体的熵泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28240v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exact variational scheme for the physics of inhomogeneous classical fluids in thermal equilibrium. A joint metadensity minimization principle is proven for the one-body density and the global interparticle distance distribution. The theory bypasses the inhomogeneous two-body density and thus remains computationally simple. A universal excess entropy functional accounts for all many-body correlations in arbitrary pairwise interacting systems. The framework is relevant for neural functional machine learning, for soft matter design, and for predicting hyperobservables, structural correlation functions, and first-principles mechanisms of entropy-energy competition.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于热平衡下非均匀经典流体物理学的精确变分方案。该理论证明了一个关于单体密度和全局粒子间距离分布的联合元密度最小化原理，从而避免了非均匀两体密度，保持了计算的简洁性。一个普适的过量熵泛函解释了任意成对相互作用系统中所有的多体关联。该框架对神经泛函机器学习、软物质设计以及预测超可观测量和熵-能竞争机制具有重要意义。
authors: Matthias Schmidt

articles.title: Entropy functional universality: Correlation, response, many-body interaction, multi-component, quantum, hyperfunctional, and Ornstein-Zernike structure
articles.title_zh: 熵泛函普适性：关联、响应、多体相互作用、多组分、量子、超泛函和Ornstein-Zernike结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03032v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We give a comprehensive account of the recent entropy functional theory for the equilibrium statistical mechanics of classical many-body systems (arXiv:2606.28240). The approach is formally exact and based on a joint grand potential minimization principle for the one-body density and the global pair distance distribution. These variational fields depend respectively on position and on scalar distance, which retains the low computational complexity of standard density functional theory. Correlation effects are contained in a unique excess entropy functional, which is universal across all systems with pairwise interparticle potentials. Functional differentiation yields entropic direct correlation functionals that generate entropic response and fluctuation correlation functions via coupled Ornstein-Zernike equations. Two alternative proofs are given for the existence and uniqueness of the underlying metadensity functional map, based on generalizations of either Levy's constrained search method or Mermin-Evans proof by contradiction. Simple excess entropy approximations yield the standard mean-field and second-virial excess free energy density functionals. We describe exact entropic functional line integrals, make connections to the recent one-body fluctuation profiles, and generalize the entropy approach beyond pairwise interparticle potentials via parametric dependence or reduction operators. We also lay out the formulation for multi-component systems, the hyperfunctional for general observables, and the quantum entropy functional.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文全面阐述了近期提出的经典多体系统平衡统计力学的熵泛函理论。该方法基于单体密度和全局对距离分布的联合巨势最小化原理，形式上是精确的。关联效应包含在一个独特的过量熵泛函中，该泛函对所有具有成对粒子间势的系统都是普适的。泛函微分产生熵直接关联泛函，通过耦合的Ornstein-Zernike方程生成熵响应和涨落关联函数。
authors: Matthias Schmidt

articles.title: Radiative spin caloritronics in nonreciprocal many-body systems
articles.title_zh: 非互易多体系统中的辐射自旋热电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22845v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We predict the spin thermal Hall effect in nonreciprocal magneto-optical many-body systems, in which a longitudinal radiative heat current generates a transverse accumulation of the spin angular momentum carried by thermal photons. We show that this effect and the inverse spin thermal Hall effect constitute an Onsager-Casimir reciprocal pair, thereby establishing heat and photon spin as coupled transport channels in nonreciprocal photonic systems. The second law of thermodynamics imposes fundamental bounds on the spin-heat coupling, leading to a thermal-spin figure of merit that quantifies the efficiency of radiative spin-heat conversion. Our results establish a complete thermodynamic framework for photon spin caloritronics and lay the conceptual foundations for spin-controlled thermal radiation and nonreciprocal photonic thermal devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文预测了非互易磁光多体系统中的自旋热霍尔效应，其中纵向辐射热流产生热光子携带的自旋角动量的横向累积。研究表明，该效应与逆自旋热霍尔效应构成Onsager-Casimir互易对，确立了热量和光子自旋在非互易光子系统中作为耦合输运通道。热力学第二定律对自旋-热耦合施加了基本限制，导出了量化辐射自旋-热转换效率的热-自旋品质因数。
authors: Philippe Ben-Abdallah

articles.title: Drumhead Surface States of Rhombohedral Graphite with Near Ideal Quantum Geometry Condition
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨的鼓面表面态及其近理想量子几何条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28491v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The ideal quantum geometry (IQG) condition for the trace of quantum metric (TrG(k)) being equal to the magnitude of Berry curvature (|Ømega(k)|) as in |Ømega|/TrG=1 has been associated with realizing fractional Chern insulators for the flat bands in a few layers of rhombohedral graphene (RG). More recently the IQG condition has also been proposed for superconductivity in the flat bands of thick RG layers. Using density functional theory and Wannier functions, we study the symmetry-protected topology of bulk RG, drumhead surface states (DSS) of semi-infinite RG surface and slabs, and the IQG condition for thin and thick RG slabs. We find that bulk RG is a weak topological insulator with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), besides being effectively a chiral semimetal with chiral nodal lines without SOC. We also find that the DSS flat bands of thick RG slabs have a sizable convex curvature with dispersion depth agreeing with the recent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy experiment. The calculated IQG also shows a convex shape with the K point at the center having a minimum with approximately |Ømega|/TrGapprox1. But the inner rim of the DSS region approaches the IQG condition of |Ømega|/TrG=1. These results on thick RG slabs from first-principles calculations provide useful information for the pristine DSS at the single-particle level for future studies to consider when enhanced electron correlation and many-body interaction will be included.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度泛函理论和Wannier函数，研究了菱方石墨（RG）的对称保护拓扑性质、鼓面表面态（DSS）以及理想量子几何（IQG）条件。研究发现，块体RG在自旋轨道耦合下是弱拓扑绝缘体，无自旋轨道耦合时是手性半金属。厚RG板的DSS平带具有显著的凸曲率，且IQG条件在K点附近接近理想值，与实验结果一致。
authors: Lin-Lin Wang

articles.title: Atomic thermometry in optical lattice clocks: model discrepancies and their impact on lattice light shifts
articles.title_zh: 光晶格原子钟中的原子测温：模型差异及其对晶格光频移的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.08164v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurate measurement of atomic temperature is fundamental for a wide range of applications, from quantum sensing to precision metrology. In optical lattice clocks, precise characterization of atomic temperature is required to minimize systematic uncertainties at the 10⁻¹⁸ level. In this work, we investigate atomic temperature measurements in the ytterbium optical clock developed at INRIM, IT-Yb1, employing sideband and transverse Doppler spectroscopy across a wide range of trapping conditions in a one-dimensional optical lattice. By implementing clock-line-mediated Sisyphus cooling [Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 053401 (2024)], we reduce the atomic temperature and enable operation at shallower lattice depths down to D = 50,E_R, where E_R is the photon recoil energy. We compare temperature estimates obtained from the perturbed harmonic oscillator model with those derived using a Born-Oppenheimer model [Phys. Rev. A 101, 053416 (2020)]. Discrepancies of up to a factor of four are observed between the temperature estimates obtained with the two approximations. We assess the impact of these modeling differences on the evaluation of lattice light shifts and find relative frequency deviations of up to 8×10⁻¹⁷. Although sufficiently low atomic temperatures and the consistent use of theoretical models reduce these discrepancies to the low 10⁻¹⁸ level, these results motivate further investigations that will be relevant to state-of-the-art optical lattice clocks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了INRIM的镱原子光晶格钟IT-Yb1中的原子温度测量，采用边带和横向多普勒光谱技术。通过时钟线介导的Sisyphus冷却，原子温度得以降低，并能在更浅的晶格深度下运行。研究比较了微扰谐振子模型和Born-Oppenheimer模型得到的温度估计值，发现两者之间存在高达四倍的差异，并评估了这些模型差异对晶格光频移评估的影响。
authors: Irene Goti, Tommaso Petrucciani, Stefano Condio, Filippo Levi, Davide Calonico, Marco Pizzocaro

articles.title: Interacting quantum reference frames
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的量子参考系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate quantum reference frames within the Dirac quantization of gauge theories, where physical states are obtained from a kinematical Hilbert space Hₘ̊ ₖᵢₙ by group averaging. We assume the gauge group G is unimodular, and we define a quantum reference frame as a system of coherent states associated with a group G_R of frame orientations acting on a tensor factor of Hₘ̊ ₖᵢₙ. In direct analogy with the Faddeev-Popov procedure in path integrals, we show that the physical inner product can be written in terms of a choice of frame orientation with an appropriate operator measure, but that the physical Hilbert space is independent of this choice of frame. This yields a generalization of the Page-Wootters reduction map used to define conditional states and conditional probabilities of measurement outcomes given a frame orientation. These probabilities correspond to the expectation values of relational Dirac observables obtained from generalizations of previously considered relativization maps. Our main result is that the map that implements a change of frame is unitary, even when G does not act as a tensor-product representation across a factorization of Hₘ̊ ₖᵢₙ. The formalism therefore accommodates interactions between reference frames and the systems described relative to them. We apply this formalism to temporal frames, showing that a unitary Schrödinger equation emerges for an interacting clock and system, and that a previously reported time-nonlocal Schrödinger equation is recovered in an appropriate limit. With this, problems of non-unitarity are avoided by the use of the gauge-fixing measure in the physical inner product. We also discuss the case of interacting spatial frames, where the known correspondence between coherence in one frame and entanglement in another is shown to depend on the coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在规范理论的狄拉克量子化框架内构建了量子参考系，其中物理态通过群平均从运动学希尔伯特空间获得。作者将量子参考系定义为与作用于希尔伯特空间张量因子上的参考系方向群相关的相干态系统。研究表明，物理内积可以表示为参考系方向的选择和适当算符测度的函数，但物理希尔伯特空间与此选择无关。
authors: Leonardo Chataignier, Alexander R. H. Smith

articles.title: Local Clifford equivalence to CSS codes: Polynomial-time classification and conversion
articles.title_zh: 局部Clifford等价于CSS码：多项式时间分类与转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) codes support decoding and fault-tolerant logical operations through separate pure X and pure Z stabilizer checks. Generator choices and single-qubit Clifford transformations can obscure this structure. We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that decides whether an arbitrary stabilizer code is locally Clifford-equivalent to a CSS code and constructs the required transformation and CSS checks whenever such a form exists. For m possibly redundant generator rows on n qubits, the algorithm uses O(mn²⁺ⁿ⁴⁾ binary field operations. We reduce the problem to affine linear systems by characterizing local projectors that preserve the span of the binary stabilizer labels. The conversion preserves code parameters and check sparsity for quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes. We demonstrate CSS recovery and decoder reuse and resolve previously open LC-to-CSS classification questions for published code constructions. For graph states, LC-to-CSS equivalence corresponds to the existence of a bipartite graph in the local-complementation orbit. We derive a necessary-and-sufficient adjacency-matrix criterion for this property and construct such a graph whenever one exists. Our algorithm makes CSS decoding and fault-tolerant constructions accessible throughout the local Clifford equivalence classes of CSS codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种确定性多项式时间算法，用于判断任意稳定子码是否局部Clifford等价于CSS码，并在存在时构建所需的变换和CSS检查。该算法将问题简化为仿射线性系统，并通过表征保持二元稳定子标签跨度的局部投影仪来实现。此转换保留了量子低密度奇偶校验码（qLDPC）的码参数和检查稀疏性，并解决了先前关于LC到CSS分类的开放问题。
authors: Mingyuan Wang, Stefan Krastanov

articles.title: CoDecoder: Make Quantum Decoders Up to 100x Faster and Even More Accurate
articles.title_zh: CoDecoder：使量子解码器提速高达100倍并更准确
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers need fast and accurate error decoding. We present CoDecoder, a small neural frontend that composes with an existing decoder to improve accuracy and reduce mean decoding time. It predicts each shot's logical outcome, retains confident predictions and routes the remaining shots to the unchanged fallback. A logical-operator-aware output head scores shifted logical operators, combining equivalent logical lines on surface codes and deciding logical qubits jointly on bivariate-bicycle (BB) codes. Fused GPU inference and efficient routing reduce the overhead paid on every shot. In registered tests under circuit-level noise, composition reduces failures by 6.4-31.4% relative to correlated matching on surface codes of distance 7-17 and by 22-50% relative to full-DEM Relay-BP on two BB codes, with 2.3-124-fold speed-ups across these comparisons. With our re-implementations of the neural decoder Cascade, composition reduces decoding time in all four settings. A joint decision of both decoders on the routed shots keeps this speed and makes the composition more accurate than Cascade in all four, with 14-18% fewer failures on the [[72,12,6]] code. On the [[72,12,6]] BB code, a conventional head with independent logical outputs fails 3.8-5.0 times as often as our joint class score under matched training conditions. Per-shot analysis shows how composition gains accuracy. On retained shots, the frontend corrects more fallback errors than it introduces, even when it is less accurate overall.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了CoDecoder，一个小型神经网络前端，可与现有解码器结合使用，以提高准确性并缩短平均解码时间。它预测每次测量的逻辑结果，保留置信度高的预测，并将剩余的测量结果路由到未更改的备用解码器。在电路级噪声下的测试表明，CoDecoder在表面码和双变量循环码上显著减少了故障率，并实现了2.3至124倍的加速。
authors: Yicheng Guang, Yuliang Xiong, Xun Gao, Yueqi Chen

articles.title: Bias-Preserving Entanglement of Kerr-Cat Qubits with an ATS Coupler
articles.title_zh: 使用ATS耦合器实现Kerr猫量子比特的偏置保持纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kerr-cat qubits offer a hardware-efficient route to fault-tolerant quantum computing by suppressing bit-flip errors exponentially, while phase-flip errors increase only linearly with the mean photon number. To maintain this protection, entangling operations must be bias-preserving, ensuring that phase-flip errors occurring during the gate do not propagate into bit-flip errors. In this paper, we propose an asymmetrically threaded SQUID (ATS) parametric coupler to implement high-fidelity, bias-preserving entangling gates between Kerr-cat qubits. By engineering a photon-number asymmetry between the control and target modes, we enable fast gate operations that suppress non-adiabatic leakage without complex pulse shaping. Through numerical simulations of the full circuit Hamiltonian, we demonstrate a bias-preserving CX gate achieving 99.69% fidelity in the absence of photon loss for a gate duration of 50 ns. Under a single-photon loss rate of 100 kHz, our protocol yields a noise bias of 9922, exceeding the noise bias of a naive non-bias-preserving CX implementation by approximately a factor of 570. These results support the ATS coupler as a valuable building block for concatenated cat-qubit architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: Kerr猫量子比特通过指数抑制比特翻转错误，为容错量子计算提供了高效途径。为保持这种保护，纠缠操作必须是偏置保持的。本文提出了一种非对称螺纹SQUID（ATS）参数耦合器，用于实现Kerr猫量子比特之间的高保真、偏置保持纠缠门。数值模拟结果显示，在无光子损耗情况下，偏置保持CX门的保真度达到99.69%，且在单光子损耗率下，噪声偏置显著优于非偏置保持实现。
authors: Kerem Yurtseven, Shantanu R. Jha, Apoorva Limaye, Risav Pokhrel, Muhammad Waqar Amin

articles.title: Pushing beyond the memory barrier in propagation algorithms with randomization
articles.title_zh: 随机化传播算法突破内存限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Performant classical tools for simulating quantum circuits are important for benchmarking and supporting upcoming quantum devices. Pauli propagation offers promising capabilities, but deep circuits usually cause a rapid growth in the number of Pauli strings and can quickly exhaust the available memory. In this work, we introduce a randomized protocol that combines a specialized resampling schedule, merging, and a controlled amount of bias to keep the propagating Pauli sum within any prescribed memory budget. Additional computational resources can then be spent on embarrassingly parallel repetitions that systematically improve the estimate. Building on the open-source library PauliPropagation.jl, we show that 1) increasing memory of each simulation reduces the error systematically more than outside averaging, 2) resampling just enough to apply the next gate delays variance accumulation and gives better error-per-time trade-offs than more aggressive resampling, and 3) a small, controlled bias is crucial in cutting down variance and pushing far beyond unbiased randomization. The resulting framework can reproduce deterministic calculations while requiring several orders of magnitude less memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种随机化协议，用于模拟量子电路中的Pauli传播，以克服深层电路中Pauli字符串数量快速增长导致的内存耗尽问题。该协议结合了专门的重采样调度、合并和受控偏差，将传播的Pauli和保持在预设内存预算内。研究表明，增加每次模拟的内存、适度重采样以及引入受控偏差对于减少误差和方差至关重要，从而能够超越无偏随机化的限制。
authors: Manuel S. Rudolph, Ricard Puig, Slimane Thabet, Zoë Holmes

articles.title: Tunable flat bands from a parent chiral Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 从母体手性哈密顿量获得可调谐平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Systems with flat bands are interesting as they potentially host many exotic quantum phenomena that would be hard to observe in usual systems with dispersive bands. Multiple approaches were developed to construct flat band systems, with most of them requiring fine-tuning and/or solving a challenging inverse-eigenvalue problem. In this article we work with an idea that uses a parent bipartite system to generate a family of flat bands by means of Hilbert space projections. This method is largely free from fine-tuning constraints and allows us to identify conditions for a Hamiltonian to guarantee flat bands at desired energies, with desired degree of degeneracy. We also show that one can control the touching points of the flat band with dispersive bands at any desirable point in the Brillouin zone. In the process, we identify perturbations that preserve the flat bands or split them controllably. This approach provides easy tunability in designing flat band systems with desired properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用母体二分系统通过希尔伯特空间投影生成平带家族的方法。该方法在很大程度上摆脱了微调限制，并允许识别哈密顿量保证在所需能量下具有所需简并度平带的条件。研究还表明，可以控制平带与色散带在布里渊区任意点的接触点，并识别出保持或可控分裂平带的微扰。
authors: Jun-Hyung Bae, Alexei Andreanov, Saurabh Maiti

articles.title: From Qubit Tensorization to Gaussian Optimizers in Bosonic Systems
articles.title_zh: 从量子比特张量化到玻色子系统中的高斯优化器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28902v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a method for deriving Gaussian optimality results for bosonic quantum systems from inequalities for qubit systems. Inspired by Gross's derivation of the Gaussian logarithmic Sobolev inequality from an inequality on the two-point space, we use qubits as quantum two-point spaces and lift bosonic Weyl operators to pseudo-Weyl operators on large qubit systems. By controlling weighted norms and relative entropy in the fluctuation limit, we establish two transfer theorems that convert tensorized qubit inequalities into inequalities for bosonic Gaussian channels. As a first application, we prove that the sharp 2-logarithmic Sobolev inequality for the bosonic Ornstein--Uhlenbeck semigroup tensorizes without loss in the constant. We also establish a sharp output entropy inequality for tensor powers of a class of qubit channels. This includes a quantum Mrs.~Gerber's lemma determining the minimum output entropy of tensor powers of the qubit depolarizing channel at fixed input entropy. Applying our relative entropy transfer theorem, we obtain multimode constrained minimum output entropy bounds for Gaussian additive-noise channels and thermal attenuators in the heating range.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种从量子比特系统不等式推导玻色子量子系统高斯最优性结果的方法。通过将玻色子Weyl算符提升到大型量子比特系统上的伪Weyl算符，并控制涨落极限下的加权范数和相对熵，建立了两个转换定理。这些定理将张量化的量子比特不等式转换为玻色子高斯信道的不等式，并应用于证明玻色子Ornstein-Uhlenbeck半群的对数Sobolev不等式以及高斯加性噪声信道的多模受限最小输出熵界限。
authors: Salman Beigi, Hami Mehrabi

articles.title: Can Quantum Layers offer Performance and Security Advantages in Vision-Language Models?
articles.title_zh: 量子层能否为视觉-语言模型提供性能和安全优势？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As quantum computing moves from the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era toward early fault-tolerant quantum computing (EFTQC), quantum-enhanced AI is shifting from a conceptual idea to experimental research. Quantum components are expected to extend the capabilities of existing AI systems, yet it remains unclear how such components will help within large multimodal models. In this study, we try to answer that question for vision-language models (VLMs) using classically simulated quantum layers. With LLaVA-OneVision as the backbone, we evaluate 4- and 8-qubit basic-ring and strongly entangling circuits at four insertion and four replacement locations. Insertion adds quantum layers to the classical model, while replacement substitutes them for classical components. Using the same setup, we compare performance and computational cost between classical and quantum-classical hybrid models. On the Visual Spatial Reasoning dataset, inserting a quantum layer after the visual projector reaches 80.7% development accuracy, 2.28 percentage-points above classical full fine-tuning. Replacing the final decoder feed-forward sublayer retains 79.22% accuracy with 13.07 million fewer trainable parameters. Quantum insertion can thus improve accuracy, and selective replacement can reduce parameters. These benefits depend strongly on where the quantum layer is inserted or which classical component it replaces: earlier replacements lower accuracy, and fewer parameters do not reliably shorten training or reduce computation. To assess potential security benefits, we evaluated the robustness of quantum-classical hybrid models under six attack settings. Overall, our study maps where quantum layers help and hurt within VLMs, offering a starting point for hybrid VLM design; whether these gains generalize remains open. The code is available at https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/QuantumVLM.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了量子层在视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中提供性能和安全优势的可能性。作者使用经典模拟的量子层，以LLaVA-OneVision为骨干，评估了4和8量子比特电路在不同插入和替换位置的效果。结果显示，在视觉投影仪后插入量子层可使开发准确率达到80.7%，比经典全微调高出2.28个百分点，表明量子层在大型多模态模型中具有潜在的应用价值。
authors: Md Khalid Syfullah, Alvi Ataur Khalil

articles.title: Optimization versus fair sampling in quantum annealing: An exactly characterized frustrated Ising benchmark
articles.title_zh: 量子退火中的优化与公平采样：一个精确表征的受挫伊辛基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29035v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reaching a degenerate ground-state manifold and sampling it uniformly are distinct properties of a quantum annealer. We quantify this distinction using an Ising ring with additional couplings between maximally separated sites. For antiferromagnetic benchmark couplings and N ≥ 5, we derive the exact ground-state energy, degeneracy, and defect structure for each congruence class of N modulo four. This classification separates ground-state hit probability from conditional sampling bias. We embed instances with up to 162 logical spins on a D-Wave Advantage processor using length-two chains and compare its output with simulated annealing on the embedded and logical problems. For a frustrated N=83 instance, the processor visits 164 of the 166 exact ground states, yet the conditional distributions over states and defect sectors remain nonuniform. For N=160, the processor has a larger ground-state hit probability than logical simulated annealing (0.869 versus 0.519), but also a larger total-variation distance from uniformity (0.317 versus 0.136). A pause during the anneal raises the ground-state hit probability from 0.42 to 0.86 without restoring uniform sampling.
