These results identify a relaxation window and demonstrate that optimization success and sampling quality need not improve together, providing an exactly characterized benchmark for open-system quantum annealing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过一个具有额外耦合的伊辛环量化了量子退火器在达到简并基态流形和均匀采样之间的区别。研究推导了N模四的每个同余类的精确基态能量、简并度和缺陷结构。在D-Wave Advantage处理器上嵌入多达162个逻辑自旋的实例，并与模拟退火进行比较。结果表明，处理器在基态命中概率上优于逻辑模拟退火，但在均匀性方面存在更大的总变差距离。
authors: Masaru Hitomi, Masayuki Ohzeki

articles.title: Buffer-Qubit-Based Quantum Circuit Allocation Method Against Crosstalk Attacks
articles.title_zh: 基于缓冲量子比特的抗串扰攻击量子电路分配方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Multi-Programming (QMP) enables the simultaneous execution of quantum circuits from multiple users on a single quantum chip in cloud quantum computing services. However, QMP is vulnerable to crosstalk attacks, in which a malicious user deliberately induces crosstalk to disrupt other users' computations. As a countermeasure, prior work has proposed the use of buffer qubits, which remain idle and are allocated between quantum circuits to suppress the effect of crosstalk. Nevertheless, to the best of our knowledge, such countermeasures have not been publicly reported in production quantum cloud software. In this paper, we extend the QMP of OQTOPUS, open-source software that is already in production use for operating real quantum computers, with a buffer-qubit-based circuit allocation method. Experiments on a real device characterize the attack effect in terms of energy relaxation and dephasing, showing that observable degradation appears in dephasing characteristics of qubits adjacent to the attacker circuit. Based on this result, we release the proposed method as part of OQTOPUS and confirm that the buffer qubits are correctly reserved around the allocated circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子多程序（QMP）在云量子计算中易受串扰攻击。现有对策提出使用缓冲量子比特，但尚未在生产环境中应用。本文将基于缓冲量子比特的电路分配方法扩展到开源生产软件OQTOPUS中。在真实设备上的实验表明，串扰会导致相邻量子比特的退相干特性出现可观测的退化。该方法已作为OQTOPUS的一部分发布，并确认缓冲量子比特功能正常。
authors: Haruki Nakayama, Satoyuki Tsukano, Satoshi Kono, Keita Matsumoto, Toshio Mori, Takumi Oikawa, Ryo Uchida

articles.title: QUBO-Based Conformer Selection with Quantum-Classical Hybrid Optimization for Multiconformer Ligand Modeling
articles.title_zh: 基于QUBO和量子-经典混合优化的多构象配体建模构象选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29058v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A ligand can adopt multiple conformations within the same binding site, and these conformations can interact differently with the surrounding protein. Multiconformer modeling must therefore determine which candidate conformations to retain and what occupancies to assign to them. An established automated approach uses mixed-integer quadratic programming (MIQP) with hard occupancy and conformer-count limits for this selection. Here, we reformulated conformer selection as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem with finite penalties and discrete occupancies. We solved the QUBO using a quantum-classical hybrid solver. We compared this workflow with the MIQP-based qFit-ligand workflow across 83 paired X-ray ligand entries using the same experimental inputs and the same qFit-ligand processing protocol. For each entry, both final models were evaluated against the same composite-omit map generated from the common input structure before the two workflows diverged. Quantum-qFit produced higher ligand-region real-space correlation coefficients (RSCC) in 62 entries 74.7% and lower occupancy-weighted torsional strain in 66 entries 79.5%. Similar directional trends remained in the 28 entries with matched final conformer counts. The molecular Electron Density for Individual Atoms score (EDIAm) decreased in most entries. This result shows that higher regional map agreement did not necessarily correspond to stronger atom-level density support. Overall, the results show that the conformer-selection formulation can change which ligand states are represented from the same experimental data and provide a QUBO framework for studying multiconformer ligand selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 配体在结合位点内可采取多种构象，多构象建模需选择候选构象并分配占据率。传统方法使用MIQP，本文将构象选择重构为具有有限惩罚和离散占据率的二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，并使用量子-经典混合求解器解决。与MIQP方法相比，量子-qFit工作流在74.7%的配体条目中实现了更高的配体区域实空间相关系数，并降低了占据率加权扭转应变。
authors: Jiyun Lee, Haeseong Kim, Junho Lee, Joonsuk Huh

articles.title: Fast Template Matching for Quantum Circuits Using Hypergraph
articles.title_zh: 基于超图的量子电路快速模板匹配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum circuit optimization is a key step toward the efficient execution of quantum algorithms. Template matching has emerged as one of the dominant approaches for simplifying quantum circuits, yet it confronts the intrinsic challenge of accommodating gate commutativity. The state-of-the-art template-matching algorithm relies on a directed acyclic graph (DAG) representation. While this DAG-based technique handles gate commutativity satisfactorily, it fails to preserve the local connectivity inherent to quantum circuits, thereby leading to relatively high matching complexity. In this paper, we introduce a hypergraph representation (HG), a commutativity-aware representation that collapses commuting gates into a single super-node while retaining all local connectivity. This enables matches to be extended locally without revisiting the rest of the circuit, with incremental updates limited to the immediate neighborhood. Experimental results demonstrate that our HG matcher achieves 11--606x speed-up over the DAG-based implementation in Qiskit (Iten et al., 2022) on both random and arithmetic benchmarks, while maintaining the same optimization quality. The acceleration increases with circuit size, confirming that preserving locality and connectivity is the key to scalable quantum circuit optimisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路优化中的模板匹配面临门可交换性挑战。现有基于有向无环图（DAG）的方法虽能处理可交换性，但未能保留局部连通性，导致匹配复杂性较高。本文引入了一种超图（HG）表示，它能将可交换门折叠成一个超节点，同时保留所有局部连通性。实验结果表明，与Qiskit中基于DAG的实现相比，我们的HG匹配器实现了11-606倍的速度提升，并保持了相同的优化效果。
authors: Xin Hong, Jintao Yu, Runhong He, Shenggang Ying, Sanjiang Li, Mingsheng Ying

articles.title: Turning Quantum Compiler Configuration Selection Upside Down: A Top-Down Paradigm
articles.title_zh: 颠覆量子编译器配置选择：一种自上而下的范式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Selecting an effective quantum compiler configuration requires coordinated decisions over both hardware targets and compiler settings, with the ultimate goal of improving circuit execution fidelity. Existing SOTA approaches typically decompose this problem into two sequential stages: a device is chosen first, after which compiler options are tuned on that device through RL-based search. This bottom-up strategy can be fundamentally limited by its initial device decision, since a poorly matched backend may constrain the best fidelity achievable regardless of how effectively later compiler options are optimized. In contrast to classical compiler tuning, where the search space is often prohibitively large, the configuration space of quantum compilers remains manageable enough to support exhaustive search. Consequently, rather than repeatedly searching from candidate configurations, one can derive reusable configuration knowledge from offline oracle results and apply it directly to new circuits. In this paper, we introduce a top-down configuration-selection paradigm and build QuOPTBench, an exhaustively searched benchmark containing oracle configurations for 268 quantum circuits. We first study whether LLMs can directly infer suitable configurations and evaluate ten representative LLMs. The results reveal that vanilla LLMs remain far from the oracle. We then employ an LLM to extract transferable rules from sampled circuits governing configuration selection. Using these rules together with predictors trained on the enumerated configuration data of the sampled circuits, we design QuTOP, a rule-guided ML framework that performs fast configuration selection without iterative online search. Across our evaluation, the distilled rules consistently strengthen LLM-based selection, while QuTOP provides the strongest overall balance between solution quality and selection latency among the baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 选择有效的量子编译器配置需要协调硬件目标和编译器设置，以提高电路执行保真度。现有最先进（自下而上）的方法通常先选择设备，再通过强化学习调整编译器选项，但这可能受限于初始设备选择。本文提出一种自上而下的配置选择范式，利用量子编译器配置空间相对可控的特点支持穷尽搜索。我们构建了QuOPTBench，一个包含预言机结果的穷尽搜索基准，以提供可重用的配置知识。
authors: Ming Zhong, Xiangyu Ren, Kangyu Zheng, Zhi Zeng, Shenggen Zheng, Shaohua Li, Zhiding Liang

articles.title: Readout Dependent Parameter Identifiability of Quantum Kernels
articles.title_zh: 量子核的读出依赖参数可识别性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A circuit parameter can change measured features without changing their projected Gaussian kernel. We characterize this lost dependence and distinguish recovery by metric design from nonlinear feature expansion. With analytic feature coefficients, a fixed finite data basis affinely independent on the input domain, a fixed positive definite metric, and fixed bandwidth, the coefficient Gram matrix determines all-input kernel equivalence, global coordinate inactivity, and generic differential rank. An exact four-qubit family exhibits a sharp boundary: diagonal metrics give rank two, dense metrics reach but cannot exceed three, and no fixed affine expansion crosses this ceiling. One appended nonlinear scalar coordinate suffices for rank four and is minimal when the original features are retained. A single pairwise product achieves this with an explicit nondiagonal metric; a scalar sum of two products achieves it with a diagonal metric. Both use existing ideal local means. Exact certificates establish ranks in 54 selected circuit/readout settings. Matched finite-shot comparisons show that minimal representation size need not give the best sensitivity among the tested designs. Under a factorized measurement distribution, conditional product estimation cannot increase variance at a fixed design. Execution audits further separate kernel identifiability from compiled cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 电路参数可以在不改变其投影高斯核的情况下改变测量特征。本文表征了这种丢失的依赖性，并区分了通过度量设计和非线性特征扩展进行的恢复。通过解析特征系数、固定的有限数据基和正定度量，系数格拉姆矩阵决定了全输入核等价性、全局坐标不活跃性和通用微分秩。一个精确的四量子比特族展示了秩的清晰边界，并指出最小表示尺寸不一定能带来最佳性能。
authors: Hyong Keun Park, Jahoon Jeong, Joonkyo Shim, Hyunsoo Yoon

articles.title: Alignment of the amplitudes of stored states for solving the associative memory problem using quantum annealing
articles.title_zh: 利用量子退火解决联想记忆问题中存储态幅度的对齐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The solution of combinatorial optimization problems by means of quantum annealing is based on the preparation of an equally superposition state. Such superposition is crucial to the associative memory problem of correctly recalling patterns. In this paper, we study the alignment of the amplitudes of stored states in memory using the proposed auxiliary Hamiltonian, which is switched off at the end of evolution. The results of the algorithm execution were obtained both by numerical modeling and by the perturbation theory method, which made it possible to obtain the dependences on physical parameters in explicit form. As examples, systems of two and three qutrits, represented by spins S=1, are considered. Since the Hamiltonian is expressed in a univer-sal form through projectors onto states stored in memory, it can be used for other quantum sys-tems (platforms).
articles.abstract_zh: 通过量子退火解决组合优化问题依赖于等叠加态的制备，这对于联想记忆中正确回忆模式至关重要。本文研究了利用所提出的辅助哈密顿量对存储态幅度进行对齐的方法，该哈密顿量在演化结束时关闭。算法执行结果通过数值模拟和微扰理论获得，从而以显式形式给出了对物理参数的依赖关系。该方法以通用形式通过投影算符表示，可用于其他量子系统。
authors: Vladimir E. Zobov, Ivan S. Pichkovskiy

articles.title: PQ-Vault: Provably Quantum-Safe Asset Custody for Unmodified Ethereum
articles.title_zh: PQ-Vault：针对未修改以太坊的量子安全资产托管方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A quantum computer could recover the key of any Ethereum account whose public key appears on chain. We prove that no sidechain or bridge that leaves Ethereum's rules unchanged can protect such accounts: their funds must move into a contract whose release condition relies only on quantum-safe primitives. We design emphPQ-Vault, a custody system for unmodified Ethereum combining this vault, a quantum-safe proof-of-stake sidechain whose checkpoints carry compact certificates, and an optimistic dispute protocol. We give the first security proof of compact certificates against quantum attackers and a matching attack: with classically chosen parameters, the guarantee falls from 128 to about 60 bits, and a simple rule restores it. We show that a common seed-update rule in hash-chain proof of stake lets an attacker steer chosen slots and profit from splitting its stake, and give an election whose steering gain and inclusion delay are provably bounded against quantum attackers. Since compressing certificates with a pairing-based SNARK breaks quantum security, we use fraud proofs that need a single signature check. For 65,536 validators, a certificate is 0.8 MB, 260 times smaller than all signatures, and verifies in about 20 ms; the vault accepts a checkpoint for about 420,000 gas.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机可能恢复以太坊账户的密钥。本文证明，任何不修改以太坊规则的侧链或桥接都无法保护此类账户，其资金必须转移到仅依赖量子安全原语的合约中。我们设计了PQ-Vault，一个针对未修改以太坊的托管系统，结合了量子安全权益证明侧链和乐观争议协议。本文首次提供了针对量子攻击者的紧凑证书安全证明，并提出了一个匹配攻击，通过简单规则恢复了安全保证。
authors: Hassan Khodaiemehr, Khadijeh Bagheri, Chen Feng

articles.title: Adapted Fröhlich-Pizzo Model for Horizon-Induced Decoherence
articles.title_zh: 适用于视界诱导退相干的Fröhlich-Pizzo模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Fröhlich-Pizzo (FP) model is a quantum-mechanical model originally developed to describe the interaction between an atom and the electromagnetic field in the nonrelativistic limit c→infty. We show that an adaptation of the FP model based on the local algebras of a U(1) chiral current captures essential features of the horizon-induced decoherence mechanism identified by Danielson, Satishchandran, and Wald (DSW) in the limit of large holding time T. Our analysis suggests that the effective dynamics of the system undergoing decoherence in the DSW setting retains non-Markovian features. Our approach also offers a glimpse into the possible role of quantum events in the dynamics underlying horizon-induced decoherence.
articles.abstract_zh: Fröhlich-Pizzo (FP) 模型最初用于描述原子与电磁场在非相对论极限下的相互作用。本文展示了基于U(1)手性电流局部代数的FP模型的一个改编版本，在长时间保持T的极限下，捕捉了Danielson、Satishchandran和Wald (DSW) 识别的视界诱导退相干机制的基本特征。分析表明，DSW设置中系统经历退相干的有效动力学保留了非马尔可夫特征，并揭示了量子事件在视界诱导退相干动力学中可能扮演的角色。
authors: Bik-Soon Sia

articles.title: Convergence Analysis of the Quantum Blahut-Arimoto Algorithm and the Contraction Coefficient of Qubit Amplitude-Damping Channels
articles.title_zh: 量子Blahut-Arimoto算法的收敛性分析及量子比特幅度阻尼信道的收缩系数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we investigate the convergence rate of the quantum Blahut-Arimoto (BA) algorithm proposed for computing the coherent information of less noisy quantum channels. Previous work established exponential convergence under certain restrictive assumptions on the channel. Using a Taylor expansion around a positive definite optimizer, we show that, for an injective degradable channel whose degrading channel has a relative-entropy contraction coefficient strictly less than one, the algorithm converges at an exponential rate after sufficiently many iterations. We further verify this condition for qubit amplitude-damping (AD) channels in the relevant parameter regime. In addition, by analyzing the Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori (BKM) metric on the Bloch ball, we derive an explicit characterization of the relative-entropy contraction coefficient of qubit AD channels. The proposed approach is further extended to calculate the relative contraction coefficient and the relative expansion coefficient of two qubit AD channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了用于计算低噪声量子信道相干信息的量子Blahut-Arimoto (BA) 算法的收敛速度。先前工作在某些限制性假设下建立了指数收敛。通过在正定优化器附近进行泰勒展开，我们证明对于可降级信道，如果其降级信道的相对熵收缩系数严格小于一，则算法在足够多次迭代后以指数速率收敛。我们进一步验证了量子比特幅度阻尼（AD）信道在相关参数范围内的这一条件，并推导了其相对熵收缩系数的显式表征。
authors: Junke Han, Yonglong Li

articles.title: Bounds on Attainable Rate Modulation in Fermi's Golden Rule
articles.title_zh: 费米黄金法则中可实现速率调制的界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling transition rates is a central objective across quantum optics, condensed-matter physics, and chemical physics, encompassing processes such as spontaneous emission, energy and charge transfer, spin relaxation, and chemical reactions. Although Fermi's golden rule provides a powerful framework for calculating such rates of weakly coupled transitions, conventional calculations require the interaction to be specified in advance; the range of rate responses attainable over a broader interaction space remains unknown. We formulate spectral-overlap golden-rule rates as quadratic forms of the interaction and derive rigorous bounds on rate modulation over a specified interaction space. As an example, application to energy transfer from a donor to a molecular vibration coupled to an optical cavity reveals that enhancement and suppression depend jointly on the interaction and cavity detuning, including continuous reversal of the rate response for a fixed interaction. The same approach may elucidate rate control for other golden-rule processes, including excitation-energy transfer, nonadiabatic electron transfer, nonradiative electronic transitions, vibrational and spin relaxation, and spontaneous emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 控制跃迁速率是量子光学、凝聚态物理和化学物理的核心目标。尽管费米黄金法则为计算弱耦合跃迁速率提供了强大框架，但传统计算要求预先指定相互作用，而更广泛相互作用空间中可实现的速率响应范围仍未知。本文将光谱重叠黄金法则速率公式化为相互作用的二次形式，并推导了在指定相互作用空间内速率调制的严格界限。例如，应用于从供体到与光学腔耦合的分子振动的能量转移，结果表明增强和抑制共同取决于相互作用和腔失谐，包括固定相互作用下速率响应的连续反转。
authors: Kaisei Ohata, Jun-Yu Dong, Yasutaka Kitahama, Akihito Ishizaki, Keisuke Goda

articles.title: Quantum Belief Characterization: A Multi-Shot Notion of Equivalence
articles.title_zh: 量子信念表征：一种多重测量等价概念
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent formulation of quantum belief showed that quantum retrodiction depends not only on the reduced density operator of the system of interest, but also on correlations with a hidden reference system, which leads to the notion of quantum belief equivalence. In this paper we formulate a multi-shot problem, where the extended posterior obtained after one update is used again as the prior for the next update. We first define a formal notion of n-shot equivalence and derive several propositions for arbitrary extended beliefs. We then argue that the agent must also specify why the data obtained in different rounds concern the same underlying object. Through the quantum de Finetti representation, this narrows the one-copy belief to a special class: candidate-state ensemble belief. In that sector, we show that two beliefs are n-shot equivalent if and only if their (n+1)-th moments are equal. We also give a physical interpretation of this moment condition and illustrate it through the equivalence between Haar priors and projective-design priors at bounded update depth.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信念的最新表述表明，量子回溯不仅取决于系统的约化密度算符，还取决于与隐藏参考系统的关联，从而引出了量子信念等价的概念。本文提出了一个多重测量问题，其中一次更新后获得的扩展后验被再次用作下一次更新的先验。我们首先定义了形式化的n重测量等价概念，并推导了任意扩展信念的若干命题。我们进一步论证，代理人还必须说明不同轮次中获得的数据为何涉及同一底层对象。通过量子de Finetti表示，这使得单副本信念缩小到一类特殊情况：候选态系综信念。在该领域，我们证明了两个信念是n重测量等价的，当且仅当它们的(n+1)阶矩相等。我们还对这一矩条件给出了物理解释，并通过Haar先验和投影设计先验在有界更新深度下的等价性进行了说明。
authors: Mingxuan Liu, Pavel Sekatski, Valerio Scarani

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Matterwave Interferometry in a Ring Waveguide
articles.title_zh: 环形波导中的量子增强物质波干涉测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29562v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a quantum-enhanced matter-wave interferometry protocol based on fractional-revival dynamics of a Bose-Einstein condensate in a ring, combined with a controlled interaction quench. Using the Truncated Wigner Approximation, we show that nonlinear evolution to the quarter revival generates modest spin squeezing of -2.03±0.28;dB, which subsequently degrades under further nonlinear evolution. In contrast, starting from a non-interacting condensate, a controlled interaction quench applied after the initial quarter-revival beam-splitter operation generates substantially stronger spin squeezing of -14.57±0.27;dB. We further show that phase control at t=3Tᵣ/8 rotates the squeezed quadrature onto the phase-sensitive direction hatJ_y, producing a phase-squeezed state at t=Tᵣ/2. The subsequent quarter-revival evolution converts this phase-squeezed state into a number-squeezed state, enabling population-difference readout. The resulting sequence provides a route to quantum-enhanced interferometry using the intrinsic fractional-revival dynamics of a ring together with controlled interaction and phase operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子增强物质波干涉测量协议，该协议基于环形玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的分数复兴动力学，并结合受控的相互作用猝灭。使用截断Wigner近似，非线性演化到四分之一复兴产生了适度的自旋挤压（-2.03±0.28 dB）。相比之下，从非相互作用凝聚体开始，在初始四分之一复兴分束器操作后施加受控相互作用猝灭，产生了显著更强的自旋挤压（-14.57±0.27 dB）。该序列为利用环的内在分数复兴动力学以及受控相互作用和相位操作实现量子增强干涉测量提供了一条途径。
authors: Sriganapathy Raghav, Utpal Roy

articles.title: Quantum f-divergences from retrodiction: a unifying classical variational principle
articles.title_zh: 基于逆推的量子f-散度：一个统一的经典变分原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29696v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The same classical f-divergence admits inequivalent extensions to quantum states. The question is whether these extensions can be obtained from a common operational variational principle. Here we generalize Matsumoto's reverse-test optimization by introducing a reference prior state. More explicitly, we minimize the statistical distinguishability between a forward and a reverse prepare-and-measure process, related by retrodiction through the chosen reference and subject to prescribed quantum averages. Distinguishability is quantified by the classical f-divergence between their complete records. For faithful states in finite dimension, we prove that the same spectral implementation attains the minimum simultaneously for every operator-convex f. Varying the reference allows us to interpolate between standard and maximal quantum f-divergences of the prescribed states, passing through the geodesic family. More precisely, a flat reference yields the standard quantum f-divergences, thereby giving the Nussbaum-Szkoła distributions a variational characterization as optimal records. Choosing either prescribed state as reference recovers maximal quantum f-divergences and Matsumoto's reverse tests, while power references realize the geodesic interpolation. In the relative-entropy case, this gives the passage from Umegaki to Belavkin-Staszewski relative entropy by changing the prior for retrodiction.
articles.abstract_zh: 相同的经典f-散度在量子态中存在不等价的扩展。本文通过引入参考先验态，推广了松本的逆向测试优化方法，从而提供了一个统一的经典变分原理来获取这些量子扩展。研究最小化了前向和逆向制备-测量过程之间的统计可区分性，并证明了在有限维忠实态下，相同的谱实现能同时达到所有算子凸f的最小值。通过改变参考态，可以插值得到标准和最大量子f-散度。
authors: Francesco Buscemi

articles.title: Conservation in Every Quantum Measurement Outcome?
articles.title_zh: 量子测量结果中的守恒性？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum mechanics, conservation laws are usually understood only statistically and only in the context of unitary evolution: during such evolution, if an observable commutes with the Hamiltonian, its expectation value and Born-rule probability distribution remain unchanged. Individual measurement outcomes, however, disrupt even this weak form of statistical conservation. Recently, though, it has been argued that a stronger, non-statistical form of conservation, valid at the level of individual measurement outcomes, can be recovered. The proposal relies on the claim that any superposition of eigenstates of a conserved quantity must ultimately be prepared relative to another physical system, which serves as the relevant reference frame and remains correlated with the system being prepared. On this enlarged description, the change observed in the measured system is claimed to be exactly compensated by an opposite change in the preparer, thereby restoring conservation at the level of individual measurement outcomes. We analyze this proposal and argue that it faces significant conceptual difficulties. We show that the proposed mechanism is not adequately justified and, moreover, does not establish conservation in individual measurement outcomes as claimed.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学中，守恒定律通常仅在统计意义上和幺正演化背景下成立，而单个测量结果会破坏这种统计守恒。最近有观点提出，可以在单个测量结果层面恢复更强的非统计守恒性，即被测系统中的变化可由制备器中的相反变化精确补偿。本文分析了这一提议，并指出其面临显著的概念性困难。
authors: E. Okon, D. Sudarsky, M. Wiedemann

articles.title: Resource Analysis of Quantum Optimization Algorithms via Variational Methods
articles.title_zh: 基于变分方法的量子优化算法资源分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) are promising approaches for solving combinatorial optimization problems on near-term quantum devices. However, the role played by quantum resources such as entanglement and coherence during the optimization process remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the evolution of these resources in two VQAs--the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) and the Feedback-based Algorithm for Quantum Optimization (FALQON)--applied to the Minimum Vertex Cover problem. We employ a variational resource-quantification framework based on the Bures metric and Uhlmann's theorem, in which an auxiliary quantum circuit is optimized to identify the closest resource-free states. This approach allows us to quantify Bures entanglement and Bures coherence of the algorithmic states without requiring full quantum state tomography. For the considered problem instance, QAOA exhibits a pronounced accumulation of entanglement in its initial layers, followed by a progressive reduction as the algorithm converges toward the optimal solution. Its coherence likewise decreases overall with increasing circuit depth, although a finite residual value persists due to the degeneracy of the optimal-solution subspace. In contrast, FALQON exhibits a substantially lower entanglement peak, reached at larger circuit depth, followed by a decay as convergence proceeds. Its coherence decreases smoothly and monotonically together with the optimization error. These results reveal distinct quantum-resource trajectories associated with the two optimization strategies and illustrate how entanglement and coherence evolve as variational quantum states approach solutions of a classical combinatorial optimization problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQAs）在解决组合优化问题方面前景广阔，但量子资源（如纠缠和相干性）在优化过程中的作用尚不明确。本研究利用基于Bures度量和Uhlmann定理的变分资源量化框架，分析了QAOA和FALQON两种VQA在解决最小顶点覆盖问题时纠缠和相干性的演化。结果显示，QAOA在初始层纠缠显著积累，随后随算法收敛而逐渐减少，相干性也随电路深度增加而降低。
authors: Vitor Dallabona, Lucas Friedrich, Jonas Maziero

articles.title: Finite Classification of Transversal Diagonal Gates Beyond Stabilizer Codes
articles.title_zh: 超越稳定子码的横向对角门有限分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish that transversal diagonal gates on exact qubit codes of distance at least two can be exhaustively classified within a finite search space. Although code-preserving physical gates can have continuous phases, any projective logical action induced by a transversal diagonal gate can always be realized by a physical gate of finite order. Crucially, we prove that this physical order has an upper bound determined solely by the code parameters. This order bound enables the subset-sum-linear-programming (SSLP) framework introduced in arXiv:2504.20847 to exhaustively enumerate all candidate discrete symmetries, after which the Knill-Laflamme equations determine the remaining continuous code parameters. Applying this method to the nontrivial diagonal sector of exact ((6,2,3)) codes, SSLP yields 66 candidate symmetry classes, of which exactly 15 are realizable, supporting full projective diagonal logical cyclic groups of orders 2, 3, and 5. In particular, for order 5, the code is unique up to local unitaries and qubit permutations, equivalent to the code constructed in arXiv:2504.20847. This code also attains the minimum length n=6 among exact ((n, 2, ge 3)) codes whose full projective transversal group cannot be conjugated into the projective Clifford group.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了距离至少为二的精确量子比特码上的横向对角门可以在有限搜索空间内进行穷尽分类。尽管物理门可能具有连续相位，但由横向对角门引起的任何投影逻辑操作都可以通过有限阶的物理门实现。研究发现，该物理阶存在一个仅由码参数决定的上限，这使得SSLP框架能够穷尽枚举所有候选离散对称性。将此方法应用于精确((6,2,3))码的非平凡对角扇区，发现了15个可实现的对称类，支持2、3和5阶的完整投影对角逻辑循环群。
authors: Xi He, Chao Zhang, Shilin Huang, Bei Zeng

articles.title: Meter-scale quantum interconnects between large quantum processors
articles.title_zh: 大型量子处理器之间的米级量子互连
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modular quantum architecture requires long-distance quantum interconnects to stitch together individual processor modules. Such interconnects, long-distance couplers or L-couplers, must support coherent quantum operation over meter-scale distances and scale to multiple connections between any two modules. Here we demonstrate four L-couplers operating between two 120-qubit IBM Nighthawk R1 superconducting qubit processors. Each L-coupler joins two Nighthawk lattice qubits through two frequency-tunable L-qubits, two RF-SQUID based "i2m" couplers, and 80 cm of superconducting aluminum coax. Each cable installs perpendicular to the processor surface, to enable denser connections, and is joined to the chip by an indium-to-indium room temperature pressure bond made after both modules were mounted. L-coupler modes near 5 GHz, with internal quality factors of 0.86 to 1.09e6, carry relay-based state transfer at a mean network benchmarking fidelity of 99.00%, with a best link of 99.29 +/- 0.07%. We then realize distant CZ gates between lattice qubits in separate modules at a mean fidelity of 94.75%, with a best link of 96.42 +/- 0.28%, and use them to generate entangled states across the two processors, including a demonstration of simultaneous Bell pair generation using two adjacent L-couplers. These four high-fidelity L-couplers establish a practical path to scalable quantum interconnects for modular quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 模块化量子架构需要长距离量子互连来连接独立的处理器模块。本研究展示了在两个120量子比特IBM Nighthawk R1超导量子处理器之间运行的四个米级L型耦合器。每个L型耦合器通过可调谐L型量子比特、RF-SQUID耦合器和80厘米超导铝同轴电缆连接两个Nighthawk晶格量子比特。这些L型耦合器实现了平均99.00%保真度的中继态传输，并在不同模块的晶格量子比特之间实现了平均94.75%保真度的远距离CZ门。
authors: Neereja M. Sundaresan, Nicholas Cotaj, Yadav Prasad Kandel, Eric Lewandowski, Christian Robert Longton, Yves Martin, Jae-woong Nah, Kathryn Pooley, Martin Sandberg, Michael Scanlon, Chi Xiong, Emanuil Sashev Yanev, David Abraham, Abhinandan Antony, Vincent Arena, Nicholas Bornman, Khanh Dang, Oliver Dial, Christopher Guarino, Gabriel Haspil, Jared Hertzberg, Kentaro Heya, Swetha Kamlapurkar, Michael Karschner, George Keefe, Eric Liniger, Laura Luo, Thomas G. McConkey, David Olson, Jason Orcutt, Dmitry Ovchinnikov, Timothy Phung, Sankeerth Rajalingam, Michael Selvanayagam, William Shanks, Dongbing Shao, Abigail Shearrow, Adam Stabile, Jiri Stehlik, Joseph Suttle, Jeng-Bang Yau, Eric Zhang

articles.title: Two particle interference: The Hanbury Brown Twiss and Hong Ou Mandel experiments
articles.title_zh: 双粒子干涉：Hanbury Brown Twiss和Hong Ou Mandel实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I discuss two important quantum optics experiments which depend on two particle interference. In the years since their first demonstration many interesting and instructive variants have appeared, including the use of atoms instead of photons as the interfering particles. This chapter gives a pedagogical overview of some of these results and argues that the two effects are closely related.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了两个依赖于双粒子干涉的重要量子光学实验：Hanbury Brown Twiss和Hong Ou Mandel实验。自首次演示以来，这些实验出现了许多有趣且富有启发性的变体，包括使用原子而非光子作为干涉粒子。本章对这些结果进行了教学性概述，并论证了这两种效应之间存在密切关联。
authors: Christoph I Westbrook

articles.title: An entanglement band structure for general multiqubit states
articles.title_zh: 通用多量子比特态的纠缠能带结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Majorana drew a symmetric multiqubit state as points on the Bloch sphere, antipodal to the zeros of its overlap with spin coherent states. Projecting only one qubit of a general state leaves the others in a state that varies with direction. Its entanglement invariants are eigenvalues of a non-Hermitian matrix and form bands over the sphere. Exceptional points appear, without gain or loss, where the entanglement family of the rest changes. Circling one exchanges two bands, so the bands form one Riemann surface. At five qubits it fixes the entanglement class up to finitely many choices.
articles.abstract_zh: Majorana将对称多量子比特态描绘为布洛赫球上的点。本文研究了通用多量子比特态投影一个量子比特后，其余量子比特态的纠缠不变量，这些不变量是非厄米矩阵的特征值，并在球面上形成能带。研究发现，存在无增益或损耗的特殊点，在此处其余部分的纠缠族发生变化，并且围绕这些点会交换两个能带，使能带形成一个黎曼曲面。对于五个量子比特，这能将纠缠类别固定为有限个选择。
authors: Chon-Fai Kam

articles.title: High-fidelity and robust controlled-Z gates for superconducting transmon qubits. I. Intrinsic errors and decoherence
articles.title_zh: 超导Transmon量子比特的高保真和鲁棒受控Z门。I. 内禀误差和退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires quantum gates that combine short duration, high fidelity, and robustness to noise. As quantum processors scale, robustness becomes increasingly important because exhaustive characterization and frequent recalibration of individual gates become impractical. We present a comprehensive optimal-control framework for controlled-Z (CZ) gates between directly coupled, frequency-tunable transmons that systematically accounts for intrinsic Hamiltonian errors and realistic decoherence mechanisms, including energy relaxation and dephasing. Using smooth, single-shot flux pulses, we obtain 12-ns CZ gates---close to the theoretical speed limit of 11.6 ns---with intrinsic errors suppressed to the 2×10⁻⁵ level. We construct dephasing noise models, calibrated against published experimental measurements, that capture fast dephasing from room-temperature control electronics and slow dephasing from 1/f flux noise. Using these models, we identify dephasing sweet spots that suppress sensitivity to dephasing noise. We further exploit transmon asymmetry as a design parameter to access distinct noise-resilient operating regimes. These results establish an experimentally applicable framework for balancing gate speed, fidelity, and noise robustness while reducing characterization and recalibration overhead.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算需要兼具短持续时间、高保真度和噪声鲁棒性的量子门。本研究提出了一个全面的最优控制框架，用于直接耦合、频率可调谐Transmon量子比特之间的受控Z（CZ）门，系统地考虑了内禀哈密顿量误差和实际退相干机制。通过平滑的单次磁通脉冲，实现了12纳秒的CZ门，内禀误差抑制到2×10⁻⁵水平。研究还构建了退相干噪声模型，并识别出抑制噪声敏感性的退相干甜点，进一步利用Transmon不对称性作为设计参数来获得不同的抗噪声操作。
authors: Chia-Hsien Huang, Hsi-Sheng Goan

articles.title: Hydrodynamic description of correlation matrix eigenvalues in a finite temperature expanding free fermionic gas
articles.title_zh: 有限温度膨胀自由费米气体中关联矩阵特征值的流体动力学描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30062v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent work considered the Page curve for entanglement entropy of a freely expanding one-dimensional Fermi gas starting from a finite box (the system) in a zero-temperature initial state that then expands in to a semi-infinite vacuum (the environment). For the case with a single defect at the system-environment junction, it was shown that the Yang-Yang entropy of the system computed from semiclassical hydrodynamics agrees with the microscopically computed entanglement entropy, yielding the Page curve. On the other hand, the environment Yang-Yang entropy showed a monotonic increase. Here, we propose a hydrodynamic description to obtain the eigenvalues of the microscopic correlation matrix for a nonzero temperature freely-expanding Fermi gas. For the system, the phase space density directly gives the correlation matrix eigenvalues and thus, via the Yang-Yang formula, yields the von-Neumann entropy. For the reservoir, a modification of the phase space density is required in the Yang-Yang formula, to incorporate coherences, in order to reproduce accurately the entropy. The hydrodynamic description of correlation matrix eigenvalues also leads to a Levitov-Lesovik type formula for the full-counting-statistics for a finite system in the transient regime. We provide a heuristic derivation of the correlation matrix eigenvalues based on a semiclassical wave-packet picture.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对有限温度下自由膨胀费米气体，本文提出了一种流体动力学描述方法，以获取微观关联矩阵的特征值。对于系统部分，相空间密度直接给出关联矩阵特征值，并通过杨-杨公式得到冯诺依曼熵。对于环境部分，杨-杨公式中的相空间密度需要进行修改以纳入相干性，从而准确重现熵。该流体动力学描述方法也适用于关联矩阵特征值。
authors: Atharva Naik, Madhumita Saha, David A. Huse, Manas Kulkarni, Abhishek Dhar

articles.title: The strengthened quantum Hamming bound of Yu, Lai, and Oh
articles.title_zh: Yu、Lai和Oh的强化量子汉明界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove a conjecture of Yu, Lai, and Oh: their rounded family of strengthened quantum Hamming bounds, which interpolates between Hamming-type bounds and the Singleton bound, holds for arbitrary exact quantum subspaces of dimension K>1. The result covers every integer local dimension pge2, every integer tge1, both distances 2t+1 and 2t+2, and every interpolation parameter ein0,łdots,t. Yu, Lai, and Oh proved these bounds for pure codes and for general codes of distance three or four; the case e=0 contains the ordinary quantum Hamming bound for general codes, recently proved by Zhang and Chen. More generally, for pge3, we prove the inequality Kf(0)łe pⁿEf(X), where XsimøperatornameBin(n,1-p⁻²), for every real polynomial f of degree at most D, with 2łe D
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了Yu、Lai和Oh提出的强化量子汉明界猜想，该猜想在汉明型界和Singleton界之间进行插值，并适用于维度K>1的任意精确量子子空间。该结果涵盖了所有整数局部维度p≥2、所有整数t≥1、距离2t+1和2t+2，以及所有插值参数e∈0,...,t。此工作推广了先前仅对纯码或特定距离码的证明，并包含了普通量子汉明界作为特例。
authors: Valery (Binyamin), Grishin (Yohananov), Aryeh Lev Zabokritskiy (Yohananov)

articles.title: Pure dephasing destroys two-photon amplitude, not nonlinear phase
articles.title_zh: 纯退相干破坏双光子振幅，而非非线性相位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A two-level emitter chirally coupled to a waveguide imprints a π conditional phase on a two-photon pulse, a key component assumed in quantum photonic neural network architectures, but whether it survives the pure dephasing of a solid-state emitter is unknown, since no two-photon scattering treatment includes it. We derive the dephased two-photon amplitude in closed form and validate it against an independent Fock-state master equation. The conditional phase is pinned at exactly π at every dephasing rate examined: dephasing destroys the amplitude carrying the nonlinear phase rather than rotating it. The one- and two-photon channels are not attenuated equally, so dephasing does not simply scale the node down but reweights it between photon-number sectors---an error no phase setting can train away. The standard factorization of two-photon correlators, exact for arbitrary loss, fails at first order in γ_φ, discarding 16--81% of pairs over γ_φ/γ=0.1--1.
articles.abstract_zh: 固态发射器的纯退相干如何影响量子光子神经网络中关键的π条件相位尚不清楚。本研究推导了退相干双光子振幅的闭合形式，并发现条件相位在所有退相干速率下均精确固定在π。这意味着退相干破坏的是承载非线性相位的振幅，而非旋转相位本身。此外，单光子和双光子通道的衰减不均等，导致退相干重新分配了光子数扇区之间的权重，这是一种无法通过相位设置消除的误差。
authors: Matthew Kozma, Stephen Hughes

articles.title: Benchmarking the Quantum Leap: Auditing LLM Evaluation for Quantum Code Generation
articles.title_zh: 量子飞跃的基准测试：审计LLM在量子代码生成中的评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28678v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate quantum programs, but reliable evaluation remains difficult because benchmarks differ in task composition, scoring, and failure handling. We evaluate 15 hosted frontier, open-weight, quantum-specialized, and retrieval-augmented models on five quantum code-generation suites (530 tasks), plus 10 models on our new QuantumBenchEval (QBE) benchmark (96 tasks across six topics). We report bootstrap confidence intervals, multiplicity-adjusted paired comparisons, and audits of output validity and evaluator behavior. QiskitHumanEval-Standard approaches saturation (98.7% pass@1), while its Hard variant retains headroom (63.8%). None of the five top-two comparisons across primary suites remains significant after multiple-comparison correction. Evaluator design substantially changes scores: removing checks for unspecified quantities raises GPT-6 Astra's QBE pass@1 from 0% to 94.1% (T1) and from 1.2% to 92.9% (T6), without changing model outputs. We identify 17 QuanBench-117 tasks with shared failures linked to benchmark-owned imports. Controlled probes also reveal unexecuted unit tests, leakage of canonical functions into candidate execution, and reference imports that block otherwise valid candidates. These defects can produce both false failures and false passes, so historical QuanBench results require revalidation under an isolated evaluator. Overall, leaderboard scores alone do not adequately characterize progress in quantum code generation. We release our harness, per-sample results, and audit artifacts and recommend validating evaluators, isolating candidate code, and reporting uncertainty and output validity.
articles.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成量子程序，但由于基准测试在任务组成、评分和故障处理方面的差异，可靠的评估仍然困难。本研究在五个量子代码生成套件和新的QuantumBenchEval基准上评估了15个LLM模型。结果显示，评估器设计显著影响分数，例如移除未指定数量的检查可大幅提高GPT-6 Astra的QBE通过率。研究还揭示了基准测试中未执行的单元测试和共享故障等问题，强调了评估LLM量子代码生成能力的复杂性。
authors: Ethan Seefried, Romit Ghosh, Sharmin Afrose, Nicholas Stapleton, Vicente Layton Ortega, Travis Humble, Tirthankar Ghosal

articles.title: Lamb shift of rotational energy levels in quantum gravity
articles.title_zh: 量子引力中转动能级的兰姆位移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28754v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the major challenges of modern foundational physics is the combination of quantum physics and general relativity into a theory of quantum gravity. A severe obstacle are the required extremely high energy scales for direct tests of quantum gravity effects. In recent years, attention has shifted towards near-future experimental predictions of effective or phenomenological models, such as gravitationally induced entanglement or interactions of linearized gravity with non-relativistic measurement devices. These developments motivate us to study the coupling between the quantized metric perturbation and an anisotropic quantum rigid rotor. The intuitive motivation for our study is that a sufficiently heavy rotor consists of a very large number of component systems. Although quantum gravitational effects are completely negligible at the scale of a single atom or molecule, the effects can get amplified by the sheer number of constituents. The resulting effective model describes the gravitational analogue of the angulon quasiparticle excitations discussed in condensed matter physics, suggesting a pathway for future analogue experiments. As a first concrete test of our model, we derive the gravitational Lamb shift for the energy eigenstates of the rotor, which become dressed by a cloud of virtual gravitons. Although the effect is very small, it could provide a concrete test for whether gravity is truly quantum.
articles.abstract_zh: 将量子物理与广义相对论结合是现代基础物理学的重大挑战之一，但量子引力效应的直接测试需要极高的能量尺度。本研究旨在探讨量子化度规微扰与各向异性量子刚性转子之间的耦合。研究的直观动机是，足够重的转子由大量组分系统组成，量子引力效应可能通过组分数量的累积而被放大。由此产生的有效模型描述了凝聚态物理中角子准粒子激发的引力模拟，为未来的模拟实验提供了途径。
authors: Oliver Benz, Marius Krumm, Wolfgang Wieland

articles.title: Methods for Deriving Nonlinear Kinetic Equations from the Dynamics of Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 从量子系统动力学推导非线性动力学方程的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28846v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The article outlines key topics related to deriving kinetic equations and, in general, to the relationship between the evolution equations governing quantum many-particle systems. The main issues being considered are the mathematical origin of quantum kinetic equations, novel methods for deriving kinetic equations from hierarchies of evolution equations for quantum systems, specifically focusing on kinetics within the framework of the evolution of observables, and the generalization of the quantum kinetic equation specified by non-separable initial states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文概述了从量子多粒子系统演化方程推导动力学方程的关键主题。主要探讨了量子动力学方程的数学起源、从量子系统演化方程层次结构中推导动力学方程的新方法，特别是关注可观测物演化框架内的动力学，以及非可分离初始态下量子动力学方程的推广。
authors: V. I. Gerasimenko

articles.title: Lieb-Robinson bounds via the Combes-Thomas estimate
articles.title_zh: 通过Combes-Thomas估计推导Lieb-Robinson界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28927v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper studies quantum spin systems: networks of spins coupled by local interactions. The Lieb-Robinson bound predicts that in these systems, information propagates at an essentially finite speed. We produce a new proof of this result. Our approach relies on a spectral bound on entries of resolvents of band matrices, the Combes-Thomas estimate, rather than on the standard path-counting argument.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子自旋系统，即由局域相互作用耦合的自旋网络。Lieb-Robinson界限预测这些系统中信息以有限速度传播。作者提出了一种新的证明方法，该方法依赖于带状矩阵预解式项的谱界限，即Combes-Thomas估计，而非标准的路径计数论证。
authors: Tali Braester, Haochen Luo, George Peykanu, Sergii Solomakha

articles.title: Algebraic criteria for complete relaxation in autonomous and periodically driven open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 自主和周期性驱动开放量子系统中完全弛豫的代数判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We derive sufficient criteria that guarantee convergence of open quantum system dynamics to a unique long-time state independent of the initial conditions. We refer to this behavior as complete relaxation. Focusing on systems described by Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equations on finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, our approach uses only elementary mathematical arguments. For autonomous systems, we recover three previously derived relaxation criteria, which can be expressed as algebraic conditions on the Lindblad operators and the Hamiltonian entering the GKSL equation. For periodically driven systems, we obtain a new criterion involving a similar algebraic condition and a local continuity requirement on the time-dependent GKSL generator. This result implies an earlier criterion for complete relaxation formulated in Ref. [J. Phys. A 52, 43LT01 (2019)]. We also discuss implications of our approach for periodically modulated classical master equations, as well as extensions to driven systems without a periodicity constraint.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了保证开放量子系统动力学收敛到与初始条件无关的唯一长时间态的充分判据，称之为完全弛豫。研究聚焦于有限维希尔伯特空间上由Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL)主方程描述的系统，并采用基本数学论证。对于周期性驱动系统，作者提出了一个新的判据，涉及类似的代数条件和时间相关GKSL生成子的局部连续性要求。
authors: Paul Menczel, Kay Brandner

articles.title: The Lévy wave packet and fractional uncertainty relations
articles.title_zh: Lévy波包与分数不确定关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29397v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work revisits the debate on fractional uncertainty relations that arose a decade ago and tries to settle it. After a careful study of the position-momentum uncertainty product of the Lévy wave packet, a novel lower bound is proposed for uncertainty relations in fractional quantum mechanics. This bound is nearly linear in the Lévy index and is satisfied by exact, calculable solutions available in the literature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本工作重新审视了十年前出现的分数不确定关系之争，并试图解决它。在仔细研究Lévy波包的位置-动量不确定性乘积后，作者为分数量子力学中的不确定关系提出了一个新的下界。该下界在Lévy指数上近似线性，并与文献中可用的精确可计算解相符。
authors: Zi-Xuan Li, Xiao-Dong Li, Towe Wang

articles.title: Splitting Probability in Monitored Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 监测量子动力学中的分裂概率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29547v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider a continuous-time quantum walk stroboscopically subjected to projective measurements on two distinct targets with sampling time period τ. We construct a general renewal framework for the first-detection amplitude at each target, from which we obtain the associated splitting probabilities. For Hamiltonians with reflection symmetry, we further show that each dual-target first-detection amplitude can be viewed as an interference effect between a pair of single-target first-detection amplitudes. This formulation yields exact expressions for the splitting probabilities and gives special sampling times at which they undergo pointwise discontinuous jumps due to a form of ergodicity breaking associated with dark states. As an illustrative example, we apply the framework to a one-dimensional tight-binding lattice chain with nearest-neighbor hopping, and study the splitting probabilities as functions of the initial position and sampling time. Below a critical sampling time, 0<τ < τ_c where τ_c = 2 π / Δ E with Δ E being the energy bandwidth, the splitting probabilities for large system sizes become equal to 1/2, independent of the initial position, as long as this position does not coincide with target sites. Above the critical sampling time, τ ≥ τ_c, the splitting probabilities deviate from 1/2 and develop oscillations as a function of initial position. The wavenumber associated with these oscillations is Q=2sin⁻¹(rτ_c/τ), where r is a positive integer. We also explore the effects of relative phase and spatial separation between different components of a coherent initial state on the splitting probabilities. Finally, we study how a finite number of measurements modifies the splitting probabilities and broadens the resonances at special sampling times.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在采样周期τ内对两个不同目标进行频闪式投影测量的连续时间量子行走。作者构建了一个通用的更新框架来计算每个目标处的首次探测振幅，并由此获得了相关的分裂概率。该框架给出了分裂概率的精确表达式，并揭示了在特定采样时间下，由于与暗态相关的遍历性破缺，分裂概率会发生逐点不连续跳跃。
authors: Prashant Singh, Sabine Tornow, David A Kessler, Eli Barkai

articles.title: Quantum Charge as a Particle/Antiparticle Label
articles.title_zh: 量子荷作为粒子/反粒子标签
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29791v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that the concept of particles and antiparticles is related to the Weyl-Heisenberg group W!H₃. Its generators are the position operators hat x^a, the momentum operators hat pₐ, and the central element Qₛfᵥ, which defines a subgroup U(1)ₛf ᵥ of W!H₃. We show that the wave functions have a charge relative to the group U(1)ₛfᵥ equal to either q₊₌₁/hbar (particle ψ₊₎ or q₋₌₋₁/hbar (antiparticle ψ₋₎. We call these eigenvalues of the operator Qₛfᵥ quantum charges: Qₛfᵥψ_±^{}=q_±^{}ψ_±^{}. The wave functions ψ₊ and ψ₋ belong to the Hilbert spaces H₊ and H₋, on which unitarily inequivalent representations πₕbar and π₋ₕbₐᵣ of the Weyl-Heisenberg group W!H₃ are defined. These representations are related to each other by the antilinear charge conjugation operator hat C, which maps H₊, q₊ to H₋, q₋. Charges q_±^{} are intrinsic characteristics of the wave functions ψ_±^{}, similar to spin and electric charge. The wave function possesses one of these charges, q₊ or q₋, prior to the specification of any equations. We show that negative probabilities/energies and the Klein paradox in Klein-Gordon and Dirac theories are consequences of the violation of U(1)ₛf ᵥ-invariance in these theories. Restoring this invariance separates particle and antiparticles and eliminates all paradoxes at the level of first-quantized relativistic theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了粒子和反粒子的概念与Weyl-Heisenberg群W!H₃相关。作者指出波函数相对于U(1)ₛfᵥ群具有量子荷q₊或q₋，这些荷是波函数的固有特性。研究表明，Klein-Gordon和Dirac理论中的负概率/能量以及Klein佯谬是由于波函数固有量子荷的性质所致。
authors: Alexander D. Popov

articles.title: Inaccessibility of the Cosmological Singularity to Quantum Probes
articles.title_zh: 量子探测器无法触及宇宙学奇点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose an operational resolution of the FLRW big bang singularity using quantum probes satisfying a curvature coupled Klein-Gordon equation. Applying the Madelung-Bohm decomposition of a Klein-Gordon field on a classical near-singularity FLRW background, we show that the induced conformal geometry renders curvature invariants finite and makes past directed causal geodesics complete. The classical big bang surface is therefore inaccessible to this class of quantum probes in finite effective proper time, while the underlying FLRW spacetime remains singular.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用满足曲率耦合Klein-Gordon方程的量子探测器来操作性地解决FLRW大爆炸奇点的方法。通过在经典近奇点FLRW背景上应用Klein-Gordon场的Madelung-Bohm分解，作者表明诱导的共形几何使曲率不变量有限，并使指向过去的因果测地线完整。因此，在有限的有效本征时间里，这类量子探测器无法触及经典大爆炸表面，而底层的FLRW时空仍然是奇点。
authors: Vishnulal Cheriyodathillathu, Saurya Das, Soumen Basak, Tanmay Patil

articles.title: Quantum mechanical Gaussian wavepackets of single relativistic particles
articles.title_zh: 单个相对论粒子的量子力学高斯波包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2309.09429v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the evolutions of selected quasi-(1+1) dimensional wavepacket solutions to the Klein-Gordon equation for a relativistic charged particle in uniform motion or accelerated by a uniform electric field in Minkowski space. We explore how good the charge density of a Klein-Gordon wavepacket can be approximately described by a Gaussian state with the single-particle interpretation. We find that the minimal initial width of a wavepacket for a good Gaussian approximation in position space is about the Compton wavelength of the particle divided by its Lorentz factor at the initial moment. This can be considered as a manifestation of relativistic length contraction, which is also observed numerically in the spreading of the wavepacket's charge density.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了闵可夫斯基空间中匀速运动或受均匀电场加速的相对论带电粒子，其Klein-Gordon方程选定准(1+1)维波包解的演化。作者探讨了Klein-Gordon波包的电荷密度在单粒子解释下，能被高斯态近似描述的程度。研究发现，波包要获得良好高斯近似的最小初始宽度约为粒子康普顿波长除以其初始时刻的洛伦兹因子，这可视为相对论长度收缩的一种体现。
authors: Yu-Che Huang, Fong-Ming He, Shih-Yuin Lin

articles.title: Mutual transformations of arbitrary ternary qubit trees by Clifford gates
articles.title_zh: 任意三元量子比特树通过Clifford门相互转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.16693v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It is shown that ternary qubit trees with the same number of nodes can be transformed by the naturally defined sequence of Clifford gates into each other or into standard representation as one-dimensional chain corresponding to Jordan-Wigner transform.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了具有相同节点数量的三元量子比特树，可以通过自然定义的Clifford门序列相互转换。这些树也可以转换为对应于Jordan-Wigner变换的一维链的标准表示。
authors: Alexander Yu. Vlasov

articles.title: Variational quantum-neural hybrid imaginary time evolution
articles.title_zh: 变分量子-神经网络混合虚时间演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.22570v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Numerous methodologies have been proposed to implement imaginary-time evolution (ITE) on quantum computers. Among these, variational ITE (VITE) methods for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computers have attracted much attention, as they use parameterized quantum circuits to mimic non-unitary dynamics. Although widely studied, conventional variational quantum algorithms face challenges in achieving high accuracy due to their strong dependence on the choice of ansatz quantum circuits. Recently, the variational quantum-neural hybrid eigensolver (VQNHE), which combines neural networks (NN) with a variational quantum eigensolver, has been proposed. This approach enhances the expressive power of variational states and improves the estimation of expectation values. Motivated by this idea, we explore the hybridization of VITE with an NN-based non-unitary operator. In this study, we propose a method named variational quantum-neural hybrid ITE (VQNHITE). By combining the NN with a parameterized quantum circuit, our proposal enhances the expressive power compared to conventional approaches, enabling more accurate tracking of imaginary-time dynamics. In addition, to mitigate the instability arising from randomly initialized NN parameters, we introduce an initial-parameter optimization procedure at a small imaginary-time step, which stabilizes the subsequent variational evolution. We tested our approach with numerical simulations on Heisenberg spin chains under both nearest-neighbor and all-to-all circuit connectivities. The results demonstrate that VQNHITE consistently achieves higher fidelity with the exact ITE state compared to VITE.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对量子计算机上的虚时间演化（ITE），已提出多种方法。其中，用于噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）计算机的变分ITE（VITE）方法备受关注。受变分量子-神经网络混合本征求解器（VQNHE）的启发，本研究提出了一种名为变分量子-神经网络混合ITE（VQNHITE）的方法。通过将神经网络与参数化量子电路结合，该方法增强了表达能力，从而能更准确地追踪虚时间演化。
authors: Hiroki Kuji, Tetsuro Nikuni, Yuta Shingu

articles.title: A parity obstruction to degree-optimal syndrome extraction in bivariate bicycle codes
articles.title_zh: 二元双环码中度数最优综合征提取的奇偶性障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.26494v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Syndrome extraction for a CSS code has depth at least the Tanner-graph degree Δ, attained by edge colouring if gate order is ignored; correctness adds a parity constraint. We prove three general obstructions to depth-Δ extraction and show that, for every two-block group-algebra code with weight-three polynomials whose checks overlap in at most two qubits, no correct single-round circuit with one ancilla per check and one CNOT per Tanner edge has depth six: the minimum is seven, so the seven-layer cycle of Bravyi emphet al. is optimal for their seven bivariate bicycle codes. This is the first analytic, family-wide impossibility result, extending prior instance-specific solver-based infeasibility results. The hypothesis cannot be dropped: a single orbit of four-qubit overlaps with a collision element of even order and 2-height at most eight makes depth six attainable, and a [[72,8,6]] code of this kind has a verified six-layer circuit. The refutations carry DRAT certificates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了深度-Δ提取的三个通用障碍，并指出对于所有检查在最多两个量子比特上重叠的权重为三多项式的两块群代数码，没有正确的单轮电路能达到深度六。因此，Bravyi等人提出的七层循环对于其七个二元双环码是最佳的，最小深度为七。这是第一个分析性的、针对整个家族的不可能性结果，扩展了先前基于求解器的实例特定不可行性结果。
authors: Guangyi Li, Yu Gan, Zeguan Wu, Xueyue Zhang, Zheshen Zhang, Junyu Liu

articles.title: Optimal phase estimation in the presence of correlated dephasing
articles.title_zh: 存在相关退相干时的最优相位估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.07211v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate optimal metrological protocols for phase estimation in the presence of correlated dephasing noise, including spin-squeezed state sensing strategies as well as parallel and adaptive protocols optimized using tensor-network-based numerical methods. The results are benchmarked against fundamental bounds obtained either via the latest quantum comb extension method or an optimized classical simulation method. We find that the spin-squeezed states offer practically optimal performance in the regime where phase fluctuations are positively correlated but can be outperformed by tensor-network-optimized strategies for negatively correlated fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在相关退相干噪声情况下的最优相位估计计量协议，包括自旋压缩态传感策略以及使用张量网络数值方法优化的并行和自适应协议。研究结果与通过最新量子梳扩展方法或优化经典模拟方法获得的基本界限进行了基准测试。作者发现，在相位波动呈正相关的区域，自旋压缩态提供了实际最优的性能，但在负相关波动情况下，张量网络优化策略可能表现更优。
authors: Srijon Ghosh, Arkadiusz Kobus, Stanisław Kurdziałek, Rafał Demkowicz-Dobrzański

articles.title: Single-step phase-engineered pulse for active readout cavity reset with a known qubit state
articles.title_zh: 已知量子比特态下用于主动读出腔复位的单步相位工程脉冲
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.08393v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a circuit QED architecture, we experimentally demonstrate a hardware-efficient and qubit-state-dependent Single-Step Phase-Engineered (SSPE) pulse scheme for actively depopulating a readout cavity. The protocol appends a reset segment with tailored amplitude and phase to a square readout pulse. Within the linear-response regime, the optimal reset amplitude scales proportionally with the readout amplitude, while the optimal reset phase remains invariant, significantly simplifying the experimental calibration procedure. For a known qubit state, time-resolved measurements demonstrate that the SSPE pulse achieves faster cavity depletion than the CLEAR protocol. Crucially, this approach enables arbitrarily fast, overshoot-free depletion of the cavity photon population, with the ultimate reset rate constrained by the available drive amplitude and the finite analog bandwidth of the measurement chain. A comprehensive evaluation of the QND character reveals no measurable increase in non-QNDness relative to the free-decay and CLEAR protocols. The remaining non-QNDness is predominantly attributable to state switching induced by qubit relaxation during the readout process. These results establish the SSPE scheme as a practical and scalable approach for achieving rapid and smooth cavity reset in superconducting quantum circuits in the case of a known qubit state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在电路QED架构中，实验演示了一种硬件高效且依赖量子比特态的单步相位工程（SSPE）脉冲方案，用于主动清除读出腔。该协议通过在方波读出脉冲后附加一个具有定制幅度和相位的复位段，实现了比CLEAR协议更快的腔体耗尽。SSPE脉冲能够任意快速、无过冲地清除腔光子布居，且未显著增加非QND特性。
authors: Ren-Ze Zhao, Ze-An Zhao, Tian-Le Wang, Peng Wang, Sheng Zhang, Xiao-Yan Yang, Hai-Feng Zhang, Zhi-Fei Li, Yuan Wu, Sheng-Ri Liu, Peng Duan, Guo-Ping Guo

articles.title: Learning Hamiltonians for O(1) Oracle-Query Quantum State Preparation
articles.title_zh: 用于O(1)谕示查询量子态制备的哈密顿量学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19181v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a Hamiltonian-based quantum state preparation method implemented via a shallow parametrized quantum circuit. The approach learns the parameters of a diagonal Hamiltonian through a classical training phase, while the quantum circuit itself performs only fixed-depth Hamiltonian evolution and mixing operations. With oracle access to the learned Hamiltonian parameters, N classical data values can be encoded into n=łog₂N qubits using O(1) quantum queries, shifting the overall computational cost to an O(NłogN) classical preprocessing stage. For structured datasets generated by an underlying function, oracle access can be avoided by expressing the Hamiltonian in the Walsh basis and retaining only a polynomial number of significant terms. In this regime, quantum state preparation is achieved in poly(n) time using poly(n) parameters, reaching infidelities on the order of 10⁻⁵. By restricting the Hamiltonian to one-local and two-local terms, the method naturally yields hardware-efficient circuits suitable for near-term quantum devices. This separation keeps the quantum execution shallow while moving optimization to classical computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了一种基于哈密顿量的量子态制备方法，通过浅层参数化量子电路实现。该方法在经典训练阶段学习对角哈密顿量的参数，量子电路仅执行固定深度的哈密顿量演化和混合操作。通过谕示访问学习到的哈密顿量参数，N个经典数据值可用O(1)量子查询编码到n个量子比特中，将主要计算成本转移到O(NlogN)的经典预处理阶段。该方法在多项式时间内实现量子态制备，保真度可达10⁻⁵量级，并能生成适用于近期量子设备的硬件高效电路。
authors: Sadegh Salami, Mohammad T. Manzuri, Mehdi Ramezani, Sina Asadiyan Zargar, Abolfazl Bahrampour, Alireza Bahrampour

articles.title: Depth dependence of entanglement and circuit complexity in random linear optical networks
articles.title_zh: 随机线性光学网络中纠缠和电路复杂度的深度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14277v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the growth of entanglement and circuit complexity in random passive linear optical networks as a function of the circuit depth. For entanglement dynamics, we start with an initial Gaussian state with all n modes equally squeezed. For random brickwork circuits, we show that entanglement, as measured by the Rényi-2 entropy, grows diffusively as a function of the depth, in contrast to the linear growth for random qubit brickwork circuits. In the other direction, for arbitrary circuit geometries we prove bounds on depths which ensure the average-case subsystem entanglement reaches within a constant factor of the maximum value in all subsystems, and bounds which ensure closeness of the random linear optical unitary to a Haar random unitary in L² Wasserstein distance. We also consider robust circuit complexity for random one-dimensional brickwall circuits, as measured by the minimum number of gates required in any circuit that approximately implements the linear optical unitary. Viewing this as a function of the number of modes and the circuit depth, we show the robust circuit complexity for random one-dimensional brickwall circuits scales at most diffusively in the depth with high probability, again in contrast to the linear scaling for certain random qubit circuits. The corresponding Gaussian unitary tildemathcal U for the approximate implementation retains high output fidelity |łangleψ|mathcal U^dagger tildemathcal U|ψångle|² for pure states |ψångle with constrained expected photon-number.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了随机无源线性光学网络中纠缠和电路复杂度随电路深度的增长情况。对于纠缠动力学，研究发现Rényi-2熵衡量的纠缠随深度呈扩散式增长。此外，对于任意电路几何，研究证明了确保平均子系统纠缠达到最大值常数因子内的深度界限，以及确保随机线性光学酉算符与Haar随机酉算符在L² Wasserstein距离上接近的界限。
authors: Laura Shou, Joseph T. Iosue, Yu-Xin Wang, Victor Galitski, Alexey V. Gorshkov

articles.title: Electronic crystals and quasicrystals in semiconductor quantum wells: an AI-powered discovery
articles.title_zh: 半导体量子阱中的电子晶体和准晶：一项AI驱动的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.10909v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The homogeneous electron gas is a cornerstone of quantum condensed matter physics, providing the foundation for developing density functional theory and understanding electronic phases in semiconductors. However, theoretical understanding of strongly-correlated electrons in realistic semiconductor systems remains limited. In this work, we develop a neural network based variational approach to study quantum wells in three dimensional geometry for a variety of electron densities and well thicknesses. Starting from first principles, our unbiased AI-powered method reveals metallic and crystalline phases with both monolayer and bilayer charge distributions. In the emergent bilayer, we discover a new quantum phase of matter: the electronic quasicrystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作开发了一种基于神经网络的变分方法，用于研究三维几何结构中不同电子密度和阱厚度的量子阱。通过这种无偏的AI驱动方法，研究揭示了具有单层和双层电荷分布的金属相和晶体相。特别地，在新出现的双层结构中，研究发现了一种新的量子物质相：电子准晶。
authors: Filippo Gaggioli, Pierre-Antoine Graham, Liang Fu

articles.title: Dynamical Tunneling Blockade in Layer-Pseudospin Ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 层赝自旋铁磁体中的动态隧穿阻塞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Double-layer systems with narrow or flat electronic bands may exhibit spontaneous interlayer coherence, described by a layer-pseudospin ferromagnetic order parameter. In modern realizations of layer-pseudospin ferromagnets, the electrons carry additional valley degeneracies, endowing each layer with a valley-pseudospin degree of freedom. We study their nonequilibrium steady states driven by a static interlayer voltage bias in the presence of interlayer tunneling. While in the low-bias regime, the system is in a static state with parallel valley pseudospins between the two layers, we show that in the high-bias regime, the dynamical precession of the layer-pseudospin stabilizes the valley pseudospins in the antiparallel configuration, strongly suppressing the interlayer tunneling. This dynamical tunneling blockade leads to an absence of ac current and a sharp drop of the dc tunneling current to a tiny value, in stark contrast to conventional quantum Hall double layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了层赝自旋铁磁体在静态层间电压偏置下的非平衡稳态。在低偏置状态下，系统处于谷赝自旋平行的静态；而在高偏置状态下，层赝自旋的动态进动使谷赝自旋稳定在反平行构型，从而强烈抑制层间隧穿。这种动态隧穿阻塞导致交流电流消失，直流隧穿电流急剧下降，与传统量子霍尔双层系统形成鲜明对比。
authors: Lingxian Kong, Yuta Murakami, Ryuichi Shindou, Zhiyuan Sun

articles.title: Two quantum skyrmions form a magnon Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 两个量子斯格明子形成一个磁振子约瑟夫森结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two quantum skyrmions in a frustrated spin-1/2 magnet bind into a molecule, and the molecule acts as a magnon Josephson junction: the relative helicity θ and the number n of magnons transferred between them obey H=E_Cn²⁻Wo̧sθ. DMRG on the J₁₋₋J₂ triangular lattice gives E_C as the curvature of the skyrmion energy at its natural size of seven flipped spins, and the measured helicity coherence fixes Wsimeq0.02J₁, half the skyrmion--antiskyrmion tunnel splitting and independent of the anisotropy. Two helicity qubits side by side are thus strongly coupled by their own interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究发现，在受挫的自旋-1/2磁体中，两个量子斯格明子结合形成一个分子，该分子表现为一个磁振子约瑟夫森结。斯格明子之间的相对螺旋度θ和转移的磁振子数量n遵循H=E_Cn²⁻Wcosθ的关系。通过DMRG计算，确定了E_C和W的值，表明两个相邻的螺旋度量子比特通过其自身相互作用而强耦合。
authors: R. L. Silva

articles.title: Josephson effect in symmetry-mismatched van der Waals hybrid junctions of NbSe2-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x and NbSe2-Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y
articles.title_zh: NbSe2与Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x及NbSe2与Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y对称失配范德华异质结中的约瑟夫森效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupling superconductors of different symmetries may lead to emergent quantum phenomena but experimental studies on heterojunctions made of lattice-mismatched crystals are scarce. Here, we fabricate Josephson junction by van der Waals stacking NbSe2 flakes on freshly cleaved surfaces of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x or Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y. We obtain pronounced Josephson currents across the heterojunctions at temperatures below 7 K. The Josephson coupling strength, characterized by the product of the critical Josephson current I_c and the normal state resistance Rₙ, can reach about 0.3 mV, much exceeding the values previously reported in Pb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x or Nb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x junctions. Microwave irradiation induces integer Shapiro steps. We also observe the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern by applying an in-plane magnetic field. We compare our results with the theoretical calculations that take into account the coherent tunneling and the order parameter mixing. Our work demonstrates the hybrid junctions as a distinctive platform for addressing pairing symmetry and emergent quantum phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过范德华堆叠NbSe2薄片与Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x或Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y晶体，制备了约瑟夫森结。实验在低于7 K的温度下观察到显著的约瑟夫森电流，其耦合强度I_cRₙ可达约0.3 mV，远超以往报道。微波辐射诱导了整数夏皮罗台阶，并在面内磁场下观察到夫琅和费衍射图样。该工作展示了这种混合结作为研究配对对称性和新兴量子现象的独特平台。
authors: Yuying Zhu, Ziye Liu, Hongtao Yan, Lin Zhao, Xingjiang Zhou, Qi-Kun Xue, Ding Zhang

articles.title: Ab Initio Approach for Quantum Magnets with Coupled Cluster and Transcorrelation
articles.title_zh: 结合耦合簇和跨关联方法的量子磁体从头计算方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nearest-neighbour exchange coupling J₁ is the simplest ingredient of model Hamiltonians used to understand magnetism in real materials. Nevertheless, its ab initio determination requires a high-level correlation treatment and a large basis for wave function expansion. Here we compute J₁ for five oxygen-bridged spin-1/2 quantum magnets --- Sr₂CuO₃, La₂CuO₄, NdNiO₂, ZnCu₃₍OH)₆Cl₂, and Li₂CuO₂ --- spanning bridging angles from 180ⁱ̧rc to 94ⁱ̧rc and the crossover from antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic coupling, using embedded-cluster methodology. To describe the open-shell singlets we use 2-determinant coupled cluster with single and double excitations, which recovers the orbital-breathing enhancement of superexchange from a minimal reference. Basis-set errors are found to be large: extrapolation to the complete basis-set (CBS) limit shifts J₁ by up to 50 meV from bases of double-ζ quality. Transcorrelated Hamiltonians reproduce the CBS estimates with modest basis set sizes, yielding an excellent accuracy against experiment at highly affordable cost. These results are the first application of transcorrelated methods in strongly correlated solid-state systems, and establish transcorrelation as a powerful theory in computational research of materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种结合耦合簇和跨关联方法的从头计算方法，用于确定量子磁体中的最近邻交换耦合J₁。该方法通过嵌入式簇方法计算了五种氧桥联自旋-1/2量子磁体的J₁值，并发现基组误差显著。跨关联哈密顿量在适中基组尺寸下能重现完整基组极限的估计值，以较低成本实现了与实验结果高度一致的准确性。
authors: Kristoffer Simula, Nikolay A. Bogdanov, Olle Gunnarsson, Daniel Kats, Ali Alavi

articles.title: From hard-core to soft-core bosons in a shell trap
articles.title_zh: 壳形陷阱中从硬核到软核玻色子的转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the low-temperature states of a system of spinless bosons trapped in a broad spherical shell. In our virtual (path-integral Monte Carlo) experiments, we specifically examine how the equilibrium structure and overall superfluidity of the system are affected by a change of the interparticle-potential core from hard to increasingly soft. In this manner we bridge the gap between the behaviors of two species of bosons: Helium-like atoms, which self-assemble into ordinary crystalline solids, and Rydberg-dressed atoms, which in simulation form cluster (super)solids. We also vary the particle mass, i.e., the quantumness of the system, so as to modify the relative stability of ``solid'' and fluid states. We thus find a whole spectrum of (finite-size) phases with a curved structure, including multilayer and cluster phases, as well as superfluids and single layer supersolids. In particular, we confirm that supersolids only occur in the presence of clusters. By considering three system sizes (from 60 to 180 particles), but rescaling the trap radius so that the density stays fixed, we verify that supersolid states only exist in the same range of particle masses. Our model serves as a platform to test how emergent properties are modified, in spherical geometry, in the crossover from atoms to dressed atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过路径积分蒙特卡洛模拟，探讨了宽球形壳形陷阱中无自旋玻色子系统的低温状态。研究考察了粒子间势核从硬到软的变化如何影响系统的平衡结构和超流性，从而连接了氦原子和里德堡修饰原子这两种玻色子的行为。通过改变粒子质量，研究发现了包括多层相、簇相、超流体和单层超固态在内的多种弯曲结构相，并证实超固态仅在簇存在时出现。
authors: G. Costa, S. Prestipino, F. Cinti, M. Ciardi

articles.title: Chiral-Nematic Lattice Instability in Charge Density Wave of 1T-TiSe2
articles.title_zh: 1T-TiSe2电荷密度波中的手性向列晶格不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral charge-density waves (CDWs) are a rare form of electronic order with handedness, enabling novel couplings among light, lattice, and topology in quantum materials. Yet the microscopic origin of chirality has remained elusive, even in the prototypical chiral CDW system 1T-TiSe2. Using ab initio calculations, we investigate the structural stability and electronic structure of competing CDW models in 1T-TiSe2. We show that a chiral monoclinic (C2) structure is stabilized by the cooperative condensation of multiple phonon modes and reproduces the chiral topography and energy gap observed experimentally. We further find an exceptionally soft potential landscape around this energy-minimized structure, along the direction that removes the remaining rotational symmetry, allowing the lattice to fluctuate through fully asymmetric configurations while its average structure remains chiral. This dynamical chiral CDWnaturally reconciles the chiral domains seen by time-averaged topographic probes with the complete loss of symmetry detected by bulk spectroscopy, and clarifies how chiral CDWs emerge from the interplay of lattice instability and fluctuation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用从头计算方法，探讨了1T-TiSe2中手性电荷密度波（CDW）的微观起源。研究表明，手性单斜（C2）结构通过多个声子模式的协同凝聚而稳定，并能重现实验观察到的手性形貌和能隙。此外，围绕该能量最小结构存在一个异常柔软的势能面，解释了手性CDW如何从晶格不稳定性和对称性破缺的相互作用中产生。
authors: Abdurrafi Ahsan Alghifari, Euihwan Do, Jae Whan Park, Han Woong Yeom

articles.title: Quantum Interference Enhanced Rectification in Mesoscopic Nanowires
articles.title_zh: 介观纳米线中量子干涉增强的整流效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoscale nonreciprocal elements are needed to control signal flow in scalable quantum technologies, but existing nonreciprocal components are often bulky. Here, we show that a strongly nonreciprocal current-voltage relation can arise entirely from coherent elastic scattering in a mesoscopic Rashba nanowire with gate-defined scatterers. We first identify the symmetry constraints that enforce reciprocal transmission in a phase coherent conductor even when inversion and time-reversal symmetry are broken. We then show how gates that are capacitively coupled to the leads, together with a magnetic scatterer or transverse subband mixing, can remove these constraints. In the weak-scattering regime, nonreciprocal conductance originates from interference between distinct backscattering paths. In the strong-scattering regime, nonreciprocity can be resonantly enhanced by the hybridization of the transmitting channel with bound states that arise from a higher transverse subband or spin-split band. In this regime, we find that a bias-induced change in the gate potentials of about one percent can produce an order-unity diode response, i.e., electrons are transmitted almost as in a clean wire for one bias polarity, whereas for the other polarity the current is strongly suppressed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在具有栅极定义散射体的介观Rashba纳米线中，强非互易电流-电压关系可完全由相干弹性散射产生。研究首先确定了在反演和时间反演对称性破缺时仍强制互易传输的对称性约束，并展示了如何通过电容耦合栅极与磁性散射体或横向子带混合来消除这些约束。在强散射区域，非互易性可通过传输通道与束缚态的杂化而共振增强，实现显著的二极管响应。
authors: T. J. Osborne, B. Braunecker, H. F. Legg

articles.title: Interaction-Induced Bloch Geometry and Transverse Thermoelectric Transport
articles.title_zh: 相互作用诱导的布洛赫几何与横向热电输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron--electron interactions can reconstruct Bloch wave functions, changing their geometry and the associated thermoelectric response. We derive the linear thermoelectric response within the Hartree--Fock (HF) approximation using the thermal length-gauge density-matrix approach, resolving Drude, symmetric quantum-metric, and antisymmetric Berry-curvature contributions. In a noninteracting Bloch eigenbasis, we separate the reconstructed Berry connection into the noninteracting connection and an interaction connection. This gives bare, coherence, and interaction-connection contributions to the anomalous thermoelectric response. We determine the constraints imposed by spatial inversion, rotational, time-reversal, and combined symmetries on the three transport channels. In the relaxation-time approximation, the leading weak-broadening behavior is Γ⁻¹ for the Drude contribution, Γ for the quantum-metric contribution, and Γ⁰ for the Berry-curvature contribution. The interband scalings apply away from band degeneracies. Self-consistent calculations for the triangular-lattice extended Hubbard model illustrate how interactions generate Berry curvature and a quantum metric, change the symmetry of the system, and thereby contribute to transverse thermoelectric transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了电子-电子相互作用如何重构布洛赫波函数，从而改变其几何结构和相关的热电响应。研究在Hartree-Fock近似下，利用热长度规范密度矩阵方法推导了线性热电响应，并解析出Drude、对称量子度规和反对称贝里曲率贡献。通过自洽计算，该工作阐明了相互作用如何在三角晶格扩展Hubbard模型中产生贝里曲率，进而影响横向热电输运。
authors: Heng-Yu Di, YuanDong Wang, Zhen-Gang Zhu, Gang Su

articles.title: Quantum criticality in a two-component two-dimensional nematic metal
articles.title_zh: 双分量二维向列金属中的量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nematic fluctuations alter the low-energy electronic behavior and reshape the mean-field phase diagram. We study a two-dimensional nematic metal with a two-component internal degree of freedom. Near the quantum critical point (QCP), longitudinal nematic fluctuations generate the non-Fermi-liquid self-energy propto|ømega|²/³, whereas transverse fluctuations give a subleading logarithmic, marginal-Fermi-liquid correction. Nevertheless, the transverse sector dominates the correction to the phase diagram through a quantum order-by-disorder mechanism: the emergent nematic background reshapes the electronic spectrum, alters the decay of nematic bosons, and produces a negative singular free-energy correction. This correction reconstructs the phase diagram, drives the transition first order, and is described by a scaling function whose two asymptotic limits define two critical regimes with free-energy corrections scaling as R⁸/³ and R³, respectively, where R is the order-parameter magnitude; their powers follow from the competition between the characteristic momentum of normal-state nematic fluctuations and that of the ordered-state background. These two regimes are experimentally distinguishable through nematic-susceptibility hysteresis measurements. The corrected phase diagram shows that the enlarged nodal α phase masks the otherwise bare QCP, making it inaccessible; consequently, the logarithmic self-energy correction is by no means negligible at low energies.
