Here, we report an experimental proof-of-principle implementation of one such protocol, where we perform BB84-like quantum cryptography by placing AB's measurement-and-preparation operations in a photonic quantum SWITCH. By embedding AB within the quantum SWITCH, the protocol achieves an average eavesdropper detection probability of 0.15 ± 0.02 per shared qubit, with eavesdropper detection performed through measurements of the control qubit rather than comparing the key. Unlike standard BB84 and related schemes, which detect eavesdropping by publicly revealing and discarding a fraction of the raw key, our approach requires no disclosure of key material: every retained qubit can, in principle, be tested for eavesdropping while remaining available for key generation. Although the present implementation does not yet constitute a secure quantum key distribution protocol, owing to post-selection required for measurements within the quantum SWITCH, it provides a proof of principle that indefinite causal order can be exploited to detect eavesdropping without sacrificing key bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了在不确定因果序中实现量子密钥分发（QKD）协议的原理性实验。研究人员通过将BB84类量子密码学中的测量和制备操作置于光子量子SWITCH中，实现了平均0.15 ± 0.02的窃听者检测概率。与传统BB84不同，该方法通过测量控制量子比特而非比较密钥来检测窃听，无需公开和丢弃原始密钥。尽管当前实现尚未构成安全的QKD协议，但它展示了一种无需披露密钥材料即可检测窃听的新途径。
authors: Yann Valibouse, Martí Cladera-Rosselló, Michael Antesberger, Hector Spencer-Wood, Kyrylo Simonov, Patrik Sund, Mathieu Bozzio, Philip Walther, Lee A. Rozema

articles.title: Parallel Quantum Advantage with Limited Adaptivity Requires Structure
articles.title_zh: 有限适应性下并行量子优势需要结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20297v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aaronson and Ambainis (Theory of Computing, 2014) conjectured that quantum query algorithms admit efficient almost-everywhere classical simulation: for any T-query quantum algorithm, its acceptance probability can be approximated on a (1-δ) fraction of inputs, up to ϵ additive error, using poly(T, 1/ϵ, 1/δ) classical queries. At a high level, the conjecture suggests that exponential quantum speedups are possible only on sufficiently structured inputs. In this work, we make progress on this conjecture by proving it for quantum algorithms that make massively parallel quantum queries. In contrast, Yamakawa and Zhandry (Journal of the ACM, 2024) showed that quantum algorithms restricted to parallel queries can still achieve exponential speedups over classical algorithms for sampling problems. We establish our simulation theorem by proving the stronger statement that parallel-query quantum algorithms cannot distinguish the uniform distribution over oracles from oracles drawn from so-called "dense distributions". Our main technical contribution is a coupling theorem that relates the uniform distribution over oracles to oracles drawn from dense distributions. We further extend this approach beyond the purely parallel setting. We prove simulation theorems for quantum algorithms with constant rounds of adaptivity, and for quantum algorithms with a bounded quantum-query prefix followed by a massively parallel quantum-query stage.
articles.abstract_zh: Aaronson和Ambainis曾提出一个猜想，认为量子查询算法在几乎所有输入上都可被高效地经典模拟。本工作通过证明该猜想对大规模并行量子查询算法成立，从而取得了进展。研究表明，并行查询量子算法无法区分预言机的均匀分布和“密集分布”，这为模拟定理提供了更强的支持。
authors: Qipeng Liu, Saachi Mutreja

articles.title: The JLMS formula in a large code with approximate error correction
articles.title_zh: 具有近似纠错功能的大型编码中的JLMS公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00442v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Gauge/gravity duality is often described as a quantum error correcting code. However, as seen in the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula, exact quantum error correction with complementary recovery (and thus entanglement wedge reconstruction) emerges only in the limit G → 0. As a result, precise arguments controlling error terms have focused on what we call `small' codes which, as G → 0, describe only perturbative excitations near a given classical solution. Such settings are quite restrictive and, in particular, they prohibit discussion of any modular flow that would change the classical background. As a result, they forbid consideration of modular flows generated by semiclassical bulk states at order-one modular parameters. In contrast, we present a single `large' code for the bulk theory that can accommodate such flows and, in particular, in the G → 0 limit includes superpositions of states associated with distinct classical backgrounds. This large code is assembled from small codes that each satisfy an approximate Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula. In this extended setting we clarify the meaning of the (approximate) JLMS relation between bulk and boundary modular Hamiltonians and quantify its validity in an appropriate class of states.
articles.abstract_zh: 规范/引力对偶常被描述为量子纠错码，但精确的量子纠错仅在G→0的极限下出现。本文提出了一个用于体理论的“大型”编码，能够容纳改变经典背景的模流，并在G→0极限下包含与不同经典背景相关的态的叠加。该大型编码由满足近似Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena公式的小型编码组装而成，从而澄清了扩展设置中JLMS公式的含义。
authors: Xi Dong, Donald Marolf, Pratik Rath

articles.title: Gaussian continuous tensor network states: short-distance properties and imaginary-time evolution
articles.title_zh: 高斯连续张量网络态：短距离性质与虚时演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15987v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study Gaussian continuous tensor network states (GCTNS) - a finitely parameterized subclass of Gaussian states admitting an interpretation as continuum limits of discrete tensor network states. We show that, at short distance, GCTNS correspond to vacua of free Lifshitz theories with even dynamical exponent, establishing a connection between certain entanglement properties of the two. Two schemes for approximating ground states of free bosonic field theories using GCTNS are presented: rational approximants to the exact dispersion relation and Trotterized imaginary-time evolution. We apply them to Klein-Gordon theory and characterize the resulting GCTNS, identifying the scale at which deviations from its conformal short-distance behavior appear. In particular, we construct an optimal rational approximation for which, at fixed accuracy, the bond dimension grows only logarithmically with the UV cutoff. These results provide a simple and analytically controlled setting to assess the strengths and limitations of GCTNS as variational ansätze for relativistic quantum fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了高斯连续张量网络态（GCTNS），发现其在短距离上对应于具有偶数动力学指数的自由Lifshitz理论的真空态。研究提出了两种利用GCTNS近似自由玻色子场论基态的方案，并将其应用于Klein-Gordon理论。结果表明，在固定精度下，最优有理近似的键维仅随紫外截止对数增长，为评估GCTNS作为相对论量子场变分拟设的优缺点提供了受控设置。
authors: Marco Rigobello, Erez Zohar

articles.title: Multiparameter Quantum Estimation and Degeneracy Structure in Three-Flavor Neutrino Oscillations
articles.title_zh: 三味中微子振荡中的多参数量子估计与简并结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30222v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate three-flavor neutrino oscillations within the framework of quantum estimation theory using the quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM). We analyze all six independent elements of the QFIM for the parameters θ₂₃, δCP, and Δ m²₃₁, together with the corresponding quantum Cramér--Rao bounds and normalized parameter correlations. To connect the intrinsic quantum sensitivity of the neutrino state with experimentally accessible information, we further compare the QFI with the classical Fisher information (CFI) associated with flavor-probability measurements. We find that the difference between the quantum and classical information bounds is strongly dependent on the oscillation parameter and L/E, demonstrating that the efficiency with which the available quantum information is accessed depends on the measurement. We also investigate probability-degenerate solutions in the (θ₂₃,δCP) parameter space. Although different parameter sets can produce identical ν_μi̊ghtarrowνₑ appearance probabilities at specific L/E values, their corresponding quantum states can remain distinct, as demonstrated by the quantum fidelity. The QFIM differences further reveal distinct local quantum-information geometries for these probability-degenerate solutions, while the corresponding CFIM differences show a parameter and L/E dependent degree of distinguishability accessible through the flavor-probability measurement. Our results demonstrate that QFI and CFI provide complementary information for neutrino parameter estimation, with the QFIM serving as a measurement-independent quantum benchmark and the CFI characterizing the information accessible through a specified measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用量子费希尔信息矩阵（QFIM）研究了三味中微子振荡，分析了参数θ₂₃、δCP和Δm²₃₁的QFIM元素、量子Cramér-Rao界限及参数相关性。研究发现，量子信息与经典信息界限之间的差异强烈依赖于振荡参数和L/E，表明可获取量子信息的效率取决于测量方式。此外，尽管不同参数集在特定L/E值下可能产生相同的μ子中微子到电子中微子出现概率，但其量子态仍可通过量子保真度保持区别。
authors: Bhavna Yadav, Amir Subba, Yu Shi

articles.title: Genuine Multi-Entropy in the Toric Code
articles.title_zh: 环面码中的本征多熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06050v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study genuine multi-entropy as a diagnostic of multipartite entanglement in the toric code, which provides a controlled setting for probing multipartite structures in topologically ordered states. Our main question is whether genuine multi-entropy captures information that is not reducible to conventional lower-party entropic data, such as topological entanglement entropy. We first analyze toric-code ground states that admit a stabilizer-state description, where the relevant quantities can be evaluated exactly. We conjecture that, for stabilizer states and mathttqge4, the mathttq-partite genuine multi-entropy at replica index n<mathttq collapses to a linear combination of multi-entropies involving at most mathttq-2 parties. We establish this pattern explicitly for mathttq=4 in the toric code stabilizer sector: for n=2,3, the genuine multi-entropy is proportional to the tripartite information I₃ and, for the Kitaev-Preskill partition, contains no independent genuine four-partite information beyond that captured by the topological entanglement entropy. At n=4, however, this reduction breaks down: the genuine multi-entropy is no longer proportional to I₃, but remains a topological invariant of the toric-code stabilizer ground states under Kitaev-Preskill-preserving deformations that do not change whether the numbers of vertex- and plaquette-type junctions coincide. For generic non-stabilizer superpositions within the ground-state manifold and for coherent superpositions of local excitations, the low-n reduction also fails. These results show that genuine multi-entropy probes multipartite entanglement structure beyond the tripartite information, and hence beyond the topological entanglement entropy in the Kitaev-Preskill partition, whereas for stabilizer states at low replica index it reduces to lower-partite entropic data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了环面码中的本征多熵，作为多体纠缠的诊断工具，以探究拓扑有序态中的多体结构。研究发现，对于稳定器态和q≥4，当复制指数n<q时，q体本征多熵会坍缩为涉及至多q-2个体的多熵的线性组合。然而，当n=4时，这种简化不再成立，表明本征多熵在某些情况下能捕捉到超越拓扑纠缠熵的独立多体信息。
authors: Sriram Akella, Norihiro Iizuka, Akihiro Miyata

articles.title: Tunable state-dependent interactions in collisionally stable mixtures of polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 极性分子碰撞稳定混合物中可调谐的态依赖相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25777v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose encoding a pseudo-spin-1/2 system in the ground (v=0) and first excited (v=1) vibrational states of polar molecules. Double microwave shielding simultaneously shields molecules in both states, suppressing two-body losses by orders of magnitude while strictly avoiding three-body recombination. The microwave dressing is state-dependent and results in highly tunable, long-range dipolar Ising exchange (J_z), density-density (V), and spin-density (W) interactions. These interaction length scales readily exceed the typical interparticle spacing, pushing the molecules deep into the strongly interacting regime. In bulk gases, this enables the exploration of itinerant quantum magnetism and quantum droplets with novel anisotropic spin textures; in optical lattices, it naturally realizes extended Hubbard and t-J_z models, opening new directions in quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出将伪自旋-1/2系统编码在极性分子的基态和第一激发振动态中，通过双微波屏蔽显著抑制两体损失。微波修饰导致高度可调谐的长程偶极Ising交换、密度-密度和自旋-密度相互作用，其作用尺度远超粒子间距，使分子进入强相互作用区域。这为探索巡回量子磁性、具有各向异性自旋纹理的量子液滴以及在光学晶格中实现扩展Hubbard和t-Jz模型开辟了新方向。
authors: Hubert J. Jóźwiak, Hanwei Yang, Eugen Dizer, Arthur Christianen, Tijs Karman

articles.title: Near-deterministic loading of molecular arrays by microwave-assisted collisions
articles.title_zh: 微波辅助碰撞实现分子阵列的近确定性加载
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25783v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Molecular tweezer arrays offer great prospects for quantum simulation, sensing, and computing, and would benefit from methods that enhance loading efficiency. Whereas light-assisted collisions underpin enhanced loading methods for atomic tweezer arrays, this approach cannot be directly extended to molecular arrays due to collisional loss. We show how this collisional loss can be suppressed by shelving molecules in rotationally or vibrationally excited states, so that a shelved molecule interacts with a newly loaded molecule through a repulsive van der Waals interaction. By introducing microwave assisted collisions, we show how to control the final states and the energy released in a collision between a pair of molecules. Following this controlled collision, one of the two molecules can be ejected, and we explore several strategies for ensuring deterministic ejection. Our schemes rely on currently available techniques for laser-coolable molecules, and we predict achievable filling fractions up to 96%, paving the way for scalable molecular arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子镊子阵列在量子模拟、传感和计算中具有巨大潜力，但其加载效率受碰撞损失限制。本文提出通过将分子置于旋转或振动激发态来抑制碰撞损失，使其通过排斥范德华相互作用与新加载的分子作用。通过引入微波辅助碰撞，可以控制分子对碰撞的最终态和释放能量，并实现其中一个分子的确定性弹出。该方案基于现有技术，预计可实现高达96%的填充率，为可扩展分子阵列奠定基础。
authors: Etienne F. Walraven, Kang Feng, Jonas Rodewald, Michael R. Tarbutt, Tijs Karman

articles.title: Spectral signatures of hidden order and hidden quantum critical points
articles.title_zh: 隐藏序和隐藏量子临界点的光谱特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hidden-order phases elude the conventional Ginzburg-Landau framework: although they spontaneously break symmetry, their order remains invisible to standard local two-point correlators. Instead, they are typically characterized by nonlocal (string) order parameters and are believed to underlie a range of exotic quantum states, such as symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases. While hidden correlations have previously been detected through nonlocal observables in quantum gas microscope experiments, in realistic solid-state systems multipoint observables are typically inaccessible and the signatures of hidden order remain largely unexplored. In this work, we show that hidden order in doped spin chains can be directly probed through dynamical two-point response functions measurable by resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) and neutron scattering. Focusing on a minimal model, we numerically identify clear spectral fingerprints of both the hidden-order phase, its associated hidden quantum critical point as well as a specific group of gapless SPT phases. Complementing our numerical results with analytical insights, we uncover the microscopic origin of these spectral signatures and demonstrate how they emerge from the interplay between spin and charge degrees of freedom. Together, our results establish spectroscopy as a practical probe of hidden order and gapless SPT phases and provide a unified understanding of the low-energy physics governing these unconventional quantum phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 隐藏序相无法通过传统Ginzburg-Landau框架描述，其序对标准局域两点关联函数不可见。本工作表明，掺杂自旋链中的隐藏序可通过共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）和中子散射可测量的动力学两点响应函数直接探测。通过对一个最小模型的数值研究，作者识别出隐藏序相、其相关的隐藏量子临界点以及特定无能隙对称保护拓扑（SPT）相的清晰光谱指纹，并结合分析见解揭示了其微观机制。
authors: Reja H. Wilke, Henning Schlömer, Sebastian Paeckel, Annabelle Bohrdt, Fabian Grusdt

articles.title: Stacking-Induced Tuning of a Flat-Band Surface State in NbIrTe4
articles.title_zh: NbIrTe₄中堆叠诱导的平带表面态调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ternary layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) offer high tunability and access to correlated and topological states. However, like the broader family of layered TMDCs, their properties are sensitive to stacking order and interlayer coupling. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and surface states of NbIrTe₄, a candidate Weyl semimetal in bulk, and predicted to be a quantum spin Hall insulator in monolayer form. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density-functional theory (DFT), we attribute the strong resonance in tunnelling spectroscopy located approximately 8 meV below the Fermi level to a surface-derived flat band which shows sensitivity to the local stacking order at the surface. In regions where the top layer is laterally shifted, tunnelling spectroscopy instead shows a gap-like feature with intensity near the Fermi level shifted in energy. Combining DFT and quasiparticle interference (QPI) measurements, we find this dramatic change in the spectroscopy in the vicinity of the quasi-1D flat-band surface state becomes dispersive due to a change in the spatial distribution of the density of states in the top two layers. These findings establish NbIrTe₄ as a platform where surface band dispersion can be effectively tuned through local structural manipulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了三元层状过渡金属二硫化物NbIrTe₄的电子结构和表面态。通过扫描隧道显微镜、角分辨光电子能谱和密度泛函理论，研究发现费米能级下方约8 meV处的强共振归因于对局部堆叠序敏感的表面平带。在顶层横向位移的区域，隧道光谱显示出能隙状特征，其强度在费米能级附近发生能量偏移。结合DFT和准粒子干涉测量，发现准一维平带表面态附近的光谱剧烈变化是由于堆叠序改变导致其色散性增强。
authors: Jiabin Yu, Mohamed Oudah, Giang Nguyen, Hsianghsi Kung, V. King, Rysa Greenwood, Adrian F. Rumson, Jisun Kim, Matteo Michiardi, Giorgio Levy, Andrea Damascelli, E. R. Johnson, Meigan Aronson, Lukas Muechler, Sarah A. Burke

articles.title: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 原子级薄半导体中拓扑相奇点的电荷守恒产生与湮灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. Our results provide a general strategy for exploring and manipulating topological optical states.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子级薄过渡金属二硫化物为光学相位操控提供了平台，其介电函数快速变化可产生拓扑相奇点（PSs）。本文以蓝宝石上的原子级薄MoS₂薄膜为模型系统，理论和实验证明介电色散的演化决定了光学PSs在拓扑电荷守恒下的产生、轨迹、合并和湮灭。通过改变MoS₂薄膜厚度，实验实现了高能n-k色散环逐渐收缩，从而改变其与零反射条件的交点，为探索和操控拓扑光学态提供了通用策略。
authors: Yongjing Wang, Yuhang Wang, Guoshuai Fan, Qingqing Luo, Yanning Li, Lidong Sun, Chunguang Hu, Wanfu Shen

articles.title: Persistent Photo-Enhancement of Molecular Orbital Excitations in the Kondo Insulator FeSb₂
articles.title_zh: Kondo绝缘体FeSb₂中分子轨道激发的持久光增强现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When insulators are excited by photons with above-gap energies, photo-doped carriers are transiently generated. Typically, orbital excitations weaken and broaden due to increased screening by these transient carriers, followed by a few-ps recovery via phonon thermalization. Here we report the observation of anomalous dynamics of many-body molecular orbital excitations in the narrow-gap Kondo insulator FeSb₂. In the pumped X-ray absorption spectra following excitation with 1~μm photons, we observe a transient transfer of absorption intensity from the delocalized states at the main absorption peak to the localized molecular orbital states at the pre-edge. At the resonance of the low-energy molecular orbital excitations, the pumped resonant inelastic X-ray spectra show an approximately 30% intensity increase at a pump fluence of 11 mJ/cm² concomitant with the emergence of an energy gain feature. While the energy gain feature disappears after about 1-2~ps, the increased molecular orbital excitation intensities partially persist for at least 50~ps with no discernible energy shift. These observations require the invocation of a many-body excitation picture beyond single particle population changes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了窄带隙Kondo绝缘体FeSb₂中多体分子轨道激发的异常动力学。在1微米光子激发后的泵浦X射线吸收光谱中，观察到吸收强度从主吸收峰的离域态瞬态转移到预边缘的局域分子轨道态。在低能分子轨道激发共振处，泵浦共振非弹性X射线光谱显示强度增加约30%，并伴随能量增益特征的出现。尽管能量增益特征在1-2皮秒后消失，但增强的分子轨道激发强度部分持续至少50皮秒，且没有明显的能量偏移。
authors: Ke-Jun Xu, Nathan Giles-Donovan, Paulina Majchrzak, Abhi Suthar, Matthias Hepting, Marco Trento, Giacomo Ghiringhelli, Elizabeth Skoropata, Hiroki Ueda, Eugenio Paris, Biaolong Liu, Elia Razzoli, Wei-Sheng Lee, Thomas P. Devereaux, Zhi-Xun Shen, Dung-Hai Lee, Robert J. Birgeneau

articles.title: Symmetry Enriched Criticality from Kennedy Tasaki Self-Duality
articles.title_zh: 基于Kennedy-Tasaki自对偶性的对称性富集临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between topology and quantum criticality has established symmetry enriched criticality as a new paradigm beyond conventional frameworks in condensed matter and statistical physics. However, the conditions under which such criticality emerges remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that a broad class of symmetry enriched critical points separating symmetry protected topological (SPT) and spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) phases is governed by Kennedy Tasaki (KT) self duality. At these criticalities, the KT transformation that interchanges the SPT and SSB phases acts as a self-dual noninvertible symmetry, endowing the critical points with nontrivial topological characteristics. We numerically demonstrate this mechanism in Zₙ × Zₙ cluster qudit chains and further argue that it naturally extends to higher dimensions, providing a duality based criterion for identifying symmetry-enriched criticality across dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了对称性富集临界性，发现分隔对称保护拓扑（SPT）相和自发对称破缺（SSB）相的广泛对称性富集临界点受Kennedy-Tasaki（KT）自对偶性支配。在这些临界点处，交换SPT和SSB相的KT变换表现为自对偶的不可逆对称性，赋予临界点非平凡的拓扑特征。研究通过Zₙ × Zₙ簇qudit链数值验证了这一机制，并提出其可推广到更高维度，为跨维度识别对称性富集临界性提供了基于对偶性的判据。
authors: Mingyuan Chen, Sheng Yang, Xue-Jia Yu

articles.title: Collective Hall quantization in 3D Chern vector systems
articles.title_zh: 三维陈矢量系统中的集体霍尔量子化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the three-dimensional (3D) quantum Hall effect, characterized by a Chern vector rather than a single Chern number, has been a central pursuit in topological physics. While quantized Hall transport is established for the special case with one nonzero Chern component, recent realizations of more general Chern-vector states raise a fundamental question: how does such topology protect quantized transport? Here, we predict a distinct 3D quantized Hall effect protected by C=(0,m,n). For samples with dimensions L_y and L_z, global topology enforces collective quantization of mL_y+nL_z, despite the fragility of individual edge modes to disorder. This reveals a novel transport regime in which robust quantization emerges as a holistic property of a unified chiral network,rather than of its constituent modes. Crucially, this collective response manifests as a quantized Hall conductance Gₓy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h, with a distinctive dependence on both Chern-vector components and sample dimensions. We propose candidate materials to facilitate experimental observation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文预测了一种由陈矢量C=(0,m,n)保护的独特三维量子霍尔效应。研究发现，对于尺寸为L_y和L_z的样品，全局拓扑结构强制实现mL_y+nL_z的集体量子化，即使单个边缘模式对无序很脆弱。这种集体响应表现为量子化的霍尔电导Gₓy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h，其独特地依赖于陈矢量分量和样品尺寸。该工作还提出了候选材料以促进实验观测。
authors: Zhi-Qiang Zhang, Shuguang Cheng, Hongfang Liu, Hailong Li, Hua Jiang, X. C. Xie

articles.title: Field theories and critical excitations at anyon condensation transitions
articles.title_zh: 任意子凝聚相变中的场论与临界激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anyon condensation transitions remain challenging to characterize especially when the condensing anyons are non-abelian. We develop two complementary approaches for extracting information about the transition from the categorical data of the parent topological order and the condensate. The first adapts a Ginzburg-Landau procedure developed for 1+1D transitions in the SymTFT setting to 2+1D anyon condensation transitions. The construction applies when the anyons participating in the condensate have integer quantum dimensions. The second gives a criterion for identifying which point and loop excitations become critical at a continuous transition. The key step is to determine which anyon loops remain condensed throughout. All other loops become critical, while a point excitation becomes critical if it braids trivially with every condensed loop. We illustrate both proposals in several abelian and non-abelian examples.
articles.abstract_zh: 任意子凝聚相变，尤其当凝聚任意子为非阿贝尔型时，其表征仍具挑战。本文提出了两种互补方法，用于从母拓扑序和凝聚体的范畴数据中提取相变信息。第一种方法将1+1维相变的Ginzburg-Landau程序推广到2+1维任意子凝聚相变。第二种方法提供了一个判据，用于识别在连续相变中哪些点状和环状激发会变得临界。这些方法在多个阿贝尔和非阿贝尔示例中得到了验证。
authors: Luisa Eck, Xie Chen

articles.title: Finite-size spin fluctuations and fixed-index sweeps in a ferromagnetic spinor condensate
articles.title_zh: 铁磁旋量凝聚体中的有限尺寸自旋涨落与固定指标扫描
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find a dip in the optimized rotation quantum Fisher information of a zero-magnetization ferromagnetic spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate near the excited-state quantum phase transition. Its displacement from ϵ_c=-q decreases on an inverse-size scale. At q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2, the dip value of Fₘₐₓ equals 2łangle S²ångle for N up to 3840, linking it to total-spin fluctuations. A semiclassical orbit average normalized by the classical density of states describes the dip over N=120--3840 with maximum relative residual below 0.028; a small power law fits comparably. Inserting the measured energy offsets directly into the semiclassical formula leaves residuals of 17--30%, so κ acts as an effective cutoff. Among retained states, spin-nematic squeezing occurs at the spectral edges. Separately, fixed-index excited-state sweeps have half-excitation times between 11.2 and 13.1 times their ground-state counterparts, with local size exponents increasing across the four sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在零磁化铁磁自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中，发现激发态量子相变附近优化旋转量子Fisher信息出现一个下降。该下降值与总自旋涨落相关，并可由半经典轨道平均描述。研究还发现，在保留态中，自旋向列挤压发生在谱边缘。此外，固定指标激发态扫描的半激发时间是基态对应值的11.2到13.1倍。
authors: Yi Ding, Junyan Luo, Yixiao Huang

articles.title: Proliferation Transitions for Quantum Doubles of Groups
articles.title_zh: 群量子双体的增殖相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proliferation transitions are phase transitions between a 2+1d topological order T and another T/A, obtained by condensing anyons in an algebra Asubset T. We consider such transitions in quantum doubles of groups, T=D(G, ømega), for finite groups G possibly with three-cocycle ømega, for which condensable algebras are fully classified. Given a condensable algebra A, we represent T in terms of a Symmetry Topological Field Theory (SymTFT), that is tailored to the A proliferation transition. The SymTFT bulk is constructed from the Müger center of the subcategory generated by the algebra, i.e. the category of transparent lines, which can be bosons or fermions. Properties of the transition can then be inferred directly from the algebra classification data. For gauged Landau-Ginzburg (LG*) type transitions, we show that they do not only depend on the anyons in A through their field content, but the cubic interactions are fixed in terms of the multiplication structure of A. Applied to twin algebras, which have the same anyon content but different multiplication structures, we show that twins result in distinct proliferation transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 增殖相变是2+1维拓扑序T与通过凝聚代数A中任意子得到的T/A之间的相变。本文研究了有限群G（可能带有三上循环ømega）的量子双体T=D(G, ømega)中的此类相变，其中可凝聚代数已完全分类。研究表明，增殖相变的性质可直接从代数分类数据推断。对于规范化的Landau-Ginzburg型相变，三次相互作用由代数A的乘法结构决定。对于具有相同任意子内容但不同乘法结构的“孪生代数”，它们会导致不同的增殖相变。
authors: Yuhan Gai, Sakura Schafer-Nameki

articles.title: Classical spin liquids in the kagome Ising model, and their link with magnetoelasticity
articles.title_zh: 笼目伊辛模型中的经典自旋液体及其与磁弹性耦合的联系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a nearest-neighbor Ising model on the kagome lattice coupled to elastic lattice distortions. By integrating out the lattice degrees of freedom, we derive an approximate spin-only description in terms of a kagome (J₁)-(J₂)-(J₃) Ising model with interactions extending to third nearest-neighbors. Using tensor network methods complemented by classical Monte Carlo simulations, we revisit its zero-temperature phase diagram and characterize the ground states studied more than thirty years ago. We discover three phases with extensive zero-temperature entropy and algebraically decaying spin correlations. Importantly, these states are not confined to fine-tuned points or frontiers between phases, but occupy extended areas of parameter space. Their quasi long-range order is reflected in Bragg-like peaks in the structure factors; we relate this, and other properties, to diverse phases found in Ising and Heisenberg models. Finally, we trace the trajectories generated by the magnetoelastic coupling through the effective-model phase diagram, explaining the emergence of self-frustration for the unfrustrated magnetoelastic model with ferromagnetic interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了笼目晶格上最近邻伊辛模型与弹性晶格畸变的耦合。通过积分掉晶格自由度，导出了一个近似的纯自旋描述。利用张量网络方法和经典蒙特卡洛模拟，重新审视了其零温相图，并发现了三个具有广泛零温熵和代数衰减自旋关联的相。这些相占据了参数空间的扩展区域，其准长程有序性体现在结构因子中的布拉格峰。研究还解释了无挫折磁弹性模型中自挫折的出现。
authors: T. Vignau Costa, J. Colbois, G. L. Rossini, F. Mila, D. C. Cabra, S. A. Grigera, R. A. Borzi

articles.title: Steady-state cooperative emission of interlayer excitons in atomically thin light-emitting diodes
articles.title_zh: 原子级薄发光二极管中层间激子的稳态协同发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an ensemble of emitters is confined within an optical wavelength, its radiation can become correlated, leading to cooperative emission. In two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) electron-hole bilayers, strong light-matter coupling enables the formation of interlayer excitons (IXs), long-lived dipolar excitations that provide an ideal setting for emergent collective phenomena. Here, we engineer an atomically thin light-emitting diode (LED) that generates electroluminescence (EL) from electrically injected IXs that are confined near the sample edges by an edge-enhanced fringing electric field. By measuring Hanbury-Brown-Twiss photon-photon correlations, we find pronounced signatures of collective decay in the form of large photon bunching followed by finite delay antibunching and bunching revivals. These emitter correlation signatures disappear when free charge carriers are doped to form a degenerate Fermi sea but are enhanced by the introduction of localized electrons. The results are consistent with a many-body quantum master equation that models the steady-state superradiant photon statistics of incoherently injected IXs. Our work establishes steady-state cooperative emission in a 2D TMD LED as a platform for studying strong light-matter interactions in electrically driven, non-equilibrium phases of Bose-Fermi mixtures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种原子级薄发光二极管，通过电注入的层间激子（IXs）产生电致发光。通过测量Hanbury-Brown-Twiss光子-光子关联，发现了集体衰变的显著特征，表现为大的光子聚束，随后是有限延迟的反聚束和聚束复苏。这些发射体关联特征在掺杂自由载流子形成简并费米海时消失，但通过引入局域电子而增强。实验结果与模拟非相干稳态超辐射光子统计的多体量子主方程一致。
authors: Andrés M. Mier Valdivia, Pavel E. Dolgirev, Grace H. Chen, Nadine Leisgang, Andrew Y. Joe, Stefan Ostermann, Deepankur Thureja, Yongxin Zeng, Dapeng Ding, Daniel Rhodes, Bumho Kim, Song Liu, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, James C. Hone, Susanne F. Yelin, Hongkun Park, Mikhail D. Lukin, Philip Kim

articles.title: Grain-Boundary Scattering between Chiral Domains in Chiral Topological Semimetal CoSi
articles.title_zh: 手性拓扑半金属CoSi中手性畴间晶界散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We evaluate the electron scattering properties in CoSi thin films having either twin (heterochiral) or non-twin (homochiral) grain boundaries using first-principles quantum transport calculations. We find that scattering across a twin grain boundary is more resistive than scattering across a non-twin grain boundary and that non-twin grain boundaries have a greater percentage of surface conduction than twin grain boundaries. This is corroborated by the transmission eigenstate profiles, which show that the surface Fermi-arc electrons can transmit past the non-twin grain boundaries between homochiral domains on the same surface without significant backscattering. In contrast, these surface electrons get scattered along the twin grain boundaries between heterochiral domains to the opposite surface, resulting in partial forward transmission and partial backscattering that yields higher grain-boundary resistivity. This work helps elucidate the complexities of electron transport in chiral topological semimetals for potential application in next-generation nano-interconnects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用第一性原理量子输运计算，评估了CoSi薄膜中具有孪晶（异手性）或非孪晶（同手性）晶界的电子散射特性。研究发现，穿过孪晶晶界的散射比穿过非孪晶晶界更具电阻性，且非孪晶晶界具有更高的表面传导百分比。表面费米弧电子可以无显著背散射地穿过同手性畴间的非孪晶晶界。这项工作有助于阐明手性拓扑半金属中电子输运的复杂性，以期应用于下一代纳米互连。
authors: Nicholas A. Lanzillo, Ion Garate, Ching-Tzu Chen

articles.title: Dynamics of thermalization in classical three-dimensional many-body systems: Non-Maxwellian distributions and the role of anisotropic trapping
articles.title_zh: 经典三维多体系统热化动力学：非麦克斯韦分布与各向异性囚禁的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27368v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The physics of interacting baths is of interest in a variety of contexts, ranging from ultracold atoms to ionized gases. While many features can already be captured in a one-dimensional model, others are specific to the situation of two or three-dimensional systems. In this paper, we focus on three-dimensional features of a model for thermalization between two baths that we have explored in earlier publications. In contrast to the one-dimensional situation we show that, en route to thermalization, deviations from the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions more akin to κ-distributions are observed. In three dimensions, these can be seen in changes at the peak of the distribution, which is precluded by the expected monotonic behavior of the energy distributions in one dimension. Furthermore, we consider thermalization for anisotropic trapping and explore its role in the onset of anomalous scaling with respect to the particle number. These results may be pertinent to the understanding of the interplay between turbulent behavior and nonlinearities for a variety of many-body classical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了经典三维多体系统中两个浴之间热化的特性。研究表明，在热化过程中，能量分布偏离麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布，更接近κ分布，这在三维中表现为分布峰值的变化。此外，论文还考虑了各向异性囚禁下的热化，并探讨了其在粒子数异常标度出现中的作用。这些结果有助于理解各种多体经典系统中湍流行为与非线性之间的相互作用。
authors: Roberto Onofrio, Bala Sundaram

articles.title: Topological Charge-2ne Superconductivity and Clustering Hierarchy
articles.title_zh: 拓扑电荷-2ne超导与簇集层级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21325v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Charge-2ne superconductors condense clusters of more than two electrons, extending superconductivity beyond Cooper pairing. They exhibit distinctive signatures including fractional flux quantization h/(2ne) and are actively being explored in strongly correlated systems. We develop a general framework for constructing and characterizing emphtopological charge-2ne superconductors by combining wavefunction and field theory approaches. Generalizing the Read-Green wavefunction and Higgsing Read-Rezayi-type states yield two families that can support deconfined non-Abelian anyons and non-Abelian superconducting vortices. The first family also admits a construction from doping Jain states. Through Higgs theories, we find that the first and second families realize weak and intermediate clustering regimes, respectively, distinguished by the topology of vortices carrying flux greater than h/(2ne), while strong clustering yields a charge-2ne superconductor without intrinsic topological order. These reveal that higher-charge superconductivity supports a richer hierarchy of topological phases beyond the Read-Green weak-strong pairing dichotomy, with distinct internal clustering structures giving rise to different topological structures at fixed condensate charge.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个构建和表征拓扑电荷-2ne超导体的通用框架，该超导体凝聚了两个以上电子的簇，将超导性扩展到库珀配对之外。通过推广Read-Green波函数和Higgs化Read-Rezayi型态，得到了两类可支持非阿贝尔任意子和非阿贝尔超导涡旋的超导体。通过Higgs理论，发现第一类和第二类分别实现了弱和中等簇集机制，而强簇集则产生没有本征拓扑序的电荷-2ne超导体。这揭示了高电荷超导支持比Read-Green弱-强配对二分法更丰富的拓扑相层级。
authors: Zhi-Qiang Gao, Yan-Qi Wang, Hui Yang, Congjun Wu

articles.title: Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid theory for one-dimensional attractive Fermi gases
articles.title_zh: 一维吸引费米气体的Tomonaga-Luttinger液体理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13958v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The one-dimensional (1D) Yang-Gaudin model--an integrable δ-function interacting Fermi gas, serves as a paradigm in quantum many-body physics, encompassing phenomena from spin-charge separation to the Luther-Emery liquid. However, a consistent description of the Luther-Emery liquid and the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO)-like pairing states in the 1D attractive Fermi gas remains elusive. In this work, we develop a universal Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid (TLL) theory to describe the FFLO state both for the case of weak and strong binding between fermions of opposite spins. We rigorously derive a low-energy effective Hamiltonian using bosonization, revealing the emergence of a two-component TLL: one exhibiting spin-charge coupling in the weak binding regime, and another featuring charge-charge separation in the strong binding regime. For the weak binding regime, we further derive renormalization-group equations for the sine-Gordon term in the spin sector and show that this term undergoes a relevant-irrelevant phase transition driven by the magnetic field. We further analyze the dynamical correlation functions of the FFLO pairing state based on the effective Hamiltonian we constructed. Finally, we discuss experiments using ultracold atoms to elucidate the Luther-Emery liquid behavior and the subtle phenomena of spin-charge coupling and charge-charge separation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种普适的Tomonaga-Luttinger液体（TLL）理论，用于描述一维吸引费米气体中的Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO)态，涵盖了弱束缚和强束缚情况。通过玻色化严格推导了低能有效哈密顿量，揭示了双分量TLL的出现：弱束缚区表现出自旋-电荷耦合，强束缚区表现出电荷-电荷分离。对于弱束缚区，进一步推导了自旋扇区正弦-戈登项的重整化群方程，并分析了FFLO配对的动力学关联函数。
authors: Hai-Ying Cui, Yu-Hao Yeh, Randall G. Hulet, Han Pu, Thierry Giamarchi, Xi-Wen Guan

articles.title: Resonance Proliferation Across Localization Transitions
articles.title_zh: 局域化转变中的共振增殖
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05445v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Models of many-body localization (MBL) exhibit slow numerical drifts towards delocalization with increasing system size, for which no satisfactory theory exists. Numerical results indicate that these drifts are driven by the proliferation of many-body resonances at intermediate disorder strengths. We develop a statistical method to predict the distribution of resonance oscillation frequencies, accounting for how resonances formed at larger frequency scales affect the subsequent formation of resonances at lower frequencies. Working within the statistical Jacobi approximation (SJA), we derive a flow equation for a power-law exponent θ(w) characterizing the density of resonances at frequency scale w. A localized phase is described by a line of fixed points with θ(w)>0, while an instability of the flow signals resonance proliferation and the onset of thermalization. The predicted θ(w) agrees with numerical results for the Anderson model on random regular graphs and the Lévy--Rosenzweig--Porter random matrix ensemble, both of which host resonance-driven delocalization transitions. We further connect the flow to eigenstate properties such as the participation ratio and to dynamical observables such as the return probability. The predicted θ(w) also agrees with numerical measurements in real-space models of MBL at intermediate disorder strengths, providing a step towards explaining the finite-size drifts observed in MBL.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体局域化（MBL）模型在系统尺寸增大时表现出向离域化的缓慢数值漂移。本文提出了一种统计方法来预测共振振荡频率的分布，解释了较大频率尺度上形成的共振如何影响较低频率上共振的形成。在统计Jacobi近似框架下，推导了一个描述共振密度幂律指数θ(w)的流方程。该理论预测的θ(w)与Anderson模型和Lévy–Rosenzweig–Porter随机矩阵系综的数值结果一致，这些模型都存在共振驱动的离域化转变。
authors: Carlo Vanoni, David M. Long, Anushya Chandran

articles.title: Orientation-resolved tunnel spectroscopy of a triplet superconductor
articles.title_zh: 三重态超导体的取向分辨隧道谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04742v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Although Cooper pairs in superconductors generally condense into a spin-singlet state, spin-triplet superconductivity has attracted sustained interest since it enables dissipationless spin transport and is an important requirement for manifold topological quantum technologies. Noncentrosymmetric superconductors provide a promising route to triplet pairing because their intrinsic antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling (ASOC) can mix spin-singlet and spin-triplet states. To date, the strongest evidence for such mixed-parity superconductivity has been reported in heavy-fermion systems, where strong electronic correlations obscure the role of ASOC. Whether ASOC alone can support a substantial spin-triplet component remains unresolved. Here we show that the weakly correlated noncentrosymmetric superconductor Nb₁₈Re₈₂ (Nb-Re) hosts a mixed-parity superconducting state with a substantial spin-triplet contribution. Orientation-resolved low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy reveals a strongly anisotropic quasiparticle density of states. A symmetry-constrained analysis shows that the spectroscopic dataset is explained by an order parameter combining a nodal spin-singlet component with a spin-triplet contribution reaching up to half of the singlet amplitude. These findings provide a momentum-resolved determination of a mixed-parity superconducting order parameter and demonstrate that ASOC alone can foster a substantial spin-triplet component. More broadly, they establish orientation-resolved tunneling spectroscopy as a route to identifying mixed-parity superconducting states and suggest that triplet superconductivity may be more widespread among noncentrosymmetric materials than previously recognized.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了弱关联非中心对称超导体Nb₁₈Re₈₂ (Nb-Re)，发现其存在具有显著自旋三重态贡献的混合宇称超导态。取向分辨的低温扫描隧道谱学揭示了准粒子态密度的强各向异性。对称性约束分析表明，光谱数据可以通过一个混合宇称序参量来解释。这项工作为理解非中心对称超导体中自旋三重态配对的机制提供了重要证据。
authors: Marcel Strohmeier, Andriy Smolyanyuk, Karsten Held, Michael Smidman, Geetha Balakrishnan, Wolfgang Belzig, Elke Scheer, Angelo Di Bernardo

articles.title: Quantum Fisher Information in semiclassical magnon systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.20424v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) is a powerful spectroscopic tool to witness many-body quantum entanglement in solid state materials, but it is not always obvious how to relate it to other characteristics of condensed matter systems. In this study we elaborate on the meaning and interpretation of QFI in condensed matter by examining simple theoretical spin systems. We use finite sized spin systems to illustrate that QFI quantifies the momentum- dependent degree of quantum entanglement (that is the entanglement depth at a given wave vector) within a wave function. We subsequently use semiclassical frustrated spin models to show that, in the context of linear spin wave theory (LSWT), QFI quantifies the momentum-dependent degree of magnon squeezing in the ground state. In antiferromagnets with a zero-energy Goldstone mode, LSWT breaks down and QFI (and entanglement depth) diverges at the magnetic ordering wave vector. We also show examples of emergent quantum phases in frustrated spin systems that do not appear in classical phase diagrams. When these emergent phases are approached, QFI diverges across multiple wave vectors in momentum space. Taken together, QFI is not only helpful as a lower bound for entanglement depth, but serves as a momentum-resolved probe of entanglement that offers a novel perspective on quantum critical phenomena.
authors: Wolfgang Simeth, Pontus Laurell, Allen Scheie

articles.title: Extreme First-Passage Time of Many Interacting Particles
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22528v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Extreme first-passage events are broadly relevant to biological, chemical, and physical processes in which the first successful arrival determines the outcome. Existing theories are largely confined to noninteracting searchers. Interacting extreme-statistics problems are notoriously difficult because correlations destroy probability factorization. We establish a general framework for interacting extreme search. A no-go theorem shows that broad classes of short-range interactions cannot beat the 1/łn N extreme timescale of N independent Brownian searchers, and complementary upper bounds prove that this scale is exact for repulsive interactions. We then identify three sharp mechanisms beyond the logarithmic class and derive a unified interaction-driven acceleration limit. In particular, deterministic pairwise interaction can at most reduce the extreme search time to order 1/N, while stochastic pairwise forcing attains 1/(Nłn N). Our results separate acceleration due to statistical redundancy from that generated by coherent many-body transport or amplified fluctuations, deepening our understanding of interacting many-body systems.
authors: Ruicheng Bao

articles.title: Magic steady state production: non-Hermitian, dissipative, and stochastic pathways
articles.abstract: Universal quantum computers require entanglement and non-stabilizerness, a resource known as quantum magic. Here, we introduce a protocol that prepares magic steady states by leveraging non-Hermitian (NH) dynamics, which, contrary to unitary dynamics, can host pure-state attractors. By studying the dissipative qubit, we find the optimal parameters to prepare and steady states. Interestingly, this approach does not require knowledge or preparation of a particular initial state, since all the states of the Bloch sphere converge to the engineered target steady state. We also consider the addition of classical noise in the anti-hermitian part and provide the regimes for which the noisy dynamics still converges to high magic states. In addition, we introduce a dissipative protocol to prepare magic steady states, compare the approaches with magic state cultivation and provide a particular realization of the NH scheme in a cat qubit.
authors: Pablo Martinez-Azcona, Matthieu Sarkis, Alexandre Tkatchenko and Aurélia Chenu

articles.title: Quantum-enhanced inference of conditional future probabilities with reduced memory cost
articles.abstract: Many potential future events have devastating consequences, from the onset of earthquakes to financial black swan events. Accurate predictions of their probability of occurrence are vital. Yet as the stochastic systems underlying such events become increasingly complex, these probabilities can depend on ever-growing amounts of past data, which require ever more memory to track. The accuracy of our estimates is ultimately limited by both computational and memory constraints; the former to reduce sampling error, the latter to avoid sampling bias. Traditional quantum algorithms—such as amplitude estimation—address only the former, and become untenable especially in near-future quantum devices where quantum memory is a premium. Here, we offer quantum-algorithmic means to reduce systematic bias while maintaining a quadratic speed-up. Our results thus advance the timeline for the practical deployment of quantum technologies, and illustrate their additional benefits when simulating processes of growing complexity.
authors: Jianjun Chen, Akshat Gupta, Chengran Yang, Ariel Neufeld, Jayne Thompson, Thomas J Elliott and Mile Gu

articles.title: Concurrent Entanglement Purification Scheduling in Dynamic Quantum Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum networks must deliver end-to-end entanglement whose fidelity meets application requirements, which typically requires entanglement purification along multi-hop paths. Existing scheduling approaches either purify at the link level or optimize end-to-end fidelity for a static set of requests, and do not capture concurrent requests competing for network resources over time. This paper studies concurrent entanglement purification scheduling in a time-slotted quantum network with heterogeneous links, in which requests compete for link capacity and quantum memories, and each request may be served by multiple parallel paths for increased reliability. We formulate a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) scheduler that maximizes the number of scheduled requests, with max-min path allocation as a fairness criterion, and develop reinforcement learning (RL) schedulers based on DQN, PPO, and SAC, whose rewards balance request success against Bell-pair consumption. Simulations under varying network load, topologies and target fidelity thresholds show that the RL schedulers achieve the highest success rates, improving on MILP by up to 6% and on Progressive Filling and Greedy heuristics by 16.5% and 19.5% respectively, at the cost of higher Bell pair consumption and the deferral of a small fraction of requests. MILP, in contrast, achieves the highest fairness and the lowest Bell pair consumption in most scenarios.
authors: Gongyu Ni, Lester Ho

articles.title: Rényi multi-entropy of graph states and the n -> 1 limit
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rényi multi-entropy extends the Rényi entropy to pure states of more than two parties. It is defined by a replica contraction at integer replica number n, and the multi-entropy is its n→1 limit. In holography this limit is conjectured to compute the area of a minimal soap-film web in the bulk. Understanding multi-entropy for general states, however, is harder. Unlike the bipartite case, the replica contraction is not a moment of a density matrix, and the continuation to n=1 has to be found by other means. We study this problem for qubit graph states. We show that at every odd n the contraction equals 2⁻k/², where k is a sum of ranks of matrices over a finite field, one row and one column per qubit. We define a class of graphs that we call collision-controlled, for which the rank sum is a polynomial in n. This class includes graphs without even cycles and all complete bipartite graphs. The natural polynomial n → 1 continuation is a finite sum over partitions of the parties. While the Rényi multi-entropy is non-increasing under single-qubit Pauli measurements at every odd integer n>1, the continuation to n=1 is not. A Z measurement on one qubit of an odd ring with 2r + 1 ≥ 7 qubits raises it from (r+1)łog 2 to (2r-1) łog 2. Thus the continuation is not an entanglement monotone.
authors: Sriram Akella, Abhijit Gadde

articles.title: Active isolation of transmon readout with a tunable inductive bridge
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable superconducting quantum computation requires fast, high-fidelity readout. Currently, this is assisted through cryogenic amplification of the readout signal. In traditional dispersive readout schemes, the amplifiers that are used to provide high signal-to-noise ratio also generate thermal noise that can decohere the qubits, demanding additional ferrite-based isolators to suppress this noise. Here, we integrate a chip-scale microwave switch, the tunable inductive bridge, into the readout chain of a fixed-frequency transmon. Flux-pulsing the switch, such that it transmits only during the readout, did not make a discernable difference to qubit coherence, residual excited-state population, or readout fidelity metrics. By injecting broadband noise that mimics amplifier thermal photons, we show that the switch suppresses the resulting qubit dephasing by more than 30~dB, consistent with its independently measured on-off ratio, establishing it as a potential chip-based integrated replacement for readout-chain isolators.
authors: Chunyang Ding, Chuyao Tong, Paul Varosy, Nikitha Jain, Ziyi Zhao, Eric I. Rosenthal, Konrad W. Lehnert, David I. Schuster

articles.title: Quantum Fluctuations and Wigner Dynamics of a Carbon Nanotube Oscillator Driven by an Atomic Force Microscope
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Suspended carbon nanotubes provide a useful platform for studying controlled nanomechanical motion in regimes where environmental fluctuations, memory effects, and quantum coherence can all influence the dynamics. We model the fundamental flexural mode of a carbon nanotube driven by an atomic force microscope as a harmonic quantum Brownian oscillator subject to a prescribed classical force and coupled linearly to a thermal environment. Starting from the generalized Langevin equation, we formulate the reduced dynamics directly in phase space, where the Wigner function evolves through a Gaussian propagator determined by dissipative linear transport, a deterministic force-induced displacement, and bath-induced fluctuations. For a Drude memory kernel, the retarded response is expressed through the three roots of a characteristic cubic equation. In the classical-noise limit, the three independent entries of the finite-time covariance matrix reduce to explicit finite sums over these response poles, eliminating numerical double-time covariance integration. We extend the construction to the full quantum fluctuation spectrum, obtaining a thermal frequency series representation that retains zero-point and low-temperature fluctuations. For an initial two-packet superposition, we examine interference attenuation and the integrated negative part of the Wigner function, which provides a phase space measure of nonclassicality. These results provide an explicit analytical framework for finite-memory quantum Brownian motion of bound oscillators and a tractable phase space description of driven carbon nanotube dynamics relevant to future quantum state preparation and quantum tomography experiments.
authors: Conrad Silio, Cristian Staii

articles.title: Optimal four-copy detection of the three-tangle and its fault-tolerant cost
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The three-tangle, τ₃, is a measure of genuine tripartite entanglement that distinguishes GHZ-type from W-type entanglement in pure three-qubit states. Here, we identify the statistically optimal one-sided four-copy detector of the three-tangle and study its implementation cost. The optimal detector has click probability τ₃²/48, while previous four-copy constructions achieve τ₃²/256 and therefore require asymptotically 16/3 times as many experimental repetitions. Using the representation-theoretic structure of the problem, we construct an ancilla-free implementation of the optimal detector using 15 CNOT gates, together with an 11-CNOT detector with click probability τ₃²/96. These results reveal a tradeoff between statistical efficiency and implementation cost, since reducing the number of repetitions requires increasingly expensive circuits. We then show that this tradeoff persists once the circuits are encoded. In a fully fault-tolerant setting, the increased click probability comes with a substantial non-Clifford synthesis cost, while an early fault-tolerant implementation based on T gates and STAR rotations reduces this overhead at the expense of additional encoded resources. We quantify these costs using both the Steane and [[8,3,2]] codes, providing explicit resource estimates for implementing the optimal detector across different computational regimes.
authors: Federico Tomás B. Pérez, Berta Casas, I-Chi Chen, Su Yeon Chang, Philipp Schleich, M. Cerezo

articles.title: Shot Allocation Strategies in Debugging Quantum Circuits
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Debugging quantum programs remains challenging due to the nature of quantum measurement. As quantum algorithms and systems scale, it is increasingly crucial to develop rigorous debugging and verification approaches. Statistical assertion-based debugging validates quantum program behavior through repeated circuit execution and statistical hypothesis testing, but existing frameworks treat shot count as a fixed input parameter, leaving the problem of optimal shot allocation across multiple mid-circuit assertions unexplored. To improve debugging efficiency by making better use of given shot counts, this paper proposes and evaluates four shot allocation strategies within the QDB quantum debugger implemented within the CUDA-Q framework. These allocation approaches: equal split, static weight allocation, adaptive entropy routing, and sequential retirement, use statistical approaches to test whether qubits have expected state characteristics at different points in execution. We evaluate these allocation strategies on different circuits, under both noise-free and depolarizing noise conditions. We show how adaptive strategies use shots efficiently by concentrating them on assertions with high uncertainty. This substantially reduces total shot usage while maintaining comparable debugging confidence.
authors: Era Thaqi, Coco Gong, Margaret Martonosi

articles.title: Assignment maps for arbitrary reduced quantum dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Given an open quantum system S with environment E, we establish a one-to-one correspondence between completely positive trace-preserving (CPTP) maps from S to E and assignment maps initializing the composite system SE in a possibly correlated state prior to unitary evolution. We show that every possible joint state h̊oSE can be realized by such assignment maps, which are inherently Hermiticity-preserving and trace-preserving (HPTP). While these maps sacrifice global positivity, we derive a simple necessary and sufficient condition for any local state of S to belong to their domain of validity. Furthermore, we prove that the geometry of this domain is governed by the joint state assigned to the maximally mixed input, ensuring that a non-zero volume of admissible local states can readily coexist with initial system-environment entanglement. Finally, we provide an operational protocol for witnessing such limits of validity.
authors: James Fullwood, Weixiang Ye

articles.title: Quantum algorithm for high-dimensional nonlinear stochastic differential equations based on Carleman linearization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Addressing nonlinear numerical problems in quantum computing remains challenging, but several approaches, including Carleman linearization (CL), have been proposed to construct quantum algorithms for such problems. In this work, we develop a CL-based method for a high-dimensional nonlinear stochastic differential equation (SDE) d Xₜ = łeft(A(t) Xₜ + F(t) Xₜøtⁱmes si̊ght) d t + B(t) d Wₜ for an R^N-valued random process Xₜ, aiming at quantum speed-up with respect to the dimension N. We introduce auxiliary processes Y^jₜ that approximate Xₜøtⁱmes j, derive a linearized system of SDEs for them, and obtain the linear ordinary differential equation (ODE) governing their expectations. We then apply a quantum ODE solver to it and, from the resulting quantum state, extract an estimate for the expectation of a linear function of Xₜ by overlap estimation. We show that, provided the nonlinear and noise terms in the SDE are sufficiently small relative to the linear term, the CL error decreases exponentially with the truncation order J in CL, and we can estimate the target expectation with a m̊ polylog(N) number of queries to unitaries encoding coefficient matrices A, F, and B. Finally, we also run a numerical demonstration for an SDE related to Langevin dynamics, observing the exponential decay of the CL error as J increases.
authors: Koichi Miyamoto

articles.title: Field demonstration of a self-contained 10 km mobile-to-ground quantum network node via common-aperture co-propagation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we demonstrate a dual-function, common-aperture free-space optical system that simultaneously supports decoy-state BB84 quantum key distribution (QKD) at 803 nm and bidirectional classical laser communication at 640/660 nm over a 10.31 km terrestrial link from a mobile platform to a stationary ground station. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first field demonstration of a fully integrated common-aperture architecture where a co-propagating classical optical link simultaneously performs full QKD post-processing and ecrypted payload transmission over a 10 km atmospheric channel. The classical link utilizes Manchester-coded on-off keying (MC-OOK) at 10 MHz, achieving a packet error rate of sim 0.4 % (estimated bit error rate (BER) of 3.13 × 10⁻⁵) with hardware-based self-synchronization and error-packet retransmission. Over the 10.31 km link, the QKD system achieved an average quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 2.512 % and an average secret key rate of 644 bps using rate-adaptive low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. Finally, using the distilled keys, real-time AES-256 encrypted image transmission was executed over the co-aligned classical optical channel, proving the feasibility of a completely self-contained, jam resistant mobile quantum optical network.
authors: Dongkyu Kim, Dong-Gil Im, Kyungdeuk Park, Jisu Kim, Jonguk Choi, Yonggi Jo, Yong Sup Ihn

articles.title: Engineering (XY) and (ZZ) interactions between two remote superconducting qubits via a multimode waveguide
articles.title_zh: 通过多模波导工程化两个远程超导量子比特间的(XY)和(ZZ)相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Waveguides provide a flexible platform for long-range interactions between superconducting qubits. Here, we study how to engineer the effective (XY) and (ZZ) interactions between two qubits via qubit frequency assignments and multimode interference determined by the mode configuration and standing-wave parities of a finite multimode waveguide. For a single-mode waveguide, we find that (XY) and (ZZ) interactions cannot be simultaneously suppressed to zero and the residual qubit-qubit coupling always exists. For example, the (XY) interaction may be suppressed to a negligible level when two qubits and the waveguide mode satisfy the two-photon resonant condition, but the (ZZ) interaction cannot be switched off. For multimode configurations within the central dispersive window, the engineered interaction types are very different for odd and even numbers of modes. Even-mode configurations can readily produce strong (XY) interactions, whereas odd-mode configurations can strongly suppress the (XY) interaction while retaining a finite (ZZ) interaction. Full-Hamiltonian simulations of minimal two- and three-mode configurations confirm (XY)-dominated SWAP dynamics and (ZZ)-dominated CZ-type dynamics, respectively. These results establish a frequency assignment criterion of qubits and waveguide modes for selectively engineering long-range qubit-qubit interaction types induced by the waveguide with finite multimode.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了如何通过量子比特频率分配以及由有限多模波导的模式配置和驻波奇偶性决定的多模干涉，来工程化两个远程超导量子比特之间的有效(XY)和(ZZ)相互作用。研究发现，在单模波导中，(XY)和(ZZ)相互作用无法同时抑制为零。而在多模配置中，奇数和偶数模式数量的相互作用类型差异显著，偶数模式易产生强(XY)相互作用，而奇数模式能强烈抑制(XY)相互作用同时保留有限的(ZZ)相互作用。
authors: Da-Wei Wang, Yu-xi Liu

articles.title: Quantum Cryptanalysis on Two Feistel-Type Constructions
articles.title_zh: 针对两种Feistel型结构的量子密码分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the rapid advancement of quantum computing, the security of traditional cryptographic systems is facing significant challenges. As a fundamental component of symmetric cryptography, block ciphers have attracted increasing attention regarding their quantum security in recent years. In this paper, we propose new quantum attacks on two Feistel-type constructions, i.e., New Structure IV and the lightweight block cipher LBlock, under the quantum chosen-plaintext attack (qCPA) model. First, we construct an 8-round quantum distinguisher for New Structure IV and perform an r(r>12)-round quantum key-recovery attack. Compared with Li et al.'s qCPA-based result presented at INSCRYPT 2024, our attack reduces the time complexity by a factor of 2ⁿ/², where n denotes the subkey length. Second, we design a 9-round quantum distinguisher for LBlock and extend it to an r(r>15)-round quantum key-recovery attack. The proposed quantum distinguisher covers one more round than Liu et al.'s automated-search distinguisher at ASIACRYPT 2025, which results in a 2¹⁶ reduction in the time complexity of our r-round quantum key-recovery attack on LBlock. Furthermore, by analyzing the structure of the round function and the key scheduling of LBlock, we reduce the subkey guess space for the 15-round attack from 76 bits to 52 bits, lowering the time complexity from (O(2³⁸)) to (O(2²⁶)) by a factor of (2¹²).
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子计算的快速发展，传统密码系统的安全性面临挑战。本文在量子选择明文攻击（qCPA）模型下，对两种Feistel型结构（New Structure IV和轻量级分组密码LBlock）提出了新的量子攻击。对于New Structure IV，构建了8轮量子区分器并进行了r(r>12)轮量子密钥恢复攻击，将时间复杂度降低了2ⁿ/²。对于LBlock，设计了9轮量子区分器并扩展到r(r>15)轮量子密钥恢复攻击，使时间复杂度降低了2¹⁶。
authors: Yan-Ying Zhu, Bin-Bin Cai, Fei Gao, Song Lin

articles.title: Collision-aware Bayesian mitigation of photon loss in linear optical quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 线性光学量子电路中光子损耗的碰撞感知贝叶斯缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photon loss is the dominant noise source in linear optical quantum circuits. Each lost photon turns an ideal n-photon outcome into a pattern with fewer photons, so the detector counts no longer follow the ideal output distribution, and the lossless events that do follow it become exponentially rare as the photon number grows. Discarding the lossy events (postselection) therefore wastes most of the data at realistic loss rates, and the ideal distribution has to be inferred from the lossy counts themselves. Recycling-based mitigation (Mills & Mezher, Quantum 2026; Quandela's photonᵣₑcycling) reweights lossy samples to recover lossless probabilities, but its estimators are biased and restricted to the no-collision sector, where each output mode holds at most one photon. We instead treat the raw counts as Multinomial observations under per-photon binomial loss and infer the ideal output distribution and the loss rate jointly from a Bayesian posterior, which extends naturally to outputs with collisions. On data from the independent Perceval simulator at the scale of prior work (n=4 photons in m=20 and m=10 modes), the posterior has lower KL divergence than both recycling and postselection at every tested loss rate in the no-collision benchmark. In the collision regime it recovers the loss rate and the collision-pattern probabilities, which recycling cannot estimate, and stays below recycling at every loss rate and below postselection except at low loss, where the two are comparable. Its advantage over recycling grows with the sample count, and it supplies credible intervals that the baselines lack.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子损耗是线性光学量子电路中的主要噪声源，导致检测计数不再遵循理想输出分布。本文提出了一种碰撞感知贝叶斯方法来缓解光子损耗，该方法将原始计数视为每光子二项式损耗下的多项式观测值，并从贝叶斯后验中联合推断理想输出分布和损耗率。与现有方法不同，该方法自然地扩展到包含碰撞的输出，并在模拟数据上显示出更低的Kullback-Leibler散度。
authors: Seungwoo Kim, Seunghyun Ahn, Donguk Nam, Hyunho Cha, Jungwoo Lee

articles.title: Microscopic Bipartition and Macroscopic Symmetry in a Rényi Entanglement Ensemble
articles.title_zh: Rényi纠缠系综中的微观二分与宏观对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27587v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal information extracted from entanglement at a critical point is commonly associated with the long-distance properties of the bulk state, while microscopic details of a lattice bipartition are expected to be washed out under coarse graining. Counterintuitively, we show directly that such microscopic information can survive in the statistical ensemble that determines the second Rényi entropy and obviously change the physics there. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the square-lattice J-Q₃ model at the Néel--valence-bond-solid (VBS) transition, we measure magnetic and dimer order parameters in the Rényi-2 ensemble. For a standard axis-aligned bipartition, the VBS component perpendicular to the entanglement boundary remains finite in the thermodynamic extrapolation and is inequivalent to the parallel component, while the Néel order vanishes. For a 45ⁱ̧rc tilted bipartition, in contrast, the two VBS components remain equivalent within numerical accuracy. We interpret this contrast in terms of the Rényi twist defect: the two bipartitions have the same bulk theory but realize different microscopic defect symmetries. Our results demonstrate that lattice information invisible to the bulk continuum theory alone can remain active in the long-distance Rényi ensemble, providing a microscopic explanation for the strong bipartition dependence previously observed in entanglement studies of deconfined criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在临界点处，晶格二分的微观细节如何在决定第二Rényi熵的统计系综中存留并改变物理性质。通过对正方晶格J-Q₃模型在Néel-VBS相变点的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，测量了Rényi-2系综中的磁序和二聚体序参数。结果显示，标准轴对齐二分与45度倾斜二分在VBS分量上表现出显著差异，这归因于Rényi扭曲缺陷在不同微观缺陷对称性下的表现。
authors: Zhe Wang, Dongxu Liu, Zheng Yan

articles.title: Stabilizer Rényi moments beyond entanglement
articles.title_zh: 超越纠缠的稳定子Rényi矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stabilizer Rényi moments depend on a choice of operator basis and need not be determined by entanglement spectra. In this paper, we study their spatial decay in critical quantum chains described by two-dimensional conformal field theories. We derive an exact entanglement baseline for reductions of pure stabilizer states and a symmetry selection rule for the charged contribution at fixed support. An exact Ising example shows that an on-site rotation changes the full decay exponent while preserving every subsystem entanglement spectrum. For growing Ising intervals at index two, we obtain an exact Pfaffian representation and compare the charged amplitude with a candidate conformal boundary calculation. The data support this prediction, but its identification with the lattice limit still requires endpoint matching and control of the order of limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 稳定子Rényi矩依赖于算符基的选择，不一定由纠缠谱决定。本文研究了它们在二维共形场理论描述的临界量子链中的空间衰减。我们推导了纯稳定子态约化的精确纠缠基线和固定支持下带电贡献的对称选择规则。一个精确的Ising模型例子表明，局域旋转可以改变完整的衰减指数，同时保留每个子系统纠缠谱。
authors: Vishnu Jejjala, Joydeep Naskar

articles.title: Single-photon time qubit: Quantum-vacuum control and complementarity of the arrow of time
articles.title_zh: 单光子时间量子比特：量子真空控制与时间箭头的互补性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Treating the arrow of time as a controllable quantum variable rather than a fixed external parameter is a central challenge in quantum physics. Recently, Bloch~i̧teBloch2025 proposed the theoretical concept of a emphtime qubit, a two-level control space H_T=spanket+,ket- that selects between opposite Hamiltonian evolutions hatH±=hatH₀±hatV, but this paradigm has remained experimentally unrealized. Here we formulate the quantum-optical theory of a single-photon time qubit---uncovering quantum-vacuum control and complementarity of the arrow of time---and experimentally probe and validate its predictions using phase-resolved single-photon interferometry from two coherently seeded entangled nonlinear biphoton sources~i̧teLee2018,Yoon2021. First, we show theoretically and verify experimentally that a controlled π pump--seed phase inversion during pair creation from the quantum vacuum flips the stimulated displacement generator hatV→ -hatV on top of the spontaneous two-mode squeezing background hatH₀, reversing the stimulated evolution time [hatUₛₜᵢₘ,₋(t)=hatUₛₜᵢₘ,₊(-t)] and enabling universal single-qubit SU(2) control and postselection-free first-order tomography on the temporal Bloch sphere. Second, we prove that spontaneous idler vacuum fluctuations record complete which-branch (temporal-direction) information whereas the shared coherent seed erases it without cascading or aligning the idler beams, establishing an exact wave--particle complementarity law |bmr|=V=|α|²/(1+|α|²⁾ for the purity of the arrow of time and enabling direct first-order measurement of the Loschmidt time-reversal echo.
articles.abstract_zh: 将时间箭头视为可控量子变量是量子物理学的核心挑战。本文提出了单光子时间量子比特的量子光学理论，揭示了量子真空控制和时间箭头的互补性。通过相分辨单光子干涉实验，理论和实验均证实，在量子真空产生光子对过程中，受控的π泵浦-种子相位反转可以反转受激位移生成器，从而逆转受激演化时间，实现普适的单量子比特SU(2)控制。
authors: Tai Hyun Yoon

articles.title: Axion detection in the non-Markovian noise
articles.title_zh: 非马尔可夫噪声中的轴子探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The detection of axion dark matter poses a significant challenge due to its exceptionally weak coupling to standard-model particles. Here we develop a noise-tolerant quantum-metrology scheme based on coupled ¹²⁹Xe spin ensembles to search for such weakly interacting particles. Within an experimentally accessible parameter regime, our scheme achieves an ideal exclusion limit on the axion coupling constant that is several orders of magnitude more stringent than that of conventional detection methods. We further investigate the performance of our scheme under dissipative noise and find that its robustness is fundamentally governed by the energy-spectrum structure of the composite spin-environment system. Remarkably, when a bound state emerges in the spectrum, the exclusion limit asymptotically recovers its ideal value in the non-Markovian dynamics, whereas under the Markovian approximation the limit deteriorates significantly due to noise. Our results establish a universal mechanism for noise-resilient exploration of beyond-standard-model physics, which can be practically implemented by engineering bound-state formation via tuning the Larmor frequency of the spin ensembles.
articles.abstract_zh: 轴子暗物质的探测因其与标准模型粒子极弱的耦合而极具挑战。本文提出了一种基于耦合¹²⁹Xe自旋系综的抗噪声量子计量方案，用于探测这种弱相互作用粒子。该方案在非马尔可夫动力学中，当能谱中出现束缚态时，其排除极限能够渐近恢复到理想值，比传统方法严格数个数量级。这为探索超越标准模型物理学提供了一种普适的抗噪声机制。
authors: Jing Dong, Shuang-Quan Ma, Rong-Hang Chen, Bin-Kai Luo, Tao Liu, Qing Ai, Jun-Hong An

articles.title: Multimode Parametric Amplifier for K-Band Quantum Measurements
articles.title_zh: 用于K波段量子测量的多模参量放大器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate K-band nondegenerate three-wave-mixing amplification in a multimode resonator comprising an array of 500 SNAILs. Pairing K-band signal modes with lower-frequency internal idler modes enables 20 dB of gain continuously from 19.6 to 25.6 GHz with pump frequencies below 32.2 GHz. At 20 dB gain, the 3-dB bandwidth ranges from 2.6 to 11.7 MHz, and the input-referred 1-dB compression power reaches -100.9 dBm. In the 20-22 GHz band, the average added noise is 0.73 quanta. A two-mode nondegenerate parametric amplification model describes the measured gain response and gain-bandwidth behavior, while a multimode Kerr model captures the overall compression scale. Our amplifier provides a practical solution for implementing a state-of-the-art readout of superconducting qubits in the K-band.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种在由500个SNAIL阵列组成的多模谐振器中实现的K波段非简并三波混频放大器。该放大器通过将K波段信号模式与低频内部闲频模式配对，实现了在19.6至25.6 GHz范围内连续20 dB的增益。在20 dB增益下，其3 dB带宽范围为2.6至11.7 MHz，平均附加噪声为0.73量子，为K波段超导量子比特的先进读出提供了实用解决方案。
authors: Chulwoo Ahn, Vladimir Manucharyan

articles.title: Bidirectional Path Integral Monte Carlo Simulation of Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子电路的双向路径积分蒙特卡洛模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an approximate classical algorithm for estimating quantum circuits' transition amplitudes, łangle Ψ_f | hatU | Ψ₀ ångle, based on Monte Carlo sums over bidirectionally sampled Feynman paths. The algorithm generates Feynman paths, i.e., sequences of intermediate computational basis states, by combining information from random walks initiated at both the input and output states, Ψ₀ and Ψ_f, respectively. It further combines this bidirectional approach with Multiple Importance Sampling, a powerful variance reduction technique that avoids variance peaks caused by divisions by the very low sampling probabilities associated with hard to reach paths. Empirical data demonstrate the superior convergence rate exhibited by the bidirectional algorithm over a unidirectional, forward-only sampling approach. This superiority is due to the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in finding and weighting paths with non-zero amplitude in an extremely sparse path space. Sum of paths algorithms exhibit very favourable space complexity. Monte Carlo replaces exhaustive enumeration of the exponentially large path space by stochastic sampling, the computational cost being determined by the variance of the estimator. This work demonstrates these two features by presenting results on very large quantum circuits, with up to 4096 qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种近似的经典算法，用于估计量子电路的跃迁振幅，该算法基于对双向采样的费曼路径进行蒙特卡洛求和。该算法通过结合从输入和输出状态开始的随机游走信息来生成费曼路径，并将其与多重重要性采样技术相结合。经验数据表明，该双向算法在收敛速度上优于单向采样方法，因为它能有效在稀疏路径空间中找到并加权具有非零振幅的路径。
authors: Luis Paulo Santos, Thomas Bashford-Rogers

articles.title: Narrowband nonreciprocal transmission in a Doppler-broadened multilevel atomic system
articles.title_zh: 多普勒展宽多能级原子系统中的窄带非互易传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate narrowband nonreciprocal transmission in a Doppler-broadened five-level M-type atomic medium. After Doppler averaging, the M-type system retains a narrow near-resonant electromagnetically induced transparency window that is narrower than that of a standard three-level Łambda system. This spectral narrowing is associated with the decreasing separation between the two inner dressed states as atomic velocity increases. The transparency window exhibits pronounced direction-dependent transmission, with high forward transmission and strong suppression in the reverse direction. The transparency linewidth and forward-backward probe transmission can be controlled via two independent driving fields, while the central transparency frequency is kept essentially unchanged. The resulting narrowband nonreciprocity supports high forward transmission together with strong suppression in the reverse direction, which is suitable for frequency-selective optical filtering and nonreciprocal optical transmission in thermal atomic media. Our scheme with these specific features is geared towards enabling compact vapor-cell-based nonreciprocal devices for quantum network applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了多普勒展宽五能级M型原子介质中的窄带非互易传输。经过多普勒平均后，M型系统保留了一个比标准三能级Lambda系统更窄的近共振电磁感应透明窗口。该透明窗口表现出显著的方向依赖性传输，具有高正向传输和强反向抑制。透明线宽和正反向探测传输可通过两个独立的驱动场控制，为热原子介质中的频率选择性光滤波和非互易光传输提供了可能。
authors: Ying-Xue Zhang, Hui-Min Zhao, Yan-Kui Bai

articles.title: Trapped-ion-based quantum repeater node across a 17 km metropolitan fiber
articles.title_zh: 基于囚禁离子的量子中继节点在17公里城市光纤上的实现
