The magnetic exchange interactions between local moments on atomic sites are calculated using a linear response approach based on the QSGW band structure. While the induced magnetic moments are small on the vanadyl Oᵥ and bridge O_b, their exchange interactions with the V are found to be larger than between V atoms. The Néel temperature T_N are calculated within the mean-field (MFA) and random phase (RPA) approximations for two different crystal structures with P2₁ₘₙ and Pmmn spacegroups. The critical temperatures are are corrected by a quantum statistical factor of (S+1)/S to obtain reasonable agreement with experiment. Band structures, optical dielectric functions calculated using the Bethe Salpeter Equation method and spin waves are also calculated and presented for both crystal structures and both compounds. The spin wave dispersions are calculated from the classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian including magnetic moments on both V and O atoms. Besides the lowest energy weakly interacting spin waves of the two chains of spins in the unit cell, the model predicts additional high energy optical spin waves, which correspond to more complex spin excitations in which the spins on the two V across a bridge, vanadyl O and bridge O precess independently from each other instead of staying locked together according to their collinear alignment in the ground state. These show only weak dispersion and extend up to about 1 eV but we argue that these are an artefact of using the Heisenberg model beyond its validity range and would be suppressed in a more complete theory that allows for coupling of the transverse spin with longitudinal spin and charge excitations.
authors: Claudio Garcia, Ilteris K. Turan, Jerome Jackson, Swagata Acharya, Mark van Schilfgaarde, Walter R. L. Lambrecht

articles.title: Maximum-Temperature Theorem for a Nanothermometer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The steady-state temperature predicted for an ideal point heat source diverges in conventional heat-conduction theory, but no physical thermometer measures a point value. We derive a sharp, shape-independent upper bound on the quasi-steady temperature rise of a sensor with thermometric volume Vₛ, placed anywhere inside a region enclosed by an isothermal reference surface. The bound requires only the total heat power generated in the region dotQ, a lower bound on its thermal conductivity κₘ, and the value of Vₛ. It is otherwise independent of the heat-source distribution, domain shape, and source--sensor distance. For dotQ=50~pW, κₘ = 0.1~mathrmW,m⁻¹K⁻¹, and Vₛ₌₁₀⁻²²,m³, approximately the volume of a 60~nm-diameter sphere, the theorem permits a maximum temperature rise of approximately 2~mK above the reference level. The result applies directly to nanodiamonds, upconversion nanoparticles, fluorescent polymer particles, and core-shell quantum dots. It shows that neither source localization nor uncertain source-sensor separation can account for kelvin-scale readings under steady-state heat conduction.
authors: Taras Plakhotnik

articles.title: Spontaneous particle-hole symmetry breaking in a disordered two-site quantum breakdown model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24669v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study spontaneous particle-hole symmetry breaking in a disordered two-site quantum breakdown model. The model is solvable in the limit of a large number of fermionic modes on each site. For a small ratio of the numbers of modes on the two sites, we derive the free energy analytically and find a finite-temperature symmetry-breaking transition. This transition changes from continuous to first order as the number of fermions produced in each conversion increases. Numerical results show that both types of transition persist beyond this regime, with an order-parameter exponent close to 1/2 for continuous transitions.
authors: Kinya Guan

articles.title: Scaling Dimensions and Two-Point Amplitudes from Operator Covariance Matrices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The long distance behavior of two-point functions of critical lattice statistical mechanics models depend on detailed information of the underlying quantum field theory. Yet these universal properties can be difficult to extract because generic lattice operators couple to the infinite hierarchy of continuum scaling operators with unknown coefficients. Recently in Physical Review E 114, 024146 (2026), one approach to disentangle some of this information was proposed using the eigen-decomposition of the operator covariance matrix constructed from cross correlations of a finite set of Nₑₗₗ lattice operators. In this work we analyze this method in detail. We provide an explicit proof that under the assumption of scale invariance the leading decay of the eigenvalues are controlled by the smallest Nₑₗₗ scaling dimensions, even after taking irrelevant perturbations into account. Based on this understanding, we propose a new method by which the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix can be used to construct the amplitudes of the continuum two-point correlation functions. This allows for a complete determination of the structure of the continuum two-point functions from the lattice covariance matrix. We demonstrate our ideas both on synthetic data sets (drawn from the scaling hypothesis) and numerically exact data for the two dimensional Ising model.
authors: You-Chiuan Chen, Ribhu K. Kaul

articles.title: Interaction-driven competing instabilities in two-dimensional checkerboard quadratic band crossing semimetals
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional quadratic band crossing point (QBCP) semimetals serve as a fertile platform for interaction-driven quantum criticality, nevertheless, the role of the complete fermion-fermion interactions remains largely unexplored. To address this, we systematically investigate the low-energy physics of a spin-1/2 checkerboard-lattice QBCP semimetal by considering all 16 marginally short-range fermion-fermion interactions. Using the momentum-shell renormalization group, we derive the coupled flow equations, which reveal that the low-energy physics is governed by a series of fixed points. Depending on the initial conditions, the system may exhibit a single stable fixed point, several discrete fixed points, or three continuous groups of fixed points parameterized by a few variables. By introducing source terms and evaluating susceptibilities, we identify the dominant and subdominant instabilities. The leading phases include nematic spin-nematic (NSN), quantum anomalous Hall (QAH), chiral superconducting (SC₁₎, and quantum spin Hall (QSH) orders. Moreover, several features distinguish our findings from previous simplified models. Off-diagonal interactions generate terms that promote orders absent in such models, the continuous groups allow systematic tuning of the leading instability, and trajectory-dependent instabilities emerge where the full RG flow, rather than the fixed point alone, determines the dominant state. These results offer a comprehensive theoretical understanding of low-energy quantum critical behaviors and phase instabilities in two-dimensional QBCP semimetals and related electron systems.
authors: Jia-Hao Wen, Wen-Hao Bian, Jing Wang

articles.title: Self-Trapping and Liouvillian Spectral Transitions in a Dissipative Bose-Hubbard Dimer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the self-trapping transition in dissipative double wells using mean-field theory and exact diagonalization. We find that, similar to the conventional interaction-driven transition from oscillatory dynamics to self-trapping, dissipation alone can also induce self-trapping-like localization in one well. The resulting state, although transient and decaying, persists for a substantial time. At the mean-field level, the interaction- and dissipation-driven transitions are discontinuous and continuous, respectively. When interaction and dissipation both are present, their interplay produces three dynamical regimes: (i) at weak interaction, increasing dissipation drives a transition from oscillations to self-trapping; (ii) at moderate interaction, self-trapping at weak dissipation, oscillatory dynamics at intermediate dissipation, and re-entrant self-trapping at strong dissipation; and (iii) at strong interaction, self-trapping persists but is weakened by dissipation. We connect the transition with the Liouvillian spectrum. It is observed that purely dissipation-driven transition coincides with an exceptional point in the spectra, and a peak in the Liouvillian gap, marking the onset of the quantum-Zeno regime. In the presence of interactions, however, the onset of the Zeno regime is shifted to dissipation strengths larger than that required for the self-trapping transition.
authors: Subhendu Saha, Raka Dasgupta

articles.title: Phase engineering of odd parity state in a quantum dot Josephson junction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling fermion parity in quantum-dot Josephson junctions (QDJJs) enables access to novel superconducting physics. While parity transitions are usually tuned electrically, we study phase-induced transitions in a strongly coupled QDJJ using the superconducting phase difference across the dot terminals, denoted by φ. We find that this phase allows control over the ground state parity, with parity transitions observed as the Andreev bound states (ABSs) energies crossing zero. These crossings occur near φ = π, and their behavior is in good correspondence to a simple model considering a single-level quantum dot proximitized by a superconductor. These results place phase-controlled QDJJ arrays as a promising platform for exploring exotic phenomena such as Majorana zero modes.
authors: Shohei Kobayashi, Tyler Lindemann, Sergei Gronin, Geoffrey Gardner, Peter Stano, Daniel Loss, Michael Manfra, Seigo Tarucha, Sadashige Matsuo

articles.title: Magnetoelectric Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Solids
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is commonly believed that a bulk photovoltaic current requires broken spatial inversion symmetry. However, in this work, we demonstrate that dc photocurrents can arise in centrosymmetric solids from the bilinear coupling between the electric and magnetic components of light. This magnetoelectric bulk photovoltaic effect (MBPE) has a quantum-geometric origin in the dipole moments of the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature. We identify four distinct MBPE mechanisms, including time-reversal-even and time-reversal-odd injection-like and shift-like photocurrents driven by linearly or circularly polarized light. Our symmetry analysis shows that the MBPE is allowed in broad classes of two-dimensional centrosymmetric nonmagnetic and magnetic materials under normally incident light. As representative examples, we predict sizable MBPEs in centrosymmetric monolayer Pt₂HgSe₃ and altermagnetic RuF₄, with current densities on the order of 1~mA/m. Notably, the injection-like photocurrent in RuF₄ reverses sign upon switching either the light helicity or the Néel vector. Our results extend the bulk photovoltaic effect to centrosymmetric solids and open new opportunities for electrical readout of altermagnetic order.
authors: Longjun Xiang, Fuming Xu, Lei Zhang, Jian Wang

articles.title: Hidden piezo-Hall effect
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extensive studies of hidden spin polarization have established a broad class of hidden phenomena in quantum materials. Here, we introduce the hidden piezo-Hall effect, in which strain induces finite anomalous Hall conductivities (AHCs) in individual sectors while the global AHC remains zero. At zero strain, neither the full system nor its sectors exhibit an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Under uniaxial strain, however, opposite sector AHCs emerge while their sum remains canceled. We establish this effect for a d-wave hidden altermagnet using a tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for the experimentally synthesized material RbV₂Te₂O. Rotating the strain direction from the x to the y axis reverses the signs of the sector AHCs without generating a net Hall response. The same symmetry mechanism may also give rise to hidden piezomagneto-optical, piezo-thermal Hall, piezo-Nernst, and piezo-Ettingshausen effects. Our work extends hidden physics to strain-controlled transport and identifies RbV₂Te₂O as a promising candidate for experimental verification.
authors: San-Dong Guo, Shi-Hao Zhang, Bingwen Zhang

articles.title: Machine Learning-Assisted Discovery of Carbon-Related Defect Formation Mechanisms in Diamond
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diamond is an important host material for functional defects such as solid-state spin qubits. During the defect creation by irradiation and subsequent thermal annealing, carbon-related defects, including vacancies and interstitials, are generated and can migrate to form new defect complexes. To investigate this kinetically driven process and reveal the formation mechanisms of the di-interstitials and di-vacancies in the neutral charge state, we fine-tuned a universal machine learning interatomic potential using a small dataset generated from density functional theory calculations. We obtained a barrier of 1.84 eV for mono-interstitial migration and found that two initially separated mono-interstitials only need to overcome a lower barrier to form di-interstitial configurations. Beyond the training data, the MLIP also identified the formation pathway for an additional di-interstitial configuration and a stepwise divacancy dissociation mechanism. These results reveal migration-assisted defect complex formation mechanisms and demonstrate how targeted MLIP training can identify reaction pathways.
authors: Grace Huang, Christopher Fivecoat, Xun Xu, Mengen Wang

articles.title: Two-Dimensional Quantum Droplets in a Mixture of Bose-Einstein Condensates
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum droplets represent a striking manifestation of beyond-mean-field physics, with properties that depend sensitively on dimensionality. Although quantum droplets have been experimentally realized in one and three dimensions, their realization in two dimensions has remained elusive. Here, we observe the formation of a two-dimensional (2D) quantum droplet in a quasi-2D geometry by transferring the single-component Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) into a spin mixture in the Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) regime, where the LHY effect evidently deviates from its three-dimensional form. We find that, in our scheme, 2D quantum droplets are more stable and exhibit longer lifetimes than previously reported quantum droplets. By instead transferring the initial BECs into another single-spin state with a negative scattering length, we generate 2D Townes solitons. A comparison between the two types of self-bound states shows that, whereas 2D Townes solitons are stable only near a critical atom number determined by the scattering length, 2D quantum droplets remain well-defined and self-bound over a much broader parameter range. These realizations of quantum droplets and Townes solitons in two dimensions provide new insights into self-bound states and open new avenues for exploring nonlinear dynamics in quantum liquids.
authors: Yue Zhang, Liangchao Chen, Wei Han, Linshan Gong, Yazhou Wang, Zekui Wang, Xinhao Liang, Wenjie Sui, Pengjun Wang, Lianghui Huang, Zengming Meng, Zhuxiong Ye, Jing Zhang

articles.title: Strain-induced disorder from Schottky gates on high mobility 2DEGs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrostatic gates on two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) in GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructures are essential for numerous studies of correlation driven phenomena, many performed within the fractional quantum Hall effect. However, the most commonly used type of gates, the metallic Schottky gate, has the propensity to adversely impact the electron mobility and suppress the fractional quantum Hall states. Here we demonstrate through commensurability oscillations under specially designed nanostructured superlattice gates, that strain effects are responsible for the mobility reduction. The experimental results agree well with COMSOL Multiphysics simulations. In a regular, unpatterned gate the disordered, granular nature of the metal film fills the same role as the superlattice in creating a strain field penetrating down to the 2DEG, as we show with a simplified model. These results will help in understanding, improving and finding novel methods to reduce strain-induced disorder in gated high-mobility 2DEGs.
authors: Sambit Mohapatra, Lukas Berg, Jean-Baptiste Cuvellier, Yan Sun, Abdelhanin Aassime, Alan Durnez, Antonella Cavanna, Dominique Mailly, Ulf Gennser

articles.title: Variational Block Correlated Coupled Cluster Monte Carlo
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent success of quantum neural states, we present a variational implementation of the coupled cluster method suitable for quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We introduce a Young tableaux representation of the wave-function coefficients and their derivatives that substantially reduces the computational complexity of the variational optimization. While the algorithm is generic, we illustrate its implementation with an application to the Heisenberg model in one and two dimensions, using the block correlated coupled cluster ansatz (BCCC) with doubles and triples. Convergence is greatly improved by means of importance sampling based on a fictitious temperature. The resulting approach achieves competitive accuracy while providing a scalable framework for variational coupled-cluster calculations.
authors: Hunter Brodie, Alexander Shilcusky, Adrian E. Feiguin

articles.title: Absorbing state transitions with long-range annihilation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.03280v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a family of classical stochastic processes describing diffusive particles undergoing branching and long-range annihilation in the presence of a parity constraint. The probability for a pair-annihilation event decays as a power-law in the distance between particles, with a tunable exponent. Such long-range processes arise naturally in various classical settings, and increasingly play a role in the study of quantum dynamics: for example, quantum state preparation or error correction processes aim to prepare ordered ground states, which requires removing point-like excitations in pairs via non-local feedback operations conditioned on a global set of measurement outcomes. We analytically and numerically describe features of absorbing phases and phase transitions in this family of classical models as pairwise annihilation is performed at larger and larger distances. Notably, we find that the two canonical absorbing-state universality classes -- directed-percolation and parity-conserving -- are endpoints of a new line of universality classes with continuously varying critical exponents. These new classes follow from an interplay of long-range interactions and symmetries: decreasing the long-range exponent effectively weakens the local effects of global symmetry constraints. This competition significantly broadens known non-equilibrium phases and phase transitions.
authors: Nicholas O'Dea, Sayak Bhattacharjee, Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Vedika Khemani

articles.title: Quantum Geometric Injection and Shift Optical Forces Drive Coherent Phonons
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.17814v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant quantum-geometric theory of light-induced Raman forces driving coherent lattice dynamics in solids. We show that the resonant interband response separates into injection and shift forces, providing the lattice analogue of injection and shift photocurrents. Crucially, the electronic quantum metric and Berry curvature directly govern these forces, weighted by distinct electron--phonon quantities. The injection force is controlled by the quantum geometric tensor and differences between band-diagonal electron--phonon couplings, producing the resonant displacive response. The shift force is a resonant impulsive response governed by quantum geometry and a phononic shift vector arising from interband electron--phonon coherence. We derive polarization selection rules, symmetry constraints, and temporal signatures. Applied to interlayer shear phonons in a bilayer Haldane model, the theory predicts tunability with optical frequency, topology, electronic temperature, and current-induced symmetry breaking. These results establish a quantum-geometric framework for coherent lattice dynamics and identify coherent phonons as experimentally accessible signatures of electronic quantum geometry in quantum materials.
authors: J. Luke Pimlott, Habib Rostami

articles.title: Kolmogorov-type non-thermal fixed points and beyond of far-from-equilibrium dilute system: ultra-cold Fermi gas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.18821v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The far-from-equilibrium dynamics driven by the scattering from next-to-leading-order (NLO) corrections in the quantum field theory has stationary solutions for the particle distribution characterized as the Kolmogorov-type non-thermal fixed points corresponding to scale-invariant particle/energy flux. The dynamics of the spatially homogeneous dilute ultra-cold Fermi gas is investigated, and its kinetic equation confirms the Kolmogorov-type non-thermal fixed points in the perturbation theory by the quasi-particle assumption, in contrast to the wave turbulence of the ultra-cold Bose gas. In addition, other stationary states are discussed when the the vertex correction becomes significant in the kinetic equation. It is found that conditions for the scale-invariant flux in this case no longer hold when the quasi-particle assumption is applied.
authors: Chun-Wei Su

articles.title: Linear Ensemble-Constrained Quantum Monte Carlo: From Dilute Fermi Gas to Flat-Band Ferromagnetism
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.08552v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a finite-temperature canonical-ensemble determinant quantum Monte Carlo algorithm that enforces an exact fermion number and enables numerically stable simulations of correlated lattice fermions. We propose a stabilized QR update that reduces the computational complexity from standard cubic scaling O(β N³⁾ to linear scaling O(β N Nₑ²⁾ with respect to the system size N, where Nₑ is the particle number. This yields a dramatic speedup in dilute regimes (Nₑ łl N), opening unbiased access to large-scale simulations of strongly correlated low-density phases. We validate the method on the dilute Fermi gas with onsite Hubbard interactions, observing the suppression of the fermion sign problem in the dilute limit. Furthermore, we apply this approach to a one-dimensional flat-band system, where the canonical ensemble allows for precise control over filling. We reveal a ferromagnetic instability at low temperatures in the half-filling regime. Our linear-scaling approach provides a powerful tool for investigating emergent phenomena in dilute quantum matter.
authors: Tu Hong, Kun Chen, Xiao Yan Xu

articles.title: Scattering Measures and Information Geometry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.34721v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We formulate scattering experiments in terms of parameterized finite measures on outcome spaces and develop the associated information geometry defined by the Fisher metric. The decomposition of a scattering measure into total mass and normalized shape separates Fisher information into contributions from changes in overall scattering strength and redistribution among outcomes. Measurement processes are represented by probability or sub-probability kernels acting on the scattering measure. Such kernels contract Fisher information, placing a broad class of experimental operations within a common information-theoretic framework. This formulation connects scattering experiments to the theory of optimal experimental design through the Fisher geometry of scattering measures. The same finite-measure structure arises naturally in quantum measurements with incomplete detection, clarifying its place in the hierarchy from quantum measurement to classical outcome statistics.
authors: Tatsuro Oda

articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24025v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We give explicit binary constant-weight codes that raise the lower bounds on A(n,6,w) in eight cells of Brouwer's table, all now listed there. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: A(27,6,11)ge 19305, A(27,6,12)ge 24453, A(28,6,10)ge 18642 and A(28,6,9)ge 11154, together with an explicit A(24,6,12) code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: A(29,6,10)ge 27183, A(29,6,11)ge 42042, A(29,6,9)ge 14781, A(28,6,10)ge 19110, A(27,6,12)ge 24804, A(28,6,9)ge 11388 and A(27,6,13)ge 27783, three of which replace first-round values. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group AΓ L(1,27), its index-2 subgroup, or AGL(1,23), acting on all but at most two coordinates. The orbits were chosen by maximum-weight independent set search on the orbit conflict graph: branch and bound in the first round, iterated local search in the second. Each code was checked by two separately written programs over all pairs of words and was regenerated from its generators and orbit representatives. We also report two qubit stabilizer codes, [[20,11,4]] and [[43,32,4]], which raise the lower bounds of 3 listed at codetables.de to the listed upper bound 4.

articles.title: Insertion Correcting Capability for Quantum Deletion-Correcting Codes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20635v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It is conjectured that a quantum code C corrects t deletion errors if and only if C corrects a total of t insertion and deletion errors. Although this conjecture has been proved only under certain conditions, it has not been proved in general. In this paper, we prove this conjecture for general quantum codes. Specifically, we show that a quantum state after an insertion error is represented as a product state of the original multi-qudit system and the inserted quantum state. Then, we prove this conjecture by combining the previous results and this property. In addition, we define generalized insertion errors by removing the quantum channel requirement from insertion errors and present their properties.

articles.title: Exploring Quantum Phase Transitions Beyond Landau Theory on a Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 在量子处理器上探索超越朗道理论的量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct continuous quantum phase transitions between phases that break distinct symmetries challenge the conventional Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm and provide a framework for deconfined quantum criticality. Here, we investigate a Landau-forbidden ferromagnetic-to-valence-bond-solid (FM-VBS) transition in a frustrated one-dimensional spin chain using superconducting quantum processors. Combining matrix-product-state-assisted circuit preparation with quantum-hardware measurements, we resolve the suppression of long-range ferromagnetic correlations and the redistribution of competing-order fluctuations across the transition. Distance-resolved correlations and finite-size analyses reveal signatures consistent with critical behavior. We further extend our investigation to nonequilibrium dynamics, directly preparing dimerized states and tracking the evolution of VBS order and joint FM-VBS fluctuations under local unitary interactions. Our results establish a versatile quantum-hardware framework for probing competing orders, critical correlations, and many-body dynamics beyond conventional Landau theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用超导量子处理器，研究了受挫一维自旋链中朗道理论所禁止的铁磁-价键固体（FM-VBS）相变。研究结合矩阵乘积态辅助电路制备和量子硬件测量，揭示了长程铁磁关联的抑制以及竞争序涨落的重新分布。结果为探测超越传统朗道理论的竞争序、临界关联和多体动力学提供了一个通用的量子硬件框架。
authors: Ruizhe Shen, Yin Zhong, Ching Hua Lee

articles.title: Resonant pair production and flat band melting in a driven Rydberg chain
articles.title_zh: 驱动里德堡链中的共振对产生与平带熔化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a Rydberg chain subjected to a two-tone periodic drive of the detuning Δ(t) and Rabi frequency Ømega(t) at frequencies ømega₁ and ømega₂₌ν ømega₁ respectively with ν in Z. In the strong Rydberg blockade limit, such a system reduces to the PXP model and exhibits exact Floquet flat band. Here we determine, using a time-dependent Schrieffer-Wolff transformation, the domain of validity of such PXP dynamics once the blockade-violating processes are taken into account. We study the melting of such flat bands in the presence of strong, but finite, blockade strength. Using Floquet perturbation theory (FPT), we identify two mechanisms for such melting; the first occurs due to the presence of many-body resonances involving resonant production of nearest-neighbor Rydberg excitation pairs while the second involves virtual processes that access intermediate states with such pairs. Our analytical FPT results match with those obtained using exact diagonalization on a finite chain. We study the dynamics for |m̊ vacångle (Fock state with no Rydberg excitation), |mathbb Z₂ångle, and |mathbb Z₃ångle (Fock states with Rydberg excitations on alternate and every third site respectively) initial states. We find that |m̊ vacångle shows exceptional stability against resonant pair formation while |mathbb Z₃ångle exhibits flat band melting via virtual processes away from the direct resonances. We find oscillatory dynamics with large time period for the |mathbb Z₂ångle initial state and the presence of Floquet scars that have large overlap with |mathbb Z₃ångle state; these phenomena occur due to processes that are absent in the PXP limit. We propose measurement of nearest neighbor pair correlation functions using Rydberg atom quantum simulator platforms as an accessible experimental probe for these effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在双音周期驱动下的里德堡链，并利用含时Schrieffer-Wolff变换确定了PXP动力学的有效范围。研究发现，在强但有限的阻塞强度下，平带熔化存在两种机制：一是涉及最近邻里德堡激发对共振产生的多体共振，二是涉及访问中间态的虚过程。分析结果与有限链上的精确对角化结果一致。
authors: Tista Banerjee, K. Sengupta

articles.title: Programmable Preparation of Topological Entangled States
articles.title_zh: 可编程制备拓扑纠缠态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Programmable preparation of entangled quantum states is a central requirement for scalable quantum information processing, quantum networking and photonic quantum computing. Topological photonic platforms offer an attractive route towards robust quantum-state generation by encoding information in symmetry- protected optical modes, yet the generated entangled states are typically dictated by the lattice geometry and therefore lack programmability. Here we demonstrate programmable preparation of topological entangled states by inverse engineering the nonlinear optical pump profile of an integrated photonic lattice. Our approach enables deterministic control over both the dimensionality and modal structure of the generated entangled state while preserving its topological character. We experimentally realize silicon photonic topological superlattices in which the nonlinear generation pathway itself becomes programmable via tailored excitations. The superlattices host a multiband manifold of co localized topological interface modes, while coherently controlled inputs synthesize pump superpositions within this protected basis. We showcase this principle by selectively addressing topological biphoton eigenstates, steering correlations to produce a desired target state in a high-dimensional Hilbert space, and inverse-designing pump states that generate targeted Schmidt dimensionalities. Site-resolved two-photon correlation measurements remain reproducible across nominally identical fabricated devices, demonstrating robustness to realistic nanofabrication-induced disorder. Programmable preparation of topological entangled states establishes a pathway towards exploiting topological photonic modes as application-specific quantum resources, enabling tailored input states for high-dimensional quantum communication, quantum networking and photonic quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过逆向工程集成光子晶格的非线性光学泵浦剖面，实现了拓扑纠缠态的可编程制备。该方法能够确定性地控制所生成纠缠态的维度和模态结构，同时保持其拓扑特性。研究在硅光子拓扑超晶格中实验验证了这一方法，展示了通过定制激发实现非线性生成路径的可编程性。
authors: M. Javad Zakeri, Alaric Pan, Darren D Hudson, Andrea Blanco-Redondo

articles.title: Concrete Functions in Private Simultaneous Quantum Messages: Quantum Advantages and Structural Limitations
articles.title_zh: 私有同步量子消息中的具体函数：量子优势与结构限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Private simultaneous quantum messages (PSQM) provide a minimal model of noninteractive secure multiparty quantum computation, yet their communication complexity for concrete functions remains poorly understood. We show that familiar total functions already exhibit both genuine quantum advantages and strong structural limitations. For three-party equality on n-bit inputs, which determines whether the players' n-bit strings are identical, we construct an entanglement-assisted protocol with asymptotic communication (1.633łdots)n qubits, whereas every perfectly correct protocol without prior entanglement requires at least 3n qubits. For three-bit majority, one shared GHZ state and one transmitted qubit per player suffice for perfect correctness and perfect privacy, reducing the communication from the optimal classical cost of six bits to three qubits. Three-bit AND behaves differently. No perfectly correct and perfectly private protocol exists when the players share an arbitrary three-qubit state, apply arbitrary local unitary encodings, and transmit one qubit each. However, increasing the local dimension overcomes this obstruction: one shared three-qutrit GHZ state and one transmitted qutrit per player yield a one-shot protocol with total communication 3łog₂ 3. Together with the six-bit classical lower bound, this gives a strict quantum communication advantage. More generally, for every k≥ 3, we construct a perfectly correct and perfectly private one-shot protocol for k-bit AND using one qudit of dimension at most k per player, and hence at most kłog₂ k qubits in total.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了私有同步量子消息（PSQM）中具体函数的通信复杂度，揭示了量子优势和结构限制。对于三方n比特相等性问题，构建了一种纠缠辅助协议，渐近通信量为(1.633...)n量子比特，显著优于无预先纠缠的经典协议。研究还发现，对于某些函数，如三比特AND，在特定条件下无法实现完美正确和完美隐私的协议，但增加局部维度可以克服这一障碍。
authors: Harumichi Nishimura

articles.title: Nonequilibrium Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions in the Extended Agassi Model
articles.title_zh: 扩展Agassi模型中的非平衡动力学量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) in the extended Agassi model following sudden quenches of same level pairing (Σ), monopole-monopole (ḩi) and cross level pairing (Łambda) strengths. Using exact diagonalization, we characterize the non-equilibrium dynamics through the Loschmidt echo and intensive return-rate function. Quenches across equilibrium phase boundaries produce cusp-like structures in the return rate that shows non-analyticities with increasing system size. Equilibrium finite size to large scaling identifies the ḩi-driven transition as a second order phase transition similar to mean-field, Dicke, and Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick (LMG) models critical behaviour with the exponent of the order parameter β simeq 1/2, while the Σ- and Łambda-driven transitions are first order. We further characterize the associated dynamical singularities through a local scaling exponent α, with α_ḩi simeq 2/3, α_Łambda simeq 1/3, and α_Σ simeq 3/2 of all three parameters. The distinct scaling behaviours across the parameter channels show that dynamical criticality is not determined solely by the equilibrium order of the transition, revealing multiple dynamical scaling regimes. These non-analyticities are associated with the Fisher zeros of the Loschmidt amplitude, which cross the real time axis at critical times and the time derivatives of the return-rate function to characterize the order of DQPTs within the extended Agassi model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过精确对角化方法，研究了扩展Agassi模型中在突然淬火后出现的动力学量子相变（DQPTs）。研究发现，跨越平衡相边界的淬火会在返回率函数中产生尖峰结构，并随系统尺寸增加呈现非解析性。结果表明，动力学临界性并非完全由平衡相变的阶数决定，而是与参数通道的独特标度行为相关。
authors: Ritesh Kumar Palai, Rajiv Kumar, Venktesh Singh, Sunil K. Mishra

articles.title: Liouvillian Non-Invertible Symmetry
articles.title_zh: 耗散算符非可逆对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-invertible symmetries extend conventional symmetries beyond group-like transformations and play an important role in quantum field theory and many-body physics. However, a general framework of non-invertible symmetries in open quantum systems is still lacking. Here, we formulate a general Liouville-space duality framework that extends Hilbert-space non-invertible dualities to open quantum systems. The resulting defect relates Liouvillians with dual Hamiltonian and dissipative parameters and becomes an exact symmetry at self-duality. We apply this framework to the periodic transverse-field Ising chain with two collective Lindblad channels exchanged by Kramers--Wannier (KW) duality. A strong Z₂ symmetry divides Liouville space into four parity sectors, while the defect acts nontrivially only in the even-even sector. At self-duality, the KW defect imposes a momentum-resolved selection rule on Liouvillian Jordan blocks. Modes with different Liouville momenta or KW-defect eigenvalues cannot form a common exceptional Jordan block. For a three-site chain, a global Rényi-2 KW asymmetry dynamically identifies the self-dual conditions. At the same time, the spectral structure exhibits both a semisimple degeneracy and a self-dual exceptional point with a perturbation-selective response. These results extend non-invertible dualities to Markovian quantum dynamics and establish a symmetry-based selection rule for Liouvillian Jordan structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个通用的Liouville空间对偶框架，将希尔伯特空间中的非可逆对偶性扩展到开放量子系统。该框架在自对偶点处形成精确对称性，并将Liouvillian与对偶哈密顿量和耗散参数联系起来。研究将此框架应用于周期性横场Ising链，揭示了Kramers-Wannier缺陷在自对偶时对Liouvillian Jordan块施加的动量分辨选择规则。
authors: Ying-Cheng Yang, Jhen-Dong Lin, Yueh-Nan Chen

articles.title: Exponential-SWAP gate between bosonic motional modes of trapped ions
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子玻色子运动模式间的指数SWAP门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23208v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The exponential-SWAP (eSWAP) gate generates a coherent superposition of identity and SWAP operations, with continuously tunable amplitudes. We experimentally implement this gate between two bosonic motional modes of trapped ions using spin-independent and spin-dependent beam splitter interactions. Measurements of selected slices of the joint characteristic function for distinct input states test the gate and demonstrate continuous control of the identity-SWAP superposition. This implementation provides a tunable interaction for hybrid qubit-bosonic quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验实现了囚禁离子两个玻色子运动模式之间的指数SWAP（eSWAP）门，该门能生成恒等操作和SWAP操作的相干叠加，并具有连续可调的振幅。通过测量不同输入态的联合特征函数切片，验证了该门的性能并展示了对恒等-SWAP叠加的连续控制。这项实现为混合量子比特-玻色子量子信息处理提供了一种可调谐的相互作用。
authors: E. J. W. Koh, Rongjie Zhang, Dzmitry Matsukevich

articles.title: Quantum Sensitivity of N-Component Cat States
articles.title_zh: N分量猫态的量子灵敏度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend our previous study of squeezed two-component Schrödinger cat states to a phase-referenced single-mode family with an arbitrary number N of coherent components and general relative phases. Within the established circular-state construction, we derive a closed complex overlap kernel for the ordered action of displacement, phase rotation, and squeezing, retaining exact finite-amplitude normalization. We distinguish finite-displacement orthogonality from local phase-estimation sensitivity quantified by quantum Fisher information (QFI). For equal-phase states, we compare N=2,łdots,9 at a common mean photon number and include coherent-state and squeezed-vacuum benchmarks. A bound on the higher photon-number sectors establishes the fixed-energy asymptote FQ,N=4bar n(N-bar n)+o(1). Its leading term agrees with the known QFI of a vacuum--N-photon superposition. The resulting decrease of the ideal local quantum Cramér--Rao bound does not establish unlimited attainable precision: prior phase information, sample size, phase-reference resources, optical loss, state preparation, and measurement choice remain relevant.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将之前对压缩两分量薛定谔猫态的研究扩展到具有任意N个相干分量和一般相对相位的单模家族。研究推导了一个封闭的复数重叠核，用于位移、相位旋转和压缩的有序作用，并保持精确的有限振幅归一化。通过量子Fisher信息（QFI）量化了局部相位估计灵敏度，并比较了不同N值下的性能。
authors: Ranjit Singh, Alexander E. Teretenkov

articles.title: Quantum Circuits for Variable-Coefficient Vlasov Dynamics via Schrödingerisation
articles.title_zh: 通过薛定谔化实现变系数Vlasov动力学的量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-dimensional Vlasov equations present promising use cases for quantum simulation, but their transport coefficients must be implemented coherently in order to preserve a compact quantum representation. We develop explicit Schrödingerised circuits for prescribed external field Vlasov dynamics without classical field updates. In 1D1V, velocity-dependent streaming is compiled directly from the encoded velocity register, while a non-linear cubic field is evaluated using reversible fixed-point arithmetic. For fixed polynomial degree, the field workspace scales linearly with the coordinate register width, while the field evaluation subroutine has polynomial depth. As a proof of concept, we simulate a minimal coupled 3D3V anharmonic Penning system and realise mixed electric-field terms and transverse magnetic coupling on a six-dimensional phase space in agreement with classical calculations. Resource analysis shows approximately linear growth with the number of time steps, while identifying the auxiliary register as the dominant depth bottleneck. Structured preparation and register recovery of the auxiliary state reveal an interplay between loading cost and readout. Together, our algorithm demonstrates a fully coherent quantum simulation of high-dimensional Vlasov dynamics with variable coefficients and identifies the practical resource costs that must be controlled for large-scale quantum implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了用于预设外场Vlasov动力学的显式薛定谔化量子电路，无需经典场更新。研究在1D1V中直接从编码速度寄存器编译速度依赖流，并使用可逆定点算术评估非线性三次场。作为概念验证，模拟了一个最小耦合的3D3V非谐Penning系统，并在六维相空间中实现了混合电场项和横向磁耦合，结果与经典计算一致。
authors: Fong Yew Leong, Dax Enshan Koh, Wei-Bin Ewe, Qiubo Chen, Zhun-Yong Ong

articles.title: Temperature dependence of a warm ensemble based memory on quantum communication rates
articles.title_zh: 基于暖系综存储器对量子通信速率的温度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The success of long-distance quantum communication will hinge on quantum repeater nodes equipped with robust and scalable quantum memories. Such memories must possess specific operating characteristics to make these nodes practical. An attractive option for these memory devices is an atomic warm vapor system operating under the conditions of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT). These systems are easy to implement and require relatively low equipment overhead. A key metric in atomic-based quantum memory performance is optical depth, as it is closely tied to the strength of light-matter coupling. Here, we simulate and measure the optical depth-based performance of an EIT quantum memory using a warm atomic vapor cell. We then translate the simulated and measured optical depth and efficiency metrics into expected entanglement distribution rates. Our analysis evaluates the feasibility of these memories in optical quantum repeater nodes, which are essential for robust long-distance quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于电磁感应透明（EIT）的原子暖蒸气量子存储器在量子通信中的性能。通过模拟和测量光学深度，并将其转化为预期的纠缠分发速率，评估了这种存储器在光量子中继节点中的可行性。研究结果对于实现鲁棒的长距离量子通信至关重要。
authors: Kenny Gregory, Khaled Mnaymneh, Connor Kupchak, Andrew MacRae

articles.title: Improving the estimation of spin-bath parameters via initial correlations and a two-qubit probe
articles.title_zh: 通过初始关联和双量子比特探针改进自旋浴参数估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how a second qubit can improve the estimation of spin-environment parameters when only one of the two qubits is measured. Both qubits are coupled to a common spin bath through the exactly solvable central-spin model, in which populations and coherences both evolve. Because the bath operator coupled to the qubits commutes with the bath Hamiltonian, the environment induces no effective interaction between the qubits. Without initial correlations or direct inter-qubit coupling, the two-qubit probe therefore performs exactly like a single qubit. When initial system-environment correlations are included, preparing the second qubit reshapes the environment statistics in a parameter-dependent way, and the measured qubit reads out this imprint. This improves the quantum Fisher information (QFI) for the coupling strength by factors of 3-4 relative to a correlated single-qubit probe, and by more than an order of magnitude relative to an uncorrelated one. For temperature estimation, the improvement reaches a factor of about 8. A direct Ising coupling does not help by itself, but the advantage persists in its presence. We also derive the classical Fisher information for arbitrary projective measurements and identify the measurement that saturates the QFI, which in general lies out of the equatorial plane of the Bloch sphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了如何通过引入第二个量子比特来改进自旋环境参数的估计，即使只测量其中一个量子比特。研究发现，当包含初始系统-环境关联时，第二个量子比特的制备能够以参数依赖的方式重塑环境统计数据，从而显著提高耦合强度和温度估计的量子Fisher信息。这种方法在没有直接Ising耦合的情况下也能带来优势，并在其存在时保持。
authors: Anila Khan, Huzaifa Amjad, Rizwan Abbas, Ali Raza Mirza

articles.title: Demonstration of Logical Error Suppression in a Surface Code Memory on a Cloud-Accessible IBM Superconducting Processor
articles.title_zh: 在云可访问的IBM超导处理器上演示表面码存储器中的逻辑错误抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction can suppress logical errors exponentially with code distance when physical noise is below threshold. Realizing this on hardware requires tight coordination among quantum gates, mid-circuit measurements, and qubit coherence. Device variation, noise asymmetry, and correlations across space and time complicate the translation of these capabilities into logical error suppression. Here, we study rotated surface-code memory on an IBM Nighthawk r2 processor. Performance varies across tested processor placements, which we attribute to differences in qubit quality. We optimize the code by combining short readout, fused measurement and reset, and an XX echo on data qubits during ancilla readout. Compared with standard readout without reset or echo, the optimized syndrome extraction circuit reduces the median per-round logical error rate by factors of 3.8 in the X basis and 1.4 in the Z basis. In memory experiments of up to 150 rounds, the distance advantage weakens, alongside long-lived correlations that may reflect a persistent error component. Under our optimization recipe, increasing the protected distance from 3 to 6 while holding the other distance fixed reduces the per-round logical error rate from 0.53% to 0.24% in Z memory and from 0.52% to 0.22% in X memory. The corresponding error-suppression factors under maximum-likelihood decoding are 1.68 and 1.85. These results connect circuit compilation and optimization to surface-code memory performance and limitations, and motivate QPU and QEC circuit codesign for fault-tolerant quantum computing primitives on current cloud hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作在IBM Nighthawk r2超导处理器上研究了旋转表面码存储器中的逻辑错误抑制。通过结合短读出、融合测量与复位以及数据量子比特上的XX回波等优化方案，研究人员成功将每轮逻辑错误率在X基下降低了3.8倍，在Z基下降低了1.4倍。尽管在长达150轮的存储实验中距离优势有所减弱，但该研究展示了在实际硬件上实现量子纠错以抑制逻辑错误的可行性。
authors: Shuwen Kan, Aaron Hoyt, Sean Garner, Ethan Vo, Adrian Harkness, Rod Rofougaran, Zefan Du, Chenxu Liu, Norm Tubman, Ying Mao, Samuel Stein

articles.title: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard. A live record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: QMBL：量子多体排行榜。一个记录已发表的晶格哈密顿量基态能量的实时平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22387v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In condensed matter physics, scientists explore phase diagrams of matter through various methods (analysis, numerics, experiment) and achieve consensus when enough methods agree. The quality of variational results for quantum many-body ground states is mainly judged by energy values and respective errors. Here, we present QMBL, the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard (https://www.qmbl.org), serving as the energy layer of the scientific consensus. It is a maintained, interactive record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. The latest release v0.4.0 holds 1434 energies on 395 instances of six model families and collects all of the community's efforts into one view. Of those instances 153 have no exact solution and any new record serves as a direct improvement to an open science problem. They are the targets of a companion benchmark, QMBL: Open Problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了QMBL（量子多体排行榜），这是一个维护良好且交互式的平台，用于记录已发表的晶格哈密顿量基态能量。该平台旨在为凝聚态物理中量子多体基态的变分结果提供一个能量层面的科学共识。最新版本v0.4.0包含了六个模型家族395个实例的1434个能量数据，其中153个实例尚无精确解，任何新记录都将直接改进这些开放科学问题。
authors: Tristan Zerweck, Juan Carrasquilla

articles.title: Area Theorems for Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错的面积定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22710v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The extrinsic information transfer (EXIT) and generalized EXIT (GEXIT) area theorems provide fundamental conservation laws that connect the rate of classical codes to the performance of maximum-a-posteriori decoding on binary memoryless channels. In this work, we generalize these area theorems to quantum error correction. We first develop a coset-entropy formalism for nested linear codes, where the message specifies a coset and encoder randomization selects a codeword within that coset. The area under the resulting coset (G)EXIT function equals the normalized dimension of the quotient. For stabilizer codes, the measured syndrome restricts the Pauli error but does not always determine its logical effect, and the remaining uncertainty is an entropy over logical correction classes. We show that this entropy equals a classical coset entropy associated with the stabilizer group and the Pauli operators that commute with it. The resulting quantum GEXIT function has area equal to the number of encoded qubits per channel use for any stabilizer code, and this applies to the depolarizing channel through its joint four-valued Pauli-error distribution. For CSS codes on the quantum erasure channel and under independent bit- and phase-flip noise, the logical correction problem separates into two binary coset-decoding problems. On the quantum erasure channel, the duality between the stabilizer group and the Pauli operators that commute with it gives a folding identity at complementary erasure probabilities. Using this and the area theorem, we derive an upper bound on the rate of code families with vanishing logical error probability that matches the capacity of the quantum erasure channel. For the depolarizing channel, we also derive a rate-dependent converse, using a connection between correction-class entropy and coherent information to establish an inequality involving the complementary channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将经典的外部信息传输（EXIT）和广义EXIT（GEXIT）面积定理推广到量子纠错领域。研究人员首先为嵌套线性码开发了一种陪集熵形式主义，并证明了所得陪集(G)EXIT函数下的面积等于商的归一化维度。对于稳定子码，他们进一步展示了逻辑纠正类上的不确定性熵等于与稳定子群和与其可交换的泡利算符相关的经典陪集熵。最终，得到的量子GEXIT函数下的面积等于每个信道使用中编码量子比特的数量，适用于任何稳定子码和退极化信道。
authors: Avijit Mandal, Mert Gökduman, Henry D. Pfister

articles.title: Development of a fabrication-to-benchtop process for SiN-based quantum devices
articles.title_zh: 基于氮化硅的量子器件从制造到台式测试的工艺开发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22776v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Silicon nitride has emerged as a key material for the advancement of future quantum communication and computational devices. However, challenges persist in establishing a comprehensive development process, spanning from fabrication to optical characterization, essential for advancing these devices to their next stage of potential. Maintaining control over the entire process, from start to finish, alongside device modeling, enables more efficient and timely iteration and optimization. Here we introduce a fabrication-to-benchtop process. We employ an in-house stoichiometric recipe for device fabrication and conduct comprehensive characterization of optical losses and material properties. Understanding and controlling the refractive index of the device are vital for predicting device geometries and group indices. Implementing the refractive indices of our fabricated devices, we simulate microring resonators and demonstrate their application in generating optical solitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮化硅是未来量子通信和计算设备的关键材料，但其全面的开发流程仍面临挑战。本文介绍了一种从制造到台式测试的完整工艺流程，包括采用内部化学计量配方进行器件制造，并对光学损耗和材料特性进行全面表征。通过理解和控制器件的折射率，研究人员能够模拟微环谐振器并展示其在产生光学孤子方面的应用，从而实现更高效的迭代和优化。
authors: Connor Kupchak, Abubaker Tareki, Tara Moradi, Patrick Laferriere, Niall Tait, Khaled Mnaymneh

articles.title: Chirality-resolved imaging of spin waves with a quantum spin
articles.title_zh: 利用量子自旋对自旋波进行手性分辨成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22867v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin waves carry their propagation direction in the handedness of their circularly polarized stray field, a property inaccessible to scalar magnetometers. In the Damon-Eshbach surface wave of an in-plane magnetized film, the dipolar field above the film rotates with a handedness fixed by the direction of travel. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre in diamond is an intrinsic polarization analyser: a right-handed field about the NV axis drives one spin transition, and a left-handed field drives the other, in both the ground and the excited state. Here, we exploit the two excited-state transitions, which lie inside the spin-wave band of yttrium iron garnet (YIG), as a pair of chirality channels and image Damon-Eshbach waves in both directions. Because reflection from an etched boundary reverses the handedness, the incident and reflected waves appear as two lines in one spectrum and are imaged separately. In the ground state, the same rule applies, and the selected field drives Rabi oscillations, a route to chirality-selective control of the NV spin by magnons. Reading the two channels gives the direction of a spin wave at one point, without a phase reference. This advances chirality-resolved quantum sensing and provides insight into chiral spin-wave dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心作为固有的偏振分析器，实现了对自旋波的手性分辨成像。研究人员利用NV中心的两个激发态跃迁作为手性通道，成功对钇铁石榴石（YIG）中的Damon-Eshbach波进行了双向成像。通过这种方法，入射波和反射波在光谱中显示为两条独立的线并被分别成像，从而揭示了自旋波的传播方向。
authors: Enbo Zhang, Tiancheng Zheng, Bo-Yuan Yang, Shreyes Nallan, Chengchao Xu, Mark Ku, Jian-Gang Zhu

articles.title: Nonergodicity from Hilbert-Subspace Cloning
articles.title_zh: 希尔伯特子空间克隆导致的非遍历性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23105v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We identify a class of nonintegrable quantum many-body systems composed of single Pauli strings that possess an extensive number of noncommuting local conserved quantities and exhibit partial ergodicity breaking due to exponentially degenerate energy spectra. We show that such systems exhibit a novel mechanism, Hilbert-subspace cloning, where the identical chaotic Hamiltonian acts on each of exponentially many disconnected Hilbert subspaces. Although the dynamics within each clone thermalizes, quantum coherence between clones remains protected and detectable by local observables. Consequently, the long-time behavior of local observables is described by a coherence-preserving partial Gibbs ensemble, where the hidden subsystem retains its initial quantum coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文识别了一类由单个泡利串组成的非可积量子多体系统，这些系统具有大量非对易的局域守恒量，并因指数简并的能谱而表现出部分遍历性破缺。研究发现，这些系统展现出一种新颖的希尔伯特子空间克隆机制，其中相同的混沌哈密顿量作用于指数多个不连通的希尔伯特子空间。尽管每个克隆内部的动力学热化，但克隆之间的量子相干性仍受保护并可通过局域可观测量检测，导致局域可观测量在长时间行为中由保持相干性的部分吉布斯系综描述。
authors: Yuuya Chiba, Ryusuke Hamazaki

articles.title: Impact of Irrep Truncations on Quantum Simulations of QCD
articles.title_zh: 不可约表示截断对QCD量子模拟的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23681v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories with continuous gauge groups require a choice of basis (how states of the gauge theory map to the qubit computational basis) and truncation scheme (which of the infinitely many gauge theory basis states should be omitted in the map to the finite dimensional qubit Hilbert space.) The most common choices are adapted to an electric basis for the gauge theory, where the basis states for each link are associated with irreducible representations of the gauge group. Electric bases and truncations are generally advantageous for preserving gauge symmetries and simulating the strong coupling regime, but their effectiveness in the weak coupling regimes of physical interest are less well understood. In this work, we compute relative probabilities p(R')/p(R) for finding a link in the irreps R,R' in the ground state of SU(3) lattice gauge theory using Euclidean Monte Carlo methods and weak-coupling lattice perturbation theory. The observables that compute these relative probabilities are constructed by introducing seams into an anisotropic lattice, and by a similar construction we are also able to measure relative probabilities of different site singlets (ways that electric flux braids together into a gauge singlet) at each vertex. With these methods we can quantify, for example, the importance of higher electric flux states in the weak coupling ground state. These results directly inform what truncations are needed to accurately capture non-abelian gauge dynamics near the continuum limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了不可约表示（irrep）截断对具有连续规范群的晶格规范理论量子模拟的影响。研究人员利用欧几里得蒙特卡洛方法和弱耦合晶格微扰理论，计算了SU(3)晶格规范理论基态中，在不同不可约表示R和R'中找到链的相对概率p(R')/p(R)。这些可观测量通过在各向异性晶格中引入缝隙来构建，旨在更好地理解电基和截断在物理感兴趣的弱耦合区域的有效性。
authors: Patrick Draper, Drishti Gupta

articles.title: Transport and thermalization under noncommuting localized constraints
articles.title_zh: 非对易局域约束下的输运与热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23781v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the effects of spatially localized conserved quantities on transport and thermalization in quantum and classical many-body systems. We consider several related models: the integrable quantum Volterra model, its nonintegrable classical limit, and two cellular automata derived from the latter. Although localized constraints are often associated with lattice gauge theories, our models do not admit such an interpretation. In systems with discrete degrees of freedom, these constraints induce uniform fragmentation of the Hilbert or configuration space. In the quantum Volterra model, we derive an exact mapping of the dynamics within each Hilbert-space fragment onto a quantum chiral Potts chain. We find that energy transport is ballistic, with identical transport coefficients across all fragments. In the nonintegrable classical limit, energy transport is diffusive, and we similarly find the diffusion constant to be independent of whether or not the constraints are fixed (resolved). Finally, in the cellular automata, we show that, despite leaving transport unaffected, localized constraints lead to a strong breakdown of local ergodicity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了空间局域守恒量对量子和经典多体系统中输运与热化的影响。研究人员考察了可积量子Volterra模型及其非可积经典极限，以及两种元胞自动机。在量子Volterra模型中，能量输运是弹道式的，且所有片段的输运系数相同；而在非可积经典极限中，能量输运是扩散式的，扩散常数与约束是否固定无关。尽管局域约束不影响输运，但在元胞自动机中，它们导致了局域热化的严重破坏。
authors: Amir Nesturov, Attila Takács, Lenart Zadnik

articles.title: Exponential clustering of bipartite quantum entanglement at arbitrary temperatures
articles.title_zh: 任意温度下二分量子纠缠的指数聚类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2108.12209v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Macroscopic quantum effects play central roles in the appearance of inexplicable phenomena in low-temperature quantum many-body physics. Such macroscopic quantumness is often evaluated using long-range entanglement, i.e., entanglement in the macroscopic length scale. The long-range entanglement not only characterizes the novel quantum phases but also serves as a critical resource for quantum computation. Thus, the problem that arises is under which conditions can the long-range entanglement be stable even at room temperatures. Here, we show that bi-partite long-range entanglement is unstable at arbitrary temperatures and exponentially decays with distance. Our theorem provides a no-go theorem on the existence of the long-range entanglement. The obtained results are consistent with the existing observations that long-range entanglement at non-zero temperatures can exist in topologically ordered phases, where tripartite correlations are dominant. In the derivation of our result, we introduce a quantum correlation defined by the convex roof of the standard correlation function. We establish an exponential clustering theorem for generic quantum many-body systems for such a quantum correlation at arbitrary temperatures, which yields our main result by relating quantum correlation to quantum entanglement. As a simple application of our analytical techniques, we derived a general limit on the Wigner-Yanase-Dyson skew information and the quantum Fisher information, which will attract significant attention in the field of quantum metrology. Our work reveals novel general aspects of low-temperature quantum physics and sheds light on the characterization of long-range entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在任意温度下，二分长程纠缠是不稳定的，并随距离呈指数衰减。这一定理为长程纠缠的存在性提供了一个“不可能定理”，与现有观察结果一致，即非零温度下的长程纠缠主要存在于三方关联占主导的拓扑有序相中。在推导过程中，研究人员引入了一种由标准关联函数的凸包定义的量子关联，并建立了广义量子关联的指数聚类定理。
authors: Tomotaka Kuwahara, Keiji Saito

articles.title: Continuous variable dense coding under realistic non-ideal scenarios
articles.title_zh: 现实非理想场景下的连续变量密集编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.07609v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the continuous variable (CV) dense coding protocol between a single sender and a single receiver when affected by noise in the shared and encoded states, as well as when the decoding is imperfect. We present a formalism to derive the dense coding capacity (DCC) of generic two-mode Gaussian states when affected by Gaussian noise models. When the constituent modes are affected by quantum-limited amplifiers, pure-loss channels, and environmental interactions, together with an inefficient decoding mechanism comprising imperfect double-homodyne detection, we specifically investigate the performance of the two-mode squeezed vacuum state (TMSV) by varying the strength of the noise. Through numerical simulations, we further show that the negative conditional entropy may be used to assess the quantum advantage of CV dense coding in Gaussian setups. While comparing the TMSV with other Gaussian states, we identify a class of pure Gaussian states capable of furnishing a capacity equal to that of the TMSV, under equal energy constraints in the ideal regime. Further, we demonstrate that, while the TMSV state is more susceptible to noise, it still provides the maximum quantum advantage in the DC protocol under practical conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在共享和编码态受噪声影响以及解码不完善的现实非理想场景下，单发送者与单接收者之间的连续变量（CV）密集编码协议。研究人员提出了一个形式主义来推导受高斯噪声模型影响的通用双模高斯态的密集编码容量（DCC）。通过数值模拟，他们发现负条件熵可用于评估高斯设置中CV密集编码的量子优势，并识别出一类在理想条件下具有与双模压缩真空态（TMSV）相同容量的纯高斯态。
authors: Mrinmoy Samanta, Ayan Patra, Rivu Gupta, Aditi Sen De

articles.title: Bottlenecks in quantum channels and finite temperature phases of matter
articles.title_zh: 量子信道中的瓶颈与有限温度下的物质相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.09598v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove an analog of the "bottleneck theorem," well-known for classical Markov chains, for Markovian quantum channels. In particular, we show that if two regions (subspaces) of Hilbert space are separated by a region that has very low weight in the channel's steady state, then states initialized on one side of this barrier will take a long time to relax, putting a lower bound on the mixing time in terms of an appropriately defined "quantum bottleneck ratio." Importantly, this bottleneck ratio involves not only the probabilities of the relevant subspaces, but also the size of off-diagonal matrix elements between them. For low temperature quantum many-body systems, we use the bottleneck theorem to bound the performance of any quasilocal Gibbs sampler. This leads to a new perspective on thermally stable quantum phases in terms of a decomposition of the Gibbs state into multiple components separated by bottlenecks. As a concrete application, we show rigorously that weakly perturbed commuting projector models with extensive energy barriers (which include certain classical and quantum expander codes) have exponentially large mixing times
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为马尔可夫量子信道证明了经典马尔可夫链“瓶颈定理”的类比。研究表明，如果希尔伯特空间的两个区域被一个在信道稳态中权重很低的区域隔开，那么初始状态位于屏障一侧的系统将需要很长时间才能弛豫，从而通过适当定义的“量子瓶颈比”给出混合时间的下限。该定理为热稳定量子相提供了一个新视角，并严格证明了具有广泛能量势垒的弱扰动对易投影模型具有指数大的混合时间。
authors: Tibor Rakovszky, Benedikt Placke, Nikolas P. Breuckmann, Vedika Khemani

articles.title: Floquet-ADAPT-VQE: A Quantum Algorithm to Simulate Non-Equilibrium Physics in Periodically Driven Systems
articles.title_zh: Floquet-ADAPT-VQE：一种模拟周期驱动系统中非平衡物理的量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.11613v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Periodically driven quantum systems exhibit many fascinating phenomena absent in equilibrium systems, but their simulation is more challenging than that of static systems. Consequently, quantum simulation of these systems offers greater opportunity for achieving quantum advantage. To build the foundation for simulating time-periodic Hamiltonians, we utilize the Floquet-Hilbert space formalism to transform the Hamiltonian into a time-independent form and provide its Pauli decomposition. Within this formalism, we develop a hybrid quantum-classical algorithm, Floquet-ADAPT-VQE, that produces three key quantities that govern periodically driven quantum dynamics: the quasienergy, the associated Floquet eigenstates, and expectation values of observables with respect to these eigenstates. The latter is achieved by applying a fixed-depth quantum circuit to an initial Floquet eigenstate---an efficient construction made possible by the Floquet-Hilbert space formalism. We also identify a suitable auxiliary initial state whose squared Floquet energy is independent of the number of auxiliary qubits as well as the driving frequency, which leads to better convergence with fewer ADAPT iterations. We demonstrate our algorithm by performing numerical simulations on a periodically driven XYZ model with a magnetic field. We also explore potential applications of our algorithm for studying various non-equilibrium phenomena in periodically driven systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种混合量子-经典算法Floquet-ADAPT-VQE，用于模拟周期驱动系统中的非平衡物理。该算法利用Floquet-希尔伯特空间形式主义将时间周期哈密顿量转换为时间无关形式，并生成准能量、相关的Floquet本征态以及可观测量对这些本征态的期望值。通过将固定深度的量子电路应用于初始Floquet本征态，该方法实现了高效的构建，并识别出一种辅助初始态，其平方Floquet能量独立于辅助量子比特数量和驱动频率。
authors: Abhishek Kumar, Karunya Shirali, Nicholas J. Mayhall, Sophia E. Economou, Edwin Barnes

articles.title: Circuit-based characterization of finite-temperature quantum phases and self-correcting quantum memory
articles.title_zh: 基于电路的有限温度量子相表征与自纠正量子存储器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.15204v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum phases at zero temperature can be characterized as equivalence classes under local unitary transformations: two ground states within a gapped phase can be transformed into each other via a local unitary circuit. We generalize this circuit-based characterization of phases to systems at finite-temperature thermal equilibrium described by Gibbs states. We construct a channel circuit that approximately transforms one Gibbs state into another provided the two are connected by a path in parameter space along which a certain correlation-decay condition holds. For finite-dimensional systems of linear size L and approximation error ϵ, the locality of the circuit is m̊ polylog(m̊ poly(L)/ϵ). The correlation-decay condition, which we specify, is expected to be satisfied in the interior of many noncritical thermal phases, including those displaying discrete symmetry breaking and topological order. As an application, we show that any system in the same thermal phase as a zero-temperature topological code coherently preserves quantum information for a macroscopically long time, establishing self-correction as a universal property of thermal phases. As part of the proof, we provide explicit encoding and decoding channel circuits to encode information into, and decode it from, a system in thermal equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将零温度下量子相的电路表征推广到有限温度热平衡态。作者构建了一个通道电路，可以在满足特定关联衰减条件时，将一个吉布斯态近似转换为另一个。该方法适用于许多非临界热相，包括具有离散对称性破缺和拓扑序的系统。作为应用，研究表明与零温度拓扑码处于相同热相的任何系统都能相干地长时间保存量子信息，确立了自纠正的普适性。
authors: Ruochen Ma, Vedika Khemani, Shengqi Sang

articles.title: Hybrid boson sampling-neural network architecture for enhanced classification
articles.title_zh: 用于增强分类的混合玻色子采样-神经网络架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.13332v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Demonstration of quantum advantage for classical machine learning tasks remains a central goal for quantum technologies and artificial intelligence. Two major bottlenecks to this goal are the high dimensionality of practical datasets and the limited performance of near-term quantum computers. Boson sampling is among the few models for which experiments have claimed quantum advantage, yet it has limited practical applications. Here, we propose a hybrid framework that combines the computational power of boson sampling with the adaptability of neural networks to construct quantum kernels that enhance support vector machine classification. The neural network adapts the data features onto a programmable boson sampling circuit, producing quantum states that span a high-dimensional Hilbert space and enable improved classification performance. Using four datasets with various classes, we demonstrate that our model outperforms classical linear and sigmoid kernels. These results highlight the potential of boson sampling-based quantum kernels for practical quantum-enhanced machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子技术在经典机器学习任务中展现量子优势是核心目标。本文提出一种混合框架，结合玻色子采样的计算能力与神经网络的适应性，构建量子核以增强支持向量机分类。神经网络将数据特征映射到可编程玻色子采样电路，生成高维希尔伯特空间中的量子态，从而提高分类性能。通过在四个不同数据集上的实验，该模型优于经典的线性和Sigmoid核，突显了基于玻色子采样的量子核在实际量子增强机器学习中的潜力。
authors: Mohammad Sharifian, Abolfazl Bayat

articles.title: Higher-Dimensional Information Lattice: Quantum State Characterization through Inclusion-Exclusion Local Information
articles.title_zh: 高维信息格：通过容斥局部信息表征量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20793v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Developing a local description of quantum information is a central problem in quantum many-body physics: the goal is to identify how correlations are organized across positions and scales without choosing specific observables. We introduce a higher-dimensional information lattice, an inclusion-exclusion construction that decomposes the von Neumann information of reduced density matrices into contributions labeled by subsystem position and scale. Above one dimension, overlapping subsystems can form loops, allowing information associated with one subsystem to be inferred nonlocally from the density matrices of others. The sign of the inclusion-exclusion information resolves such overlap redundancies in position and scale: positive values mark positions and scales with net information gain, while negative values occur where redundant contributions dominate new ones. We implement the construction in two dimensions and apply it to many-body ground states with distinct entanglement structures. For localized states, such as disordered-localized states or gapped ground states of local Hamiltonians, the local information decays exponentially along different directions, defining direction-dependent information length scales. In critical states with a Fermi surface, decay becomes algebraic, with dominant directions tied to the velocity of gapless modes. In the toric code, topological order manifests as a negative information value at the largest lattice scale, interpreted as global information redundancy between the smallest loop-enclosing overlapping subsystems. We also isolate the universal information carried by edge states and locate the signatures of non-Abelian fusion channels in position and scale. Our results establish the higher-dimensional information lattice as a framework for resolving universal correlation structures through the spatial and scale distribution of quantum information.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种高维信息格，这是一种容斥构造，将约化密度矩阵的冯诺依曼信息分解为由子系统位置和尺度标记的贡献。在高于一维的情况下，重叠子系统可以形成环，允许从其他密度矩阵非局域地推断与一个子系统相关的信息。容斥信息的符号解决了位置和尺度上的重叠冗余：正值表示净信息增益，负值表示冗余贡献占主导。该方法在二维中实现并应用于具有不同纠缠结构的多体基态，结果显示对于局域态，局部信息呈指数衰减。
authors: Ian Matthias Flór, Claudia Artiaco, Thomas Klein Kvorning, Jens H. Bardarson

articles.title: Failure of the mean-field Hartree approximation for a bosonic many-body system with non-Hermitian Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 非厄米哈密顿量玻色子多体系统平均场哈特里近似的失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13038v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mean-field Hartree theory is a central tool for reducing many-body dynamics to an effective one-particle evolution. This approximation has been employed when the Hamiltonian governing the many-body dynamics is not Hermitian. Indeed, non-Hermitian Hamiltonians model particle gain/loss or the evolution of open quantum systems between consecutive quantum jumps. Furthermore, the validity of the Hartree approximation for generic non-Hermitian Hamiltonians lies at the basis of a quantum algorithm for nonlinear differential equations. In this work, we show that this approximation can fail. First, we consider the most general bosonic mean-field Hamiltonian with two-body interactions and we prove that, for non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, the Hartree equation does not capture the correct second time derivative of the one-particle marginal state at t=0 in the thermodynamic limit. Then, we analytically solve a model of N bosonic qubits with a purely anti-Hermitian Hamiltonian, compute the limit for N→infty of the one-particle marginal state and show that it does not agree with the solution of the non-Hermitian Hartree equation. We further show that there exists an initial condition such that the exact one-particle marginal state undergoes a finite-time transition to a mixed state, a phenomenon that is completely absent in the case of Hermitian Hamiltonians. Finally, we simulate a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian with real spectrum and show that, also in this case, there are initial conditions for which the Hartree equation does not reproduce the correct one-particle marginal state in the limit N→infty. Our findings challenge the validity of the mean-field Hartree approximation for non-Hermitian Hamiltonians, and call for additional conditions for the validity of the mean-field regime to model the dynamics of particle gain and loss and the open-system dynamics in bosonic many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 平均场哈特里理论是简化多体动力学为有效单粒子演化的核心工具，常用于非厄米哈密顿量系统。本文证明了该近似可能失效。研究发现，对于非厄米哈密顿量，哈特里方程在热力学极限下无法捕捉单粒子边际态在t=0时的正确二阶时间导数。通过解析求解一个具有纯反厄米哈密顿量的N个玻色子量子比特模型，结果显示其N→∞极限下的单粒子边际态与非厄米哈特里方程的解不一致。
authors: Matias Ginzburg, Simone Rademacher, Giacomo De Palma

articles.title: Low-Resource Quantum Energy Gap Estimation via Randomization
articles.title_zh: 基于随机化的低资源量子能隙估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13881v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Estimating the energy spectra of quantum many-body systems is a fundamental task in quantum physics, with applications ranging from chemistry to condensed matter. Algorithmic shadow spectroscopy is a recent method that leverages randomized measurements on time-evolved quantum states to extract spectral information. However, implementing accurate time evolution with low-depth circuits remains a key challenge for near-term quantum hardware. In this work, we propose a hybrid quantum-classical protocol that integrates Time Evolution via Probabilistic Angle Interpolation (TE-PAI) into the shadow spectroscopy framework. TE-PAI enables the simulation of time evolution using shallow stochastic circuits while preserving unbiased estimates through quasiprobability sampling. We construct the combined estimator and derive its theoretical properties. Through numerical simulations, we demonstrate that our method accurately resolves energy gaps and exhibits enhanced robustness to gate noise compared to first-order Trotter-based shadow spectroscopy. We further validate the protocol experimentally on up to 20 qubits using IBM quantum hardware. This makes TE-PAI shadow spectroscopy a promising tool for spectral analysis on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 估计量子多体系统的能谱是量子物理学的基本任务。本文提出一种混合量子-经典协议，将概率角插值时间演化（TE-PAI）整合到影子光谱学框架中，以实现低资源能隙估计。TE-PAI利用浅层随机电路模拟时间演化，并通过准概率采样保持无偏估计。数值模拟表明，该方法能准确解析能隙，并对门噪声具有更强的鲁棒性。该协议已在IBM量子硬件上通过多达20个量子比特的实验得到验证。
authors: Hugo Pages, Chusei Kiumi, Yuto Morohoshi, Bálint Koczor, Kosuke Mitarai

articles.title: Learning Midcircuit Measurement Backaction from Three Repeated Measurements
articles.title_zh: 从三次重复测量中学习中途测量反作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00433v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate modeling of midcircuit measurements (MCMs) is essential for dynamic-circuit operations such as syndrome extraction, measurement-based reset, and the separation of state-preparation and measurement error. Unlike terminal measurement, a noisy MCM both produces a classical outcome and alters the incoming quantum state, thereby influencing subsequent circuit operations. This makes conventional confusion-matrix or fidelity-level characterization insufficient. Here, we introduce an efficient, self-consistent protocol for learning a single-qubit Z-twirled MCM instrument, retaining the readout-backaction correlations and excitation-decay asymmetry that are erased in Pauli-error descriptions. Remarkably, readout bit strings from only three repeated MCMs on a maximally mixed input determine all learnable parameters of the reduced instrument, up to a single unidentifiable gauge degree of freedom. Physicality constraints convert this nonidentifiability into narrow, gauge-aware error intervals. Implemented on IBM superconducting processors, the learned instrument improves Pauli-observable prediction by sim 100× over a conventional confusion-matrix model and reveals a T₁₋decay dominated backaction. Our protocol provides a compact characterization layer for state-preparation and measurement error separation, reset optimization, and noise-aware quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确建模中途测量（MCMs）对于动态电路操作至关重要。本文提出一种高效、自洽的协议，用于学习单量子比特Z-旋转MCM仪器，保留了保利误差描述中被抹去的读出反作用关联和激发衰减不对称性。通过对最大混合输入进行三次重复MCMs的读出比特串，可以确定约化仪器的所有可学习参数。该协议在IBM超导处理器上实现，将保利可观测预测的准确性提高了约100倍。
authors: Chia-Tung Chu, Su-un Lee, Han Zheng, Senrui Chen, Bibek Pokharel, Alireza Seif, Liang Jiang

articles.title: Enhancing Quantum Metrology with High-order Fisher Information and Experiments
articles.title_zh: 利用高阶费雪信息增强量子计量学及实验验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27633v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fisher information plays a central role in statistics and quantum metrology, providing the basis for the celebrated Cramér-Rao bound.
