In this work, we introduce a new information measure based on higher-order Fisher information and show that it naturally leads to a generalized uncertainty relation for parameter estimation, which can be regarded as an extension of the Cramér-Rao bound. As an application, we analyze the case of quantum phase estimation with a single qubit and compare our theoretical bounds with the well-known established hierarchical bounds. Finally, we experimentally validate the proposed framework using a photonic platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 费雪信息在统计学和量子计量学中扮演核心角色。本文引入了一种基于高阶费雪信息的新信息度量，并证明其自然地引出参数估计的广义不确定关系，可视为克拉默-劳界的扩展。作为应用，作者分析了单量子比特量子相位估计的情况，并将其理论界限与已有的分层界限进行比较。最后，该框架通过光子平台进行了实验验证。
authors: Xin-Zhu Liu, Jun-Li Jiang, Yan-Han Yang, Li-Ming Zhao, Xue Yang, Shao-Ming Fei, Ming-Xing Luo

articles.title: Noise structuring in fixed-depth Trotter simulation: stationary channels and observable-level depolarization
articles.title_zh: 固定深度Trotter模拟中的噪声结构化：平稳信道与可观测层去极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.17936v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze fixed-depth Trotter simulation as a method for structuring hardware noise in digital many-body dynamics. The number of layers is chosen using the largest endpoint time and is then kept fixed throughout the time scan, making the total noise dose approximately independent of the endpoint time. For local stochastic faults, we show that, once propagated faults lose memory of their insertion layer, the noisy circuit factorizes into ideal evolution followed by a stationary finite-depth binomial channel. In the dilute-layer limit, this channel reduces to a Poissonian exponential. The memory time of a single fault is related to a Loschmidt echo. An important consequence is observable-level depolarization: for selected macroscopic observables at low to moderate noise levels, the stationary channel can act as an almost time-independent affine contrast correction, even though the full channel need not be depolarizing, which is crusial for error mitigation purposes. At short times, the same protocol produces a digital Zeno-like transient, in which a fixed number of noise opportunities competes with a vanishing coherent angle per layer. Our results also reveal limitations of naive zero-noise extrapolatin strategies based on oversimplified functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了固定深度Trotter模拟作为数字多体动力学中硬件噪声结构化的一种方法。研究表明，对于局部随机故障，一旦传播的故障失去其插入层的记忆，噪声电路会分解为理想演化和一个平稳的有限深度二项式信道。一个重要结果是可观测层去极化：在低到中等噪声水平下，平稳信道可以作为几乎与时间无关的仿射对比度校正，这对于误差缓解至关重要。在短时间内，该协议还会产生数字芝诺效应般的瞬态。
authors: G. L. Stavisskii, W. V. Pogosov, L. E. Fedichkin, A. V. Lebedev

articles.title: Quantum key distribution over a 2 km free-space channel with a high secure key rate
articles.title_zh: 2公里自由空间信道高安全密钥率量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24118v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Free-space quantum key distribution (QKD) provides crucial advantages, including mobility and deployment exibility, for securing next-generation communication networks. However, atmospheric turbulence and beam wander severely degrade single-photon coupling effciency and link stability over outdoor channels. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate a free-space decoy-state BB84 QKD system operating at 803 nm with a 100 MHz repetition rate over a 2 km outdoor link. By employing an active beam-wander correction based on fast-steering mirrors (FSMs) and position sensitive detectors (PSDs) with a 500 Hz control loop, we enhance the ?ber coupling effciency and achieve an average ?nite-key secure key rate of 110 kbps with an average quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 3.28 %, representing a 2.5 times secure key rate enhancement under an active beam stabilization. This work demonstrates the indispensability of active beam stabilization and provides an operational reference for robust, long-range free-space quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）为下一代通信网络提供了关键优势，但大气湍流和光束漂移会严重降低性能。本文实验演示了一个在2公里户外链路上运行的自由空间诱骗态BB84 QKD系统。通过采用基于快速转向镜的主动光束漂移校正，研究团队将光纤耦合效率提高，实现了110 kbps的平均有限密钥安全密钥率和3.28%的平均量子误码率。该工作证明了主动光束稳定对于稳健、远距离自由空间量子通信的不可或缺性。
authors: Kyungdeuk Park, Dongkyu Kim, Dong-Gil Im, Yonggi Jo, Jisu Kim, Jonguk Choi, Yong Sup Ihn

articles.title: Level statistics of the disordered Haldane-Shastry model with 1/r^α interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有1/r^α相互作用的无序Haldane-Shastry模型的能级统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14695v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding how the interaction range and various types of disorder affect the level statistics of many-body quantum systems, leading to the emergence of many-body localization (MBL), is a challenging open frontier. We study the level statistics of a variant of the spin-1/2 Haldane-Shastry model with 1/rα interactions, where α≥0 parametrizes the range of the interactions, in the presence of position disorder and/or random magnetic fields. We find that neither position disorder nor random magnetic fields alone yields pristine Poisson statistics in this system; however, Poisson statistics emerge in their combined presence, suggesting the emergence of MBL when both types of disorder coexist. Interestingly, once random magnetic fields break the SU(2) symmetry, the strength of the position disorder, δ, appears to play an important role, as evidenced by an approximate scaling collapse of the disorder-averaged gap ratios that is parametrized in terms of a single parameter, α δ.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解相互作用范围和各种无序如何影响多体量子系统的能级统计，从而导致多体局域化（MBL）的出现，是一个具有挑战性的开放前沿。本文研究了具有1/r^α相互作用的自旋-1/2 Haldane-Shastry模型的能级统计，发现单独的位置无序或随机磁场都不能产生纯泊松统计。然而，当两者共存时，泊松统计出现，表明MBL的出现。研究还发现，一旦随机磁场打破SU(2)对称性，位置无序的强度δ将发挥重要作用。
authors: Vengatesan Ganapathy, Pranay Patil, Ajit C. Balram

articles.title: Perspective: Quantum Computing on Magnetic Racetrack
articles.title_zh: 展望：磁性赛道上的量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Magnetic domain walls have long been pursued as carriers of classical information for storage and processing. With the ability to create, control, and probe domain walls at the nanoscale, they are recently recognized as an ideal platform for studying macroscopic quantum effects and provide a natural blueprint for building scalable quantum computing architectures. In particular, the experimentally demonstrated high mobility of domain walls makes them not only suitable as stationary qubits but also as flying qubits, which may offer advantages over currently explored quantum computing platforms. In this Perspective, we outline our current understanding of the essential ingredients and key requirements for realizing universal quantum computation based on magnetic domain walls. We highlight promising concrete material platforms and identify the experiments that are still needed to advance this concept. We also discuss the potential challenges and point to new opportunities in this emerging research direction at the interface between magnetism and quantum information science.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁畴壁长期以来被视为经典信息载体。随着在纳米尺度上创建、控制和探测畴壁的能力，它们被认为是研究宏观量子效应和构建可扩展量子计算架构的理想平台。本文概述了基于磁畴壁实现通用量子计算的基本要素和关键要求，并强调了有前景的具体材料平台和仍需进行的实验。文章还讨论了潜在挑战，并指出了磁学与量子信息科学交叉领域的新机遇。
authors: Ji Zou, Jelena Klinovaja, Daniel Loss

articles.title: Temporal Interference from Topological Transitions in Monitored Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 监测量子动力学中拓扑转变产生的瞬时干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27045v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum interference is conventionally associated with the coherent superposition of alternative paths. We uncover a temporal form of interference in repeatedly monitored quantum systems, appearing directly as fringes in the stochastic first-detection-time distribution. This temporal interference becomes remarkably long lived near a class of topological transitions at which a pair of dark states emerges in Hilbert space. Close to such transitions, the corresponding quasi-dark modes dominate the late-time dynamics and interfere coherently, producing pronounced temporal fringes whose decay becomes arbitrarily slow upon approaching the transition. We identify the symmetry conditions underlying this mechanism and relate the fringe frequency to the energy spectrum of the Hamiltonian. Our results reveal how the interplay of quantum superposition, topological transitions, and dark-state formation generates long-lived temporal interference in monitored quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子干涉通常与替代路径的相干叠加相关。本文揭示了在重复监测的量子系统中出现的一种瞬时干涉形式，表现为随机首次探测时间分布中的条纹。这种瞬时干涉在拓扑转变附近变得异常长寿，此时希尔伯特空间中出现一对暗态。研究识别了该机制的对称性条件，并将条纹频率与哈密顿量的能谱联系起来，揭示了量子叠加、拓扑转变和暗态形成如何共同产生监测量子动力学中的长寿命瞬时干涉。
authors: Qingyuan Wang, Ruoyu Yin, Eli Barkai

articles.title: Attraction from repulsion in an interacting Chern band: chiral superconductivity, generalized Hall crystals, and competing fractional Chern insulators
articles.title_zh: 相互作用陈带中的排斥吸引：手性超导、广义霍尔晶体和竞争性分数量子霍尔绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experiments realizing strong interactions in partially filled Chern bands have observed fractional Chern insulators (FCIs), superconductors, and topological crystals in close proximity. Yet the microscopic relation between them remains poorly understood. Here, we use tensor network simulations to study repulsively interacting spinless fermions in a tunable topological band of the checkerboard lattice. We characterize the competing phases and identify key features of the experimental phenomenology. FCIs from the Jain sequence transition into chiral p-wave superconductivity both below and above half filling as the band dispersion is enhanced. By contrast, at half filling, a generalized Hall crystal with quantized Hall conductance and a doubled unit cell forms for sufficiently strong coupling. Surprisingly, a weak-coupling approach starting from a metallic parent state captures the nature of both ordered phases at intermediate coupling. We find that fluctuations in the metal generate longer-range attraction, which we analyze within the random-phase approximation. This approach captures the pairing symmetry as well as the radial form factors of the Cooper pairs, and incorporating this attraction into Hartree-Fock selects the observed Hall crystal. Together, these results identify fluctuation-induced attraction from repulsion as a common microscopic ingredient of ordering, while our tensor network computations establish the direct competition of both phases with FCIs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用张量网络模拟，探讨了棋盘格晶格中可调拓扑能带内排斥相互作用无自旋费米子的竞争相。结果表明，Jain序列的分数量子霍尔绝缘体（FCIs）在半填充上下均可转变为手性p波超导，而半填充时则形成广义霍尔晶体。令人惊讶的是，从金属母态出发的弱耦合方法能捕捉到中间耦合下两种有序相的性质，揭示了金属中的涨落如何产生长程吸引。
authors: Fabian Pichler, Clemens Kuhlenkamp, Ashvin Vishwanath, Michael Knap

articles.title: Pressure-Dependent hcp-to-fcc Phase Transition Path Derived from Exact Lattice Summations over Inverse Power Law Potentials
articles.title_zh: 基于逆幂律势精确晶格求和推导的压致hcp-fcc相变路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the phase transition between hexagonal close-packed (hcp) and face-centered cubic (fcc) structures along the Burgers-Bain transformation path at pressures up to several hundred gigapascals. We consider a hierarchy of interatomic potentials, from (n,m)-Lennard-Jones potentials to extended Lennard-Jones two-body interactions in terms of inverse-power expansions and the Axilrod-Teller-Muto three-body term, alongside density functional theory (DFT) calculations for solid argon. For inverse-power potentials, free energies are evaluated through exact lattice sums and efficient integral representations based on generalizations of the Epstein zeta function to anisotropic interaction kernels, followed by lattice-parameter optimization. This methodology enables an accurate determination of the pressure-dependent Burgers-Bain minimum-energy path and the associated activation barrier for the phase transition. The transformation exhibits pronounced symmetry breaking connecting the Burgers and Bain paths, a feature confirmed by DFT calculations. At high pressure, the hcp-to-fcc activation barrier increases approximately linearly with pressure, owing to the dominant pressure-volume contribution. Including entropy and anharmonic effects yields excellent agreement with experimental temperature-dependent volumes up to the melting point. DFT results also highlight the increasing importance of many-body interactions under compression. Whereas two-body potentials predict that the path passes through the body-centered cubic (bcc) structure only at very high pressures, DFT generally predicts a pathway that bypasses bcc. The Axilrod-Teller-Muto term slightly reduces this discrepancy. Furthermore, DFT performs better at high pressures, where dispersion forces become less important.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在高达数百吉帕压力下，沿Burgers-Bain转变路径的密排六方(hcp)到面心立方(fcc)结构的相变。研究采用了一系列原子间势，并通过精确晶格求和与密度泛函理论计算，准确确定了压致Burgers-Bain最小能量路径及相变激活能垒。结果显示，该转变表现出显著的对称性破缺，且在高压下hcp-fcc激活能垒近似线性增加。
authors: Tage W. Maltby, Andres Robles-Navarro, Jonathan K. Hartlaub, Andreas A. Buchheit, Øivind Wilhelmsen, Morten Hammer, Peter Schwerdtfeger

articles.title: Inducing Extraordinary-log Criticality through a Quantum Spin Chain
articles.title_zh: 通过量子自旋链诱导超对数临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the emergence of extraordinary-log criticality in a quantum many-body system by coupling a spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain to a two-dimensional quantum critical Heisenberg bilayer. Under the quantum-to-classical mapping, the chain acts as a plane defect in a three-dimensional critical environment for which the extraordinary-log universality class has recently been predicted. Using large-scale sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we directly probe the renormalization-group flow of the effective defect coupling through the spin stiffness. We observe the characteristic logarithmic growth with linear system size L, corresponding to a stable weak-coupling fixed point and a running coupling g(L)sim 1/łog L. Furthermore, the extracted step-scaling function quantitatively follows the universal renormalization-group flow predicted for the extraordinary-log universality class, including the leading and subleading universal coefficients. Our results establish extraordinary-log criticality in a genuine quantum many-body setting and show that its universal behavior persists despite the topological θ-term present in the low-energy field theory of the isolated spin chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过将自旋-1/2海森堡链耦合到二维量子临界海森堡双层，展示了量子多体系统中超对数临界性的出现。研究利用大规模无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟，直接探测了有效缺陷耦合的重整化群流，观察到与系统尺寸L呈对数增长的特征行为。结果证实了超对数普适类的普遍重整化群流，从而在真实的量子多体环境中确立了超对数临界性。
authors: Grigorios Makris, Francesco Parisen Toldin, Stefan Wessel

articles.title: Statistics-controlled topological phases in a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger ladder
articles.title_zh: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger梯子中统计量控制的拓扑相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In strictly one-dimensional lattices, free fermions and hard-core bosons exhibit equivalent physical properties in many-particle systems. However, this statistical equivalence generally breaks down upon moving to higher dimensions. Our work investigates the significant effects of this difference on the topological phase transition in a minimal system lying away from one dimension: the two-leg Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) ladder. Starting in the limit of two decoupled SSH chains having opposite hopping dimerization patterns (staggered dimerization), we demonstrate that introducing inter-leg coupling drives a transition from a topological to a trivial phase for both spinless fermions and hard-core bosons. However, the topological to trivial phase transition boundary is strongly sensitive to the underlying particle statistics. We find that this intriguing effect favors a trivial phase sandwiched between the two topological phases with opposite characters for the case of hard-core bosons, resulting in a reentrant topological phase transition. In contrast, this reentrant phenomenon is absent for spinless fermions, with the topological phases being separated by a gapless line instead of an intervening trivial phase. This study demonstrates the interplay between particle statistics and topological features, revealing fundamentally different properties in an experimentally accessible set-up.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在二维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 梯子中，粒子统计量对拓扑相变的重要影响。研究发现，引入腿间耦合会使无自旋费米子和硬核玻色子从拓扑相转变为平庸相，但相变边界对粒子统计量高度敏感。对于硬核玻色子，这种效应导致一个平庸相夹在两个具有相反特征的拓扑相之间，从而产生重入拓扑相变，而无自旋费米子则没有此现象。
authors: Rajashri Parida, Biswajit Paul, Smitha Vishveshwara, Diptiman Sen, Tapan Mishra

articles.title: Topological Magnetism in 2D and 3D: Skyrmions and Hopfions. Classical and quantum approaches
articles.title_zh: 二维和三维拓扑磁性：斯格明子与霍普夫子。经典与量子方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss the properties of ferromagnetic skyrmions in relation to the Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction, nonlinear sigma models, merons, vortices, frustration, and dipole dipole interactions. Particular attention is given to skyrmion skyrmion interactions and to the dynamical equations governing magnetic textures, including the Landau Lifshitz Gilbert, Thiele, and Landau Lifshitz Bloch equations. The review subsequently extends the discussion to antiferromagnetic systems and to topological structures in three dimensions, with emphasis on Hopfions and their topological characterization. We then examine quantum skyrmions, including approaches that go beyond the semiclassical description, and discuss the emergence of quantum Hopfions. The theoretical framework is complemented by appendices presenting analytical solutions and ansatzes for skyrmions, spin coherent states and path integrals, quantum antiferromagnets, spin torques, fiber-bundle concepts and the Hopf map, and the Euler Lagrange formalism in three dimensions. By connecting continuum field theory, magnetic dynamics, topology, and quantum mechanics, this review aims to provide a coherent framework for understanding the formation, stability, dynamics, interactions, and quantum properties of topological magnetic textures across different dimensions and magnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论了铁磁斯格明子的性质及其与Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、非线性sigma模型等的关系，并特别关注斯格明子间的相互作用和磁畴动力学方程。随后，讨论扩展到反铁磁系统和三维拓扑结构，重点介绍了霍普夫子及其拓扑特征。文章还探讨了量子斯格明子和量子霍普夫子的出现，旨在通过连接连续场论、磁动力学、拓扑学和量子力学，提供一个全面的理论框架。
authors: ANtonio S T Pires

articles.title: Symmetry constraints on magnon-induced dynamics of skyrmion helicity in frustrated magnets
articles.title_zh: 磁振子诱导的受挫磁体中斯格明子螺旋性动力学的对称性约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The helicity of a magnetic skyrmion in a centrosymmetric frustrated magnet is a soft collective coordinate and a candidate variable for encoding quantum information. Its coherence is ultimately influenced by coupling to the magnon environment, which is commonly incorporated only phenomenologically. Here we combine a microscopic Keldysh treatment of the helicity--magnon coupling to resolve the contribution of individual magnon modes to the effective helicity dynamics. In the U(1)-symmetric model, the magnon bath generates, to leading order, a reactive helicity mass renormalization. When U(1) symmetry is broken, additional direct helicity--magnon couplings become allowed. In the presence of finite magnon lifetimes, these couplings generate an Ohmic contribution to the low-frequency helicity dynamics. The spatial symmetry of the perturbation determines which magnon sectors contribute to this damping, providing mode-resolved selection rules for the helicity--magnon coupling. Thus, we establish a microscopic connection between helicity dynamics and the excitation spectrum of frustrated skyrmions and identify the symmetry constraints governing dissipation of helicity-based quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过微观Keldysh方法研究了中心对称受挫磁体中磁斯格明子螺旋性与磁振子环境的耦合。研究发现，在U(1)对称模型中，磁振子浴主要产生螺旋性质量的重整化；而当U(1)对称性破缺时，额外的直接耦合会产生低频螺旋性动力学的欧姆贡献。扰动的空间对称性决定了哪些磁振子扇区对阻尼有贡献，从而建立了螺旋性动力学与受挫斯格明子激发谱之间的微观联系，并揭示了控制其动力学的对称性约束。
authors: Gabriel Mayor, Christina Psaroudaki

articles.title: Thermodynamic bound on the Fano factor of a coherent thermoelectric heat engine
articles.title_zh: 相干热电热机Fano因子的热力学界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11704v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that for fermionic coherent thermoelectric transport, selecting heat-engine operation yields a thermodynamic uncertainty relation for the charge current that imposes a universal lower limit of F > 1/2 on the corresponding Fano factor. We find that violations of the thermodynamic uncertainty relation for classical Markov processes, typically associated with a quantum advantage, are far more restricted for heat engines than what is allowed by a generic thermodynamic process. For bosonic and classical carriers, the minimum Fano factor increases to F > 1, and the thermodynamic uncertainty relation for classical Markov processes is never violated. We provide numerical evidence that all the obtained bounds are tight and can be saturated by properly designed transmissions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，对于费米子相干热电输运，热机操作会为电荷电流施加一个热力学不确定关系，从而对Fano因子F设定一个普遍的下限F > 1/2。研究发现，与一般热力学过程相比，热机中经典马尔可夫过程的热力学不确定关系违背现象受到更多限制。对于玻色子和经典载流子，最小Fano因子增加到F > 1，且经典马尔可夫过程的热力学不确定关系从未被违背。
authors: Nahual Sobrino, Rosario Fazio, Matteo Acciai

articles.title: Typical Superpositions are Magical
articles.title_zh: 典型叠加态是“魔法”的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-stabilizerness, or "magic", of a quantum state is a common metric for the hardness of simulation on a classical computer, and is often quantified by the stabilizer Rényi entropy (SRE). We show how random superpositions of classically simulable states saturate the SRE to the symmetry-restricted Haar-random maximum. For any large-N random pure-state ensemble satisfying the conditions of Schur's lemma, the average SRE of the m-component superposition łangle M₂₍ₘ₎ångle=N-łog₂[łangle W(m)ångle] is governed by an average witness łangle W(m)ångle that universally decomposes into a Haar floor and an ensemble-specific excess. As the number of components m increases, the excess is suppressed, resulting in a logarithmic scaling of the SRE before plateauing at the Haar-valued maximum. We derive a general closed form for łangle W(m)ångle in the thermodynamic limit, and numerically verify our result for random stabilizer states and random Gaussian states.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态的非稳定性（“魔法”）是衡量其在经典计算机上模拟难度的一个常用指标，通常用稳定器Rényi熵（SRE）量化。本文展示了经典可模拟态的随机叠加如何使SRE饱和到受对称性限制的Haar随机最大值。研究发现，随着叠加分量m的增加，SRE呈现对数标度增长，最终达到Haar值最大值，并推导了热力学极限下平均见证量W(m)的通用闭合形式。
authors: Joshuah T. Heath, Andrew Urilyon, Damien Quinn, Graham Kells

articles.title: Multi-Time States in Quantum and Operational Probabilistic Theories: An Axiomatic Framework
articles.title_zh: 量子与操作概率理论中的多时间态：一个公理化框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum states over time were introduced, in part, to extend Bayesian probability to quantum theory and have since found applications across diverse areas, ranging from quantum causality and open-system dynamics to tests of macroscopic realism. While axiomatic characterizations of these states exist for Markovian dynamics, a general framework accommodating non-Markovian dynamics is still lacking. Moreover, extending this framework beyond quantum mechanics to general physical theories also remains elusive. In this work, we develop an axiomatic framework for multi-time states within a class of operational probabilistic theories (OPTs) that includes quantum mechanics as a special case. Based on three assumptions---compositionality, reconstructibility, and spatio-temporal marginal consistency---the framework accommodates both Markovian and non-Markovian dynamics, and provides sufficient conditions to certify signaling and temporal memory within OPT. As a concrete application of our OPT framework, we fully characterize the unique multi-time state in boxworld and develop a method for Bayesian retrodiction of physical transformations there. Our general framework is consistent with quantum theory, reproducing several existing results. In the non-Markovian quantum dynamics, we establish a correspondence between multi-time states and the process-matrix framework, and fully characterize the multi-time states compatible with general dynamics. This correspondence also lets us infer quantum causal models from multi-time states, and as a proof of principle, we propose a semidefinite program to infer causal order from quantum multi-time states. These results provide a unified framework for studying spatio-temporal states, causal relations, and Bayesian reasoning within OPTs, with implications for both fundamental and applied research.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为操作概率理论（OPTs）中的多时间态开发了一个公理化框架，该框架将量子力学作为特例包含在内。基于组合性、可重构性和时空边缘一致性三个假设，该框架能够处理马尔可夫和非马尔可夫动力学，并提供了在OPT中验证信号和时间记忆的充分条件。作为具体应用，该工作完全刻画了盒世界中独特的多时间态，并开发了贝叶斯回溯物理变换的方法。
authors: Kaumudibikash Goswami, Archana Barvar, Manabendra Nath Bera

articles.title: Circuit Synthesis for Variational Quantum Algorithms: The Depth of Algebra and Geometry
articles.title_zh: 变分量子算法的电路合成：代数与几何的深度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22689v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The analysis of Hamiltonian Variational Ansätze centers on three fundamental questions: which states are exactly reachable from a given initial state, what native control depth suffices for local and global synthesis, and whether a bounded circuit extension can expose a direction of decreasing cost at a suboptimal output. We address these challenges by leveraging the dynamical Lie algebras (DLAs) associated with the circuits and the geometry of the initial state's orbit under the action of the corresponding dynamical Lie group G. We show that an initial state has a closed projective orbit whenever it is a nondegenerate eigenstate of a control Hamiltonian. Combined with asymptotic QAOA convergence, this guarantees exact, finite depth ground state preparation for architectures employing diagonal problem Hamiltonians and irreducible stoquastic mixers. We bound the number of native control exponentials required for local unitary synthesis and state preparation using DLA commutator filtration growth alongside reachable orbit dimensions. Complementing these local results, we construct global frameworks on invariant sectors equipped with full unitary or special unitary dynamical Lie algebras. These constructions yield explicit applications to Pauli-generated systems and constrained maximum independent set multi-angle QAOA circuits; specifically, we show that their native control costs are directly determined by commutator filtration depth and independent-set toggle-group geometry, respectively. Finally, if the dynamical Lie group is compact, the observable H_P generates an admissible evolution (iH_P in mathfrakg, where mathfrakg is the DLA), and the projective orbit of the initial state contains a ground state ray of H_P, then a bounded depth, identity-initialized circuit extension exhibits either first-order descent or negative curvature at every suboptimal circuit output.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用电路相关的动力学李代数（DLAs）和初始态在动力学李群G作用下的轨道几何，解决了哈密顿变分Ansätze分析中的三个核心问题。研究表明，当初始态是控制哈密顿量的非简并本征态时，它具有闭合的投影轨道。结合渐近QAOA收敛性，这保证了对角问题哈密顿量和不可约随机混合器架构的精确、有限深度基态制备。
authors: Boris Tsvelikhovskiy

articles.title: Quantum-Classical Neural Networks for Solving Lindblad Master Equations
articles.title_zh: 求解Lindblad主方程的量子-经典神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms have emerged as a promising approach for simulating open quantum systems, yet their expressive power and trainability remain poorly understood. We propose a variational framework for solving Lindblad master equations by minimizing a residual cost function using a compositional ansatz obtained by combining a classical neural network with a parameterized quantum circuit. The density matrix is represented through a purification on an enlarged Hilbert space, ensuring positivity, Hermiticity, and unit trace by construction, while all gradients are evaluated exactly via the parameter-shift rule. Beyond the algorithmic formulation, we derive an upper bound for the covering number of the proposed compositional model and compare it with that of purely quantum neural networks. Our analysis shows that the classical parametrization enlarges the effective hypothesis class while providing finer control over its complexity, thereby establishing a theoretical connection between expressivity, covering numbers, effective dimension, and the barren plateau phenomenon. Numerical experiments validate both the accuracy of the proposed method for representative Lindblad master equations and the theoretical predictions regarding gradient concentration. These results provide a unified variational and theoretical framework for the simulation of dissipative quantum dynamics using compositional quantum machine learning models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种变分框架，通过结合经典神经网络和参数化量子电路的组合Ansatz来求解Lindblad主方程。该方法通过在扩展希尔伯特空间上纯化表示密度矩阵，确保了其正定性、厄米性和单位迹。研究还推导了所提出组合模型的覆盖数上限，并发现经典参数化扩大了有效假设类，同时提供了对其复杂性的更精细控制，从而建立了表达能力、覆盖数、有效维度和贫瘠高原现象之间的理论联系。
authors: Rafael Florencio Díaz, Julio Guerrero García, Elvira Romera Gutiérrez

articles.title: Metric and Dispersive Dynamics of Phase Perturbations in Bohmian Quantum Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 玻姆量子力学中相扰动的度量和色散动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By linearizing the hydrodynamic equations associated with the Madelung transformation in the context of Bohmian dynamics, we derive an effective metric for the phase perturbation around a background state. We show that the metric previously obtained previously by the same authors arises naturally as a particular case of a more general structure, in which the complete functional variation of the quantum potential is retained and external classical potentials can be incorporated. This generalization preserves the dependence of the quantum potential on the density and its spatial derivatives, generating additional terms that introduce dispersive corrections and act as sources in the effective Klein-Gordon equation. To organize these contributions, we introduce differential operators that separate the local sector responsible for the effective geometry from the corrections associated with the complete functional structure of the quantum potential. We identify the conditions under which these additional terms become negligible, recovering homogeneous propagation and the effective geometry for the Gaussian wave packet of a free particle.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过线性化玻姆动力学中与Madelung变换相关的流体动力学方程，推导了背景态周围相扰动的有效度量。研究表明，先前获得的度量是更一般结构的一个特例，该推广保留了量子势对密度及其空间导数的依赖性，引入了色散修正项。通过引入微分算子，该工作分离了负责有效几何的局部部分和与量子势完整泛函结构相关的修正，并确定了这些附加项可忽略的条件。
authors: Felipe S. Escórcio, Hermano Velten

articles.title: The Classical Boundary of Quantum Computation: History-Resolved Causal Stochastic Machines and the Cost of Classicalization
articles.title_zh: 量子计算的经典边界：历史解析因果随机机器与经典化成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22750v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: What separates quantum computation from classical computation when a classical model may retain every branch history and arbitrary causal memory? We study this question using history-resolved causal stochastic machines (HCSMs), which describe positive causal history laws. Probabilistic Turing machines (PTMs) embed in stochastic-ensemble models (SEnMs), which in turn embed in HCSMs. We prove that HCSM history laws coincide exactly with the fixed-basis, prefix-preserving diagonal sector of ideal quantum processes, denoted by mathsfPTMₘ̊ ₚᵣₒc and distinguished here from algorithmic quantum Turing machines (QTMs). Coherent quantum processes extend strictly beyond this sector. The boundary is already visible in reversibility. Born-probability shadows of unitary gates preserve inverse composition exactly for basis permutations with phases. Outside this class, an exact positive stochastic simulation that supports universal quantum continuations must retain predictive information absent from visible probabilities. An inverse-recovery identity quantifies this phase ledger, and universal continuation forces the retained probability law to be tomographically sufficient for the quantum state. Under continuous full-state encoding assumptions, this requirement yields quantum-state dimension lower bounds. The familiar slogan mathsfPTMsubseteqmathsfQTM is thereby sharpened into a precise classical boundary and a no-free-classicalization principle. Complete classical branching does not remove the predictive information needed to represent quantum coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用历史解析因果随机机器（HCSM）研究了量子计算与经典计算之间的界限，即使经典模型保留了所有分支历史和任意因果记忆。研究证明HCSM历史定律与理想量子过程的固定基、前缀保留对角扇区精确吻合，而相干量子过程则严格超越此扇区。该边界在可逆性中已显现，并通过逆恢复恒等式量化了相位账本，揭示了通用延续所需的预测信息。
authors: Kyoungho Cho, Junghee Ryu, Minsu Kim, Jeongho Bang

articles.title: Quantumness of Entanglement in Schwarzschild de Sitter Spacetime
articles.title_zh: 史瓦西-德西特时空中纠缠的量子性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate genuine multipartite entanglement and genuine tripartite nonlocality of a noisy generalized GHZ state in Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime. The genuine multipartite concurrence and optimized Svetlichny parameter are employed to characterize these two quantum correlations. It is shown that the black hole and cosmological event horizons redistribute genuine multipartite entanglement differently among the physically accessible and inaccessible reduced states, while Svetlichny violation occurs only in the physically accessible state. We find that genuine multipartite entanglement can survive in the physically inaccessible states even when genuine tripartite nonlocality is absent. In addition, initial white noise suppresses both correlations, with Svetlichny nonlocality surviving over a narrower parameter region. Furthermore, in the Nariai limit, under the normalization adopted here, the correlations become concentrated in the physically accessible state. These results demonstrate the different robustness of genuine multipartite entanglement and genuine tripartite nonlocality under horizon effects and initial noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了史瓦西-德西特时空中含噪声广义GHZ态的真实多体纠缠和真实三体非局域性。结果表明，黑洞和宇宙事件视界以不同方式重新分配了可访问和不可访问约化态之间的真实多体纠缠，而Svetlichny非局域性仅出现在可访问态中。即使真实三体非局域性缺失，真实多体纠缠仍可在不可访问态中存活。此外，初始白噪声会抑制这两种关联，且在Nariai极限下，关联集中于可访问态。
authors: Sumeng Wang, Xiaofen Huang

articles.title: On the relationship between the POVM framework and the no-signaling hypothesis
articles.title_zh: 关于POVM框架与无信号假设之间的关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum foundations literature contains dozens of "no-signaling" arguments that rely on the Born rule or, more generally, the positive operator-valued measure (POVM) framework to show that the resources of non-relativistic quantum mechanics (NRQM) cannot be used to send superluminal signals. What these arguments typically establish, however, is not a prohibition on superluminal signaling per se, but the seemingly stronger claim that signaling at any speed between mutually isolated systems is forbidden. This paper gives a precise formulation of this claim, the no-signaling hypothesis, and investigates the following converse question: under what additional assumptions does it imply that all experimental outcome probabilities are described by POVMs? Surprisingly few are needed: given the standard NRQM representation of composite experiments and two textbook claims about marginal probabilities, the no-signaling hypothesis is equivalent to the universality of the POVM framework. More broadly, by formalizing the relevant concepts and deriving the logical relationships between them, the paper shows that the no-signaling hypothesis can be used to derive most, though not all, of the probability-generating fragment of NRQM. The resulting map of implications clarifies which common postulates of NRQM are logically interrelated and which can be modified independently.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子基础文献中关于“无信号”的论证，这些论证通常表明非相对论量子力学资源无法发送超光速信号，甚至禁止孤立系统间任何速度的信号传输。文章精确阐述了无信号假设，并反向探究了在何种附加假设下，该假设能推出所有实验结果概率均由POVM描述。研究发现，在标准非相对论量子力学表示和两个关于边际概率的教科书结论下，无信号假设等价于POVM框架的普适性。
authors: Will Cavendish

articles.title: Quantum approximate stochastic combinatorial optimisation
articles.title_zh: 量子近似随机组合优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-stage stochastic combinatorial optimisation concerns discrete decisions made before all relevant information is known. An initial decision is made; once uncertainty is resolved, it can be adapted to the realised scenario, at a cost. The aim is to find the initial decision that minimises the upfront cost plus the expected cost of optimal adaptation. The first-stage decision problem is often NP-hard, and computing the expected minimum recourse cost can be #P-hard for a single first-stage candidate. We introduce Quantum Approximate Stochastic Combinatorial Optimisation (QASCO), a variational quantum-walk ansatz that coherently incorporates scenario-dependent recourse into its dynamics to search over first-stage decisions without explicitly evaluating expected minimum recourse costs. We demonstrate QASCO for MaxCut with stochastic edge weights, obtain a circuit with polynomial per-layer gate complexity, and study the ansatz via exact state-vector simulation. Across the instances considered, QASCO concentrates amplitude more effectively on stochastic-optimal first-stage decisions than a previously proposed two-stage QAOA construction. We further show that the ansatz can be calibrated using a depth-independent number of parameters and applied to unseen instances without further circuit-parameter optimisation, including joint decision--scenario--recourse spaces spanning more than 2³² configurations. Under a query-cost model, comparison with the tested classical heuristics using sample-average approximations of the expected minimum recourse cost shows that QASCO more reliably reaches globally optimal first-stage solutions while requiring fewer cut evaluations. These results show how to incorporate scenario-dependent recourse into the ansatz dynamics, providing a general framework for variational quantum walks in two-stage stochastic combinatorial optimisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对两阶段随机组合优化问题，其中初始决策在所有信息未知前做出，并可根据后续不确定性进行调整。我们引入了量子近似随机组合优化（QASCO），这是一种变分量子游走拟设，它将依赖于场景的追索权相干地融入其动力学中，以搜索第一阶段决策，而无需显式评估预期的最小追索成本。通过对具有随机边权重的MaxCut问题进行演示，QASCO比现有QAOA方法能更有效地将振幅集中在随机最优的第一阶段决策上。
authors: Edric Matwiejew, Paulo E. Santos, Jingbo B. Wang, Ugo Varetto

articles.title: Quantum-Assisted Unambiguous Discrimination of Pure States with Robustness Bounds
articles.title_zh: 具有鲁棒性界限的量子辅助纯态无歧义判别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a hybrid quantum-classical framework for the unambiguous discrimination of pure states by combining the noisy intermediate-scale quantum semidefinite program solver (NSS) with the reciprocal-state representation. In NSS, a given semidefinite program (SDP) is represented within a subspace spanned by chosen ansatz states, with the required quantities estimated using quantum circuits, and the resulting optimization is performed classically. This makes NSS naturally applicable to discrimination problems involving circuit-prepared states, as finding a discrimination measurement can be formulated as an SDP. By choosing the discriminated states themselves as the ansatz and exploiting the reciprocal-state representation, the general matrix-variable NSS formulation is reduced to an optimization over N scalar variables, where N is the number of discriminated states. The resulting formulation reduces the number of optimization variables and positive-semidefinite constraints compared with the original NSS formulation. We further establish robustness guarantees against Gram matrix estimation errors, including a rescaling procedure that guarantees a valid positive operator-valued measure (POVM) under bounded perturbations. The resulting bounds quantify both the deviation in average success probability and violations of the no-error condition using only the estimated Gram matrix, its SDP solution, and a characterized perturbation bound, without access to the ideal Gram matrix. Numerical simulations validate the derived robustness bounds and characterize finite-shot scaling. We also perform experiments on IBM quantum hardware to estimate pairwise overlaps, and then evaluate the performance of the resulting POVMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种混合量子-经典框架，通过结合噪声中等规模量子半定规划求解器（NSS）和互易态表示，实现纯态的无歧义判别。在NSS中，半定规划问题在选定拟设态张成的子空间中表示，所需量通过量子电路估计，优化则在经典计算机上执行。通过选择被判别态作为拟设并利用互易态表示，将通用矩阵变量NSS公式简化为对N个标量变量的优化，并建立了针对格拉姆矩阵估计误差的鲁棒性保证。
authors: Jinhyeok Heo, Dongkeun Lee, Junghee Ryu, Minjin Choi

articles.title: Encodings and Node Architecture: Lessons from the Fault-Tolerant Distributed Transversal Fanout
articles.title_zh: 编码与节点架构：容错分布式横向扇出操作的经验教训
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An encoding choice specifies the quantum error-correcting code used to encode logical qubits at a given node. Different encoding choices may differ in the number of physical qubits, the number of encoded logical qubits, the code distance, and the available fault-tolerant operations. We study different encodings for a distributed transversal fanout operation and look at its implications on node architecture. Our experiments suggest that an encoding with higher distance, even if requiring more ebits, can yield a lower logical error rate for distributed operations, and that ``upgrading'' an encoding prior to distributed operations and having a cache, as part of node architecture, for qubits can be useful for distributed operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子纠错码的不同编码选择及其对节点架构的影响，特别是在分布式横向扇出操作中的应用。实验结果表明，即使需要更多e比特，具有更高距离的编码也能为分布式操作带来更低的逻辑错误率。此外，在执行分布式操作之前“升级”编码以及在节点架构中设置量子比特缓存，对分布式操作可能是有益的。
authors: Seng W. Loke

articles.title: Quantum Tsallis Entropy Estimation: Near-Optimal Bounds and High-Precision Improvements
articles.title_zh: 量子Tsallis熵估计：近最优界限与高精度改进
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating statistical properties of probability distributions is a fundamental problem in statistics and theoretical computer science. We develop quantum algorithms for estimating the q-Tsallis entropy H_qTsa(P) =fracsumᵢ₌₁ⁿ pᵢ^q-11-q when 0 <1, given purified quantum query access to a distribution P on [n]. When 0 <1, we introduce a two-stage simultaneous probability estimation procedure, yielding a quantum algorithm with query complexity widetildeOłeft(fracnfrac¹²⁺frac¹²qǎrepsilonfrac¹²q+fracn¹⁻qǎrepsiloni̊ght), which improves the result given by Chen et al. (ICALP 2026) when ǎrepsilon=Ob̊ran¹⁻²q.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文致力于估计概率分布的统计特性这一基本问题，并开发了量子算法来估计当0 < q < 1时，给定对[n]上分布P的纯化量子查询访问下的q-Tsallis熵H_qTsa(P)。我们引入了一种两阶段同步概率估计过程，从而得到了一种量子算法，其查询复杂度在特定误差范围内相较于现有工作有所改进。
authors: Chengshen Gao, Zongxing Xiong, Lvzhou Li

articles.title: Discrete time crystals and classical logic gates in coupled open Dicke models
articles.title_zh: 耦合开放Dicke模型中的离散时间晶体与经典逻辑门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the dynamics of coupled discrete time crystals (DTCs) in the coupled Dicke model or Dicke dimer (DD) with dissipation. By numerically simulating the mean-field dynamics of the system, we show that coupling two DTCs decreases their oscillation amplitude following a transient relaxation period. For sufficiently strong coupling, the coupled DTCs become unstable, resulting in the system relaxing towards the normal phase (NP). We demonstrate that the relaxation time diverges near the critical coupling strength, suggesting a continuous phase transition. Using the truncated Wigner approximation (TWA), we explore how the dynamics are affected by the introduction of quantum fluctuations. We also consider a scenario in which an NP is briefly coupled to a DTC, seeding the NP to transform into a DTC that is either synchronized or anti-synchronized relative to the DTC. We investigate the robustness of this phenomenon in the presence of noise. Using these results, we propose a scheme to perform NAND and NOR operations with three DTCs by sequentially coupling the input and output sites. We identify the parameter regimes in which the logic gate architecture remains valid, and investigate how the protocol is affected by the presence of quantum fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了耗散耦合Dicke模型（Dicke二聚体）中耦合离散时间晶体（DTCs）的动力学。数值模拟表明，DTCs的耦合会降低其振荡幅度，强耦合会导致系统不稳定并弛豫到正常相。弛豫时间在临界耦合强度附近发散，预示着连续相变。基于这些结果，我们提出了一种通过顺序耦合输入和输出站点，利用三个DTCs执行NAND和NOR操作的方案。
authors: Emmanuel D. G. U, Roy D. Jara Jr., Jayson G. Cosme

articles.title: Sample-Based Quantum Linear Solver and Bounds on Krylov-State Sampling
articles.title_zh: 基于采样的量子线性求解器与Krylov态采样的界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To solve linear systems Ax=b, we propose a sample-based quantum linear solver combining quantum Krylov-state sampling with classical variational diagonalization. Rather than simulating the cost Hamiltonian H_b(A)=A^dagger(I-|bånglełangle b|)A, we measure quantum Krylov states e⁻ⁱAT|bångle generated by the original Hermitian operator A in the computational basis. We then classically diagonalize the projected cost Hamiltonian to reconstruct an approximate solution. Using a representation of A⁻¹|bångle as a linear combination of quantum Krylov states, we derive lower bounds on computational-basis sampling probabilities from solution amplitudes. We establish support-discovery guarantees for finite nonnegative-time grid sampling and signed-time sampling, which permits both positive and negative evolution times. The former bounds the maximum evolution time, whereas the latter improves ideal shot complexity at the cost of occasional long evolutions. For a condition-number bound κ on A, a lower bound β_L on the solution probability weight of each of L target basis states, and failure probability δ, signed-time sampling achieves O(κ²β_L⁻¹łog(L/δ)) shots, matching a worst-case lower bound up to constants within an evolution-only observation model in a specified parameter regime. Finally, we analyze the effects of finite-length qDRIFT compilation and circuit reuse on sampling and derive an infidelity bound for the reconstructed solution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于采样的量子线性求解器，它结合了量子Krylov态采样与经典变分对角化来解决线性系统Ax=b。该方法通过在计算基下测量由原始厄米算符A生成的量子Krylov态，然后经典对角化投影的代价哈密顿量来重构近似解。我们推导了从解振幅到计算基采样概率的下界，并为有限非负时间网格采样和带符号时间采样建立了支持发现保证。
authors: Byeongyong Park, Keunhong Jeong, Doyeol Ahn

articles.title: Controlled PROP: Theory and Applications to Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 受控PROP：理论及其在量子电路中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control is a fundamental concept in quantum and reversible computational models. It enables the conditional application of a transformation to a system, depending on the state of another system. We introduce a general framework for diagrammatic reasoning featuring control as a constructor. To this end, we provide an elementary axiomatization of control functors, extending the standard formalism of PROPs to controlled PROPs. As an application, we show that controlled PROPs facilitate diagrammatic reasoning for quantum circuits. In particular, they admit a simple and complete axiomatization involving at most three qubits, whereas in the standard PROP setting, completeness necessarily requires axioms involving arbitrarily many qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一个以控制作为构造器的图示推理通用框架，将标准PROP形式主义扩展到受控PROP。我们提供了控制函子的基本公理化。作为应用，研究表明受控PROP有助于量子电路的图示推理，它允许一个简单且完备的公理化，最多涉及三个量子比特，这与标准PROP设置中需要任意数量量子比特才能实现完备性形成对比。
authors: Noé Delorme, Simon Perdrix

articles.title: Learning angles for quantum approximate optimization
articles.title_zh: 量子近似优化算法的角度学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) and its variants are leading algorithms to help solve challenging combinatorial optimization problems. QAOA maps these problems to Ising Hamiltonians such that their ground state is the desired solution. Candidate solutions are then drawn from a variational quantum circuit. The performance of QAOA hinges on a set of variational angles. However, finding good angles is an instance-specific and computationally expensive non-convex classical optimization task. Here, we learn the mapping from the problem instance to high-quality QAOA angles. Our learned models replace the per-instance optimization, that we call the solver, with a single forward pass that is several orders of magnitude faster than the solver with a near identical quality. Our models further generalize to unseen topologies such as Barabási-Albert and 2D grid graphs. Experiments on quantum hardware confirm that QAOA samples with angles produced by our open-source models are indistinguishable from solver angles. Crucially, models sensitive to the topology of the problem instance increase the quality of the QAOA angles. Our work amortizes a major bottleneck in QAOA by an up-front data generation and training cost. Importantly, this cost can be amortized over time in settings where many similar problems are optimized on a regular basis, as is often the case in applications for industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的性能高度依赖于变分角度，而寻找这些角度是一个计算成本高昂且实例特定的非凸优化任务。本文提出学习从问题实例到高质量QAOA角度的映射，使学习模型能够以远快于传统求解器的方式生成角度，且质量几乎相同。这些模型还能泛化到未见的拓扑结构，量子硬件实验证实其生成的QAOA样本与求解器角度的样本无异。
authors: Johannes Jakubik, Isabelle Wittmann, Zaheed Gaffoor, Gciniwe Simphiwe Baloyi, Craig Mahlasi, Etienne Vos, Thomas Brunschwiler, Daniel J. Egger

articles.title: SpinControl: Control Software for Prototyping and Benchmarking of Spin-Qubit Devices and Measurement Protocols
articles.title_zh: SpinControl：用于自旋量子比特器件和测量协议原型设计与基准测试的控制软件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computers require software to control the states of the qubits. As the actions on qubits grow in complexity with circuit execution, calibration, and benchmarking, the complexity of the control software grows in tandem. Spin-qubit quantum computers are at a stage where experimentalists need low-level access for tuning and calibration, and quantum algorithm researchers want high-level circuit-level access. In this article, we present the software design of SpinControl. SpinControl integrates three architectural metrics: 1) customizability, to allow prototyping devices and measurement protocols, is achieved by separating data and behaviour; 2) modularity and extensibility are achieved by separating functionalities into different components; and 3) robustness, to reliably execute quantum circuits on many qubits, is achieved by CI pipelines and input validation. SpinControl allows different types of measurements while customizing the instruments used, the pulse or circuit program executed, and the data processing. It allows building standardized experiments from measurement and analysis building blocks and executing these for calibration in a custom and conditional order. SpinControl implements these functionalities alongside robust configuration and data management, a connection to the cloud, and calibration scheduling. Pulse and circuit compilation, virtual gate matrices, as well as spin-qubit-specific GUIs integrated by SpinControl, make heavy use of software packages developed by Delft University of Technology: pulse lib, core-tools (both open source), and QConstruct
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机需要复杂的软件来控制量子比特状态、校准和基准测试。本文介绍了SpinControl的软件设计，该设计集成了可定制性、模块化和鲁棒性。SpinControl通过分离数据与行为实现设备和测量协议的原型设计，通过分离功能实现模块化和可扩展性，并通过CI管道和输入验证确保鲁棒性。它允许定制仪器、脉冲或电路程序以及数据处理，从而能够从构建块中构建标准化实验。
authors: Harold B. Meerwaldt, Daniël P. van der Velde, Pieter T. Eendebak, Michiel J. Haye

articles.title: Bell scenarios encode classical non-causality
articles.title_zh: 贝尔情景编码经典非因果性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bell and contextuality scenarios are unified within the Acín-Fritz-Leverrier-Sainz hypergraph formalism, in which measurements are hyperedges. Multipartite measurements are obtained from product rules that combine independent contextuality scenarios into a single hypergraph. Several such rules exist: they are structurally distinct, yet yield the same classical, quantum, and boxworld correlations. Here, we show that this difference is not incidental, unveiling an unexpected connection. The measurements of composite Bell scenarios are exactly the process functions, the deterministic classical communication protocols that may be non-causal, i.e., lack a definite causal order without generating paradoxes. Validity of a hyperedge and logical consistency of a process function are thus one and the same condition. This allows us to characterize process functions by normalization and no-signaling alone, providing transformations that generate non-causal process functions from no-communication ones. The product rules, in turn, order process functions by causal structure, from no-communication to non-causality, which yields a graphical criterion for the latter: a process function is non-causal precisely when its hyperedge is generated by the disjunctive but not the maximal product. We thereby obtain the first joint hypergraph representation of (non-causal) process functions and (nonlocal-without-entanglement) measurements, recasting classical non-causality as a non-standard way of composing black boxes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在Acín-Fritz-Leverrier-Sainz超图形式主义下统一了贝尔和语境性情景，其中测量被视为超边。研究发现，复合贝尔情景的测量恰好是非因果的确定性经典通信协议，即过程函数。超边的有效性与过程函数的逻辑一致性是同一条件，这使得仅通过归一化和无信号条件即可表征过程函数。该工作揭示了复合贝尔情景与非因果过程函数之间的深层联系，并提供了从无通信协议生成非因果过程函数的方法。
authors: Andreas Leitherer, Kyrylo Simonov, Ravi Kunjwal, Antonio Acín, Kuntal Sengupta, Hippolyte Dourdent

articles.title: Resonance crossings and diabolical points for DC electric field quantum sensors
articles.title_zh: 直流电场量子传感器的共振交叉与魔鬼点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the 1990s, experiments on double-well heterostructures have highlighted a key phenomenon: applying an external DC electric field induces pronounced wave packet oscillations at specific field strengths.  To gain a deeper insight into this effect, a comprehensive quantitative analysis of the properties of quantum resonances near a crossing point is required.  This approach lays the theoretical foundation for devising a quantum sensor capable of rapidly and efficiently determining whether the strength of an external DC electric field lies within a narrow target range.
articles.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，双阱异质结构实验揭示了直流电场在特定场强下能诱导显著波包振荡的现象。为深入理解此效应，本文对交叉点附近量子共振特性进行了全面的定量分析。该研究为设计一种量子传感器奠定了理论基础，该传感器能够快速高效地判断外部直流电场强度是否处于狭窄的目标范围内。
authors: Andrea Sacchetti

articles.title: Cayley access models for matrix functions: reachable class and cost
articles.title_zh: 矩阵函数的凯莱访问模型：可达类别与成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how to compute f(A)b on a quantum computer, where A is Hermitian. When f is nonsmooth or has localized difficulty in the spectrum, classical numerical linear algebra approximates it with rational functions rather than polynomials. We propose the Cayley transform, parameterized by σ in R and γ > 0, as an alternative to the standard quantum access model. The two parameters let one concentrate accuracy where f is difficult, which standard models can achieve only by raising the polynomial degree globally. This transformation converts Hermitian matrices to unitaries, allowing generalized quantum signal processing to apply Laurent polynomials bounded on the unit circle. We compare three access models (block encoding, matrix exponential, and Cayley encoding) in terms of query complexity and of the cost of their circuit realization. When the difficulty of f is localized in the spectrum, the Cayley encoding reduces the required degree by a factor of three to four, and it represents the shifted resolvent exactly at degree one. For spectral projectors, the standard models cannot reach the target accuracy at fixed degree, because their approximants cannot concentrate resolution near the discontinuity. Realizing the Cayley encoding from a block encoding requires solving a shifted linear system, whose cost offsets its query-complexity gain over the standard models. For structured matrices arising in practice, however, low-depth circuits for the encoding can be constructed directly, and the gain is preserved at the circuit level.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在量子计算机上计算厄米矩阵函数f(A)b的方法，特别针对函数f在谱中存在非光滑或局部困难的情况。作者提出了一种由参数σ和γ控制的凯莱变换作为标准量子访问模型的替代方案，该变换允许在函数困难区域集中精度。研究结果表明，当函数f的困难性局限于谱时，凯莱编码能将所需度数降低三到四倍，并且在度数为一时精确表示移位预解式。
authors: Gianna M. Del Corso

articles.title: Solving Large-Scale Parameter Inference in Controllable Nuclear Fusion via Coherent Ising Machines and Block Coordinate Descent
articles.title_zh: 通过相干伊辛机和分块坐标下降解决可控核聚变中的大规模参数推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian inference enables self-consistent plasma parameter inversion in tokamak integrated data analysis by fusing multi-source diagnostics. However, under nonlinear Gaussian likelihoods, finding the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate typically relies on sampling methods whose high computational overhead precludes real-time plasma control. To address this bottleneck, we propose a Bayesian inversion framework using a Coherent Ising Machine (CIM)-a quantum computing architecture based on coupled degenerate optical parametric oscillators (DOPOs). With native all-to-all connectivity, the CIM directly maps the negative log-posterior potential onto a spin Hamiltonian and leverages quantum vacuum fluctuations for rapid state-space search during pitchfork bifurcation. Validated on plasma current profile inversion for the EAST tokamak, this method achieves a single-run solution time of approximately 1 ms. Although current qubit limits necessitate a block-wise iterative scheme that prevents full real-time execution today, rapidly scaling quantum hardware offers a clear pathway toward real-time tokamak control.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝叶斯推断在托卡马克集成数据分析中实现了等离子体参数的自洽反演，但传统采样方法计算开销大，难以实现实时控制。本文提出了一种基于相干伊辛机（CIM）的贝叶斯反演框架，将负对数后验势映射到自旋哈密顿量，并利用量子真空涨落进行快速搜索。在EAST托卡马克等离子体电流剖面反演上的验证显示，该方法单次运行求解时间约为1毫秒。尽管当前量子比特限制需要分块迭代方案，但快速发展的量子硬件为实现实时托卡马克控制提供了明确途径。
authors: Zijie Liu, Wenchao Liu, Wenxin Li, Anzhe Jiang, Hongdong Zhu, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Hai Wei, Yao Huang, Yuehang Wang, Kai Wen, Jiangang Li

articles.title: Electrostatic Limits on Quantum Spatial Search
articles.title_zh: 量子空间搜索的静电学限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that a quantum walker cannot search a two-dimensional lattice in Grover's O(sqrt N) time, resolving the long-standing open question posed by Aaronson and Ambainis in 2003. A walker that hops between neighbouring sites of an L× L lattice, N=L², needs Ømega(sqrtNłog N) local steps at least to find a marked vertex, even with unlimited memory and free queries. Hence, Tulsi's algorithm is asymptotically optimal. Our proof rests on a surprising correspondence with classical electrostatics. We treat the marked vertex as a point charge and weight the overlap between the walker's states with and without the mark by the potential drop, which vanishes where queries act. Only local steps change this weighted overlap, at a rate limited by the field energy, so the lower bound is set by the self-potential of the charge. In the plane this self-potential grows logarithmically with system size, like the Coulomb potential, leading to the extra root-logarithmic factor. Several marked vertices turn the charge into a conductor, and the lower bound depends on their arrangement through its capacitance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了量子行走者无法在二维格子上以Grover的O(sqrt N)时间进行搜索，解决了Aaronson和Ambainis在2003年提出的长期开放问题。在L×L格子上，即使拥有无限内存和免费查询，寻找一个标记顶点至少需要Ω(sqrtN log N)的局部步数。这一证明基于与经典静电学的惊人对应关系，将标记顶点视为点电荷。研究结果表明，Tulsi的算法在渐近意义上是最优的。
authors: Weikang Li

articles.title: Partially isophase electro-magnetic configurations
articles.title_zh: 部分等相电磁配置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Separation of variables in Schrödinger equation allows an infinite-dimensional family of physically distinct field configurations that are dynamically indistinguishable in one selected sector, labeled by a conserved quantum number, while differing in all others. We call such a symmetry a partial isophase symmetry. Two main examples are considered: axially symmetric magnetic backgrounds (a rigid spectral flow of the Fock--Darwin oscillator, purely magnetic isophase families, and a two-channel extension) and a Cartesian slab geometry (magnetic barriers in two-dimensional electron gases, treated in the Appendices). We further discuss the consequences of this symmetry for the inverse spectral problem and consider its quasiclassical counterpart.
articles.abstract_zh: 薛定谔方程中的变量分离揭示了一类无限维的物理上不同但在一个选定扇区（由守恒量子数标记）中动力学上无法区分的场配置，作者称之为部分等相对称性。本文探讨了轴对称磁背景和笛卡尔平板几何中的主要例子。研究进一步讨论了这种对称性对逆谱问题的影响，并考虑了其准经典对应物。
authors: Andrey M. Pupasov-Maksimov

articles.title: Delta-sigma noise shaping for low-resolution quantization in Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 高斯调制连续变量量子密钥分发中低分辨率量化的Delta-Sigma噪声整形
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-resolution digital-to-analog conversion can simplify continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CVQKD) transmitters, but coarse quantization increases excess noise and can generate data-correlated spectral replicas. We demonstrate digital delta--sigma modulation (DSM) for low-resolution waveform generation in Gaussian-modulated CVQKD. In a 500-MBaud CVQKD system over 20~km of fiber, 3-bit second-order DSM achieves an estimated asymptotic secret key rate of 46.38~Mbps at an oversampling ratio of 12, whereas uniform quantization yields no positive rate. With 4-bit second-order DSM, the rate reaches 50.11~Mbps, approximately 97% of the 12-bit reference. A noise model combining the DSM noise-transfer function with matched filtering guides the sampling-rate and signal-band design for effective noise suppression. We also identify a phase-conjugate spectral replica arising from third-order intermodulation between the pilot tone and quantum signal, and evaluate its key-rate penalty using a linear-replica security model. At 3-bit resolution and an oversampling ratio of 24, first-order DSM reduces the experimentally estimated leakage-mode strength by approximately four orders of magnitude. Together, our findings establish the security boundaries and operating conditions of DSM, providing design guidance for low-resolution CVQKD transmitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 低分辨率数模转换可简化连续变量量子密钥分发（CVQKD）发射机，但粗量化会增加额外噪声。本文展示了在500-MBaud、20公里光纤的CVQKD系统中，数字Delta-Sigma调制（DSM）用于低分辨率波形生成。结果显示，3比特二阶DSM在过采样率为12时可实现46.38 Mbps的渐近秘密密钥率，而均匀量化无法产生正速率。该研究还识别了由导频音和量子信号三阶互调引起的相位共轭谱副本，并评估了其对密钥率的影响。
authors: Wenjun Fan, Zhenlin Zhao, Dawei Wang

articles.title: Expressivity of IQP Feature-Map Quantum Kernels via Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
articles.title_zh: 基于再生核希尔伯特空间的IQP特征映射量子核的表达能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum kernels are among the most promising methods in quantum machine learning, providing a natural way to embed data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces via quantum circuits and capturing non-linear relationships in data. Their learning behaviour is governed by the function class they represent, which is formally characterized by the structure of the associated Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). However, a theoretical characterization of this function class, and of how it depends on the choice of feature map and its hyperparameters, is still lacking. In this work, we focus on the Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) feature map and derive a Fourier representation of the associated RKHS generators as finite sums of trigonometric functions evaluated on polynomially transformed input variables, with a finite set of accessible frequencies determined by the circuit construction and scaled by the bandwidth hyperparameter. This representation identifies three bandwidth regimes with qualitatively distinct expressive properties from localised, through multimodal, to periodic. Numerical experiments on synthetic datasets with controlled periodic and multimodal structure, across data dimensions and feature-map configurations, reproduce the three regimes in both supervised classification and unsupervised anomaly detection, benchmarked against a classical Gaussian kernel. These results make the relationship between expressivity and data structure explicit for IQP kernels: expressive power translates into a practical benefit only when the accessible frequencies match with the structure of the data, which provides a criterion for selecting the bandwidth when the periodic or multimodal structure of data is known.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子核是量子机器学习中的重要方法，但其表达能力及其与特征映射和超参数的依赖关系尚缺乏理论表征。本文专注于瞬时量子多项式（IQP）特征映射，并推导了其关联再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）生成器的傅里叶表示。该表示揭示了三种带宽机制，它们具有从局部到多模态再到周期性的定性不同的表达特性。数值实验进一步验证了这些理论发现。
authors: Valeria Repetto, Stefano Melchionna, Romina D'Aurizio

articles.title: Recursive Operator Localization and Spectral Gap Descent via the Geometry of Local Spectral Expansion
articles.title_zh: 基于局部谱展开几何的递归算子局域化与谱隙下降
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Recursive Operator Localization (ROL), a framework for constructing hierarchies of local energy problems linked by linear maps between Hilbert spaces. To address spectral-gap problems, including those arising in quantum systems, we study a realization of ROL by nested subspaces indexed by a weighted simplicial complex. Using spectral gaps of auxiliary classical random walks on links, we propagate geometric estimates upward and use them to turn local spectral gaps at the bottom of the hierarchy into a spectral-gap bound for the global operator. For weighted scalar-valued functions on facets, the ROL decomposition becomes the law of total variance, recovering classical spectral-gap bounds from local link expansion (Alev and Lau, STOC 2020). Moreover, for positive binary spin distributions, conditional influence describes the overlap of the corresponding subspaces, yielding known heat-bath gap bounds from spectral independence (Anari, Liu, and Oveis Gharan, FOCS 2020). The framework also offers a route toward quantum Gibbs sampling, with applications requiring model-specific geometric estimates and energy comparisons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了递归算子局域化（ROL）框架，用于构建通过希尔伯特空间之间线性映射连接的局部能量问题层次结构。为解决量子系统中的谱隙问题，研究通过加权单纯复形索引的嵌套子空间实现了ROL。该框架利用辅助经典随机游走的谱隙，将局部谱隙转化为全局算子的谱隙界限。ROL分解在特定条件下恢复了经典谱隙界限，并为量子吉布斯采样提供了新途径。
authors: Ryu Hayakawa

articles.title: Quality-of-Transmission Estimation in Quantum Networks: Compute, Simulate, or Learn?
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中的传输质量估计：计算、模拟还是学习？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Future quantum networks will rely on control-plane decisions such as routing, scheduling, entanglement provisioning, purification, and memory allocation. Each decision depends on a timely and reliable estimate of the quality of the entanglement that a candidate path can deliver, with end-to-end fidelity as a central metric. Inspired by the optical-networking experience with quality-of-transmission (QoT) estimation, this article asks when a quantum controller should compute fidelity analytically, simulate it, or learn a surrogate model. The optical analogy is useful but incomplete: optical QoT estimation often predicts a scalar transmission margin, whereas quantum QoT estimation must account for probabilistic entanglement generation, random memory waiting times, decoherence, state consumption, and measurement constraints that can make fidelity a stochastic target. We propose a compute/simulate/learn framework for quantum QoT estimation and illustrate it with a simulation-based proof of concept. Our study shows that analytical composition can be sufficient in simple regimes, that simulation becomes necessary when stochastic memory effects shape the delivered fidelity distribution, and that lightweight learned surrogates can approximate simulator labels at much lower runtime cost for online control. We close with open challenges for deployment, including stochastic targets, sim-to-real transfer, data-generation cost, physics-informed learning, and generalization beyond individual paths to full network topologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 未来的量子网络将依赖于控制平面决策，如路由和纠缠分配，这些决策需要及时可靠地估计候选路径的纠缠质量。本文受光网络传输质量（QoT）估计的启发，探讨了量子控制器何时应通过分析计算、模拟或学习代理模型来估计端到端保真度。研究提出了一个计算/模拟/学习框架用于量子QoT估计，并通过基于模拟的概念验证进行了说明。结果表明，在简单情况下分析组合足够，而当存在随机内存效应时模拟变得必要。
authors: Anis Bekri, Amar Abane, Van Sy Mai, Abdella Battou, Saddek Bensalem

articles.title: Leveraging verifiable structure in quantum circuits to find more efficient compilations with agentic AI
articles.title_zh: 利用量子电路中可验证结构通过智能AI实现更高效的编译
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss an effective paradigm of utilizing AI agents to better compile quantum circuits when one can constrain bottleneck subroutines to have some form of classically verifiable structure. For example, when critical subroutines are composed exclusively of reversible classical logic, phasing operations, and measurement based uncomputation, one can efficiently simulate execution for classical inputs. This property facilitates efficient certification of approximate circuit synthesis via a form of fuzz testing, provided suitable assumptions on the input distribution. While this pattern was recently exploited to improve quantum cryptanalysis circuits, here we highlight the flexibility of the broader approach by discussing three important applications. (1) The computation of 1/sqrtx that bottlenecks real space simulations of the Coulomb operator such as those important for modeling inertial confinement fusion reactors. (2) The decoding of Reed-Solomon codes which bottlenecks the decoded quantum interferometry algorithm when used to approximately solve the optimal polynomial intersection problem. And (3) the quantum look-up tables and controlled application of Givens rotations that bottleneck the most performant quantum algorithms for simulating chemistry in second quantization. We discuss reference implementations of these algorithms and how they can be constrained and verified in the interest of seeding a Kaggle competition designed to accelerate AI-based research into the optimization of their compilation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一种利用AI智能体优化量子电路编译的有效范式，尤其当瓶颈子程序具有经典可验证结构时。这种特性使得通过模糊测试高效认证近似电路合成成为可能。研究通过讨论三个重要应用，包括库仑算子的实空间模拟、里德-所罗门码的解码以及量子查找表，展示了该方法的灵活性。该方法有望显著提高量子算法的编译效率。
authors: Tanuj Khattar, Nicholas C. Rubin, Craig Gidney, Michael Broughton, Guang Hao Low, Ryan Babbush

articles.title: Task-aligned spectral inductive biases in parameterized quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 参数化量子电路中任务对齐的谱归纳偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parameterized quantum circuits are widely investigated in quantum machine learning, yet how their architecture can provide task-aligned inductive biases remains poorly understood. We study data reuploading quantum circuits with two distinct inputs: a signal that varies between samples and a fixed, task-defined spectral query that specifies how the signal should be probed. We show that encoding the query can change the circuit's hypothesis class over the signal by modulating how its existing signal frequencies are combined, without introducing new sample-dependent information. This mechanism matches tasks built on nonuniform Fourier transforms, whose evaluation frequencies specify the query and whose sampling positions guide its encoding. We examine this connection in a classification task inspired by synthetic aperture radar, where acquisition geometry determines a query for classifying unfocused spectral patches before image formation. Across small-scale spectral and radar-like tasks, aligned queries improve learning from limited data over parameter-matched circuits with mismatched or absent queries. These results provide a route from known spectral task structure to the design and validation of inductive biases in parameterized quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 参数化量子电路在量子机器学习中备受关注，但其架构如何提供任务对齐的归纳偏置仍不甚明了。本文研究了具有两种输入的量子电路：一个随样本变化的信号和一个固定的、任务定义的谱查询。研究表明，编码查询可以通过调制现有信号频率的组合方式来改变电路对信号的假设类别，从而提高有限数据下的学习效果。这些结果为设计具有任务感知归纳偏置的量子电路提供了新途径。
authors: Felix Frohnert, Adrián Pérez-Salinas, Sebastian Lange, Marcus Schwaebisch, Evert van Nieuwenburg, Vedran Dunjko

articles.title: Semiclassical Analysis of Wave Dynamics via Wigner Transforms: Applications to the Quantum Harmonic, Anharmonic, and Dirac Oscillator
articles.title_zh: 基于维格纳变换的波动力学半经典分析：在量子谐振子、非谐振子和狄拉克振子中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this Master's thesis, we give a pedagogical introduction to the semiclassical analysis of wave dynamics in single-band and multi-band systems. We show how the semiclassical evolutions of Wigner functions can approximate the dynamics of wave packet centers and wave packet deformations. Three systems of increasing complexity are considered: the quantum harmonic oscillator and the quantum anharmonic oscillator as single-band systems, and the Dirac oscillator as a two-band system. We explain the origins of the first-order semiclassical corrections (Moyal, Littlejohn-Flynn, and Berry) in the equations of motion and examine their effects on predictive accuracy. Another focus is set on the conditions for validity of the semiclassical analysis. For both the quantum anharmonic and the Dirac oscillators, a dimensionless parameter controlling the accuracy of the approximation is identified. In multi-band systems, the formalism applies only to states within a single adiabatic subspace, which, for the Dirac oscillator, corresponds to an energy branch. This motivates the construction of single-branch almost coherent states: approximately Gaussian wave packets formed by superpositions of states from a single energy branch. Their centers undergo oscillations with an aperiodic envelope. These states enable comparison between semiclassical Wigner function evolution and the commonly used Sundaram-Niu formalism. We show that semiclassical Wigner function evolution captures deformation-related dynamics, including the initial decay of oscillations, which the Sundaram-Niu formalism cannot describe by construction. Additionally, exact quantum evolution reveals partial relocalization of these single-branch almost coherent states, a phenomenon that cannot be captured by the semiclassical evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本硕士论文对单带和多带系统中的波动力学半经典分析进行了教学性介绍。论文展示了维格纳函数的半经典演化如何近似波包中心和波包形变的动力学。研究考虑了量子谐振子、量子非谐振子和狄拉克振子三种系统，并解释了运动方程中一阶半经典修正的来源及其对预测精度的影响。
authors: August Burg

articles.title: Universal Threshold Laws for Dipolar Evaporation of Molecular Fermi Gases
articles.title_zh: 偶极分子费米气体蒸发冷却的普适阈值定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22639v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fermi statistics suppress the elastic collisions that rethermalize a Fermi gas during evaporative cooling, creating a fundamental low-temperature bottleneck for producing quantum degenerate gases. We show that, for shielded single-component ultracold dipolar molecular Fermi gases in the Wigner threshold regime, this bottleneck is governed by universal threshold laws fixed by the effective dimensionality of the gas. In this regime, Fermi suppression of rethermalization scales quadratically with temperature in 3D but only linearly in 2D. Consequently, the thermalization-to-loss ratio is more favorable in 2D than in 3D, and these results suggest that 2D geometries are better suited for reaching deep degeneracy. We also present ab initio close-coupling calculations that agree well with experimental measurements on Fermi degenerate gases of KRb molecules, supporting our conclusions.
articles.abstract_zh: 费米统计抑制了费米气体在蒸发冷却过程中的弹性碰撞，从而在产生量子简并气体时造成了根本性的低温瓶颈。本研究表明，对于维格纳阈值区域中受屏蔽的单组分超冷偶极分子费米气体，该瓶颈受气体有效维度决定的普适阈值定律支配。研究发现，费米抑制在3D中与温度呈二次方关系，而在2D中仅呈线性关系，这表明2D几何结构更适合实现深度简并，并得到了从头算耦合计算的支持。
authors: Kevin B. Xu, John L. Bohn, Reuben R. W. Wang

articles.title: From quantum emitters to technological platforms: a perspective on semiconductor quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 从量子发射器到技术平台：半导体量子点的展望
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photonic quantum technologies are based on controlled photon states. To generate these, quantum dots have emerged as excellent sources of single and entangled photons. In this Perspective, we briefly review the chronological development of quantum dots as photon sources, from their beginnings as quantum emitters in the early 2000s to the advanced photonic devices being developed today. We highlight the interplay between fundamental research and industrial aspects before discussing the photonic quantum technologies we expect to emerge in the near future.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子量子技术依赖于受控光子态，而量子点已成为单光子和纠缠光子的优秀来源。本展望回顾了量子点作为光子源的编年史发展，从21世纪初的量子发射器到当今先进的光子器件。文章强调了基础研究与工业应用之间的相互作用，并讨论了预计在不久的将来出现的光子量子技术。
authors: Klaus D. Jöns, Dorian A. Gangloff, Doris E. Reiter

articles.title: Multiscale Quantum-Classical Simulation of Protein Autoproteolysis in a Million-Atom Membrane Environment
articles.title_zh: 百万原子膜环境中的蛋白质自蛋白水解多尺度量子-经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23108v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting chemical reactions in biomolecules is challenging because reactive centers are embedded within complex environments that strongly influence their energetics and mechanisms. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical workflow that combines molecular dynamics, density functional theory, and correlated wavefunction methods, tightly integrating CPUs, GPUs, and quantum processing units (QPUs) to enable simulations across multiple length and accuracy scales. We apply this approach to ADGRG1 autoproteolysis, a maturation reaction in an adhesion G protein-coupled receptor that has not previously been studied using correlated electronic-structure methods. Our simulations treat a biologically realistic system containing more than one million atoms, including the full-length uncleaved receptor embedded in an endoplasmic-reticulum membrane, while incorporating a 54-qubit IQM quantum processor and up to 1,200 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. These results demonstrate how quantum computers can serve as accelerators within scalable scientific workflows, extending correlated electronic-structure methods to biologically relevant systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测生物分子在复杂环境中的化学反应极具挑战性。本研究提出了一种混合量子-经典工作流程，结合了分子动力学、密度泛函理论和关联波函数方法，并紧密整合了CPU、GPU和量子处理单元。该方法应用于ADGRG1自蛋白水解反应，模拟了一个包含超过一百万个原子的生物学真实系统，展示了量子计算机如何作为可扩展科学工作流程中的加速器，将关联电子结构方法扩展到生物学相关系统。
authors: Alexander Orlov, Alexis Ralli, Tim Weaving, Michael Williams de la Bastida, Reuben Martin, Zohim Chandani, Minh Chung, P. V. Sriluckshmy, Fedor Simkovic IV, Luigi Iapichino, Peter J. Love, Christian B. Mendl, Andrea Townsend-Nicholson, Peter V. Coveney

articles.title: Unconditional Quantum PAC Learning Advantage in the Large Error Regime
articles.title_zh: 大误差区域中无条件量子PAC学习优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish an unconditional super-polynomial separation between quantum and classical PAC learning of Boolean functions under the uniform distribution in the large error regime. For every advantage łambda(n) = n⁻ømega⁽¹⁾, we construct a concept class that a polynomial-time quantum learner learns to agreement 1/2+łambda(n) with success probability at least 1-1/n^k. The learner uses only quantum random examples and outputs a polynomial-size deterministic classical circuit. In contrast, no polynomial-time classical learner achieves agreement 1/2 + łambda(n)/n^k with success probability greater than 1/n^k, even with membership queries.
