For specified uniform and dimerized chains, we compare fixed reservoirs at matched drift, ports, high-gain band and complete gain/loss rate caps. At the representative cap R=8 and halfwidth Ømega=0.05, nearest-neighbor arithmetic band average noise exceeds the unrestricted optimum by more than 1.01265 quanta in the uniform chain for every finite Nge64. Boundary-response bounds give necessary rates and targets requiring range two. At N=64, finite-auxiliary calculations retain a noise advantage under matched total coupling budgets; response bounds quantify noise-resolution tolerances. These theoretical results guide reservoir design and noise calibration for a proposed cryogenic microwave array with a 100 kHz design band.
articles.abstract_zh: 定向量子放大器能实现弱信号读出并保护源，但储层噪声限制了其灵敏度。本文构建了在局部兼容条件下达到已知单频最小值的相邻位点损耗通道作为基准。研究发现，在均匀链中，最近邻算术带平均噪声超过了无限制最优值。这些理论结果为低温微波阵列的储层设计和噪声校准提供了指导。
authors: Chengxi Li, Hao Zhu, Tie-Fu Zhang, Lin Zhuang, Wanzi Sun, Wuming Liu

articles.title: Surviving readout errors and incomplete postselection in monitored quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 监测量子电路中读出误差和不完全后选择的存活
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how readout errors affect dynamics in monitored quantum circuits. Such errors make postselection effectively incomplete, conditioning trajectories on imperfect rather than true records. Focusing on U(1)-symmetric circuits, we find that the charge-sharpening transition survives at a finite error rate, with the sharp phase's vanishing fluctuations replaced by a finite steady-state plateau. The charge fluctuations show a shallow minimum near the ideal transition point as a function of measurement rate, signaling the competition between measurement-induced purification and noise-induced mixing. By decomposing the fluctuations into quantum and classical contributions, we show the minimum marks where incomplete postselection still retains enough trajectory memory to attenuate noise-induced mixing, leaving a detectable signature of the transition even in a noisy setting. Mid-circuit measurements are far harder to mitigate against readout errors than standard end-of-circuit ones, because the errors corrupt the postselection itself; the decomposition therefore offers a minimal mitigation framework and a route to locate the transition directly from experimental data. Our results show that charge sharpening survives readout errors in a quantitative and experimentally accessible way.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了读出误差如何影响监测量子电路中的动力学，这些误差使得后选择变得不完全。针对U(1)对称电路，研究发现电荷锐化转变在有限误差率下仍然存在，其尖锐相的消失涨落被有限稳态平台取代。电荷涨落曲线在理想转变点附近呈现浅谷，表明测量诱导纯化与噪声诱导混合之间的竞争。
authors: Murtaza Ali Mir, Teemu Ojanen, Ali G. Moghaddam

articles.title: A constructive solution to the n-representability problem
articles.title_zh: n-可表示性问题的一个构造性解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a solution to the fermionic quantum marginal problem by constructing the complete family of two-body witnesses at each level of a weighted sum-of-squares hierarchy. Our construction combines positive-semidefinite Gram matrices with explicit linear nullspace constraints that exactly cancel all higher-body contributions, replacing the search for individual representability conditions with a systematic algebraic procedure. Beyond the completeness proof, we demonstrate the construction numerically by solving the associated semidefinite program and recovering the exact ground-state energy of a Richardson Hamiltonian in the three-fermion sector. We further prove that higher-degree particle-number multipliers are unnecessary when the full sum-of-squares generating algebra is used. These results establish a unified constructive framework for verifying the physicality of a candidate two-particle reduced density matrix through a complete characterization of all two-body witnesses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建加权平方和层次结构中每个级别的完整两体见证族，提出了费米子量子边际问题的一个解决方案。该构造结合了正半定Gram矩阵和显式线性零空间约束，精确抵消了所有高阶体贡献。数值演示通过求解半定规划，恢复了三费米子扇区中Richardson哈密顿量的精确基态能量。这些结果为验证候选两粒子约化密度矩阵的物理性提供了一个统一的构造性框架。
authors: Nicholas C. Rubin, A. Eugene DePrince III

articles.title: Standard and Bipolar Rectification in Tilted Periodically-Driven Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 倾斜周期驱动量子系统中的标准和双极整流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing mechanisms to control transport in correlated quantum systems is essential for advancing quantum circuit technologies. In this work, we establish a rectification mechanism for both particle and energy flow in a fermionic system coupled to external baths, in the presence of a tilted potential modulated locally by a time-periodic drive. The drive generates particle and energy currents even in the absence of chemical or thermal bias between the baths. These drive-induced currents are enhanced at resonant frequencies at which avoided crossings occur in the Floquet quasienergy spectrum, reflecting the role of the Floquet states as intermediate channels for transport. Once a bias between the baths is introduced, the drive-induced current contribution can reinforce, compete with, or even cancel the bias-induced contribution. These effects enable rectification in the non-interacting regime, which we quantify via the rectification coefficient R. This coefficient measures the asymmetry between transport up the tilt (forward bias) and down the tilt (reverse bias). In addition to standard rectification, where transport is reduced under reverse bias, we identify a regime of bipolar rectification, in which the current flows only up the tilt regardless of the bias polarity. At the boundary between standard and bipolar regimes, the system achieves perfect rectification, corresponding to complete suppression of the reverse-bias current. In the presence of interactions between particles, the parameter region that supports bipolar rectification is enlarged and R can be enhanced by many orders of magnitude. Our results establish a rectification mechanism for particle and energy transport that can be experimentally realized in condensed matter and cold atom systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在倾斜周期驱动量子系统中控制粒子和能量流动的整流机制。即使在没有化学或热偏置的情况下，驱动也能产生粒子和能量电流，并且这些电流在Floquet准能量谱中出现避免交叉的共振频率处得到增强。当引入偏置时，驱动引起的电流贡献可以增强、竞争甚至抵消偏置引起的贡献，从而在非相互作用区域实现整流。
authors: Joaquín Peñuela-Parra, Juan José Mendoza-Arenas

articles.title: The Lovász number is not alone: a continuum of Rényi points in the entanglement-assisted spectrum of graphs
articles.title_zh: Lovász数并非孤立：图的纠缠辅助谱中Rényi点的连续统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Li and Zuiddam's entanglement-assisted asymptotic spectrum of graphs consists of the normalized graph parameters that are additive under disjoint unions, multiplicative under strong products and monotone under entanglement-assisted cohomomorphisms; the entanglement-assisted Shannon capacity is their pointwise minimum. To our knowledge, the Lovász number ǎrtheta was its only known element. We find a continuum of others. Three quantities of Duan and Winter, łog₂ǎrtheta, the minimal Holevo capacity Cₘᵢₙ and the logarithm of the no-signalling simulation cost Σ, are the smallest information radii of classical-quantum channels compatible with a graph, measured with Petz-Rényi divergences of orders 0, 1 and 2. At order zero this is due to Schrijver (as credited by Dalai) and to Duan and Winter; at order one it is the min-max formula for the Holevo capacity. Interpolating in the order gives a family ǎrtheta_α, 0łeαłe2, and we prove that every member lies in the spectrum. The main step, multiplicativity under strong products for channels that need not factor, follows from an exact nesting identity for compressions. Sandwiched Rényi radii of order βin[1/2,infty] give the same family, at α=2-1/β. On the five-cycle the family takes every value in [sqrt5,5/2]. A Hilbert-Schmidt inequality for the pentagon gives Cₘᵢₙ(C₅₎₌łog₂₍₅/2), proving a conjecture of Duan and Winter. We also settle the two open links of their inequality chain: the graph-level no-signalling simulation rate always equals its single-letter value łog₂Σ(G), and a 32-vertex graph from the Mermin-Peres magic square has Cₘᵢₙ<łog₂Σ, certified in exact rational arithmetic. Finally, Σ never exceeds the projective rank of the complement; a rank inequality for the same square makes this strict on a 1440-vertex graph.
articles.abstract_zh: Li和Zuiddam提出的图的纠缠辅助渐近谱由在特定操作下具有加性、乘性和单调性的归一化图参数组成，其点态最小值是纠缠辅助香农容量。本文发现，除了已知的Lovász数外，该谱中还存在一个连续统的元素。通过Petz-Rényi散度测量的经典-量子信道的最小信息半径，可以得到Duan和Winter提出的三个量，它们在不同阶数下对应于Lovász数、最小Holevo容量和无信号模拟成本的对数。研究证明，通过插值得到的Rényi参数族中的每个成员都属于该谱。
authors: Nidhal Mghirbi, Seth Douglas

articles.title: Infinite magic and the emergence of the continuum
articles.title_zh: 无限魔力与连续统的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Which features of a quantum state are needed for a relativistic quantum field theory to emerge from a lattice system? We address this question by establishing a quantitative relationship between the type classification of hyperfinite von Neumann algebras and the quantum-information-theoretic resource of nonstabilizerness, also called magic. Our results establish two complementary parts of this relationship. First, we prove that any stabilizer system on a lattice defines a canonical GNS Hilbert space in which local von Neumann algebras do not contain type III factors in their central decomposition. As an explicit example, we prove that for stabilizer systems with short-range order, the local algebras are isomorphic to tensor products of hyperfinite factors of type I or type II. This demonstrates that the absence of magic is accompanied by the absence of type III factors in the local algebras, therefore prohibiting the appearance of a quantum field theory. Second, for the hyperfinite factors of Araki, Woods and Powers, we prove a quantitative equivalence: The limiting factor is of type III if and only if the locally optimized min-relative entropy of magic diverges. This divergence is necessary to generate the continuous spectrum associated to a type III factor. Thus, in this setting, the emergence of a type III factor requires not merely the presence of magic, but an infinite amount of it. These results provide a rigorous setting supporting the proposal that infinite magic is a necessary structural ingredient for the emergence of a relativistic continuum from lattice systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子态的哪些特性是相对论量子场论从格点系统涌现所必需的，通过建立超有限冯诺依曼代数的类型分类与量子信息理论资源“非稳定态性”（即“魔力”）之间的定量关系来解决此问题。研究证明，格点上的稳定器系统定义的局部冯诺依曼代数不包含III型因子，表明“魔力”的缺失伴随着III型因子的缺失，从而阻止了量子场论的出现。此外，对于Araki、Woods和Powers的超有限因子，研究证明了极限因子是III型当且仅当局部优化的最小相对熵满足特定条件。
authors: Leo Shaposhnik, Lorenzo Leone, Lennart Bittel, Dimitris Saraidaris, Alexander Jahn, Jens Eisert

articles.title: Sparse-QITE: Discovering Compact Generators for Quantum Imaginary-Time Evolution via Regularization Methods
articles.title_zh: Sparse-QITE：通过正则化方法发现量子虚时演化的紧凑生成器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE) provides a systematic route to ground-state preparation, but its cost grows rapidly with the locality D of the unitary approximation, for which the local Pauli basis scales as 4^D. We introduce Sparse-QITE, a regularized formulation that promotes compact generators, reducing the number of quantum operations and yielding circuits with fewer gates and lower depth. We derive rigorous bounds on the sparsification error and benchmark the method in one-dimensional transverse-field Ising and antiferromagnetic Heisenberg models. Sparse-QITE exhibits a controllable sparsity--accuracy trade-off while retaining strong compression even in the high-accuracy regime. In scalability experiments with respect to D, the active support grows much more slowly than in standard QITE and, in several regimes, approximately saturates over the domain sizes studied. After circuit construction and transpilation, some of the largest-domain cases require only about 1% of the standard-QITE gate count while maintaining high accuracy. We further introduce adaptive and active-discovery variants: the former selects the regularization strength dynamically during the evolution, while the latter reduces the number of Pauli expectation values that need to be evaluated and, consequently, the measurement requirements. These results establish sparsity-promoting regularization as a route toward more resource-efficient QITE. More broadly, these results suggest that sparsity-promoting regularization may also benefit variational quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子虚时演化（QITE）是制备基态的系统方法，但其成本随酉近似的局域性D迅速增长。本文引入了Sparse-QITE，这是一种正则化公式，旨在促进紧凑生成器，从而减少量子操作数量并产生更少门和更低深度的电路。研究推导了稀疏化误差的严格界限，并在横场Ising和反铁磁海森堡模型中对该方法进行了基准测试。Sparse-QITE在保持高精度的同时展现出可控的稀疏性-精度权衡，并且在可扩展性实验中，其活跃支持的增长速度远低于标准QITE。
authors: Rafael Gómez-Lurbe, Luca Ion, Alberto Acevedo, Andreu Anglés-Castillo

articles.title: Syndrome-Resolved Decoding of Qubit Readout Errors
articles.title_zh: 量子比特读出错误的综合征分辨解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Readout errors in superconducting qubits include incorrect state assignment, bit flips within the computational subspace, and leakage to non-computational states. These errors require different mitigation strategies, yet conventional measurement fidelity and repeatability metrics do not resolve their individual contributions. Previous repeated-readout studies have shown that temporal correlations reveal additional information about readout errors. Here we introduce the Readout Error Decoder (RED), which converts repeated thresholded binary records into a channel-resolved error budget. Controlled error injections validate the channel-specific response of the decoder. We demonstrate RED on both fluxonium and transmon qubits and across distinct leakage-lifetime regimes. RED identifies the error channels limiting readout performance without requiring dedicated discrimination of non-computational states, providing a basis for targeted readout optimization across different qubit modalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子比特的读出错误包括状态分配不正确、计算子空间内的比特翻转以及泄漏到非计算状态，这些错误需要不同的缓解策略。本文引入了读出错误解码器（RED），它将重复的阈值二进制记录转换为信道分辨的错误预算。通过受控错误注入验证了RED对特定信道的响应，并在fluxonium和transmon量子比特上进行了演示。RED能够识别限制读出性能的错误信道，无需专门区分非计算状态，为不同量子比特模态的靶向读出优化提供了基础。
authors: Han Zheng, Vladimir Pešić, Nikolay Gusarov, Andrea Lizzit, Taketo Imaizumi, Chulwoo Ahn, Marco Nicolas Mueller, Raymond Mencia, Edoardo Charbon, Vladimir E. Manucharyan

articles.title: Entanglement of superpositions in zero-energy subspace: insights from stabilizer theory
articles.title_zh: 零能量子空间中叠加态的纠缠：来自稳定器理论的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact zero-energy eigenstates built from entangled dimers have recently been found in a large class of spin Hamiltonians. While the individual states have a simple structure, their superpositions can have very different entanglement properties. In this work, we study these superpositions for geometrically local spin-1/2 chains with periodic boundary conditions. Using stabilizer theory and polynomial methods, we characterize the subspace they span and find the minimum entanglement entropy between two halves of the chain. For Hamiltonians generated by a single local Pauli interaction with noncommuting translates, this minimum obeys a volume law at fixed interaction range. The structure of the least-entangled superpositions also suggests further exact eigenstate constructions, including zero-energy states separable between the two halves of the chain and states at nonzero energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期在大量自旋哈密顿量中发现了由纠缠二聚体构建的精确零能量本征态。本文利用稳定器理论和多项式方法，研究了几何局域自旋-1/2链在周期性边界条件下的这些叠加态。研究表征了它们所跨越的子空间，并找到了链两半之间最小纠缠熵。对于由单个局域泡利相互作用生成的哈密顿量，在固定相互作用范围下，该最小纠缠熵遵循体积定律。
authors: Konstantin Antipin, Richik Sengupta

articles.title: Perfect and peak state transfer on IBM quantum hardware
articles.title_zh: 在IBM量子硬件上实现完美和峰值态转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We run continuous-time quantum walks with perfect and peak state transfer on a present-day superconducting quantum processor, IBM Quantum's 156-qubit Heron device ibmₖᵢₙgston, deliberately without error correction or error mitigation. Perfect state transfer and its relaxations have been studied extensively in algebraic graph theory, where one can prove exactly which graphs move a quantum state from one vertex to another with probability one (or with the largest probability the graph allows, in the case of peak state transfer), and at what time. Our experiments cover perfect state transfer on the hypercubes Q₂ = C₄ and Q₃, and on the Hamming-weighted paths HPₙ, the equitable-partition quotients of the hypercubes Qₙ, for n up to 20; peak state transfer on the Xₙ family for n up to 11; and, for comparison, moving the state along a path of qubits by a sequence of SWAP gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在IBM Quantum的156量子比特Heron设备ibmₖᵢₙgston上，在不进行纠错或错误缓解的情况下，运行了具有完美和峰值态转移的连续时间量子行走。实验涵盖了超立方体Q₂=C₄和Q₃上的完美态转移，以及Hamming加权路径HPₙ上的完美态转移。此外，还研究了Xₙ家族上的峰值态转移，并与通过一系列SWAP门沿量子比特路径移动状态进行了比较。
authors: Priscilla Awuah, Krystal Guo

articles.title: A tutorial on quantum scattering theory and coupled-channel calculations of bimolecular collisions
articles.title_zh: 量子散射理论和双分子碰撞耦合通道计算的教程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collisions between atoms and molecules govern how energy is exchanged and redistributed in the gas phase, underpinning phenomena from spectral line broadening and interstellar molecular excitation to the cooling and trapping of molecules. A quantitative account of these collisions requires connecting the theoretical description of the interaction between the collision partners to measurable quantities such as cross sections. However, scattering theory as presented in quantum mechanics textbooks does not readily translate into numerical methods. Here, we formulate the scattering problem in Dirac notation, as customary in present-day quantum mechanics courses, and show how to build a practical numerical framework from it. We derive the "coupled channel" representation of the scattering problem with correct asymptotic behaviour and introduce Numerov's method to obtain time-independent wavefunctions, from which we calculate cross sections, the observables measured in scattering experiments. Starting from single channel scattering, we build up to the realistic collision of a ground-state atom with a diatomic molecule.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子和分子之间的碰撞控制着气相中能量的交换和再分配，是光谱线展宽、星际分子激发以及分子冷却和捕获等现象的基础。本文以狄拉克符号形式阐述了散射问题，并展示了如何构建实用的数值框架。研究推导了具有正确渐近行为的散射问题的“耦合通道”表示，并引入了Numerov方法来获得时间无关的波函数，从而计算散射实验中测量的截面。
authors: Karl P. Horn, Christiane P. Koch

articles.title: monoprop: Scaling Pauli and Majorana propagation via Anticommutation Indices
articles.title_zh: monoprop：通过反交换索引实现Pauli和Majorana传播的扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce monoprop, an open-source, massively parallel operator-propagation framework for fermion and qubit bases. For N qubits or modes, existing codes represent each of the K tracked operator terms (Pauli strings or products of Majorana operators) as a 2N-bit string, testing each for anticommutation with the gate at O(KN) cost per gate. Here, we introduce the anticommutation index which rapidly looks up the terms anticommuting with a gate. A local gate changes only the terms that touch its sites, and when terms are truncated to act on few sites, only a fraction sim1/N touch any given qubit or mode, and we use this to prove the time per gate scales as O(K/N). This counterintuitive result tells us that for a fixed number of terms, increasing the number of sites can make things faster. We demonstrate this numerically, and show monoprop scales almost ideally to 8192 cores, tracking 9.5×10¹⁰ terms. Beyond propagation, we present memory-efficient surrogate graphs, which record one propagation and replay it at new angles, for fast energy re-estimation and parameter gradients, and an efficient method for finding energy-minimising gates and optimal angles for simulating adaptive quantum-chemistry circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了monoprop，一个用于费米子和量子比特基的大规模并行算符传播开源框架。针对现有代码在N个量子比特或模式下以O(KN)成本测试每个算符项与门的反对易性问题，monoprop引入了反交换索引，可以快速查找与门反对易的项。研究证明，对于固定数量的项，增加站点数量可以加快处理速度，时间复杂度可达O(K/N)。数值结果表明monoprop在8192个核心上几乎理想地扩展，跟踪了9.5×10¹⁰个项。
authors: Aaron Miller

articles.title: Reducing QUBO Complexity in Drone Delivery Through Classical Feasibility Preprocessing
articles.title_zh: 通过经典可行性预处理降低无人机配送中QUBO的复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Drone-delivery planning combines routing decisions with operational constraints such as payload capacity and limited onboard energy, resulting in combinatorial optimization problems that can become costly to encode directly in binary form. This work investigates a hybrid quantum--classical approach in which candidate drone missions are generated and evaluated classically before constructing a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model for mission selection. Payload- and energy-infeasible missions are removed during preprocessing, while the reduced QUBO is solved using exact enumeration, simulated annealing (SA), and the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), with mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) used as a classical reference. Experiments on controlled synthetic delivery instances evaluate solution quality, the effect of preprocessing, and computational scaling. Exact QUBO optimization reproduces the MILP optimum on the evaluated small instances, while SA achieves 100% feasibility with a median optimality gap of 0%. Combined payload-and-energy preprocessing reduces the mean number of QUBO variables by 29.60% and quadratic interactions by 49.20%, while reducing mean SA runtime by 31.26%. In contrast, the evaluated shallow statevector-based QAOA configuration achieves lower feasibility and is restricted to small QUBO instances. These results indicate that, in the considered setting, the main practical benefit of the hybrid architecture comes from classical feasibility preprocessing that reduces the binary search space before QUBO-based optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 无人机配送规划结合了路径决策和有效载荷容量、有限机载能量等操作约束，导致组合优化问题直接编码为二进制形式成本高昂。本文研究了一种混合量子-经典方法，其中候选无人机任务在构建用于任务选择的二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）模型之前，通过经典方法生成和评估。预处理过程中移除了有效载荷和能量不可行的任务，然后使用精确枚举、模拟退火（SA）和量子近似优化算法（QAOA）求解简化后的QUBO。
authors: Silvie Illésová, Vojtěch Novák, Martin Beseda

articles.title: Singular wave functions and quantum collapse in inverse-power potentials
articles.title_zh: 逆幂势中的奇异波函数与量子坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum collapse (QC) occurs under the action of the inverse-power potential U(r)=-U₀/(2rⁿ) in the framework of the Schroedinger equation. The corresponding stationary wave functions feature an infinite number of spatial oscillations at ri̊ghtarrow 0. The ground state (GS) is missing in the presence of the QC, but the available bound states at finite energies may be physically relevant, as they are normalizable. This work aims to produce singular stationary wave functions. The analytical findings represent an asymptotic form of the stationary wave functions at ri̊ghtarrow 0, which fill a continuous spectrum, and some exact solutions for the wave functions, obtained under appropriate conditions. As a regularized version, we also consider the potential truncated at a finite difference from the center. The regularized wave functions feature a finite number of spatial oscillations, the missing GS reappears, and the spectrum of the bound states is discrete.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子坍缩（QC）在薛定谔方程框架下，逆幂势U(r)=-U₀/(2rⁿ)的作用下发生。相应的定态波函数在r趋近于0时呈现无限次空间振荡。本文旨在产生奇异定态波函数，分析结果给出了r趋近于0时定态波函数的渐近形式，它们填充了连续谱，并在适当条件下获得了一些波函数的精确解。作为正则化版本，研究还考虑了在距中心有限距离处截断的势，此时正则化波函数具有有限次空间振荡，缺失的基态重新出现，并且束缚态谱是离散的。
authors: Hidetsugu Sakaguchi, Boris Malomed

articles.title: Agent-assisted experimental strategy transfer across quantum processors
articles.title_zh: 代理辅助的量子处理器间实验策略转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21047v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Progress in quantum hardware requires a growing volume of experiments across diverse devices, straining the capacity of human experts. Automation remains challenging because device differences and drift can render workflows developed on one processor unsuitable for another. Here we present an agent-assisted experimental strategy for conducting experiments across three-qubit nuclear magnetic resonance processors. Developed on one processor and applied sequentially to four others, the strategy uses an agent to assess experimental evidence, select subsequent measurements and adapt procedures, with operators providing instrument preparation and physical intervention. Using three-qubit Grover state preparation as a common task, each deployment combined device-specific calibration, control-pulse optimization and measurement. The experimental strategy was refined through sequential deployment, and all four processors ultimately produced outputs dominated by their respective marked states. The marked-state populations of the reconstructed dominant eigenstates ranged from (0.910) to (0.959), with relative deviations below (3.8%) from the ideal value of 0.945. These results demonstrate that an agent-assisted experimental strategy can be reused and refined across processors to realize a common quantum task, providing a basis for scaling experimental practice beyond individual devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子硬件的进步要求在不同设备上进行越来越多的实验，这给人类专家带来了压力。本文提出了一种代理辅助的实验策略，用于在三量子比特核磁共振处理器之间进行实验。该策略在一个处理器上开发，并依次应用于其他四个处理器，利用代理评估实验证据、选择后续测量并调整程序。通过顺序部署，实验策略得到了完善，所有四个处理器最终都产生了以其各自标记态为主的输出。
authors: Shi-Yao Hou, Zipeng Wu, Chao Zhang, Guanru Feng, Keren Li, Jingen Xiang

articles.title: Multiplicative Semidefinite Programming Upper Bounds on Quantum No-Signalling-Assisted Zero-Error Capacity
articles.title_zh: 量子无信号辅助零误差容量的乘性半正定规划上界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study zero-error communication and exact simulation of quantum channels assisted by quantum no-signalling correlations. For a channel with Kraus operator space K, we introduce a semidefinite programming parameter Γ(K) that is exactly multiplicative under tensor products and upper-bounds Θₘ̊ NS(K), where łog₂Θₘ̊ NS(K)=C₀,ₘ̊ NS(K) and C₀,ₘ̊ NS(K) denotes the asymptotic quantum no-signalling-assisted zero-error capacity. Among known upper bounds on Θₘ̊ NS given by semidefinite programs, Γ is the tightest. We also prove that the previously introduced simulation lower bound Σ⁻(K) is exactly multiplicative and satisfies Θₘ̊ NS(K)łeqΓ(K)łeqΣ⁻(K)łeqΓ(K)². Using this multiplicativity, we show that neither S₀,ₘ̊ NS(K)=łog₂Σ⁻(K) nor its regularized extension S₀,ₘ̊ NS(K)=łimnolimitsₙ→ᵢₙfₜyn⁻¹łog₂Σ⁻(Køtⁱmes ⁿ) holds in general. This answers an open question about the asymptotic simulation cost S₀,ₘ̊ NS(K). For classical-quantum channels, we obtain sharp bounds. If r is the effective output dimension, then Θₘ̊ NSłeqΓłeq(1+r¹/²)Θₘ̊ NS/2 and ΓłeqΣ⁻łeq(1+r¹/²)Γ/2. If k is the minimum rank of the output support projections, then Σ⁻/Θₘ̊ NSłeq[(1+r¹/²)/(1+k¹/²)]², and this bound is sharp for every 1łeq kłeq r. Thus, we obtain the sharp bound S₀,ₘ̊ NS-C₀,ₘ̊ NSłeq2łog₂[(1+r¹/²)/(1+k¹/²)].
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子无信号关联辅助下的量子信道零误差通信和精确模拟。对于具有Kraus算符空间K的信道，研究引入了一个半正定规划参数Γ(K)，该参数在张量积下具有精确乘性，并作为渐近量子无信号辅助零误差容量C₀,ₘ̊ NS(K)的对数上界。该参数Γ是已知半正定规划上界中最紧的。研究还证明了先前引入的模拟下界Σ⁻(K)也具有精确乘性，并满足Θₘ̊ NS(K) ≤ Γ(K) ≤ Σ⁻(K) ≤ Γ(K)²。
authors: Xin Li, Yinan Li

articles.title: Stitched surface codes: planar concatenation through GHZ corridors
articles.title_zh: 缝合表面码：通过GHZ走廊的平面级联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fault-tolerant quantum-memory architecture that concatenates four distance-t rotated surface-code patches with the [[4,2,2]] outer code, encoding two logical qubits at code distance d = 2t in a physical footprint of N < 2(2t+1)² qubits on a square lattice with nearest-neighbor connectivity. The outer-code stabilizer generators XXXX and ZZZZ, each of physical weight 4t, are measured in situ via verified Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) ancillae distributed through narrow corridors between adjacent patches, without lattice surgery or long-range gates. The outer-code gadgets introduce hyperedge fault mechanisms, but by design each decomposes into graphlike components, so the complete syndrome is decoded by a single minimum-weight-perfect-matching pass. Circuit-level simulations show logical error rates that scale as p^t, consistent with distance-2t protection. Finally, we implement the construction experimentally on a 105-qubit Willow superconducting processor in both the ZZ and XX memory bases. With the correlated-matching decoder, increasing the code distance from d = 4 to d = 6 reduces the block logical error rate by a factor of 1.52. The construction thus provides a near-term testbed for concatenated architectures beyond the standard surface code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种容错量子存储架构，通过[[4,2,2]]外码将四个距离为t的旋转表面码块级联起来，在具有最近邻连接的方形格子上编码两个逻辑量子比特。外码稳定器生成器通过GHZ辅助比特在相邻块之间的狭窄走廊中原位测量，无需晶格手术或长程门。电路级模拟显示逻辑错误率与p^t成比例，与2t距离保护一致，并在105量子比特的超导处理器上进行了实验实现。
authors: Mohamed A. Shalby, Alexandre Bourassa, Amir Karamlou, Leigh Martin, Alexis Morvan, Nicholas Noll, Craig Gidney, Leonid P. Pryadko

articles.title: Parallel Repetition for Entangled Games via Conditional Relative Entropy
articles.title_zh: 基于条件相对熵的纠缠博弈并行重复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a proof of the cubic parallel-repetition bound for finite two-player entangled games using quantum conditional relative entropy. For a game with entangled value 1-ǎrepsilon<1 and answer alphabets mathcal A,mathcal B, its n-fold repeated value is at most [ exp[-Ømega(ǎrepsilon³ⁿ/L)],qquad L:=max1,łog(|mathcal A||mathcal B|), ] for every nge1. This recovers Song's cubic rate. We also prove a threshold bound: the probability of winning a fraction at least 1-ǎrepsilon+δ is at most exp[-Ømega(δ⁵ⁿ/(ǎrepsilon²L))] for 0<δłeǎrepsilon. Our information charge is the decrease in relative entropy when a question reference is discarded. Our comparison states preserve the original conditional question law. A chain rule bounds the coordinate charges using the cost of conditioning on checked wins and retaining checked answers. Our main lemma converts small charges into nearby pure-state descriptions and local corrections, each depending only on one player's question. Together with Song's sampler, these enable approximate local preparation of the conditioned workspace.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用量子条件相对熵，证明了有限双玩家纠缠博弈的立方并行重复界限，恢复了Song的立方速率。对于纠缠值为1-ε<1的博弈，其n次重复值至多为exp[-Ω(ε³ⁿ/L)]。作者还证明了一个阈值界限，并引入了信息荷的概念，即丢弃问题参考时相对熵的减少，从而实现条件工作空间的近似局部准备。
authors: Rahul Jain

articles.title: Crossovers between Time-Bin and Energy-Time Entanglement in Homodyned Resonance Fluorescence
articles.title_zh: 零拍共振荧光中时间间隔和能量-时间纠缠的交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate photonic entanglement generated by homodyning resonance fluorescence from a two-level emitter with a phase-locked laser field. Under weak excitation, increasing the relative laser-field amplitude produces crossovers from time-bin to energy--time and back to time-bin entanglement. The intermediate energy--time regime occurs near amplitude matching, where destructive interference suppresses the single-photon component, allowing the two-photon contributions to dominate the coincidence signal. We evaluate the resulting photon statistics and first-order coherence and characterize the entanglement through violations of the CHSH Bell inequality in a Franson interferometer. This scheme provides a route to controlling photonic entanglement through linear optics and coherent interference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了通过对两能级发射器的共振荧光进行零拍检测所产生的光子纠缠。在弱激发下，增加相对激光场振幅会导致时间间隔纠缠、能量-时间纠缠以及再次时间间隔纠缠之间的交叉。中间的能量-时间区域发生在振幅匹配附近，此时单光子分量被抑制，双光子贡献占据主导。该方案通过线性光学和相干干涉，为控制光子纠缠提供了一条途径。
authors: Zi-Qi Zeng, Jian Wang, Bang Wu, Zhiliang Yuan

articles.title: Accurate gap control of 3D-integrated superconducting quantum circuits using asymmetric indium architecture and multi-angle flip-chip bonding
articles.title_zh: 使用非对称铟结构和多角度倒装芯片键合实现3D集成超导量子电路的精确间隙控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flip-chip 3D integration is a key enabling technology for overcoming the routing and layout constraints of planar superconducting quantum processors, but it requires accurate and uniform control of the inter-chip spacing while preserving qubit coherence. In conventional processes, thick indium bumps are deposited symmetrically on both chips, while dedicated spacers are introduced to limit the residual tilt. Here, we present a flip-chip bonding process based on an asymmetric indium architecture, combining 20,μm thick indium bumps on the control chip with 200,nm thin indium pads on the qubit chip. Using electrical and microwave measurements, we demonstrate low resistance and low loss indium interconnects, and show that transmon qubits integrated with this process reach relaxation and coherence times of T₁₌₍₁₅₉±14),μs and T₂,ₑcₕₒ=(294±42),μs, respectively, comparable to planar devices. Combined with a multi angle compression procedure that suppresses systematic tilt, this approach reduces the average post bonding tilt to (20±12),μrad. These results establish an asymmetric indium architecture combined with multi angle compression as a robust, coherence preserving route toward 3D integrated superconducting quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 倒装芯片3D集成是克服平面超导量子处理器布线和布局限制的关键技术，但需要精确控制芯片间距并保持量子比特相干性。本文提出了一种基于非对称铟结构的倒装芯片键合工艺，实现了低电阻、低损耗的铟互连。该工艺使集成的transmon量子比特达到与平面器件相当的弛豫和相干时间。结合多角度压缩程序，该方法将键合后的平均倾斜度降低至(20±12)μrad，为鲁棒的3D集成提供了新途径。
authors: L. Richard, N. Bruckmoser, J. Feigl, D. Bunch, A. Bhattacharjee, L. Koch, I. Tsitsilin, V. P. Bader, H. Hu, L. Södergren, S. Filipp

articles.title: Limits of adaptive linear postprocessing in six-state quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 六态量子密钥分发中自适应线性后处理的局限性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-way classical communication improves the noise tolerance of quantum key distribution, but the limits of adaptive parity processing remain unclear. For the six-state protocol with equal three-basis error rate pin[p_*,1/2], where p_*=(5-sqrt5)/10simeq27.64%, we construct a single compatible collective attack that defeats a broad class of linear postprocessing. Each public message may be an affine function of the sender's raw key, chosen adaptively from the public history. For every finite input length and every accepted transcript of positive probability, Eve's optimal probability of recovering any affine function of Alice's raw key is at least Bob's. Consequently, reliable agreement on a linear final key is incompatible with secrecy. The same conclusion holds for arbitrary publicly seeded privacy amplification after reliable recovery of a linear candidate. The proof conditions on the complete transcript, which restricts the two raw keys to affine subspaces. A local degradation of Eve's state, a known Rényi-entropy comparison, and a coset-probability inequality then give the recovery comparison. Both inequalities are proved in self-contained appendices. The result allows block splitting, regrouping, nonzero-syndrome selection, and adaptive linear reconciliation.
articles.abstract_zh: 双向经典通信可以提高量子密钥分发的噪声容忍度，但自适应奇偶校验处理的局限性尚不明确。本文针对六态协议，构建了一种单一兼容的集体攻击，能够击败广泛的线性后处理。研究表明，对于任何有限输入长度和接受的记录，Eve恢复Alice原始密钥的任何仿射函数的最佳概率至少与Bob相同。因此，在线性最终密钥上达成可靠一致与保密性不兼容，这一结论也适用于任意公开播种的隐私放大。
authors: Toyohiro Tsurumaru

articles.title: Reducing the Cost of Qudit State Preparation by Learning a Sparse Structure for SNAP Gates
articles.title_zh: 通过学习SNAP门的稀疏结构来降低Qudit态制备成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preparing quantum states in bosonic qudits with SNAP--Displacement sequences requires both optimizing the gate parameters and deciding which Fock levels should be controlled by each SNAP gate. A fully parameterized ansatz assigns an independent phase to every Fock level in every gate, leading to a number of phases that grows steeply. This constitutes a problem for short to medium term systems as controlling many phases requires complex control pulses which are subject to increased control errors. Previous work reduced this cost by restricting the trainable phases to predefined sparse patterns, such as a diagonal or a grid, which however may not be optimal for a specific target state. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a method that learns which phases are needed together with their values, using a differentiable mask. A sparsity penalty encourages the removal of unnecessary phases, while temperature annealing gradually turns the masks into binary decisions. We compare the proposed method with fully parameterized and predefined sparse ansatzes on Fourier and Haar-random target states. The evaluation considers both the minimum number of phases required to reach different infidelity thresholds and the overall trade-off between fidelity and phases required, measured through Pareto frontiers and hypervolume. The results show that learning the location of the phases together with their values provides competitive or improved fidelity--resource trade-offs, although the advantage depends on the target state and qudit dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用SNAP-位移序列制备玻色子qudit量子态需要优化门参数并确定每个SNAP门应控制的Fock能级。传统的全参数化方法导致相位数量急剧增加，增加了控制复杂性和误差。本文提出了一种通过可微分掩码学习所需相位及其值的方法，利用稀疏性惩罚和温度退火来移除不必要的相位。该方法在傅里叶和Haar随机目标态上与现有方法进行了比较，旨在降低qudit态制备的成本和复杂性。
authors: Marco Pennazio, Leonardo Ignazio Pagliochini, Riccardo Pellini, Maurizio Ferrari Dacrema, Paolo Cremonesi

articles.title: Time-optimal robust quantum control for partially known errors
articles.title_zh: 部分已知误差的时间最优鲁棒量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Robust quantum control usually assumes one of two extremes: the error is of a known form and only its strength is unknown, or nothing at all is known about it. In practice one often sits in between. The size of a static error is unknown, but its class is known, for example, it only shifts energy levels, or it acts on each subsystem separately. We ask how fast a control can cancel, to first order, every error in such a class. A time-independent Hamiltonian can do this if and only if all errors in the class have zero diagonal in a common basis. In that case an equally spaced energy ladder in this basis does it after one period. A lower bound that holds for any time-dependent control with bounded drive power shows that this simple constant control is optimal for several natural classes, including unknown level shifts and unknown local errors on two subsystems. Completely unknown errors need a time-dependent control, and there, knowing the error class shortens the minimum time by a factor sqrtd²⁺¹. So partial knowledge of the error changes not only how long an optimal robust control takes, but also its form.
articles.abstract_zh: 鲁棒量子控制通常假设误差形式已知或完全未知，但实际情况常介于两者之间。本文研究了在已知误差类别但强度未知的情况下，控制能以多快速度抵消误差。研究发现，如果所有误差在共同基下对角线为零，则时间无关哈密顿量可在周期后完成此任务，且对于某些误差类别（如未知能级偏移）是时间最优的。部分误差知识不仅缩短了最优鲁棒控制所需的时间，也改变了其形式。
authors: Llorenç Balada Gaggioli

articles.title: Practical Fidelity Estimation for Noisy Quantum Devices Using Direct and Survival-Probability-Based Protocols
articles.title_zh: 使用直接和基于生存概率的协议对噪声量子设备进行实用保真度估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable characterization of quantum states and quantum processes is central to the development of scalable quantum computing. Standard characterization techniques such as full quantum state tomography become rapidly impractical as system size increases. In this work we present two software-oriented fidelity estimation protocols that avoid full tomographic reconstruction while remaining experimentally relevant for noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. The first protocol is direct fidelity estimation (DFE), where the fidelity between a target state and an experimentally prepared state is estimated from importance-sampled Pauli measurements. The second protocol is a survival-probability-based method that reconstructs fidelity from experimentally accessible moments of a noisy evolution and its approximate inverse, and is intrinsically robust against state-preparation-and-measurement (SPAM) errors. We discuss the theoretical basis of both approaches, analyze their noise sensitivity, and present numerical evidence on representative multiqubit states under depolarizing, dephasing, and amplitude-damping channels. For DFE we show that attenuation-aware correction improves robustness against measurement noise. For the survival-probability approach we show that an L₂₋ₒₚₜᵢₘᵢzed expansion substantially outperforms naive Taylor truncation in high-noise regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着系统规模的增加，量子态和量子过程的可靠表征变得不切实际。本文提出了两种软件导向的保真度估计协议，旨在避免完全层析重建，适用于噪声中等规模量子设备。第一个是直接保真度估计（DFE），通过重要性采样Pauli测量来估计保真度。第二个是基于生存概率的方法，从噪声演化及其近似逆的实验可访问矩中重建保真度，并对SPAM误差具有内在鲁棒性。
authors: Ahmed Aman, Kaustav Chatterjee, Younes Javanmard, Tanmoy Pandit

articles.title: Driving the cooling process of a quantum system via classical noise
articles.title_zh: 通过经典噪声驱动量子系统的冷却过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is known that under particular hypotheses anomalous thermalization processes can occur, such as the Mpemba effect, consisting in a faster cooling down when the system is prepared in a hotter initial condition, thus making convenient to warm up the system before the freezing process in order to make it freeze in a shorter time. It is shown here that the action of a Markovian classical noise during the freezing process can accelerate the approach to the zero-temperature thermal state. This prediction is counterintuitive, especially after observing that a classical noise can be considered equivalent to the action of an infinite-temperature reservoir, since both drive the system toward the same state. These facts lead to the statement that warming up the system during the contact with a low-temperature reservoir can accelerate the cooling process.
articles.abstract_zh: 已知在特定假设下会发生异常热化过程，例如Mpemba效应。本文研究表明，在冷却过程中引入马尔可夫经典噪声可以加速系统向零温热态的趋近。这一发现是反直觉的，因为经典噪声通常被认为等同于无限温度热库的作用。研究结果表明，在与低温热库接触期间对系统进行加热，反而可以加速冷却过程。
authors: B. Militello, A. Napoli

articles.title: Quantum instanton approach to metastable collective spin systems: Numerical implementation and applications
articles.title_zh: 亚稳态集体自旋系统的量子瞬子方法：数值实现与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven-dissipative collective spin systems can host several long-lived metastable states; rare switching between them governs slow relaxation and first-order dissipative phase transitions associated with changes in the dominant stationary state. In the companion Letter [arXiv:2604.15091], we introduced a quantum instanton framework based on exact quasiprobability dynamics to describe this switching and illustrated it with a minimal model possessing a simplifying symmetry. Here we develop its numerical implementation, combining collocation and shooting methods, and apply it to two microscopically motivated systems: the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model with purely collective dissipation and the cooperative resonance fluorescence with collective and local dissipation. By determining the leading exponential scaling of switching rates between metastable attractors, we predict the stationary magnetization, the first-order dissipative phase-transition point, and the exponential scaling of slow relaxation rates. These predictions agree with quantum master-equation calculations and an exact analytical result for the second model without dephasing. We also examine how the choice of quasiprobability representation affects numerical convergence and find that the alternative semiclassical Wigner approach, based on Gaussian truncation, has varying accuracy across models and parameter regimes. These results substantiate the framework's applicability to experimentally relevant collective spin systems with both collective and local dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 驱动耗散集体自旋系统可存在多个长寿命亚稳态，它们之间的罕见切换控制着慢弛豫和一阶耗散相变。本文基于精确准概率动力学，发展了量子瞬子框架的数值实现，并将其应用于Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick模型和合作共振荧光系统。通过确定亚稳态吸引子之间切换速率的主导指数标度，该方法成功预测了稳态磁化强度、一阶耗散相变点和慢弛豫速率的指数标度，并与量子主方程计算结果一致。
authors: Maciej Chudak, Massimiliano Esposito, Krzysztof Ptaszynski

articles.title: Operator-Space Entanglement Entropy in Random Fermionic Gaussian Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 随机费米子高斯动力学中的算符空间纠缠熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the von Neumann operator-space entanglement entropy (OSEE) of initial product operators evolved under random gaussian dynamics, as modeled by a Brownian SYK₂ model. By exploiting a mapping to a domain-wall melting problem, we derive an exact expression for the time-dependent bipartite OSEE in the thermodynamic limit, and obtain an analytic characterization of the corresponding gaussian Page curve emerging at late times. Our results build on recent work on the entanglement dynamics in the all-to-all quantum simple exclusion process, leveraging tools from RMT, including the Coulomb-gas approach and a mapping to the free Jacobi process. Finally, based on our results, we discuss the possibility of relating the OSEE with non-gaussianity measures in the Heisenberg picture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在布朗SYK₂模型模拟的随机高斯动力学下演化的初始乘积算符的冯诺依曼算符空间纠缠熵（OSEE）。通过映射到畴壁熔化问题，推导出了热力学极限下时间相关的二分OSEE的精确表达式，并解析表征了晚期出现的相应高斯Page曲线。研究结果利用了随机矩阵理论工具，并讨论了将OSEE与海森堡图像中的非高斯性度量联系起来的可能性。
authors: Pablo Bayona-Pena, Elena Gramellini, Lorenzo Piroli

articles.title: Local finite rate semi device independent randomness expansion from quantum contextuality
articles.title_zh: 基于量子语境性的局部有限速率半设备无关随机性扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite rate randomness expansion (RE) which is secure against quantum adversaries is a crucial information processing task which is well studied in the case of two non-communicating parties sharing Bell non-local correlations in a device independent manner. In this paper we show that contextual correlations with only a single localized party are sufficient for RE in a semi-device independent (SDI) manner. We propose a template SDI-RE protocol which is applicable for arbitrary N-cycle non-contextuality (NC) inequalities and derive its RE rate under finite statistics. As a special case, we also highlight the advantages of the situation when RE is constrained by Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) inequality but with characterized measurements implemented by only a single party. Our template protocol also incorporates non-ideal statistics which may not satisfy perfect commutativity and perfect repeatability, both of which are necessary in a loophole-free test of NC inequalities. As such, several recent experimental implementations of significantly loophole-free tests of NC inequalities can be modified for secure RE following our approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限速率随机性扩展（RE）是信息处理中的一项关键任务。本文证明了仅有一个局部方参与的语境关联足以实现半设备无关（SDI）的RE。作者提出了一个适用于任意N循环非语境性（NC）不等式的模板SDI-RE协议，并推导了其在有限统计下的RE速率。该协议还考虑了非理想统计数据，可用于修改近期无漏洞NC不等式测试的实验实现，以实现安全的RE。
authors: Dhananjoy Ghosh, Nandana J, Jaskaran Singh

articles.title: Same Spectrum, Harder First-Order Training: Phase-Locking in Single- versus Multi-Qubit Re-Uploading Circuits
articles.title_zh: 相同谱，更难的一阶训练：单量子比特与多量子比特重上传电路中的锁相现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Angle-encoded variational quantum circuits implement truncated Fourier series. For one-dimensional inputs, a single-qubit re-uploading (serial) circuit represents every function that a multi-qubit circuit with the same encoding budget E can; we find that this exchange of width for depth is not free in first-order training. Because its state lives on the Bloch sphere, all parameters of the serial circuit move the state, at each input, along one complex direction, which we call emphphase-locking. We prove that this costs no Fourier direction but leaves no direction to spare: however many parameters it has, the serial circuit has at most 2E+2 tangent directions, one more than its 2E+1 Fourier coefficients need, while a two-qubit control with the same encoding budget and model class generically has at least 6E+6. The cost in training is measured against this control, as the number of runs out of 100 that reach the optimum within a fixed step budget. On an exact loss with flat-spectrum targets the gap grows with E; at E=32 the serial circuit converges in 3, 53 and 83 runs under gradient descent, Adam and Levenberg--Marquardt, the control in 99, 100 and 100. On three real-world series, at matched parameter counts, the serial circuit reaches the least-squares optimum in at most 9 runs under Adam and in 32 to 93 under Levenberg--Marquardt, the control in at least 98 and in all 100; its held-out error is up to about 1.5 times that of the control under Adam, but no larger in the typical run under Levenberg--Marquardt.
articles.abstract_zh: 角度编码的变分量子电路实现了截断傅里叶级数。研究发现，在单量子比特重上传（串行）电路中，这种深度换宽度的代价在第一阶训练中并不小，因为其参数在布洛赫球上移动状态时会产生“锁相”现象。这导致串行电路的切线方向数量远少于多量子比特电路。数值实验表明，在多种优化器下，串行电路的收敛性能显著低于对照组，且差距随编码预算E的增加而增大。
authors: Michael Poppel, David Bucher, Maximilian Zorn, Markus Baumann, Sebastian Wölckert, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien, Philipp Altmann, Jonas Stein

articles.title: Quantum-compatible Riemannian conjugate gradient for ground-state preparation
articles.title_zh: 用于基态制备的量子兼容黎曼共轭梯度法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Riemannian optimization provides a natural geometric framework for designing quantum algorithms for ground-state preparation, most notably through quantum imaginary-time evolution. However, existing geometry-aware approaches primarily employ steepest-descent updates, leaving more advanced methods from classical Riemannian optimization largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce quantum conjugate gradient descent (QCGD), a quantum-compatible implementation of Riemannian conjugate gradient that combines the steepest descent direction with information retained from previous search directions. In our numerical experiments, the proposed approach achieves faster convergence per iteration than the baseline double-bracket quantum imaginary-time evolution (DB-QITE) algorithm, and we quantify the associated circuit cost with gate counts produced by Qrisp. This improvement, however, comes at the cost of increased circuit depth for each update step, revealing a trade-off between convergence rate and implementation complexity. Nevertheless, since the circuit depth for those algorithms grows exponentially with the number of iterations, the proposed method may offer practical advantages, particularly in the early fault-tolerant regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 黎曼优化为设计量子基态制备算法提供了自然的几何框架。本文提出了一种量子兼容的黎曼共轭梯度下降（QCGD）算法，该算法结合了最速下降方向和先前搜索方向的信息。数值实验表明，QCGD在每次迭代中比基线双括号量子虚时演化（DB-QITE）算法收敛更快。然而，这种改进是以每次更新步骤增加电路深度为代价的，揭示了收敛速度和实现复杂性之间的权衡。
authors: Andres Arcia-Lopez, Marek Gluza, Yudai Suzuki, Cyrus Mostajeran

articles.title: Controlled-Memory Identification with Shared Generators: Dimension--Horizon Tradeoffs and Quantum--Classical Separation
articles.title_zh: 共享生成器下的受控记忆识别：维度-时间范围权衡与量子-经典分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We determine the finite-horizon identification limits of a (d)-dimensional memory when the control interface is restricted to four shared, time-homogeneous generators. A writer encodes a message by applying a prefix word to a common root state. The verifier then applies a candidate-dependent query word followed by a shared terminal binary test, with each word of length at most (T). For fixed error tolerances (łambda₂>0) and (łambda₁₊łambda₂<1), the optimal identification sizes satisfy (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf Q,₄=Θłₐₘbdₐ_₁,łₐₘbdₐ_₂(mind²,T)) for arbitrary CPTP generators and (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf S,₄=Θłₐₘbdₐ_₁,łₐₘbdₐ_₂(mind,T)) for stochastic maps. Four unitary letters and four permutation letters attain these respective bounds, showing that a four-letter reversible alphabet reaches the static code-size orders in optimal quadratic and linear word length. In the fully dimension-limited regime, this yields (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf Q,₄=Θ(d²⁾) versus (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf S,₄=Θ(d)), establishing a quadratic quantum--classical separation in logarithmic code size. Low-overlap Grassmann and agreement-code packings supply the orbit endpoints, while exact inverse query words match each encoded state to its designated test. At the sharp boundary (łambda₂₌₀), (0łeqłambda₁<1), all four model classes satisfy (łn N=Θ(minłn d,T)). Thus any fixed positive false-acceptance tolerance activates the metric-packing regime, whereas zero false acceptance imposes an exclusive-witness constraint and yields the logarithmic-dimension boundary.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当控制接口受限于四个共享、时齐生成器时，(d)维记忆的有限时间范围识别极限。研究发现，对于任意CPTP生成器和随机映射，最优识别大小存在特定关系。该工作表明，四字母可逆字母表在最优二次和线性字长下达到了静态码字大小的阶数。在完全维度受限的情况下，这导致了对数码字大小的二次量子-经典分离，揭示了量子系统在信息识别能力上相对于经典系统的显著优势。
authors: Yixin Zhao

articles.title: Three-axis Active Magnetic Compensation with Spatial Feedforward Matrix Decoupling and Hysteresis PI Regulation for Suppressing Zeeman Decoherence of Cold Atom Quantum Memories
articles.title_zh: 基于空间前馈矩阵解耦和迟滞PI调节的三轴主动磁场补偿，用于抑制冷原子量子存储器的塞曼退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21801v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cold-atom quantum memories require a near-zero magnetic environment (residual field <1 microtesla) to mitigate Zeeman decoherence. Conventional three-axis active compensation suffers from inter-coil crosstalk and geomagnetic drift, which degrade the uniformity and long-term stability of the zero-field region. To address this, we propose a spatiotemporally cooperative feedback-controlled suppression architecture for magnetic interference. An integrally printed three-dimensional orthogonal coil frame mechanically suppresses inter-axis flux leakage. A spatial feedforward inverse matrix is introduced to algorithmically eliminate first-order cross-coupling. A dual-threshold hysteresis incremental-PI controller filters magnetometer quantization fluctuations and avoids frequent small jitter adjustments of coil driving currents. Hardware ablation experiments, long-duration stability tests and spatial magnetic-field mapping were conducted. Experimental results show that during a 714.4 s continuous steady-hold stage, the mean and maximum residual fields at the central point reach 0.112 microtesla and 0.224 microtesla, respectively. The overlapping Allan deviations of all three components remain below 5 nT for averaging times of 1.9-178.2 s. Based on differential-ferrofluid lattice-scan measurements combined with centre-constrained quadratic vector reconstruction and soft Maxwell regularization, a weak-field spatial distribution with an RMS variation of 5.65 microtesla is fitted within a spherical region of interest of radius 5 mm, where 67.5% of the model volume meets the sub-5 microtesla coverage criterion. For a prolate ellipsoidal region matching the atomic-cloud distribution with full axis lengths of 10, 5, and 5 mm, the upper field bound within 93.7% of the volume is 2.68 microtesla.
articles.abstract_zh: 冷原子量子存储器需要近零磁场环境以减轻塞曼退相干，但传统补偿方法存在串扰和漂移问题。本文提出了一种时空协同反馈控制的磁干扰抑制架构，通过一体化打印的三维正交线圈框架、空间前馈逆矩阵解耦和双阈值迟滞增量PI控制器来解决这些问题。实验结果表明，在714.4秒的连续稳定保持阶段，中心点的平均和最大残余磁场分别达到0.112微特斯拉和0.224微特斯拉。该方法显著提升了零场区域的均匀性和长期稳定性。
authors: Ya Li, Xiao-Long Zou, Xiang-Yao Liang, Chang-Qing Niu, Xin Guo, Wei-Zhe Qiao, You-Xing Chen

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Optimization for Emergency-Priority Traffic Signal Control
articles.title_zh: 混合量子-经典优化在紧急优先交通信号控制中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Emergency-priority traffic signal control requires reducing emergency-vehicle delay while limiting disruption to ordinary traffic. This work investigates a finite-horizon QUBO formulation and compares Exact QUBO optimization, QAOA, CVaR-QAOA, a quantum machine-learning policy, fixed-time control, and max-pressure control in a three-intersection corridor. The study evaluates three traffic-demand regimes, examines the effect of the emergency-priority weight, and compares quantum solutions with the exact QUBO optimum. The optimization-based controllers achieved reliable emergency progression across all tested demand regimes, while max-pressure produced lower ordinary-traffic delay. Increasing emergency priority reduced emergency travel time but increased congestion, with diminishing improvements at larger weights. CVaR-QAOA reproduced the exact QUBO solution more accurately than standard QAOA, although the resulting differences in closed-loop traffic performance were comparatively small.
articles.abstract_zh: 紧急优先交通信号控制旨在减少紧急车辆延误，同时限制对普通交通的干扰。本研究探讨了有限时间范围的QUBO公式，并比较了精确QUBO优化、QAOA、CVaR-QAOA、量子机器学习策略、固定时间控制和最大压力控制在三交叉路口走廊中的性能。结果表明，基于优化的控制器在所有测试需求下均实现了可靠的紧急车辆通行。CVaR-QAOA比标准QAOA更准确地再现了精确QUBO解，尽管对闭环交通性能的影响相对较小。
authors: Silvie Illésová, Vojtěch Novák

articles.title: Opinion bubbles in the quantum Buridan's ass problem
articles.title_zh: 量子布里丹之驴问题中的意见气泡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum Buridan's ass problem concerns a network of interconnected nodes in which transitions between the nodes are governed by the laws of quantum mechanics. In such situations interference between probability amplitudes plays a key role in determining whether the probability of leaving the initial node is large or small and also the speed at which the associated transitions occur. In this paper we extend this idea to consider transitions between one given set of coupled nodes and the remainder of the network. We have in mind a quantum analogy to changing an opinion, in which the initially occupied set of nodes is one opinion bubble, with the remaining parts of the network corresponding to a different opinion. We find that quantum interference again plays a crucial role in the dynamics. A further key component is the role of symmetry between the nodes and their interconnections, as it is symmetry that lies at the heart of the Buridan's ass puzzle. In the classical Buridan's ass paradox it is symmetry between competing alternatives that freezes the ass into indecision. In the quantum case, however, interference results in a far richer dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子布里丹之驴问题研究了互连节点网络中由量子力学定律控制的节点间跃迁。本文将此概念扩展到考虑给定耦合节点集与网络其余部分之间的跃迁，将其类比为意见的改变，其中初始节点集代表一个“意见气泡”。研究发现，量子干涉在动力学中起着关键作用，并且节点及其互连之间的对称性也是一个重要因素。与经典布里丹之驴悖论中对称性导致犹豫不决不同，量子情况下干涉导致了更丰富的动态行为。
authors: Leonid Chaichenets, Jaroslav Novotný, Igor Jex, Stephen M. Barnett, Tamás Kiss

articles.title: Synergistic charging of a quantum battery via Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and non-Markovian noise
articles.title_zh: 基于Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和非马尔可夫噪声的量子电池协同充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protecting quantum batteries from environmental noise remains a challenge. Using exact Burshtein-Kubo equations, we study a two-spin quantum battery with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) coupling under indepen dent local longitudinal random telegraph noise (RTN). At a fixed effective noise scale, the DM-assisted slow switching protocol yields a superadditive transient ergotropy gain and near-maximal ergotropy during the initial charging stage, while the no-DM slow-switching control reaches comparable ergotropy only in a later revival. A finite superadditive region persists at fixed RTN amplitude, with protocol-dependent location and gain. In the Ising model, the enhancement is nonmonotonic in DM strength, with intermediate coupling giving near-optimal performance. Dressed-channel analysis associates this enhancement with changes in transition frequencies and longitudinal-noise matrix elements that reduce slow-RTN spectral weight. Superadditivity also persists in the tested anisotropic XY model.
articles.abstract_zh: 保护量子电池免受环境噪声影响是一个持续的挑战。本文利用精确的Burshtein-Kubo方程，研究了在独立局部纵向随机电报噪声（RTN）下，具有Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）耦合的双自旋量子电池。研究发现，在固定有效噪声尺度下，DM辅助的慢速切换协议在初始充电阶段产生了超加性瞬态功提取增益和接近最大功提取。这种增强与跃迁频率和纵向噪声矩阵元素的变化有关，从而降低了慢速RTN的谱权重。超加性在测试的各向异性XY模型中也持续存在。
authors: Si-Yu Zhang, Meng-Long Song, Hai-Tao Dong, Xue-Ke Song, Liu Ye, Dong Wang

articles.title: Quantum control of solid state qubits via Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 基于强化学习的固态量子比特量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The use of reinforcement learning (RL) in the design of quantum control strategies for pulse level control of NISQ era quantum devices is attracting growing interest. Model-free RL, not requiring preexisting knowledge of the physical system, acts as a black-box optimization tool well suited for noisy devices. In this work, we provide a simulation-based analysis of the performance of model-free RL for state preparation and qubit gate design in a challenging setup: indirect control of NV nuclear spins in a spin-bath. In particular, the spin-bath is modeled via the generalized cluster correlation expansion accounting for magnetic impurities and intra-bath interactions. We analyze the performance of the RL agents by performing simulations with minimally observable environments and noisy, sparse rewards as introduced in (Phys. Rev. X 12, 011059), and compare them to other state-of-the-art black-box optimization tools.
articles.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在设计NISQ时代量子设备的脉冲级量子控制策略方面日益受到关注。本文对无模型强化学习在具有挑战性的NV核自旋间接控制场景中，用于态制备和量子比特门设计的性能进行了基于仿真的分析。研究通过考虑磁杂质和浴内相互作用的广义簇关联展开来建模自旋浴。该工作比较了RL智能体与其他最先进的黑盒优化工具的性能，验证了其在噪声环境下的有效性。
authors: Dennis Herb, Mirko Rossini, Sabine Wölk, Joachim Ankerhold, Dominik Maile, Alessio Belenchia

articles.title: Bubble-Sort Exchange Networks: Symmetry Selection Rules and Language-Model Distillation on Exchange-Only Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 冒泡排序交换网络：交换型自旋链上的对称选择规则和语言模型蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On a chain of exchange-coupled quantum dots a Heisenberg exchange pulse of area pi is a SWAP, so the parallel bubble-sort SWAP network of superconducting chains is native to exchange-only (EO) spin qubits, and any other pulse area fuses routing with an entangling interaction. We build a variational "bubble-sort exchange network" (odd-even transposition, one parameter per pulse) and study it as a Born machine read out by Pauli spin blockade. Exchange conserves total spin, so the reachable readout distributions are fixed by the total-spin content of the initial product state. For the two-spin singlet-triplet encoding we derive a selection rule -- outcomes with k triplet pairs are bounded by the initial weight in sectors S <= k (S = 0 excluded for k = 1) -- and prove by a transportation argument that it is also sufficient: the reachable distributions form the polytope cut out by the rule, and its total-variation floor is attained. Products of singlets and T0's forbid whole outcome classes; the Neel state forbids none; the three-spin EO code has no floor. We then distil, in noise-free simulation, next-token distributions of GPT-2 over restricted vocabularies into the network, with matrix-product-state (MPS) Born machines as classical control. At six logical qubits the three-spin chain reaches KL = 0.011 nat at depth N and 0.004 at 2N, below the bond-dimension-4 MPS; the two-spin chain from the Neel state reaches 0.014 at 2N and 0.004 at 3N, against 0.28-1.5 from singlet/triplet products for the first teacher. Final states lie largely outside the code space: leakage is a resource, not an error. No arrangement of disjoint pulses meets every pair in fewer than N-1 rounds, and at depth 2N the chain distils as well as a 2D array or non-local couplings. Sector-restricted simulation extends this to 10-14 logical qubits (up to 30 dots).
articles.abstract_zh: 在交换耦合量子点链上，海森堡交换脉冲可以实现SWAP操作，这使得并行的冒泡排序SWAP网络天然适用于交换型（EO）自旋量子比特。本文构建了一个变分“冒泡排序交换网络”，并将其作为通过泡利自旋阻塞读出的玻恩机器进行研究。研究导出了双自旋单重态-三重态编码的选择规则，并证明了其充分性。此外，该工作在无噪声模拟中，对GPT-2的下一个token分布进行了蒸馏，展示了其在量子信息处理中的潜力。
authors: Yuichiro Minato

articles.title: Operational Limits of Gravity-Mediated Entanglement
articles.title_zh: 引力介导纠缠的操作极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tests of gravity-mediated entanglement aim to determine whether two massive objects in spatial superposition can become entangled through their mutual gravitational interaction. In an ideal model, the two objects are often treated as pointlike branches, but real wave packets have a finite width and are also exposed to dephasing and residual non-gravitational forces. We study these effects in a two-branch gravitational cat-state model with Gaussian wave packets. The Newtonian interaction is averaged over the finite wave-packet width, and spatially correlated dephasing is included phenomenologically. We then ask a practical question: when does the generated state remain useful rather than merely entangled? To answer this, we examine Bell violation, teleportation fidelity, coherent information, Fisher information, and state distinguishability. We find finite parameter windows where the same state is Bell-nonlocal and teleportation-useful, but these windows shrink as the wave packets become broader or the dephasing becomes stronger. We also show that a residual electrostatic branch interaction can coherently cancel the gravitational nonlocal phase and strongly suppress the operational signal. The results identify finite-width and electrostatic tolerance boundaries that should be considered in future tests of gravity-mediated entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 引力介导纠缠的测试旨在确定两个处于空间叠加态的宏观物体是否能通过相互引力作用而纠缠。本文在一个具有高斯波包的双分支引力猫态模型中，研究了有限波包宽度、退相干和残余非引力力对引力介导纠缠的影响。通过分析贝尔不等式违反、隐形传态保真度、相干信息等指标，研究发现存在有限的参数窗口使纠缠态具有实用性。然而，这些窗口会随着波包变宽或退相干增强而缩小，表明了引力介导纠缠的实际操作限制。
authors: Atta ur Rahman, Muhammad Noman, Ying-Jian Zhu, Jia-Xin Peng, Saeed Haddadi

articles.title: Patchwork: automated lattice surgery and space-time partitioning for real-time decoding
articles.title_zh: Patchwork：用于实时解码的自动化晶格手术和时空分区
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce patchwork, a lattice-surgery compiler for arbitrary multi-qubit Pauli measurements on a prescribed narrow-corridor two-dimensional surface-code layout. Systematic geometric rules simplify stabilizer placement and gate scheduling, including for logical Y measurements implemented using twist defects. We introduce measurement circuits and schedules that, together with protruding lobes of Y-extension patches, preserve the full effective code distance for all numerically tested code distances. To support parallel decoding, we develop a wavefront algorithm that partitions merged lattice-surgery patches into space-time commit, buffer, and cleanup regions. Simulations of three sequential multi-qubit Pauli measurements acting on ten logical qubits show that staged decoding achieves total failure probabilities close to those of monolithic decoding over the parameters tested. These methods provide an automated framework for fault-tolerant lattice surgery and a route toward scalable, real-time decoding.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Patchwork，一个用于在预设窄走廊二维表面码布局上进行任意多量子比特泡利测量的晶格手术编译器。该系统利用系统的几何规则简化了稳定子放置和门调度，并引入了测量电路和调度以保持完整的有效码距离。为支持并行解码，开发了一种波前算法将合并的晶格手术补丁划分为时空提交、缓冲和清理区域。模拟结果表明，分阶段解码的总失败概率接近于整体解码，为可扩展的实时解码提供了自动化框架。
authors: Christopher Chamberland, Muyuan Li, Scott Thornton, Justin Gage Lietz, Melody Ren, Antonio deMarti iOlius

articles.title: Gyrators for superconducting circuit design
articles.title_zh: 超导电路设计中的回转器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Assuming only the solubility of Kirchhoff's laws, the conservation of energy, and the form of the constitutive relations, we present a flux-charge symmetric Hamiltonian formalism that always admits a symplectic reduction for nonsingular, well-posed circuits involving gyrators, inductors, and capacitors (LCG circuits) with arbitrary non-linearity. The formalism introduces a notion of circuit duality on non-linear non-reciprocal circuits and a family of point transformations that inserts, removes, and moves reciprocal elements across gyrators while preserving the Hamiltonian spectrum. With these transformations, we extend Tellegen's classic result that gyrators make reciprocal elements behave as their dual to non-linear reciprocal elements such as the Josephson junction and quantum phase slip. Furthermore, we present conditions under which non-reciprocal circuits can be transformed to dynamically equivalent reciprocal circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个磁通-电荷对称的哈密顿形式，适用于包含回转器、电感器和电容器（LCG电路）的任意非线性、非奇异、适定电路，并始终允许辛约化。该形式引入了非线性非互易电路上的电路对偶概念，以及一系列点变换，可以在回转器之间插入、移除和移动互易元件，同时保持哈密顿谱。这些变换将泰勒根的经典结果推广到约瑟夫森结和量子相变等非线性互易元件，并给出了非互易电路可转换为动态等效互易电路的条件。
authors: Ciro Salcedo, Sasha Cocquyt, Andrew Osborne, Andrew A. Houck

articles.title: Programmable all-to-all entangling gates for cavity-coupled atoms
articles.title_zh: 可编程的全连接腔耦合原子纠缠门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault tolerant quantum computers greatly benefit from having both high fidelity entangling gates and a non-local qubit connectivity. However, most entangling gates for neutral atoms are local, requiring separated atoms to be moved using optical tweezers to yield entanglement between them. Here, we design a high fidelity Mø lmer Sø rensen-like entangling gate between neutral atoms coupled to a photonic cavity, enabling a programmable all-to-all connectivity through the shared cavity coupling. The gate is both robust to changes in cavity photon number, and enables selective entanglement between any subset of separated atoms through local laser addressing. This eliminates the need to physically move atoms to perform the gate, and therefore motional errors and erasure are suppressed. Using experimentally realistic parameters we demonstrate gate fidelities exceeding F > 0.99, with higher fidelities achievable through optimal control of the pump amplitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算机需要高保真纠缠门和非局域量子比特连接。本文设计了一种高保真Mølmer-Sørensen型纠缠门，用于光腔耦合的中性原子，通过共享腔耦合实现可编程的全连接。该门对腔光子数变化具有鲁棒性，并通过局部激光寻址实现任意分离原子子集之间的选择性纠缠。实验参数表明，门保真度超过0.99。
authors: Angus Crookes, Ben Yuen, Angela Demetriadou

articles.title: Classical Capacity of Single-Mode Bosonic Gaussian Channels
articles.title_zh: 单模玻色高斯信道的经典容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The classical capacity of a noisy optical channel is the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted reliably, given a constraint on the mean input energy. For the ubiquitous bosonic Gaussian channels, which include standard models of loss and noise in fibre and free-space optical links, determining this rate requires addressing whether entanglement between channel uses or non-Gaussian signals can outperform Gaussian encodings. More precisely, the question is whether the energy-constrained Holevo information is additive across arbitrarily many channel uses and coincides with its Gaussian counterpart. We answer these fundamental questions in the affirmative for every single-mode bosonic Gaussian channel at every input energy. Namely, we prove that independently prepared Gaussian states with Gaussian-distributed random displacements achieve the capacity, including in the low-energy regime where squeezing the signals competes with encoding information in their displacement. Our proof connects an entanglement inequality to a sharp, additive lower bound on output entropy. We then characterise communication above capacity: under a strict total photon-number cutoff, the probability of correct decoding decreases exponentially with the number of channel uses, and we derive explicit bounds on the decay exponent. When only the mean photon number is constrained, a simple energy-rescaling formula determines exactly the entire asymptotic rate--error trade-off: the capacity at mean photon number N and allowed average decoding error ϵ equals the vanishing-error capacity at mean photon number N/(1-ϵ). Together, these results identify the ultimate limits of classical communication for some of the most fundamental models of optical communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声光学信道的经典容量是信息可靠传输的最大速率。本文肯定地回答了单模玻色高斯信道在任意输入能量下，能量受限的Holevo信息是否具有可加性并与高斯编码一致的问题。研究证明，独立制备的具有高斯分布随机位移的高斯态可以达到信道容量。该证明将纠缠不等式与输出熵的精确可加下界联系起来。
authors: Gerardo Adesso, Ludovico Lami, Vittorio Giovannetti

articles.title: Magic in quantum trajectory unravelings of noisy random quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 噪声随机量子电路量子轨迹展开中的“魔力”
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum-trajectory description of a noisy quantum circuit is not unique: every Kraus representation of the noise channel defines a different unraveling, i.e., a different ensemble of pure states that averages to the same density matrix. While all unravelings share the same expectation values of observables, they generally differ in the amount of quantum resources carried by the individual trajectories. Here we study non-stabilizerness, or magic, quantified by the stabilizer Rényi entropy, in quantum-trajectory unravelings of Haar-random and T-doped random Clifford brickwork circuits subject to local dephasing noise of strength p. The canonical unraveling in terms of Pauli jumps is Clifford and leaves magic untouched, so that trajectories retain the Haar-random value of non-stabilizerness. Exploring the full two-parameter family of minimal unravelings, we find that the trajectory-averaged magic can be substantially reduced by a state-independent choice of Kraus operators, and that the optimal choice is not in general the projective-measurement unraveling, but a two-outcome generalized measurement in which the Kraus operators correspond to a weak measurement of the noisy qubit. The optimal unraveling reduces the extensive magic density of the trajectories by a p-dependent factor without altering its linear scaling with system size. At the same time, it produces a very broad distribution of magic over trajectories, with a sizable fraction of trajectories retaining Haar-random magic. Since the cost of stabilizer-based classical simulation grows exponentially with the magic of the state, these high-magic trajectories, rather than the average, control the simulation cost. Our results delineate the potential and the limitations of unraveling optimization as a route to the classical simulation of noisy quantum dynamics with stabilizer methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声量子电路的量子轨迹描述并非唯一，不同的Kraus表示定义了不同的展开。本文研究了在局部退相干噪声下，Haar随机和T掺杂随机Clifford砖块电路的量子轨迹展开中的非稳定性（“魔力”）。研究发现，通过与状态无关的Kraus算符选择，轨迹平均的“魔力”可以显著降低。最优选择通常不是投影测量展开，而是一种两结果的广义测量。
authors: Sara Santos, Alessio Paviglianiti, Vincenzo Savona

articles.title: Representation-split Carleman lattice Boltzmann with near-unit step success probability on quantum computers
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上具有接近单位步成功概率的表示分裂Carleman格子玻尔兹曼方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20620v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Carleman lattice Boltzmann method replaces the quadratic collision of the lattice Boltzmann equation by a linear map on a lifted state. Existing block encodings of this map succeed with probability 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻² per step, so that the probability of a multi-step evolution decays exponentially with the number of steps. This study develops multi-relaxation-time Carleman lattice Boltzmann, a representation split in which the Carleman-lifted collision is performed in a moment basis on the amplitude-encoded state, while streaming remains a permutation in population space. The level-2 hierarchy closes under collision but not under streaming, which generates the work of pressure, advection and stress on the momentum flux. The state therefore remains the full pair array, and the moment representation is an orthogonal change of basis of the population one, with identical dynamics and truncation error. The operator to be block encoded changes with the basis, and with it the success probability of a quantum step. In the weighted Hermite basis with the amplitude encoding fᵢ/sqrtwᵢ, the relaxation is a diagonal operator of norm one, and the level-2 collision stage becomes this diagonal plus a sparse coupling from products of conserved moments. A structured block encoding of this form raises the single-step success probability on the D2Q9 lattice from 10⁻² for the best population encoding to 0.98. With the pair sector in relative coordinates and scaled, one step requires O(łog² N) Toffoli gates and is verified by statevector simulation. The encoding and readout overhead of a T-step run is then polynomial in T and N rather than accumulating a factor p^T. For resolved flows, the remaining exponential loss in coherent multi-step Carleman lattice Boltzmann evolution is set by the non-equilibrium norm relaxed by dissipation rather than by the block encoding.
articles.abstract_zh: Carleman格子玻尔兹曼方法将格子玻尔兹曼方程的二次碰撞替换为提升态上的线性映射。现有方法的单步成功概率较低，导致多步演化概率呈指数衰减。本研究提出了一种多弛豫时间Carleman格子玻尔兹曼方法，通过在矩基下对振幅编码态执行Carleman提升碰撞，显著提高了量子步的成功概率。在加权Hermite基下，弛豫是一个范数为一的对角算符。
authors: Hua-Dong Yao, Sauro Succi

articles.title: Finite-cutoff geometry from double-scaled SYK
articles.title_zh: 双尺度SYK模型中的有限截断几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20703v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a finite-cutoff holographic description of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We construct microscopic deformations of Kourkoulou-Maldacena and thermofield-double SYK states whose double-scaling limits reproduce a lower-dimensional analogue of TøverlineT and TøverlineT+Łambda₂ deformations, which we denote T² and T²⁺Łambda₁, respectively. The ensemble-averaged theory describes wormhole states in finite-cutoff sine dilaton gravity, and finite-cutoff anti-de Sitter and de Sitter geometries in the low- and high-energy regimes, respectively. The analysis includes both perturbative and non-perturbative solutions to the energy spectrum flow equation, and the regions behind and beyond the respective horizons. Only the perturbative branch admits physical quantum states. We study how to incorporate end-of-the-world (ETW) branes in the finite cutoff holographic dictionary. The ETW brane leads to an additional boundary theory deformation, which leads to black hole or eternal traversable wormhole geometries depending on the existence of normalizable bound states. We extend the finite cutoff length evaluations for constant mean curvature (CMC) slices, and interpret them as complexity in the boundary theory. We discuss possible extensions with matter. Our results provide a microscopic framework for studying the finite-cutoff boundaries, CMC slices and branes in the holographic dictionary of DSSYK.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了双尺度SYK（DSSYK）模型的有限截断全息描述。通过构建Kourkoulou-Maldacena和热场双SYK态的微观形变，其双尺度极限再现了T²和T²⁺Λ₁形变。系综平均理论描述了有限截断正弦膨胀引力中的虫洞态，以及低能和高能区域的有限截断反德西特和德西特几何。研究还探讨了如何在有限截断全息字典中引入世界末日（ETW）膜。
authors: Sergio E. Aguilar-Gutierrez

articles.title: Boundary-induced geometrical frustration in a square Rydberg-atom lattice
articles.title_zh: 方形里德堡原子晶格中边界诱导的几何挫折
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20723v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study geometric defects in square-lattice Rydberg-atom arrays induced by lattice-size parity in the striated density-wave phase. While odd-sized lattices select a single striated domain, even-sized lattices seed incompatible domains at the four corners, resulting in a π/2-rotation invariant state with a geometrical defect emanating from the lattice center. At larger detunings, we instead identify a π-rotation-invariant state with two domains nucleated by opposite corners and separated by a one-dimensional diagonal defect. We probe the state-preparation protocol on the Aquila atomic quantum processor and benchmark it with equilibrium and real-time dynamics tensor-network simulations. Our results assess the role of boundaries and lattice size in determining the global ordering in programmable quantum matter.
