articles.title: Post-Quantum Secure Aggregation via Code-Based Homomorphic Encryption
articles.title_zh: 基于码本同态加密的后量子安全聚合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13031v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Secure aggregation lets a server learn the sum of inputs from multiple users without learning individual contributions. Recent single-server protocols achieve this with key- and message-additive homomorphic encryption (KAHE), but existing instantiations rely on lattice assumptions. We instantiate a KAHE from the Learning Parity with Noise (LPN) assumption and analyze the challenges that arise with the Hamming metric. Decryption of the aggregate amounts to decoding over a q-ary symmetric channel whose crossover probability grows with the number of users. Security under leakage of the key sum reduces to LPN with a noise rate that is quadratic in the KAHE noise rate, and a matching attack shows that this loss is inherent when all but two users collude. Asymptotically, we characterize the optimal communication cost in closed form, showing that the overhead over the raw payload vanishes as the input length grows, and decouple the field size from the input range via the Chinese remainder theorem. In cross-silo settings, our protocol requires less communication than information-theoretically secure aggregation for moderate to high collusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 安全聚合允许服务器了解多个用户的输入总和，而不学习单个贡献。现有协议依赖于格点假设，本研究从带噪声奇偶校验（LPN）假设实例化了密钥和消息可加同态加密（KAHE），并分析了汉明度量带来的挑战。聚合解密相当于在交叉概率随用户数量增长的q元对称信道上进行解码。在密钥和泄漏下的安全性归结为LPN，其噪声率是KAHE噪声率的平方，并证明了通信开销随输入长度增长而消失。

articles.title: Rare Event Simulation of Quantum Error-Correcting Circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错电路的稀有事件模拟
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2237 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-15-2237 We describe a practical approach for accessing the logical failure rates of quantum error-correcting (QEC) circuits under low physical (component) failure rate regimes. Standard Monte Carlo is often the de facto approach for studying the failure rates of quantum circuits. However, in the study of fault-tolerant error-correcting circuits, the ability to extend this approach to low physical failure rates is limited. In particular, the use of Monte Carlo to access circuits that are relatively large or have high correcting power becomes more difficult as we lower the input failure rates of the individual components (gates) in the circuit. For these reasons, many simulations studying the circuit model go no lower than end-to-end logical failure rates in the 10⁻⁶ regime. In this report, we outline an approach that borrows from earlier work by Bravyi and Vargo [ 6 ] to the more complex circuit noise model. Earlier works studied both the capacity and phenomenological noise models [ 6 , 3 , 5 ], but the work is insufficient for generating similar simulations in the circuit-noise model. To the best of our knowledge, our team is the first to develop a full prescription of the rare event simulation by splitting technique for the circuit-based noise model. We have also generated promising results that are confirmed by standard Monte Carlo simulation under an accessible regime. This work shows that we can access noise in the circuit-model prescription of quantum error-correcting code to failure rates below 10⁻²⁰ regime.

articles.title: Asymmetric quantum Rabi model, trap-dipole resonance, and quantum gates with optically trapped ultracold polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 光学捕获超冷极性分子的非对称量子拉比模型、陷阱-偶极共振和量子门
articles.abstract: Optically trapped ultracold polar molecules can have multiple long-lived states for coding quantum information, and can exhibit electric dipole-dipole interactions (DDI) which enable entanglement generation. The general understanding on the quantized motion (QM) of optically trapped molecules is that it causes fluctuation of DDI. Here, we find that the molecular QM can realize an asymmetric quantum Rabi model, which is of specific importance in the study of fundamental physics. The molecular QM can also lead to an exotic trap-dipole resonance, resulting in excess population loss to uncoupled motional states, and, hence, should be avoided in a general quantum control over polar molecules. To examine the impact of QM on quantum computing based on polar molecules, we introduce two protocols, (1) a one-pulse iSWAP gate which can be realized by a global microwave pulse, and (2) a controlled-phase gate with an arbitrary controlled phase. Both gates can attain a high fidelity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了光学捕获超冷极性分子的量子化运动（QM）对量子信息处理的影响。研究发现分子QM可以实现非对称量子拉比模型，并导致一种特殊的陷阱-偶极共振，后者应在量子控制中避免。为评估QM对基于极性分子的量子计算的影响，论文提出了两种高保真度的量子门协议：单脉冲iSWAP门和任意受控相位的受控相位门。

articles.title: Quantum Mpemba effect: anomalous relaxation of multi-spin system under local noise
articles.title_zh: 量子姆潘巴效应：局域噪声下多自旋系统的反常弛豫
articles.abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect (QMPE) is characterized by a state initially farther from equilibrium relaxing faster than one closer to it. In this work, we investigate the QMPE in an open central-spin model, and examine whether the QMPE emerges when the spins’ system is subjected to their independent noisy environment for different initial states. Simultaneously, we analyze the influence of the noisy environment on the dynamics and demonstrate that tuning local noise strengths can induce the QMPE. Furthermore, we systematically explore finite-size effects by varying the number of peripheral spins. In addition, we investigate the Pontus Mpemba effect within the same framework, demonstrating that an auxiliary decohering environment can accelerate the approach to stationarity. To observe the effect, we select the trace distance, energy, and -norm coherence as observables. By combining initial-state engineering (global rotation operations) with the modulation of the noisy environment, we clearly reveal the physical mechanisms for inducing and controlling the QMPE in this model. Our results show that both rotating the initial states and applying non-uniform local noises can alter the relaxation rate ordering among different states, leading to crossings in the evolution curves of various physical quantities, that is, the realization of the QMPE. This finding provides a new perspective for manipulating anomalous relaxation behavior in the quantum many-body system and open quantum system.

articles.title: Invertible subalgebras for chiral semion topological order
articles.title_zh: 手性半子拓扑序的可逆子代数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral topological order is incompatible with strictly two-dimensional local commuting-projector Hamiltonians on finite-dimensional tensor-product Hilbert spaces. Invertible subalgebras (ISAs) provide an alternative framework. We construct an ISA supporting chiral semions, together with its anti-semion commutant, on a square lattice with one qubit per edge. We give explicit non-Pauli generators for both algebras and prove that together they generate all local operators on the Hilbert space. Starting from the Z₄ toric code, we condense the boson e²m² and identify the semion and anti-semion algebras. We then decompose each Z₄ qudit into two qubits and use a finite-depth circuit to disentangle one qubit per edge fixed by the condensation constraints. Pumping the semion ISA along the z direction defines an explicit three-dimensional non-Clifford quantum cellular automaton (QCA). We show that pumping eight times is equivalent to a translation followed by a finite-depth quantum circuit with ancillary qubits. We also give an explicit finite-depth circuit relating this construction to the semion QCA previously obtained from topological quantum field theory. A similar condensation construction yields a U(1)₄ ISA on a square lattice. Together with the semion and earlier odd-prime ISAs, finite stacking realizes every pointed Witt class of bosonic Abelian anyon theories. Finally, we extend both constructions to all spatial dimensions d=4k-2, with one qubit or Z₄ qudit on each (2k-1)-cell for the semion or U(1)₄ ISA, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性拓扑序与严格二维的局域对易投影哈密顿量不兼容，该文提出可逆子代数（ISA）作为替代框架。作者在方格晶格上构建了一个支持手性半子及其反半子对易子的ISA，并给出了显式的非泡利生成元。通过Z₄环面码的凝聚和量子比特分解，该工作还定义了一个三维非Clifford量子元胞自动机，并展示了其与先前获得的半子QCA的关联。

articles.title: Logical gate set tomography
articles.title_zh: 逻辑门集层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) can strongly suppress noise, but predicting whether a computation succeeds requires understanding not only how much effective noise persists after QEC, but what form that noise takes. To thoroughly characterize this noise, we introduce logical gate set tomography (``logical GST''). Logical GST produces detailed representations of noisy logical operations that can be used to derive higher-level metrics, such as gate fidelity and diamond distance, and to test for non-Markovian and coherent logical errors. We use logical GST to obtain the first full, self-consistent characterization of a universal single-qubit logical gate set, implemented in the seven-qubit Steane code using Quantinuum System Model H1, a 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum processor. In the experimental data from H1, logical GST identified predominantly logical Pauli-stochastic errors, found no evidence of logical non-Markovianity, and detected weak potential signatures of coherent logical error. By contrast, higher-shot datasets generated with Quantinuum's detailed system emulator, identify mechanisms for weak but statistically significant logical non-Markovianity and strong evidence of coherent logical error. Finally, we use logical GST to perform error attribution with the system emulator, revealing how specific physical error sources shape logical error mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错能有效抑制噪声，但要预测计算成功率，需理解纠错后残余噪声的性质。该文引入了逻辑门集层析成像（logical GST）技术，用于详细表征噪声逻辑操作，并推导高层度量。通过在Quantinuum System Model H1上对七量子比特Steane码实现通用单量子比特逻辑门集进行实验，logical GST识别出主要是逻辑泡利随机误差，未发现逻辑非马尔可夫性，并检测到弱的相干逻辑误差迹象。
authors: Piper C. Wysocki, Juan Gonzalez De Mendoza, Karl Mayer, Natalie C. Brown, Ciaran Ryan-Anderson, Jalan A. Ziyad, Jordan H. Hines, Daniel G. Hothem, Corey I. Ostrove, Timothy J. Proctor, Kevin C. Young, Robin J. Blume-Kohout, Charles H. Baldwin, Kenneth M. Rudinger

articles.title: The Generalized BEADS Representation: An Informationally Complete Visualization of Mixed Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 广义BEADS表示：混合量子态的信息完备可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A deep understanding of quantum information theory is essential for quantum science and technology. However, quantum mechanics and particularly quantum information theory suffer from a lack of intuitive images. Visualization tools offer novel perspectives on many problems in quantum physics by revealing important properties of quantum states and processes that are otherwise obscured by abstract mathematical formalisms. Here, we extend the previously established BEADS representation of pure states to the so-called generalized BEADS representation of mixed quantum states. We introduce spherical functions, so-called beads to visualize correlation structures of mixed quantum states. A recursive optimization scheme is used to obtain minimum-entanglement pure state decompositions of all subsystems of a given N-qubit state. We show how correlation function components can be decomposed into individual contributions that directly correspond to different types of correlations of mixed states. This allows us to visually characterize the total correlation, genuine n-partite entanglement, nonclassical quantum-discord-type correlations as well as classical correlations. After outlining the mathematical details relevant for constructing the representation, we examine the generalized BEADS representations for various classes of mixed states including product, classically correlated, separable but nonclassically correlated, as well as entangled states. As exemplary applications of the generalized BEADS representation, we showcase entanglement distillation and the effects of noise channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信息理论缺乏直观图像，限制了对其的深入理解。该文将纯态的BEADS表示扩展到混合量子态的广义BEADS表示，引入球形函数（珠子）来可视化混合量子态的关联结构。通过递归优化方案，该方法能够获得给定N量子比特态所有子系统的最小纠缠纯态分解，并分解关联函数分量以表征总关联、真实n体纠缠和非经典量子失谐型关联。
authors: Celina Bräutigam, Steffen J. Glaser, Dennis Huber

articles.title: The cost of classically simulating quantum communication is as high as it could be
articles.title_zh: 经典模拟量子通信的成本可能达到最高
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A long-standing open question is to characterize the classical communication cost of simulating the correlations arising from measurements on finite-dimensional quantum systems. We consider this question in the prepare-and-measure scenario. First we construct a classical simulation model involving a finite average number of bits of one-way communication that simulates exactly the correlations arising from arbitrary d-dimensional quantum states and arbitrary measurements. Second, we show that no classical simulation protocol involving a finite average message dimension can exist for d≥ 4, hence strengthening a recent result of de Gois, Santos and Vieira. Our first result relies on a more general simulation theorem which can be applied to certain continuous variable (i.e. infinite-dimensional) quantum systems, and even beyond quantum theory, e.g. to generalized probabilistic theories. In particular, we show that multimode Gaussian states of bounded average energy and general Gaussian measurements admit an exact classical simulation with a finite expected number of bits. Overall, our results show that the classical simulation cost of quantum communication is essentially as high as it could be.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文探讨了模拟有限维量子系统测量关联所需的经典通信成本。研究首先构建了一个经典模拟模型，该模型通过有限平均比特的单向通信精确模拟任意d维量子态和测量的关联。其次，研究证明对于d≥4，不存在涉及有限平均消息维度的经典模拟协议，从而强化了现有结果。这些结果表明，经典模拟量子通信的成本可能达到其理论上限。
authors: Riccardo Castellano, Pavel Sekatski, Nicolas Brunner

articles.title: A modular quantum computer based on Cornucopia codes
articles.title_zh: 基于丰饶角码的模块化量子计算机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra-high-rate quantum error correction codes can store many logical qubits in a single code block with few physical qubits. A fault-tolerant quantum computer, however, also requires a universal set of logical operations on individually addressable logical qubits, and the ancilla overhead of these operations may erode the advantage of the high encoding rate. Here, we propose the Cornucopia architecture, in which a universal set of logical operations is implemented at low overhead for the Cornucopia codes. In particular, we focus on the [[2844,1426,18]] Cornucopia code as an example and introduce a modular quantum computer built from such code blocks connected by bridges. Each block stores 1,426 logical qubits and serves as a universal logical processor. Exploiting the code's translation symmetry, we construct a family of reusable gadgets that individually address 1,422 logical qubits within each block. These gadgets support three universal logical instruction sets: basic, high-throughput and fixed-extractor. Excluding magic-state factories, a module with sufficient workspace to execute any instruction in the basic set requires an average of 4.1 physical qubits per logical qubit, compared with 3.0 for memory alone. The architecture thus preserves the resource advantage of ultra-high-rate quantum memory while enabling universal logical computation, providing a route towards low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 超高编码率量子纠错码能以少量物理量子比特存储大量逻辑量子比特，但容错量子计算机还需要低开销的通用逻辑操作。该文提出了丰饶角（Cornucopia）架构，以低开销实现丰饶角码的通用逻辑操作。以[[2844,1426,18]]丰饶角码为例，构建了一个由代码块通过桥接连接的模块化量子计算机，每个模块存储1426个逻辑量子比特并作为通用逻辑处理器。
authors: Zhide Lu, Weikang Li, Yinghao Ma, Hanyu Yan, Bingrun Wang, Yixuan Ma, Zheng-Zhi Sun, Dong-Ling Deng

articles.title: Retrieving Metrological Information from Noisy Squeezed Spin States via Bayesian Optimization
articles.title_zh: 通过贝叶斯优化从含噪声压缩自旋态中提取计量信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frequency inhomogeneity can obscure the metrological advantage of squeezed spin states, making the choice of readout crucial. We study interacting spin-1/2 ensembles with static local frequency disorder and optimize a common collective readout over independent disorder realizations. Using Bayesian optimization of the full measurement-outcome distribution, we identify observables combining dipole and quadrupole operators that yield greater classical Fisher information than the optimized dipole readout considered here. For ensembles of up to 17 spins, their disorder-averaged CFI surpasses the standard quantum limit at both disorder strengths studied, including a regime where the dipole readout remains below it. For the larger ensembles studied, fixing the encoding axis to the direction that maximizes the disorder-averaged quantum Fisher information retains nearly the same performance. These results identify a route to extracting metrological information from frequency-disordered spin ensembles through the choice of collective observable.
articles.abstract_zh: 频率不均匀性会掩盖压缩自旋态的计量优势，因此读出方式至关重要。该文研究了具有静态局域频率无序的相互作用自旋-1/2系综，并通过贝叶斯优化集体读出方式。研究发现，结合偶极和四极算符的观测值能产生比优化偶极读出更大的经典费舍尔信息，并且在所研究的无序强度下，其无序平均CFI超越了标准量子极限。
authors: Enze Li, Yunjie Cai, Jingwei Zhang, Emi Yukawa

articles.title: Dynamical Decoupling of Nonclassical States in a Biased-Noise Spin Qudit
articles.title_zh: 偏置噪声自旋量子位中非经典态的动态解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Encoding quantum information in d-dimensional systems (qudits) with d>2 offers appealing new directions for resource-efficient quantum computing. However, protecting the coherence of nonclassical qudit resource states remains an open challenge. Dynamical decoupling (DD) is a well-established technique for extending coherence, but its application to qudits is hindered by the quadratic scaling of the decoupling sequence overhead with the dimension d. As a result, demonstrations of qudit DD have so far been limited to low-dimensional qudits. Here, we show that noise-biased qudits enable a nontrivial reduction of this overhead, for example, from quadratic to linear. We perform qudit DD on a model d=8 qudit, the nuclear spin of an antimony donor in silicon. We benchmark DD performance on highly nonclassical states such as uniform superpositions, cat states, and Haar random states and measure coherence improvements up to a factor 5 to 10. For a spin-cat error correction code, continuous DD extends the coherence time of the logical superposition |+ångle_L to 225~ms, compared to 19~ms under free evolution and 85~ms with a Hahn echo. This improvement shows that DD sequences tailored to a system's noise bias can significantly enhance the lifetime of encoded logical qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 将量子信息编码在d>2维量子位中可提高量子计算的资源效率，但保护非经典量子位态的相干性仍是挑战。动态解耦（DD）技术在量子位中的应用受限于其与维度d的二次方开销。该文展示了噪声偏置量子位能将DD开销从二次方降低到线性，并在d=8的锑掺杂硅核自旋量子位上实现了DD。实验表明，DD将非经典态的相干性提高了5到10倍，并显著延长了逻辑叠加态的相干时间。
authors: Arjen Vaartjes, Namit Anand, Rocky Y. Su, Akram Youssry, Ritik Sareen, Jeffrey Marshall, Mark R. van Blankenstein, Danielle Holmes, Benjamin Wilhelm, Bibek Pokharel, Xi Yu, Laura A. O'Neill, Martin Nurizzo, Alexander M. Jakob, Fay E. Hudson, Kohei M. Itoh, Andrew S. Dzurak, David N. Jamieson, Andrea Morello

articles.title: Quantum-enhanced phase interrogation of a fiber-optic strain sensor
articles.title_zh: 光纤应变传感器的量子增强相位询问
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fiber-optic sensors enable high-sensitivity measurements of various physical parameters. Here, we demonstrate a quantum-enhanced interrogation of an all-fiber-optic Fabry-Perot resonator, employing entangled two-photon interference to probe directly strain-induced optical phase shifts. The resonator is interrogated by a narrow-linewidth laser that is frequency-locked to its resonance mode, thereby exploiting the cavity's inherent sensitivity to variations in the fiber length. To access the phase fluctuations transferred to the interrogation field due to external perturbations on the sensor, we implement an in-fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometer readout. This configuration allows the sensor to operate both with classical coherent light and with entangled photon pairs generated via spontaneous parametric down-conversion. Harnessing two-photon entangled states corresponding to an N = 2 NOON state, we experimentally demonstrate a reduction of the measurement noise below the standard quantum limit. These results provide clear evidence of the quantum advantage in enhancing fiber-optic sensors under practical constraints on optical power.
articles.abstract_zh: 光纤传感器可实现高灵敏度物理参数测量。该文展示了对全光纤法布里-珀罗谐振器的量子增强询问，利用纠缠双光子干涉直接探测应变引起的光学相移。通过使用N=2 NOON态的纠缠双光子态，实验证明测量噪声可降低至标准量子极限以下。这些结果清晰地证明了在实际光功率限制下，量子优势在增强光纤传感器方面的潜力。
authors: Romain Dalidet, Marialuisa Capezzuto, Hugo Degert, Davide D'Ambrosio, Saverio Avino, Anthony Martin, Sebastien Tanzilli, Laurent Labonte, Paolo De Natale, Gianluca Gagliardi

articles.title: Tomography for coherent noise
articles.title_zh: 相干噪声层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent noise poses a fundamentally greater challenge to quantum error correction than independent s- tochastic Pauli errors, because unitary errors preserve interference between error paths, can accumulate over multiple quantum error correction rounds, and leave the encoded logical channel with a residual coherent com- ponent. If the parameters of such coherent noise can be accurately determined, this knowledge can be exploited to inject correlated priors into the decoding graph, and to perform maximum-likelihood decoding under poly- nomially tractable structures, significantly improving the accuracy of syndrome-based decoding. In this work, we introduce one protocol to determine the model and parameters of coherent noise, and reduce the complexity of the experiment from 16nto O(16), which is of great significance for correcting coherent noise in quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干噪声对量子纠错构成比随机泡利误差更大的挑战，因为它会积累并留下残余相干分量。该文提出了一种确定相干噪声模型和参数的协议，并将实验复杂度从16ⁿ降低到O(16)。准确确定相干噪声参数有助于将其注入解码图，从而显著提高基于综合征解码的准确性，对量子纠错中的相干噪声校正具有重要意义。
authors: Long Huang

articles.title: Majorana Edge Modes Reshape Kibble-Zurek Scaling in Kitaev Honeycomb Ribbons
articles.title_zh: 马约拉纳边缘模式重塑Kitaev蜂窝状纳米带中的Kibble-Zurek标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent progress in programmable quantum simulators motivates exact benchmarks for nonequilibrium dynamics in topological quantum matter. We study the Kitaev honeycomb model driven through its critical regions by a linear ramp of the bond coupling J_z over a ramp time τ, comparing zigzag and armchair ribbons with fully periodic tubes. The production of excitations exhibits a geometry-dependent finite-size crossover controlled by N₂/sqrtτ, the ratio of the ribbon width to the Kibble--Zurek length. Periodic tubes obey the expected critical-line Kibble--Zurek scaling and serve as the boundary-free benchmark. Zigzag ribbons follow the same scaling until defect production is exponentially suppressed by a finite-width algebraic gap floor associated with the formation of Majorana edge modes, whose occupation is pinned by inversion parity. Armchair ribbons instead support transient Majorana edge modes with exponentially small gaps, producing width-parity-dependent defect plateaus: exactly one defect per unit length for odd widths and an approximate, transient plateau near one half for even widths. The quench-generated entanglement entropy and fermionic logarithmic negativity inherit the same geometry-dependent structure, and the negativity further distinguishes the coherence-borne entanglement of the Kibble--Zurek regime from the population-borne entanglement of the edge-mode plateaus. These results identify boundary Majorana modes as the mechanism controlling departures from ideal Kibble--Zurek dynamics and provide geometry-resolved benchmarks for programmable simulations of topological matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用可编程量子模拟器，探讨了Kitaev蜂窝模型在通过临界区域时的非平衡动力学。结果显示，激发产生表现出几何依赖的有限尺寸交叉，受纳米带宽度与Kibble-Zurek长度之比控制。锯齿形纳米带中，马约拉纳边缘模式的形成会指数级抑制缺陷产生，而扶手椅形纳米带则支持瞬态马约拉纳边缘模式，导致缺陷平台依赖于宽度奇偶性。
authors: Hyesung Choi, Antonio Mandarino, Mahn-Soo Choi

articles.title: Photon Demultiplexing Using Spatial Routing
articles.title_zh: 基于空间路由的光子解复用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial sectioning of the far-field noncollinear field from spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) is a promising approach for multiparty quantum communication. Although demonstrations with six pairs of users have been reported, the fundamental limits remain unknown. These include the maximum number of channels, the required degree of channel optimization, and the dependence on input parameters. In this paper, we provide a practical framework that answers these questions by connecting input parameters and invoking a design theorem. For a representative configuration, we realize 12 user-pair channels with routing consistency exceeding 0.9999 at a 12% reduction in photon flux. We further show that sectioning improves the accidental-coincidence budget linearly with the number of channels N, allowing the aggregate key rate to scale with the user count. These results provide a design strategy for spatial-division multiplexing of entangled photons analogous to the channel-spacing standards used in wavelength-division networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用自发参量下转换（SPDC）远场非共线场进行空间分段的光子解复用方法，旨在实现多方量子通信。研究建立了一个连接输入参数并引入设计定理的实用框架，以确定最大通道数、所需通道优化程度以及对输入参数的依赖性。该方法还线性改善了意外符合预算，使总密钥速率随用户数量扩展，为纠缠光子的空分复用提供了设计策略。
authors: Hashir Kuniyil, Asad Ali, Saif Al-Kuwari

articles.title: Advances in quantum optomechanical control based on cavity cold-atom systems
articles.title_zh: 基于腔冷原子系统的量子光力学控制进展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cavity optomechanics represents a frontier research direction in quantum science and technology, centered on the control and exploration of interactions between electromagnetic fields and mechanical motion. Rooted in quantum mechanics, this field realizes efficient coupling and precise manipulation of optical fields and mechanical vibrations through the structural design and precise regulation of optical microcavities and mechanical oscillators, thereby revealing and harnessing novel quantum phenomena. In recent years, cavity optomechanics has evolved into an interdisciplinary frontier integrating quantum optics, condensed matter physics, and quantum precision measurement, exhibiting profound application in both fundamental physics research and quantum information science. With advancements in technologies such as nanomanufacturing and laser cooling, optomechanical interactions have been successfully demonstrated in various experimental systems. Among these platforms, cavity cold-atom systems stand out as one of the ideal platforms for implementing quantum optomechanics. Featuring exceptional environmental isolation, long quantum coherence times, and strong light-matter interaction, these systems provide a crucial testbed for exploring strong and even ultrastrong optomechanical coupling effects as well as rich nonlinear quantum phenomena. This paper reviews the recent progress in optomechanical control and manipulation based on cavity cold-atom systems. We first outline the fundamental principles of standard cavity optomechanical systems. Then, we describe the experimental realization of linear and nonlinear optomechanical couplings in cold-atom systems. After that, we focus on the representative applications of this platform in high-precision quantum sensing, quantum memory, and the preparation of macroscopic nonclassical states. Finally, we give an outlook and challenges in this field.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔光力学是量子科学与技术的前沿领域，专注于控制和探索电磁场与机械运动之间的相互作用。该领域通过光学微腔和机械振荡器的结构设计与精确调控，实现光场与机械振动的有效耦合和精确操控。腔冷原子系统因其卓越的环境隔离和长量子相干性，被认为是实现量子光力学的理想平台之一。
authors: Baijun Li, Tianxiang Lu, Jie Wang, Hui Jing

articles.title: Strong subadditivity of topological entropy on the torus: Rényi order and non-Abelian structure
articles.title_zh: 环面上拓扑熵的强次可加性：Rényi阶数与非阿贝尔结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We classify strong subadditivity for the canonical topological Rényi functional at finite positive orders on an unpunctured torus in the topological quantum field theory of any finite unitary modular tensor category. Universal validity means validity for all pure ground states and all regular region pairs with transverse or disjoint boundaries and compatible corner rounding. At von Neumann order one, the inequality holds universally. For each fixed order strictly between zero and one, universal validity is equivalent to pointedness, meaning that every simple anyon type has quantum dimension one. For every nonpointed category and each finite positive order other than one, we construct a violating pure state and an allowed pair. For a fixed pointed category and fixed order above one, universal validity is equivalent to a same-order modular Fourier entropy bound for every pure state. Global homological constraints on actual unions and intersections and established weighted modular uncertainty prove the order-one theorem. For parallel annuli at fixed flux distribution, the order-one functional is affine in their positive count. At other orders, unequal quantum dimensions on the occupied support induce strict curvature that suitable overlapping regions convert into negative deficits. Under the boundary-charge cutting prescription, the von Neumann theorem extends to arbitrary logical density matrices in the same ground space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在任意有限酉模张量范畴的拓扑量子场论中，对未穿孔环面上有限正阶规范拓扑Rényi泛函的强次可加性进行了分类。研究发现，在冯诺依曼一阶时，该不等式普遍成立。对于介于零和一之间的固定阶数，普遍有效性等价于“尖点性”，即每个简单任意子类型具有量子维度一。对于非尖点范畴和除一之外的每个有限正阶，研究构造了一个违反纯态和允许对。
authors: Yi Liang

articles.title: Loss-Tolerant Measurement-Device-Independent QKD over Untrusted Repeaters via High-Dimensional Time-Bin Multiplexing
articles.title_zh: 基于高维时间复用的抗损耗测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议通过不可信中继器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a loss-tolerant measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol using time-bin-multiplexed single photons entangled with local qubits stored in nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers. In each round, Alice and Bob each send a single multiplexed photon to an untrusted intermediary, Charlie. Each photon first becomes entangled with Charlie's NV-center qubits; Charlie then performs entanglement swapping between his NV qubits to establish EPR pairs between Alice's and Bob's local qubits. With d time bins per photon, łog₂ d + 1 EPR pairs can be generated per transmitted photon, substantially increasing the probability of EPR-pair creation under limited channel bandwidth. To further mitigate the effects of prolonged memory storage, the protocol employs a memory-insensitive (MI) architecture, where multiple banks of qubits and multiplexed photon routing reduce the effective memory lifetime requirements. This approach enhances loss tolerance, enabling higher secret key rates and secure key distribution over longer distances compared to conventional single-photon protocols. Using the Lo-Chau EPR-QKD framework and Shor-Preskill reduction, we prove that the protocol is secure without trusting intermediate nodes, making it suitable for quantum networks with untrusted repeaters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种抗损耗的测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议，该协议利用与氮空位（NV）中心存储的局部量子比特纠缠的时间复用单光子。通过每个光子使用d个时间箱，每次传输可生成log₂d + 1个EPR对，显著提高了在有限信道带宽下EPR对的创建概率。为缓解长时间存储的影响，协议采用了一种存储不敏感（MI）架构，增强了抗损耗能力，实现了更高的密钥速率和更长距离的安全密钥分发。
authors: Yu-Chun Yin, Ching-Yi Lai, Alexei Ashikhmin

articles.title: A hybrid quantum interferometer bridging Hong-Ou-Mandel and N00N-state interference
articles.title_zh: 连接Hong-Ou-Mandel和N00N态干涉的混合量子干涉仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference offers robustness in high-noise environments due to its phase-insensitive nature, while N00N-state interference provides enhanced phase sensitivity for precision measurements in low-noise settings. However, their realizations have typically required separate experimental platforms. Here, we report a single hybrid quantum interferometer that can dynamically transition between HOM and N00N-state interference by adjusting two time delays, τ₁ and τ₂. This tunability enables operation in phase-insensitive, phase-sensitive, or hybrid modes within a unified setup, as confirmed by theoretical analysis and experimental demonstration. Our system offers a versatile platform with potential for quantum sensing applications, paving the way for integrated quantum technologies capable of adapting to diverse noise conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) 干涉在噪声环境中具有鲁棒性，而N00N态干涉则提供增强的相位灵敏度，但两者通常需要独立的实验平台。本文报道了一种单一的混合量子干涉仪，通过调整两个时间延迟，可以动态地在HOM和N00N态干涉之间转换。这种可调谐性使得该系统能够在统一的设置中以相位不敏感、相位敏感或混合模式运行，为量子传感应用提供了一个多功能平台。
authors: Zi-Qi Zeng, Samuel Corona-Aquino, Tao Xie, Bin Yin, Yan Guo, Yukun Song, Yun Meng, Kai Zou, Song Li, Xiaolong Hu, Alfred B. U'Ren, Roberto de J. León-Montiel, Chenglong You, Baihong Li, Dongzhou Wang, Rui-Bo Jin

articles.title: Petz Recovery through a Single Polar Transformation for Approximate Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 通过单一极变换实现近似量子纠错中的Petz恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Petz recovery map provides a near optimal decoder for approximate quantum error correction, but its inverse square-root normalization complicates circuit implementation. We use the polar structure of the Petz recovery isometry to implement recovery through a single quantum singular value transformation (QSVT). We give explicit block-encoding circuits and an extended recovery isometry that yields approximate Petz recovery without postselection. We bound the diamond distance between the approximate and ideal Petz encoding-recovery channels in terms of a spectrum-weighted loss, which provides a channel specific objective for optimizing the QSVT angles. Uniform polynomial approximation yields an asymptotic error bound that decays exponentially with the number of QSVT iterations, at a rate controlled by the smallest nonzero scaled singular value. Applications to Haar-random encoding and the Hayden-Preskill protocol illustrate the tradeoff between circuit depth and recovery accuracy and place existing scrambling decoders within a common Petz recovery framework.
articles.abstract_zh: Petz恢复映射为近似量子纠错提供了一个近乎最优的解码器，但其逆平方根归一化使其电路实现复杂。本文利用Petz恢复等距的极结构，通过单一量子奇异值变换（QSVT）实现恢复。研究给出了显式块编码电路和扩展恢复等距，实现了无需后选择的近似Petz恢复。通过谱加权损耗来限制近似与理想Petz编码-恢复信道之间的钻石距离，并展示了QSVT迭代次数增加时误差界限呈指数衰减。
authors: Hanzhang Zhao, Shenglong Xu

articles.title: Stabilizer entropy cones as self-dual slices of linear rank cones: a five-party gap and dependence on the local dimension
articles.title_zh: 稳定子熵锥作为线性秩锥的自对偶切片：五方差距与对局部维度的依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18905v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement entropies of multipartite pure states satisfy linear inequalities; for stabilizer states, the backbone of quantum error correction, the achievable entropy vectors generate a convex cone. We show that, after a linear lift, the closure of this cone is exactly the self-dual slice of a classical object on one more element than there are parties: the closed cone generated by the rank functions of arrangements of subspaces over GF(d) for a prime local dimension d, and of subgroups of abelian groups of exponent dividing d in general. This correspondence brings two features of rank inequalities into play. First, the purifier acts as an extra variable: already for five parties the stabilizer cone is strictly smaller than the quantum linear rank cone, with which earlier evidence suggested it might coincide; an explicit six-variable inequality witnesses the gap. Second, the characteristic of the field enters, so the cone depends on the local dimension. It does not for up to four parties. With enough parties, the cone of Z_d qudits is contained in that of Zd' qudits if and only if d divides d', and already for six parties the logical zero state of Steane's code lies outside the stabilizer cone of every odd local dimension. For this last result we show that the seven-variable characteristic-dependent inequalities we checked all follow from Shannon inequalities on the self-dual slice, and instead transfer one of them through a family of subgroups derived from the Fano plane.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体纯态的纠缠熵满足线性不等式，对于量子纠错的核心——稳定子态，可实现的熵向量生成一个凸锥。本文证明，经过线性提升后，该锥的闭包恰好是经典对象（比参与方多一个元素）的自对偶切片。研究发现，对于五方系统，稳定子锥严格小于量子线性秩锥，并提出了一个六变量不等式来证明这一差距。此外，该锥还依赖于局部维度，对于Z_d量子比特的锥包含在Z_d'量子比特的锥中当且仅当d整除d'。
authors: Xidan Song, Ruifeng Cao

articles.title: Measurement-induced criticality for non-Abelian anyons: The monitored golden chain
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子的测量诱导临界性：受监测的黄金链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18965v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-Abelian anyon chains whose interactions favor a single fusion channel host quantum critical ground states described by minimal-model conformal field theories (CFTs) protected by a topological symmetry. We show that their measurement-only counterpart, where non-commuting fusion charge measurements act locally on the anyons of a chain of L sites, provides a fundamental example of a non-unitary CFT controlling a non-Abelian learning problem. Mapping the monitored dynamics to a random tensor network, we numerically find 1/L scaling Lyapunov gaps, logarithmic entanglement scaling with the chord length, and an effective central charge in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record. The conserved topological charge sharpens with dynamical exponent z= 1 and is learnable by a decoder on an O(L) time scale. As the topological symmetry is a non-invertible symmetry of the SU(2)ₖ anyon theories, we establish the monitored golden chain (k=3) as a non-Abelian generalization of the weakly (Kramers-Wannier) self-dual quantum critical point of the toric code (k=2), and the first of a family for k≥ 3.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非阿贝尔任意子链的测量诱导临界性，其中非对易融合电荷测量局域作用于链上的任意子。研究表明，这种受监测的动力学可映射到随机张量网络，并数值发现1/L标度的李雅普诺夫间隙、与弦长呈对数关系的纠缠标度以及测量记录香农熵中的有效中心荷。该工作将受监测的黄金链（k=3）确立为环面码（k=2）弱自对偶量子临界点的非阿贝尔推广。
authors: Zhaohui Zhi, Bo Han, Romain Vasseur, Andreas W. W. Ludwig, Simon Trebst, Guo-Yi Zhu

articles.title: A low-cost compact muon detector for millikelvin operation
articles.title_zh: 一种用于毫开尔文操作的低成本紧凑型μ子探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ionizing radiation produces correlated errors in superconducting qubits, posing some challenges to quantum error correction. In addition, it causes background events in other superconducting cryogenic devices, such as kinetic inductance detectors and superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors. Cosmic muons are a component of this background that can only be partly shielded against at ground level, but can be tagged by an independent detector inside the cryostat, so that the affected data can be vetoed, or the muon tags incorporated into error correction. We present a low-cost, compact muon detector consisting of two plastic scintillator modules, each read out by a silicon photomultiplier (SiPM), operated in coincidence. We characterize the SiPMs from room temperature down to 10 mK, including the breakdown and upper-limit voltages that define the operating bias range. Operated as a muon counter, the detector measures a coincidence rate that, as expected, is independent of temperature within uncertainties and agrees with analytical and Monte Carlo predictions. Below approximately 8 K, each muon event produces two pulses, one narrow and one broad, an effect that, to our knowledge, has not been reported before. Coincidences with an independent muon detector outside the cryostat confirm that muons are still counted reliably in this regime. By studying the appearance of double pulses as a function of temperature and magnetic field up to 4.5 T, we find a behavior consistent with the phase diagram of a type-II superconductor. This links the double pulses to a superconducting material in the SiPM, likely an adhesion layer or diffusion barrier introduced during manufacturing. The mechanism by which the superconducting state produces the second pulse is not yet understood.
articles.abstract_zh: 电离辐射在超导量子比特中产生相关错误，对量子纠错构成挑战，并导致其他超导低温设备中的背景事件。本文介绍了一种低成本、紧凑型μ子探测器，由两个塑料闪烁体模块组成，每个模块由硅光电倍增管（SiPM）读出并以符合方式操作。该探测器作为μ子计数器运行时，测得的符合率在不确定性范围内与温度无关，并与分析和蒙特卡洛预测一致。
authors: Tengiz Ibrayev, Danish Khan, Alex Herscovics, Komal Kataruka, Matilda Lawton, Sandhya Sharma, Steven Waddy, Laura Manenti

articles.title: A quantum annealing approach to the minimum distance problem of quantum codes
articles.title_zh: 量子退火方法解决量子码的最小距离问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.17703v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes (QECCs) are at the heart of fault-tolerant quantum computing. As the size of quantum platforms is expected to grow, one of the open questions is to design new optimal codes of ever-increasing size. A related challenge is to certify the quality of a given code by evaluating its minimum distance, a quantity characterizing code's capacity to preserve quantum information. This problem is known to be NP-hard. Here we propose to harness the power of contemporary quantum platforms to address this question, and in this way help design quantum platforms of the future. Namely, we introduce an approach to compute the minimum distance of quantum stabilizer codes by reformulating the problem as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem and leveraging established QUBO algorithms and heuristics as well as quantum annealing (QA) to address the latter. The reformulation as a QUBO introduces only a logarithmic multiplicative overhead in the required number of variables. We demonstrate the formulation using the D-Wave Advantage 4.1 quantum annealer and the hybrid quantum-classical algorithm Qbsolv, and benchmark the resulting QUBO-based implementations against specialized classical distance-finding methods. The QA- and SA-assisted implementations show broadly comparable performance, while the classical comparison clarifies the relative strengths of heuristic optimization and exact distance certification. Our results establish a solver-independent QUBO formulation with only a logarithmic multiplicative overhead in the number of variables and characterize connectivity and minor embedding as central limitations of its present implementation on quantum-annealing hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错码（QECCs）是容错量子计算的核心，评估其最小距离是认证代码质量的关键挑战，该问题是NP难的。本文提出了一种利用量子退火（QA）计算量子稳定子码最小距离的方法，通过将问题重新表述为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题。这种重构仅引入了所需变量数量的对数乘法开销。研究使用D-Wave Advantage 4.1量子退火器和混合量子-经典算法Qbsolv验证了该方法。
authors: Refaat Ismail, Ashish Kakkar, Anatoly Dymarsky

articles.title: Fundamental Limits on QBER and Distance in Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 量子密钥分发中量子误码率和距离的根本限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22319v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables information-theoretic secure communication, yet its ultimate tolerance to noise and achievable transmission distance remain fundamentally constrained. We establish the maximum quantum bit error rate (QBER) compatible with secure QKD and derive corresponding upper bounds on communication distance. Our results follow from a fundamental capacity threshold for qubit Pauli channels and apply to protocols based on two or more mutually unbiased bases, using either single-photon or weak coherent sources. By connecting information-theoretic limits to realistic physical noise models, we obtain universal bounds on achievable distances in fiber and free-space links, including diffraction-limited constraints relevant to deep-space quantum communications. These findings clarify the ultimate noise robustness of QKD and delineate the fundamental boundaries of secure quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）实现了信息论安全的通信，但其对噪声的最终容忍度和可达传输距离受到根本限制。本文建立了与安全QKD兼容的最大量子误码率（QBER），并推导了相应的通信距离上限。研究结果源于量子比特泡利信道的基本容量阈值，并适用于基于两个或更多互不偏基的协议。通过将信息论限制与实际物理噪声模型相结合，该工作获得了光纤和自由空间链路中可达距离的普遍界限，阐明了QKD的最终噪声鲁棒性并划定了安全量子通信的基本边界。
authors: Stefano Pirandola

articles.title: Heterogeneous entanglement between a trapped ion and a solid-state quantum memory
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子与固态量子存储器之间的异质纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05836v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid quantum networks offer a promising architecture for scalable quantum information processing and a future quantum internet, as they can combine the complementary strengths of disparate physical platforms. While single-atom systems provide deterministic quantum logic gates, atomic ensembles enable large-capacity quantum storage. However, generating entanglement between such heterogeneous systems has remained an open challenge, primarily due to fundamental spectral mismatches and system complexity. Here, we demonstrate a hybrid quantum network that entangles a single trapped mathrm¹⁷¹Yb⁺ ion and a quantum memory based on m̊ ¹⁵³Eu³⁺o̧lon!Y₂SiO₅ crystal over a 75-m separation. Using polarization-maintaining quantum frequency conversion, we map spin-photon entanglement onto a hybrid entanglement between a single spin qubit and a collective excitation of the quantum memory. The resulting entangled state achieves a fidelity of (89.21 ± 2.23)% and violates the CHSH-Bell inequality by 6 standard deviations (S = 2.328 ± 0.055), confirming nonlocality between two heterogeneous nodes. This work establishes entanglement between a quantum processing module with a multiplexed quantum memory node, representing a key step toward a scalable, multifunctional quantum internet.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合量子网络为可扩展量子信息处理提供了前景广阔的架构，但异质系统间的纠缠生成因光谱失配而面临挑战。本工作展示了单个囚禁的¹⁷¹Yb⁺离子与基于¹⁵³Eu³⁺:Y₂SiO₅晶体的量子存储器之间跨越75米的混合纠缠。通过偏振保持量子频率转换，研究人员将自旋-光子纠缠映射到混合纠缠态，实现了89.21%的保真度并显著违反了CHSH-Bell不等式，证实了两个异质节点之间的非局域性。
authors: Chen-Xu Wang, Yi-Yang Wang, Tian-Xiang Zhu, Qing-Quan Yao, Peng-Jun Liang, Yuan-Cong Li, Zi-Peng Liu, Ran He, Yong-Jian Han, Jin-Ming Cui, Zong-Quan Zhou, Yun-Feng Huang, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo

articles.title: Learning Quantum Operator Dynamics from Short-Time Data
articles.title_zh: 从短时数据学习量子算符动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.14699v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Real-time dynamics of quantum observables provide direct access to excitation spectra and correlation functions in quantum many-body systems, but currently available quantum devices are limited to short evolution times due to decoherence. We propose a neural ordinary differential equation (Neural ODE) framework with a physics-driven neural network to reconstruct long-time operator dynamics from short-time quantum data. By expanding observables in the Pauli basis and exploiting locality and symmetry constraints, the operator evolution is reduced to a tractable set of coefficients whose dynamics are learned from the measurement data. Applied to the Ising spin chain with mixed fields, the operator learning method accurately extrapolates its long-time correlation function and resolves its excitation spectrum. We validate the framework by collecting short-time data from IBM's superconducting quantum processor and successfully reconstruct the Fourier spectrum of an N=8 Ising spin chain with 5 times enhanced precision. Our results demonstrate a scalable and data-efficient strategy for extracting dynamical and spectral information from practical quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 当前量子设备受退相干限制，难以获取量子可观测量在长时间内的实时动力学。本研究提出了一种基于物理驱动神经网络的神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）框架，用于从短时量子数据重建长时间算符动力学。通过在泡利基中展开可观测量并利用局域性和对称性约束，该方法将算符演化简化为可处理的系数集，并从测量数据中学习其动力学。该方法在伊辛自旋链上成功应用，并经IBM超导量子处理器数据验证，显著提高了傅里叶谱的重建精度。
authors: Jinyang Li, Satoshi Iso, Shunji Matsuura, Lingxiao Wang, Xiaoyang Wang

articles.title: Magnetic domains stabilized by symmetry-protected zero modes
articles.title_zh: 由对称性保护的零模稳定的磁畴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15510v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding mechanisms for the breakdown of thermalization in closed quantum systems is a central problem in quantum many-body physics. We demonstrate strong nonergodic behavior in the XX model on coupled chains, where domain-wall initial states retain an inhomogeneous magnetization profile for arbitrarily long times. We find that this effect arises due to zero modes protected by chiral symmetry. Using an analysis based on the Lanczos algorithm, we identify evidence for a localization transition in the thermodynamic limit at a critical coupling between the chains. We further show that antiferromagnetic defects in the initial state and symmetry-breaking perturbations restore slow thermalization, whereas it remains robust for symmetry-conserving perturbations. These results establish that degenerate, symmetry-protected subspaces can give rise to thermodynamically stable nonergodic dynamics in experimentally accessible quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解封闭量子系统中热化失效的机制是量子多体物理学的核心问题。本研究在耦合链上的XX模型中展示了强烈的非遍历行为，其中畴壁初始态能长时间保持不均匀的磁化分布。研究发现这种效应源于手征对称性保护的零模，并通过Lanczos算法分析揭示了热力学极限下链间临界耦合处的局域化转变。结果表明，反铁磁缺陷和破缺对称性的微扰会恢复缓慢热化，而对称性守恒的微扰则保持其鲁棒性。
authors: Pavel Kos, Dominik S. Wild, Kristian Knakkergaard Nielsen

articles.title: Structured-Light Magnetometry in a Coherently Controlled Atomic Medium
articles.title_zh: 相干控制原子介质中的结构光磁力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25781v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A structured-light-based approach to magneto-optical rotation (MOR) magnetometry is proposed, in which magnetically induced polarization rotation is converted into a directly observable spatial displacement. A radially polarized Laguerre--Gaussian beam propagating through cold ⁸⁷Rb atoms in the presence of a longitudinal magnetic field experiences circular birefringence, which induces a relative phase shift between the σ₊ and σ₋ polarization components. This phase shift manifests itself as the angular rotation of a petal-shaped interference pattern, enabling the MOR angle to be determined directly from the spatial intensity distribution. Unlike conventional MOR detection techniques based on balanced polarimetry or Stokes-parameter reconstruction, the proposed method requires only a fixed-axis polarization projection and avoids computationally intensive polarization analysis. By translating polarization rotation into a topology-dependent spatial observable, the scheme enables direct and spatially resolved magnetic-field measurements. Furthermore, the use of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) allows low-loss operation while preserving high sensitivity. These characteristics make the proposed technique a promising platform for optical magnetometry and structured-light-based quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于结构光的磁光旋转（MOR）磁力测量方法，将磁致偏振旋转转换为直接可观察的空间位移。当径向偏振的拉盖尔-高斯光束穿过存在纵向磁场的冷⁸⁷Rb原子时，会经历圆双折射，导致σ₊和σ₋偏振分量之间产生相对相移。这种相移表现为花瓣状干涉图样的角旋转，从而可以直接从空间强度分布确定MOR角。该方法避免了复杂的偏振分析，并结合电磁感应透明（EIT）实现了低损耗操作。
authors: Parkhi Bhardwaj, Shubhrangshu Dasgupta

articles.title: Topological zero-reflection points in multi-terminal quantum wire junctions
articles.title_zh: 多端量子线结中的拓扑零反射点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31586v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study scattering in noninteracting multi-terminal quantum wire junctions and show that junctions with dihedral symmetry can exhibit exact zero-reflection points for N ge 4 terminals. By analyzing the scattering matrix, we identify these reflectionless points in the (E,t') parameter space, where E is the incident particle energy and t' is the junction hopping amplitude. These points exhibit an even-odd dependence on N and converge asymptotically to a common limiting value in the large-N limit. We show that the reflectionless points are characterized by an integer winding number associated with the phase of the reflection amplitude, providing a topological description for their stability against weak on-site disorder. We also consider junctions with broken time-reversal symmetry and find that a magnetic flux can induce additional reflectionless points, including for the N = 3 case. For a four-terminal junction threaded by a π-flux, we identify a unique parameter regime in which the reflection amplitude vanishes over the entire energy band. Finally, we discuss experimental signatures through the behavior of Friedel oscillations and examine the stability of these reflectionless points in the presence of weak interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了非相互作用多端量子线结中的散射现象，并发现具有二面体对称性的结（N ≥ 4）可以展现精确的零反射点。通过分析散射矩阵，这些无反射点在(E,t')参数空间中被识别，并表现出对N的奇偶依赖性，在大N极限下渐近收敛。这些点由反射振幅相位相关的整数缠绕数表征，提供了其对弱局域无序稳定性的拓扑描述。研究还发现磁通量可以诱导额外的无反射点，包括N=3的情况。
authors: Abhiram Soori, Udit Khanna, Diptiman Sen

articles.title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
articles.title_zh: 强朗道能级混合下的非阿贝尔量子霍尔态：用第一性原理AI寻找任意子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor ν = 3/2. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension sqrt2, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子是容错拓扑量子计算的基础，预计出现在偶数分母填充因子的分数量子霍尔态中。识别其拓扑序需要对朗道能级混合进行精确的非微扰处理，这在现有理论研究中尚缺失。本工作首次为填充因子ν=3/2的自旋极化电子提供了完整的非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题解决方案，包括所有电子和朗道能级。研究开发了一种动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，仅通过微观哈密顿量进行优化，直接揭示了具有量子维度sqrt2的任意子，这是伊辛型非阿贝尔序的标志。
authors: Pierre-Antoine Graham, Ahmed Abouelkomsan, Liang Fu

articles.title: Full-Continuum Ultrafast Quantum Gas Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 全连续超快量子气体显微镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum gas microscopy provides single-shot access to many-body configurations, but their microscopic reconstruction has so far largely relied on a predefined discrete spatial basis during fluorescence readout. Here we realize ultrafast atom-resolved fluorescence microscopy of an ultracold ¹⁶²Dy gas directly in continuous space, with all external confinement removed during imaging. Exploiting the large mass and broad optical transition of dysprosium together with a high numerical aperture in-vacuum objective, we detect single atoms within 4,μs while maintaining an effective point-spread function with a full width at half maximum of 254.8(3),nm, and an isolated single-atom classification fidelity of 99.72(3)%. We use the measured single-atom response to construct a statistical configuration-inference model that recovers atomic positions and multiplicities, coming from overlapping atoms, directly from single fluorescence snapshots. Benchmarking our model on Monte-Carlo generated images shows a total reconstruction fidelity of 98.7%. Our approach extends quantum gas microscopy beyond predefined detection lattices, enabling atom-resolved measurements of counting statistics and higher-order spatial correlations directly on the intrinsic length scales of continuum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子气体显微镜能够单次获取多体构型，但其微观重建通常依赖于预定义的离散空间基底。本研究实现了超冷¹⁶²Dy气体在连续空间中直接进行超快原子分辨荧光显微成像，成像过程中移除了所有外部限制。利用镝的大质量和宽光学跃迁特性以及高数值孔径真空物镜，研究人员在4微秒内探测到单个原子，并保持了254.8(3)纳米的有效点扩散函数，单原子分类保真度达到99.72(3)%。
authors: Andrea Litvinov, Clemens Ulm, Eva Casotti, Gerard Solà Berga, Manfred J. Mark, Francesca Ferlaino

articles.title: Topological superconductivity in layered d-wave altermagnetic metals
articles.title_zh: 层状d波交变磁性金属中的拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate multilayer d-wave altermagnetic metals with odd-parity helical p-wave pairing. In the minimal bilayer system, interlayer tunneling reconstructs the spin-split Fermi surfaces and generates two layer-hybridized sectors with distinct effective chemical potentials. Without Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC), the emergent mirror symmetry and subsystem chiral symmetry stabilize phases with different numbers of helical Majorana edge-mode pairs and additional counterpropagating pairs, jointly characterized by the mirror Chern number and the winding numbers defined along high-symmetry lines. The combination of RSOC and the altermagnetic exchange field gaps out the helical Majorana pairs while, in a certain parameter regime, leaving another pair of counterpropagating Majorana edge modes gapless, giving rise to second-order topological phases with isolated or twofold Majorana corner modes, as well as a hybrid-order phase in which gapless Majorana edge modes coexist with Majorana corner modes. We identify a layer symmetry that elucidates the physical origin of these phases. For an arbitrary N-layer system, such a symmetry naturally arises from the interlayer-coupling matrix, allowing N-fold Majorana corner modes to emerge when all layer-hybridized sectors enter the nontrivial second-order regime. Our results establish the interplay among the layer degree of freedom, odd-parity pairing, and Fermi-surface configurations as a controllable route to engineering topological superconductivity in layered altermagnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了具有奇宇称螺旋p波配对的多层d波交变磁性金属中的拓扑超导性。在最小双层系统中，层间隧穿重构了自旋分裂的费米面，并产生了两个具有不同有效化学势的层杂化区域。在没有Rashba自旋轨道耦合（RSOC）的情况下，出现的镜像对称性和子系统手征对称性稳定了具有不同数量螺旋马约拉纳边缘模式对的相。RSOC与交变磁交换场的结合会使螺旋马约拉纳对产生能隙，但在特定参数范围内，会留下另一对反向传播的马约拉纳边缘模式无能隙，从而产生具有孤立或双重马约拉纳角模式的二阶拓扑相，以及边缘模式与角模式共存的混合阶相。
authors: Yijie Mo, Zhongbo Yan

articles.title: Pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures (Habilitation thesis)
articles.title_zh: 闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的赝相对论费米子和拓扑态（教授资格论文）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tracing my scientific path from many-body physics in semiconductor nanostructures to topological quantum matter, this Habilitation à diriger des recherches (HDR) memoir presents only part of my research since defending two PhD theses in Toulouse and Nizhny Novgorod in 2011. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists. The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. The second examines pressure-, temperature-, and disorder-driven phase transitions in single and double HgTe quantum wells (QWs), including bilayer-graphene-like semimetals and a two-dimensional higher-order topological insulator (2D HOTI) phase beyond the minimal BHZ model. The third develops three-layer InAs/Ga(In)Sb QWs as a III-V platform for massless Dirac fermions, large-gap quantum spin Hall insulators, 2D HOTI phases, and semimetals with quadratic band touching, and discusses InAsₓSb₁₋ₓ/InAsySb₁₋y heterostructures as a promising alternative. Several of these predictions are supported by experimental observations, including quantized helical edge transport up to 60 K and the unconventional quantum Hall effect. Defended on March 25, 2026, at the University of Montpellier. Jury: Michel GOIRAN (chair and rapporteur, LNCMI-CNRS, Toulouse); Alexey KAVOKIN (rapporteur, Westlake University, Hangzhou); Robson FERREIRA (rapporteur, LPENS-CNRS, Paris); Alexei BARANOV (member, IES-CNRS, Montpellier); Benoit JOUAULT and Frédéric TEPPE (members, L2C-CNRS, Montpellier).
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇教授资格论文（Habilitation thesis）追溯了作者从半导体纳米结构中的多体物理到拓扑量子物质的科学研究历程。论文重点关注闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的赝相对论费米子和拓扑态。研究内容涵盖了块体HgCdTe中的Kane费米子、HgTe量子阱（QWs）中由压力、温度和无序驱动的相变（包括双层石墨烯类半金属和超越最小BHZ模型的二维高阶拓扑绝缘体相），以及作为无质量狄拉克费米子III-V平台的三层InAs/Ga(In)Sb量子阱。
authors: Sergey S. Krishtopenko

articles.title: Spectral signatures of spin textures and the emergence of a pseudogap
articles.title_zh: 自旋织构的谱学特征与赝能隙的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic solids with strongly interacting electrons display phenomena -- from Mott localization to high-temperature superconductivity -- that escape conventional band theory. Efforts to address this unconventional physics have been typically cast in the language of Green's function theories and the associated frequency- and momentum-dependent self-energies capturing strong correlations beyond the reach of mean-field theories. Here, we underscore that frequency- and momentum-dependent self-energies emerge also from mean-field solutions that break translational symmetry, and that these self-energies can display the characteristic fingerprints of strong correlations for certain, physically meaningful, spatial patterns. We showcase this perspective by studying the paradigmatic case of the 2D Hubbard model. We find that already at the mean-field level the doped antiferromagnet displays, in addition to stripes, many quasi-degenerate self-consistent solutions with antiferromagnetic textures organized into antiphase domains separated by hole-rich interfaces, reminiscent of the phase-separation scenario. Remarkably, these solutions map into spectral functions that display very distinctively the phenomenology of the pseudogap, including the nodal-antinodal dichotomy of the self-energy, Fermi arcs, and a complementary Luttinger surface. The result is a conceptually simple description of such an intricate many-body state: the pseudogap emerges as the momentum-space spectral portrait of the real-space interplay between antiferromagnetic domains and the metallic interfaces, which echoes the role of spin-fluctuations identified by nonperturbative methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有强相互作用电子的周期性固体展现出超越传统能带理论的现象，例如莫特局域化和高温超导。本研究强调，频率和动量相关的自能也可以从打破平移对称性的平均场解中产生，并且这些自能可以展现出强关联的特征指纹。通过研究二维哈伯德模型的典型案例，研究发现掺杂的反铁磁体在平均场水平上就表现出许多准简并的自洽解，这些解具有反铁磁织构和富空穴界面，类似于相分离情景，并映射到具有赝能隙特征的谱函数。
authors: Matteo Quinzi, Andrea Pintus, Tommaso Chiarotti, Massimo Capone, Nicola Marzari

articles.title: Signatures of symmetry-stabilized Dirac fermions in correlated oxide CaNbO3 thin films
articles.title_zh: 钙铌氧化物薄膜中对称性稳定狄拉克费米子的谱学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry-protected electronic states in correlated oxides offer a route to combining topology, lattice tunability, and many-body interactions, but creating such topological electronic states in complex oxides remains challenging. Here, we show that oxygen octahedral rotations provide a symmetry-control parameter for stabilizing Dirac-related electronic states in epitaxial CaNbO3 films. By comparing compressively strained tetragonal films and relaxed orthorhombic films, we demonstrate that distinct octahedral rotation patterns preserve nonsymmorphic symmetry and lead to distinct transport signatures consistent with Dirac-like electronic states. The films exhibit metallic transport with high mobility of 138,000 cm2 V-1 s-1, multichannel conduction, and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations from small high-mobility Fermi pockets. Landau-fan diagram analysis indicates finite Berry-phase contributions, while first-principles calculations reveal a strain-driven evolution from nodal-line band crossings in the orthorhombic phase to Dirac-electron band features in the tetragonal phase. These results establish oxygen octahedral symmetry as a design knob for engineering topological electronic states in correlated perovskite oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 在复杂氧化物中创建拓扑电子态仍然具有挑战性。本研究表明，氧八面体旋转可以作为对称性控制参数，稳定外延CaNbO₃薄膜中的狄拉克相关电子态。通过比较受压四方薄膜和弛豫正交薄膜，研究人员证明了不同的八面体旋转模式保留了非共形对称性，并导致了与狄拉克类电子态一致的独特输运特征。薄膜表现出高迁移率的金属输运、多通道传导以及来自小高迁移率费米袋的Shubnikov-de Haas振荡，第一性原理计算揭示了从正交相中的节点线能带交叉到四方相中狄拉克电子能带特征的应变驱动演化。
authors: Yunkyu Park, Seoung-Hun Kang, Jeongkeun Song, Minsik Kong, Seohee Kim, Shan Lin, Eun Sang Choi, Km Rubi, Hua Zhou, Sangmoon Yoon, Hu Miao, Satoshi Okamoto, Jong Mok Ok, Ho Nyung Lee

articles.title: Room-Temperature Metallic 2D Ferromagnetism Stabilized by Quantum Metric
articles.title_zh: 量子度规稳定室温金属二维铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of long-sought dice-lattice bands in layered electride YCl opens up unprecedented opportunities for studying correlated electrons in real dice lattice systems. While the weakly dispersive band at the Fermi level is partially filled and density-wave states are expected due to Fermi surface nesting based on conventional theories, the ARPES measurement nevertheless revealed a uniform flat band splitting of 0.5 eV, suggesting unusual ferromagnetism (FM) borne out of the metallic 2D dice lattice. In this Letter, we propose that the uniform metallic FM order is stabilized by the prominent quantum metric near topological band crossing points at K and K', which reconstructs the magnetic instability in the dice metal and tips the density-wave instability toward a uniform FM order. Importantly, our analysis based on random phase approximation (RPA) and Hartree-Fock theory predicts a remarkably high Curie temperature above room temperature for the 2D FM order. These findings establish the first example of a room-temperature 2D metallic magnet stabilized by quantum metric, which not only exemplifies the fundamental significance of quantum geometry in solids but also bears far-reaching applications in energy-efficient high-density magnetic memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在层状电化物YCl中发现的骰子晶格能带为研究真实骰子晶格系统中的关联电子提供了前所未有的机会。尽管费米能级处的弱色散能带部分填充，并且基于传统理论的费米面嵌套预计会导致密度波态，但ARPES测量却揭示了0.5 eV的均匀平带分裂，表明金属二维骰子晶格中产生了异常的铁磁性（FM）。本研究提出，拓扑能带交叉点K和K'附近显著的量子度规稳定了这种均匀的金属FM序，将密度波不稳定性转向均匀FM序。随机相近似（RPA）和Hartree-Fock理论分析预测，该二维FM序的居里温度显著高于室温，这确立了第一个由量子度规稳定的室温二维金属磁体的例子。
authors: Teng-Fei Ying, Jianqi Zhong, Songyuan Geng, Fangjie Chen, Haoxiang Li, Benjamin T. Zhou

articles.title: Beyond Kitaev exchange: Γ'-driven magnetism in Ag₃LiRh₂O₆
articles.title_zh: 超越Kitaev交换：Ag₃LiRh₂O₆中Γ'驱动的磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Kitaev magnets, frustration arises from bond-dependent spin anisotropic interactions, which can potentially realize sought-after quantum spin liquid phases. However, material realizations with dominating Kitaev exchange are scarce and the broad parameter space of extended Kitaev models remains largely unexplored experimentally. Here, we use density-functional theory, cluster many-body, spin-wave, and density-matrix renormalization calculations to show that the recently discovered honeycomb rhodate Ag₃LiRh₂O₆ hosts an off-diagonal exchange Γ₁' that is second in magnitude only to the ferromagnetic Kitaev exchange K₁. This combination of K₁ and Γ₁' explains key experimental observations, an unusually high magnetic ordering temperature of 94 K at ambient pressure and its rapid decrease under hydrostatic pressure as Ag₃LiRh₂O₆ evolves from ferromagnetic toward zigzag order within the honeycomb planes. Our spin-wave calculations further predict an unusual topology of the magnon bands arising from the Γ₁' term in the spin Hamiltonian of the honeycomb layer. We show that the large trigonal splitting of t₂g states enhances Γ₁', the hitherto underappreciated term in Kitaev magnets, and opens the way to new interesting regimes of the extended Kitaev model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用多种理论计算方法，揭示了蜂窝状铑酸盐Ag₃LiRh₂O₆中存在一个仅次于铁磁Kitaev交换K₁的非对角交换Γ₁'。K₁和Γ₁'的结合解释了该材料在环境压力下异常高的磁有序温度（94 K）及其在静水压力下迅速下降的实验现象。自旋波计算进一步预测了由Γ₁'项引起的磁振子能带的特殊拓扑结构，并指出t₂g态的大三角分裂增强了Γ₁'。
authors: Efrain Insuasti Pazmino, Shi Feng, Ramesh Dhakal, Ioannis Rousochatzakis, Stephen M. Winter, Johannes Knolle, Alexander A. Tsirlin

articles.title: Making Weak Interlayer Excitons Absorb: Manipulating the Effective Oscillator Strength via Purcell Engineering of Critical Coupling
articles.title_zh: 使弱层间激子吸收：通过Purcell工程临界耦合操纵有效振子强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interlayer excitons (IXs) in transition metal dichalcogenide bilayers possess unique dipolar properties, providing a path for exploring correlated many-body phases, electrically tunable dipole-dipole interactions, and long-range exciton transport. However, the large electron-hole separation underlying their dipolar character also results in a significantly reduced oscillator strength, limiting their direct optical interaction with light, and thus the direct probing of their dynamics and many-body interactions. Here, we show that by using Purcell engineering of critical coupling, a weak interlayer transition can absorb as strongly as the dominant intralayer transition, despite its much smaller intrinsic oscillator strength. Using this approach, in an open cavity architecture we demonstrate an order of magnitude IX absorption modulation in bilayer and trilayer MoS2, with doubling of the IX to A-exciton interaction strength weight from ~23% to ~53%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that in a tailored closed cavity architecture, the IX enhancement can reach beyond an order of magnitude, from ~5% to ~83% excitonic absorption, enabling IX absorption similar to intralayer excitons. An analytical description of the interaction is obtained via a closed-form transmission-line model which separates the excitonic and photonic contributions to the optical response, revealing how cavity architecture can be designed towards critical coupling. Our findings establish Purcell engineering of critical coupling as a general route to controlling and enhancing weak excitonic transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物双层中的层间激子（IXs）因其独特的偶极特性而具有重要研究价值，但其较弱的振子强度限制了直接光学探测。本研究展示了通过Purcell工程临界耦合，可以使弱层间跃迁的吸收强度与主导的层内跃迁相当。在开放腔结构中，实现了MoS2双层和三层中IX吸收的一个数量级调制，并将IX与A激子的相互作用强度权重从约23%提高到约53%。
authors: Saroj Poudyal, Anabel Atash Kahlon, Michael Klein, Matan Meshulam, Yonatan Gershuni, Thomas Poirier, James H. Edgar, Mukesh Kumar, Seth Ariel Tongay, Itai Epstein

articles.title: A Boson-informed neural network for Ground States of Many-Body Schrödinger equations
articles.title_zh: 一种用于多体薛定谔方程基态的玻色子信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a symmetry-preserving Boson-informed neural network (BINN) for the variational Monte Carlo computation of interacting-boson ground states in continuous space. The framework explicitly separates the two dominant physical scales of the system. At the microscopic interaction scale, a cell Jastrow factor absorbs the leading near-contact stiffness, while at the macroscopic scale, a potential-aware envelope encodes the external confinement, leaving the neural network to capture a smoother many-body residual. Across both two- and three-dimensional tests, the BINN approaches the Hartree and Gross-Pitaevskii limits with an empirical O(N⁻¹) finite-size trend in both energy and density. The energies agree with diffusion Monte Carlo to within 0.06% for the particle number tested up to 350 in the three-dimensional shrinking-range case. Applications are made under various trapping scenarios, justifying robust performance of BINN.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种对称性保持的玻色子信息神经网络（BINN），用于连续空间中相互作用玻色子基态的变分蒙特卡罗计算。该框架明确分离了系统的两个主要物理尺度，通过细胞Jastrow因子处理微观相互作用，并利用势能感知包络编码宏观外部限制。在二维和三维测试中，BINN在能量和密度上都接近Hartree和Gross-Pitaevskii极限，并与扩散蒙特卡罗结果高度一致。
authors: Zhizhong Kong, Jerry Zhijian Yang, Cheng Yuan, Xiaofei Zhao

articles.title: Adaptive qubit freezing enables robust graph partitioning for divide-and-conquer QAOA
articles.title_zh: 自适应量子比特冻结实现分治QAOA的鲁棒图划分
articles.abstract: Separator-based divide-and-conquer QAOA (DC-QAOA) can address graphs wider than the qubit capacity of one circuit, meaning the number of physical qubits usable by that circuit, but the large graph partitioner (LGP) in DC-QAOA aborts when no small vertex separator exists. We introduce frozen LGP (FrozenLGP), a three-phase extension of this specific pipeline. It first runs standard LGP (Phase 1); after failure, it freezes a minimum node cut of each selected residual graph, conditional on the first budget-feasible separator (Phase 2); and it uses a deterministic width-feasible split as coverage-preserving partitioning (CPP) for a final fallback (Phase 3). For a fixed frozen spin assignment, removed Ising couplings are folded exactly into local fields; assignment selection, QAOA, truncated reconstruction, and fallback ranking remain approximate. On the pooled high-connectivity partition benchmarks ( ), the scalable driver achieves 89.8% separator-based coverage without the CPP fallback at freeze budget , compared with 4.6% for standard LGP alone. In the 100-instance end-to-end benchmark, FrozenLGP’s Phase 2 increases coverage without CPP from 76 to 91 instances in the selected best-restart outcomes. The deterministic CPP fallback handles the remaining nine. CPP-inclusive coverage is 100%, including all tested partitioning instances up to vertices. This is a termination guarantee, not a measure of freezing-based recovery. When Phase 1 succeeds, both methods follow identical seeded circuit paths and attain identical approximation ratios. Compared with QAOA-in-QAOA, FrozenLGP achieves higher mean approximation ratios at each measured size, at the cost of more invoked subcircuit solves and greater aggregate quantum work. Under two simulated noise channels, the coverage extension persists while the reported output distributions of every method degrade under the stronger channel. In simulation, these results support FrozenLGP as a topology-robust front end for separator-based DC-QAOA.
articles.abstract_zh: 分隔器分治QAOA（DC-QAOA）在处理超出单个电路量子比特容量的图时，其大图划分器（LGP）可能因缺乏小顶点分隔器而中止。本研究引入了FrozenLGP，这是一个三阶段扩展，旨在提高图划分的鲁棒性。FrozenLGP在标准LGP失败后，通过冻结残余图的最小节点割来增加覆盖率，并在最终回退时使用确定性宽度可行分割。在基准测试中，FrozenLGP在不使用回退的情况下实现了89.8%的分隔器覆盖率，显著优于标准LGP的4.6%。
authors: Sokea Sang, Leanghok Hour, Dongmin Kim and Youngsun Han

articles.title: Optimal Disorder Strength for Approximate Unitary k-Designs in Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 自旋链中近似酉k-设计的最优无序强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum simulators with disordered spin Hamiltonians offer a natural route to Haar-like unitary ensembles, but face a competition. Disorder enhances randomness, yet strong disorder suppresses dynamics and localizes the system in the computational basis. This suggests an optimal intermediate disorder strength for approximating a unitary k-design, which has so far been identified mainly empirically. Here, we develop a perturbative theory for the moment gap Δ⁽k⁾, the deviation of the k-th moment operator from its Haar value, for the full spectrum of the interacting XXZ chain in a fixed-magnetization sector. We find the non-monotonic asymptotic scalings łn Δ⁽k⁾sim -σ² at weak disorder and łn Δ⁽k⁾sim -1/σ at strong disorder, whose crossover sets an optimal disorder strength σ_csim Jₓy, where Jₓy is the energy scale of the non-random interaction. We further show that a multi-quench protocol further suppresses the gap exponentially in the number of quenches. Numerical simulations confirm both scalings and this exponential suppression, and we demonstrate the usefulness of the protocol for classical shadow tomography. This work suggests that strong disorder may block both thermalization and the formation of unitary designs through a common localization mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有无序自旋哈密顿量的量子模拟器是实现类Haar酉系综的途径，但存在无序强度与系统动力学之间的竞争。本研究为相互作用XXZ链的k阶矩间隙Δ⁽k⁾发展了微扰理论，揭示了在弱无序下Δ⁽k⁾~-σ²和强无序下Δ⁽k⁾~-1/σ的非单调渐近标度，其交叉点确定了最优无序强度。研究还表明，多淬火协议可以指数级地抑制间隙，数值模拟证实了这些发现，并展示了该协议在经典阴影层析成像中的应用价值。
authors: Tian-Gang Zhou, Yi-Neng Zhou, Thierry Giamarchi, Julian Sonner

articles.title: Stabilizer Rényi Entropy Without a Phase Reference
articles.title_zh: 无相位参考的稳定器Rényi熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stabilizer Rényi entropy quantifies magic relative to a complete Pauli frame. In settings such as helicity states of massless particles, unsynchronized qubit registers, energy eigenbases, and systems under superselection rules, the computational basis may be fixed while the transverse Pauli axes remain unspecified. The stabilizer Rényi entropy then depends on the choice of those axes. We define a phase-averaged stabilizer Rényi entropy by averaging the Pauli moments before taking the logarithm. It is exactly invariant under independent local rephasings. For pure states, it vanishes precisely when the state is a stabilizer state in every phase convention. For a broad class of sparse supports, it reduces to a closed-form function of the basis-state probabilities alone. Within this class, the ceiling for n channels is łn[n³/(6n-5)] for n≥3 and łnfrac75 for two channels. We apply the invariant to tree-level gluon scattering at four and five points, where the helicity-basis phases are unspecified. It saturates the two- and three-channel ceilings: łnfrac75 at four points and łnfrac2713 in 3→2 scattering. In same-helicity 2→3 scattering, it lies between a floor of łnfrac87 and a ceiling of łnfrac184125, reached in the resolved soft limit and particular collinear limits, respectively. In every configuration studied, the invariant is independent of the fixed external colors.
articles.abstract_zh: 稳定器Rényi熵通常依赖于横向泡利轴的选择。本研究定义了一种相位平均的稳定器Rényi熵，通过在取对数前对泡利矩进行平均，使其在独立的局部重相位下保持精确不变。对于纯态，当状态在所有相位约定下都是稳定器态时，该熵恰好为零。该方法应用于四点和五点树级胶子散射，其中螺旋度基相未指定。
authors: Jinwei Chu, Savan Kharel

articles.title: Programmable Polaron Models and Tomography in Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulators
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子量子模拟器中的可编程极化子模型与层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong coupling between mobile charge carriers or excitons and lattice vibrations gives rise to polarons: quasiparticles formed by charge carriers dressed by a cloud of phonon excitations. Polaron formation determines transport properties of systems ranging from transition-metal oxides and organic semiconductors to light-harvesting complexes. In excitonic systems that admit a hard-core boson description, mapping the excitations to pseudospins provides a natural framework for studying polaron physics, including the nonperturbative regime in which hopping amplitudes, phonon energies, and coupling strengths are comparable. Here, we propose a trapped-ion blueprint for realizing spin-phonon Hamiltonians with programmable spatial coupling between excitation density and phonon displacements, encompassing local Holstein and long-range Fröhlich-type interactions. To access strongly dressed quasiparticles whose bare spectral weight is suppressed, we introduce displaced Green's functions implemented through spin-dependent phonon displacements. Their spectral response reveals the polaron band spectrum, including binding energies and phonon-excitation sidebands, while spatially resolved measurements probe the structure of the phonon dressing cloud, providing a route to polaron tomography. We further complement this spectroscopy with direct and ancilla-assisted measurements of spin-phonon correlations that track the coupled dynamics of the excitation and its environment.
