These approaches connect the emergent quasiparticle spectrum to the microscopic buildup of its dressing cloud, enabling controlled studies of how the spatial range of coupling shapes polaron formation and mobility.
articles.abstract_zh: 极化子是电荷载流子与晶格振动强耦合形成的准粒子，其形成决定了多种系统的输运性质。本研究提出了一种囚禁离子蓝图，用于实现具有可编程空间耦合的自旋-声子哈密顿量，涵盖了局域Holstein和长程Fröhlich型相互作用。为了探测裸谱权重被抑制的强缀饰准粒子，研究引入了通过自旋依赖声子位移实现的位移格林函数。这些函数的谱响应揭示了极化子能带谱，包括结合能和声子激发。
authors: Filip Marijanovic, Utso Bhattacharya, Abhishek Menon, Visal So, Guido Pagano, Eugene Demler

articles.title: Federated Unlearning of Quantum Data via Classical Shadows
articles.title_zh: 基于经典影子的量子数据联邦遗忘学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum federated learning trains a quantum neural network (QNN) across nodes that hold quantum data, such as the states of quantum sensors. To forget data, unlearning methods for quantum models replay them, and federated unlearning from stored updates removes whole nodes only. Quantum data cannot be replayed, since a state is consumed when measured and cannot be cloned. We propose Shadow-based Data Erasure (SHADE), in which each node records a classical shadow of every training state, a few randomized single-qubit measurements taken at training time. The gradient and curvature of a QNN on a state are expectations of observables, so SHADE estimates them for the forget data from the shadows at any later parameters and removes their effect by a federated Newton correction. Only classical estimates cross the network. We prove that the shadow size needed for a target unlearning error grows exponentially in the size of the backward light cone of the measured observable and not in the number of qubits. In simulation with 50 nodes and on edge boards, SHADE matches the forget accuracy of retraining within 0.5 points, without replay and in under 0.2 s.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子联邦学习在持有量子数据的节点间训练量子神经网络，但量子数据无法重放以实现遗忘。本研究提出了一种基于影子的数据擦除（SHADE）方法，其中每个节点记录每个训练状态的经典影子。SHADE利用这些影子估计遗忘数据的梯度和曲率，并通过联邦牛顿校正来消除其影响，且仅有经典估计值在网络中传输。研究证明，实现目标遗忘误差所需的影子大小与被测量可观测量的后向光锥大小呈指数增长。
authors: Zihao Ding, Jun Huang, Cong-cong Xing

articles.title: Post-Optimization Subspace Corrections to Quantum Ansätze
articles.title_zh: 量子拟设的后优化子空间校正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circuit depth and measurement count are the main limitations for chemical applications of the leading variational quantum algorithms on quantum computers. We show that both resource requirements can be reduced by augmenting adaptive variational quantum algorithms with post-optimization corrective techniques. We focus on two such techniques---Hamiltonian-moment Krylov subspace diagonalization and the identity-augmented quantum self-consistent equation of motion (q-sc-EOM)---applied to optimized ADAPT-VQE states without further ansatz growth or nonlinear optimization. Across molecular systems studied with up to 20 qubits, first-order Krylov correction reduces the optimized iterations (and the corresponding number of adaptive layers) needed to reach the 1.6~mEₕ threshold by up to approximately sixfold, with a general trend toward larger reductions at higher determinant Rényi entropy. We also find measurement-cost reductions of up to approximately fortyfold using a suitable resource-cost model. Identity-augmented q-sc-EOM improves molecular potential-energy curves obtained from truncated ADAPT-VQE ansätze with limited expressivity and recovers accuracy from states produced by sampled operator ranking without additional gradient-based operator selection, providing an advantage when small pool gradients make selection measurement intensive. Together, these post-optimization corrections offer routes to improve energy accuracy and reduce adaptive circuit growth in quantum algorithms as quantum hardware advances.
articles.abstract_zh: 电路深度和测量计数是变分量子算法在化学应用中的主要限制。本研究表明，通过在自适应变分量子算法中加入后优化校正技术，可以减少这两种资源需求。研究重点介绍了两种技术：哈密顿量矩Krylov子空间对角化和恒等式增强量子自洽运动方程（q-sc-EOM），它们应用于优化的ADAPT-VQE状态。结果显示，一级Krylov校正可将达到目标阈值所需的迭代次数减少约六倍，并使测量成本降低约四十倍。
authors: Prince Frederick Kwao, Bharath Sambasivam, Jason Saroni, Srivathsan Poyyapakkam Sundar, Edwin Barnes, Ayush Asthana

articles.title: Selective Control and Imaging of Higgs and Goldstone Modes with a Quantum Simulator
articles.title_zh: 利用量子模拟器选择性控制和成像希格斯和戈德斯通模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We realize the mesoscopic Bose-Hubbard model at unit-filling on a two-dimensional array of transmon qubits and selectively excite collective modes associated with amplitude or phase fluctuations of the superfluid order parameter. We identify these modes respectively as the Higgs and Goldstone modes using complementary local observables, extracted from measuring the number of particles on each site. Modulation of the coupling between sites excites the Higgs mode, which we detect via the density of doubly occupied sites. In contrast, modulation of the local chemical potential with an appropriately chosen spatial profile excites the lowest-frequency Goldstone mode, which we detect via changes in the local density. The two modes have different symmetries and do not couple to one another. By varying the system geometry, we characterize the impact of finite system size on the evolution of both modes. In the thermodynamic limit, decay into a continuum of lower-energy excitations can obscure the Higgs response. In our mesoscopic system, however, the finite system size leads to spectral gaps and allows us to detect the Higgs mode as a coherent, long-lived excitation. Our work demonstrates how finite quantum simulators can isolate and probe physical phenomena that become difficult to resolve in the thermodynamic, large-scale limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在二维超导量子比特阵列上实现了单位填充的介观玻色-哈伯德模型，并选择性地激发了与超流序参量振幅或相位波动相关的集体模式。通过测量每个位点上的粒子数，研究人员将这些模式分别识别为希格斯和戈德斯通模式。通过调制位点间的耦合或局部化学势，可以分别激发希格斯模式和最低频率的戈德斯通模式。在介观系统中，有限的系统尺寸导致了谱隙，从而能够将希格斯模式检测为相干振荡。
authors: Connie Miao, Pranjal Praneel, Thomas G. Kiely, Eliott Rosenberg, Nicole S. Ticea, Pedram Roushan, Erich Mueller, Andre G. Petukhov

articles.title: Quantum-classical algorithm interpolation for spatial search
articles.title_zh: 空间搜索的量子-经典算法插值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-walk algorithms can quadratically reduce the dependence of spatial search on the classical hitting time HT. Realising this speedup using standard quantum-walk algorithms, however, requires deep coherent circuits, limiting their applicability on near-term and early fault-tolerant quantum devices. We derive a parameterised family of hybrid quantum-classical spatial search algorithms that continuously interpolates between the classical and fully coherent quantum regimes, trading off circuit depth for total query complexity. For any γin[0,1], our algorithms use circuits of depth widetildeO(HTγ/²) and find a marked vertex with constant success probability at total cost widetildeO(HT¹⁻γmathsfS + HT¹⁻γ/²(mathsfU + mathsfC)), where mathsfS, mathsfU, and mathsfC denote the setup, update, and checking costs, respectively. We also derive an optimal continuous depth-query trade-off for fixed-point amplitude amplification, providing a potential building block for other hybrid designs.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子游走算法可以二次方地减少空间搜索对经典命中时间HT的依赖，但实现这种加速需要深层相干电路。本研究推导了一族参数化的混合量子-经典空间搜索算法，可以在经典和全相干量子机制之间连续插值。这些算法通过权衡电路深度与总查询复杂度，为近期和早期容错量子设备上的空间搜索提供了更实用的解决方案。
authors: Diogo Ramos, Duarte Magano

articles.title: Quantum Reservoir Computing for Attention-like Selective Reproduction
articles.title_zh: 用于类注意力选择性再现的量子储备池计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Choosing which information to use as the context changes is a basic cognitive operation. We introduce a new task of this kind for quantum reservoir computing (QRC): a binary cue indicates which of two simultaneous input streams the reservoir must reproduce. In simulated spin reservoirs with a trained linear readout, infinitely many measurements (exact expectation values) let the reservoir reproduce the cued stream accurately. At a finite number of measurements (N_M), the score exceeds that of a linear readout of the raw inputs only at large (N_M) because of sampling noise. Performance increases with both entanglement and coherence in the computational basis, and then saturates. These results show that QRC can select and reproduce a cued stream, and they are a starting point for harder cognitive tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 选择在上下文变化时使用哪些信息是一种基本的认知操作。本研究为量子储备池计算（QRC）引入了一项新的任务：一个二进制提示指示储备池必须再现两个同步输入流中的哪一个。在模拟自旋储备池中，QRC能够准确地选择并再现提示的流，其性能随纠缠和计算基相干性增加而提高。这些结果表明QRC能够执行选择性再现，为更复杂的认知任务奠定了基础。
authors: Hadi Zadeh-Haghighi, Christoph Simon

articles.title: Gap-Priced |Tångle-States: Dynamic |Tångle Post-Selection and Budget-Aware Factory Provisioning
articles.title_zh: 间隙定价|Tångle态：动态|Tångle后选择与预算感知工厂配置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic |Tångle-state preparation dominates the cost of fault-tolerant quantum computation on surface codes, yet cultivation and distillation are typically provisioned statically, leaving much of the program's error budget unused. We present Gap-Priced |Tångle States (GP|Tångle-S), a lattice surgery scheduler and factory allocator that co-optimizes both methods under a total T-error budget. GP|Tångle-S uses the complementary gap of each cultivated state as a fidelity estimate and dynamically adjusts the cultivation gap cutoff, converting budget slack into speed by giving the scheduler control over the cultivation post-selection. GP|Tångle-S also characterizes distillation factories by size, |Tångle-state production rate, and budget slack, and introduces cultivating factories that embed cultivation within routing channels, achieving fidelities otherwise requiring two-level distillation at a single-level footprint. GP|Tångle-S organizes these characterizations into a factory catalog, and performs distillation factory allocation over this catalog in tandem with the gap cutoff using dynamic-programming to achieve one of i) minimum spacetime volume, ii) minimum execution time, or iii) minimum space overhead, all within a user-provided T-error budget. Across sixteen benchmarks under high and low T-error budgets of 10⁻³ and 10⁻⁵ respectively, GP|Tångle-S consistently outperforms cultivation-only and single-factory baselines without exceeding the budget, achieving a 5.5× geometric mean speedup in logical cycle count and a 3.4× geometric mean reduction in space-time volume.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔术|Tångle态的制备是表面码容错量子计算的主要成本来源，但其培养和蒸馏通常是静态配置的，导致大部分错误预算未被利用。本研究提出了间隙定价|Tångle态（GP|Tångle-S），这是一种晶格手术调度器和工厂分配器，可在总T误差预算下共同优化这两种方法。GP|Tångle-S通过动态调整培养间隙截止值，将预算松弛转化为速度，并引入了将培养嵌入路由通道的培养工厂，从而提高了效率。
authors: Maxwell Poster, Sayam Sethi, Yuhao Liu, Jonathan Baker, Costin Iancu

articles.title: Leakage benchmarking with decohering subgroups in the presence of preparation and measurement errors
articles.title_zh: 在制备和测量误差存在下使用退相干子群的泄漏基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common problem with physical qubits is that the state can leak outside the computational subspace. To characterize the problem, it is desirable to measure both the leakage probability and the fidelity of gates inside the computational subspace. Randomized benchmarking is a readily accessible method for estimating average gate fidelities and can be modified to account for leakage. However, in the presence of state preparation and measurement errors (SPAM) there are parameter degeneracies, and fidelities and leakage become underdetermined. We study the example of qudits with any number of leakage levels under the assumption of gate-independent noise. We show that randomized benchmarking sequences with leakage level decoherence can be analyzed as a Markov process with noisy classical preparations and measurements. This result generalizes to randomized benchmarking with random gates from an arbitrary group that contains a phase-decohering subgroup. We characterize the parameter degeneracy in inferring the Markov process, preparations and measurements. Based on this characterization we develop a measurement and inference method taking advantage of known conservative bounds on SPAM to constrain fidelity, leakage and other parameters of the Markov process, state preparations and measurements. As part of our study, we experimentally implemented the measurement method for a qubit defined on the one-excitation subspace of two transmons, for which there are two leakage levels. We determined confidence intervals accounting for parameter degeneracy for a number of performance parameters of the system. For leakage and fidelity, we compare these intervals to those obtained for several conventional methods for leakage benchmarking.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理量子比特的一个常见问题是其状态可能泄漏到计算子空间之外。为了表征此问题，需要测量泄漏概率和计算子空间内门的保真度。本研究探讨了在存在制备和测量误差（SPAM）的情况下，泄漏基准测试的挑战。我们展示了具有泄漏级别退相干的随机基准测试序列可以被分析为带有噪声经典制备和测量的马尔可夫过程，并基于此开发了一种测量和推断方法。
authors: Shawn Geller, Tongyu Zhao, Alex Kwiatkowski, Scott Glancy, Raymond W. Simmonds, Emanuel Knill

articles.title: Quantum LDPC Codes from Polynomial Minors
articles.title_zh: 基于多项式子式的量子LDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct quantum codes from codewords of a cyclic code and the minors of a polynomial matrix. The construction uses a two-row, three-column matrix whose minors yield a second matrix satisfying the CSS orthogonality condition. We derive the code dimension from the greatest common divisors of the entries and minors, with a simplified formula for odd lifting factors. A residue characterization identifies additional common factors of the minors and leads to a method for controlling the dimension through polynomial selection. We also give a condition for changing the minor generator without changing the code. Explicit polynomial constructions yield 13 quantum codes with verified minimum distances, including a [[255,80,12]] code of rate 80/255.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用循环码的码字和多项式矩阵的子式构建了量子码。该构造使用一个两行三列的矩阵，其子式产生一个满足CSS正交条件的矩阵。研究人员从矩阵元素和子式的最大公约数推导出码的维度，并给出了奇数提升因子的简化公式。通过显式多项式构造，他们得到了13个具有验证最小距离的量子码，其中包括一个[[255,80,12]]码。
authors: Vahid Nourozi, Roxana Smarandache, David G. M. Mitchell

articles.title: Shot- and Noise-Aware Pauli Correlation Encoding for Max-Cut Experiments on IBM Heron Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 针对IBM Heron量子处理器上Max-Cut实验的散粒噪声感知Pauli关联编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pauli correlation encoding (PCE) encodes m binary variables in the signs of k-body Pauli correlators of n=O(m¹/k) qubits, and trains a parameterized circuit on a relaxed loss of sharpness α. The strongest published schedules sharpen this loss aggressively and are benchmarked with exact expectation values, whereas a quantum computer estimates correlators from a finite number of shots. We show that the sharpness is a hidden shot budget. Since the expected sign of a correlator estimated from S shots, erf(csqrtS/2), agrees with tanh(0.851sqrtS,c) to within 0.019, the edge term of the relaxed loss at α=0.851sqrtS approximately equals, up to a constant, minus twice the cut expected from decoding S shots. This explains why schedules tuned with exact expectation values lose their advantage at realistic budgets, and yields a shot-aware schedule whose final sharpness is set by the shot budget. On five G-set graphs with 800 variables on 13 qubits, this schedule outperforms every published schedule at its target budget in all 150 paired comparisons of the decoded circuit output, owing to the sharpness at 1.6×10⁴ shots and mostly to switching off the regularization at 10³; after a classical bit-swap search, it remains the best on average at 1.6×10⁴ shots. Device noise damps the correlators by a factor s, which amounts to a smaller shot budget s²S. On the IBM Heron processor ibm_fez, an all-to-all ansatz of the type used for the best published G-set results compiles to 835 CZ gates and decodes to a random cut, while our 96-CZ hardware-native circuit, trained in simulation and sharpened to αsimeq0.65,ssqrtS, retains up to 0.919 of the best-known cut. For new circuits, a damping and an offset calibrated on other circuits of the same graph predicted the decoded cuts at 10³ shots to within 0.002.
articles.abstract_zh: Pauli关联编码（PCE）将二元变量编码到Pauli关联器的符号中，并通过参数化电路训练。本文指出，编码中的“锐度”参数实际上是一个隐藏的散粒预算。研究表明，精确期望值调优的调度在实际预算下会失去优势，并提出了一种散粒噪声感知的调度方法。在IBM Heron量子处理器上对Max-Cut实验的评估显示，该调度在给定预算下优于所有已发布的调度。
authors: Achraf Boussahi

articles.title: Cryogenic Multiplexing Control Chip for Superconducting Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 用于超导量子处理器的低温复用控制芯片
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a scheme and design of cryogenic multiplexing control chip (MCC) which enables one microwave cable to control many superconducting qubits. Designed based on adjustable inductor, MCC is a non-reciprocal device which generates microwave signals between 4 and 8 GHz and constructs XY control circuit to operate qubits. The effects of filters, isolators, power splitters, qubits and load impedance on MCC are analyzed in the frequency-domain simulation. And in time-domain simulation, the response time, Gaussian pulses, single-sideband, amplitude and frequency compensation of MCC are examined. The MCC can be integrated with the superconducting qubits on the same package at 20 mK temperature stage, and output specific microwave pulses used to drive the superconducting qubits without crosstalks. The MCC can greatly reduce the number of microwave control lines and is beneficial to the development of large-scale superconducting quantum processor.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并设计了一种低温复用控制芯片（MCC），旨在通过一根微波电缆控制多个超导量子比特。该MCC基于可调电感设计，是一个非互易器件，能产生4-8 GHz的微波信号并构建XY控制电路。仿真结果表明，MCC能够与超导量子比特集成在同一封装中，在20 mK温度下输出特定微波脉冲以驱动量子比特而无串扰。该芯片有望大幅减少微波控制线的数量，从而促进大规模超导量子处理器的发展。
authors: Rutian Huang, Xiao Geng, Xinyu Wu, Genting Dai, Liangliang Yang, Jianshe Liu, Wei Chen

articles.title: Transport Information Beyond Strong Eigenstate Thermalization
articles.title_zh: 超越强本征态热化理论的输运信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong eigenstate thermalization (ETH) in operationally mean-ergodic, non-chaotic systems provides an opportunity to investigate whether Floquet eigenstates retain information about classical transport beyond their leading thermodynamic behavior. We address this question using the double kicked top (DKT), which exhibits nonmixing transport and dynamics consistent with weak mixing transport under variation of its control parameters. We show that the coefficient m of the leading finite-size correction to the normalized eigenstate entanglement entropy (EE) s tracks the restructuring between these transport regimes even when the thermodynamic-limit entropy c becomes nearly insensitive to them. This coefficient m is positive for nonmixing transport and negative when dynamics consistent with weak mixing transport dominate. The coefficient's sign reversal in the coexistence regime remains stable as the semiclassical resolution increases. Our results demonstrate that finite-size eigenstate structure can encode signatures of classical transport that are invisible in the thermodynamic-limit entropy, providing an eigenstate-based diagnostic of dynamical organization beyond the leading thermodynamic behavior associated with strong ETH.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在强本征态热化（ETH）系统中，Floquet本征态是否保留了超越其主要热力学行为的经典输运信息。研究使用双踢陀螺（DKT）模型，发现归一化本征态纠缠熵（EE）的前导有限尺寸修正系数m，即使在热力学极限熵对输运机制不敏感时，也能追踪不同输运机制之间的重构。该系数的符号变化揭示了经典输运的特征，这些特征在热力学极限熵中是不可见的。
authors: Avadhut V. Purohit, Harshit Sharma, Udaysinh T. Bhosale

articles.title: Acoustic scattering from quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 基于量子动力学的声学散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scattering of sound waves propagating in a compressible fluid is linked to the quantum dynamics generated by a class of non-Hermitian Hamiltonian operators. The scattering amplitude is expressed in terms of the corresponding evolution operator. This is used to provide a new proof of the reciprocity theorem in acoustic scattering, conduct analytic low-frequency acoustic scattering calculations, and study the scattering of sound waves by a finite planar array of delta-function point scatters embedded in an infinite acoustic slab. A detailed discussion of acoustic scattering properties of a homogeneous acoustic slab including a pair of delta-function point scatters on one of its faces is provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将可压缩流体中声波的散射与一类非厄米哈密顿算子产生的量子动力学联系起来。散射振幅用相应的演化算子表示，并用于重新证明声学散射中的互易定理。研究人员进行了低频声学散射的解析计算，并探讨了无限声学平板中嵌入的有限平面阵列点散射体的声波散射。该工作为理解声学散射提供了新的量子动力学视角。
authors: Farhang Loran, Ali Mostafazadeh

articles.title: Trading energy for coherence in mode discrimination
articles.title_zh: 模式判别中能量与相干性的权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy is arguably the main resource in classical physics; coherence is the prototypical quantum resource. In this paper, we study the interplay between these two resources in the task of optimal mode discrimination. This task, motivated by cryptography and metrology, consists of finding in which mode a signal has been encoded, for a given finite set of possible modes. After recalling that the task can be cast as a semi-definite program, we solve completely the case of two-mode discrimination under a hard energy constraint nłeq N. Specifically, we identify the region of modes overlap, for which the maximal energy state (the Fock state with N excitations) is the best choice for discrimination. For other overlaps, having access to coherence leads to better discrimination.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在最优模式判别任务中，能量和相干性这两种资源之间的相互作用。该任务旨在识别信号被编码在哪种模式中。研究人员完全解决了在严格能量约束下双模式判别的情况，并确定了模式重叠区域，在此区域内最大能量态是最佳选择。对于其他重叠情况，利用相干性可以实现更好的判别性能。
authors: Shuyang Meng, Valerio Scarani

articles.title: Single and coupled quantum van der Pol oscillators: Wigner-function dynamics, exact qutrit solutions, and synchronization
articles.title_zh: 单个和耦合量子范德波尔振荡器：Wigner函数动力学、精确三能级解和同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum van der Pol oscillator in which single-photon pumping competes with a nonlinear two-photon dissipative channel to produce a quantum limit cycle, and the question of how two such oscillators with non-identical intrinsic frequencies synchronize in the sense of phase locking when coupled dissipatively to one another. For a single oscillator, starting from a Lindblad description of the dynamics, we derive the exact Wigner-function evolution equation, and show that its Fokker--Planck approximation admits in the appropriate regime an equivalent classical Itô stochastic description that reproduces remarkably well the full Lindblad dynamics. Notably, the stochastic approach provides an efficient means of capturing system dynamics in the semiclassical regime, where a large number of energy eigenstates contribute and direct numerical simulations become computationally demanding. Restricting to the three lowest Fock states and using a parity symmetry, we obtain in closed form the stationary-state density matrix and its Wigner-function representation that displays pronounced nonclassical features. For two non-identical oscillators, we study the full Lindblad dynamics numerically and characterize synchronization through the stationary-state order parameter as a function of frequency mismatch and dissipative coupling. We find that increasing the effective nonlinear dissipative strength suppresses the synchronized region. Restricting the two oscillators to the three-level qutrit subspace, a parity symmetry reduces the stationary-state problem to an exact 41-dimensional linear system, allowing to compute the synchronization order parameter. In this reduced description, results in the limit of large dissipation agree closely with those from the full dynamics, while exhibiting in the limit of small dissipation a double-peak synchronization structure accompanied by a phase reversal.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了单个和耦合量子范德波尔振荡器，其中单光子泵浦与非线性双光子耗散通道竞争以产生量子极限环。对于单个振荡器，研究人员推导了精确的Wigner函数演化方程，并展示了其Fokker-Planck近似在适当条件下可由经典Itô随机描述很好地再现。对于两个非相同振荡器，研究探讨了它们在耗散耦合下如何实现锁相同步。
authors: Rohitashwa Chattopadhyay, Vinayak Pendse, Shamik Gupta

articles.title: On the structure of low-rank PPT entangled states violating Peres conjecture
articles.title_zh: 违反Peres猜想的低秩PPT纠缠态的结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bound-entangled states with positive partial transpose (PPT) can exhibit quantum steering and Bell nonlocality, disproving the long-standing Peres conjecture and its stronger steering counterpart. These counterexamples, obtained through explicit constructions or numerical searches, raise the question of whether they share a common structural origin. We address this question in the low-rank regime by asking whether known counterexamples can be obtained, up to invertible local filtering, from the complement of an unextendible product basis (UPB). We find that the answer depends crucially on the local dimension. In 3øtimes3, the rank-four structure of PPT entangled states implies that both the steerable PPT state of Moroder et al. and the Bell-nonlocal PPT state of Vértesi and Brunner can be obtained from UPB-complement states under invertible local filtering. For three qubits, in contrast, rank-four states that are PPT across every bipartition are separable across each cut. Moreover, comparison of the product-vector structure of the relevant kernels shows that the known three-qubit Bell-nonlocal PPT states cannot be obtained by invertible local filtering from the complement of any three-qubit UPB. Going beyond rank four, we further show that a known rank-eight three-qutrit state, supported on the complement of a UPB and PPT across every bipartition, is genuinely multipartite entangled. These results show that UPBs provide a unifying structural origin for important low-rank PPT entangled states in 3øtimes3, but that nonlocal bound entanglement is not, in general, a UPB phenomenon.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有正部分转置（PPT）的束缚纠缠态可以表现出量子导引和贝尔非局域性，从而反驳了Peres猜想。本文在低秩状态下探讨了这些反例是否具有共同的结构起源，即它们是否可以通过可逆局部滤波从不可扩展乘积基（UPB）的补集获得。研究发现，答案关键取决于局部维度。在3x3系统中，已知的可导引和贝尔非局域PPT态可以从UPB补集态获得，但在三量子比特系统中则不能。
authors: Gurvir Singh, Manik Banik

articles.title: Quantum Folding in Chebyshev-Based Quantum Subspace Diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 基于切比雪夫量子子空间对角化中的量子折叠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum subspace diagonalization (QSD) with a Krylov space spanned by Chebyshev polynomials of the Hamiltonian is a natural ground-state method for fault-tolerant quantum computers, but every guarantee it offers---convergence rate, noise floor, and the cost of turning its classical output back into a physical state---is controlled by the overlap of the reference state with the true ground state, which decays exponentially with system size for any product state and non-trivial Hamiltonian. We propose quantum folding: for a system governed by a local Hamiltonian, seed the QSD with the product of the ground states of its subsystems, which differs from the target only through the interface terms. We prove a nonasymptotic error bound for the Chebyshev QSD that is linear in the measurement noise, by transplanting Kirby's effective-Hamiltonian analysis to the Chebyshev--Krylov basis, and identify the block-encoding rescaling of the Hamiltonian as a parameter of the guarantee. Exact simulations of antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chains show that the folded reference state reduces the Krylov dimension for a given accuracy severalfold and lowers the error under noise by two to five orders of magnitude relative to the Néel state. We show how the Ritz vector is prepared as a physical state and that the ground-state generation probability obeys a tight ceiling set by the overlap, so that recursive folding prepares ground states at polynomial cost. Taken together, these results allow for a scalable QSD framework that avoids the exponentially small ground-state overlaps associated with conventional product-state initialization. Finally we compute the fold fidelity itself: a slow power law for the gapless spin-1/2 chain, a size-independent constant for the gapped spin-1 chain, and an exact closed form converging to 1/4 for the AKLT chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子子空间对角化（QSD）是一种用于容错量子计算机的基态方法，但其性能受参考态与真实基态重叠的限制。本文提出了“量子折叠”方法，通过将子系统的基态乘积作为QSD的初始参考态。研究证明了切比雪夫QSD的非渐近误差界限与测量噪声呈线性关系。对反铁磁海森堡链的精确模拟表明，折叠参考态能显著降低达到给定精度所需的Krylov维度。
authors: Seung Park, Dongni Chen, Stefano Chesi, Kyunghyun Baek, Mahn-Soo Choi

articles.title: Deterministic and Programmable Fusion for Scalable Generation of Photonic Graph States
articles.title_zh: 用于可扩展生成光子图态的确定性可编程融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement in multiphoton graph states is an important resource with various applications, such as measurement-based quantum computing and memory-less quantum repeaters. While some primitive instances have been successfully prepared, scalable generation of large-scale graph states with programmable connections remains an outstanding challenge. Fusion provides a promising "divide-and-conquer" approach by linking smaller resource states into larger, more complex graphs. However, its practical scalability has been limited by the probabilistic nature of conventional fusion protocols, which necessitates extensive hardware overhead and feed-forward resources to achieve deterministic outcomes. Here, we introduce and experimentally demonstrate a deterministic fusion operation with built-in error mitigation, capable of connecting small time-bin-encoded cluster states--originally generated on-demand from a quantum emitter--into larger, reconfigurable photonic graph states of increased sizes. The fusion operation is realized by nondestructively projecting pairs of flying microwave photonic qubits into Bell states using superconducting circuits with in-situ programmability. Crucially, the protocol features active reset and reuse of matter qubits during graph state generation, thereby circumventing the coherence constraints of the quantum emitter and enabling the generation of genuine multipartite entanglement across 13 photonic qubits. Our results establish a scalable framework for photonic graph-state synthesis, paving the way for fault-tolerant measurement-based quantum computation and distributed quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 多光子图态的纠缠是量子计算和量子中继器中的重要资源，但其可扩展生成仍面临挑战。本文提出并实验演示了一种确定性融合操作，该操作具有内置的错误缓解功能。该方法能够将小型时间编码簇态连接成更大、可重构的光子图态。通过使用超导电路将飞行微波光子量子比特对非破坏性地投影到贝尔态，实现了这一融合操作，为大规模光子图态的生成提供了可扩展的途径。
authors: Yan Li, Yunfan Yang, Zenghui Bao, Jize Yang, Luyan Sun, Yipu Song, Yukai Wu, Hongyi Zhang, Luming Duan

articles.title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for Rényi Entropies Estimation
articles.title_zh: 改进的Rényi熵估计量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entropy estimation of discrete probability distributions is a fundamental problem in statistical inference and quantum property estimation. In this paper, we study the problem of estimating Rényi entropy H_α(p) for any distribution p = (pᵢ₎ᵢ₌₁ⁿ given its purified quantum query-access. For non-integer α > 1, our algorithm estimates H_α(p) to within additive error ϵ using only widetildeObig(nmax¹/²,¹⁻¹/α/ϵbig) queries, which improves the best known upper bound for dependence on both n and 1/ϵ. For 0<α<1, our algorithm has query complexity widetildeObig(n¹/⁽²α⁾/ϵmax¹,¹/⁽²α⁾big), which improves the dependence on 1/ϵ of the current best upper bound without incresing its n dependence. Our approach adapts the multi-level estimation framework to relative approximation of the power sums and leverage binary search to remove the requirement of prior knowledge of them. We also strengthen the precision-dependent lower bound to Ømegabig(1/ϵmax¹,¹/⁽²α⁾big) for 0<α<1, which identifies the optimal precision dependence of our algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在给定纯化量子查询访问权限下，估计离散概率分布的Rényi熵H_α(p)的问题。对于非整数α > 1，提出的算法将查询复杂度改进至O(n⁽¹/2) * (1/ϵ)⁽¹⁻¹/α))，提升了对n和1/ϵ的依赖性。对于0 < α < 1，算法的查询复杂度为O(n⁽¹/(2α)) * (1/ϵ)⁽¹/(2α)))，在不增加n依赖性的前提下改进了对1/ϵ的依赖性。该方法通过多级估计框架和二分查找，提高了Rényi熵估计的效率和精度。
authors: Zongxing Xiong, Chengshen Gao, Lvzhou Li

articles.title: Joint-measurement advantage and finite-time transitions in accelerated detector registers
articles.title_zh: 加速探测器寄存器中的联合测量优势和有限时间跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Unruh response thermalizes accelerated detectors, but the entanglement remaining in a register does not by itself specify what distributed measurements can recover. We study this distinction for a four-qubit cluster state whose two assisting nodes independently undergo generalized amplitude damping, while the target nodes remain isolated and the environments are inaccessible. We derive the exact joint-assisted concurrence and the exact one-way value for arbitrary local measurements. The joint optimum equals the bipartition negativity, and computational-basis measurements attain the one-way optimum. A polar-decomposition argument, together with compactness, establishes a necessary and sufficient condition for separable measurements to attain the joint optimum and proves a strict gap whenever this condition fails. For assisting detectors at equal Unruh temperature with relaxation-rate ratio r>1, joint advantage exists precisely when the thermal excitation factor satisfies q<1/r. At finite positive temperature it ends at a unique finite time, while the remaining entanglement is nonzero. For r=2, both the transition time and remaining resource have closed expressions. These results identify when joint assistance is necessary within the independent weak-coupling thermalization model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Unruh响应热化加速探测器后，寄存器中剩余纠缠与分布式测量可恢复信息之间的区别。研究以一个四量子比特簇态为例，推导了精确的联合辅助纠缠和任意局部测量下的单向值。结果表明，当热激发因子q < 1/r时，联合优势存在，并在有限正温度下于一个独特的有限时间结束，而此时剩余纠缠仍非零。该工作揭示了加速探测器系统中纠缠和测量优势的复杂动态。
authors: Zhiming Huang

articles.title: Testing graph isomorphism using simple quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 使用简单量子电路测试图同构性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19962v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The graph isomorphism problem asks whether two graphs are equivalent up to a permutation of their vertices. Its precise computational complexity remains unresolved, and it is still unknown whether a polynomial-time algorithm exists. We investigate whether simple graph-dependent Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) and Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm (QAOA) circuits can distinguish non-isomorphic graphs. We first show that suitable IQP and QAOA constructions allow the underlying graph to be reconstructed using a polynomial number of samples. Building on previous work using the QAOA energy, we show that Hamming weight distributions can distinguish graph pairs at circuit depths for which the numerically computed energy gap is zero. We then apply graph invariants to the matrix of ZZ correlators on the output distribution. For the specific case of the graph spectrum, at QAOA depth p=2, this invariant numerically distinguishes all 10,486 cospectral regular graph pairs tested on up to 18 vertices. For IQP circuits, we introduce a finer invariant based on probability multiplicities within Hamming weight sectors, which distinguishes every non-isomorphic graph pair tested numerically. Finally, we derive exact graph-theoretic characterisations of the IQP output distribution at θ=π/2 and θ=π/4. These results show that simple graph-dependent quantum circuits encode substantial structural information, while leaving open whether this information can be extracted efficiently for general graph isomorphism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了简单的图依赖瞬时量子多项式时间（IQP）和量子近似优化算法（QAOA）电路能否区分非同构图。研究表明，合适的IQP和QAOA结构可以通过多项式数量的样本重建底层图。此外，通过汉明权重分布和图不变量，这些电路在特定深度下能够区分图对。例如，在QAOA深度p=2时，数值上区分了所有测试的10,486对余谱正则图。
authors: Samuel Beasley, Ashley Montanaro

articles.title: Hyperentanglement in intermediate phase-space planes: benchmarking a photon-pair source for quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 中间相空间平面中的超纠缠：用于量子密钥分发的双光子源基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We characterize a source of photon pairs simultaneously entangled in polarization and in the transverse spatial degree of freedom, with the spatial measurements performed in intermediate planes of the fractional Fourier transform. The source consists of two crossed type-I crystals in a non-collinear geometry, such that the transverse variables carry information about the crystal of origin. Detection in the crystal plane reveals this information completely and destroys the polarization entanglement, so that a scheme using the near and far fields as conjugate spatial bases cannot support a parallel polarization channel. In intermediate planes both spatial bases combine position and momentum, such that the which-crystal information is partially erased, and the polarization entanglement survives in all four combinations of spatial bases. Applying Bell and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen criteria to the same photon pairs certifies both degrees of freedom simultaneously. We evaluate quantum bit error rates and asymptotic secret key rates in each degree of freedom, and find that the source delivers two simultaneously usable channels per photon pair.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表征了一种在偏振和横向空间自由度上同时纠缠的双光子源，其空间测量在分数傅里叶变换的中间平面进行。研究发现，在这些中间平面中，空间基底结合了位置和动量信息，部分消除了“哪个晶体”的信息，从而使偏振纠缠在所有四种空间基底组合中得以保留。通过评估量子比特错误率和渐近秘密密钥率，该光源为每个光子对提供了两个可同时使用的通道。
authors: Murilo H. Magiotto, Millena B. Novaes, Wesley B. Cardoso, Ardiley T. Avelar, 1 Paulo H. Souto Ribeiro, Stephen P. Walborn, Guilherme L. Zanin, Rafael M. Gomes

articles.title: Multi-Instantons and Exact-WKB Stokes Jumps in Multi-Well Quantum Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 多阱量子力学中的多瞬子与精确WKB斯托克斯跳跃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the relation between the exact-WKB Delabaere--Dillinger--Pham Stokes jumps and the multi-instanton expansion of a one-dimensional potential with N equal-depth minima. For a single barrier this relation is the Bogomolny--Zinn-Justin cancellation between the instanton--anti-instanton ambiguity and the Borel ambiguity of perturbation theory, and we extend it to every consecutive barrier interval and to the integration contours themselves. In the dilute large-T regime at fixed nonperturbative grade, we derive the quasi-zero mode integral over the instanton separations from the Euclidean path integral and reduce it to Gamma and Hankel periods. With the local Weber level function of each well and one normalization per well fixed by the local Weber connection matrix, these periods reproduce the two lateral connected exact-WKB coefficients. The two lateral contours of each instanton--anti-instanton separation differ by exactly one Hankel cycle, and this linear Picard--Lefschetz relation reproduces the Stokes jump of the connected coefficient. A numerical solution of the Schrödinger equation for a symmetric triple well confirms the resulting two-barrier level splitting. At higher fixed grade, the map from ordered event sequences to normalized scalar coefficient products is not one-to-one. At leading dilute order the scalar weight of a closed event sequence depends only on the numbers of barrier crossings, mathcal Ibarmathcal I pairs, and mathcal Imathcal I/barmathcal Ibarmathcal I pairs. We construct two inequivalent grade-six triple-well event sequences with the same product of local Weber amplitudes, which embed in every potential with Nge3 wells. Our results hold within the regular dilute, one-loop, local Weber approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了精确WKB Delabaere-Dillinger-Pham斯托克斯跳跃与具有N个等深势阱的一维势的多瞬子展开之间的关系。研究将单势垒的Bogomolny-Zinn-Justin抵消关系推广到每个连续势垒区间和积分路径。在稀疏大T区域，从欧几里得路径积分推导出瞬子分离的准零模积分，并将其简化为Gamma和Hankel周期。数值求解对称三阱薛定谔方程的结果证实了这些关系。
authors: Alireza Behtash, Syo Kamata

articles.title: Pinning of a High-Energy Wavepacket by a Single Impurity
articles.title_zh: 单个杂质对高能波包的钉扎效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that a single repulsive impurity enhances directional confinement of a high-energy wavepacket in a finite two-dimensional lattice of quantum wells. At energies far above the interwell barriers, the impurity suppresses transverse dynamical tunneling while preserving propagation along a principal lattice axis, even as the corresponding classical regular region shrinks. Confinement is strongest at impurity amplitudes comparable to the barrier height and weakens for stronger perturbations. Spectral analysis links this nonmonotonic pinning to the wavepacket's overlap with eigenstates concentrated along the launch direction, consistent with impurity-induced variational scarring. These results show that a single local defect can control quantum propagation over distances far exceeding its own spatial extent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在有限二维量子阱晶格中，单个排斥性杂质能增强高能波包的方向性限制。在远高于阱间势垒的能量下，杂质抑制了横向动力学隧穿，同时保持了沿主晶格轴的传播。这种限制在杂质振幅与势垒高度相当时最强，并通过光谱分析与波包和沿发射方向集中的本征态的重叠相关联。这些结果表明，单个局部缺陷可以控制远超其自身空间范围的量子传播。
authors: Fartash Chalangari, Anant Vijay Varma, Joonas Keski-Rahkonen, Esa Räsänen

articles.title: Exact analytical spectra of an effective field-modified radial Schrödinger equation by the Nikiforov--Uvarov method
articles.title_zh: 采用Nikiforov--Uvarov方法求解有效场修正径向薛定谔方程的精确解析谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit the effective radial Schrödinger equation for a charged spinless particle in collinear static electric and magnetic fields that was formulated in our earlier work within the tridiagonal representation approach (TRA). In that model the angular factor of the electric coupling is replaced by the orientation parameter C=o̧sθ, the linear Zeeman term is diagonal in the azimuthal quantum number, and the effective field-modified central potential takes the form V(r)=Vt(r)+qECr. Here we show that the same equation can be solved exactly without the TRA, by the Nikiforov--Uvarov (NU) method, once the potential component Vt(r) is prescribed. Three examples are worked out in closed form: a Kratzer-type component, which yields a linear-plus-Coulomb-plus-inverse-square central potential; a pseudoharmonic-type component, which yields a linear-plus-harmonic-plus-inverse-square potential; and a Hulthén-type component with a repulsive core (Manning--Rosen form), which yields a screened confining potential with a finite number of s-wave bound states. For each case we obtain the energy spectrum, the normalized eigenfunctions in terms of Laguerre or Jacobi polynomials, the location of the potential minimum, and closed-form radial moments. The spectra are independent of the orientation θ and of the electric field, in agreement with the structure found by the TRA, while the field enters through the shape of V(r), the radial moments, and the expectation value łangle Vångleₖ. All analytical results are confirmed by an independent finite-difference diagonalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了带电无自旋粒子在共线静电磁场中的有效径向薛定谔方程，并展示了如何使用Nikiforov-Uvarov (NU) 方法精确求解该方程，而无需依赖三对角表示法。研究给出了三种具体势函数的闭合形式解，包括Kratzer型、伪谐振型和Hulthén型势。对于每种情况，都获得了能量谱和归一化本征函数。
authors: Tunde Joseph Osunmusanmi, Berihu Teklu

articles.title: Geometric-resource bounds and permutation-averaged success probabilities for the WZP algorithm
articles.title_zh: WZP算法的几何资源界限和置换平均成功概率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving linear systems of equations is a fundamental task in machine learning and optimization. In this work, we extend the original WZP algorithm from real symmetric linear systems to complex Hermitian linear systems. We then study the success probability of the modified WZP algorithm from a resource-theoretic perspective. By expressing the postselection success probability as the expectation value of a positive operator, we derive upper and lower bounds of the maximal success probability over separable, incoherent, and real pure states. These bounds further establish connections between the maximal success probability and geometric entanglement, coherence, and imaginarity. We further show that, under permutation averaging, the averaged success probability is an affine function of the coherence fraction, with its dependence determined by the alignment between the success operator and the equal-superposition state. We also investigate the preprocessed WZP algorithm under subgroup-constrained preprocessing. For the two-level family, the optimal success probability is determined by the maximal projection weight onto the orbit of the target projector. Our results provide a unified perspective on the WZP success probability under different operational constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将WZP算法从实对称线性系统扩展到复厄米线性系统，并从资源理论角度研究了修改后WZP算法的成功概率。通过将后选择成功概率表示为正算符的期望值，推导了在可分离、非相干和实纯态上的最大成功概率的上下界。这些界限揭示了最大成功概率与几何纠缠、相干性和虚数性之间的联系。研究还表明，在置换平均下，平均成功概率是相干分数的一个仿射函数。
authors: Linlin Ye, Linmao Wang, Zhaoqi Wu, Shao-Ming Fei

articles.title: Gaussian and Qubit Semigroup Dynamics beyond GKSL
articles.title_zh: 超越GKSL的高斯和量子比特半群动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20258v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A well established approach to describe open quantum system dynamics is the celebrated Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equation. In this article we aim to shed light on semigroup dynamics that are not of this form. Such dynamics may appear in real physical systems describing asymptotic long-time dynamics. Thus, they correspond to semigroup dynamics applicable to a restricted set of initial states only. As a way of motivating our studies, first we review known results about the single-mode Gaussian Quantum Brownian motion channel and corresponding master equations. Next we discuss a conceptually simpler family of qubit semigroup generators and identify parameter regions of completely positive, merely positive, and non-positive dynamics. We then focus on the latter case to which we will refer to as restricted-positive, as the semigroup generator may well be physically meaningful when applied to a restricted set of admissible initial states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不属于Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) 形式的半群动力学，这类动力学可能描述真实物理系统中的渐近长时间行为，且仅适用于受限的初始态集合。研究回顾了单模高斯量子布朗运动通道，并讨论了一系列量子比特半群生成器，识别了完全正、仅正和非正动力学的参数区域。文章重点关注了非正动力学，称之为受限正动力学，因为它们在应用于受限的初始态集合时可能具有物理意义。
authors: Nadine Diesel, Charlotte Bäcker, Walter T. Strunz

articles.title: Quantum Spectral Estimation with Multiple Initial States: Improved Error and Cost Scaling
articles.title_zh: 采用多初始态的量子谱估计：改进的误差和成本缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum spectrum and eigenstate property estimation using multiple initial states and generalized Hadamard tests. Building on the QFAMES (quantum filtering and analysis of multiplicities in eigenvalue spectra) framework, we introduce a new method that samples evolution times independently for each initial-state pair. Under the stated assumptions, when statistical error determines the sampling cost, the total Hamiltonian simulation cost required for fixed-accuracy eigenvalue and observable estimation is independent of the number of initial states, up to logarithmic factors. This improves scalability when many initial states are needed to explore the target eigenspaces. The method also reduces the cost of multiplicity recovery and retains Heisenberg-limited scaling for eigenvalue estimation. Numerical experiments support the predicted statistical error scalings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了使用多个初始态和广义Hadamard测试进行量子谱和本征态性质估计的方法。在QFAMES框架基础上，提出了一种新方法，为每个初始态对独立采样演化时间。在统计误差决定采样成本时，固定精度本征值和可观测估计所需的总哈密顿量模拟成本与初始态数量无关，从而提高了探索目标本征空间时的可扩展性。该方法还降低了多重性恢复的成本，并保持了本征值估计的海森堡极限缩放。
authors: Lingwei Zhang, Zhiyan Ding

articles.title: Demonstration of a mobile ion-trap quantum device
articles.title_zh: 移动式离子阱量子器件的演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trapped-ion devices are being investigated for transportable applications, including the transfer of exotic charged particles between laboratories and the development of portable quantum technologies. To date, ion transport has been demonstrated only in magnetic (Penning) traps, whereas radiofrequency (Paul) traps are the predominant platform in quantum science. Here, we report the first transport of a few thousand ions confined in a linear Paul trap over distances of several kilometers, with transport durations of 15 and 45 min. These results establish a foundation for mobile trapped-ion quantum devices capable of operating while in motion and may enable the transport of exotic ions in Paul traps between experimental facilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次演示了在直线Paul阱中囚禁的数千个离子在数公里距离上的传输，传输时长分别为15和45分钟。这些结果为移动式离子阱量子器件奠定了基础，使其能够在运动中运行。这项技术有望实现Paul阱中奇异离子在不同实验设施间的传输，推动便携式量子技术的发展。
authors: Sara Alfaro, Dipesh Bhanushali, Sankarshan Choudapurkar, Ashwin Bhartia, Thomas Lafenthaler, Tommaso Faorlin, Yannick Weiser, Lorenz Panzl, Thomas Monz, Rainer Blatt, Giovanni Cerchiari

articles.title: Quantum Work Statistics from Entanglement-Assisted Invariance
articles.title_zh: 基于纠缠辅助不变性的量子功统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that the one-time measurement scheme is more consistent than the standard two-time measurement scheme with respect to the fundamental symmetry of entanglement, namely entanglement-assisted invariance (envariance). In particular, the work statistics obtained from the one-time measurement scheme arise naturally as a direct consequence of envariance for any driving unitary, without involving an explicit measurement postulate, whereas the analogous identification for the two-time measurement scheme is possible only for a Haar-measure-zero set of unitaries. This envariance-based formulation eliminates the ambiguity in work statistics related to the energetic cost of measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在纠缠辅助不变性（envariance）这一基本对称性方面，一次测量方案比标准两次测量方案更具一致性。一次测量方案的功统计结果是纠缠辅助不变性的直接推论，适用于任何驱动幺正变换，且无需明确的测量假设。相比之下，两次测量方案的类似推导仅对Haar测度为零的幺正变换集合成立。这种基于纠缠辅助不变性的表述消除了与测量能量成本相关的功统计模糊性。
authors: Akira Sone, Akram Touil, Emery Doucet, Sebastian Deffner

articles.title: Intermediate memory costs of quantum channel synthesis with a protected subsystem
articles.title_zh: 具有受保护子系统的量子信道合成的中间内存成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A quantum memory can preserve a subsystem perfectly while discarding information needed by a later operation. We study the total intermediate dimension required for channel synthesis when the first stage protects a b-dimensional subsystem and has a prescribed noncommutative graph imposing full confusability on an a-dimensional control register. For a finite family of classically controlled branches, exact synthesis is possible if and only if the target graph contains the prescribed graph of the first stage. For every feasible family, we construct a single processor that implements all branches exactly. The processor uses pairwise nonorthogonal pure program states in a register of dimension at most a. A target graph may be realizable with a carrier of dimension b, while synthesizing a channel with that graph can require dimension ab. We also characterize the closure of the attainable channels, distinguishing exact synthesis from arbitrarily accurate approximation. Finally, for a family built from the trine communication task, a four-dimensional carrier permits exact synthesis with quantum programs under output depolarization. At the same total carrier dimension and without free shared randomness, classical programs have optimal normalized diamond error (1-η)/4, where 0łeqηłeq1 is the depolarization strength. For η<1, the gap persists under sufficiently small perturbations of the target branches.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在量子信道合成中，当第一阶段保护一个b维子系统并对a维控制寄存器施加完全混淆的非交换图时，所需的总中间维度。研究表明，对于有限的经典控制分支族，精确合成是可能的当且仅当目标图包含第一阶段的预设图。文章还构建了一个单一处理器，能够精确实现所有分支，并探讨了可实现信道的闭包，区分了精确合成和任意精确近似。
authors: Kai Liu, Deguang Han

articles.title: Quantum-Aware Key Rank for Side-Channel Attacks evaluation
articles.title_zh: 用于侧信道攻击评估的量子感知密钥排名
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Side-channel attacks on block ciphers rarely recover the key outright: they leave a residual key space ordered by subkey posteriors, and evaluation laboratories report the key rank of the true key against thresholds near 2⁴⁸ and 2⁶⁰. No evaluation framework models an adversary who collects traces classically and finishes the search on a quantum computer, although quantum search with advice provides exactly that. We give such an adversary a cost model and a metric. For a device whose key has rank r, any quantum algorithm with classical access to the posteriors needs Omega(sqrt(r)) cipher evaluations, and block search achieves O(sqrt(r)); the per-instance advantage is exactly quadratic, and the super-quadratic exponents reported for search with advice are averages over the prior that apply to no single device. Under the NIST MAXDEPTH budget D and a Grover iteration of g gates and depth d, the quadratic advantage holds only for ranks up to (4D/(pi d))² and collapses to a constant factor beyond; with the best published AES-128 oracle and D = 2⁴⁰ the window closes near rank 2⁵⁸.6. We define the quantum-aware key rank, the classical rank of equal cost, computable from the rank estimators laboratories already run, and derive the classical rank a device must retain to keep a given threshold against each depth budget. Block search and amplitude amplification from the product-form posterior state are within a factor of two to four of each other on Hamming-weight posteriors, so the cost of coherent indexing decides between them. Experiments on simulated leakage and a toy cipher confirm the predicted window: at SNR 0.125 a depth-limited quantum adversary is worth about 22 traces to a classical one, however large its gate budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 侧信道攻击通常不会直接恢复密钥，而是留下按子密钥后验排序的剩余密钥空间。本文提出了一个评估框架，用于模拟经典收集迹线并在量子计算机上完成搜索的攻击者，并为其定义了成本模型和度量。研究表明，对于密钥排名为r的设备，量子算法需要Omega(sqrt(r))次密码评估，且二次加速优势仅在特定排名范围内成立。文章定义了量子感知密钥排名，以更准确地评估量子时代侧信道攻击的风险。
authors: Yevgen Kotukh

articles.title: Logical CCZ state cultivation
articles.title_zh: 逻辑CCZ态的培养
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Logical CCZ states enable Toffoli gates, a central building block of fault-tolerant quantum arithmetic. We introduce an end-to-end protocol for direct CCZ-state preparation on bivariate tricycle and bicycle (BT/BB) codes. Our factory combines the cup-product CCZ gates native to BT codes with two novel ingredients, both enabled by engineering the logical coupling between BT and BB codes through projection-preserving lifts. Index-2 lifted BB ancillas enable selective Z-basis initialization, allowing the native cup-product gates to directly prepare two disjoint logical CCZ states. The prepared CCZ states are faithfully transferred to index-3 lifted BB memories with high code distance. We use decoder-based postselection to obtain high-fidelity output states with low overhead. We perform exact simulations of our factory under a circuit-level noise model motivated by neutral-atom hardware, obtaining joint infidelities of 1.84×10⁻⁵ at 21.94% acceptance and 4.10×10⁻⁷ at 8.89% acceptance for single-qubit, CZ, and CCZ error rates of 0.01%, 0.1%, and 0.5%, respectively. At the output-infidelity target of our smallest factory, its estimated spacetime cost per CCZ state is lower than that of T-state cultivation followed by CCZ conversion, providing an efficient route to logical CCZ states for fault-tolerant quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种在双变量三轮车和自行车（BT/BB）码上直接制备CCZ态的端到端协议。该协议结合了BT码固有的杯积CCZ门与通过投影保持提升技术实现的BT和BB码之间逻辑耦合工程。通过解码器后选择，该方法能以低开销获得高保真输出态，并在中性原子硬件噪声模型下实现了极高的联合保真度。
authors: Yuta Hirasaki, Jong Yeon Lee

articles.title: Semiclassical state on algebra of observables for de Sitter space and time reversal symmetry
articles.title_zh: 德西特空间可观测物代数上的半经典态与时间反演对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14175v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In de Sitter static patch holography, coupling bulk quantum fields to an observer's dynamical clock yields a type II₁ von Neumann algebra M₊ of gauge-invariant observables. However, the unique tracial state on this algebra fails to reproduce semiclassical bulk correlation functions. We resolve this issue by introducing a family of heavy-clock states, representing an observer reference frame with heavy inertia. We prove that in the heavy-clock limit, n-point correlation functions of gauge-invariant dressed observables reproduce the bulk quantum field correlation functions on de Sitter spacetime. Furthermore, we investigate a generalized observer Hamiltonian widehatHₘ̊ ₒbₛ=|widehatπ| that incorporates both forward-running (π≥ 0) and backward-running (π <0) clocks. The resulting von Neumann algebra M of gauge-invariant observables remains a type~II₁ factor and is isomorphic to M₊øtimes M₂₍C), where M₂₍C) is the algebra of 2×2 complex matrices transforming between the two clock orientations. Time-reversal symmetry is implemented in this setting as an anti-unitary operator that exchanges the two clock orientations, yielding a type~II₁ von Neumann algebra F of gauge-invariant, time-reversal-invariant observables. We generalize the heavy-clock state construction to both M and F, showing that n-point correlation functions calculated in heavy-clock states match the corresponding semiclassical bulk correlation functions. Finally, by coupling Einstein gravity to the Brown--Kuchař dust field, we derive the observer Hamiltonian widehatHₘ̊ ₒbₛ=|widehatπ| from a perturbative reduction along the observer's worldline in the G → 0 limit. This provides a field-theoretic foundation for the observer model developed in this work.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究解决了德西特静态补丁全息术中，唯一迹态无法重现半经典体关联函数的问题。通过引入一系列重时钟态，我们证明在重时钟极限下，规范不变的修饰可观测物的n点关联函数能重现德西特时空上的体量子场关联函数。此外，研究还探讨了包含正向和反向运行时钟的广义观测者哈密顿量，并在此背景下实现了时间反演对称性。
authors: Muxin Han, Yichen Hu

articles.title: Viscous hydrodynamics from correlated losses
articles.title_zh: 关联损耗产生的粘性流体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19083v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Interactions turn a gas into a fluid. We show that two-body loss can take their place. Correlated loss induces elastic scattering, as required by the optical theorem, which dominates at strong loss via the quantum Zeno effect. A nondegenerate gas with only two-body loss thus flows hydrodynamically, with viscosity and thermal conductivity close to those of the unitary Fermi gas. As loss heats the gas, both grow in time with a universal exponent 3/8. Unlike single-particle loss, two-body loss can engineer collisions, and hence transport, in quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究表明，双体损耗可以诱导弹性散射，从而使非简并气体表现出流体动力学行为。在强损耗下，通过量子芝诺效应，这种弹性散射占据主导地位。由此产生的气体具有与幺正费米气体接近的粘度和热导率，并且随着损耗加热气体，两者随时间以3/8的普适指数增长。这表明双体损耗可以用于工程量子物质中的碰撞和输运。
authors: Aleksandr N. Mikheev, Orjan Ameye, Oded Zilberberg, Jeff Maki

articles.title: Gravity from generalized entropy
articles.title_zh: 广义熵引力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gravity from entropy (GfE) identifies its Lagrangian with the geometric quantum relative entropy (GQRE) between the spacetime metric and a metric induced by matter and curvature, treating the metric itself as a quantum operator. We extend this construction to the Tsallis, Rényi, and Sharma-Mittal families, which we call gravity from generalized entropy (GfGE), and determine their common Einstein limit, weak-field spectra, auxiliary-field formulation, and horizon entropy. The entropy choice controls the leading higher-curvature terms and additional modes. We confirm that the linearized GfE spectrum contains a healthy scalar and a Planck-scale tachyonic spin-2 ghost. We identify the conditions that remove this ghost: curvature must enter through its scalar trace, or the entropy generator must be flat to quadratic order at the identity. The latter gives exact general relativity for Tsallis at q=0 and ghost-free f(R,Lₘ₎ theories for Rényi and Sharma-Mittal. On shell, the auxiliary G-field is proportional to the tensor in Wald's entropy formula. For analytic entropy functions, horizons with a single curvature scale have an area term followed by constant and inverse-area corrections. We also extend the volume-constraint cosmological constant to the full family; its leading entropy dependence is set by the scalar mass. A finite set of entropy-function derivatives controls the leading weak-curvature departures from general relativity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究将引力从熵（GfE）的构造扩展到Tsallis、Rényi和Sharma-Mittal家族，称之为广义熵引力（GfGE）。我们确定了它们的共同爱因斯坦极限、弱场谱、辅助场公式和视界熵。研究发现，熵的选择控制着主要的更高曲率项和附加模式，并识别了消除线性化GfE谱中速子自旋2鬼场的条件，从而得到精确的广义相对论或无鬼场的f(R,Lₘ₎理论。
authors: Hussain Gohar

articles.title: Beyond the lemon: Spectra of random Lindblad operators with a Hamiltonian component
articles.title_zh: 超越柠檬：具有哈密顿分量的随机林德布拉德算子的谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19261v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generators of continuous-time quantum Markovian evolution, known as Lindblad operators, play a key role in the theory of open quantum systems. The question of how to define and characterize random Lindblad operators has attracted considerable attention in recent years. Purely dissipative random Lindbladians have been extensively studied using toolboxes of free probability and non-Hermitian random matrix theories, which helped, among other results, to uncover a characteristic lemon-like spectral support. In this work, we focus on random Lindbladians with a Hamiltonian component. We analyze three ensembles of increasing complexity, designed to illustrate the joint effects of dissipative and Hamiltonian dynamics. While the first two ensembles allow for an exact analytic treatment with standard probabilistic and free-probability methods, the generic case of independently random Hamiltonian and dissipative components requires a novel framework that combines operator-valued free probability with sequential noise averaging. For this ensemble, our approach preserves the underlying tensor-product structure of the Lindblad operator and derives a general equation for the spectral boundary. We characterize the effect of Hamiltonian-induced spectral squeezing and explain how the spectral support changes with the relative Hamiltonian strength and the rank of the dissipative component.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究关注具有哈密顿分量的随机林德布拉德算子，它们是连续时间量子马尔可夫演化的生成元。我们分析了三个复杂性递增的系综，以阐明耗散和哈密顿动力学的联合效应。对于独立随机哈密顿和耗散分量的通用情况，我们提出了一种结合算子值自由概率和序列噪声平均的新框架，该框架保留了林德布拉德算子的底层张量积结构。
authors: Mykhailo Hontarenko, Wojciech Tarnowski, Sergey Denisov, Karol Życzkowski

articles.title: Mutual Information of Measurement in Conformal Field Theories
articles.title_zh: 共形场论中测量的互信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The mutual information of measurement of a local operator between two spatial regions characterizes the reduction in the uncertainty of measurement outcomes in one region given the outcome in the other. We study the Rényi-Shannon mutual information of measurement in conformal field theories (CFTs). Explicit calculations for scalar primaries and descendants in large N CFTs are performed in the two extreme limits of the intervals being adjacent or largely separated. The results depend on only the cross ratio and the scaling dimension Δ of the operator being measured, with striking similarities to the mutual information of entanglement. We find a surprising quadratic dependence as (Δ-1/2)² for adjacent intervals. This dependence superficially seems to violate the information processing inequality, which we discuss and resolve. We also offer a holographic interpretation of the mutual information of measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共形场论（CFTs）中两个空间区域之间局部算子测量的Rényi-Shannon互信息。在大N CFTs中，对相邻和远距离间隔的标量原算子和子算子进行了显式计算。结果仅取决于交叉比和算子的标度维度Δ，与纠缠互信息表现出惊人的相似性，并揭示了相邻间隔的二次依赖性。研究还讨论并解决了信息处理不等式的表面违反，并提供了测量的互信息的全息解释。
authors: Israel Klich, Ravisankar Rajagopal, Diana Vaman

articles.title: A compact six-beam 3D magneto-optical trap based on multifunctional metasurface chips
articles.title_zh: 基于多功能超表面芯片的紧凑型六光束三维磁光阱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19504v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magneto-optical traps (MOTs), indispensable to cold-atom-based quantum computing and quantum precision measurement, are increasingly desired in compact and stable form. Particularly, the six-beam 3D-MOT, distinguished by symmetric geometry and superior trapping performance, finds particularly broad applications. Conventional implementations, however, rely on complex and bulky free-space optics, hindering miniaturization, practical assembly, and long-term stability. Here, we demonstrate a compact six-beam 3D-MOT system that employs two multifunctional optical metasurface chips to implement the optical-field functionalities required for cooling and trapping atoms. By combining two metasurface chips and a vacuum cell, a photonic-integrated cell module (PICM) is implemented as the core assembly and the volume is only" 73*73*107 mm³" . In success, 1.3 * 10³ Rb atoms are trapped and cooled to the temperature of ~183 μK. It should be noticed that the laser beam is guided to the metasurface through optical fiber, thus such fully fiber-coupled architecture enables straightforward and stable operations. We believe that this work would pave a practical route toward compact and portable 3D-MOT.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了一种紧凑型六光束三维磁光阱（3D-MOT）系统，该系统利用两个多功能光学超表面芯片实现原子冷却和捕获所需的光场功能。通过结合两个超表面芯片和一个真空单元，实现了体积仅为73*73*107 mm³的光子集成单元模块（PICM）。该系统成功捕获并冷却了1.3 × 10³个铷原子至约183 μK，其全光纤耦合架构确保了操作的稳定性和便捷性。
authors: Chen Qing, Huijie Sun, Yize Liu, Yuxuan Liao, Yongzhuo Li, Dengke Zhang, Xue Feng, Yidong Huang

articles.title: Quantum-enhanced Search for Galactic Dark Photons Using Cat-State Cavities
articles.title_zh: 利用猫态腔量子增强搜索银河系暗光子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19751v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a quantum-enhanced search for the Galactic dark-photon background (GDPB), a relativistic and anisotropic vector field that can be produced by dark-matter decay or annihilation in the Milky Way halo. We reinterpret an existing quantum-enhanced dark-photon dataset obtained with a superconducting circuit QED platform originally developed for wave-like dark-photon dark-matter searches, consisting of a high-Q niobium cavity in the TM₀₁₀ mode dispersively coupled to a transmon qubit. By preparing four-component cat states and performing repeated quantum non-demolition parity measurements, analyzed with a hidden Markov model, we extract photon-transition probabilities for multiple cat amplitudes and integration times. The coupling to the GDPB is governed by a polarization- and angle-dependent cavity overlap function, which predicts a distinctive diurnal modulation of the excitation rate for both longitudinal and transverse polarizations. From the absence of such modulation, we set 90% confidence-level bounds on the kinetic-mixing parameter ϵ for two benchmark production mechanisms (parametric and cascade decay) over the relativistic mass range m_X łl ømega_c.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种量子增强搜索银河系暗光子背景（GDPB）的方法，利用超导电路QED平台重新解释了现有数据。通过制备四分量猫态并进行重复的量子非破坏性宇称测量，我们提取了多个猫态振幅和积分时间的跃迁概率。基于激发率中缺乏独特的昼夜调制，我们为两种基准生产机制设定了动力学混合参数ϵ的90%置信水平限制。
authors: Aoying Wang, Yanjie Zeng, Yanyan Cai, Jing Shu, Bin Xu, Yuan Xu, Pan Zheng

articles.title: Observation of correlations beyond the single-particle picture in fermionic counting statistics
articles.title_zh: 费米子计数统计中超越单粒子图像的关联观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19950v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The analysis of charge fluctuations in a mesoscopic device can shed light on the fundamental question of whether or not a single-particle picture of electron transport is appropriate, even in the presence of Coulomb interaction. It has been shown on general grounds that mapping the interacting system onto a fermionic single-particle description is subject to strict constraints on the charge-transfer statistics. These constraints can be formulated in terms of a sign rule for the factorial cumulants of the full counting statistics. We report here on the experimental observation of a sign-rule violation in a most elementary model system, i.e. a single-level quantum dot, and provide theoretical modeling that can quantitatively reproduce the experimental data. This reveals the presence of correlations introduced by electron-electron interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究报告了在最基本的单能级量子点模型系统中，实验观测到全计数统计的阶乘累积量中符号规则的违反。这一发现揭示了电子-电子相互作用引入的关联，超越了电子输运的单粒子图像。理论模型能够定量重现实验数据，证实了这些关联的存在。
authors: Johann Zöllner, Hendrik Mannel, Daniel Oppers, Martin Geller, Axel Lorke, Jürgen König

articles.title: Preservation of photon statistics upon selective molecular modulation in hollow-core fibers
articles.title_zh: 空心光纤中选择性分子调制对光子统计的保持
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19964v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Preserving the underlying statistical properties of light during frequency transduction is essential for interfacing spectrally disparate quantum systems. To do this successfully, the process needs to be highly efficient, broadband and noiseless. Despite significant progress in this field, satisfying all these conditions remains challenging. Recently, molecular modulation-based transduction in hollow-core fibers has emerged as a promising approach, where biphoton correlations were proven to be preserved during frequency up-conversion. However, beyond this previous demonstration of correlation-maintaining conversion, whether molecular modulation can preserve more general statistical properties of light remains experimentally unexplored. Here, we demonstrate the conservation of photon-number statistics during selective frequency transduction by Raman molecular modulation in a hydrogen-filled hollow-core fiber. As a proof of concept, weak 585-nm signals are selectively converted to 773 nm in the near-infrared and to 471 nm in the blue spectral region with near-unity efficiencies. Phase matching between the generated coherence waves and the transitions of interest is achieved through the effective dispersion of the system, enabling independent selection of the frequency up- and down-conversion processes. The preservation of the photon-number statistics of the shifted signals, along with the large frequency shifts, broad tunability and compatibility with quantum-optical fields, provides a versatile fiber-based platform for quantum frequency transduction. In particular, the demonstrated interfacing between visible and near-infrared wavelengths using low pump energies and low gas pressures offers a route towards connecting spectrally distinct quantum systems, including quantum emitters, sensors and atomic quantum memories, within hybrid quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了在充氢空心光纤中，通过拉曼分子调制进行选择性频率转换时，光子数统计的守恒。这对于连接光谱差异较大的量子系统至关重要，证明了该过程是高效、宽带且无噪声的。作为概念验证，弱585纳米信号被高效地转换到近红外773纳米和蓝色471纳米波段，效率接近统一。
authors: Arturo Mena, Pau Arcos, María Sánchez-Hernández, Benoit Debord, Frédéric Gérôme, Fetah Benabid, Nicolas Y. Joly, Oskar Arrizabalaga, Joseba Zubia, David Novoa

articles.title: Directional effects of the Unruh effect on steering harvesting
articles.title_zh: 昂鲁效应在转向收获中的方向性影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate directional quantum steering harvesting by two uniformly accelerated non-identical Unruh-DeWitt detectors coupled to a massless scalar field in the Minkowski vacuum. We show that the Unruh effect does not simply degrade harvested steering, but can reshape its directionality in a strongly parameter-dependent manner. At low detector energy scales, acceleration predominantly suppresses steering, whereas at higher energy scales, moderate acceleration can enhance steering and even activate an initially absent steering direction. Most strikingly, within a finite acceleration window, the Unruh effect enhances steering in one direction while simultaneously suppressing it in the opposite direction, revealing an intrinsically directional influence of relativistic acceleration. Detector non-identicality provides an additional control mechanism: a moderate energy-gap mismatch can enhance or activate one steering direction while suppressing the reverse one, whereas sufficiently large energy-gap mismatch suppresses the harvested steering. Moreover, the maximal steering asymmetry approximately marks the transition from two-way to one-way steering. Our results establish relativistic acceleration and detector non-identicality as means of controlling the strength and directionality of vacuum-harvested quantum correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了两个均匀加速的非相同Unruh-DeWitt探测器在闵可夫斯基真空中耦合到无质量标量场时，定向量子转向收获的现象。结果表明，昂鲁效应不仅会降低收获的转向，还能以强参数依赖的方式重塑其方向性。在有限的加速窗口内，昂鲁效应可以增强一个方向的转向，同时抑制相反方向的转向，揭示了相对论加速的内在方向性影响。
authors: Shu-Min Wu, Rui-Yang Xu, Zhihong Liu

articles.title: Quantized six-vertex realizations of frustration graphs
articles.title_zh: 挫折图的量子化六顶点实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20166v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A recent graph-theoretic criterion for a Hamiltonian to exhibit a free-parafermion spectrum is that its frustration graph be an indifference graph. We show that an arbitrary finite indifference graph can be realized as a frustration graph of the quantized six-vertex model at odd roots of unity, by a suitable choice of the defining wiring diagram and parameters. This provides a concrete realization of the criterion through the quantum Frobenius property of the quantized six-vertex model, recently established from its three-dimensional integrable structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究表明，任意有限的无差别图都可以通过适当选择定义布线图和参数，在单位奇数根处的量子化六顶点模型中实现为挫折图。这通过量子化六顶点模型的量子Frobenius性质，为哈密顿量展现自由类费米子谱的图论判据提供了具体实现。
authors: Atsuo Kuniba, Souta Oikawa

articles.title: All you need is Trotter
articles.title_zh: 仅需Trotter
articles.abstract: arXiv:2311.01533v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The work here enables a cost scaling of tildeOłeft( fracT ¹⁺o⁽¹⁾,m̊ log² (1/ϵ)ǎrepsiloni̊ght) and maximum depth tildeOłeft( fracT¹⁺o⁽¹⁾,m̊ log (1/ϵ)ǎrepsiloni̊ght) for estimating observables after some Hamiltonian evolution eⁱ H T using no extra block-encoding qubits, where ϵ is the algorithmic error of the target Hamiltonian evolution and ǎrepsilon is the statistical error from the observable estimation. Throughout, tildeO suppresses factors that are doubly logarithmic in 1/ϵ (i.e. m̊ polyloglog(1/ϵ)), which are subdominant to the displayed m̊ polylog(1/ϵ) factors. This is achieved through product formulas, stable interpolation (Chebyshev), and to calculate the needed fractional queries, cardinal sine interpolation is used. This is an improvement over similar work using interpolation methods which have a superlinear scaling of the form 5^p T¹⁺¹/p, where p is the order of the product formula used and an improvement on required qubits over Quantum Signal Processing methods while maintaining scaling with m̊ polylog1/ϵ. This is accomplished through an optimized and variable (with T) order p. The slightly better łog²⁽¹/ϵ) compared to łog³⁽¹/ϵ) comes from the use of cardinal sine interpolation compared to other methods using Chebyshev interpolation and product formulas. The work presented here also provides an alternative to Quantum Signal Processing techniques to calculate observables or amplitudes after a fractional query evolution with a cost O(Tłog1/ϵ) through this cardinal sine interpolation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种在哈密顿量演化后估计可观测值的方法，实现了改进的成本和深度缩放，且无需额外的块编码量子比特。它通过乘积公式、稳定插值（切比雪夫）以及基数正弦插值来计算所需的分数查询。该方法通过优化和可变阶数p，在所需量子比特方面优于量子信号处理方法，并在缩放方面超越了其他插值方法。
authors: Gumaro Rendon

articles.title: Relativistic generalization of Feynman's path integral on the basis of extended Lagrangians
articles.title_zh: 基于扩展拉格朗日量的费曼路径积分的相对论推广
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.06530v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the extended Lagrange formalism of classical point dynamics, the system's dynamics is parametrized along a system evolution parameter s, and the physical time t is treated as a emphdependent variable t(s) on equal footing with all other configuration space variables qⁱ(s). In the action principle, the conventional classical action L dt is then replaced by the generalized action Lₑds. A direct reparametrization of the conventional action yields an extended Lagrangian that is homogeneous of degree one in the velocities. A regular extended Lagrangian that is not homogeneous of degree one can also reproduce the conventional dynamics on a suitably selected invariant hypersurface. With this representation, the physical motion takes place on a hypersurface within a symplectic extended phase space of even dimension. The formal similarity of conventional and extended Lagrange formalisms provides a direct connection with the proper-time path integral approach to relativistic quantum physics. To provide an example, the non-homogeneous extended Lagrangian Lₑ of a classical relativistic spinless point particle in an external electromagnetic field will be presented. This extended Lagrangian is a quadratic function in the velocities, and its selected zero-energy hypersurface is the classical mass shell. With this Lₑ, the generalized path integral first yields an evolution equation in s. Imposing the corresponding quantum mass-shell condition then yields the Klein-Gordon equation as the physical wave equation. This establishes the relation between the classical extended Lagrangian description and proper-time quantization for a charged spin-zero particle.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在经典点动力学的扩展拉格朗日形式主义基础上，对费曼路径积分进行了相对论推广。在该形式主义中，物理时间被视为一个依赖变量，并与所有其他构型空间变量同等对待。通过这种表示，物理运动发生在偶数维辛几何扩展相空间中的一个超曲面上。该方法为相对论量子物理中的本征时间路径积分方法提供了直接联系。
authors: Jürgen Struckmeier

articles.title: Renormalisation of Quantum Cellular Automata
articles.title_zh: 量子元胞自动机的重整化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.12652v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a coarse-graining procedure for quantum cellular automata on hypercubic lattices that consists in grouping neighboring cells into tiles and selecting a subspace within each tile. This is done in such a way that multiple evolution steps applied to this subspace can be viewed as a single evolution step of a new quantum cellular automaton, whose cells are the subspaces themselves. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for renormalizability and use it to investigate the renormalization flow of cellular automata on a line, where the cells are qubits and the tiles are composed of two neighboring cells. The problem is exhaustively solved, and the fixed points of the renormalization flow are highlighted.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了超立方晶格上量子元胞自动机的粗粒化过程，该过程涉及将相邻单元格分组为瓦片并在每个瓦片内选择一个子空间。通过这种方式，应用于该子空间的多个演化步骤可以被视为一个新的量子元胞自动机的单个演化步骤。我们推导了可重整化的充要条件，并用其研究了线上一维量子元胞自动机的重整化流，识别了其不动点。
authors: Lorenzo Siro Trezzini, Alessandro Bisio, Paolo Perinotti

articles.title: Conjectured Bounds for 2-Local Hamiltonians via Token Graphs
articles.title_zh: 通过令牌图对2-局域哈密顿量提出猜想界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.03441v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We explain how the maximum energy of the Quantum MaxCut, XY, and EPR Hamiltonians on a graph G are related to the spectral radii of the token graphs of G. From numerical study, we conjecture new bounds for these spectral radii based on properties of G. We show how these conjectures tighten the analysis of existing algorithms, implying state-of-the-art approximation ratios for all three Hamiltonians. Our conjectures also provide simple combinatorial bounds on the ground state energy of the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model, which we prove for bipartite graphs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文阐释了图G上量子MaxCut、XY和EPR哈密顿量的最大能量与G的令牌图的谱半径之间的关系。基于数值研究，我们提出了这些谱半径的新猜想界限。这些猜想收紧了现有算法的分析，为这三种哈密顿量带来了最先进的近似比。我们的猜想还为反铁磁海森堡模型的基态能量提供了简单的组合界限，并对二分图进行了证明。
authors: Anuj Apte, Ojas Parekh, James Sud

articles.title: Computational Aspects of the Trace Norm Contraction Coefficient
articles.title_zh: 迹范数收缩系数的计算方面
