articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.16737v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that approximating the trace norm contraction coefficient of a quantum channel within a constant factor is NP-hard. Equivalently, this shows that determining the optimal success probability for encoding a bit in a quantum system undergoing noise is NP-hard. This contrasts with the classical analogue of this problem that can clearly be solved efficiently. We also establish the NP-hardness of deciding if the contraction coefficient is equal to 1, i.e., the channel can perfectly preserve a bit. As a consequence, deciding if a non-commutative graph has an independence number of at least 2 is NP-hard. In addition, we establish a converging hierarchy of semidefinite programming upper bounds on the contraction coefficient.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在常数因子内近似量子信道的迹范数收缩系数是NP-难的，这等价于确定在噪声量子系统中编码比特的最佳成功概率是NP-难的。这与可高效解决的经典模拟问题形成对比。作者还确立了判断收缩系数是否等于1的NP-难性，并由此推导出判断非交换图的独立数是否至少为2是NP-难的。此外，文中还提出了收敛的半定规划上界层次结构。
authors: Idris Delsol, Omar Fawzi, Jan Kochanowski, Akshay Ramachandran

articles.title: Solving the traveling salesman problem on łceil łog₂ (N-1)! c̊eil qubits with a variational quantum Kolmogorov--Arnold network: exact-gradient CVaR training and generalization over time-dependent graphs
articles.title_zh: 使用变分量子Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在 ⌈log₂(N-1)!⌉ 量子比特上解决旅行商问题：精确梯度CVaR训练和在时变图上的泛化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.22752v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The one-hot encoding of the traveling salesman problem (TSP) on quantum hardware needs (N-1)² qubits for N sites and penalty terms that dominate the cost landscape. Permutation encodings that label every tour by its Lehmer code need only łceil łog₂ (N-1)! c̊eil qubits and no penalty term, but variational solvers on them have reached the optimum reliably only up to six sites. Here we show how to train such a solver so that it scales to ten sites and transfers across graphs. A variational quantum Kolmogorov--Arnold network (VQKAN) generates the angles of a shallow circuit from the time and from features of the distance matrix; the circuit is trained on the conditional value at risk (CVaR) of the tour length with an exact adjoint gradient, a risk-level schedule, multi-start, small-angle initialization, and basin-hopping restarts, and the qubits are read as a Gray code so that neighbouring states are neighbouring tours. The method returns the optimal tour on every instance tested for N = 4 to 10 (symmetric polygons and asymmetric random graphs), and in 112 of 120 cases of a thirty-run repetition at N = 10 with the remaining gaps at 1% of the optimum, using 3 to 19 qubits where one-hot encoding needs 9 to 81, with as few as 10² measurement shots. With the distance features as inputs, one parameter set generalizes to unseen times on time-dependent graphs. An ablation identifies basin hopping as the ingredient that removes the residual local minima at N = 10, while deeper circuits do not help; controls against 2-opt, the one-hot encoding, and an N-qubit one-hot walk separate the circuit's contribution from classical post-processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种使用变分量子Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（VQKAN）解决旅行商问题（TSP）的新方法，该方法仅需 ⌈log₂(N-1)!⌉ 量子比特且无需惩罚项。通过精确梯度CVaR训练、风险水平调度、多重启动等优化策略，该求解器能够扩展到十个城市并泛化到不同图。该方法在N=4到10的测试实例中均能找到最优路径，并在N=10的重复测试中取得了高成功率，剩余差距仅为1%。
authors: Hikaru Wakaura

articles.title: Objectivity, basis ambiguity, and the classical simulability of concordant quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 客观性、基底模糊性与协调量子计算的经典可模拟性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03225v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Concordant quantum computations, in which circuits whose register carries zero quantum discord with respect to every subsystem at every step, contain neither entanglement nor any other form of quantum correlation, yet no efficient classical simulation of them is known beyond restricted gate sets. We argue that the obstruction is not a shortage of correlations but the absence of a uniquely identifiable local product basis, and we develop this emphbasis ambiguity on two fronts. Quantitatively, we introduce the Basis Ambiguity Measure βin[0,1], the normalized dimension of the manifold of admissible diagonalizing bases on a gate support, and prove a sharp equivalence: a concordance-preserving gate that defeats the Local Basis Finder of Cable and Browne exists if and only if β>0. Both directions are constructive. Physically, we identify the resource whose absence the obstruction is: emphbasis objectivity, a redundant and independently accessible record of the local basis. We show that an environment in spectrum broadcast form, together with the system--environment interaction map, replaces the NP-hard degeneracy test of Eastin by a fixed number of pairwise fragment comparisons per gate, at a cost independent of register size and circuit depth; the two ingredients live on different axes (state and dynamics), and neither alone suffices. We further prove that a theory in which every state has a strictly unique decomposition into perfectly distinguishable pure states has a simplex state space and lacks the continuity content of Hardy's fifth axiom, so that β is a computational witness of that axiom. Finally, as a proof of principle that basis ambiguity carries operational content, we present a concordant encryption protocol with hidden local bases, together with an explicit account of what its security does and does not rest on.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了协调量子计算的经典模拟难题，认为其障碍并非缺乏量子关联，而是缺乏唯一可识别的局域乘积基底。作者引入了基底模糊性度量β，并证明了当且仅当β>0时，存在一种协调保持门能规避局域基底查找器。物理上，他们将这种障碍归因于基底客观性的缺失，并提出了一种通过环境交互图替代NP-难简并性测试的方法。
authors: Bishal Kumar Das, Sourav Manna, Vaibhav Madhok

articles.title: Finite-size quantum key distribution rates from Rényi entropies using conic optimization
articles.title_zh: 利用锥优化从Rényi熵推导有限尺寸量子密钥分发速率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.10584v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Finite-size general security proofs for quantum key distribution based on Rényi entropies have recently been introduced. These approaches are more flexible and provide tighter bounds on the secret key rate than traditional formulations based on the von Neumann entropy. However, deploying them requires minimizing the conditional Rényi entropy, a difficult optimization problem that has hitherto been tackled using ad-hoc techniques based on the Frank-Wolfe algorithm, which are unstable and can only handle particular cases. In this work, we introduce a method based on non-symmetric conic optimization for solving this problem. Our technique is fast, reliable, and completely general. We illustrate its performance on several protocols, whose results represent an improvement over the state of the art.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于非对称锥优化的方法，用于计算基于Rényi熵的有限尺寸量子密钥分发（QKD）安全证明中的条件Rényi熵最小化问题。相较于传统基于Frank-Wolfe算法的特设技术，该方法快速、可靠且通用，能够为QKD协议提供更紧密的秘密密钥速率界限。该技术在多个协议上的性能展示了其优于现有技术的改进。
authors: Mariana Navarro, Andrés González Lorente, Pablo V. Parellada, Carlos Pascual-García, Mateus Araújo

articles.title: Mirror subspace diagonalization: A real-time quantum Krylov algorithm with near-optimal sampling cost
articles.title_zh: 镜像子空间对角化：一种具有近最优采样成本的实时量子Krylov算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20998v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Krylov algorithms are a promising approach for ground-state energy estimation on near-term quantum computers. However, their sampling cost is inherently high because each Hamiltonian term is measured individually. Despite various mitigation techniques, this overhead remains a bottleneck for large-scale electronic structure problems. We introduce mirror subspace diagonalization (MSD), which approaches the theoretical lower bound on the sampling cost for quantum Krylov algorithms built upon real-time evolution. MSD uses a finite-difference formula to express the Hamiltonian as a linear combination of time-evolution unitaries with symmetrically shifted timesteps, enabling efficient estimation of the Hamiltonian matrix within the Krylov subspace. By optimizing the timestep and shifting the energy spectrum, finite-difference and statistical errors are minimized simultaneously, allowing MSD to attain the sampling-cost lower bound up to a logarithmic factor. We further apply classical post-processing to infer Hamiltonian moments, which mitigate the ground-state energy error via the Lanczos scheme. Our analysis shows MSD is particularly effective when the Hamiltonian's spectral norm is much smaller than its 1-norm, as in high-accuracy molecular simulations with large basis sets and strong electronic correlations. Numerical results for various molecular models show sampling-cost reductions of roughly 10 to 10,000 times over the conventional quantum Krylov algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子Krylov算法是近期量子计算机上基态能量估计的一种有前景的方法，但其采样成本高昂。本文引入了镜像子空间对角化（MSD）算法，该算法基于实时演化，能够接近量子Krylov算法采样成本的理论下限。MSD利用有限差分公式将哈密顿量表示为时间演化酉算符的线性组合，从而在Krylov子空间内高效估计哈密顿量矩阵。通过优化时间步长和能量谱，MSD能同时最小化有限差分误差和统计误差，达到接近理论采样成本下限。
authors: Shota Kanasugi, Yuya O. Nakagawa, Norifumi Matsumoto, Yuichiro Hidaka, Kazunori Maruyama, Hirotaka Oshima

articles.title: Spatial Phase Control of Energy and Ergotropy in Quantum Batteries
articles.title_zh: 量子电池中能量和功提取的空间相位控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18192v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the role of spatial geometry in controlling energy storage and work extraction in a non-Markovian quantum battery. The system consists of two identical two-level systems coupled to a structured waveguide reservoir, where one qubit serves as the charger and the other as the battery. The spatial separation between the qubits introduces a geometry-dependent phase that governs collective interference, directly modulating the decay channels and energy transfer dynamics. We show that tuning the interqubit distance allows for the engineering of bright and dark collective pathways, which, in conjunction with environmental memory, significantly enhances the charging power, maximal stored energy, and ergotropy revivals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了空间几何在非马尔可夫量子电池中能量存储和功提取中的作用。系统由两个耦合到结构化波导储层的相同两能级系统组成，其中一个量子比特作为充电器，另一个作为电池。量子比特之间的空间分离引入了几何相关的相位，控制着集体干涉，直接调节衰减通道和能量传输动力学。研究表明，调节量子比特间距可以工程化明亮和黑暗的集体路径，结合环境记忆，显著提升充电功率、最大存储能量和功提取的复苏。
authors: Maryam Hadipour, Soroush Haseli

articles.title: Classical shadows with arbitrary group representations
articles.title_zh: 具有任意群表示的经典阴影
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.01429v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Classical shadows (CS) has recently emerged as an important framework to efficiently predict properties of an unknown quantum state. A common strategy in CS protocols is to parametrize the basis in which one measures the state by a random group action; many examples of this have been proposed and studied on a case-by-case basis. In this work, we present a unified theory that allows us to simultaneously understand CS protocols based on sampling from general group representations, extending previous approaches that worked in simplified (multiplicity-free) settings. We identify a class of measurement bases which we call "centralizing bases" that allows us to analytically characterize and invert the measurement channel, minimizing classical post-processing costs. We complement this analysis by deriving general bounds on the sample-complexity necessary to obtain estimates of a given precision. Beyond its unification of previous CS protocols, our method allows us to readily generate new protocols based on other groups, or different representations of previously considered ones. For example, we characterize novel shadow protocols based on sampling from the spin and tensor representations of textsfSU(2), symmetric and orthogonal groups, and the exceptional Lie group G₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典阴影（CS）已成为一种有效预测未知量子态性质的重要框架。本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，用于理解基于任意群表示采样的CS协议，扩展了以往在简化设置下的方法。作者识别了一类“中心化基底”，能够解析地表征和反演测量信道，从而最小化经典后处理成本。此外，文中还推导了获得给定精度估计所需的样本复杂度的通用界限，并展示了如何基于其他群或不同表示生成新的CS协议。
authors: Maxwell West, Frederic Sauvage, Aniruddha Sen, Roy Forestano, David Wierichs, Nathan Killoran, Dmitry Grinko, M. Cerezo, Martin Larocca

articles.title: Why does the wavefunction 'collapse' in relational approaches to quantum mechanics?
articles.title_zh: 关系量子力学中波函数为何“坍缩”？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12094v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: I argue that there is a straightforward way to understand the occurrence of wavefunction collapses or 'quantum events' in relational approaches to quantum mechanics: we necessarily encounter a discontinuity in our description when a system interacts with the reference relative to which we are describing it, since the reference system cannot be described relative to itself. This makes it clear how recent concerns around quantum events in relational quantum mechanics should be resolved. However, the solution requires accepting that quantum mechanics is not a complete description of all physical facts, and moreover I argue that this is most likely inevitable if we want to be able to give a precise description of quantum events.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了关系量子力学中波函数坍缩或“量子事件”的发生机制。作者提出，当系统与描述它的参照系相互作用时，描述中必然出现不连续性，因为参照系无法相对于自身进行描述。这一观点有助于解决关系量子力学中关于量子事件的近期争议，但其解决方案要求接受量子力学并非对所有物理事实的完整描述。
authors: Emily Adlam

articles.title: Sequential vs. Synchronized Entanglement Swapping: QKD Secret-Key Rate under Optimized Link-Layer Control
articles.title_zh: 顺序式与同步式纠缠交换：优化链路层控制下的量子密钥分发秘密密钥率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.04047v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum repeater chains build long-distance entanglement for quantum key distribution (QKD) by creating pairs on short links and joining them through entanglement swapping. Because stored pairs lose fidelity while they wait, swap timing can affect the secret-key rate. We study how network-layer swap scheduling affects six-state QKD on a simulated four-hop chain under an idealized Werner-state noise model. We compare a sequential (swap-and-wait) discipline, which builds and stores partial chains, with a synchronized (wait-and-swap) discipline, which waits until all links are ready before swapping. Both use the same reinforcement-learned link controllers, isolating the effect of the swapping discipline. When stored pairs cannot retain sufficient fidelity for one network time step, our sequential implementation produces no key, while synchronized retains a small key rate from simultaneous link deliveries. Once sequential becomes viable, it outperforms synchronized by up to 19.1% in the homogeneous chains studied, with the advantage decreasing as memory lifetime increases. We predict the synchronized short-memory pair-delivery rate from link-delivery statistics and derive a closed-form condition for when sequential can preserve progress across time steps. We also examine chains with one slower link, where partial chains can wait and decay at the bottleneck. In this setting, synchronized slightly outperforms sequential at longer memory lifetimes. Moving the slow link has little effect on key rate away from the transition region but strongly affects sequential link-buffer occupancy. Choosing a swapping discipline therefore depends not only on whether memories can preserve partial progress, but also on how the link configuration determines where that progress must wait and decay.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子中继器链通过短链路生成纠缠对并进行纠缠交换，以实现长距离量子密钥分发（QKD）。本研究在模拟四跳链上，比较了顺序式（交换-等待）和同步式（等待-交换）两种纠缠交换策略对六态QKD秘密密钥率的影响。结果显示，一旦顺序式策略可行，其性能可优于同步式高达19.1%，且优势随存储器寿命增加而减小。
authors: Priyam Srivastava, Akshat R. Sabavat, Siddharth Jain, Alan Scheller-Wolf, Sridhar Tayur, David Tipper, Prashant Krishnamurthy, Amy Babay, Kaushik P. Seshadreesan

articles.title: Expanding quantum magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 膨胀的量子磁场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.27426v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop the quantum theory of the causal formation of a long-range magnetic field generated by an external current that is instantaneously switched on and subsequently kept constant in time. The resulting non-equilibrium quantum state, describing the expanding magnetic field, is obtained exactly and compared with the corresponding quantum magnetostatic state. In contrast to the magnetostatic case, the expanding solution exhibits a propagating shockwave-like front separating regions where the magnetic field has already been formed from those that remain causally disconnected from the source. We show that although the expanding field locally approaches the magnetostatic field behind the shockwave-like front, the associated quantum systems remain distinct at all times. In particular, we obtain manifestly different results for the energy, photon number, and their fluctuations in expanding and magnetostatic field configurations. Our results are first derived for a general external current and then illustrated with a specific example.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了由瞬时开启并保持恒定的外部电流产生的长程磁场因果形成过程的量子理论。研究精确获得了描述膨胀磁场的非平衡量子态，并与相应的量子磁静态进行了比较。结果表明，膨胀解展现出一个传播的激波状前沿，且相关的量子系统在能量、光子数及其涨落方面表现出显著差异。
authors: Bogdan Damski

articles.title: Sympathetic Cooling in Trapped Ions with Spectral Selectivity via the Zeeman Shift
articles.title_zh: 利用塞曼位移实现光谱选择性的囚禁离子协同冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.27577v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-fidelity quantum logic operations in trapped ions often require the ions' collective motion to be cooled to near the ground state. Since cooling the ions' motion typically involves dissipative processes such as spontaneous photon scattering, sympathetic cooling is used on select coolant ions between gate sequences to cool the ion chain without affecting the data qubits. Common implementations for coolant ions include different atomic species, different isotopes of the same species or individually addressable ions. Each of these approaches have challenges associated with them, which include increased hardware complexity, reduced efficiency of radial mode cooling and re-ordering events which add additional experimental overhead. We demonstrate a sympathetic cooling scheme leveraging internal metastable atomic levels accessible via a narrow quadrupole transition, utilizing the natural Zeeman shift and individually addressed Raman transitions, to achieve isolation of the non-coolant or ``data ions" from coolant ions. We demonstrate modest decoherence of the data ions due to cooling, while preserving the coherence requirements for high-fidelity gate operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 囚禁离子中的高保真量子逻辑操作通常需要将离子的集体运动冷却至基态。本研究提出了一种利用塞曼位移和单独寻址拉曼跃迁的协同冷却方案，通过窄四极跃迁可访问的内部亚稳态原子能级，实现非冷却“数据离子”与冷却离子之间的隔离。该方案旨在解决现有协同冷却方法带来的挑战，并在冷却过程中保持了数据离子的相干性要求。
authors: Kavyashree Ranawat, Jiyong Yu, Andrew Van Horn, Jacob Whitlow, Kenneth R Brown, Jungsang Kim

articles.title: Nonlocal Teams and Information Structures
articles.title_zh: 非局域团队与信息结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.08645v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We look at Bell inequalities from the lens of information structures in stochastic teams. We consider the usual Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) game and a dynamic variant of the same to study how various classes of strategies, classical, projective and quantum, behave under team theoretic solution concepts. We endow players with a fixed quantum state that we take as the Bell state, and allow variation of the measurement strategies. In the static game, projective strategies (where each player performs projective measurements) are team optimal for all parameter values and are closed under best response. In the dynamic game these properties fail: projective strategies may be strictly outperformed by classical ones, best responses to projective strategies need not be projective, and, beyond a sharp threshold on the channel noise, team optimal projective strategies cease to be person-by-person optimal, even though person-by-person optimal projective pairs always exist. These results shed light on the delicate interplay of information structure in quantum strategies and the fragility, under a change of information structure, of structural properties that are taken for granted in the static setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从随机团队中的信息结构角度审视贝尔不等式，并通过经典的CHSH博弈及其动态变体，研究了经典、投影和量子策略在团队理论解概念下的行为。研究发现，在静态博弈中，投影策略是团队最优的；但在动态博弈中，这些特性失效，投影策略可能被经典策略严格超越，且团队最优投影策略在特定条件下不再是逐人最优。
authors: Drishti Baruah, Sachin Teli, Ankur A. Kulkarni

articles.title: A Versatile Variational Quantum Kernel Framework for Non-Trivial Classification
articles.title_zh: 一种用于非平凡分类的多功能变分量子核框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.10831v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum kernel methods are a promising branch of quantum machine learning, but their per- formance across data types and encoding choices remains incompletely understood. To address this gap, we developed an algorithmic framework for variational quantum kernels utilizing resource- efficient ansätze for complex classification tasks and introduced a parameter scaling technique to accelerate convergence. We conducted a comprehensive benchmark of this framework on eight chal- lenging, real-world and high-dimensional datasets covering tabular, image, time series, and graph data. Our results show that the proposed quantum kernel demonstrated competitive classification accuracy compared to standard classical kernels in classical simulation, such as the radial basis function (RBF) kernel. This work demonstrates that properly designed quantum kernels can func- tion as versatile, high-performance tools, laying a foundation for quantum-enhanced applications in machine learning. Further research is needed to fully assess the practical performance of quantum methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子核方法是量子机器学习的一个有前景的分支，但其在不同数据类型和编码选择上的性能尚不完全清楚。为解决此问题，本研究开发了一个利用资源高效拟设的变分量子核算法框架，并引入参数缩放技术以加速收敛。该框架在八个具有挑战性的真实高维数据集上进行了全面基准测试，结果表明所提出的量子核在分类精度上与经典核具有竞争力。
authors: Jiang Yuhan, Matthew Otten

articles.title: Quantum speed limit time for bipartite entanglement in neutrino oscillations in matter with nonstandard interactions
articles.title_zh: 存在非标准相互作用的物质中中微子振荡双分量纠缠的量子速度极限时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03748v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In the three-flavor neutrino oscillation framework, we investigate the transition probabilities of an initial muon neutrino flavor state in the presence of nonstandard interactions (NSIs) characterized by complex off-diagonal (|ϵαβ|eⁱφαβ) and diagonal parameters (|ϵαα-ϵββ|), including a CP-violating phase and a constant matter potential, under both normal (NO) and inverted mass ordering (IO) scenarios. Within these scenarios and through the lens of mode entanglement, bipartite entanglement measures such as entanglement entropy and capacity of entanglement are quantified in terms of the transition probabilities, which can be measured in neutrino oscillation experiments. Using these two bipartite entanglement measures, we further explore the quantum speed limit (QSL) time, which describes how rapidly bipartite entanglement evolves during neutrino oscillations. We illustrate our results using the baseline lengths and energies corresponding to ongoing long-baseline accelerator neutrino experiments, such as T2K, NOνA, and the upcoming DUNE experiment. In the presence of a CP-violating phase and a constant matter potential, both with and without NSI effects, we compare the QSL time behavior for bipartite entanglement in neutrino oscillations for NO and IO. The most pronounced discrepancies in the QSL time for bipartite entanglement arise from the off-diagonal NSI parameter ϵμτ across both the NO and IO scenarios. We emphasize that among all the experiments considered, NOνA and DUNE exhibit a rapid suppression of bipartite entanglement in neutrino oscillations in the standard oscillation scenario with NO at the end of their baseline lengths for the corresponding best-fit value of CP-violating phase. Our results hint at a possible imprint of new physics in neutrino oscillations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在三味中微子振荡框架下，研究了在非标准相互作用（NSI）、CP破坏相和恒定物质势存在时，初始μ中微子味态的跃迁概率。通过模式纠缠的视角，研究量化了纠缠熵和纠缠容量等双分量纠缠度量，并进一步探讨了描述中微子振荡中双分量纠缠演化速度的量子速度极限（QSL）时间。研究结果利用T2K、NOνA和DUNE等长基线加速器中微子实验的基线长度和能量进行了说明。
authors: Abhishek Kumar Jha, Lekhashri Konwar, Rukmani Mohanta

articles.title: Probing critical phases in quasiperiodic systems via subsystem information capacity
articles.title_zh: 通过子系统信息容量探测准周期系统中的临界相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06075v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We systematically investigate the entanglement and information dynamics of quasiperiodic systems across their extended, critical, and localized phases, aiming to identify dynamical signatures that can reveal the multifractal spatial structure of critical states and distinguish critical phases from the extended and localized regimes. Focusing on the generalized Aubry-André-Harper model, we complement the half-chain entanglement entropy with the spatially resolved subsystem information capacity (SIC) and demonstrate that critical states exhibit pronounced spatial heterogeneity absent in the extended and localized phases. In the steady state, the SIC reveals a stepwise ramp as a function of subsystem size, reflecting an underlying fragmentation of the chain into weakly connected subregions. Dynamically, information initially localized within such a subregion can undergo coherent long-lived oscillations, dubbed subregion echoes, whose period scales with the subregion length, in quantitative agreement with a quasiparticle picture of confined quasiparticle reflections. We trace this internal fragmentation to the incommensurately distributed zeros (IDZs) in the off-diagonal hopping terms of the Hamiltonian. To establish the generality of the SIC as a diagnostic tool, we further apply it to a mobility-edge phase with coexisting extended and localized states and to a critical phase that does not originate from IDZ fragmentation, and show that the SIC can cleanly distinguish these scenarios through their distinct steady-state profiles, initial-site sensitivities, and the presence or absence of subregion echoes. Our results demonstrate that the SIC serves as a powerful real-space probe for diagnosing critical phases and uncovering the bottlenecked connectivity that underlies the multifractal structure of critical states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了准周期系统在扩展、临界和局域相中的纠缠和信息动力学，旨在识别能揭示临界态多重分形空间结构并区分临界相与扩展/局域相的动态特征。研究聚焦于广义Aubry-André-Harper模型，通过空间分辨的子系统信息容量（SIC）补充了半链纠缠熵，并发现临界态表现出在其他相中不存在的显著空间异质性。动态上，子区域内初始局域的信息可经历相干的长寿命振荡，其周期与子区域长度成比例。
authors: Huaijin Dong, Long Zhang

articles.title: Electron-Mediated Phonon Polaritons in Quantum Cavities
articles.title_zh: 量子腔中电子介导的声子极化激元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon-photon coupling in quantum materials is commonly treated as an effective direct interaction, neglecting the crucial role played by electrons. Here we develop a gauge-invariant theory of cavity phonon polaritons that captures electronic screening, dissipation, and hybridization. We show that screening can suppress polariton formation in metals, severely constraining cavity control of phonon-mediated superconductivity. By contrast, interband electronic resonances in time-reversal-symmetric gapped systems can strongly enhance phonon-photon coupling, enabling robust polariton formation down to the monolayer limit despite electronic absorption. We illustrate these effects in NbSe2, hBN, and gapped graphene. Finally, we show that gauge invariance enforces photon decoupling from a critical soft phonon, establishing a general no-go mechanism for photon condensation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种规范不变的腔声子极化激元理论，该理论捕捉了电子屏蔽、耗散和杂化等效应，纠正了传统上忽略电子作用的声子-光子耦合处理方式。研究表明，电子屏蔽会抑制金属中的极化激元形成，而时间反演对称带隙系统中的带间电子共振则能显著增强声子-光子耦合。此外，规范不变性使得光子与临界软声子解耦，为光子凝聚建立了一个普遍的“禁行”机制。
authors: Mattia Udina, David Hagenmüller, Indranil Paul

articles.title: Nanoscale Mapping of Strain-engineered Excitons in Monolayer WSe₂
articles.title_zh: 单层二硒化钨中应变工程激子的纳米尺度映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) are highly sensitive to external stimuli, allowing control of resonance energies and lifetimes through electric and magnetic fields, heterostructures, moire potentials and mechanical strain. Observations of single-photon emission (SPE) near sample edges, wrinkles, and strained nanobubbles have motivated strain-engineering aimed at realizing localized emitters in 2D materials. The origin of these emitters remains unclear and prior studies have relied on far-field spectroscopy with strain profiles inferred separately through topography, limiting direct correlation between local strain and excitonic response. We directly probe strain-modified excitonic spectra in monolayer WSe₂ using cryogenic scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM). We compare two strain-engineering techniques, nano-indentation and patterned substrates, used to produce SPEs. At 9 K, we spatially resolve exciton resonance shifts with sub-diffraction limit resolution, simultaneously measuring near-field optical response and topography. We observe that strain transferred from nano-indentation into a deformable polymer substrate differs from that produced by draping TMDs over patterned dielectric pillars. Adhesion and tearing during plastic deformation drive a compressive exciton blueshift, while draping produces dominant tensile strain. Comparing the strain model results to the experimentally observed energy shifts shows that the nano-indentation strain is over an order of magnitude smaller than previously inferred, due to puncturing of the fragile monolayer, whereas pillar-strained devices remain intact under more modest strain. These differences suggest SPE arises from complex, strain-mediated interactions rather than simple confinement potentials, establishing s-SNOM as a powerful probe of quantum emission in strained 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 单层过渡金属二硫化物（TMDs）中的激子对外部刺激高度敏感，可通过电场、磁场和机械应变等方式控制其共振能量和寿命。为解决现有研究中局部应变与激子响应之间缺乏直接关联的问题，本研究利用低温散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）直接探测单层WSe₂中应变修饰的激子光谱。通过比较纳米压痕和图案化衬底两种应变工程技术，研究在9 K下以亚衍射极限分辨率空间分辨了激子共振位移，并同时测量了近场光学响应和形貌。
authors: Anna S. Roche, Nicholas V. Proscia, Paul D. Cunningham, Kathleen M. McCreary, Dante J. O'Hara, Hsun Jen Chuang, Cory Cress, Collin Sanborn, Samuel W. LaGasse, Jose J. Fonseca, Jeremy T. Robinson, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, John R. Schaibley, Brian J. LeRoy

articles.title: Atomic ironing for conformal interfaces in freestanding oxide nanomembranes
articles.title_zh: 悬浮氧化物纳米膜中共形界面的原子熨烫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically well-defined interfaces are essential for realizing functional interlayer coupling in stacked and twisted oxide heterostructures, yet transferred freestanding oxides can develop structural inhomogeneities, including local curvatures, interfacial voids, and incomplete contacts with substrates. Here, we demonstrate that these transfer-induced structural disorders and imperfections evolve substantially and can be suppressed by post-transfer thermal treatments, yielding bulk-like crystalline freestanding oxide nanomembranes. Using freestanding SrTiO3 membranes as a model system, we report a systematic understanding of the role of "atomic ironing" and the associated evolution of lattice mosaicity, interfacial roughness, and optical bandgap. We further demonstrate atomically bonded conformal interfaces in twisted SrTiO3 heterostructures, highlighting the importance of post-transfer thermal processes. These results establish a synthetic strategy to restore the structural integrity and intrinsic bulk-like functionality of freestanding oxide nanomembranes, enabling stacked, twisted, and heterogeneously integrated oxide architectures with atomically well-defined interfaces for emerging quantum functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子级明确的界面对于实现堆叠和扭曲氧化物异质结构中的功能性层间耦合至关重要，但转移的悬浮氧化物可能出现结构不均匀性。本研究表明，这些转移引起的结构缺陷可通过后转移热处理显著抑制，从而获得块体状结晶的悬浮氧化物纳米膜。以悬浮SrTiO3膜为模型系统，作者系统阐明了“原子熨烫”的作用及其对晶格镶嵌性、界面粗糙度和光学带隙演变的影响。这些结果为恢复悬浮氧化物纳米膜的结构完整性和本征块体功能性提供了一种合成策略。
authors: Jeongkeun Song, Keaghan Knight, Keun-Yeol Park, Young-Hoon Kim, Tyler J. Sachs, Hu Miao, Jiaqiang Yan, Celesta S. Chang, Ambrose Seo, Ho Nyung Lee

articles.title: Evidence for hidden order and its potential correlation with electron-hole asymmetry in iridate superlattices
articles.title_zh: 铱酸盐超晶格中隐藏有序的证据及其与电子-空穴不对称性的潜在关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hidden order refers to an order that shapes the properties of quantum materials yet remains difficult to identify. Here we report signatures of a hidden order in doped iridate superlattices through an unexpected electron-hole asymmetry in the coupling between the insulating state and the antiferromagnetic (AFM) state. While carrier doping suppresses both states, they remain coupled in the electron-doped regime but decouple in the hole-doped regime. Structural analysis rules out octahedral rotation and tilting as the dominant origin of this asymmetry. Instead, magnetic characterization reveals evidences of a hidden order that only appears in the hole-doped regime. This hidden order emerges above TN and is closely associated with the AFM state, coinciding with an exceptionally strong magnetic scattering intensity and an anomalously robust magnetic coherence. Our results highlight that hole-doped iridates can be a promising platform for exploring hidden and unconventional ordering phenomena in spin-orbit-entangled quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 隐藏有序是一种塑造量子材料性质但难以识别的序。本研究通过掺杂铱酸盐超晶格中绝缘态与反铁磁态耦合的意外电子-空穴不对称性，揭示了隐藏有序的迹象。结构分析排除了八面体旋转和倾斜作为不对称性的主要来源，而磁性表征揭示了仅在空穴掺杂区域出现的隐藏有序。该隐藏有序在TN之上出现并与反铁磁态密切相关，表明空穴掺杂铱酸盐是探索自旋轨道纠缠量子材料中隐藏和非常规有序现象的有前景平台。
authors: Zhihan Qiao, Han Zhang, Hangtian Wang, Deyang Li, Haiyang Zhang, Enyang Men, Junlei Jiang, Jingxin Chen, Yizhou Liu, Sang-Youn Park, Xiangnan Xie, MingLiang Tian, Haifeng Du, Ning Hao, Lin Hao

articles.title: Why shaking faster does not untangle: frequency-selective extraction of filaments from tangled matter
articles.title_zh: 为什么摇晃更快并不能解开缠结：从缠结物质中频率选择性提取细丝
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tangles of soft filaments are ubiquitous, from living worm blobs to the cables in a desk drawer. How do such tangles, held together by friction and entanglement, respond when one embedded filament is shaken? We suspend disordered tangles of tunable cohesion and ordered stitched meshes from a single thread (the tether) and oscillate it vertically at fixed amplitude. Extraction peaks at an intermediate drive frequency (sim 15 Hz) and declines at higher frequencies, although the peak drive acceleration grows quadratically. Here we combine experiments, high-speed imaging, and a tension-only spring-mass model to show that this non-monotonic response is set by timing rather than resonance. The extraction window is bounded below by a slackening threshold, where the peak drive acceleration exceeds gravity and the tether, slack for part of each cycle, creates a tensile impulse each time it snaps taut. The window is bounded above by a transmission crossover, where the transmission time across the tangle exceeds a quarter of the drive cycle, so that the tangle no longer responds as a whole and the drive's work dissipates internally. The slackening threshold depends only on the drive and gravity, while the transmission crossover is set only by the tangle's size and transmission speed. By tracing extraction to the overlap of impulse creation and impulse transmission, we identify a generic principle of driven filamentous matter and suggest frequency-selective routes to its disassembly.
articles.abstract_zh: 软细丝的缠结无处不在。本研究通过悬挂无序缠结并垂直振荡其中一根细丝，发现细丝的提取效率在中等驱动频率（约15赫兹）达到峰值，并在更高频率下下降。结合实验、高速成像和张力弹簧-质量模型，作者表明这种非单调响应是由时间而非共振决定的。提取窗口的下限由松弛阈值设定，上限由传输交叉点设定，其中缠结不再作为一个整体响应。
authors: Ishant Tiwari, Sutikshan Bansal, Rosalind Huang, Chenyi Fei, Jörn Dunkel, Vishal Patil, Saad Bhamla

articles.title: Interplay of electric field and electronic correlations in pairing competition in bilayer nickelates
articles.title_zh: 双层镍酸盐中电场与电子关联在配对竞争中的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layer polarization provides a means of tuning the competition between interlayer and intralayer pairing in bilayer nickelates. Using ground-state constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo, we study interlayer s± and intralayer d pairing in a bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model with a layer potential-energy difference ǎrepsilon representing an effective perpendicular electric field. Within the parameter range studied, increasing ǎrepsilon generally enhances the finite-size pairing vertex contribution V_d and reduces Vₛ±, shifting the relative pairing preference toward the d-wave channel. Increasing the onsite repulsion enhances both vertex contributions, more strongly in the d-wave channel, whereas increasing the crystal-field splitting reduces both and makes s± pairing relatively more competitive. Hund's coupling increases the relative competitiveness of s± pairing at weak bias, while enhancing the relative strength of d-wave pairing at large bias. The bias primarily redistributes charge between layers within each orbital sector, accompanied by an increase in the antiferromagnetic spin structure factor. Hund's coupling also enhances local interorbital parallel-spin correlations. These observations suggest possible connections between charge redistribution, magnetic correlations, and pairing competition, offering insight into how layer polarization and multiorbital interactions influence the relative pairing tendencies in the bilayer nickelate model.
articles.abstract_zh: 层极化为调节双层镍酸盐中层间和层内配对竞争提供了一种手段。本研究利用基态约束路径量子蒙特卡洛方法，在一个双层双轨道哈伯德模型中研究了层间s±和层内d配对。结果表明，增加层电势差通常会增强d波配对并减弱s±配对，使相对配对偏好转向d波通道。该偏置主要在每个轨道扇区内重新分配层间电荷，并伴随着反铁磁自旋结构因子的增加。
authors: Yanmei Cai, Yicheng Xiong, Ying Liang, Tianxing Ma

articles.title: Deep Learning of Phase Transitions for Bilinear-Biquadratic Spin-1 Chains from Correlation Aspects
articles.title_zh: 从关联角度深度学习双线-双二次自旋-1链的相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the role of different correlation functions in reconstructing the phase diagram of the spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic chain, parametrized by the angle θ between the bilinear and biquadratic couplings, using our previously developed label-free machine-learning pipeline i̧teMing21, Ming23, in which an autoencoder compresses iDMRG correlation matrices into latent features and K-means clustering with silhouette analysis groups them into phases. Without any prior labels, the scheme reveals four natural phases, the Haldane, dimerized, critical trimerized, and ferromagnetic phases, and accurately locates the Takhtajan-Babujian (θ=-π/4), SU(3)-symmetric Uimin-Lai-Sutherland (θ=π/4), and Ferro-Dimer (θ=5π/4) transition points; a shallow supervised refinement further sharpens the phase boundaries. We find that different correlation functions play fundamentally different roles in phase identification. The SU(3)-symmetric correlation alone selects a four-cluster partition that can be associated with the four phases, whereas the spin-spin and dimer-dimer correlations must be combined to recover the complete phase diagram. In contrast, the trimer-trimer correlation behaves as a marginal correlation: it is insufficient for phase identification by itself but improves the precision of the predicted phase boundaries when combined with the other correlations. Furthermore, the latent representations and silhouette values reveal signatures that we relate to the θ dependence of the correlations within each phase and, tentatively, to the underlying renormalization-group structure. These results demonstrate that machine learning can not only identify quantum phases but also uncover the physical information encoded in different correlation functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用无标签机器学习方法，探究了不同关联函数在重构自旋-1双线-双二次链相图中的作用。该方案在没有先验标签的情况下，揭示了Haldane、二聚化、临界三聚化和铁磁四种自然相，并准确定位了多个相变点。研究发现，不同的关联函数在相识别中扮演着根本不同的角色。SU(3)对称关联函数单独即可识别四种相，而自旋-自旋和二聚体-二聚体关联函数必须结合才能恢复完整的相图。
authors: Ming-Chiang Chung, Yu-Ting Kuo, Ian McCulloch, Yuan-Hong Tsai

articles.title: Unconventional quantum spin mixing of two spin-1 atoms beyond the single-mode approximation
articles.title_zh: 超越单模近似的两个自旋-1原子的非常规量子自旋混合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The single-mode approximation (SMA) has been widely employed in ultracold spinor gases, where all spin components share the same spatial mode. By adopting generalized Van Vleck (GVV) perturbation theory, we achieve a relative error of 10⁻⁶ in the ground-state energy with a reduced effective Hilbert space dimension of sim 10³ for two spin-1 bosons confined in a one-dimensional hard-wall trap. With the accurate GVV method, we explore the validity of the SMA across ground-state properties and quench spin dynamics for two ⁷Li, ⁸⁷Rb, or ²³Na atoms. Numerical results show that the quadratic Zeeman energy q provides a powerful control knob: by increasing |q|, the fidelity between the spin components in the ground state gradually decreases, leading eventually to the breakdown of the SMA (due to the competition between the kinetic energy and the quadratic Zeeman energy). Quench spin dynamics with abruptly increased q further reveals multiple resonances, where the SMA-predicted micromotion and beyond-SMA macromotion appear simultaneously. These results point to a direction to investigate the quantum spin-mixing dynamics beyond the SMA, particularly in recent experiments of strongly interacting spin-1 atomic gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 单模近似（SMA）在超冷旋量气体中被广泛应用。本研究采用广义Van Vleck微扰理论，精确计算了受限在硬壁陷阱中的两个自旋-1玻色子的基态能量。研究发现，二次塞曼能量q是一个强大的控制旋钮，增加|q|会导致基态中自旋分量之间的保真度逐渐降低，最终导致SMA失效。骤然增加q的猝灭自旋动力学进一步揭示了多个共振，其中SMA预测的微观运动和超越SMA的宏观运动同时出现。
authors: Yanhong Liu, Fulin Deng, Haoxue Qiao, Wenxian Zhang

articles.title: Transport regimes in tunnel ferromagnetic Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 隧道铁磁约瑟夫森结中的输运机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic study of the temperature-dependent transport properties of Nb- and Al-based superconductor--insulator--thin superconductor--ferromagnet--superconductor (SIsFS) Josephson junctions. By varying the superconducting material and the thickness of the intermediate superconducting layer, we identify three distinct transport regimes: a tunnel-dominated SIS-like regime, a temperature-driven crossover, and a complex weak-link regime. A unified Usadel-based description connects these regimes through the self-consistent pair potential of the intermediate s-layer. While for Al-based devices an SIS-like transport regime is observed, a self-consistent calculation of the s/F/S proximity electrode, combined with perturbative tunnel coupling to the outer electrode, accounts for Nb devices with different thickness of the superconducting interlayer. The calculation places the 10-nm-interlayer sample in a proximity-supported, strongly suppressed s state, close to the SInFS limit in which the interlayer is effectively driven normal (n). A reduced nonlinear long-junction description captures the same limiting physics. The evolution of I_cR_N(T) thereby provides a direct experimental signature of the three transport regimes. Beyond the fundamental interest, the results establish practical design guidelines: Nb junctions with sufficiently thick s interlayers are well suited for high-speed cryogenic memory elements and tunable superconducting parametric amplifiers, while Al junctions are natural candidates for coherent superconducting quantum circuits
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究系统地考察了基于Nb和Al的超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（SIsFS）约瑟夫森结的温度依赖性输运特性。通过改变超导材料和中间超导层的厚度，作者识别出三种不同的输运机制：隧道主导的SIS类机制、温度驱动的交叉机制和复杂的弱连接机制。统一的Usadel描述通过中间s层的自洽对势将这些机制联系起来。
authors: R. Satariano, A. A. Golubov, E. Raja, R. Ferraiuolo, F. Calloni, H. G. Ahmad, A. Vettoliere, N. Poccia, L. Parlato, G. Ausanio, C. Granata, G. P. Pepe, M. Yu. Kupriyanov, F. Tafuri, D. Montemurro, D. Massarotti

articles.title: Orbitronics in Zero-dimensional Graphene Nanoflakes via Electrode Coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过电极耦合在零维石墨烯纳米片中实现轨道电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that graphene nanoflakes realize a previously unexplored form of orbitronics in which orbital currents emerge in the absence of intrinsic angular momentum of the constituent atoms. Starting with a hexagonal graphene nanoflake, we demonstrate the presence of energy-degenerate eigenstates with opposite non-zero expectation values of the angular momentum. Placing electrodes in an appropriate configuration on the flake couples the reservoirs more strongly to one of the two opposite-angular-momentum states, yielding a chiral current that carries a net orbital angular momentum. The resulting circulating orbital currents generate magnetic fringe fields that are experimentally accessible with spin centers or superconducting quantum interference magnetometers, providing avenues for their experimental realization. Finally, our work establishes a new platform for exploring and studying orbitronics in zero-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了石墨烯纳米片实现了一种前所未有的轨道电子学形式，其中轨道电流在组成原子没有本征角动量的情况下产生。通过在纳米片上放置适当配置的电极，可以更强地耦合到两个具有相反角动量期望值的简并本征态之一，从而产生携带净轨道角动量的手性电流。这些循环轨道电流产生的磁场可以通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁力计进行实验探测，为零维系统中的轨道电子学研究提供了新平台。
authors: Washington F. dos Santos, Eudes Gomes da Silva, Denis R. Candido, Alexandre Reily Rocha

articles.title: Magnetic Susceptibility of Superconducting Films in the Meissner-London Regime
articles.title_zh: 迈斯纳-伦敦态下超导薄膜的磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting the London penetration depth, łambda(T), from the measured magnetic susceptibility, ḩi(T), of a superconducting platelet in a perpendicular magnetic field requires knowing the function ḩi(łambda) computed for the actual sample geometry. Thin films are increasingly important in quantum computing and superconducting electronics, most of which operate at ultra-low excitation fields in the vortex-free regime. Understanding their electromagnetic response in the Meissner--London (finite-łambda, no vortices) state is therefore essential for extracting intrinsic properties such as the London penetration depth and superfluid phase stiffness. While numerous prior works have addressed different aspects of this problem, here we focus on providing an analytical semi-empirical representation of ḩi(łambda) based on the 2D sheet-current model and establishing the limits of its applicability using two independent full 3D numerical solutions: finite-element modeling and a volume-current integral equation. As a result, we provide ḩi(łambda) for a disc of radius a and thickness d in closed form, valid for all łambda and for aspect ratios δequiv d/(2a)łe0.05, and accurate to 0.1%. The two-dimensional sheet description with Pearl length Łambda=2łambda²/d is adequate for δ łesssim10⁻⁴ and łambda gtrsim 4d. Thicker films require the full closed form, which includes the three-dimensional corrections. Using the same numerical analysis, we provide an empirical formula that maps rectangular samples---the geometry most commonly used in experiments---onto a disc with an ``effective radius'' for subsequent calculation of ḩi(łambda), and formulate a complete calibration protocol for whole-sample susceptibility measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 从超导薄片在垂直磁场中测得的磁化率中提取伦敦穿透深度，需要了解针对实际样品几何形状计算的磁化率函数。本研究旨在提供基于二维薄片电流模型的磁化率函数解析半经验表示，并利用两种独立的完整三维数值解建立其适用范围。最终，作者给出了半径a、厚度d的圆盘在所有伦敦穿透深度和纵横比下都有效的磁化率函数闭合形式。
authors: Ruslan Prozorov

articles.title: Landau quantization of C₃ high-fold fermions in honeycomb lattices
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格中C₃高重费米子的朗道量子化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the theory of the Landau levels of C₃ high-fold fermions in honeycomb lattices. These fermions arise as a generalization of the tight-binding model in a honeycomb lattice with one orbital per site, known to describe graphene, to a family of models with several orbitals per site transforming according to representations of C₃, relevant for triangulene two-dimensional crystals. The models are defined by the number of orbitals nₐ and n_b at the a and b sites of the unit cell. They feature energy bands that combine flat bands and Dirac cones, that are isomorphic to those of graphene, the Lieb, pₓy honeycomb, and the Kagome tight-binding models. Combining tight-binding and kḑot p methods, here we compute the Landau levels of the (1,1), (1,2), (2,2) and (3,3) models, we compare them to those of the reference models, and we explore the similarities and differences with the Landau levels in graphene. Our findings reveal that the nature of C₃ high-fold fermions combine Dirac-type Landau quantization, originating from the linear crossings and associated relativistic band dispersion, with anomalous Landau quantization rooted in the quantum geometry of the singular flat bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了蜂窝晶格中C₃高重费米子朗道能级的理论。这些费米子是石墨烯紧束缚模型的推广，适用于具有多个轨道且按C₃表示变换的晶体模型。通过结合紧束缚和k·p方法，作者计算了(1,1)、(1,2)、(2,2)和(3,3)模型的朗道能级，并与参考模型和石墨烯中的朗道能级进行了比较。研究结果揭示了C₃高重费米子的性质结合了狄拉克型朗道量子化和异常朗道量子化。
authors: Luisa Madail, Joaquín Fernández-Rossier

articles.title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moiré graphene
articles.title_zh: 莫尔石墨烯中的节点向列超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity can emerge in various forms in strongly correlated systems. Historically, the most extensively studied examples include nodal and triplet pairing, which were experimentally detected in cuprates and superfluid helium-3, respectively. Beyond these canonical cases, there are also nematic superconductors, in which the rotational symmetry of the lattice is broken in the superconducting state. While there are several examples of nematic superconductors whose pairing emerges inside a preexisting nematic normal state, experimental evidence for superconducting states that intrinsically break rotational symmetry on their own has been exceedingly scarce. Here, we report the experimental realization and identification of an intrinsic multi-component nodal nematic superconducting state in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (MATTG). By integrating tunneling spectroscopy with quantum transport measurements, we directly probe the symmetry of low-energy superconducting quasiparticles. Deep inside the superconducting state, we observe a pronounced two-fold anisotropy in the zero-bias tunneling conductance under an in-plane magnetic field, which is strongly suppressed together with superconductivity as the temperature or perpendicular magnetic field is increased. Remarkably, the major axis of anisotropy rotates by up to 90ⁱ̧rc across the superconducting dome, indicating an intrinsic, field- and density-tunable symmetry of the low-energy excitations. These behaviors imply a nodal superconducting state in MATTG that spontaneously breaks the six-fold rotational symmetry of the moiré superlattice. Our results establish moiré graphene as a versatile platform for realizing and interrogating nodal nematic superconductivity, opening a new avenue for exploring unconventional symmetry-breaking superconducting states in two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 非常规超导性在强关联系统中以多种形式出现，其中节点和三重态配对是研究最广泛的例子。本研究报告了在魔角扭曲三层石墨烯（MATTG）中本征多组分节点向列超导态的实验实现和识别。通过结合隧道光谱和量子输运测量，作者直接探测了低能超导准粒子的对称性。在超导态深处，观察到零偏压隧道电导在面内磁场下表现出显著的二重各向异性。
authors: Shuwen Sun, Grgur Palle, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Rafael M. Fernandes, Pablo Jarillo-Herrero, Jeong Min Park

articles.title: Anomalies, higher symmetries, and homotopy theory I: crossed precosheaves and a nonabelian Cech construction
articles.title_zh: 异常、高阶对称性与同伦理论 I：交叉预余层与非阿贝尔切赫构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetries of a quantum field theory or a quantum lattice model are expected to be described not by a group but by a homotopy type, whose homotopy groups are the higher symmetry groups and whose Postnikov invariants encode 't Hooft anomalies. We propose a homotopy-theoretic definition of 't Hooft anomalies based on the structure of localized symmetries in the operator-algebraic approach. The input is a crossed precosheaf: a collection of groups attached to regions of space, equipped with pairings recording that the commutator of two transformations localized in two regions is localized in their intersection. To a crossed precosheaf and a finite family of regions we attach a pointed connected homotopy type, the Cech-Loday classifying space. As the family of regions ranges over finite covers of space, the classifying spaces form a pro-object in the homotopy category. There is a canonical map from the ordinary classifying space of the symmetry group to this pro-type. Composing this map with a group action gives an anomaly whose nontriviality obstructs gauging. In favorable cases, the Cech-Loday space is essentially independent of the cover. In such cases, the homotopy fiber of the canonical map is a candidate for the classifying space of the higher group of symmetries. We give examples of crossed precosheaves arising from gauge transformations in continuum field theory and from quantum cellular automata and finite-depth circuits. For quantum spin systems in one and two dimensions, our construction recovers the Else-Nayak index and its generalizations to two dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子场论或量子格点模型的对称性预计由同伦类型描述，其同伦群是高阶对称群，Postnikov不变量编码't Hooft异常。本研究基于算子代数方法中局域对称性的结构，提出了't Hooft异常的同伦理论定义。输入是一个交叉预余层，即附着于空间区域的群集合，并配备了记录两个局域变换的交换子局域于其交集的配对。作者将一个有指向的连通同伦类型（Cech-Loday分类空间）附加到交叉预余层和有限区域族上，并指出其非平凡性阻碍了规范化。
authors: Anton Kapustin, Shixiong Xu

articles.title: High-Harmonic Generation Probes Quantum Nuclear Fluctuations in Liquid Water
articles.title_zh: 高次谐波产生探测液态水中的量子核涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19967v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nuclear quantum effects are essential for an accurate description of the hydrogen-bonded structure of liquid water, yet their spectroscopic signatures can be subtle and difficult to measure. Moreover, probing these effects in solution on femtosecond timescales (or below) is an open challenge that is pivotal for optical control of hydrogen bonds and ultrafast spectroscopy of proton transfer. Here, we combine path-integral molecular dynamics with real-time time-dependent density-functional theory to explore high-harmonic generation (HHG) in liquid water from first principles, rigorously accounting for quantum nuclear delocalisation. Relative to classical-nuclei simulations, quantum sampling suppresses the harmonic yield around certain harmonics by up to an order of magnitude, inducing local structural minima. By analysing the ab initio simulations and reproducing the key effects with a simplified model Hamiltonian, we trace the physical origins of the interference minima to the broadening of valence-band states induced by hydrogen-bond fluctuations, a mechanism expected to generalise to other hydrogen-bonded structures. Our work shows that nuclear quantum effects are indispensable for capturing ultrafast electronic dynamics in liquids, and demonstrates the power of liquid HHG spectroscopy for attosecond probing of nuclear fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 核量子效应对于准确描述液态水的氢键结构至关重要，但其光谱特征难以测量。本研究结合路径积分分子动力学和实时含时密度泛函理论，从第一性原理探索液态水中的高次谐波产生，并严格考虑了量子核离域化。结果显示，量子采样能显著抑制谐波产额，并诱导局部结构最小值。该工作将干涉最小值归因于氢键涨落引起的价带态展宽，为理解氢键结构中的量子核效应提供了新视角。
authors: George Trenins, Nicolas Tancogne-Dejean, Angana Mondal, Angel Rubio, Hans Jakob Wörner, Aaron Kelly, Ofer Neufeld, Mariana Rossi

articles.title: Fluctuation-driven multi-step charge density wave melting in monolayer TiSe₂
articles.title_zh: 涨落驱动的单层TiSe₂中电荷密度波多步熔化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20355v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The exact microscopic origin, symmetry, and thermal melting mechanism of the charge density wave (CDW) phase in TiSe₂ remain intensely debated, particularly regarding chiral structural order and multi-step phase transitions. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by an accurate machine-learning interatomic potential, we resolve the finite-temperature structural dynamics of the monolayer TiSe₂. We demonstrate that CDW melting deviates from conventional mean-field second-order behavior, undergoing a two-step process characterized by an extended fluctuation region (200-250 K) with proliferating domain walls, phase decoherence, component-selective melting, and an overdamped soft optical phonon. Furthermore, anisotropic long-wavelength thermal fluctuations spontaneously stabilize an asymmetric 3Q CDW order with P1 symmetry. These findings provide a unified microscopic framework for fluctuation-driven transitions in 2D quantum materials, demonstrating that the complex CDW physics of TiSe₂ is captured entirely via non-perturbative electron-phonon and phonon-phonon interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: TiSe₂中电荷密度波（CDW）相的微观起源、对称性和热熔化机制仍存在激烈争议。本研究利用大规模分子动力学模拟，揭示了单层TiSe₂在有限温度下的结构动力学。结果表明，CDW熔化偏离了传统的平均场二阶行为，经历了一个两步过程，包括一个扩展的涨落区域。这些发现为二维量子材料中的涨落驱动相变提供了统一的微观框架。
authors: Luka Benić, Dino Novko, Ivor Lončarić

articles.title: The thermopower properties of interacting systems
articles.title_zh: 相互作用系统的热电势特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.14225v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Seebeck coefficient quantifies the voltage generated across a material in response to a temperature gradient. Recent studies have shown that strong electronic correlations can enhance this coefficient, producing anomalous behavior near half-filling associated with the Mott plateau. This raises the possibility that other interaction scales, not necessarily originating in Mott physics, could give rise to similar enhancements. Here, we investigate the Seebeck coefficient in the presence of attractive interactions, nearest-neighbor interactions, sublattice potentials, and electron-phonon coupling. The Seebeck coefficient is obtained via the Kelvin formula, using entropy data derived from density calculations within determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC). We find that these additional interaction scales can indeed enhance the Seebeck coefficient and further induce multiple sign changes as a function of doping. We show that this anomalous behavior is associated with the opening of a gap in the ground state, as computed via cluster perturbation theory (CPT). Moreover, electron-phonon coupling alone-even in the absence of on-site repulsion-can produce a Seebeck anomaly. We relate these sign changes to a restructuring of the Fermi surface and an accompanying change in its topology, an effect commonly observed in cuprates.
articles.abstract_zh: 塞贝克系数衡量材料在温差下产生的电压，强电子关联已被证实能增强该系数。本研究探讨了吸引相互作用、最近邻相互作用、子晶格势和电子-声子耦合对塞贝克系数的影响。利用行列式量子蒙特卡洛计算的熵数据，通过开尔文公式获得了塞贝克系数。结果表明，这些额外的相互作用能增强塞贝克系数并诱导多个符号变化，这种异常行为与基态能隙的打开有关。
authors: M. A. Habitzreuter, Willdauany C. de Freitas da Silva, Rodrigo A. Fontenele, Natanael C. Costa, Thereza Paiva

articles.title: High-Girth QLDPC Codes from Circulant and Affine Permutation Matrices
articles.title_zh: 基于循环和仿射置换矩阵的高围长QLDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study two explicit constructions of binary Calderbank--Shor--Steane quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes with check weight six. The first uses a fixed circulant shift pattern and yields parameters o̧de6N2N+26 with Tanner graph girth twelve for N=31 and every Nge37. A graph incidence interpretation gives the ranks and girths, and a uniform weight six logical operator establishes the exact distance. The second construction uses fixed matrix polynomials with circulant and affine permutation coefficients. Here, a polynomial commutation identity guarantees orthogonality for every cyclic lift. Four realizations give [[192,16,8]], [[288,16,12]], [[384,16,14]], and [[576,32,20]], with Tanner girth eight and computationally certified distances. We give reproducible construction data, distinguish classical cycle distance from quantum distance, and identify the limitations of both families.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了两种构造校验权重为六的二元Calderbank-Shor-Steane量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码的方法。第一种方法使用固定的循环移位模式，为特定N值生成具有围长为十二的Tanner图的QLDPC码。第二种方法利用具有循环和仿射置换系数的固定矩阵多项式，保证了正交性。该工作提供了可复现的构造数据，并指出了这两种码族的局限性。
authors: Vahid Nourozi, Roxana Smarandache, David G. M. Mitchelldag

articles.title: Analog Cosmology in a Quenched Bose-Einstein Condensate Bubble
articles.title_zh: 淬火玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体气泡中的模拟宇宙学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent interest and realization of ultracold bosons confined in shell-shaped, or bubble, traps have opened up several directions in the study of Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) in intrinsically curved geometries. Here, we explore the prospect of using thin spherical shell-shaped BECs as analog gravity simulators of an expanding or contracting curved universe. We study an interacting BEC bubble subject to a temporal quench of the interaction strength. Our theoretical approach, which uses a Bogoliubov treatment following a dimensional reduction of a spherical BEC to the low-energy excitations of a shell-shaped structure, demonstrates how this system serves as a laboratory analog for a positively curved universe having a time-varying scale factor. We investigate spontaneous pair production triggered by quenches associated with exponentially decaying or growing interaction strengths, focusing on the emergence of oscillations in the structure factor---analogous to Sakharov oscillations in the Cosmic Microwave Background angular power spectrum. We quantify the entanglement of the produced pairs via logarithmic negativity, and show how this measure may be extracted from the power spectrum. These findings establish a bridge between quantum information science and early-universe cosmology in a laboratory setting.

articles.abstract_zh: 近期实验揭示了准一维电荷密度波绝缘体中显著的逆电流（1/I）量子振荡，并提出了由滑动凝聚体产生的内禀Floquet边带机制。本文发展了完整的理论，以解释这些现象。该工作深入探讨了滑动电荷密度波中量子振荡的物理机制。

articles.title: Approach to optimal quantum transport via states over time
articles.title_zh: 通过“时间态”实现最优量子输运的方法
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2236 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-14-2236 We approach the problem of constructing a quantum analogue of the immensely fruitful classical transport cost theory of Monge from a new angle. Going back to the original motivations, by which the transport is a bilinear function of a mass distribution (without loss of generality a probability density) and a transport plan (a stochastic kernel), we explore the quantum version where the mass distribution is generalised to a density matrix, and the transport plan to a completely positive and trace preserving map. These two data are naturally integrated into their Jordan product, which is called state over time (“stote''), and the transport cost is postulated to be a linear function of it. We explore the properties of this transport cost, as well as the optimal transport cost between two given states (simply the minimum cost over all suitable transport plans). After that, we analyse in considerable detail the case of unitary invariant cost, for which we can calculate many costs analytically. These findings suggest that our quantum transport cost is qualitatively different from Monge's classical transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从新角度探讨了构建蒙日经典输运成本理论的量子模拟问题。研究将质量分布推广到密度矩阵，输运计划推广到完全正且保迹的映射，并将两者整合为“时间态”。该工作假设输运成本是时间态的线性函数，并详细分析了酉不变成本的情况，发现其与蒙日经典输运成本存在质的差异。
authors: Matt Hoogsteder-Riera, John Calsamiglia, and Andreas Winter

articles.title: Efficient noisy quantum state and process tomography
articles.title_zh: 高效的含噪声量子态和过程层析成像
articles.abstract: Efficiently characterizing large quantum states and processes is a central yet notoriously challenging task in quantum information science, as conventional tomography methods typically require resources that grow exponentially with system size. Here, we introduce a structure-agnostic learning framework for noisy -qubit quantum circuits under i.i.d. single-qubit noise. We first prove that quantum states with unital noise channels admit an efficient learnable representation in the logarithmic-depth regime. We then extend this framework to quantum process tomography under constant noise, deriving a unified protocol that applies to both unital and non-unital noisy channels and retains efficient guarantees for logarithmic-depth circuits. This process-learning formulation is input-agnostic and imposes no distributional assumptions on the input quantum states. We further study a more general regime with arbitrary noise strength. In this setting, low-weight Pauli propagation induces a terminal truncation whose threshold depends logarithmically on the inverse accuracy, leading to quasi-polynomial complexity and near-unit success probability in the average case. In contrast to the preceding two results, this arbitrary-noise guarantee does not impose any restriction on the circuit depth, and therefore covers arbitrary-depth circuits, including both the noiseless limit ( ) and the strong-decoherence regime ( ). Numerical simulations of two-dimensional Hamiltonian dynamics further demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the approach, including for structured circuits beyond the random-circuit setting assumed in the theoretical analysis. These results provide a scalable and practically relevant route toward characterizing large-scale noisy quantum devices, addressing a key bottleneck in the development of quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统层析成像方法资源需求随系统尺寸呈指数增长，高效表征大型量子态和过程是量子信息科学中的挑战。本文提出了一种结构无关的学习框架，用于处理独立同分布单量子比特噪声下的含噪声量子电路。该框架证明了具有幺正噪声信道的量子态在对数深度范围内可高效学习，并将其推广到恒定噪声下的量子过程层析成像。该方法在平均情况下实现了准多项式复杂度，并具有接近单位的成功概率。
authors: Chenyang Li, Shengxin Zhuang, Yukun Zhang, Jingbo B Wang, Xiao Yuan, Yusen Wu and Chuan Wang

articles.title: Half the interference, most of the answer: approximate quantum simulation via path-sum pruning
articles.title_zh: 一半的干涉，大部分的答案：通过路径和剪枝实现近似量子模拟
articles.abstract: Classical simulation of quantum circuits is expensive for two distinct reasons. The obvious one is state-space size: an -qubit system requires exponentially many amplitudes. The less obvious one is interference: useful output distributions emerge only after many computational histories have been coherently combined at common endpoints, and this aggregation step is itself a substantial source of cost. We introduce statistical interference sampling, a framework that makes this second bottleneck explicit by treating endpoint interference as a separately schedulable computation. Using the Chemical Abstract Machine as our model, weighted path contributions evolve as concurrent molecular species, and interference reactions combine contributions that share a common output state. A threshold rule terminates the process once an endpoint accumulates sufficient amplitude, discarding the remaining reactions. The method does not improve worst-case complexity and is not intended as a general-purpose simulator. Its purpose is to ask a more targeted question: how much of the interference calculation can be skipped while still recovering a useful output distribution? Across repeated independent executions at each threshold, we observe a circuit-dependent tradeoff among endpoint-interference work, task-level success, and distributional fidelity. We use Deutsch–Jozsa as a worked illustration and evaluate the method on Grover search, Simon’s problem, and Shor period-finding. We find that thresholding omits substantial endpoint-interference work while attaining high observed task success. An early-termination policy can attain 100% observed task success on several Grover, Simon, and Shor configurations while omitting up to 65% of the interference work. Circuits with strong amplitude separation, where a large gap exists between the amplitude accumulated at the correct endpoint and the maximum amplitude attainable at any incorrect endpoint, benefit most from thresholding; circuits with flatter output distributions, where valid outputs share comparable amplitudes across many endpoints rather than concentrating probability on a single marked state, are less amenable to this strategy. These results suggest that interference arithmetic is a structured resource that admits meaningful approximation, and that exposing it explicitly opens new opportunities for pruning strategies across path-sum, Pauli-path, and tensor-network simulation methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典模拟量子电路的成本高昂，不仅因为状态空间大，还因为干涉计算复杂。本文引入了统计干涉采样框架，将端点干涉视为独立可调度的计算。该方法通过设定阈值来终止计算，以确定在保留有用输出分布的同时可以跳过多少干涉计算。该工作旨在探索在近似量子模拟中优化干涉计算的策略。
authors: Sinan Pehlivanoglu, Srinivasan Iyengar and Amr Sabry

articles.title: Empirical Scaling Laws of Quantum Vision Transformers
articles.title_zh: 量子视觉Transformer的经验缩放定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is a promising application of quantum computing, yet when and how practical learning models can achieve quantum advantage remains poorly understood. Even a polynomial improvement in the resources needed to attain a given predictive performance would be significant. In this work, we investigate empirical scaling laws of quantum vision transformers (QViTs), which connect QML to the transformer architecture underlying modern large language models. We ask whether QViTs exhibit scaling behavior analogous to classical models and how this behavior changes when qubit number is included alongside dataset size and model parameters. The validation losses in our numerical image-classification experiments are well described by a joint shifted power-law model in qubit number, transformer depth, and training dataset size. Expressing this fit in terms of the classical encoder parameter budget identifies a regime in which increasing the number of qubits can compensate for fewer classical encoder parameters at comparable predicted performance. This finding is consistent with earlier observations of parameter efficiency in quantum learning models and suggests a direction for exploring possible resource savings in QML.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习（QML）是量子计算的一个有前景的应用，但其实现量子优势的条件尚不明确。本文研究了量子视觉Transformer（QViTs）的经验缩放定律，将其与经典模型进行比较。数值实验表明，验证损失可以用量子比特数、Transformer深度和训练数据集大小的联合幂律模型很好地描述。研究发现，增加量子比特数可以在预测性能相似的情况下弥补经典编码器参数的不足。
authors: Yuqing Li, Fengyi Gao, Xin Jin, Xiaowei Jia, Qi Cheng, Junyu Liu

articles.title: On the Fast Electrons-Optical Modes Interaction Problem Error
articles.title_zh: 关于快电子-光学模式相互作用问题中的误差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recently developed relativistic quantum optics approach for a fast electron beam-optical modes interaction problem (Optica 6, 1524--1534 (2019)) contains suggestion about a smallness of the error induced by replacement Ψěc ₖapproxΨěc ₖ_₀ for noninteracting free electron Dirac spinors at such wave vector ěc k that łeft|ěc k-ěc k₀ i̊ght| łlłeft|ěc k₀ᵢ̊ght| with ěc k₀ as a peaked wave vector of a focused electron beam. Here, based on quantum information approach we strictly investigated a degree of coincidence of spinors Ψěc ₖ and Ψěc ₖ_₀ by calculating fidelity for them. The analytical expression is obtained. It is shown that the fidelity inevitably depends on not only wave vectors ěc k and ěc k₀ but also on mutual orientation of [ěc k₀,ěc k] and hatěcsdaggerěcσhatěcs with ěcs is a two-component spin unit vector and ěcσ is a vector of Pauli matrices. This result can be conceived as a chirality-like effect in the fidelity and constraints spin arbitrariness when applying the developed relativistic quantum optics approach to the problems of interest. A geometrical configuration of ěc k₀, ěc k-ěc k₀, and hatěcsdagěcσhatěcs that is optimal in terms of fidelity is established.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近的相对论量子光学方法在处理快电子束与光学模式相互作用问题时，对自由电子狄拉克旋量替换引起的误差提出了假设。本文基于量子信息方法，通过计算保真度严格研究了旋量Ψk和Ψk₀的符合程度。研究发现保真度不仅取决于波矢量k和k₀，还取决于[k₀, k]与s†σs的相互取向，揭示了保真度中的手性效应，并对应用该相对论量子光学方法时的自旋任意性施加了限制。
authors: Svetlana Churochkina, Dmitry Churochkin

articles.title: Can the Quantum Fisher Effective Dimension Judge a Hybrid Quantum Neural Network?
articles.title_zh: 量子费雪有效维度能否评估混合量子神经网络？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid quantum neural networks (QNNs) pair a classical feature extractor with a variational quantum circuit, and the effective dimension of the circuit's quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM) is widely used to assess such models. This scalar is often interpreted as an indicator of trainability or accuracy, although these readings are rarely tested under controlled conditions. We therefore investigate what it actually measures. We define the effective dimension as the participation ratio of the QFIM diagonal, which lies between one and the parameter count, and we evaluate it across two image datasets, four frozen backbones including a random-projection control, four circuit depths on eight qubits, and three seeds. During training, the effective dimension remains well below the parameter count, and its correlation with test accuracy ranges from -0.72 to +0.87, changing sign across seeds in half of the configurations. Increasing depth activates a larger share of the circuit directions, from 0.38 to 0.91 of the parameter count, while the initialization gradient variance remains between 1e-5 and 1e-4, so no barren plateau (BP) appears at eight qubits. At a fixed circuit, the four backbones share an initial effective dimension of 6 to 9, even though CIFAR-10 accuracy ranges from 23.14% to 86.44%. These results show that the effective dimension characterizes circuit geometry rather than model quality. We conclude with a practical protocol that assigns each diagnostic to the question it can answer.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合量子神经网络（QNNs）结合了经典特征提取器和变分量子电路，其量子费雪信息矩阵（QFIM）的有效维度常被用于评估模型。本文研究了有效维度在受控条件下的实际测量意义，将其定义为QFIM对角线的参与比。实验结果表明，有效维度在训练过程中远低于参数数量，且与测试准确率的相关性在不同配置下差异显著。研究还发现，增加电路深度会激活更多电路方向，但未出现贫瘠高原现象。
authors: Md Masum Mia, Amith Khandakar, Mohamed Arselene Ayari

articles.title: Hamiltonian-Dependent Compressibility and Physical Preservation in Approximate Quantum Compilation using Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于张量网络的近似量子编译中哈密顿量相关的可压缩性和物理信息保持
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14125v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Approximate quantum compilation (AQC) using tensor networks provides a promising route to reducing the circuit resources required for quantum simulation. However, the factors governing the compressibility of many-body dynamics and the extent to which compressed circuits retain physically relevant information on quantum hardware remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions using AQCtensor for an 80-qubit one-dimensional anisotropic XYZ Heisenberg chain initialized in a Néel state. By varying the exchange anisotropy and external magnetic field, we find that compression performance changes systematically with the anisotropic coupling configuration and field orientation. These variations are strongly associated with a nested-commutator measure related to second-order Trotter error, with corresponding directional trends also reflected in the target-state MPS bond dimension. For an 80-qubit quantum-hardware evaluation, AQCtensor compresses a 10-repetition target evolution to 5 repetitions while retaining a target-state fidelity of 0.995474, reducing the total circuit depth by 45.9% and the two-qubit gate count by 47.6%. The compressed circuit exhibits comparable behavior across magnetization, nearest-neighbor correlation, and Hamiltonian expectation measurements, while process-level diagnostics and local reduced-state tomography provide complementary characterization beyond these observables. Together, these results link AQCtensor compressibility to Hamiltonian commutator structure and target-state complexity and demonstrate substantial circuit reduction while retaining physically relevant features in an 80-qubit quantum-hardware experiment.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于张量网络的近似量子编译（AQC）为减少量子模拟所需的电路资源提供了途径。本文使用AQCtensor研究了80量子比特一维各向异性XYZ海森堡链的可压缩性和物理信息保持问题。研究发现，压缩性能随各向异性耦合配置和磁场方向系统性变化，且与二阶Trotter误差相关的嵌套对易子度量强相关。在80量子比特量子硬件评估中，AQCtensor将目标演化压缩了50%，同时保持了0.995474的目标态保真度，显著减少了电路深度和双量子比特门数量。
authors: Dohyun Kim, Namshik Han

articles.title: Lifting an [n,k,d] Binary Linear Code to an [[n,k,d]] Quantum Stabilizer Code
articles.title_zh: 将[n,k,d]二元线性码提升为[[n,k,d]]量子稳定子码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The codeword stabilized (CWS) framework provides a systematic method for constructing quantum error correcting codes from a simple undirected graph and a classical code. When the underlying classical code is linear, the resulting quantum code is a stabilizer code. In this work, we investigate the conditions under which an arbitrary [n,k,d] classical binary linear code can be lifted to an [[n,k,d]] quantum stabilizer code using the CWS framework. We analyze the random CWS code constructed from a given [n,k,d] binary linear code C and an Erdős-Rényi random graph G(n, frac12). We establish a lower bound on the probability that the resulting quantum code preserves the minimum distance d of the classical code. This probabilistic analysis yields a Gilbert-Varshamov-type condition on the n,k,d parameters of the classical code that guarantees the existence of a graph resulting in a quantum code with the same n,k,d parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 码字稳定（CWS）框架提供了一种从简单无向图和经典码构造量子纠错码的系统方法。本文研究了在CWS框架下，任意[n,k,d]经典二元线性码可以提升为[[n,k,d]]量子稳定子码的条件。通过分析随机CWS码，研究人员建立了所得量子码保留经典码最小距离d的概率下限。这项概率分析为经典码的n,k,d参数提供了一个Gilbert-Varshamov型条件，保证了存在一个图可以生成具有相同n,k,d参数的量子码。
authors: Thamadathil Aswanth, Navin Kashyap

articles.title: Exponential Quantum Advantage in Stationary Signal Sensing
articles.title_zh: 稳态信号传感中的指数级量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sensing time-varying signals is essential for precision measurement and for characterizing fluctuations in physical systems. In this work, we show that quantum entanglement provides an exponential advantage in the acquisition time required to learn the temporal statistics of a stationary classical signal. The task is to estimate the characteristic function of joint displacements on selected bosonic modes within a fixed-duration window, using continuous measurements of one signal realization. We present an entanglement-assisted scheme based on two-mode squeezed probes and local Bell measurements with protected idlers, and bound its acquisition time accounting for readout noise and correlations between signal windows. For a strictly stationary pulse family, it achieves polynomial acquisition time at inverse-polynomial accuracy with logarithmic squeezing and polynomial photon number. On the other hand, we prove that any local idler-free protocols require acquisition time exponential in the number of selected temporal modes per window. This lower bound holds for both sequentially prepared and arbitrarily temporally entangled probes, allowing non-Gaussian inputs and measurements and causal classical feedback, as long as each output is measured destructively within its time bin. These results establish an exponential quantum learning advantage for a single continuously monitored stationary signal, with the sensing cost measured by total acquisition time.
articles.abstract_zh: 感知时变信号对于精密测量和表征物理系统波动至关重要。本文证明了量子纠缠在学习稳态经典信号时间统计所需的采集时间上提供了指数级优势。研究提出了一种基于双模挤压探测和局部贝尔测量的纠缠辅助方案，并在严格稳态脉冲族下实现了多项式采集时间。同时，研究证明任何局部无闲置协议所需的采集时间与每个窗口选定时间模式的数量呈指数关系。
authors: Sojeong Park, Changhun Oh

articles.title: Hyperpolarization-enabled cooperative molecular magnetic amplification
articles.title_zh: 超极化实现协同分子磁放大
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting weak magnetic fields at hertz frequencies is central to biomagnetism, geophysical sensing, and searches for new physics, yet it remains challenging because of technical systematics and environmental noise. Here, we realize a continuously operating molecular magnetic amplifier. Signal amplification by reversible exchange (SABRE) parahydrogen-based hyperpolarization maintains non-equilibrium spin order at zero field, turning scalar-coupled nuclear spins in liquid state molecules into an active, frequency-selective gain medium.
