The construction can be directly extended to a pair of interacting spins sharing a common reservoir, with the resulting quantum algebra making the entanglement during a quench analytically accessible.
articles.abstract_zh: 强动力学对称性为Lindblad方程描述的开放量子系统中的持久振荡提供了代数描述。本文为集体自旋系统建立了这种代数的渐近对应关系，确定了在磁场和耗散耦合的特定条件下，非衰减振荡模式的出现条件。作者提出了相应的“对称”算符的封闭形式，可用于从稳态构建这些模式，这些模式是具有虚数特征值的Liouvillian特征向量。
authors: Joseph Tindall

articles.title: Bosonic Quantum Conditional Mutual Information and Bose-Einstein Condensation
articles.title_zh: 玻色子量子条件互信息与玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article aims to introduce the bosonic asymmetric quantum conditional mutual information (QCMI), IB(A; B|C), as a rigorously defined information-theoretic quantity for continuous-variable (bosonic) systems. After defining IB(A; B|C) through quantum instruments on infinite-dimensional Fock spaces, we prove that Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) induces a logarithmic divergence  IB(A; B|C) ≥ α łog₂ (N₀^C+1), which further establishes IB(A; B|C) as a quantum-information order parameter for BEC with power-law scaling near the critical point. We provide the complete five-step proof of this result, connecting measurement back-action, off-diagonal long-range order, and Jensen's inequality. In the condensed phase, the effective causal propagation velocity is set by the Bogoliubov sound speed cₛ in the long-wavelength limit, and vanishes continuously at the superfluid--Mott-insulator transition. Applications to composite bosons, the BEC--BCS crossover, and a quantum-gas-microscope measurement protocol are presented. Finally, we demonstrate how the reduced bosonic QCMI serves as a finite-size scaling probe analogous to the Binder cumulant.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在引入玻色子非对称量子条件互信息（QCMI），IB(A; B|C)，作为连续变量（玻色子）系统的严格定义信息论量。作者证明了玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）会引起对数发散，从而将IB(A; B|C)确立为BEC的量子信息序参量，在临界点附近具有幂律标度。文章还探讨了其在复合玻色子、BEC-BCS交叉以及量子气体显微镜测量协议中的应用。
authors: Anupam Ghosh

articles.title: Reverse quantum aging: Restoring rhythmicity from quantum aging state
articles.title_zh: 逆向量子老化：从量子老化态恢复节律性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum aging transition has recently been reported, whereby the oscillatory dynamics of a network of globally coupled quantum self-sustained oscillators is degraded sharply when the fraction of inactive nodes exceeds a critical value. Here we explore the reverse process: the revival of rhythmic dynamics from an aged state in a quantum oscillator network by introducing a controlled incoherent single-boson pumping channel. Using a self-consistent quantum master equation in the Lindblad form for globally coupled active--inactive quantum Stuart--Landau oscillators, we show that increasing the pumping strength progressively suppresses the aging transition and eventually eliminates it, restoring rhythmicity even when all oscillators are inactive. Remarkably, complete compensation of the coupling-induced dissipative loss is not required; a substantially weaker pumping strength is sufficient to eliminate the aging transition. We show that the revival is governed by a redistribution of the Fock-state population of the inactive oscillators toward higher-occupation states. Our results establish controlled incoherent pumping as an effective mechanism for restoring dynamical robustness in quantum oscillator networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子老化转变是指全局耦合量子自持振子网络在非活跃节点比例超过临界值时，其振荡动力学急剧退化。本文探索了逆向过程：通过引入受控非相干单玻色子泵浦通道，从量子振子网络的老化态中恢复节律性动力学。研究表明，增加泵浦强度可以逐步抑制并最终消除老化转变，即使所有振子都处于非活跃状态也能恢复节律性。这种恢复是由非活跃振子Fock态布居向更高占据态的重新分布所驱动的。
authors: Bulti Paul, Biswabibek Bandyopadhyay, Tanmoy Banerjee

articles.title: Euler's thirty-six officers need not all be entangled: real AME(4,6), families and classification
articles.title_zh: 欧拉三十六军官问题并非都需要纠缠：实数AME(4,6)态、族及其分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Absolutely maximally entangled states of four six-level systems, AME(4,6), are the quantum solutions of Euler's problem of the thirty-six officers. Until recently all reported solutions were complex, and it was conjectured that no real orthogonal 2-unitary matrix of order 36 exists. We give real AME(4,6) states with 60 non-zero coefficients in ±1,sqrt2/sqrt72. Of their thirty-six officers, 12 are classical, as some must be whenever fewer than 72 coefficients are non-zero. They lie in the -1 eigenspace of an order-4 local symmetry, and on their support the AME conditions become linear. We derive two closed-form families of AME(4,6) states that meet at one of these states: a 10-parameter family that is supported on 72 basis states, and an 11-parameter family on 60 basis states. At each of its two ends the first family loses 12 coefficients, and the AME states on the remaining 60 basis states form an 11-parameter family: the second family at one end, and an analogous family at the other. These two 60-term families contain 4096 real AME states up to diagonal local unitaries, 1024 of which are limits of the first family. They fall into exactly 20 classes under local unitaries and permutations of the parties, and we certify their separation with interval arithmetic.
articles.abstract_zh: 欧拉三十六军官问题的量子解是四个六能级系统的绝对最大纠缠态AME(4,6)。本文给出了具有60个非零系数的实数AME(4,6)态，其中12个军官是经典的。作者推导了两个在其中一个态处相遇的AME(4,6)态的封闭形式族：一个10参数族支持在72个基态上，另一个11参数族支持在60个基态上。这些60项族包含了4096个实数AME态，并对其进行了分类。
authors: Palash Pandya

articles.title: Direct polarisation-state reconstruction with a temporal pointer: accessible states, resolution and optimal coupling
articles.title_zh: 使用时间指针的直接偏振态重建：可访问态、分辨率和最佳耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weak measurements are used to amplify small signals, to address foundational questions, and to characterise quantum states without tomography. In direct state reconstruction each amplitude of the state vector is proportional to a single complex weak value, which for a temporal pointer is read from the mean arrival time and the mean frequency of the postselected pulse. Such an experiment requires three quantities to be fixed, the coupling, the angular resolution demanded of the reconstruction, and the set of states over which the method remains usable, and these are commonly set by the available apparatus rather than derived. We derive all three for a Gaussian temporal pointer and an arbitrary postselection state. The states that cannot be reconstructed form a spherical cap centred on the state orthogonal to the postselection, whose geodesic half-angle follows from the largest of three independent thresholds and involves no adjustable parameter. Two states are distinguishable only if they differ by more than a minimal step fixed by the coupling, by the number of incident photons and by the sensitivity of the weak value along the path followed. For an inversion at first order in the coupling the systematic and statistical errors are opposed and fix an optimal coupling that varies as the inverse sixth root of the number of incident photons, whereas an exact inversion at finite coupling removes the systematic error, the remaining bound being one on the two-centroid readout rather than on the inversion, since below an amplitude equal to a quarter of the coupling two states give the same pair of centroids while their profiles differ. These results allow a direct reconstruction experiment to be dimensioned before the apparatus is assembled.
articles.abstract_zh: 弱测量可用于放大微弱信号和表征量子态。本文针对高斯时间指针和任意后选态，推导了耦合、重建所需的角分辨率以及该方法可用的态集合这三个关键量。研究发现，不可重建的态形成一个以与后选态正交的态为中心的球冠。两个态只有当它们之间的差异超过由耦合、入射光子数和弱值敏感度决定的最小步长时才可区分。
authors: Shane P. Gervais, Lambert Giner

articles.title: Thermal aliases in quantum noise: sampling clocks and pulse widths
articles.title_zh: 量子噪声中的热混叠：采样时钟与脉冲宽度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can collective quantum-noise measurements distinguish different mode temperatures from one common temperature when the coupling spectrum is unknown? For stationary Gaussian oscillator environments, we derive a sharp bandwidth threshold for an exact thermal alias on the integer-time sampling lattice. The threshold depends on temperature order through the quantum response. For frequencies within the first alias period, fixing sufficient integer-time correlations makes one additional fractional-time fluctuation observation enough to exclude every common-temperature fit. A calibrated second pulse width provides another route through the same collective port: both widths must probe one spectrum and retain their measured variance scales. For a specified two-mode example, continuous-frequency certificates cover all common temperatures and uncertainty in a shared pulse ramp. A binary-readout protocol combines randomly interleaved matched references with collective-variance and coherence checks to handle Gaussian oscillator loss and predictable readout drift. The selected fractional-clock and two-width designs require approximately 3.8×10⁷ and 1.6×10⁸ outcomes for at most 5% type-I error and at least 95% power on the stated alternative class. These theoretical and numerical acquisition guarantees assume independently validated preparation, spectral support and control specifications; validation costs are additional. The result identifies which new observation makes thermal-model testing informative when mode-resolved access is unavailable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了在耦合谱未知的情况下，集体量子噪声测量能否区分不同的模式温度与一个共同温度。作者推导了一个精确的热混叠在整数时间采样格上的尖锐带宽阈值，并发现该阈值通过量子响应依赖于温度阶数。通过额外的分数时间涨落观测或校准的第二脉冲宽度，可以排除所有共同温度拟合。研究还提出了一种二进制读出协议，以处理高斯振荡器损耗和可预测的读出漂移。
authors: Zi-Xuan Wang, Xiu-Hao Deng

articles.title: Photon-stimulated decay of ḩi-matched ancillas causes unheralded bit flips in bosonic codes
articles.title_zh: 光子激发辅助量子比特衰变导致玻色子码中未预报的比特翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bosonic codes often read out their syndrome with a transmon ancilla whose computational levels g and f have equal parity and matched dispersive shifts: a decay f→ e is then heralded and leaves the code intact, while the direct f→ g is forbidden by parity. We show that the photons of the code open this decay at first order in the ancilla's decay rate. Dressing by the code mode lets the charge noise that limits the ancilla's T₁ drive a photon-stimulated Raman decay |f,nångle→|g,n+1ångle, at (n+1)(ḩigₑ/2g₀₁)² times the f→ e rate for a smooth noise spectrum. When the matching is set by the detuning, the decay costs approxΓfₑ/α per gate and photon, whatever the coupling strength; a deliberate mismatch or matching by a drive lowers this cost, and a qubit ancilla has no such channel. The opened decay is unheralded and flips a cat with probability approx 1/2; being first order, it overtakes the second-order double decay f→ e→ g as the ancilla improves. In a microscopic model of the Ocelot repetition cat code, it makes the bit-flip floor of the gates grow linearly with the cat size, by a factor 1.2-1.7 from four to ten photons, which would limit the noise bias to sim 10³. The published gate data end at four photons and do not yet test this growth.
articles.abstract_zh: 玻色子码在读取综合征时常使用具有匹配色散位移的辅助量子比特。本研究发现，码中的光子会在辅助量子比特衰变率的一阶效应下开启原本被宇称禁止的衰变通道 f→g。这种光子激发的拉曼衰变是未预报的，并以约1/2的概率导致比特翻转，其速率随辅助量子比特性能提升而超越二阶衰变。在Ocelot重复猫码的微观模型中，这会导致门操作的比特翻转下限随猫态尺寸线性增长，对量子计算的容错性构成挑战。
authors: Aleksandr Gulkanov

articles.title: Entanglement Sudden Death in Gapped Ground States
articles.title_zh: 间隙基态中的纠缠猝死
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial sudden death of entanglement refers to the disappearance of quantum correlations between subsystems after a certain distance called the entanglement length. Specifically, given a density matrix h̊oABC on a tripartite system ABC with B spatially separating A and C, the entanglement length is the distance ell(A,C) after which the reduced density matrix h̊oAC, given by tracing out the B subsystem, is separable. We show in the case of gapped ground states in any dimension that the entanglement length is finite on finite subsystems. Restricting to one-dimensional systems, we prove that normal matrix product states have a finite entanglement length independent of A and C, and that a finite pure state with such uniform entanglement length has a matrix product state representation with bond dimension independent of A and C. Consequently, in one dimension, entanglement length distinguishes matrix product states from all other pure states.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间纠缠猝死是指子系统间量子关联在超过一定距离（纠缠长度）后消失的现象。本研究证明，在任意维度的间隙基态中，有限子系统上的纠缠长度是有限的。对于一维系统，作者进一步证明了普通矩阵乘积态具有独立于A和C的有限纠缠长度，并且具有这种均匀纠缠长度的有限纯态可以用键维独立于A和C的矩阵乘积态表示。因此，在一维情况下，纠缠长度可以区分矩阵乘积态与其他所有纯态。
authors: Robert Ferydouni, Thomas Jackson, Samuel O. Scalet

articles.title: Bosonic unstructured search: quantum enhancement without entanglement
articles.title_zh: 玻色子无结构搜索：无纠缠的量子增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider unstructured search using multimode bosonic quantum systems under energy constraints. The task is to locate an unknown marked mode among N possibilities using arbitrary control, subject to a time-averaged mean-boson-number budget nbgg 1. We analyze a continuous-time phase-shift oracle of strength B₀, with cost given by the total oracle time, and a discrete oracle with fixed phase φ₀, with cost given by the number of queries. We give algorithms that identify the target with query complexity O(sqrtN/nbB₀) for continuous-time oracles or O(sqrtN/nb |sin(φ₀/2)|) for discrete oracles with nb |sin(φ₀/2)|=O(1). In contrast, for discrete oracles with nb |sin(φ₀/2)|=Ømega(1), we provide an algorithm using O(max1,sqrtN/nb|sin(φ₀/2)|) queries. We also prove matching lower bounds on the query complexity, showing that these algorithms are asymptotically optimal. Furthermore, we show that, in the absence of loss, non-Gaussianity is necessary to achieve the optimal joint query scaling in N and nb, but entanglement is not. Under uniform boson loss at rate γ, we prove a query lower bound of Ømega ( γ N / n b B₀² ), attained for γ = Ømega(B₀ sqrtn b/N) using coherent-state probes. Finally, we propose experimental implementations using multipass optical microscopy or superconducting circuits as potential routes to speeding up imaging or device calibration with a low boson-number budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在能量约束下使用多模玻色子量子系统进行无结构搜索的问题。研究人员提出了针对连续时间和离散时间预言机的算法，并证明了其查询复杂度是渐近最优的。结果表明，在没有损耗的情况下，实现N和nb最优联合查询缩放需要非高斯性，但不需要纠缠。此外，在均匀玻色子损耗存在时，研究还给出了查询复杂度的下限。
authors: Yu-Xin Wang, Erfan Abbasgholinejad, Supratik Sarkar, Sharoon Austin, Andrew M. Childs, Alexey V. Gorshkov, Mohammad Hafezi

articles.title: Fractional and quantum Latin squares: real solutions of quantum 36 officers problem
articles.title_zh: 分数和量子拉丁方：量子36军官问题的实数解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Latin square can be extended by replacing its symbols with probabilities or quantum states. We relate these two extensions through explicit examples, from classical and fractional Latin squares to quantum Latin squares and a real solution of Euler's quantum 36 officers problem. A simultaneous cyclic-shift ansatz on a four-torus of tensor coefficients gives a real absolutely maximally entangled (AME) state of four six-level systems. A local orthogonal change of basis yields a representative with 96 nonzero amplitudes. Two single-party arrays obtained from the corresponding quantum orthogonal Latin square yield fractional Latin squares. Signs matter: comparison with the independent real construction of Bruzda and its sign variant distinguishes three local-unitary classes, two of which have identical probabilities. We extend this probability representation to existing seven- and nine-party AME states with six levels each. Their amplitude matrices reveal 48 complex Hadamard blocks of order 3³ and six of order 6⁴, respectively. These constructions separate what can be read from a probability picture from the coherent conditions responsible for maximal entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将拉丁方符号替换为概率或量子态的扩展形式，并给出了欧拉量子36军官问题的实数解。通过张量系数的同步循环移位假设，作者构建了一个四六能级系统的实数绝对最大纠缠态。研究还发现，符号在区分局部酉类方面至关重要，并进一步将这种概率表示扩展到现有的七方和九方AME态。这些构造有助于区分概率图景与相干条件所揭示的信息。
authors: Mykhailo Hontarenko, Karol Życzkowski

articles.title: Moving quantum sensors
articles.title_zh: 移动量子传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate whether controlled motion of a quantum sensor offers a metrological advantage in a field-detection task. We consider a localized field of known strength B occupying an unknown contiguous region making up a fraction 1/N of the total search space, with a qubit sensor controlled for a total time T to maximize the probability of detecting the field. We study the regime in which the characteristic timescale of the field is slow compared to the time to move the sensor between any two regions, and we distinguish classical motion, where the sensor follows a definite trajectory, from quantum motion, where the sensor can be in a coherent superposition of locations. For a single classically moving sensor, we derive an optimal multi-stop protocol and obtain the exact maximum detection probability. Allowing coherent spatial superposition maps the single-sensor problem onto Hamiltonian search and reduces the interrogation time for successfully detecting the field from Θ(N/B) to Θ(sqrtN/B). We then extend the problem to M sensors and identify a hierarchy of optimal time scalings for constant success probability determined by the available spatial and inter-sensor quantum resources. Unentangled coherently moving sensors achieve T=Θ(sqrtN/M/B) by searching disjoint regions in parallel, while entanglement among the sensors can further enhance the effective field coupling and achieve T=Θ(sqrtN/(MB)). Matching lower bounds establish the optimality of these scalings in the presence of arbitrary controls and ancilla systems. Our results separate the roles of classical motion, spatial coherence, and entanglement in spatial field detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子传感器的受控运动是否能在场检测任务中提供计量优势。研究人员比较了经典运动和量子运动（传感器处于位置的相干叠加态）两种情况。对于单个经典移动传感器，导出了最优的多站协议；而允许相干空间叠加可以将单个传感器问题映射到哈密顿量搜索，并将成功检测场所需的时间从Θ(N/B)缩短到Θ(sqrtN/B)。研究还扩展到M个传感器的情况，并确定了不同可用资源下实现恒定成功概率的最优时间尺度层次结构。
authors: Evan Zhang, Erfan Abbasgholinejad, Yu-Xin Wang, Ali Fahimniya, Daniel J. Spencer, Sean R. Muleady, Mohammad Hafezi, Andrew M. Childs, Alexey V. Gorshkov

articles.title: Error-Corrected QRAM Queries with One-Fault-Tolerant textttCSWAP Gates
articles.title_zh: 基于单容错CSWAP门的纠错QRAM查询
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum random-access memory (QRAM) enables coherent queries to classical data. However, the (O(N)) qubits required for a memory with (N=2ⁿ) addresses make QRAM appear vulnerable to noise. Though bucket-brigade routing provides intrinsic noise resilience to reduce the error in QRAM, improving the fidelity of QRAM queries is still an important and challenging problem. We introduce a low-overhead protection framework for bucket-brigade QRAM with two complementary components. First, we propose a one-fault-tolerant repeat-until-success logical controlled-SWAP gate using the ([[4,2,2]]) code under erasure noise channel. Interleaved erasure checks and local recovery correct every single erasure, so the leading logical failure probability is second order in the physical erasure error rates. Second, we exploit validity constraints of bucket-brigade routing to define local parity checks directly on the router states, without adding extra data qubits to create code redundancy. Under bit-flip noise, minimum-weight perfect matching with noiseless syndrome measurements corrects single interior faults, while open spatial boundaries retain a first-order contribution in the residual bit-flip rate. Monte Carlo simulations confirm quadratic suppression for the protected controlled-SWAP and improved depth scaling for decoded QRAM router-state snapshots. The two codes admit a concatenated realization in which the inner code supplies erasure protection and the outer code optionally corrects interior logical bit flips. Together, these results show how routing constraints and a protected non-Clifford routing gate can improve QRAM reliability under biased and erasure-dominant noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子随机存取存储器（QRAM）在噪声面前显得脆弱，提高其查询保真度是重要挑战。本文提出了一种低开销的桶式QRAM保护框架，包含两个互补组件。首先，作者设计了一个基于[[4,2,2]]码的单容错“重复直到成功”逻辑受控SWAP门，可在擦除噪声下实现二阶逻辑错误率。其次，通过利用桶式路由的有效性约束，直接在路由器状态上定义局部奇偶校验，从而在不增加额外数据量子比特的情况下，在比特翻转噪声下纠正单次内部故障。
authors: Shifan Xu, Connor T. Hann, Nathan Wiebe, Steven M. Girvin, Yongshan Ding

articles.title: Fermionic non-Gaussianity via computable measures and experimentally accessible bounds
articles.title_zh: 通过可计算度量和实验可及界限量化费米子非高斯性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interacting fermions owe both their non-trivial correlations and their computational power to their departure from Gaussianity. Yet, quantifying that departure geometrically faces two challenges: the Gaussian manifold is non-convex, and perturbative treatments are confined to weak interactions. Here, we introduce a geometric measure of fermionic non-Gaussianity, the fidelity distance of a target state to the manifold of fermionic Gaussian states. We construct an iteration formalism to numerically access it, applicable also at strong coupling. Further, we prove a sharpened operator Jensen inequality, of interest in its own right. We use it to derive a witness that involves only two- and four-point fermionic correlators. Numerical benchmarks on the one-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model show that the quality of the witness improves with system size and, for strong coupling, is tighter than antiflatness. Our results open a scalable route to charting non-Gaussianity of strongly-interacting fermionic quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 相互作用的费米子因其非高斯性而展现出非平凡关联和计算能力。本文引入了一种费米子非高斯性的几何度量，即目标态与费米子高斯态流形之间的保真度距离，并构建了迭代形式以在强耦合下进行数值计算。研究还证明了一个改进的算子Jensen不等式，并用其导出了一个仅涉及两点和四点费米子关联量的判据。在费米-哈伯德模型上的数值基准测试表明，该判据的质量随系统尺寸增加而提高，并在强耦合下比反平坦性更紧密，为强相互作用费米子量子模拟器的非高斯性表征提供了可扩展的途径。
authors: Leela Ganesh Chandra Lakkaraju, Naga Dileep Varikuti, Philipp Hauke

articles.title: Quantum Reference Frames in terms of Tetrads
articles.title_zh: 基于四足体的量子参考系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We adapt to the context of quantum theory the treatment, familiar in relativity theory, of a reference frame as a tetrad. Since a tetrad is a set of four orthonormal vectors at a spacetime point, it encodes a timelike direction, three orthogonal spatial directions, and units; and so it gives a configuration in spacetime (a spatial orientation and state of motion) of an idealized infinitesimal apparatus (``rulers and a clock"). So a natural ``first guess" is that the state of a quantum reference frame should be an assignment of complex amplitudes to a set of tetrads. We develop this idea, in terms of bundles over spacetime of bases of the tangent spaces. This paper is a companion to two other papers. It emphasises the main conceptual aspects of our proposal, while the other two papers give physical details. It also explains the main contrast between those two papers. Namely: (i) the first considers a single spacetime geometry, so that a quantum reference frame, on our proposal, gives a superposition of perspectives on that geometry; while (ii) the second considers the spacetime manifold with no geometry given a priori, which will imply that a quantum reference frame, on our proposal, can describe a superposition of perspectives on a superposition of geometries---not ``just" a superposition of perspectives on a single geometry. The main mathematical idea for representing this contrast will be choosing between (i) the orthonormal frame bundle, for a given spacetime geometry; (ii) the frame bundle in the usual sense of containing all bases of all spacetime points' tangent spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将相对论中将参考系视为四足体的处理方法引入量子理论。作者提出，量子参考系的状态应是为一组四足体分配复振幅，并基于时空上切空间基的丛来发展这一思想。该论文作为两篇相关论文的补充，着重阐述了其提案的主要概念方面，并解释了这两篇论文之间的主要区别：一篇考虑单一时空几何，另一篇则考虑没有先验几何的时空流形。
authors: Jeremy Butterfield, Daniel A. Turolla Vanzella

articles.title: Periodic-Pulse Control of Collective Emission and Photon Statistics in Interacting Quantum Emitters
articles.title_zh: 相互作用量子发射器中集体发射和光子统计的周期脉冲控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the collective emission spectra and photon correlations of two identical dipole-dipole-coupled emitters under continuous-wave (CW) and periodic pulsed driving. Our results show that a periodic train of instantaneous πₓ pulses can generate emission spectra whose dominant features closely resemble those obtained under CW excitation. We find that the structure of the collective emission spectra reflects the interplay among the resonance conditions, dipole-dipole coupling, and the inter-pulse delay τ_D. We further demonstrate that finite-duration πₓ pulses with sufficiently high Rabi frequencies can closely reproduce the ideal instantaneous-pulse limit. In contrast to the emission spectra, the photon correlations g⁽²⁾(t,τ) are governed primarily by τ_D and, unlike under CW driving, become increasingly insensitive to the resonance conditions in the short-pulse limit. These results establish periodic pulsed driving as a versatile means of tailoring both the emission spectra and the photon statistics of coupled two-emitter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了连续波（CW）和周期脉冲驱动下，两个相同偶极-偶极耦合发射器的集体发射光谱和光子关联。研究发现，周期性的瞬时πₓ脉冲序列可以产生与CW激发下相似的发射光谱，其结构反映了共振条件、偶极-偶极耦合和脉冲间延迟的相互作用。与发射光谱不同，光子关联主要受脉冲间延迟控制，并且在短脉冲极限下对共振条件变得不敏感。这些结果表明周期脉冲驱动是调控耦合双发射器系统发射光谱和光子统计的有效手段。
authors: Kavalambramalil George Paulson, Fu Li, Hanna Terletska

articles.title: A Controlled Null Result for Per-Gate Riemannian Optimization in VQE
articles.title_zh: VQE中逐门黎曼优化的受控无效结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parametrized gates in a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) live on a product of unitary groups, which makes Riemannian optimization a natural candidate for improving training. We test this candidate in the clean per-gate setting: each single-qubit gate is optimized directly on U (2) and compared with Adam on an unconstrained Euler-angle chart representing the same physical gate, initialized from the same unitaries and tuned with a separate learning-rate sweep. On a validated hydrogen-chain benchmark, we find no measurable practical advantage from the Riemannian machinery. The direct manifold optimizer and the Euler-coordinate baseline are interleaved in final error and success rate; the classical coordinate baseline is not slower in iterations on the successful cells; and the choices of Riemannian metric, retraction, and momentum vector transport do not change the conclusion. We also identify four failure modes that can manufacture an apparent positive result: a trivial product-state benchmark, a projected-matrix Adam baseline that discards most of its own step, a non-unitary inherited Cayley retraction that lets the reported energy pass below the variational minimum, and a learning-rate grid whose optimum sits at its boundary. Each failure mode produced a plausible multi-seed result in our own workflow before being caught. The practical output of this paper is therefore a controlled null result and a validation checklist for VQE optimizer comparisons.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子本征求解器（VQE）中的参数化门存在于酉群的乘积上，使得黎曼优化成为改进训练的自然选择。本研究在逐门优化设置下，将直接在U(2)上优化的单量子比特门与基于欧拉角表示的Adam优化器进行比较。在经过验证的氢链基准测试中，研究发现黎曼优化方法没有可测量的实际优势。直接流形优化器和欧拉坐标基线在最终误差和成功率上交错，且黎曼度量、回缩和动量矢量传输的选择并未改变结论。
authors: Polina Belozerova, Pavel Osinenko

articles.title: A three-eighths upper bound on the stabilizer-rank exponent of face-center magic states
articles.title_zh: 面心魔术态稳定器秩指数的三八上限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give an explicit construction proving that the exact stabilizer rank of m copies of the qubit face-center magic state is O(2³m/⁸). Two symmetry-related fifteen-term identities combine into a twenty-four-term decomposition at twelve copies. The balanced structure of this decomposition yields a substitution that adds eight copies at a cost of eight terms per existing term. The resulting bound γ_T łeq 3/8 improves the previously published exponent łog₂₍₃₎/4.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个明确的构造，证明了m个量子比特面心魔术态的精确稳定器秩为O(2³m/⁸)。通过两个对称相关的十五项恒等式组合成一个十二副本的二十四项分解，这种平衡结构产生了一个替换，以每个现有项八个项的成本增加八个副本。由此产生的界限γ_T ≤ 3/8改进了先前发布的指数log₂(3)/4。
authors: Samuel Bevins

articles.title: Chromatic Block-Gibbs p-Bit Decoding of QLDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: QLDPC码的色块吉布斯p比特解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a parallel decoder for quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes based on probabilistic bits (p-bits), tunable stochastic binary units controlled by local fields. The idea is that predicted error configurations, interpreted as explanations of the observed syndrome, are updated stochastically using local Gibbs conditionals, while a progressively strengthened parity penalty drives the search toward syndrome-valid configurations. A coloring of the decoding graph enables parallel block updates, and independent replicas and restarts provide trajectory diversity. The best candidate encountered during the search is returned, mirroring the candidate-selection strategy of recent ensemble decoders. At the stated update budgets, the resulting logical error rates are on par with leading decoders under both code-capacity and circuit-level noise. While the total number of variable resamplings can be substantially larger than the message-update count of BP-based alternatives, the numerical results establish constraint-annealed p-bit dynamics as a competitive stochastic alternative for QLDPC decoding and motivate further study of hardware-native implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于概率比特（p比特）的量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码并行解码器。该解码器通过局部吉布斯条件随机更新预测的错误配置，并通过逐步增强的奇偶校验惩罚将搜索推向符合症候的配置。数值结果表明，在给定更新预算下，该方法在码容量和电路级噪声下，其逻辑错误率与主流解码器相当。这证明了约束退火p比特动力学作为QLDPC解码的竞争性随机替代方案的潜力。
authors: Mert Gökduman, Cyril Guyot, Henry D. Pfister

articles.title: Universal entanglement detection with geometrically optimal witnesses
articles.title_zh: 基于几何最优判据的普适纠缠检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17592v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing optimal entanglement witnesses for arbitrary quantum systems remains a formidable challenge, hindered by the structural complexity of high-dimensional quantum state spaces. In this work, we overcome this barrier by introducing a unified framework for constructing geometrically optimal witnesses capable of identifying arbitrary entanglement structures. By leveraging the geometric properties of a target quantum state relative to a specific entanglement structure in Hilbert-Schmidt space, these witnesses are constructed in an efficient and effective manner. Among all nontrivial witnesses, they provide maximal distinguishability between the target state and the set of states without the desired entanglement structure. As a result, our approach enables the universal detection of bipartite, multipartite, and high-dimensional entanglement. To demonstrate its experimental feasibility, we apply the framework to a four-qubit nuclear spin quantum system. Compared to existing methods, our approach offers enhanced noise robustness, broader detection universality, and improved construction efficiency, providing a powerful and versatile tool for advancing the characterization and understanding of entanglement in quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 为任意量子系统构建最优纠缠判据是一个巨大挑战。本文提出了一种统一框架，用于构建几何最优判据，能够识别任意纠缠结构。通过利用目标量子态在希尔伯特-施密特空间中相对于特定纠缠结构的几何特性，这些判据被高效且有效地构建。该方法实现了双组分、多组分和高维纠缠的普适检测，并在四量子比特核自旋量子系统中验证了其实验可行性。与现有方法相比，该方法具有更强的噪声鲁棒性、更广的检测普适性和更高的构建效率。
authors: Xuanran Zhu, Keyi Huang, Chao Zhang, Xinfang Nie, Qi Zhao, Dawei Lu

articles.title: Toward Interpretable Quantum Generators for Financial Returns through Problem-Informed Circuit Design
articles.title_zh: 通过问题导向的电路设计实现金融收益可解释量子生成器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When used as function approximators, quantum circuits often lack interpretability and face a fundamental trade-off between expressivity and trainability. We propose a problem-informed framework for financial return generation that uses relational structure and symmetry-inspired parameter sharing to guide the construction of quantum circuits with few trainable parameters and empirically testable operator roles. We evaluate three quantum generator architectures, referred to as ZZ, directed ZZ-CRX, and structured time evolution, within a hybrid Wasserstein quantum generative adversarial network trained to generate 16-step Bitcoin return windows. Across circuits with one to four layers and one to eight trainable coefficients, these generators recover meaningful marginal and temporal distributional features, while single-layer configurations remain competitive with deeper variants. Across matched depths, independently trained ZZ-CRX configurations exhibit a predominantly downward shift in median leverage relative to ZZ, consistent with the intended directional role of the controlled-rotation construction. The small number of coefficients also enables direct landscape analysis, revealing competing parameter preferences between marginal and temporal objectives and helping to explain the difficulty of finding parameter settings that perform well on both. These results provide an initial demonstration that structural assumptions can guide the design of compact quantum generators and link circuit architecture to observable statistical behaviour, motivating more systematic and parameter-efficient approaches to quantum circuit construction.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路作为函数逼近器时常缺乏可解释性，并面临表达能力与可训练性之间的权衡。本文提出了一种问题导向的框架，用于金融收益生成，该框架利用关系结构和对称性启发式参数共享来构建具有少量可训练参数和可经验测试算子角色的量子电路。研究评估了三种量子生成器架构，并在混合Wasserstein量子生成对抗网络中进行训练，以生成比特币收益数据。结果表明，这些生成器能够恢复有意义的边际和时间分布特征，为金融收益生成提供了可解释的量子生成器。
authors: Huijie Guan, Xuanhao Wang, Shengbin Wang, Jiale Zhang, Jian Ding, Shuxin Xie, Dongdong Li, Jianjian Gao, Hantao Sun, Wenhao Chu

articles.title: Nearly Optimal Quantum Sample Complexity of Learning Fourier-Sparse Boolean Functions
articles.title_zh: 学习傅里叶稀疏布尔函数的近最优量子样本复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17648v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the number of uniform quantum examples needed to exactly learn a Boolean function with at most k nonzero Fourier coefficients. We give a learner with near-optimal widetildeO(k) sample complexity independent of the input length n. The learner uses only separate measurements of individual examples. This improves the previous O(k³/²łog² k) upper bound (Arunachalam, Chakraborty, Lee, Paraashar, and de Wolf, 2021). The main ingredient is a candidate set formed by symmetric differences of subsets from independent groups of Fourier samples. A multilinear majority polynomial combines unbiased random approximations into an accurate witness whose Fourier support lies in this set. Granularity then forces the set to contain the entire Fourier support, including subsets never directly sampled. For comparison, we derive the tight classical sample complexity Θ(nk) by combining known sparse-recovery and lower-bound results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了精确学习具有至多k个非零傅里叶系数的布尔函数所需的均匀量子样本数量。研究提出了一种学习器，其样本复杂度为近最优的widetildeO(k)，且与输入长度n无关，仅使用单个样本的独立测量。这改进了之前O(k³/²łog² k)的上限。该方法的核心在于通过傅里叶样本子集的对称差形成候选集，并利用多线性多数多项式组合近似值。
authors: Zekun Ye

articles.title: GWPTools: An extensible Wolfram Language framework for time-dependent Gaussian wave packet dynamics
articles.title_zh: GWPTools：一个用于时间依赖高斯波包动力学的可扩展Wolfram语言框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gaussian wave packets provide an exact analytical foundation for modeling time-dependent quantum phenomena, effectively bridging the gap between classical trajectories and full quantum mechanics. We introduce GWPTools, a highly extensible Wolfram Language framework designed to compute exact time-dependent Gaussian wave packet dynamics using a unified symbolic-numeric architecture. Built upon a robust ``parameter bus'' and polymorphic dispatch, the software serves as an interactive pedagogical tool for exploring quantum theory and an exact algebraic engine for rigorously benchmarking numerical grid-based and trajectory methodologies. Version 1.0.0 focuses on exact time evolution in driven one-dimensional quadratic potentials. Native extensions into quantum hydrodynamics and phase space representations enable exact energy decompositions, analytical Bohmian trajectories, and symbolic derivations of quasi-probability distributions and information metrics. We demonstrate the framework's modular scalability by prototyping interference in superpositions, open-system decoherence, and coupled two-dimensional oscillators. Ultimately, these capabilities establish a versatile foundation for maximizing the reach of exact analytical modeling toward increasingly complex driven quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 高斯波包为建模时间依赖量子现象提供了精确的分析基础。本文介绍了GWPTools，一个高度可扩展的Wolfram语言框架，旨在利用统一的符号-数值架构计算精确的时间依赖高斯波包动力学。该软件可作为探索量子理论的交互式教学工具，也是严格基准测试数值网格和轨迹方法的精确代数引擎。GWPTools支持量子流体动力学和相空间表示的扩展，并展示了其在叠加干涉、开放系统退相干和耦合二维振荡器中的模块化可扩展性。
authors: Jeremy B. Maddox, Ismail Giliani, Carter M. Heck, Connor S. Mattingly

articles.title: QEDIA: Quantum Program Verification in Lean
articles.title_zh: QEDIA：在Lean中进行量子程序验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Practical quantum programs interleave quantum and classical computation: classical data shape the quantum operations that are performed, and measurement outcomes shape the classical computation that follows. Formal verification of such programs in a proof assistant requires mechanizing a program logic that handles this interplay consistently at every level, from the mathematics of quantum mechanics, through program syntax and semantics, to specifications and proof rules. Such mechanizations, along with the program proofs built on them, typically require substantial manual effort. We present QEDIA, a framework for verifying quantum programs with classical variables in Lean 4. At its foundation is an open library that formalizes the quantum Hoare logic QHL+ across all these levels and proves the logic sound for both partial and total correctness. We construct the library and the program proofs, under human supervision, using an LLM-based prover agent, whose general-purpose core we extend for quantum program verification. We illustrate QEDIA with verified programs including the quantum Fourier transform, phase estimation, repeat-until-success circuits, and Hamiltonian simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 实际量子程序交织量子和经典计算，其形式化验证需要一个能一致处理这种相互作用的程序逻辑。本文介绍了QEDIA，一个在Lean 4中验证带有经典变量的量子程序的框架。其核心是一个开放库，形式化了量子霍尔逻辑QHL+，并证明了其部分和完全正确性的可靠性。该库和程序证明是在人工监督下，使用一个基于LLM的证明代理构建的，该代理的通用核心已扩展用于量子程序验证。QEDIA通过验证量子傅里叶变换、相位估计等程序进行了说明。
authors: Yuanjie (Collin), Ren, Zhicheng Zhang, Junyi Liu, Jinzheng Li, Yidi Qi, Mingsheng Ying

articles.title: Representation Geometry and Inductive Biases in Quantum Classifiers across Classical Visual Benchmarks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has a theoretical advantage over classical algorithms for specific synthetic data that is computationally hard. However, it remains unclear whether such theoretical advantages play a meaningful role for realistic classical data, such as natural images. Quantum structural properties induced by unitary operations or entanglement introduce inductive biases that differ from those of classical models, potentially leading to distinct learning behavior on real-world data. In a fully quantum learning pipeline, classical real-world data are first encoded into quantum states via a quantum feature mapping, analogous to a classical feature extractor, and a quantum classifier then classifies the resulting states. Quantum feature mappings generate representations that are difficult to realize classically, while also inducing representation-level biases that do not necessarily match the structure of realistic data. To enable a fair comparison at the classifier level, we focus on the classifier and use classical feature extractors that already provide powerful representations for natural images. By controlling the data scale and supervision strength, we analyze how the unitary structure of quantum classifiers affects generalization, and show that their effectiveness depends strongly on the geometry of the input representations. These results indicate that quantum classifiers benefit from classical features that are aligned with quantum feature spaces. Our analysis shows that kernel alignment identifies representations compatible with quantum feature spaces, providing insights into translating classical models into quantum algorithms.
authors: Yu Yamaoka, Weng Ian Chan, Kosuke Mitarai

articles.title: PADO-Pauli: A GPU-Accelerated Implementation of Pauli Propagation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms utilize parameterized circuits many times during training, at new parameter values, over batches of data, and with gradients. Pauli propagation approximates the expectation values of such circuits classically by evolving the observable in the Heisenberg picture as a truncated sum of Pauli strings. We present PADO-Pauli, a GPU engine for Pauli propagation that compiles a circuit and its observables once into sparse matrices in which each rotation angle contributes only a cosine and a sine factor, so every later evaluation reuses the compiled program. It evaluates batches of parameters and data inputs embedded as rotation angles. By default its gradients come from a vector-Jacobian product registered with PyTorch's automatic differentiation, so they flow through the angles to any classical layer that produces them. PADO-Pauli also provides truncation by Pauli weight and coefficient size, and noise channels. Zero-filtering removes terms that do not contribute to an expectation value in the all-zero reference state and makes the batched forward pass about 1.5 times faster. Compared to cuPauliProp on an NVIDIA A100, PADO-Pauli evaluates up to 10 times faster on 4 to 12 qubits and uses up to 3.1 times less memory on 16 qubits. We check its accuracy against exact statevector simulation up to 28 qubits. These features make PADO-Pauli a practical toolkit for training variational quantum algorithms, including quantum machine learning models.
authors: Hyunwoo Kim, Youngseok Lee

articles.title: Boson Sampling Using Fock States from On-Demand Single Photon Source Arrays: Quantum Complexity & Impact of Dephasing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Boson sampling with array of on-demand single photons (discreet variable Fock states) as resource states provides distinct advantages in complexity scaling compared to single photon resource states mimicked by the states (continuous variable) generated in nonlinear photonics. Recent progress in realization of regular ordered array of mesa top single quantum dots (MTSQDs) enabling on-demand generation of many photon resource states with high single photon purity and indistinguishability [1,2] has opened the possibility of implementing chip-scale Boson sampling with single photons. An important question towards scale up of such circuits is how the dephasing and decay timescale of individual on-demand single photons affect the final probability distribution of the N-photon entangled state. In this work we report a framework that provides direct link between the physical sources of decoherence to the outcome of multiphoton correlation measurements. We explicitly incorporate the symmetrization of the N-photon states while accounting for the shape of the individual wave packets and dephasing. Using this framework, we show predictive estimates of the probability of generation of a 4-photon NOON state using an optical circuit initialized with 4 identical single photon wave packets, mimicking the emitted photons from MTSQD single photon sources reported in [2]. Specifically, we show how the probability of generating various 4-photon entangled states depend on the two-photon interference visibility which is determined by the pure dephasing timescale in relation to the radiative decay timescale. The results provide quantitative guidelines to measure 4 photon and higher number of entangled photon states generated in an optical circuit with on demand single photon sources and provide a link between physical processes such as temperature and the output state of the quantum optical circuits.
authors: Swarnabha Chattaraj, Anupam Madhukar

articles.title: Broadening the reflection band of atomic mirrors by engineering the emitter-waveguide coupling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate single-photon coherent transport through a finite waveguide quantum electrodynamics (QED) array with spatially modulated emitter-waveguide couplings. By combining exact scattering calculations with spectral factorization and a semiclassical WKB analysis, we identify how the coupling profile controls the reflection bandwidth and its finite-size dependence. A Gaussian transverse displacement produces an exponential-of-Gaussian decay-rate profile that broadens the high-reflectivity window and suppresses the boundary-induced Fabry-Perot oscillations compared with a uniform array. The transmission zeros remain exactly degenerate at the atomic resonance for arbitrary positive coupling profiles at non-Bragg spacings. In contrast, the collective poles reorganize under the spatial modulation, redistributing their radiative widths and preventing individual subradiant resonances from terminating the reflection window. We further derive an algebraic 1/N scaling law for the contraction of the bandwidth toward its bulk value. The bulk bandwidth is determined by the largest local decay rate, whereas the finite-size correction increases as the profile becomes sharper, leading to an optimal profile width. These results establish spatial coupling engineering as a practical tool for designing broadband atomic mirrors in atom-nanofiber and circuit-QED platforms.
authors: C. -Y. Lee, G. -D. Lin, H. H. Jen, K. -T. Lin

articles.title: A Tutorial on Quantum Amplitude Embedding with Data Re-Uploading
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amplitude embedding lets a variational quantum model read many classical features with few qubits, but the model output is then only a quadratic form in the normalized input. Data re-uploading, which encodes the input repeatedly between trainable blocks, can be used to enrich such a model. Because every additional upload of an amplitude embedding repeats a costly state preparation, the gain that an upload buys has to be known before the gates are spent. This tutorial thus addresses the problem of explaining what data re-uploading adds to an amplitude-embedded model and how large the gain is. We express sequential re-uploading and parallel re-uploading with two copies in one notation and show that each upload raises the reachable polynomial order by two. Under one trainable circuit family and one budget of trainable parameters, simulation results show that re-uploading raises the test coefficient of determination from 0.689 to between 0.883 and 0.975 on targets of order four and from 0.337 to between 0.642 and 0.783 on targets of order six, on all ten seeds. On a quadratic target and on handwritten digits, one upload remains the best choice, and every additional upload lowers the gate error that the classifier tolerates. These results help designers match the number of uploads to the polynomial order of the task at hand.
authors: Hyojun Ahn, Joongheon Kim

articles.title: Development and experimental implementation of noise characterisation techniques on a superconducting quantum processor
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noise characterisation not only enables error mitigation but also provides valuable information about the intrinsic performance of a quantum device, identifying dominant error contributions and bounding noise stability well beyond the aggregated calibration data. Deploying such methods on a specific hardware topology must combine efficiency and accuracy, assess noise stability, and validate the reconstructed noise model. Here we develop and implement these methods on a superconducting processor with square-lattice topology. First, we revise the cycle-benchmarking protocol and reduce the bias arising from unlearnable degrees of freedom via a regularised cost function. Second, we extend a previously developed tensor-network tomography method to match the device layout and show how its accuracy can be improved by repeated layer execution. Both methods allow approximate sublayer noise models to be extracted from parent ones. Using noise characterisation as a tool, we map the noise structure, track drift, and validate the adequacy of the learnt noise models against experimentally observed noisy estimations in benchmark physical and chemistry circuits. These results inform further improvements in the underlying technology and provide estimates of the size of noise-mitigated circuits that the device can support.
authors: Nelson M. M. Fernández, Francesco Grieco, Hetta Vappula, Stefano Mangini, Boris Sokolov, Elsi-Mari Borrelli, Matteo A. C. Rossi, Sergey N. Filippov, N. Walter Talarico

articles.title: Ergotropy of multipartite entangled states in the quantum atmosphere
articles.title_zh: 量子大气中多体纠缠态的功能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the ergotropy of tripartite Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) and W states in the quantum atmosphere of a Schwarzschild black hole, focusing on how the extractable work is redistributed under Hawking-induced thermalization. We find that the two classes of multipartite entanglement exhibit qualitatively different ergotropy structures. For GHZ states, the ergotropies associated with different accessible subsystems organize into two degenerate families, whereas for W states they obey a linear averaging relation with no counterpart in the GHZ case. Under symmetric gravitational thermal corrections, the two GHZ families remain separated by a constant energy gap that is independent of the radial position. We further show that the Hartle-Hawking constant DHH and the normalized radial distance r/rₕ play competing roles in the evolution of extractable work: increasing DHH suppresses its recovery toward the asymptotic Hawking limit, while increasing r/rₕ enhances the ergotropy accessible to the observers. These results show that the redistribution of extractable work in a black-hole environment is governed not only by gravitationally induced thermalization but also by the structure of the underlying multipartite entanglement, providing a thermodynamic signature that distinguishes GHZ- and W-type quantum correlations in curved spacetime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了史瓦西黑洞量子大气中三体GHZ态和W态的功能，重点分析了霍金辐射引起的量子热化如何重新分配可提取功。结果表明，这两种多体纠缠态展现出定性不同的功能结构。研究还发现，Hartle-Hawking常数和归一化径向距离在可提取功的演化中扮演着竞争角色，揭示了黑洞环境中可提取功的重新分配机制。
authors: Ruopu Sun, Xiaofen Huang

articles.title: Lossless Reductions and Hybrid Sampling for Phylogeny Using the Maximum Compatibility Criterion
articles.title_zh: 基于最大兼容性准则的系统发育无损约化与混合采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Maximum compatibility provides a criterion for phylogenetic reconstruction in which the objective is to retain a maximum set of mutually compatible characters. For binary characters, pairwise compatibility can be represented by a weighted graph whose vertices correspond to characters and whose edges connect compatible pairs. A leading algorithm by Cherry [BMC Bioinformatics, 18(1):127, 2017] uses this representation to identify maximum compatible character sets as maximum weight cliques. We formulate the problem as maximum weight independent set enumeration on the complement graph and use deterministic postprocessing to map sampled bit strings to maximal feasible solutions. To explore the prospects of quantum computational advantage, we further construct bespoke correction-in-the-loop Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm instances and find that traditional Lagrange multiplier choices may not be optimal for the enumeration problem on noisy devices. We also introduce lossless graph reductions with reconstruction rules that preserve the complete set of optimal solutions. Our results indicate that graph reduction and sampling can be effectively combined to address the enumeration bottleneck in maximum compatibility phylogeny, while retaining exact reconstruction when the residual optimum set is completely resolved. We enhance Cherry's approach to maximum compatibility by introducing graph reduction techniques and quantum sampling. Our classical benchmarks show a clear difference between finding one optimum and recovering the optimum set in practice. We demonstrate the utility of our methods on graphs constructed from SARS-CoV-2 sequences.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于最大兼容性准则的系统发育重建方法，旨在保留最大互兼容字符集。研究将该问题重新表述为补图上的最大权独立集枚举，并引入了无损图约化与重建规则。为探索量子计算优势，作者还构建了定制的量子近似优化算法实例，并发现传统拉格朗日乘子选择在噪声设备上可能并非最优。
authors: Orson Ye, James Bonfield, Joshua Cudby, Richard Durbin, Sergii Strelchuk

articles.title: Optimal Lower Bound on the Sample Complexity of Coherent Classical Shadows for Mixed States
articles.title_zh: 混合态相干经典影子的样本复杂度最优下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18031v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study coherent classical shadows protocols for an unknown d-dimensional quantum state of rank at most r, allowing an arbitrary joint measurement on all available copies. For observables with operator norm at most one and centered squared Frobenius norm at most F, we study the minumum number of copies T needed for the protocol to successed with propbability 1 - δ. We prove a lower bound on T, that depends both on δ and the number M of post-measurement observables. Denoting ell=maxłog(2M),łog(1/δ), we show that T=Ømegałeft(minłeft{fracsqrtrFellǎrepsilon,frac(Fell)²/³ǎrepsilon⁴/³i̊ght}+fracellǎrepsilon²i̊ght) under the mild assumption łog(2M)łesssim dminr,F. The lower bound nearly matches the known upper bound and matches the conjectural strengthening of the known upper bound. The proof is inspired by the framework of the proof of the lower bound for Boolean Hidden Matching. We develop a Gaussian-lift noise kernel that transfers forward and reverse Gaussian hypercontractivity to the Grassmannian, allowing us to bound the distinguishing advantage in an auxiliary game with a revealed query observable. We use Schur--Weyl structure and posterior moment bounds to control arbitrary coherent measurements on the source side.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了未知d维秩至多为r的量子态的相干经典影子协议的样本复杂度。研究确定了协议成功所需的最小副本数T，并给出了一个依赖于误差概率δ和测量后可观测值数量M的下界。该下界与已知上界几乎匹配，并与已知上界的推测性加强相符，为理解相干经典影子的效率提供了理论基础。
authors: Pavel Svetlichnyy

articles.title: Scalable long-distance quantum fan-out gates with reduced resource overhead
articles.title_zh: 具有降低资源开销的可扩展长距离量子扇出门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable long-distance quantum gates are essential for distributed quantum computation and scalable quantum networks. We propose an efficient scheme for implementing an n-qubit fan-out gate Cⁿ (also known as a controlled-NOT-ḑots-NOT gate) across spatially separated parties. Our protocol requires only a pre-shared n-qubit Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state, n local controlled-NOT (CNOT) gates, and feed-forward operations, thereby reducing both the CNOT and Hadamard gate counts by (n-2) when compared with the standard decomposition-based approach. We further develop two optical architectures to implement the heralded and post-selected n-photon fan-out gates, respectively. These schemes require fewer single photons resources and achieve higher success probabilities than their decomposition-based counterparts, representing significant improvements. The results indicate that our approach is experimentally feasible and pave the way toward practical long-distance quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种高效方案，用于在空间分离的各方之间实现n量子比特扇出门（Cⁿ门）。该协议仅需一个预共享的n量子比特GHZ态、n个局部CNOT门和前馈操作，与标准分解方法相比，显著减少了CNOT和Hadamard门的数量。研究还开发了两种光学架构来实现预示和后选择的n光子扇出门，这些方案所需单光子资源更少，成功概率更高，为实用的长距离量子计算铺平了道路。
authors: Wen-Qiang Liu, Hai-Rui Wei

articles.title: Local error correction prolongs time-crystalline memory
articles.title_zh: 局部纠错延长时间晶体记忆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete time crystals are non-equilibrium phases of matter with spatiotemporal order and a response that breaks the time-translation symmetry of a periodic external drive. Interactions, spatial disorder and correlated random driving can in theory stabilize this order. In experiments, however, coupling to the environment limits the time crystal lifetime. Here we use stochastic local bit-flip error correction to prolong the time-crystalline response of a driven, spatially disordered two-dimensional Ising model on a superconducting quantum processor, using a repetition code with distances three and five on a honeycomb lattice with up to 68 physical qubits. Even though ancilla qubits, midcircuit syndrome measurements and decoding increase the required quantum and classical resources, the stochastic drive increases the memory decay time by a factor of up to two. At late times we observe that recovery stabilizes spatial order across the lattice. The spin-configuration distributions explain this separation, as recovery suppresses disagreeing bonds while broadening occupies completely reversed states. Syndrome measurements without correction accelerate the memory decay, demonstrating the importance of conditional correction. Our results show that local bit-flip error correction can preserve time-crystalline memory over more drive cycles than the bare dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散时间晶体是一种具有时空序的非平衡物质相，其响应打破了周期性外部驱动的时间平移对称性。本研究利用随机局部比特翻转纠错，在超导量子处理器上延长了驱动的二维Ising模型的时间晶体响应。尽管增加了资源开销，但随机驱动将记忆衰减时间延长了高达两倍，并在后期观察到恢复稳定了整个晶格的空间序。
authors: Benedikt Fauseweh

articles.title: Distance Prediction for Quantum Codes
articles.title_zh: 量子码距离预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The distance of a quantum code is a fundamental metric that dictates its error-correction capability. While quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) families such as Bivariate Bicycle (BB) codes offer a promising pathway to low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computing, computing their distance is challenging. Current exact solvers and even search heuristics that provide a distance upper bound suffer from severe computational bottlenecks, restricting the discovery of optimal codes. In this paper, we construct a dataset of BB codes with corresponding distance upper bounds obtained through high-budget heuristic searches. We introduce BB-Net, an attention-based neural network architecture for predicting the distance of BB codes. It achieves 96.39% accuracy on the reference distances in the test set, compared with 94.86% for state-of-the-art heuristics with a budget of up to 10⁴ times more computational runtime. On a subset with certified exact distances, BB-Net achieves 98.94%. By relieving the distance-calculation bottleneck, BB-Net enables faster screening of large code spaces, particularly in ML-driven search pipelines, and thereby can accelerate the discovery of novel quantum error-correcting codes, an important capability for advancing scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/NadavSc/BBNet
articles.abstract_zh: 量子码的距离是衡量其纠错能力的关键指标，但计算量子低密度奇偶校验码（qLDPC）的距离极具挑战性。本文构建了一个BB码数据集，并引入了BB-Net，一种基于注意力机制的神经网络架构来预测BB码的距离。BB-Net在测试集上取得了96.39%的准确率，显著优于现有启发式算法，有效缓解了距离计算瓶颈，加速了最优量子码的发现。
authors: Nadav Schneider, Eliya Nachmani

articles.title: Spectrally enhanced gravitational redshift signals in photonic interferometry
articles.title_zh: 光子干涉测量中光谱增强的引力红移信号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum mechanics and general relativity are remarkably successful, yet their joint predictions remain beyond direct experimental reach. Photonic interferometers operating in a gravitational field offer a promising route to test this regime: gravitational redshift differentiates photon propagation between vertically separated arms, leading to a predicted phase shift and reduction in interference visibility. These effects are minute on laboratory scales, motivating existing proposals to consider large interferometer areas to accumulate them geometrically. Indeed, such schemes typically require kilometre-scale optical paths to produce appreciable interferometric signals. Here, we propose a strategy that replaces geometric accumulation with spectral enhancement by coupling the two interferometer arms to optical scatterers based on ultranarrow atomic transitions. These transitions serve as local spectral references: gravitational redshift changes the photon's detuning from each resonance, producing large differences in reflection amplitude and hence substantial visibility loss and interferometric phase shift already for centimetre-scale height differences. We quantify the experimental requirements and assess the feasibility of implementation with current or near-term technology. Our proposal thus opens a route to tabletop optical tests of the interplay between quantum mechanics and general relativity.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学和广义相对论的联合预测仍难以直接实验验证。本文提出一种策略，通过将光子干涉仪的两臂耦合到基于超窄原子跃迁的光学散射体，以光谱增强取代几何累积来探测引力红移信号。引力红移会改变光子与共振的失谐，从而在厘米级高度差下产生显著的反射振幅差异、可见度损失和干涉相移，为在实验室尺度上探测量子引力效应提供了新途径。
authors: Jerzy Paczos, Piotr T. Grochowski, Natalia Bruno, Emanuele Distante, Stephan Welte, Magdalena Zych

articles.title: Theory of Trotter Error with Variable-Weight Schedules
articles.title_zh: 变权重调度下Trotter误差理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trotterization is a widely used algorithm for simulating quantum evolutions and consists of approximating a target unitary through a local linear decomposition of its generator that is repeated over N steps. We introduce scheduled trotterization, a variable-weight modification in which the coefficients of the local linear decomposition are allowed to change from step to step. Using the geometry of the Lie group of unitary operators, we express the global endpoint error as a product of transported local defects, whose leading terms are obtained by two applications of the Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff formula, one inside each local step and one between different transported defects, separating the internal Trotter error from the external accumulation error. While we recover recent tighter bounds on the global approximation error when the weights are held fixed, the new framework allows us to propose a weight-varying schedule that significantly decreases the global error. For exact infinitesimal synthesis, we prove that this improves the usual fixed-weight O(N⁻¹) behavior to O(N⁻²), without changing the basic pulse skeleton. We also extend the framework to imperfect infinitesimal synthesis, as arises in quantum gate synthesis problems, where admissible coefficients may only approximate the desired local corrections. In this case, the error is controlled by a local covering parameter measuring the quality of the available coefficient set. Numerical experiments for random SU(2) targets further support the predicted theoretical improvements. The results suggest a novel perspective for the analysis of Trotter errors, which can be treated as schedulable quantities to be coherently canceled at the endpoint.
articles.abstract_zh: Trotter化是模拟量子演化的常用算法。本文引入了调度Trotter化，这是一种变权重修改，允许局部线性分解的系数在每一步中变化。通过酉算子李群的几何结构，研究将全局端点误差表示为传输局部缺陷的乘积。该新框架提出了一种变权重调度，可显著降低全局误差，将通常的O(N⁻¹)行为改进为O(N⁻²) 。
authors: Henrique Ennes (COATI, DATASHAPE, UniCA)

articles.title: Methods for Automated Equivalence Checking of Quantum Error-Correction Codes
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错码自动等价性检查方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error-correction code and circuit construction is an active field of research, motivating automated methods for identifying equivalent designs. We develop and evaluate automated strategies for deciding whether two descriptions of quantum error-correction codes are equivalent under specified transformations. We formalize permutation equivalence for stabilizer and CSS codes and local-Clifford equivalence for stabilizer codes within a unified framework that separates physical from representation freedom. We develop three decision strategies (group-action search, isomorphism-based methods, and constraint solving), together with invariants and signatures for preprocessing. The empirical evaluation shows that no paradigm dominates across equivalence notions, code families, and parameter ranges. We therefore combine their complementary strengths in input-dependent hybrid checkers following a staged Refute-Refine-Decide architecture. Mean hybrid runtimes remain below 10 s for most evaluated structured-code cases with n łeq 37; for inequivalent code instances with n=144, they are about 310 s for permutation and 16 s for local-Clifford equivalence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发并评估了自动策略，用于判断两种量子纠错码描述在特定变换下是否等价。研究在一个统一框架内形式化了稳定子码和CSS码的置换等价性以及稳定子码的局部Clifford等价性。通过结合群作用搜索、基于同构的方法和约束求解三种决策策略，以及不变量和签名进行预处理，实现了高效的混合检查器，为量子纠错码的设计与验证提供了有力工具。
authors: Maxie Bichmann, Ludwig Schmid, Robert Wille

articles.title: PPVM: A Circuit Simulation Framework for Digital Twins of Quantum Processors
articles.title_zh: PPVM：量子处理器数字孪生电路仿真框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computers are approaching the early fault-tolerant regime. Verifying the next generation of quantum hardware requires joint emulation of the quantum processor, hardware noise, and classical control and decoding logic. We introduce the Programmable Pauli Virtual Machine (PPVM), an open-source framework for digital twins of quantum processors. PPVM unifies Pauli propagation and generalized tableau simulation under a common abstraction within a single virtual machine. Its bytecode supports arbitrary classical control flow, with measurement-conditioned feed-forward available in the generalized tableau backend. For neutral-atom hardware, we derive independent and correlated atom-loss channels and integrate them into both backends. We demonstrate loss-aware magic state distillation on over a thousand physical qubits and integration with classical decoding through Bloqade QEC Studio.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子计算机接近早期容错阶段，验证新一代量子硬件需要联合仿真量子处理器、硬件噪声和经典控制解码逻辑。本文介绍了可编程泡利虚拟机（PPVM），一个用于量子处理器数字孪生的开源框架。PPVM在一个虚拟机中统一了泡利传播和广义tableau仿真，其字节码支持任意经典控制流。该框架已成功应用于千比特级物理量子比特的失真感知魔术态蒸馏，并与经典解码集成。
authors: Xiu-Zhe Luo, David Plankensteiner, Kai-Hsin Wu, Rob Patterson, Alexander Schuckert, Oriol Rubies-Bigorda, Refaat Ismail, Jonhas Colina, Neelay Fruitwala, Danylo Lykov, Tyson Jones, Stefan Krastanov, Rafael Haenel, Stefan Ostermann, Sheng-Tao Wang

articles.title: Resource-based reliability of quantum-coherent devices
articles.title_zh: 量子相干设备的基于资源的可靠性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum devices can lose the resource needed for a specified function without entering a fixed failure subspace. We propose a resource-based reliability framework for this situation, quantifying the remaining task-relevant resource relative to a stated ideal capacity. The resource measure is selected through its operational connection to the task and the allowed operations. We develop this approach for a trusted quantum random-number generator and a calibrated two-port interferometer. Relative-entropy coherence determines the optimal asymptotic yield of standard coherent qubits under incoherent operations for the former, while logarithmic l₁ coherence quantifies the fringe resource of the latter and determines its calibrated correct-port probability. An exactly solvable multi-spin spin-boson model illustrates how environmental records affect these resources at the same isolated-spin dephasing strength. Collective noise preserves coherence within magnetization sectors for product inputs, but enhances the decay of Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger branch coherence. Finite-record simulations connect the resource definitions to measurement counts and show that increasing the sample size reduces statistical fluctuations without eliminating bias from an incorrect many-spin noise model. The resulting framework provides a task-specific route to reliability assessment when a fixed failure projector is insufficient, while keeping retained resource capacity distinct from a classical survival probability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于资源的可靠性框架，用于量化量子设备在不进入固定故障子空间的情况下，针对特定功能所剩余的任务相关资源。该框架通过其与任务和允许操作的运算连接来选择资源度量。研究将此方法应用于可信量子随机数发生器和校准的双端口干涉仪，并利用多自旋自旋-玻色子模型说明了环境记录如何影响这些资源。
authors: Bowen Sun, D. L. Zhou

articles.title: Towards an autonomous optomechanical Maxwell Demon engine
articles.title_zh: 迈向自主光机麦克斯韦妖引擎
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18237v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fully autonomous model of a mechanical Maxwell demon engine that converts heat absorbed by a qubit into population inversion in an attached quantum battery. A damped mechanical oscillator acts as a pointer that incorporates the essential demon function of information acquisition about the qubit state and subsequent feedback into the system dynamics, replacing external measurements and control operations. This is achieved by means of a Holstein-type Hamiltonian, which makes the pointer's equilibrium position depend on the qubit state and thereby induces a state-dependent resonance shift. The mechanism enables a selective energy transfer to an attached spin system that acts as the quantum battery. We derive both local and global Lindblad master equations for the coupled system and identify the parameter regimes in which the engine operates efficiently. The figure of merit is the resulting steady-state population inversion of the battery, quantified in terms of ergotropy. Based on these results, we discuss the necessary conditions for practical implementations of the demon engine on realistic experimental platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个完全自主的机械麦克斯韦妖引擎模型，该引擎将量子比特吸收的热量转化为连接的量子电池中的布居数反转。一个阻尼机械振荡器充当指针，实现对量子比特状态的信息获取和反馈功能，取代了外部测量和控制操作。研究导出了耦合系统的局部和全局Lindblad主方程，并确定了引擎高效运行的参数范围，为在实际实验平台上实现麦克斯韦妖引擎提供了理论基础。
authors: Sander Stammbach, Giulio Gasbarri, Stefan Nimmrichter

articles.title: A complete quantum process model for physically realistic photo-detection in the joint photon-number and spectral degrees of freedom
articles.title_zh: 联合光子数和光谱自由度中物理真实光电探测的完整量子过程模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photo-detection is a fundamental component of experimental photonics, yet theoretical models often treat detectors solely in the photon-number basis, neglecting other relevant degrees of freedom such as spectral characteristics. We present a complete quantum process model for physically realistic photodetection that incorporates both photon-number effects and frequency-dependent detector response, described through explicitly derived Kraus operators in the operator-sum representation. This formalism accommodates realistic inefficiencies, models detection within finite spectral windows, and can be directly substituted for idealized models in quantum optical analyses. The model leads to identifying the suitable detection window of the detectors relative to the spectral distribution of incident photons and conversely, in order to maximize the observability of quantum effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有的光电探测理论模型常忽略光谱特性等自由度。本文提出了一个完整的量子过程模型，通过显式推导的Kraus算符，将光子数效应和频率依赖的探测器响应结合起来。该模型考虑了实际效率和有限光谱窗口内的探测，可替代理想化模型用于量子光学分析，并有助于优化探测窗口以最大化量子效应的可观测性。
authors: Sadia Rafi, Aeysha Khalique

articles.title: Beyond Gaussian Entanglement: Practical Criteria for Polynomially Excited Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 超越高斯纠缠：多项式激发量子态的实用判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polynomial excitations consisting of creation and annihilation operators are studied. Subsystem entanglement is proven produced and preserved by such manipulations. NPT entanglement already present between any two subsystems of a general pure or mixed multipartite Gaussian state is preserved under all polynomial excitations. Nevertheless, these excitations can create NPT entanglement between initially separable subsystems, implying that the number of NPT entangled pairs cannot decrease. Polynomial excitations of a wide class of initially separable pure states are considered. For these states, the method reduces the infinite-dimensional positivity problem to a finite-dimensional one: after partial transposition, NPT entanglement is equivalent to a corresponding bilinear representation matrix not being positive semi-definite. Furthermore, using symplectic diagonalization and spectral decomposition, an explicit transformation is constructed between the Fock-space and position representations. It is applied to quadratic excitations of a three-mode mixed Gaussian state. The behavior of the NPT entanglement is tracked between subsystems as a function of a parameter κ, which tunes the non-locality of the excitation, and quantum negativity is evaluated. Under a chosen quadratic Hamiltonian, the resulting unitary time evolution maintains NPT entanglement for long intervals, interrupted only by short periods of PPT states. Finally, a closed analytical expression is derived for the covariance matrix of a general quadratic operator for an arbitrary number of degrees of freedom in phase space. Our framework directly connects mathematical foundations, theoretical modeling, and experimentally feasible implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由产生和湮灭算符组成的多项式激发，证明了这种操作能产生并保持子系统纠缠。对于任意高斯态，多项式激发能保持已有的NPT纠缠，甚至能在初始可分离的子系统间创建NPT纠缠。研究还构建了Fock空间和位置表示之间的显式变换，并应用于三模混合高斯态的二次激发。
authors: Gábor Homa, Richárd Balka, Nikolett Német, András Bodor, Tamás Kiss, András Csordás

articles.title: Unequal Coherent Ergotropy at Equal Interferometric Visibility and Energy in Quantum-Controlled Interferometers
articles.title_zh: 量子控制干涉仪中相等干涉可见度和能量下的不相等相干功能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18474v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ergotropy, or unitarily extractable work, of a quantum system naturally splits into incoherent and coherent contributions, respectively set by population inversion and coherences in the energy eigenbasis. We show that this split makes the coherent ergotropy of a Mach--Zehnder qubit sensitive to path predictability that the output interference fringes do not reveal. We send the path qubit, prepared as a thermal quantum battery, through two quantum-controlled interferometers built from the same elements, a fixed beam splitter and a beam splitter coherently controlled to be present or absent, differing only in the order in which these two act. The two arrangements share identical visibility, stored energy, and incoherent ergotropy at every point in the parameter space. Yet, for work extracted from the output battery alone, placing the controlled beam splitter first never yields less coherent ergotropy, and at fixed visibility and interferometric phase the difference is governed by the path predictability that this ordering creates. The same expression reappears as a purity deficit on the beam-splitter controller, so the work advantage comes with a Landauer bound on the cost of locally resetting the controller that is never larger at the same temperature. We further examine the effects of decoherence on the battery and consider a relativistic realization in which a Wigner rotation correlates the particle's spin with its path. Tracing out the spin decoheres the battery and allows the two arrangements to exhibit different coherent ergotropies even in regimes where their non-relativistic counterparts coincide. These results show that interference visibility is not a complete measure of the coherence available as work.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子系统的功能（可酉提取的功）分为非相干和相干两部分。本文发现，马赫-曾德尔量子比特的相干功能对路径可预测性敏感，而输出干涉条纹无法揭示这一点。通过比较两种不同顺序的量子控制干涉仪，尽管它们在参数空间中具有相同的可见度、存储能量和非相干功能，但将受控分束器置于首位时，提取的相干功能从不减少。
authors: Tonipe Anuradha, André H. A. Malavazi, Borhan Ahmadi, Lucas Pollyceno, Pedro R. Dieguez

articles.title: Experimental Realization of a C-Shunt Flux-Qubit Coupler for Controlled-Z Gates between Transmons
articles.title_zh: 用于Transmon之间受控-Z门的C并联通量量子比特耦合器的实验实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast entangling gates and low-interaction idling require distinct operating conditions in superconducting quantum processors. We experimentally realize a transmon-C-shunt-transmon (TCT) device in which a flux-tunable, three-junction capacitively shunted flux-qubit coupler connects two transmon data qubits. The C-shunt coupler provides a flux-tunable, positively anharmonic spectrum for tailoring the interactions between the data qubits. Conditional Ramsey and swap measurements identify an idle region with near-zero residual ZZ interaction strength and suppressed transverse exchange. At this bias, simultaneous single-qubit interleaved randomized benchmarking yields X-gate fldelities above 99.7%, consistent with individual operation. A 45 ns nonadiabatic controlled-Z (CZ) gate achieves an interleaved randomized benchmarking fldelity estimate of 99.23(15)%. Numerical simulations identify coupler energy relaxation as an important limitation on CZ-gate fldelity and indicate that extending the coupler lifetime can improve gate performance. These results demonstrate the experimental feasibility of C-shunt flux-qubit couplers for combining low-interaction idling with fast entangling operations between transmon qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子处理器中的快速纠缠门和低交互空闲需要不同的操作条件。本文实验实现了一种Transmon-C并联-Transmon (TCT) 器件，其中一个通量可调、三结电容并联的通量量子比特耦合器连接两个Transmon数据量子比特。实验结果表明，在空闲区域实现了接近零的残余ZZ相互作用强度和抑制的横向交换，单量子比特X门保真度超过99.7%。一个45纳秒的非绝热受控-Z (CZ) 门实现了99.23(15)%的保真度，数值模拟表明耦合器能量弛豫是CZ门保真度的主要限制。
authors: Weiping Yuan, Silu Zhao, Li Li, Chenglin Deng, Zhenghe Liu, Yu Liu, Tianming Li, Mingchuan Wang, Bingjie Chen, Guihan Liang, Jiacheng Song, Jinming Guo, Shuaili Wang, Mingxuan Zhou, Xiaohui Song, Kai Xu, Heng Fan, Zhongcheng Xiang, Dongning Zheng

articles.title: Lifting: Quantum State Discrimination Framework for Mid-Circuit Measurements
articles.title_zh: Lifting：用于电路中测量（MCM）的量子态判别框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computing promises new capabilities beyond classical computation. Mid-circuit measurements (MCMs) enable error correction and outcome-dependent control, but their reliability is limited by noise on superconducting hardware. These operations depend on accurate quantum state discrimination (QSD), which assigns measured signals to state labels. Neural network-based (NN-based) QSD improves this assignment, yet its error remains bounded below by the Bayes risk of the available readout distributions. A complementary challenge is state deterioration as successive measurements accumulate and circuit execution advances, making static calibration less representative of the workload. We present Lifting, a QSD framework that addresses both challenges through repetition encoding, neural decoding, and in situ calibration. Encoding supplies joint in-phase and quadrature (I-Q) readout signals from the target and auxiliary qubits, while contextual calibration trains the decoder for the conditions encountered during execution. Our theoretical analysis shows that retaining additional channels from a fixed joint distribution cannot increase Bayes risk and establishes sufficient conditions for contraction of an overlap-based upper bound.
