Experiments across three IBM processors evaluate the framework on repeated stabilizer measurement, parity-check, and teleportation workloads.
articles.abstract_zh: 电路中测量（MCMs）在量子计算中至关重要，但其可靠性受噪声限制，依赖于精确的量子态判别（QSD）。传统的QSD方法受限于贝叶斯风险，且静态校准难以应对连续测量导致的态退化。本文提出了Lifting框架，通过重复编码、神经网络解码和现场校准来解决这些挑战。理论分析表明，从固定联合分布中保留额外通道不会增加贝叶斯风险。
authors: Chi Zhang, Neel Vora, Yilun Xu, Gang Huang, Fan Chen, Lei Jiang

articles.title: Steering the Fidelity in State Preparation on Noisy Bosonic Systems with Risk-Seeking Optimization
articles.title_zh: 在噪声玻色子系统中通过风险偏好优化引导态制备的保真度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In order to execute quantum algorithms on bosonic quantum computers, it is necessary to encode their inputs into a desired target quantum state, with a process called state preparation. In real settings, state preparation methods operate in stochastic scenarios, where the prepared state is represented as a mixed state, that is a probabilistic ensemble of pure states. Therefore, existing state preparation methods optimize a variational ansatz by averaging over all possible sequences of photon loss events contained in the prepared ensemble, yielding an output state which approximates the desired target with a certain average fidelity. Such an approach, however, does not take into account directly the distribution of fidelities across states in the ensemble. In this work, we aim to maximize the fidelity of only a subset of pure states sampled from the prepared ensemble, at the cost of reducing the average fidelity overall. This trade-off is relevant when the goal is to obtain high-fidelity states with a certain probability, rather than maximizing the average fidelity of the prepared ensemble. We borrow and adapt objective functions from risk-sensitive optimization, a framework that optimizes specific characteristics of a distribution rather than only its expectation, and that has been successfully applied in Reinforcement Learning. In the considered experimental settings, our results show that the infidelities of some pure states in the prepared ensemble can be reduced by up to four orders of magnitude when using risk-seeking objectives, compared to those achieved using the standard optimization of the average fidelity. Furthermore, we show that it is possible to control the trade-off between the probability of obtaining high-fidelity states and the lowest infidelity threshold reached, providing the flexibility to select the operating point that best suits a certain application.
articles.abstract_zh: 在玻色子量子计算机上执行算法需要将输入编码为目标量子态，即态制备。现有方法通过平均所有可能的失光事件来优化变分拟设，以最大化平均保真度。本文旨在通过风险偏好优化，牺牲整体平均保真度，来最大化系综中特定纯态子集的保真度。这种权衡在追求以一定概率获得高保真度态而非最大化平均保真度时具有重要意义。
authors: Riccardo Piantoni, Riccardo Pellini, Maurizio Ferrari Dacrema, Paolo Cremonesi

articles.title: On the Increase of Boltzmann Entropy in Closed Macroscopic Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 封闭宏观量子系统中玻尔兹曼熵的增加
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a closed macroscopic quantum system in a pure state ψ evolving unitarily with Hamiltonian H in a finite-dimensional Hilbert space mathscrH. Following von Neumann, we assume a decomposition of mathscrH into mutually orthogonal subspaces mathscrHν, where each ν represents a macro state, and mathscrH_ν contains the pure states compatible with ν. We define the quantum Boltzmann entropy for a macro state ν as S_qB(ν) = kB łog dim mathscrHν, where k_B is the Boltzmann constant. Goldstein et al. [http://arxiv.org/abs/1903.11870] have suggested, as a version of the second law of thermodynamics, that S_qB predominantly increases with time for realistic macroscopic systems. Here, we discuss precise versions of this statement and confirm them for several simple models of H and mathscrH_ν.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在有限维希尔伯特空间中，处于纯态并酉演化的封闭宏观量子系统。遵循冯·诺依曼的观点，将希尔伯特空间分解为代表宏观态的正交子空间，并定义了量子玻尔兹曼熵。研究讨论了热力学第二定律的一个版本，即对于实际宏观系统，量子玻尔兹曼熵S_qB随时间主要增加，并通过几个简单的哈密顿量和宏观态模型证实了这些陈述。
authors: Cedric Igelspacher, Roderich Tumulka

articles.title: T-efficient unitary synthesis via block-sparse Hamiltonian simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过块稀疏哈密顿量模拟实现T门高效的酉变换合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct Clifford+T circuits implementing arbitrary n-qubit unitaries with worst-case T-count widetildeO(N⁸/⁷) at constant operator-norm error, where N=2ⁿ, improving the previous exponent 5/4. The construction uses widetildeO(N⁶/⁷) clean ancillas. The main idea is to reduce the data addressed by each query to the block-encoding circuit for a sparse piece while controlling the additional simulation work needed to combine the pieces. We simulate a Hermitian logarithm of the target by flattening its traceless part with a two-layer random similarity transformation, randomly partitioning the transformed generator into block-sparse Hermitian pieces, and combining their evolutions using qDRIFT. For a target operator-norm error ϵin(0,1/2), let L=łog₂₍N/ϵ), the qubit count plus the requested bits of accuracy. By successively correcting the approximation error, we obtain a circuit using widetildeO(N⁸/⁷L³/⁷+NL) T gates and widetildeO(N) clean ancillas whenever Lłe N. We also prove that, at constant precision, the exponent 8/7 is optimal within a sequential block-SELECT model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了Clifford+T电路，以最坏情况T门计数为widetildeO(N⁸/⁷)实现任意n量子比特酉变换，将先前指数5/4提升至8/7，并使用widetildeO(N⁶/⁷)个辅助量子比特。核心思想是通过随机相似变换平坦化目标酉变换的无迹部分，将其生成器随机划分为块稀疏的厄米分量，并使用qDRIFT组合它们的演化。研究还证明了在恒定精度下，指数8/7在顺序块-SELECT模型中是最佳的。
authors: Diyi Liu, Shuchen Zhu, Wibe Albert de Jong, Di Fang, David Williams-Young, Chao Yang

articles.title: Explicitly correlated ground states with a feedback-free variational hybrid algorithm
articles.title_zh: 基于无反馈变分混合算法的显式关联基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Explicitly correlated methods, which represent dominant short-range correlations by a diagonal Jastrow-type correlator, are designed to accurately describe systems of strongly correlated electrons, such as the fully periodic 2D Fermi--Hubbard model. However, as the reference state is compact in momentum space whereas the correlator acts naturally in real space, there is a fundamental mismatch of bases that classical algorithms resolve only by restricting the reference or the correlator. Here we propose a hybrid algorithm in which a quantum processor prepares a low-entanglement momentum-space matrix product state (MPS), precomputed classically by the transcorrelated method at the cost of a nonvariational energy, rotates it to real space, and measures in bases fixed by the Hamiltonian. Because the measurement bases are independent of the correlator, the correlator can be variationally optimized entirely in classical post-processing with no quantum-classical feedback loop. We demonstrate our algorithm on 32 qubits of Quantinuum's H2-2 with a bond-dimension-4 MPS for the half-filled 4 × 4 lattice and achieve a relative ground-state energy error of 16 ± 4% after postselection, reduced to 3.5 ± 0.5% by calibration using low-order moments from the MPS. Compared with other feedback-free hybrid algorithms, even under generous assumptions, our method requires fewer samples than quantum-selected configuration interaction and fewer two-qubit gates than quantum Krylov methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 显式关联方法旨在精确描述强关联电子系统，但经典算法在基矢匹配上存在限制。本文提出一种混合算法，量子处理器制备低纠缠动量空间矩阵乘积态（MPS），并将其旋转到实空间进行测量。由于测量基矢与关联器无关，关联器可在经典后处理中进行变分优化，无需量子-经典反馈循环。该算法在Quantinuum H2-2的32个量子比特上进行了演示，并实现了相对基态能量的优化。
authors: Benjamin Corbett, Akimasa Miyake

articles.title: PULSUS: Direct Frequency-Domain Multidimensional Spectroscopy Beyond the Impulsive Rotating-Wave Approximation
articles.title_zh: PULSUS：超越瞬时旋转波近似的直接频域多维光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce PULSUS, a direct frequency-domain framework for multidimensional spectroscopy of open quantum systems beyond the impulsive rotating-wave approximation. Coherence-frequency intervals are represented through Liouvillian resolvents, while finite Gaussian pulses are incorporated through operator-valued functions of the field-free Liouvillian. This enables direct evaluation on Cartesian grids or arbitrary spectral coordinates while retaining molecular evolution during the pulse envelopes and, when required, the complete light--matter interaction. The implementation is validated against analytical and independent time-domain benchmarks and supports targeted spectral sampling that reduces the number of evaluated coordinates when the response is spectrally localized. A controlled hierarchy of finite-pulse, rotating-wave, short-pulse, and impulsive models separates the errors introduced by each approximation. For a coupled electronic dimer, the total impulsive-RWA error is nonmonotonic in pulse duration: an intermediate regime provides the highest accuracy, whereas ultrashort pulses expose coupling-enabled beyond-RWA pathways and longer pulses develop substantial finite-pulse corrections. These results show that the impulsive and rotating-wave approximations cannot be assumed to improve simultaneously and should be tested when quantitatively interpreting multidimensional spectra. PULSUS provides a direct frequency-domain framework for carrying out that comparison.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了PULSUS，一个用于开放量子系统多维光谱学的直接频域框架，超越了瞬时旋转波近似。该框架通过Liouvillian预解式表示相干频率区间，并通过无场Liouvillian的算符值函数纳入有限高斯脉冲。这使得在笛卡尔网格或任意光谱坐标上进行直接评估成为可能，同时保留了脉冲包络期间的分子演化和完整的光-物质相互作用。研究还发现，对于耦合电子二聚体，总的瞬时RWA误差在脉冲持续时间上是非单调的。
authors: Alfonso Castillo-Gonzolez, Eric R. Bittnre

articles.title: Quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing with machine-learning estimation
articles.title_zh: 结合机器学习估计的量子增强机械传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Massive mechanical oscillators couple directly to forces, accelerations and gravity, making them attractive probes of new physics and of quantum mechanics at macroscopic scales. Pushing sensitivities beyond the standard quantum limit for signals of unknown phase requires non-Gaussian quantum states, whose metrological advantage has so far been confined to lighter systems such as trapped ions. Here we operate a microgram-scale acoustic mode of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator as a phase-insensitive quantum-enhanced sensor. A transmon qubit prepares the mode in Fock states of up to seven phonons by optimal control, and resolves its phonon-number distribution after interaction with a weak resonant signal. Bayesian analysis yields a Fisher information five times the vacuum value, a 7.0 dB gain in signal-amplitude sensitivity over any classical probe state, irrespective of its energy, currently limited by state preparation infidelities. We then train a neural network on the measured sensor response to perform Bayesian estimation without any analytical model of the system, showing the same sensitivity gain with half the systematic bias. Our results establish acoustic resonators prepared in non-Gaussian states as quantum-enhanced probes for high-frequency gravitational waves, dark matter and wave-function collapse.
articles.abstract_zh: 宏观机械振子是探测新物理和宏观尺度量子力学的理想探针。本文将高泛音体声波谐振器的微克级声学模式作为相位不敏感的量子增强传感器。通过最优控制，Transmon量子比特将该模式制备成最多七个声子的Fock态，并在与弱共振信号相互作用后解析其声子数分布。贝叶斯分析显示，费雪信息量是真空值的五倍，信号幅度灵敏度比任何经典探测态提高了7.0 dB。此外，研究还训练了一个神经网络，在没有系统分析模型的情况下进行贝叶斯估计，并获得了相同的灵敏度增益。
authors: Finn Müßigbrodt, Andraž Omahen, Q. Rumman Rahman, Giulio Corazza, Yiwen Chu, Matteo Fadel

articles.title: Relative-Entropy Geometry and Convergence in Nonconvex Wiretap Optimization
articles.title_zh: 非凸窃听优化中的相对熵几何与收敛性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop and analyze an entropic descent method for a nonconvex optimization problem on probability simplices arising in classical and quantum secure communication. The optimization variables describe a randomized encoder, allowing its input distribution and stochastic preprocessing to be optimized jointly. An exact relative-entropy identity yields a channel-independent majorization bound and an explicit mirror-descent iteration with a fixed unit step size. We establish quantitative descent, convergence of objective values, and stationarity of accumulation points on their support faces for arbitrary finite classical channels, without assuming degradedness or less noisiness. For strictly positive transition matrices, a square-root parametrization and a Kurdyka--Ł{}ojasiewicz argument establish finite length of the transformed trajectory and convergence of the entire sequence, including limits on the simplex boundary. For less-noisy channels, a restricted convex formulation admits global convergence with an explicit (O(1/t)) objective-error bound. We extend the relative-entropy construction to noncommuting quantum outputs and derive monotone alternating updates for covariant encoders, including correlated preprocessing over a fixed block. Numerical experiments compare the method with analytic benchmarks and constrained optimization, reveal multiple attracting values, and demonstrate strict improvements from stochastic preprocessing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对经典和量子安全通信中概率单纯形上的非凸优化问题，开发并分析了一种熵下降方法。该方法通过相对熵恒等式得到一个信道无关的优越界和显式镜像下降迭代。研究证明了对于任意有限经典信道，目标值的定量下降、收敛性以及累积点在其支撑面上的平稳性。该工作还将相对熵构造扩展到非对易量子输出。
authors: Farzin Salek, Masahito Hayashi

articles.title: On the coincidence of discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation
articles.title_zh: 纠缠形成度离散与连续定义的一致性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is proved that every Borel ensemble of pure states on a separable bipartite Hilbert space with finite average entanglement admits a countable ensemble with the same barycenter and arbitrarily small additional average entanglement. Consequently, the discrete and continuous versions of the Entanglement of Formation coincide on the whole space of states of infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system (with infinite values allowed). The main idea of the proof (realized with the AI-assistance) is the identification of a Borel ensemble of pure bipartite states with a Borel probability measure on the unit sphere of the space of Hilbert--Schmidt operators followed by dividing the support of this measure into appropriate cells and replacing each cell by its conditional barycenter. The resulting countable ensemble is obtained by a recursive construction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在具有有限平均纠缠的可分双分量希尔伯特空间中，每个纯态的Borel系综都存在一个具有相同重心和任意小额外平均纠缠的可数系综。因此，纠缠形成度的离散和连续版本在无限维双分量量子系统的整个态空间上是重合的。该证明的核心思想是将纯双分量态的Borel系综与希尔伯特-施密特算子空间单位球上的Borel概率测度进行识别，并通过递归构造得到可数系综。
authors: Haobo Ma, Maksim E. Shirokov, Wenlin Zhang

articles.title: Non-Monotonic Exciton Transport Efficiency in Multi-layer Ring-shaped Quantum Networks inspired by Photosystem I
articles.title_zh: 光系统I启发的环形多层量子网络中激子传输效率的非单调性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13949v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photosystem I (PSI) is one of the most efficient natural photosynthetic complexes and serves as a structural prototype for understanding excitation energy transfer (EET) and designing artificial light-harvesting systems. Here, we construct a multilayer elliptical-conical quantum network inspired by PSI to investigate how antenna architecture affects EET. Excitation dynamics are simulated using the quantum jump approach combined with coherent modified Redfield theory (QJA-CMRT). The transfer efficiency exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic dependence on pigment density, reaching a maximum of 0.86 at x=6 in the five-layer network. The optimal configuration contains 91 pigments, close to the number of core antenna pigments in natural PSI. Our combined density-of-states and kinetic analyses reveal that this nonmonotonic dependence originates from a trade-off: at low pigment densities, enhanced band overlap promotes energy transfer, whereas at high densities, excessive exciton delocalization compromises funnel directionality and reduces efficiency; the optimal configuration is consequently achieved at x=6. These findings provide insights into PSI antenna organization and offer guidelines for designing efficient artificial light-harvesting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个受光系统I启发的椭圆锥形多层量子网络，以研究天线结构如何影响激发能量转移（EET）。模拟结果显示，传输效率对色素密度表现出显著的非单调依赖性，在五层网络中于x=6时达到0.86的最大值。这种非单调性源于低色素密度下能带重叠增强促进能量转移，而高密度下激子过度离域损害漏斗方向性之间的权衡。这些发现为设计高效人工捕光系统提供了见解。
authors: Yi Li, Rui Li, Kai-Ya Zhang, Ming-Zi Jin, Tao Liu, Qing Ai

articles.title: Real-Space Interference from Quantum Metric
articles.title_zh: 量子度规引起的实空间干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-space interference of wave packets is governed by their central momentum separation and momentum width, which set the oscillation wavelength and spatial envelope, respectively. Here, we show that in crystalline systems, quantum metric distribution in an isolated band can similarly give rise to real-space interference through the evanescent tails of a localized bound state. The location and width of a quantum metric hot spot in the momentum space set a complex wavevector as one evanescent plane wave component of a bound state. Consequently, with multiple quantum metric hot spots, the density distribution of a bound state or the total density of two spatially overlapped bound states exhibits an interference pattern, where the oscillation period and long-range decay length are determined by the momentum-space separation of the hot spots and the width of the narrowest hot spots, respectively. This quantum-geometric interference is particularly pronounced in (nearly) flat bands, where competing scales from band dispersion are suppressed. Furthermore, we demonstrate that using a Josephson STM the real-space interference can be experimentally observed through the tip-position dependence of the Josephson critical current. Our results reveal a direct correspondence between momentum-space quantum geometry and real-space interference, showing how bound-state profiles encode the momentum-resolved quantum metric.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了晶体系统中，孤立能带中的量子度规分布如何通过局域束缚态的倏逝尾部产生实空间干涉。动量空间中量子度规热点的位置和宽度决定了束缚态的一个倏逝平面波分量的复波矢。多个量子度规热点会导致束缚态密度分布或两个空间重叠束缚态的总密度呈现干涉图样，其振荡周期和长程衰减长度由热点的动量空间分离和最窄热点的宽度决定。这种量子几何干涉在（近）平坦能带中尤为显著。
authors: Bo-Qing Wu, Xing-Lei Ma, Jin-Xin Hu, Jinchao Zhao, K. T. Law

articles.title: Grover Search for a Threshold-Fraction Variant of the Travelling Salesman Problem: A Circuit-Level Construction
articles.title_zh: 旅行商问题阈值分数变体的Grover搜索：电路级构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14062v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) is a classic combinatorial optimisation problem which is NP-hard in optimisation form and NP-complete as a decision problem. The standard question asks for the shortest tour that visits every city exactly once and returns to the origin. This paper studies a threshold-fraction variant, which we call the robust TSP, formulated as a promise problem: given a distance threshold K and a promised fraction p, decide whether at least a fraction p of all tours have total length at most K, or whether no such tour exists. We show that Grover's quantum search algorithm decides this problem using O(1/sqrtp) oracle queries, independent of the number of cities N, with each query implemented by a quantum circuit of polynomial size in N. For any fixed robustness level p, the total runtime is therefore polynomial in N. Measured in oracle queries, the quantum algorithm offers a quadratic improvement in the dependence on 1/p over classical random sampling, which needs Θ(1/p) samples; because each quantum query is costly, however, it is faster in total running time only when p is very small (roughly below N⁻⁴), where the number of queries is no longer constant. We describe the problem formulation, detail the oracle construction (edge-length loading, sequential quantum addition, and threshold comparison), and analyse the query complexity to achieve the required result.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了旅行商问题（TSP）的一个阈值分数变体，即鲁棒TSP，其目标是判断至少有p比例的路径总长度是否小于等于K。我们展示了Grover量子搜索算法能以O(1/√p)的预言查询次数解决此问题，且每次查询由N的多项式大小量子电路实现。与经典随机采样相比，量子算法在1/p的依赖性上提供了二次加速。然而，由于每次量子查询成本较高，总运行时间仅在p非常小（约低于N⁻⁴）时才更快。
authors: Aayra Dhindsa Sawkmie

articles.title: Separating entanglement at emission from femtoscopic correlations
articles.title_zh: 从飞秒关联中分离发射时的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14358v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate how femtoscopic correlations modify the relation between the spin entanglement of emitted particle pairs and that of pairs selected at a given relative momentum. For two spin-frac12 particles, we show that the momentum-selected spin state can be entangled even when the corresponding state at emission is separable. We derive a momentum-dependent separability criterion that determines whether the observed spin correlations require entanglement at emission. As an application, we consider a pair of identical Łambda hyperons, for which quantum statistics and final-state interactions affect the singlet and triplet spin channels differently at low relative momentum. Our results provide a framework for using experimentally accessible spin correlations to investigate entanglement at emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了飞秒关联如何改变发射粒子对的自旋纠缠与给定相对动量下选择的粒子对之间的关系。对于两个自旋1/2粒子，我们发现即使发射时的对应态是可分的，动量选择的自旋态也可能纠缠。我们导出了一个动量相关的可分性判据，以确定观测到的自旋关联是否需要发射时的纠缠。该框架可用于利用实验可及的自旋关联来研究发射时的纠缠。
authors: Isaac Vidaña

articles.title: Competitive scaling of small-subsystem-optimization heuristics for LABS
articles.title_zh: LABS小小子系统优化启发式算法的竞争性标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14361v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The low autocorrelation binary sequences (LABS) problem, often formulated as a spin-lattice energy-minimization problem, is a combinatorial optimization problem with a very rugged energy landscape. We demonstrate that iterative optimization of very small subsystems of n spins that are decoupled from the rest of the system achieves global optimization of LABS with a time-to-solution scaling that is competitive with heuristics that optimize the global system of N spins directly. Our isolated-subsystem heuristic with n = 4 achieves a time scaling of O(1.333N ) on the interval N = [27, 60], while the current state-of-the-art classical and quantum scalings are respectively O(1.34N ) and O(1.21N ). Our results suggest that specialized optimization hardware with only small numbers of logical spins may be of practical relevance.
articles.abstract_zh: 低自相关二元序列（LABS）问题是一个具有崎岖能量景观的组合优化问题。本文证明，对与系统其余部分解耦的n个自旋小小子系统进行迭代优化，可以实现LABS的全局优化，其求解时间标度与直接优化N个自旋全局系统的启发式算法具有竞争力。我们使用n=4的孤立子系统启发式算法在N=[27, 60]区间内实现了O(1.333^N)的时间标度，这与现有最先进的经典和量子算法的标度具有可比性。
authors: Ginger E. Lau, Adil A. Gangat

articles.title: Primordial Graviton Entanglement in Quasicrystalline Inflation
articles.title_zh: 准晶暴胀中的原初引力子纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15249v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the entanglement structure of gravitons in quasicrystalline inflation. Both parity-even and parity-odd interactions generate graviton pairs with nonzero total momentum. For opposite-helicity pairs with identical momenta, the parity-even contribution can be nonzero, whereas the parity-odd contribution vanishes. The transition from inflation to radiation domination produces additional conventional two-mode squeezing. We derive the resulting normal and anomalous covariances. The initially nonzero reciprocal blocks of the full field-momentum covariance remain nonzero under homogeneous evolution, although individual components can vanish. We show that this homogeneous, helicity-preserving evolution acts unitarily within each helicity sector and therefore preserves the entanglement between the complete right- and left-helicity sectors. Nevertheless, it can eliminate entanglement in the reduced state of a co-propagating pair. We illustrate this distinction using a solvable four-mode model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了准晶暴胀中引力子的纠缠结构。宇称偶和宇称奇相互作用都会产生总动量非零的引力子对。从暴胀到辐射主导的转变会产生额外的常规双模压缩。我们推导了由此产生的正常和异常协方差，并表明均匀的、螺旋度守恒的演化在每个螺旋度扇区内是酉的，从而保持了左右螺旋度扇区之间的纠缠。然而，它可能消除共传播对的约化态中的纠缠。
authors: Jiro Soda

articles.title: Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers for OFDM Systems: An Atomic-Comb Design
articles.title_zh: 用于OFDM系统的里德堡原子量子接收器：一种原子梳设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15306v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQR) exhibit exceptional sensitivity to radio-frequency (RF) signals, positioning them as promising candidates for next-generation wireless systems. Extending their capabilities to orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM), however, requires atomic responses that go beyond broadband reception and are tailored to the structured interference of multicarrier signals. To bridge this gap, we develop an atomic-comb Rydberg receiver based on six-wave mixing (SWM) transduction. In particular, injecting a multi-tone local oscillator (LO) into the RAQR generates frequency-shifted replicas of the intrinsic SWM response. By subtly tuning the amplitude and phase of each LO tone, constructive and destructive interference can be selectively induced to preserve desired response components while attenuating harmful frequency offsets. Furthermore, we harness the response-reshaping capability of the proposed atomic comb to proactively mitigate OFDM interference. More explicitly, by exploiting the discrete difference-frequency structure of both carrier-frequency-offset (CFO)-induced and phase-noise (PN)-induced inter-carrier interference (ICI), we optimize the atomic-comb response to suppress dominant ICI components directly. We further reveal an intrinsic coupling between spectral shaping and the time-domain effective channel memory, motivating a joint optimization of both ICI and inter-symbol interference (ISI), which simultaneously suppresses inter-carrier leakage and post-cyclic-prefix (CP) tail energy. Extensive simulation results validate our atomic-comb design, unveiling that the proposed atomic comb can effectively reshape the receiver response over the OFDM, while mitigating ICI, shortening the effective channel memory, and substantially lowering CP overhead.
articles.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子量子接收器（RAQR）对射频信号具有极高的灵敏度，是下一代无线系统的潜在候选。为将其能力扩展到正交频分复用（OFDM）系统，本文开发了一种基于六波混频（SWM）的原子梳里德堡接收器。通过注入多音本地振荡器，该接收器能够生成SWM响应的频移副本，并通过精细调整LO音的幅度和相位来选择性地诱导干涉。这种原子梳设计能够主动减轻OFDM干扰，为未来无线通信提供新途径。
authors: Yuanbin Chen, Chong Meng Samson See, Chau Yuen

articles.title: Quantum circuit representation and incomplete Bell measurements in Compton scattering
articles.title_zh: 康普顿散射中的量子电路表示和不完全贝尔测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15526v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We formulate massless tree-level Compton scattering as an effective two-qubit operation on electron and photon helicities. In the Bell basis, the scattering map separates into two parity sectors and admits a simple quantum circuit representation with one nonunitary filter. After Kraus normalization, this filter defines an unsharp incomplete Bell measurement that distinguishes the two Bell-parity sectors but not the relative Bell label within each sector. We further show that the incomplete measurement alone does not surpass the classical teleportation threshold, whereas a subsequent complete Bell-basis readout enables unit conditional teleportation fidelity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将无质量树级康普顿散射公式化为电子和光子螺旋度上的有效两量子比特操作。在贝尔基下，散射映射分为两个宇称扇区，并具有一个包含非酉滤波器的简单量子电路表示。该滤波器定义了一种不完全贝尔测量，可以区分两个贝尔宇称扇区，但不能区分每个扇区内的相对贝尔标签。研究表明，单独的不完全测量无法超越经典隐形传态阈值，而随后的完整贝尔基读出则能实现单位条件隐形传态保真度。
authors: Wei Xie, Yu-Chen Guo, Shuang Li, Ji-Chong Yang

articles.title: Spatial interference changes the symmetry class of a Josephson element
articles.title_zh: 空间干涉改变约瑟夫森元件的对称性类别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15746v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spatial interference can break the inversion symmetry of an effective Josephson potential even in a laterally homogeneous junction with inversion-symmetric local energy. We derive a general criterion based on harmonic-dependent complex spatial form factors: a single local harmonic remains a shifted cosine, whereas multiple harmonics can acquire phases incompatible with any common inversion center, permitting cubic interactions and three-wave mixing. Phase reflection reverses all odd-order expansion coefficients about corresponding minima while preserving the even-order ones. For a capacitively shunted junction at fixed charging energy and arbitrary offset charge, it also preserves the complete quantum spectrum, enabling reversal of the odd nonlinear sector without spectral retuning. A centered cross junction with multiple local harmonics is one concrete example. Within the imposed-field model, a three-component magnetic field can generate an inversion-asymmetric effective potential, and reversing an odd number of field components exactly reflects it without changing the quantum spectrum of the capacitively shunted junction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了空间干涉如何打破有效约瑟夫森势的反演对称性，即使在具有反演对称局部能量的横向均匀结中也是如此。我们基于谐波相关的复空间形状因子导出了一个通用判据：单个局部谐波保持为移位余弦，而多个谐波可以获得与任何共同反演中心不兼容的相位，从而允许三次相互作用和三波混频。研究表明，通过相位反射可以反转奇数阶展开系数，同时保持偶数阶系数，这在电容分流结中可以实现奇数非线性扇区的反转而不改变量子谱。
authors: Takayuki Kubo

articles.title: Eigenstate transitions and critical transport in 3D Aubry-André model
articles.title_zh: 三维Aubry-André模型中的本征态跃迁和临界输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15842v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We numerically study spectral and wave-function properties, as well as time evolution, in finite-size commensurate approximations of the 3D Aubry-André model. We explicitly show, through scaling analysis, the existence of two critical points. One of the critical points is a localization-delocalization transition in real-space, similar to the critical point in the 3D Anderson model. The other is a localization-delocalization transition in a dual momentum space, which does not have any analog in the 3D Anderson model. We estimate their values from spectral measures, such as the gap ratio and the spectral form factor, as well as from wave-function measures, such as the inverse participation ratio and the participation entropy. Additionally, we demonstrate that both critical points exhibit hallmarks of critical points between quantum ergodicity and localization. First, the eigenstates and the eigenspectrum at the critical point fulfill the mutual universal relation between the eigenspectrum compressibility ḩi and the eigenstate fractal dimension d⁽¹⁾ [S. Jiricek et al., Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 123, e2518027123 (2026)]. Second, the dynamics of the wave packet at the critical point is governed by the critical dynamical exponent z, characterized by the spectral fractal dimension and the dimensionality of the lattice [M. Hopjan and L. Vidmar, Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 060401 (2025)]. Thus, similarly to the 3D Anderson model, the critical dynamical exponent is sub-diffusive with the value of z=3.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文数值研究了三维Aubry-André模型有限尺寸近似中的谱和波函数性质以及时间演化。通过标度分析，我们明确展示了两个临界点的存在：一个在实空间中是局域-离域转变，另一个在对偶动量空间中也是局域-离域转变。这些临界点表现出量子遍历性和局域化之间临界点的特征，例如本征态和本征谱满足本征谱压缩率与本征态分形维数之间的普适关系。
authors: Pragna Das, Lev Vidmar, Miroslav Hopjan

articles.title: Quantum Localization in Geometric Complex Networks
articles.title_zh: 几何复杂网络中的量子局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum localization, the phenomenon by which wave diffusion is halted, here understood as the superposition of propagating waves, can have many different origins, such as onsite random potentials in Anderson localization. However, some systems exhibit complex geometries and could potentially reproduce similar results without external potentials. In this work, we study how localization of single particle states is affected by the underlying topology of a simple but highly predictive complex network model: the geometric soft configuration model mathbb S¹. By tuning the model's temperature and heterogeneity parameters, we are able to generate different structural patterns and focus on the transition from a small-world to a non-small-world regime. Our study suggests that small-world networks tend to have extended states, which spread the whole system's size, in contrast to non-small-world networks which tend to localize, showing how complex connectivity can play the role assigned to random energetic disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了几何复杂网络中单粒子态的量子局域化现象。通过调整几何软配置模型（mathbb S¹）的温度和异质性参数，我们能够生成不同的结构模式，并关注从小世界到非小世界状态的转变。研究表明，小世界网络倾向于具有扩展态，而与此相反，非小世界网络则倾向于局域化。这揭示了复杂的连通性如何在没有外部势能的情况下，扮演随机能量无序的角色。
authors: Jan Lewenstein-Sanpera, Tobias Grass, M. Àngeles Serrano, Bruno Juliá-Díaz

articles.title: Deterministic positioning accuracy of B centers in hBN by electron irradiation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16468v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is a promising material platform for quantum technologies, enabling both the realization of nanophotonic devices and the hosting of point defects that act as high-quality single-photon emitters (SPEs). Among these defects, B centers, which reproducibly emit at 436 nm, can be generated individually at predefined positions using electron beam irradiation, a crucial capability for top-down quantum photonics. Yet, the spatial accuracy of emitter creation strongly conditions the potential applications. Here, we generate arrays of individual B centers in a scanning electron microscope (SEM) with in-situ cathodoluminescence (CL) monitoring. We characterize the sources of random deviations from the target positions to identify the limitations to their deterministic positioning. In particular, we measure the distance between the electron beam and the emitter at the moment the emitter is created based on CL mapping. This approach provides a direct estimation of the spatial extent of the beam-emitter interaction. We find this contribution to be the main constraint to the emitter fabrication accuracy, yielding a standard deviation of 27 nm. Additional contributions, primarily from the finite density of UV-emitting carbon dimer precursors, increase the overall positional standard deviation to 40 nm. Our results highlight the possible improvements to the B center creation technique to reach sub-10 nm accuracy.
authors: A. Núñez Marcos, C. Arnold, J. Barjon, S. Buil, J. -P. Hermier, A. Delteil

articles.title: Exact Gaussian--Hermite closure of the mapping quantum--classical Liouville equation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16864v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Liouville equation contains an excess coupling term in addition to the Poisson bracket. Neglecting this term yields the Poisson bracket mapping equation (PBME). We expand the mapping dependence of the density in Hermite functions about the Gaussian factor common to all physical mapping densities. In this basis, the excess coupling term acts purely as a raising operator and exactly cancels the raising contribution generated by the back--reaction force. Consequently, the exact dynamics does not generate higher Hermite orders and closes on a finite, sparse system of equations for the coefficient fields. Within the physical sector, these equations reduce to the subsystem quantum--classical Liouville equation. In contrast, the PBME retains the raising contribution of the force, modifying the back reaction within the physical sector while continuously generating higher Hermite orders. For Tully's dual avoided crossing model, direct propagation of the coefficient equations confirms this finite closure and agrees with independent solutions of the subsystem equation. Comparison with converged full quantum dynamics further shows that, across all regimes examined, the PBME is less accurate than the quantum--classical description for populations, coherences, and momentum distributions.
authors: Sahand Nikzat Ali Nassimi, Rony Modak Parai

articles.title: Mutual information across the commensurate--incommensurate crossover and near the Kosterlitz--Thouless point of the spin-tfrac12 J₁₋₋J₂ Heisenberg chain
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16915v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: What quantum mutual information adds to conventional correlation functions is often unclear. We study the spin-1/2 J₁₋J₂ Heisenberg chain, using DMRG on infinite chains and periodic rings and an SU(2) decomposition of the mutual information into correlation channels. For singlet ground states the two-site mutual information is an exact function of the spin correlator, so any additional content must come from blocks. In the dimerized phase, blocks resolve bond-energy correlations in the SU(2)-scalar channel without an independent asymptotic length: singlet and triplet correlation lengths agree to about 1%. The scalar channel dominates block mutual information at large distances in the commensurate regime up to J₂/J₁₌₀.40, but falls to a few percent beyond the disorder point, which coincides numerically with the Majumdar-Ghosh point J₂/J₁₌₁/2; the structure-factor peak splits only at the Lifshitz point J₂/J₁₌₀.520622(2). On the gapless side we compare block mutual information on rings extrapolated to infinite size with the two-interval prediction of SU(2)₁ conformal field theory across the Kosterlitz-Thouless point J₂/J₁₌₀.241167. There, for block lengths lłe6, the correction decays as l⁻p with p=1.96-2.07, and any logarithmic term is at least 60 times smaller than in the Heisenberg chain. Expanding in the marginal coupling (from level spectroscopy) the first-order coefficient is consistent with l⁻² scaling and the second-order coefficient is positive for xłe1/4, suggesting that the mutual information relative to the field-theory value becomes stationary at the KT point for large blocks. The scalar-channel share approaches 1/4 at small cross ratio x, as expected from SO(4) symmetry; under two stated assumptions its first-order response to the coupling is (3/8)łn x-5/8 at small x, matched by the l=4 data within 1-3% at xłe1/9.
authors: Wuttichai Pankeaw, Pruet Kalasuwan

articles.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-k dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. Unlike approaches based primarily on phenomenological leakage models, our first-principles, multi-terminal quantum-transport framework treats the source, drain, and gate as current-carrying quantum-mechanical contacts and resolves the local current density throughout the device. The spatially resolved current density shows that gate-injected carriers tunnel through the high-k dielectric preferentially near the drain side of the gate, where the dielectric barrier is most strongly lowered by the drain bias, and are collected by the drain. This provides a direct real-space picture of the DIDBL-driven gate-drain leakage mechanism.
authors: Denis Mamaluy, Juan P. Mendez, Coleman Cariker, Michael Titze, Alex A. Belianinov

articles.title: Quantum Geometry and Pair Breaking in Intra- and Intervalley Superconductivity of Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The observation of superconductivity emerging from a spin- and valley-polarized normal state in rhombohedral graphene raises a basic puzzle: intravalley Cooper pairs involve states that are not generically degenerate because of trigonal warping, and therefore lack the particle--particle nesting underlying the conventional Cooper instability. While recent model studies suggest that nontrivial band geometry can strongly promote chiral pairing, how this geometric enhancement competes with realistic band-structure-induced pair breaking remains unclear. Here we study Kohn--Luttinger superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral tetralayer graphene using a DFT-fitted multiorbital tight-binding model, retaining the full Bloch-wave-function form factors in both RPA screening and the projected Cooper interaction. We separate the superconducting instability into three contributions: the symmetry-resolved form-factor-dressed interaction, the Cooper-pair phase space determined by the symmetrized pair dispersion, and the energy mismatch generated by trigonal warping. We find that the Bloch form factors strongly favor intravalley pairing, with a leading predominantly pₓ₋ᵢₚ_y instability and a substantially larger maximum T_c than the intervalley reference state. At the same time, trigonal-warping-induced mismatch cuts off the Cooper logarithm and confines intravalley superconductivity to a much narrower region of the phase diagram. The dominant instability occurs near pair-Lifshitz transitions and primarily in reconstructed annular or three-lobed Fermi-surface regimes. Our results show that superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene is controlled by the combined effects of quantum-geometry-dressed interactions, pair fermiology, and trigonal-warping-induced pair breaking.
authors: Louis Primeau, Yang Zhang, Shi-Zeng Lin

articles.title: Enhancing Quasi-Two-Dimensional Electronic Structure in Bi2O2Se via Chlorine Substitution
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. First-principles calculations attribute this selective tunability to the unique spatial separation between conductive Bi-O layers and dopant Se/Cl layers, which enables independent optimization of interlayer coupling and intralayer transport. Remarkably, our theoretical calculations combined with experimental observations project a broad bandgap engineering across a wide range (0.8 ~ 3.5 eV) within the Bi2O2Se system. Our findings not only expand the application potential of Bi2O2Se-based materials in optoelectronics, nanoelectronics, and fundamental research but also highlight spatial decoupling as a viable strategy for modifying detailed electronic structure of quasi-2D quantum systems.
authors: Yong-Zhen Jiang, Qi-Xun Wen, Xiang Xu, Su-Tao Sun, Feng-Fan Ren, Zi-Xuan Zhou, Xing-Yuan You, Yu-Cheng Kan, Zheng Zhang, Jie-Yi Liu, Yu-Zhou Zhao, Zheng-Tai Liu, Mao Ye, Shu-Hua Yao, Jian Zhou, Yan-Bin Chen, Zhong-Kai Liu, Yu-Lin Chen, Yang-Yang Lv, Cheng Chen

articles.title: Crossed Electric Spin Generation in Multilayers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a crossed electric spin generation effect in multilayer structures. This effect combines the advantages of in-plane and gate electric fields for manipulating spin, and unveils a nice quantum geometric structure in terms of the underlying hybrid Berry curvatures that are unique to quasi-2D systems and manifest inherent spin-layer-orbital coupling. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict sizable spin generation in 2D ferromagnetic Fe3GeTe2 and altermagnetic V2Te2O. Our theory opens a new Berry-curvature route for all-electric spin manipulation in 2D materials
authors: Xukun Feng, Wei Du, Jin Cao, Qian Niu, Shengyuan A. Yang, Cong Xiao

articles.title: Driven Vortex Motion in Periodic Channel Potential Embedded in Superconducting Films
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we investigate vortex dynamics in periodically width-modulated superconducting channels by numerically solving the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau (TDGL) equations. The channels are designed with sinusoidally varying widths characterized by their average width and modulation amplitude. The motion of driven vortices generates an oscillatory electric field with a fundamental frequency, f₀, set by the channel periodicity, together with higher-order harmonics. In contrast to the situation of vortex lattice dynamics in a periodic pinning landscape of circular holes considered by Al Luhaibi et al. [1], we show that the harmonic content of the generated electric field can be effectively controlled through the channel geometry. In particular, appropriately engineered channel profiles strongly suppress higher-order harmonics, yielding an electric-field response that closely approaches a pure sinusoidal waveform. These results demonstrate that geometric modulation offers a viable route to engineering low-harmonicity microwave signals in superconducting devices and may enable cryogenic on-chip waveform generators for controlling superconducting qubits. Such devices could provide a useful building block for scalable transmon-based quantum computing architectures.
authors: A. Al Luhaibi, A. Glatz, Michael Vogl, Hocine Bahlouli, J. B. Ketterson

articles.title: Reparameterizing GFN1-xTB for Ionic Liquids
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ionic liquids are materials whose properties can be tailored for a wide range of applications, but their chemical diversity and complex electronic structure make systematic screening using quantum-mechanical methods computationally demanding. Semiempirical quantum methods offer an alternative, although their accuracy depends on their parameterization. We investigate the reparameterization of the DFTB method GFN1-xTB for predicting structural, energetic, and electronic properties of ionic liquids. For this purpose, we built a database containing over 14,000 conformations to construct training datasets and explored different parameterization strategies fitted to binding energies, forces, HOMO-LUMO gaps, and geometries. Analysis of the original GFN1-xTB model reveals systematic errors in these properties, with distinct behavior for saturated and aromatic cations. Thus, we investigate two models: CXMIM-xTB, a targeted model trained on imidazolium-based ionic liquids, and IL-xTB, a more general model designed to describe systems containing saturated and aromatic cations. CXMIM-xTB improves the description of binding energies, geometries, and frontier orbital energies while retaining computational efficiency. The model is subsequently applied to estimate electrochemical windows of ionic liquids, providing values consistent with DFT and experimental values. IL-xTB follows a hierarchical parameterization strategy including different cation and anion families and substantially reduces the systematic errors of GFN1-xTB across the chemical space considered, providing a route for developing xTB parameterizations with broader applicability to ionic liquids. Overall, both parameterization strategies outperform the original GFN1-xTB model, demonstrating that reparameterized methods provide an efficient approach for connecting configurational sampling with quantum-mechanical properties of ionic liquids.
authors: F. Stavarache, S. Calero, J. M. Vicent-Luna

articles.title: Framework for an AI-Ready ARPES Community Database
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Condensed matter stands to gain profoundly from widespread adoption of artificial intelligence (AI). However, its current means of data organization impedes this endeavor. As a premier measure of electronic structure underlying material properties, Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES) has accumulated over four decades of spectra, yet the community's publication-centered workflow preserves only a highly selected fraction of its experimental record. A shared data ecosystem could transform these fragmented measurements and their contexts into a persistent, collective scientific memory, creating immediate value for reproducibility and reuse while laying the foundation for AI-enabled discovery. In this Perspective, we report outcomes of a recent community workshop and propose a practical path toward such an ecosystem. Its benefits unfold along three timescales. In the near term, standardized, searchable, and citable datasets strengthen analysis pipelines independently of AI. In the intermediate future, community-validated tools operating across laboratories could enable broader reuse and increasingly closed-loop automated experiments. In the long term, a diverse corpus of measured electronic spectra could support foundation models for quantum matter. Looking forward, a diverse corpus of measured electronic spectra could support foundation models for quantum matter and new discoveries. We discuss lessons from existing scientific databases, the current state of AI in ARPES, as well as areas of community convergence on data organization, access, credit, governance, and a staged pilot program.
authors: Zhi-Xun Shen, Jin Gene Wong, Karen Lei, Leon Garcia, Felix Baumberger, Sergey Borisenko, Aaron Bostwick, Ting Cao, Tanny Chavez, Yulin Chen, Monika Choudhary, Andrea Damascelli, Dan Dessau, Thomas P.
