Dolgirev, Danica Pavicevic, Albert Liu, Andrea Cavalleri, and Eugene Demler We present a theoretical approach for computing and analyzing two-dimensional spectroscopy of bosonic collective excitations in disordered many-body systems. Specifically, we employ the Keldysh formalism to derive, within a nonperturbative treatment of disorder effects, the third-order nonlinear res… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043031] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种计算和分析无序多体系统中玻色子集体激发的二维光谱学的理论方法。作者利用Keldysh形式主义，在对无序效应进行非微扰处理的框架下，推导了三阶非线性响应。这项工作为理解和探测无序多体系统中的集体激发提供了新的理论工具。
authors: Alex Gómez-Salvador, Ivan Morera, Marios H. Michael, Pavel E. Dolgirev, Danica Pavicevic, Albert Liu, Andrea Cavalleri, and Eugene Demler

articles.title: Lattice location of ion-implanted ⁶He in diamond
articles.title_zh: 离子注入⁶He在金刚石中的晶格位置
articles.abstract: Author(s): U. Wahl, J. G. Correia, A. Costa, B. Biesmans, G. Magchiels, S. M. Tunhuma, A. Lamelas, A. Vantomme, and L. M. C. Pereira Understanding the properties of helium in diamond is crucial for geological dating and possible quantum applications. Here, the authors determine the lattice location of ion-implanted short-lived 6 He in single-crystal diamond at temperatures from 30°C to 800°C using the β − emission channeling technique. 6 He preferentially occupies tetrahedral interstitial sites. From the temperature dependence of the interstitial fraction, the migration energy of He is estimated at 1.63–2.89 eV, implying unbound interstitial helium is unstable in diamond over geological timescales, an important insight to be considered in He-based dating methods. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 194105] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 了解氦在金刚石中的性质对地质测年和量子应用至关重要。本文利用β-发射沟道技术，确定了离子注入的短寿命⁶He在单晶金刚石中30°C至800°C温度范围内的晶格位置。研究发现⁶He优先占据四面体间隙位，并估算了氦的迁移能为1.63–2.89 eV。这一结果表明非束缚间隙氦在地质时间尺度上在金刚石中不稳定，为基于氦的测年方法提供了重要见解。
authors: U. Wahl, J. G. Correia, A. Costa, B. Biesmans, G. Magchiels, S. M. Tunhuma, A. Lamelas, A. Vantomme, and L. M. C. Pereira

articles.title: Lattice thermal transport from phonon spectra beyond perturbation theory
articles.title_zh: 超越微扰理论的声子谱晶格热输运
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zezhu Zeng, Michele Simoncelli, and David E. Manolopoulos We develop a molecular dynamics framework to compute the mode-resolved phonon spectral density from classical correlations of an annihilation-like phonon variable. For harmonic oscillators, classical molecular dynamics exactly reproduces the corresponding quantum Kubo-transformed correlator, providi… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 204303] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种分子动力学框架，用于从类湮灭声子变量的经典关联中计算模式分辨的声子谱密度。对于谐振子，经典分子动力学能够精确重现相应的量子Kubo变换关联函数。该方法为研究晶格热输运提供了超越传统微扰理论的新途径。
authors: Zezhu Zeng, Michele Simoncelli, and David E. Manolopoulos

articles.title: Bose-Einstein condensate of magnons in superfluid ³He-B as a tuned resonant quantum amplifier
articles.title_zh: 超流³He-B中磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚作为可调谐共振量子放大器
articles.abstract: Author(s): M. Človečko, K. Goliaš, O. Podopryhora, M. Skyba, and P. Skyba We show that the Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) of magnons in superfluid ³He-B in the form of a homogeneously precessing domain can be used as a new type of tuned resonant quantum amplifier. The underlying physical principle of the resonant amplification is the violation of the U(1) (c… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 214506] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了超流³He-B中以均匀进动畴形式存在的磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）可作为一种新型可调谐共振量子放大器。共振放大的基本物理原理是U(1)对称性的破缺。这项工作为开发基于超流氦的新型量子器件提供了理论基础。
authors: M. Človečko, K. Goliaš, O. Podopryhora, M. Skyba, and P. Skyba

articles.title: Strong quantum interaction between excitons bound by cavity photon exchange
articles.title_zh: 腔光子交换束缚激子之间的强量子相互作用
articles.abstract: Author(s): Miguel S. Oliveira and Cristiano Ciuti We theoretically predict the interaction between polaritonic excitations arising from the coupling of a cavity photon mode with bound to continuum intersubband transitions in a doped quantum well. The resulting exciton bound by photon exchange, recently demonstrated experimentally, exhibits a bindin… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 235112] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论预测了腔光子模式与掺杂量子阱中束缚-连续子带间跃迁耦合所产生的极化激元激发之间的相互作用。由此产生的由光子交换束缚的激子，最近已通过实验证实，表现出特定的束缚特性。该研究揭示了腔光子介导的激子间强量子相互作用机制。
authors: Miguel S. Oliveira and Cristiano Ciuti

articles.title: Control of attosecond photoemission time delays by quantum state interference
articles.title_zh: 通过量子态干涉控制阿秒光电子发射时间延迟
articles.abstract: Author(s): D. Bharti, J. C. del Valle, A. T. Bondy, K. Bartschat, R. Moshammer, A. Harth, and T. Pfeifer Scattering theory has long established that wave packets can experience time delays and advances, while developments in attosecond interferometry have made such temporal shifts experimentally accessible. They are encoded in the spectral phase of the emitted electron wave packet and are commonly acce… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043033] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 散射理论早已确立波包会经历时间延迟和超前，而阿秒干涉测量技术的发展使得这些时间偏移在实验上变得可及。这些时间延迟编码在发射电子波包的谱相位中。本文研究了如何通过量子态干涉来控制阿秒光电子发射的时间延迟，为超快动力学研究提供了新的调控手段。
authors: D. Bharti, J. C. del Valle, A. T. Bondy, K. Bartschat, R. Moshammer, A. Harth, and T. Pfeifer

articles.title: Upward deviation from the Wiedemann-Franz law and phonon-dominated thermal transport in the topological semimetal NbP₂
articles.title_zh: 拓扑半金属NbP₂中偏离Wiedemann-Franz定律的向上偏差和声子主导的热输运
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jie Yang, Luyao Zhong, and Xiaolong Yang Transition-metal dipnictides RX₂ (R=Nb or Ta and X=P, Sb, or As) represent a key class of topological semimetals that exhibit rich quantum transport phenomena owing to their nontrivial band topology. However, their thermal transport mechanisms remain poorly understood. H… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 204302] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二磷化物RX₂是一类重要的拓扑半金属，因其非平凡的能带拓扑而展现出丰富的量子输运现象，但其热输运机制仍不清楚。本文研究了拓扑半金属NbP₂中的热输运特性。研究发现NbP₂存在偏离Wiedemann-Franz定律的向上偏差，且热输运主要由声子主导。
authors: Jie Yang, Luyao Zhong, and Xiaolong Yang

articles.title: Quantum-critical mediation of magnetic order by a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid
articles.title_zh: Tomonaga-Luttinger液体对磁序的量子临界介导
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hironori Yamaguchi, Sota Monju, Akira Matsuo, Shunsuke C. Furuya, Nicolas Suaud, Koji Araki, Takanori Kida, Masayuki Hagiwara, and Koichi Kindo Quantum-critical many-body states host universal correlations extending across all length scales. Whether these critical correlations merely characterize quantum-critical matter or can actively generate interactions that organize collective order has remained an open question. Here, we establish the… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 235113] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 量子临界多体态具有跨越所有长度尺度的普适关联，但这些临界关联是仅仅表征量子临界物质，还是能主动产生组织集体有序的相互作用，一直是一个悬而未决的问题。本文确立了Tomonaga-Luttinger液体能够介导磁序的量子临界机制。这项工作揭示了量子临界涨落如何主动驱动集体有序的形成。
authors: Hironori Yamaguchi, Sota Monju, Akira Matsuo, Shunsuke C. Furuya, Nicolas Suaud, Koji Araki, Takanori Kida, Masayuki Hagiwara, and Koichi Kindo

articles.title: Enhancing entanglement asymmetry in fragmented quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 增强碎裂量子系统中的纠缠不对称性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Lorenzo Gotta, Filiberto Ares, and Sara Murciano Entanglement asymmetry provides a quantitative measure of symmetry breaking in many-body quantum states. Focusing on inhomogeneous U(1) charges, such as dipole and multipole moments, we show that the typical asymmetry is bounded by a universal fraction of its maximal value. Multipole char… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 235114] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠不对称性为多体量子态中的对称性破缺提供了一个定量度量。本文聚焦于非均匀U(1)荷，如偶极矩和多极矩，并证明了典型的纠缠不对称性被其最大值的一个普适分数所限制。该研究为理解和量化碎裂量子系统中的对称性破缺提供了新的视角。
authors: Lorenzo Gotta, Filiberto Ares, and Sara Murciano

articles.title: Information-Theoretic Principle of Emergent 1-Form Symmetries

articles.abstract: Author(s): Yu-Jie Liu, Wen-Tao Xu, Frank Pollmann, and Michael Knap Viewing emergent 1-form symmetries through the lens of quantum error correction(QEC) makes them detectable with QEC decoders, providing efficient protocols for revealing emergent symmetry structure and probing phase transitions in quantum many-body systems. [PRX Quantum 7, 043006] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从量子纠错（QEC）的角度审视涌现的一形式对称性，使得它们可以通过QEC解码器进行检测。这为揭示量子多体系统中的涌现对称结构和探测相变提供了高效的协议。该研究将信息论与量子对称性相结合，为理解复杂量子系统提供了新工具。
authors: Yu-Jie Liu, Wen-Tao Xu, Frank Pollmann, and Michael Knap

We propose a setup that coherently couples free electrons in an electron microscope to a trapped-ion quantum processor, enabl… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 150804] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 自由传播的电子可作为量子探针，与其它量子系统实现相干关联，从而提供先进的计量资源。本文提出了一种将电子显微镜中的自由电子与囚禁离子量子处理器相干耦合的装置。该装置有望实现自由电子与量子计算机之间的量子信息交换，为量子测量和量子计算开辟新途径。
authors: Elias Pescoller, Santiago Beltrán-Romero, Sebastian Egginger, Nicolas Jungwirth, Martino Zanetti, Dominik Hornof, Michael S. Seifner, Iva Březinová, Philipp Haslinger, Thomas Juffmann, Johannes Kofler, Dennis Rätzel, and Philipp Schindler

Shaffer Microelectromechanical—so-called “MEMs”—vapor cells are a key component in atom-based quantum sensors, such as clocks, gyroscopes, electric field sensors, and magnetometers. MEMs vapor cell fabrication for Rydberg atom radio frequency sensors is particularly demanding. The Rydberg states used for th… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 153203] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 微机电系统（MEMs）蒸气池是原子基量子传感器（如时钟、陀螺仪、电场传感器和磁力计）的关键组件。本文研究了具有无源内腔的MEMs蒸气池，特别关注其在里德堡原子射频传感器中的应用。该研究旨在优化MEMs蒸气池的设计和制造，以满足高性能量子传感器的需求。
authors: Rajesh Pandiyan, Sanyasi Bobbara, Somayeh Mirzaee, Su-Peng Yu, Ruoxi Wang, Adam Sibenik, Reza Kohandani, Stephanie Bohaichuk, and James P. Shaffer

articles.title: Non-Ohmic to Ohmic Crossover in the Breakdown of the Quantum Hall States in Graphene under Broadband Excitations
articles.title_zh: 宽带激发下石墨烯量子霍尔态击穿中的非欧姆到欧姆转变

Parmentier, and Erwann Bocquillon Graphene, through the coexistence of large cyclotron gaps and small spin and valley gaps, offers the possibility to study the breakdown of the quantum Hall effect (QHE) across a wide range of energy scales. In this Letter, we investigate the breakdown of the QHE in high-mobility graphene Corbino dev… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 156602] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 石墨烯因其大回旋能隙与小自旋和谷能隙的共存，为研究量子霍尔效应（QHE）在宽能量范围内的击穿提供了独特平台。本文研究了高迁移率石墨烯科尔比诺器件中量子霍尔效应的击穿现象。研究揭示了在宽带激发下，量子霍尔态击穿过程中从非欧姆行为到欧姆行为的转变机制。
authors: Torsten Röper, Aifei Zhang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Olivier Maillet, François D. Parmentier, and Erwann Bocquillon

articles.abstract: Author(s): Othmane Benhayoune-Khadraoui, Cristóbal Lledó, and Alexandre Blais Researchers show that auxiliary circuit modes trigger multiphoton resonances that break down Kerr-cat qubit coherence under strong driving. [Phys. Rev. X 16, 041012] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员发现，辅助电路模式在强驱动下会触发多光子共振。这些共振导致克尔猫量子比特的相干性遭到破坏。该研究揭示了辅助模式对量子比特性能的负面影响，对设计和优化超导量子计算系统具有重要意义。
authors: Othmane Benhayoune-Khadraoui, Cristóbal Lledó, and Alexandre Blais

Hegde, and Chandrakala Meena Postselection of quantum trajectories is known to effectively introduce nonlinearity into dynamics of open quantum systems. We study the effect of such nonlinearity in continuous-time quantum walks (CTQWs) on networks with homogeneous and heterogeneous degree distributions. Using the recently propos… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 042206] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 量子轨迹的后选择已知能有效地将非线性引入开放量子系统的动力学中。本文研究了这种非线性在具有同质和异质度分布网络上的连续时间量子行走（CTQWs）中的影响。研究发现后选择可以诱导量子行走的局域化现象，并影响其相干特性。
authors: Adithya L. J., Suraj S. Hegde, and Chandrakala Meena

articles.title: Quantum annealing approach to the minimum distance problem of quantum codes
articles.title_zh: 量子退火方法解决量子码的最小距离问题
articles.abstract: Author(s): Refaat Ismail, Ashish Kakkar, and Anatoly Dymarsky The authors reformulate the NP-hard problem of finding a quantum stabilizer code’s minimum distance into a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) framework compatible with classical, quantum, and hybrid solvers. Testing the approach with quantum annealing and hybrid optimization, they identify hardware connectivity and embedding as the main limitations of current implementations. [Phys. Rev. A 114, 042610] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者将寻找量子稳定器码最小距离的NP难问题重新表述为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）框架，该框架兼容经典、量子和混合求解器。通过量子退火和混合优化测试该方法，他们发现硬件连接性和嵌入是当前实现的主要限制。这项工作为利用量子计算解决量子纠错码的关键问题提供了新途径。
authors: Refaat Ismail, Ashish Kakkar, and Anatoly Dymarsky

articles.title: Multioutcome circuit optimization for enhanced non-Gaussian state generation
articles.title_zh: 用于增强非高斯态生成的多种结果电路优化
articles.abstract: Author(s): S. Ismailzadeh and B. Abedi Ravan Photonic quantum computing has gained significant interest in recent years due to its potential for scaling to large numbers of qubits. A critical requirement for fault-tolerant quantum computation is the reliable generation of non-Gaussian quantum states, typically achieved using Gaussian operation… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 043511] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 光子量子计算因其扩展到大量量子比特的潜力而备受关注。容错量子计算的一个关键要求是可靠地生成非高斯量子态，这通常通过高斯操作实现。本文提出了一种多结果电路优化方法，旨在提高非高斯量子态的生成效率和可靠性。
authors: S. Ismailzadeh and B. Abedi Ravan

articles.title: First-order Maxwell operator formalism for macroscopic quantum electrodynamics with open dielectric boundaries

The Green's function propagates the field and noise operators arising from material absorption account for quantum fluctuations. Standard macroscopic QED represents the field through bulk n… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 043711] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 宏观量子电动力学（QED）描述了色散、吸收介质中的光-物质相互作用。格林函数传播场，而源于材料吸收的噪声算子解释了量子涨落。本文提出了一种用于具有开放介电边界的宏观量子电动力学的一阶麦克斯韦算子形式。该形式为理解复杂介质中的光与物质相互作用提供了新的理论工具。
authors: Ishita Agarwal, Ankit Kundu, Christian M. Lange, and Jonathan D. Hood

articles.title: Direct characterization of classical dephasing noise for a qubit
articles.title_zh: 量子比特经典退相干噪声的直接表征
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yuan-De Jin, Zheng-Fei Ye, and Wen-Long Ma The authors propose a simple method to directly characterize classical stochastic noise causing qubit dephasing through repetitive Ramsey interferometry measurements (RIMs) on the qubit. They demonstrate that each RIM with a short evolution time and suitably chosen control pulses directly samples the noise field, and the n -point correlations of the RIM outcomes are proportional to the n -point correlation functions of the noise processes. [Phys. Rev. A 114, L040401] Published Fri Oct 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一种简单方法，通过对量子比特进行重复拉姆齐干涉测量（RIMs）来直接表征导致量子比特退相干的经典随机噪声。他们证明了每次具有短演化时间和适当选择控制脉冲的RIM直接采样噪声场。RIM结果的n点关联与噪声过程的n点关联函数成比例，为噪声表征提供了有效工具。
authors: Yuan-De Jin, Zheng-Fei Ye, and Wen-Long Ma
