articles.title: Andreev bound-state optoelectronics: absorption spectroscopy and microwave-to-optical transduction
articles.title_zh: 安德烈夫束缚态光电子学：吸收光谱与微波到光学的转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.04176v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconducting weak-link junctions host electron--hole hybridized excitations called Andreev bound states, central to mesoscopic transport and emerging quantum information platforms. Andreev physics has so far been synonymous with the microwave range. However, advancements in superconductor--semiconductor hybrid junctions open the door to the characterization, and manipulation, of Andreev states by light. Here we introduce a model for light--Andreev interaction, with distinct features: Electrons transitioning into Andreev levels can sidestep Pauli exclusion, resulting in two optical absorption resonances separated by twice the bound state energy. One resonance populates the Andreev state and the other empties it, enabling optical control of Andreev qubit parity; pumping both resets the junction and prevents saturation. Given their strong microwave coupling, we show how Andreev bound states can operate as optical--to--microwave transducers with MHz-scale intermode coupling, a key ingredient for heat load management and quantum networking. We illustrate these effects with realistic device parameters. Our results highlight the possibilities in the new field of Andreev optoelectronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个光与安德烈夫束缚态相互作用的模型，揭示了电子跃迁到安德烈夫能级时，可绕过泡利不相容原理，产生两个光学吸收共振。一个共振填充安德烈夫态，另一个清空它，从而实现对安德烈夫量子比特奇偶性的光学控制。鉴于其强大的微波耦合，安德烈夫束缚态可作为光学到微波的转换器，具有MHz量级的模式间耦合，为热负载管理和量子网络提供了关键要素。
authors: Benjamin Remez, Pouyan Ghaemi, Jay D. Sau, Mohammad Hafezi

articles.title: Quantized transconductance emerges from non-symmetric quantum fluctuations: theoretical prediction
articles.title_zh: 量子化跨导源于非对称量子涨落：理论预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.05813v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show theoretically that weak quantum fluctuations induced by a non-symmetric electromagnetic environment may lead to a quantized transconductance of a multi-terminal quantum contact rather than to a blockade of transport in the contact. The result suggests the possibility to realize Quantum Hall phenomenology without its common ingredients and/or a topological quantum state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上指出，由非对称电磁环境引起的弱量子涨落可能导致多端量子接触的量子化跨导，而非输运阻塞。这一结果表明，有可能在没有常见要素的情况下实现量子霍尔现象学，或实现拓扑量子态。
authors: Klaiv Mertiri, Yuli V. Nazarov

articles.title: Dynamically robust counterdiabatic topological pumping
articles.title_zh: 动态鲁棒的反绝热拓扑泵浦
articles.abstract: Author(s): Joshua Chiel, Christopher Jarzynski, and Jay Sau Adiabatic Thouless pumps, which undergird the modern theory of polarization, have potential applications ranging from metrology to adiabatic quantum computing. Here, the authors use counterdiabatic driving to develop a non-adiabatic Thouless pump. Their analytic model, which has only nearest neighbor interactions, exhibits exactly quantized charge pumping that is topologically robust to disorder, and dynamically robust to disorder and noise for sufficiently rapid driving – which the authors demonstrate is a universal feature of counterdiabatic driving. The fast, robust and locally tuned pump cycle also models qubit flips, which may have quantum hardware applications. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 154308] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了一种基于反绝热驱动的非绝热Thouless泵。作者的解析模型仅包含最近邻相互作用，展现出精确量子化的电荷泵浦，该泵浦对无序具有拓扑鲁棒性，并且在足够快的驱动下对无序和噪声具有动态鲁棒性。这种快速、鲁棒且局部可调的泵浦循环也模拟了量子比特翻转，可能在量子硬件中具有应用潜力。
authors: Joshua Chiel, Christopher Jarzynski, and Jay Sau

articles.title: Entanglement structure across Zₙ phase transitions in one-dimensional Rydberg atom arrays
articles.title_zh: 一维里德堡原子阵列中Zₙ相变下的纠缠结构
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hyeonjun Yeo, Kabgyun Jeong, and Hyunchul Nha Multipartite quantum entanglement plays a crucial role in the emergence of quantum phases and their transitions in quantum many-body systems. It is of general interest to know what sort of analysis on quantum entanglement can bring us a profound insight to understand the rich dynamics of quantum man… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033371] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 多体量子纠缠在量子多体系统的量子相及其相变中扮演着关键角色。该研究旨在探索量子纠缠分析如何为理解量子多体系统的丰富动力学提供深刻见解。具体而言，文章聚焦于一维里德堡原子阵列中Zₙ相变下的纠缠结构。
authors: Hyeonjun Yeo, Kabgyun Jeong, and Hyunchul Nha

articles.title: Exact quantum transport in non-Markovian open Gaussian systems
articles.title_zh: 非马尔可夫开放高斯系统中的精确量子输运
articles.abstract: Author(s): Guglielmo Pellitteri, Vittorio Giovannetti, and Vasco Cavina We build an exact framework to evaluate heat, energy, and particle transport between Gaussian reservoirs mediated by a quadratic quantum system. By combining full counting statistics with newly developed non-Markovian master equation approaches, we introduce an effective master equation whose soluti… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 144308] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个精确框架，用于评估由二次量子系统介导的高斯储层之间的热量、能量和粒子输运。通过结合全计数统计和新开发的非马尔可夫主方程方法，作者引入了一个有效的主方程。该工作为理解非马尔可夫开放系统中的量子输运提供了理论工具。
authors: Guglielmo Pellitteri, Vittorio Giovannetti, and Vasco Cavina

articles.title: Ab initio quantum embedding description of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene at even-integer fillings
articles.title_zh: 偶数填充下魔角扭曲双层石墨烯的从头算量子嵌入描述
articles.abstract: Author(s): Raehyun Kim, Woochang Kim, Kevin D. Stubbs, Steven G. Louie, and Lin Lin The correlated phase diagram of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) is very sensitive to both material parameters and modeling choices. To limit the impact of these factors, here, the authors propose an embedding workflow for modeling MATBG and other moiré materials that incorporates automatic gauge fixing and is consistent with a b i n i t i o density functional theory. Using this workflow, the authors find that in MATBG, the Hartree-Fock ground state at ν = − 2 is a fragile semimetal with intervalley coherence. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 185131] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）的关联相图对材料参数和建模选择非常敏感。为减少这些因素的影响，作者提出了一种用于建模MATBG和其他莫尔材料的嵌入工作流，该工作流结合了自动规范固定并与从头算密度泛函理论一致。利用此工作流，作者发现MATBG在ν = − 2时的Hartree-Fock基态是一种具有谷间相干性的脆弱半金属。
authors: Raehyun Kim, Woochang Kim, Kevin D. Stubbs, Steven G. Louie, and Lin Lin

articles.title: Universal squeezing-enhanced readout approach for bosonic qubits
articles.title_zh: 玻色子量子比特的通用挤压增强读出方法
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yuan Qiu, Yiming Yu, Ye-Hong Chen, and Yan-Xia In this article, we propose a squeezing-enhanced protocol for the efficient readout of bosonic qubits, whose encoding states can be first mapped onto a multilevel atom and then read out via dispersive coupling. We demonstrate that by simultaneously applying intracavity and external squeezing for the… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033365] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种挤压增强协议，用于玻色子量子比特的高效读出。该协议将玻色子量子比特的编码态首先映射到多能级原子上，然后通过色散耦合进行读出。作者证明，通过同时施加腔内和外部挤压，可以实现读出性能的显著提升。
authors: Yuan Qiu, Yiming Yu, Ye-Hong Chen, and Yan-Xia

articles.title: Emergence of magnetic excitations in one-dimensional quantum mixtures under confinement
articles.title_zh: 限制下的一维量子混合物中磁激发态的出现
articles.abstract: Author(s): P. Capuzzi, P. Vignolo, A. Minguzzi, and S. Musolino We obtain an exact solution for the spectral function for one-dimensional Bose-Bose and Fermi-Fermi mixtures with strong repulsive interactions, valid in arbitrary confining potentials and at all frequency scales. For the case of harmonic confinement, we show that, on top of the ladder structure of … [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033370] Published Mon Sep 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究获得了一维玻色-玻色和费米-费米混合物在强排斥相互作用下的谱函数的精确解，该解适用于任意限制势和所有频率尺度。对于谐波限制的情况，作者展示了磁激发态的出现。这项工作为理解受限量子混合物中的激发态提供了理论基础。
authors: P. Capuzzi, P. Vignolo, A. Minguzzi, and S. Musolino

articles.title: Nonstabilizerness of quantum tensor network states is intractable in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维量子张量网络态的非稳定性是难处理的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonstabilizerness is a necessary resource for quantum systems to lie beyond the classically simulable regime. With the advent of stabilizer α-Rényi entropies, nonstabilizerness has also become a many-body diagnostic, complementary to entanglement. While deciding whether an arbitrary quantum state has nonstabilizerness is provably hard, such states already require a description exponentially large in the number of qubits and are thus out of reach for many-body physics. Here we instead consider 2D tensor network (TN) states, which compactly capture states obeying an entanglement area law, and ask whether they admit a simpler algorithm for the same task. In contrast to the 1D case, we prove that, even at small, constant bond dimension, computing the stabilizer entropy of 2D TN states is # P hard for any integer αge 2, and deciding stabilizer membership is m̊ C₌ P  complete. Hence, under standard complexity assumptions, no classical or quantum algorithm with polynomial resources can solve either problem in the worst case. Both hardness results persist even when the problems are formulated up to constant additive accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 非稳定性是量子系统超越经典可模拟范围的必要资源。本文研究了二维张量网络（TN）态的非稳定性问题。作者证明，即使在小的、常数键维下，计算二维TN态的稳定器α-Rényi熵对于任何整数α≥2都是#P难的，并且判断稳定器成员资格是C=P完全的。这意味着在标准复杂性假设下，没有多项式资源的经典或量子算法能在最坏情况下解决这些问题。
authors: Gianluca Esposito, Georgios Styliaris

articles.title: Emergent cavity-QED dynamics along the edge of a photonic lattice
articles.title_zh: 光子晶格边缘的涌现腔QED动力学
articles.abstract: We investigate qubits coupled to the boundary of a two-dimensional photonic lattice that supports dispersionless edge modes—unlike conventional edge modes that sustain propagating photons. As a case study, we consider a honeycomb lattice (photonic graphene) of coupled resonators with a zigzag edge, where the edge modes form a flat band defined only over a restricted region of momentum space. We show that light–matter interactions are effectively captured by a dissipative cavity-QED model, wherein the emitter coherently couples to a localized mode emerging as a superposition of edge modes. This mode has support on only one sublattice and displays an unconventional power-law localization around the qubit—yet remaining normalizable in the thermodynamic limit—with a spatial range that can be tuned by introducing lattice anisotropy. We predict the occurrence of vacuum Rabi oscillations and state transfer between distant emitters. An experimental demonstration using superconducting circuits is proposed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了耦合到二维光子晶格边界的量子比特，该晶格支持无色散边缘模式。作者发现光-物质相互作用可被耗散腔QED模型有效描述，其中发射器与一个由边缘模式叠加形成的局域模式相干耦合。该模式展现出非传统的幂律局域化，并预测了真空拉比振荡和远距离发射器之间的态转移。文章还提出了使用超导电路进行实验验证的方案。
authors: Enrico Di Benedetto, Xuejian Sun, Marcel A Pinto, Luca Leonforte, Chih-Ying Chang, Vincent Jouanny, Léo Peyruchat, Pasquale Scarlino and Francesco Ciccarello

articles.title: Restricting Trainable Lie-Algebra Growth in Equivariant Quantum Networks via Hierarchical Ancilla-Controlled Subspace Projections
articles.title_zh: 通过分层辅助比特控制子空间投影限制等变量子网络中可训练李代数的增长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equivariant quantum networks encode symmetry as an inductive bias, which can improve generalization and may also favor optimization convergence. Equivariance alone, however, does not constrain the noncommuting closure of trainable generators, and this closure can still grow rapidly in symmetry-preserving variational circuits. We introduce a hierarchical ancilla-controlled architecture that addresses this Lie-algebra-growth mechanism. Commuting invariant-sector projectors on the data register select parameterized operations on a shared ancilla register, where the noncommuting trainable dynamics is confined. The trainable circuit decomposes into compatible joint sectors, giving a sector-probability-weighted ancilla response and an explicit view of parameter sharing across hierarchical paths. For an ancilla dimension d_A=2^m and Kₑₗₗ retained layer-wise control modes, we prove the group-independent bound dim(mathfrak g)łe (d_A²⁻¹⁾prodₑₗₗ₌₁L(Kₑₗₗ₊₁₎. The bound is polynomial in the number of data qubits when m and Kₑₗₗ remain constant along a logarithmic-depth hierarchy. Particle-number and parity projectors illustrate the general construction, while a fixed Clebsch--Gordan coupling tree supplies a concrete SU(2) realization with rotation-invariant scalar outputs. Finite-size state-vector simulations exhibit slower gradient-variance decay and larger initialization gradients than generic and conventional rotationally equivariant circuits over the studied system sizes. The same realization fits sparse rotation-invariant classification tasks and geometry-dependent Heisenberg ground-state energies. These results support restricted trainable Lie-algebra growth as a structural strategy for initialization trainability in the regimes considered here.
articles.abstract_zh: 等变量子网络将对称性编码为归纳偏置，有助于提高泛化能力和优化收敛。然而，仅等变性不足以限制可训练生成器的非交换闭包增长。本文引入了一种分层辅助比特控制架构来解决这一李代数增长机制，将非交换可训练动力学限制在共享辅助寄存器上。该方法为辅助比特维度和控制模式数量给出了一个与群无关的界限，并在特定条件下该界限是数据量子比特数量的多项式。
authors: Ting Li, Zhiming Xiao, Qibiao Tang

articles.title: Three-uniform edge-ordered hypergraph quantum states: entanglement and its relation to hypergraph properties
articles.title_zh: 三均匀边序超图量子态：纠缠及其与超图性质的关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The encoding of 3-uniform edge-ordered weighted hypergraphs into multiqubit quantum states is proposed. We derive an analytical expression for the geometric measure of entanglement of hypergraph quantum states and establish its relation to hypergraph properties. The results establish a direct connection between the local structure of hypergraphs, hyperedge weights, and the entanglement of the corresponding quantum states. For equally weighted hypergraphs, it is shown that the entanglement depends explicitly on the vertex degree. The dependence of entanglement on hypergraph parameters is studied analytically and using quantum computing. Hypergraph states associated with chain, star, regular lattice, and binary-tree hypergraphs are examined, and their entanglement is quantified using quantum computing. These results open up the possibility of studying hypergraph properties with quantum programming.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种将三均匀边序加权超图编码为多量子比特量子态的方法。作者推导了超图量子态几何纠缠度的一个解析表达式，并建立了其与超图性质之间的关系。研究结果揭示了超图的局部结构、超边权重与相应量子态纠缠之间的直接联系。该工作还利用量子计算量化了链、星、正则格和二叉树超图的纠缠，为通过量子编程研究超图性质开辟了可能性。
authors: N. A. Susulovska, Kh. P. Gnatenko

articles.title: Construction of Partial Join Graphs with Perfect State Transfer in Shunt Decomposition-Based Quantum Walks
articles.title_zh: 基于分流分解的量子行走中具有完美态转移的部分连接图的构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we define directed partial join graphs with signed couplings and construct discrete-time quantum-walk transition operators for these graphs using the shunt-decomposition framework. The resulting transition operators apply to several important graph families, including complete graphs with loops, circulant partial joins, complete bipartite graphs, tensor powers of complete bipartite graphs, all with signed couplings. For each family, we identify the corresponding structure of the transition operator and derive necessary and sufficient conditions for periodicity and perfect state transfer (PST), when one of the two directed regular graphs admits PST. Based on these results, we identify two types of state transfer; internal PST, which occurs between vertices within the same graph, and coupling PST, which occurs between two components of join graphs. We further develop a double-cover construction for directed partial join graphs and derive conditions for periodicity and PST when the associated transition operators do not necessarily commute. Using this construction, we establish PST results for double covers of complete graphs with loops. In particular, we provide an example in which the complete graph (Kₙ) does not exhibit PST for (n≥4), whereas a suitable partial join of (Kₙ) exhibits PST when (n=2^m), (m≥2). Hence, these results extend the class of graph families admitting PST in shunt-decomposition-based quantum walks and provide a unified framework for studying quantum state transfer in graph joins, products, and covers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文定义了带符号耦合的有向部分连接图，并利用分流分解框架构建了这些图的离散时间量子行走转移算子。研究为多种重要图族导出了周期性和完美态转移（PST）的充要条件，并区分了内部PST和耦合PST两种类型。此外，作者还开发了有向部分连接图的双覆盖构造，并在此基础上建立了完全图双覆盖的PST结果。
authors: Banita Katuwal, Y Lakshmi Naidu, Srinath M S, Supriyo Dutta

articles.title: Encryptability As a Coordinate Choice: Depth-One Homomorphic Federated Learning of Quantum Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 可加密性作为坐标选择：量子神经网络的深度一态同态联邦学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30581v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Encrypted training relies on keeping server-side updates low-degree. This constraint traditionally excludes models whose weights inhabit a compact Lie group (notably variational quantum circuits, where every trainable weight is an SU(2) rotation). Expressed in Euler angles or discrete alphabets, these updates appear transcendental, historically demanding prohibitive costs: one client--server round per gate, or upwards of 25,000 operations per weight. This penalty is strictly an artefact of coordinates. In the unit-quaternion (spin) chart, group composition is exactly bilinear (degree two, with coefficients in -1,0,+1). Consequently, encrypted rotation updates cost one multiplicative level and federated averaging costs zero in any levelled homomorphic scheme, completely eliminating bootstrapping. This implementation-independent algebraic property is confirmed across two cryptographic backends, introducing only 0.0 and -2.0×10⁻¹² rad of aggregation error. Leveraging this reduction yields a non-interactive protocol for encrypted federated training of hybrid quantum--classical networks. It includes correctness proofs for aggregation and sign handling, plus a compilation lemma proving parameterised entanglers add only constant-factor overhead without altering the depth class. Empirically, a paired five-seed study confirms zero measurable utility tax (Δ=+9×10⁻⁶ MSE, p=0.92), and a noise-budget ablation falsifies the hypothesis that encryption noise regularises. These convergence trends replicate across datasets and scale to 20 clients. Finally, hardware validation on a 156-qubit processor achieves 0.9918 fidelity against a 0.99957 unencrypted control.
articles.abstract_zh: 加密训练要求服务器端更新保持低度数，这传统上排除了权重位于紧李群的模型，如变分量子电路。本文指出，这种限制是坐标选择的产物，在单位四元数表示下，群组合是精确双线性的。因此，加密旋转更新仅需一个乘法级别，联邦平均成本为零，从而消除了自举需求。该研究利用这一简化提出了一个非交互式协议，用于混合量子-经典网络的加密联邦训练。
authors: Marcel Mordarski, Nathan Mani, Arshad Patel, William Knottenbelt, Roberto Bondesan

articles.title: A Novel q-Derivative Framework with Applications to q-Deformed Thermodynamics and Leakage Suppression in Superconducting Qubits
articles.title_zh: 一种新颖的q-导数框架及其在q-形变热力学和超导量子比特泄漏抑制中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a new q-derivative operator built directly from Jackson's q-number formulation, designed to preserve the structural properties of standard differential calculus while incorporating deformation effects. By analyzing q-deformed Heisenberg algebras, we demonstrate that this formulation maintains the consistency of thermodynamic quantities-such as internal energy, particle number, and specific heat-in dilute gas limits without requiring ad-hoc chain-rule modifications. Furthermore, we explore the physical implications of algebraic deformation using the Biedenharn-Macfarlane realization, showing how q-deformation induces intrinsic anharmonicity in quantum oscillator spectra and affects multi-level quantum systems (d ge 3). Applying this algebraic scheme to superconducting transmon qubits, we derive analytical pulse-shaping corrections that generalize the Derivative Removal by Adiabatic Gate (DRAG) technique, offering a robust method to suppress computational leakage in ultra-fast quantum logic operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Jackson q-数公式的新型q-导数算子，旨在在保持标准微分演算结构特性的同时引入形变效应。该框架在稀薄气体极限下保持了热力学量的一致性，并通过Biedenharn-Macfarlane实现揭示了q-形变对量子振子谱和多能级量子系统的影响。此外，作者将此代数方案应用于超导transmon量子比特，推导了广义的DRAG技术脉冲整形校正，为超快量子逻辑操作中的计算泄漏抑制提供了一种鲁棒方法。
authors: André A. A. Marinho, Gisele B. Freitas, Clovis A. C. Filho

articles.title: A Generalized Stein Lemma for Quantum Channels
articles.title_zh: 量子信道的广义Stein引理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove a generalized quantum Stein lemma for parallel discrimination of an arbitrary finite-dimensional channel against families of alternative channels. The alternatives are compact and convex, closed under tensor products, and contain a faithful replacer. At every fixed type-I error tolerance, the optimal type-II error exponent equals the regularized Umegaki channel relative entropy minimized over the alternatives, and both defining limits exist. Inputs may be entangled across channel uses and with a reference system. The main technical result constructs exactly trace-preserving approximations with exponentially small diamond error, dominated in completely positive order by free channels at every rate above the common exponent. The proof combines uniform auxiliary map approximation, iterative reduction of the domination rate, and tensor amplification. It yields asymptotic equipartition with trace-preserving smoothing at every subexponentially vanishing error, an exponential strong converse, and stability under vanishing diamond-norm perturbations. Under additional permutation invariance and closure under insertion of a fixed faithful input state and discarding of its output, we also prove an explicit finite-block completion bound. This quantitative construction uses weighted discarding, local operator corrections, and comparison with auxiliary extensions. Applications include state-preserving, coherence-restricted, covariant, entanglement-breaking, and positive-partial-transpose channels. For isometric targets against entanglement-breaking or positive-partial-transpose alternatives, we obtain exact finite-block testing and smoothing formulas.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了一个广义的量子Stein引理，用于并行判别任意有限维信道与一系列备选信道。在每个固定的第一类错误容忍度下，最优的第二类错误指数等于在备选信道上最小化的正则化Umegaki信道相对熵。该研究的主要技术成果是构建了具有指数级小钻石误差的精确保迹近似，并结合了辅助映射近似、支配率迭代降低和张量放大等方法。
authors: Minbo Gao, Zhengfeng Ji, Chenghua Liu

articles.title: Classification of Generalised Triorthogonal Codes through Length 54
articles.title_zh: 长度达54的广义三正交码分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic state distillation is a widely considered primitive in fault-tolerant quantum computation for the preparation of high-fidelity non-Clifford resources. The most commonly considered class of such protocols are generalised triorthogonal codes; these distil n noisy input T states into purified third-level diagonal magic states. Extensive prior work has searched this space of protocols, often using heuristic methods that do not guarantee optimality. Existing classification work is limited to protocols distilling k output T states with n+kłeq 38 (Nezami and Haah, Phys. Rev. A 106, 012437 (2022)). In this work, we significantly expand this classification to all protocols with lengths nłeq 54. We restrict to distance d≥ 3 to keep the classification to a sensible size, and because efficient searches are well understood at distance 2 (Singh et al., arXiv:2606.28518). Moreover, our results are complementary to synthillation (Campbell and Howard, Phys. Rev. A 95, 022316 (2017)), which can distil third-level states from T states, but only at distance 2. Under optimality in terms of input count, space footprint, and distance for a given output, we find 74 optimal generalised triorthogonal protocols in our range, 65 of which are new to the literature. To achieve our classification, we extend the classification of unital triorthogonal spaces of Nezami and Haah from length 38 to 54 using a directional derivative method. Using these as the stabiliser spaces, we add logical rows that satisfy the triorthogonality constraints to create full protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔术态蒸馏是容错量子计算中制备高保真非Clifford资源的关键原语。本文将广义三正交码的分类范围显著扩展到长度n≤54的所有协议，并限制距离d≥3。这项工作补充了现有研究，并为在给定输出条件下，输入计数、空间占用和距离方面的最优性提供了新的见解。
authors: Adam Wills, Shubham P. Jain, Shraddha Singh

articles.title: From Received Power to Certified Secret Keys: A General Method for Bridging Classical FSO Link Budgets and Decoy-State QKD
articles.title_zh: 从接收功率到认证密钥：连接经典FSO链路预算与诱骗态QKD的通用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Received optical power determines photon arrival flux, but photon arrival flux does not certify a quantum key. This paper gives a deployment-independent interface from a classical free-space optical (FSO) link budget to phase-randomized weak coherent pulse BB84, decoy-state estimation, and composable finite-key postprocessing. The channel interface separates geometric collection, atmospheric extinction, residual pointing, and detector efficiency, and states when common geometric and pointing expressions are approximations. The finite-key output follows the decoy-state analysis of Lim et al., with key- and test-basis counts estimated separately and an infinite-decoy asymptotic reference. The numerical study covers a five-level attenuation sweep, basis- and vacuum-probability sensitivities, a conditional Chernoff comparison, and integer-count Monte Carlo. For 3.33 × 10⁸ emitted pulses, the Hoeffding-based predicted one-kilobit-per-second distance limits are 2.727, 1.883, 1.472, 1.236, and 0.962 km from very clear to dense-fog parameterizations. These are conditional performance predictions, not experimental security certificates. Satellite, drone, high-altitude-platform, terrestrial, and train links enter through the same interface but require their own propagation, acquisition, and device inputs. The framework integrates established security tools into an engineering procedure without claiming a new security proof or a universal range.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种与部署无关的接口，将经典自由空间光（FSO）链路预算与相位随机弱相干脉冲BB84、诱骗态估计和可组合有限密钥后处理联系起来。该信道接口分离了几何收集、大气消光、残余指向和探测器效率等因素。数值研究涵盖了多级衰减扫描和概率敏感性分析，并预测了在不同天气条件下每秒千比特的距离限制。
authors: Hasan Abbas Al-Mohammed

articles.title: Preparation Changes the Cost of Calibration for Quantum Control
articles.title_zh: 制备方式改变量子控制校准的成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Error-correction records can reveal noise yet supply the information needed for control too slowly. In a surface code under Gaussian dephasing, encoded calibration learns a correlation that reverses the preferred control mainly through rare events. A product probe exposes it more often through the same checks, reducing ideal-record sample complexity from inverse-square to inverse-linear in phase variance. Counting both calibration and execution costs, we show that this gain can repay probe overhead and enable protected tasks within budgets that exclude encoded calibration.
articles.abstract_zh: 错误校正记录虽然能揭示噪声，但提供控制信息的速度过慢。本文研究了高斯退相干下表面码的校准问题，发现通过引入乘积探针可以更频繁地暴露相关性，从而将理想记录的样本复杂度从相位方差的平方反比降低到线性反比。该研究表明，这种增益可以弥补探针开销，并在排除编码校准的预算内实现受保护的任务。
authors: Xiu-Hao Deng

articles.title: Non-factor quantum dynamics and relativity
articles.title_zh: 非因子量子动力学与相对论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the effect of relativistic principles on the structure of the local evolutions of non-factor quantum systems such as those which naturally arise in quantum spacetimes and causal structures. Generalising a former result that had been given for factor systems, we show that any evolution which can be applied locally on a direct sum of factor systems and without producing superluminal signals must be linear, unitary, and respect the block decomposition of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了相对论原理对非因子量子系统局部演化结构的影响，这类系统自然出现在量子时空和因果结构中。研究推广了因子系统的一个先前结果，表明任何可以在因子系统直和上局部应用且不产生超光速信号的演化，都必须是线性的、幺正的，并尊重系统的块分解。
authors: Octave Mestoudjian, Matt Wilson

articles.title: Solving Graph Coloring Problems Using Feedback-Based Algorithm for Quantum Optimization
articles.title_zh: 使用基于反馈的量子优化算法解决图着色问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The feedback-based algorithm for quantum optimization (FALQON), which is an extension of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA), is a promising approach for finding approximate solutions to combinatorial optimization problems. The FALQON avoids the optimization of variational parameters by using information derived from iterative measurements. To solve a constrained combinatorial optimization problem, it is sometimes more efficient to use an XY mixer rather than the conventional X mixer. We applied the FALQON with the XY mixer to graph coloring and investigated the expectation value of the problem Hamiltonian, success probability of graph coloring, and fair sampling for several small-scale problems. The FALQON with the XY mixer exhibited better performance than that with the X mixer.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于反馈的量子优化算法（FALQON）是量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的扩展，为组合优化问题提供了一种有前景的近似解法。本文将带有XY混合器的FALQON应用于图着色问题，并研究了问题哈密顿量的期望值、图着色的成功概率和公平采样。结果表明，带有XY混合器的FALQON比传统X混合器表现出更好的性能。
authors: Yuika Kawatomi, Yukina Tatsuta, Kazue Kudo

articles.title: When Can Quantum Extreme Learning Machines Replace Quantum Reservoirs?
articles.title_zh: 量子极限学习机何时能取代量子储备池？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum reservoir computers (QRCs) retain information from earlier inputs, whereas reset-window quantum extreme learning machines (QELMs) start afresh and receive only a recent input window. We establish when this window can replace the reservoir's memory. Under our stated assumptions and with exact expectation values, sufficiently expressive QELMs can reproduce reservoir outputs arbitrarily accurately as their windows grow precisely when the influence of the omitted past becomes uniformly negligible. However, longer windows do not always solve the problem. We construct a simple two-qubit reservoir that performs temporal recall exactly, while every fixed-window predictor faces the same positive worst-case error over unbounded delays, regardless of model capacity. Analytical benchmarks and simulations distinguish missing history from limited features and finite measurements. The central conclusion is simple: better representations can improve how available information is used, but cannot recover a past the model never receives.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子极限学习机（QELMs）何时能替代量子储备池（QRCs）的记忆功能。研究发现，在特定假设下，当被忽略的过去信息影响变得可以忽略时，足够表达力的QELMs可以通过增加输入窗口来精确复现储备池的输出。然而，更长的窗口并非总能解决问题，因为模型无法恢复其从未接收到的历史信息。
authors: Markus Baumann, Gerhard Stenzel, Jonas Stein, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien

articles.title: Computational aberration-retrieval with entangled photons
articles.title_zh: 基于纠缠光子的计算像差恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adaptive optics (AO) is central to high-resolution microscopy, yet conventional implementations often require repeated correction-and-measurement cycles whose number increases with aberration complexity. This measurement burden can become prohibitive when the available temporal window for correction is short or when photon budgets are constrained. Here, we demonstrate an AO strategy that exploits the spatial correlations of entangled photon pairs to retrieve aberrations directly. By using the second-order correlation function as an aberration-sensitive metric, the required correction can be determined with only a few measurements, without relying on image-based feedback or iterative optimization. This correlation-based approach establishes an efficient framework for AO leveraging quantum light, offering a new route toward quantum-enhanced microscopy in regimes where conventional correction strategies become challenging.
articles.abstract_zh: 自适应光学（AO）在高分辨率显微镜中至关重要，但传统方法常因像差复杂性而导致测量负担过重。本文展示了一种利用纠缠光子对空间相关性直接恢复像差的AO策略。通过使用二阶相关函数作为像差敏感度量，只需少量测量即可确定所需的校正，无需图像反馈或迭代优化。这种基于相关性的方法为利用量子光进行AO提供了一个高效框架，为量子增强显微镜开辟了新途径。
authors: Baptiste Courme, YoonSeok Baek, Hugo Defienne

articles.title: Modeling quantum neural network gradient with reinforcement learning
articles.title_zh: 基于强化学习的量子神经网络梯度建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31066v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Training quantum neural networks (QNNs) on near-term hardware remains hampered by two compounding difficulties: the exponential vanishing of gradient variance known as the barren plateau, and the O(L ḑot 2ⁿ⁾ time and memory cost of differentiating through an n-qubit, L-layer circuit. We propose RLQ-Grad, a reinforcement-learning-based optimizer in which a classical policy π_φ (a spectrally-normalized PPO agent) learns to propose parameter updates directly, conditioned on the QNN's current parameters, loss, accuracy, and previous update. Because the surrogate gradient is emitted by a classical network rather than obtained by differentiating through the unitary U(θ), its variance is not constrained by the barren plateau concentration bound, and its cost scales with the number of trainable parameters rather than the Hilbert-space dimension. We prove these properties formally and verify them on a hardware-efficient ansatz across four supervised benchmarks with up to n=20 qubits. RLQ-Grad preserves a near-flat gradient-variance curve where backpropagation, parameter-shift, and adjoint differentiation decay by 1 to 2 orders of magnitude. Accounting for the full training pipeline (PPO rollouts, actor-critic updates, and optimizer states), RLQ-Grad needs under 2 MB of memory and runs 2490×, 7876×, and 673× faster per iteration than these three methods at n=20. It improves top-1 accuracy by up to +10% over gradient-based baselines on circuits of up to 12 qubits, and matches dedicated barren plateau mitigation methods on CIFAR-10 at 14 to 20 qubits, where evolutionary and gradient-free optimizers collapse to chance.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对量子神经网络（QNNs）训练中梯度方差指数消失和高计算成本的挑战，本文提出了一种名为RLQ-Grad的强化学习优化器。RLQ-Grad通过一个经典策略网络直接学习参数更新，其代理梯度不受贫瘠高原集中界限的限制，且成本与可训练参数数量而非希尔伯特空间维度成比例。实验结果表明，RLQ-Grad在多达20个量子比特的基准测试中保持了接近平坦的梯度方差曲线，显著优于传统方法。
authors: Nhan Trong Luu, Duong Trung Luu, Nam Ngoc Pham, Thang Cong Truong

articles.title: On the applicability of Kolmogorov's theory of probability to the description of quantum phenomena. Part II: Bell inequalities
articles.title_zh: 关于柯尔莫哥洛夫概率论在描述量子现象中的适用性。第二部分：贝尔不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Among the various "no-go theorems" in the foundations of quantum mechanics, Bell inequalities are among the few, which do not implicitly rely on the mathematical structure of quantum mechanics. Instead, Bell inequalities are commonly understood to rest on Kolmogorov's theory of probability and a "locality" assumption. Physical evidence supporting their violation is hence taken as evidence against at least one of these two assumptions. This work provides a comprehensive analysis of the physical debate on Bell inequalities from the point of view of Kolmogorov's theory of probability, focusing on the Bell-Clauser-Horn-Shimony-Holt inequality (BCHSH inequality). The central contribution is the motivation and mathematical study of the notion of contextuality in Bell experiments: in so-called contextual Bell models the detectors themselves behave randomly and the distribution of the random detector parameters depends on the chosen detector settings. It is shown how even "classical" Bell experiments motivate such a description. The need to account for contextuality was pointed out before by de la Peña, Cetto, Brody, Lochak, Bohm, Hiley and others. A broad class of contextual models is proven to satisfy the BCHSH inequality, thereby generalizing a previous result by Gill and Lambare. Nonetheless, even under strong locality requirements, contextual Bell models may violate the BCHSH inequality: based on work by Popescu and Rohrlich, we consider a "proof of concept" example exhibiting the maximum possible violation. Contrary to the much debated "loopholes" in empirical tests of Bell inequalities, contextuality thus reveals a conceptual misunderstanding in the physical conclusions commonly drawn from Bell inequality violations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从柯尔莫哥洛夫概率论的角度，对贝尔不等式相关的物理争议进行了全面分析，重点关注贝尔-克劳泽-霍恩-希莫尼-霍尔特（BCHSH）不等式。研究的核心贡献在于对贝尔实验中情境性概念的动机和数学研究。文章指出，在情境性贝尔模型中，探测器本身随机行为，且随机探测器参数的分布取决于所选的探测器设置，甚至经典贝尔实验也支持这种描述。
authors: Maik Reddiger

articles.title: Supporting functionals and singular boundary geometry of two-qubit entanglement of formation
articles.title_zh: 双量子比特形成纠缠的支撑泛函与奇异边界几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a criterion for the existence of a global supporting affine functional for the entanglement of formation at an entangled two-qubit state. It exists if and only if the spin-flip bilinear form is nondegenerate on the support of the state, or equivalently, if the last concurrence root associated with the support is nonzero. In this case the entanglement of formation is locally Lipschitz continuous. In the degenerate case the state has rank two or three, and its projective support is tangent to the product-state quadric. For suitable perturbations outside the support, the entanglement of formation decreases as the square root of the mixing parameter. The leading term is obtained explicitly. This square-root decrease violates the one-sided Lipschitz bound required for a global supporting affine functional.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个判据，用于判断纠缠双量子比特态的形成纠缠是否存在全局支撑仿射泛函。该泛函存在当且仅当自旋翻转双线性形式在态的支撑上是非退化的，或者等价地，与支撑相关的最后一个并发根不为零。在退化情况下，态的秩为二或三，且其投影支撑与乘积态二次曲面相切。研究发现，在支撑外部的适当扰动下，形成纠缠会以混合参数的平方根形式减小，这种平方根减小违反了全局支撑仿射泛函所需的一侧Lipschitz界限。
authors: Wei Song, Xiao-Lan Zong

articles.title: Optical characterization of excited-state spin Hamiltonians and clock transitions at telecommunication wavelength in Tm3+:YAlO3
articles.title_zh: Tm3+:YAlO3中激发态自旋哈密顿量和电信波长时钟跃迁的光学表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The zero-phonon line (ZPL) between the two excited-state manifolds 3F4 and 3H4 of the trivalent thulium ion in yttrium aluminum perovskite (Tm3+:YAlO3) lies within the telecom E-band at around 1451 nm and exhibits an optical coherence time of a few μs at cryogenic temperatures. To improve this time in view of potential applications, e.g. single-photon sources and optical quantum memory, we characterized the magnetic properties of the lowest Stark levels of these two manifolds. Varying the external magnetic field amplitude and orientation, we measured the enhanced nuclear Zeeman splitting by probing the field-dependent frequency detuning of side holes created by means of spectral hole burning, and we characterized the inhomogeneous line shift caused by the quadratic Zeeman interaction. Together, this allowed us to establish the spin Hamiltonians for the lowest Stark level of the 3F4 and 3H4 manifolds, and to predict optical clock transitions for particular orientations and magnitudes of the magnetic field
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在低温下对Tm3+:YAlO3中三价铥离子3F4和3H4激发态流形之间的零声子线进行了光学表征，该零声子线位于电信E波段（约1451 nm），并表现出微秒级的相干时间。为改善其在单光子源和光量子存储等应用中的性能，研究人员通过光谱烧孔技术测量了增强的核塞曼分裂和二次塞曼相互作用引起的非均匀线位移。这些测量结果使得研究人员能够建立3F4和3H4流形最低斯塔克能级的自旋哈密顿量，并预测特定磁场方向和强度下的光学时钟跃迁。
authors: Akshay Babu Karyath, Luozhen Li, Julien Bertrand, Alexandre Kings, Tianyang Shen, Gabriel Aeppli, Simon Gerber, Guy Matmon, Wolfgang Tittel

articles.title: Bypassing no-go theorems on mixed classical-quantum systems: the (counter)example of hybrid van Hove theory
articles.title_zh: 规避混合经典-量子系统中的“不可能定理”：混合范霍夫理论的（反）例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by models of mixed quantum-classical hybrid theories, we consider the representation of classical observables as Hilbert-space operators based on van Hove's unitary representation of contact transformations. This leads to a reformulation of classical mechanics where the phase space density satisfies the Liouville equation and, more importantly, classical observables are represented by van Hove operators that satisfy a commutation algebra isomorphic to the classical Poisson algebra of functions in phase space. Thus, this Hilbert space approach captures all the essential features of the phase space formulation of classical mechanics in that it reproduces its algebraic structure -- something that is not achieved by other approaches such as the Koopman-von Neumann theory. As an important feature, the definition of appropriate physical states in this formalism imposes certain natural requirements on the phase of the classical wave function, which ensure correct expectation values for the observables. Furthermore, we discuss how to extend the approach to the hybrid van Hove theory of mixed classical-quantum systems and illustrate its application with the example of interacting classical and quantum oscillators. Finally, we focus on the question of how hybrid van Hove theory evades no-go theorems on mixed classical-quantum systems and point to the various assumptions of the no-go theorems that do not apply to our approach. This demonstrates that these no-go theorems are not universally applicable, contrary to their original claims.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文受混合量子-经典混合理论模型的启发，基于范霍夫接触变换的酉表示，将经典可观测量表示为希尔伯特空间算符。这种方法重新构建了经典力学，其中相空间密度满足刘维尔方程，且经典可观测量由满足与经典泊松代数同构的对易代数的范霍夫算符表示。该希尔伯特空间方法成功再现了经典力学的代数结构，克服了其他方法（如Koopman-von Neumann理论）的不足。此外，文中还讨论了如何将该方法扩展到混合经典-量子系统的混合范霍夫理论。
authors: Marcel Reginatto, Andrés Darío Bermúdez Manjarres, Sebastian Ulbricht

articles.title: Distinct Feedback-Strength Requirements for Quantum-State Ensemble Preparation under Channel-Equivalent Monitoring
articles.title_zh: 信道等效监测下量子态系综制备的不同反馈强度要求
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Different measurements of the same environment can preserve the average quantum channel yet change the feedback strength needed to prepare a state ensemble. We establish this distinction for a multiqubit register under complete Pauli monitoring, targeting the uniform ensemble of real-amplitude pure states. With unit detection efficiency, public records, and bounded Hamiltonian feedback, fixed transverse noise requires a minimum peak strength proportional to ϵ⁻¹ at distributional error ϵ. Tangent noise instead admits a construction requiring only O[sqrtłog(1/ϵ)]. At fixed preparation time, we determine the optimum over all allowed feedback policies and derive a geometric lower bound beyond radial symmetry. The separation identifies the measurement realization as part of the control-resource specification for monitored ensemble preparation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究发现，对同一环境的不同测量可以保持平均量子信道不变，但会改变制备量子态系综所需的反馈强度。研究人员针对在完全泡利监测下的多量子比特寄存器，以实振幅纯态的均匀系综为目标，建立了这种区别。结果表明，在固定制备时间下，横向噪声需要与分布误差ϵ的倒数成比例的最小峰值强度，而切向噪声仅需O[sqrtłog(1/ϵ)]。这项工作将测量实现确定为受监测系综制备中控制资源规范的一部分。
authors: Haitao Huang, Qinglin Zhao, Xiaoyu Li

articles.title: Chiral Transfer and Entanglement Generation of Even-Parity Bell States with Engineered Two-Photon Loss
articles.title_zh: 利用工程化双光子损耗实现偶宇称贝尔态的手性转移与纠缠生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate chiral transfer and dissipative generation of even-parity Bell states in a two-qubit system with coherent two-photon driving and engineered two-photon loss. We find that adiabatic encirclement of a second-order exceptional point induces direction-dependent transfer between the Bell states |Φ⁺ångle and |Φ⁻ångle, governed by a time-integrated low-loss branch-selection mechanism. We develop a hybrid-Liouvillian description with a control parameter q that interpolates between conditional no-jump dynamics and unconditional Lindblad evolution, and use it to assess how exceptional-point-induced chirality survives in the presence of quantum jumps. When the same parameter loop is initialized in the separable state |00ångle, it directly generates strong even-parity entanglement. Together, these results extend dissipative Bell-state control beyond the single-excitation manifold. They further demonstrate that exceptional-point-based protocols can unify chiral state transfer and entanglement generation within a single engineered two-photon platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在具有相干双光子驱动和工程化双光子损耗的双量子比特系统中，偶宇称贝尔态的手性转移和耗散生成。研究发现，二阶奇异点的绝热环绕诱导了贝尔态|Φ⁺⟩和|Φ⁻⟩之间方向依赖的转移。通过混合Liouvillian描述，该工作评估了量子跳跃存在下奇异点诱导手性的存活情况。当参数循环从可分离态|00⟩开始时，可以直接生成强偶宇称纠缠，这表明基于奇异点的协议可以在单一工程化双光子平台中统一手性态转移和纠缠生成。
authors: Lin Xiao, Jian Li, Mu Zhou, Bin Wei, Qing-Xu Li, Jia-Ji Zhu

articles.title: Steady--State Current Signatures of Strong Light--Matter Coupling in Single--Molecule Junctions
articles.title_zh: 单分子结中强光-物质耦合的稳态电流特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong light-matter coupling offers exciting opportunities for controlling molecular properties, yet resolving single-molecule behavior from collective effects remains a challenge. Recent experiments in scanning tunneling microscope break junctions (STM-BJs) have demonstrated strong light-matter coupling at the single-molecule level. Because STM-BJs provide direct access to molecular-junction currents, we investigate whether strong coupling leaves a measurable fingerprint in transport, potentially probing polaritonic states beyond optical spectroscopy. Using a semiclassical mapping approach for nonequilibrium quantum transport, we find that steady-state current indeed carries a direct signature of single-molecule strong coupling. We test the robustness of this signature against electrode connectivity, nuclear motion, spatially structured electromagnetic modes, and solvent effects. While environmental factors and nuclear motion reshape the signature, the current is not a passive response but is actively influenced by coupled molecular dynamics. Our work establishes current as a tool to interpret and control strong light-matter interactions in nanoscale junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 强光-物质耦合为控制分子性质提供了新机遇，但从集体效应中分辨单分子行为仍具挑战。本文利用非平衡量子输运的半经典映射方法，研究了扫描隧道显微镜断裂结（STM-BJs）中单分子强光-物质耦合是否在稳态电流中留下可测量的指纹。研究发现，稳态电流确实携带着单分子强耦合的直接特征，并且该特征对电极连接、核运动、空间结构电磁模式和溶剂效应具有鲁棒性。这项工作确立了电流作为解释和控制强光-物质相互作用的工具。
authors: Kritanjan Polley, Norah M. Hoffmann

articles.title: Quantum environment afterglow from broadband excitation spectroscopy in superconducting qubits
articles.title_zh: 超导量子比特中宽带激发光谱的量子环境余辉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31280v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the qubit environment is central to fault-tolerant superconducting quantum computation. Characterization typically relies on relaxation, leaving excitation largely underexplored. Here, we access this information with time-resolved broadband excitation spectroscopy. The resulting qubit excitation spectrum reveals a highly structured landscape, interspersed with cold regions. Combined with postselection, this technique enables full reconstruction of the noise power spectral density (PSD) and separates quantum from classical noise. With feed-forward, it exposes long-lived two-level-systems (TLSs), whose relaxation times span tens of microseconds to milliseconds - uncovering an intrinsic link between the qubit-TLS coupling and TLS relaxation. The data suggest that the long-lived TLSs are intrinsic to the qubit environment, and can cause excitation that lasts for many qubit operation cycles. Consequently, the environment retains a memory of prior dynamics, and properties like gate fidelity become non-Markovian and protocol-dependent. The presented approach enables identifying and bypassing the hidden roadblocks formed by long-lived TLSs in fault-tolerant quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解量子比特环境对于容错超导量子计算至关重要。本文利用时间分辨宽带激发光谱技术，揭示了量子比特激发谱的高度结构化景观，并结合后选择实现了噪声功率谱密度（PSD）的完整重建，从而区分了量子噪声和经典噪声。该方法揭示了长寿命双能级系统（TLSs）的存在，其弛豫时间可达数十微秒至毫秒，揭示了量子比特-TLS耦合与TLS弛豫之间的内在联系。研究表明，这些长寿命TLSs是量子比特环境固有的，并能导致持续多个量子比特操作周期的激发，使得环境保留了先前动态的记忆，门保真度也因此变得非马尔可夫且依赖于协议。
authors: J. R. Guimarães, Y. Liu, Y. Gao, Y. Haddad, A. Galicia, D. A. Volkov, J. T. Schmieder, H. Bhardwaj, M. Neis, J. Cereijo, M. Jerger, P. A. Bushev, R. Barends

articles.title: Residual Fisher Information in Measurement-Error Uncertainty
articles.title_zh: 测量误差不确定性中的残余费雪信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Measurement error in the Watanabe-Sagawa-Ueda formulation is the excess estimation error of a classical record over the quantum statistical limit. We show that, at the quantum-instrument level, this excess has an exact decomposition. The record-only error matrix equals a residual-aware error matrix plus a positive Schur-complement term fixed by Fisher information left in the unread post-measurement system. Thus measurement error separates into intrinsic instrument loss and record-restriction loss
articles.abstract_zh: 在Watanabe-Sagawa-Ueda公式中，测量误差是经典记录相对于量子统计极限的超额估计误差。本文证明，在量子仪器层面，这种超额误差具有精确分解。仅记录误差矩阵等于一个残余感知误差矩阵，加上一个由未读测量后系统中剩余的费雪信息确定的正Schur补项。因此，测量误差可以分解为固有的仪器损失和记录限制损失。
authors: Masayuki Ohzeki, Taiga Suzuki

articles.title: Causal Query Compression for Lindblad Dynamics: Optimal Queries and Nearly Linear Local Simulation
articles.title_zh: Lindblad动力学的因果查询压缩：最优查询与近线性局部模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a causal query compiler for time-dependent Lindblad dynamics and establish query and gate bounds under distinct input models. With coherent block encodings of the Hamiltonian and individual jump operators, a Lipschitz generator can be simulated to diamond-norm error ǎrepsilon using O(1+τ+łog(1/ǎrepsilon)/łog(e+łog(1/ǎrepsilon)/τ)) controlled queries, where τ=T(α_H+sum_μα_μ²⁾. This bound is independent of the time-grid size and is worst-case optimal for τge1. Weak active entry and clean return yield a factorial history tail; combining two reuse lengths removes the auxiliary input. A three-call polar correction supplies the Lindblad cells. The compiler also characterizes the minimum oracle action of bounded adaptive Markovian protocols by quantum query complexity and the general adversary bound, up to constant factors. For finite-range dynamics on n lattice sites, efficient coherent evaluation of the local matrices and fixed local parameters give O(n(T+1)øperatornamepolylogX) elementary gates, where X=maxe,n(T+1)(1+Kₜ₊B)/ǎrepsilon, for piecewise Hölder generators with fixed exponent, local variation bound Kₜ, and at most B breakpoints per term. The jumps need not commute. This gate bound includes evaluation, arithmetic, selection, routing, and environment storage. Its proof combines a spatial decomposition on a common bath, compilation on occupied inputs, and routing on compressed records. Reusing bath storage between short segments gives depth (T+1)øperatornamepolylogX and space nøperatornamepolylogX.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个用于时间依赖Lindblad动力学的因果查询编译器，并在不同输入模型下建立了查询和门限。通过哈密顿量和单个跳跃算符的相干块编码，一个Lipschitz生成器可以被模拟到钻石范数误差ϵ，所需的受控查询次数为O(1+τ+log(1/ϵ)/log(e+log(1/ϵ)/τ))。该编译器还通过量子查询复杂度和通用对抗界限来表征有界自适应马尔可夫协议的最小预言机作用。对于n个格点上的有限范围动力学，高效的局部矩阵相干评估和固定局部参数可以提供O(n(T+1)polylogX)个基本门。
authors: Jacob Kitchen

articles.title: Sharp Data-Processing Region for Quantum Conditional Rényi Entropies
articles.title_zh: 量子条件Rényi熵的精确数据处理区域
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31350v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the three-parameter family of quantum conditional Rényi entropies Hα,z^łambda introduced in Commun. Math. Phys. 407, 180 (2026). We prove that the previously established data-processing region is sharp. We then characterize the club-sandwiched family through a classical coarse-graining principle: within the full data-processing region, universal monotonicity under deterministic coarse-graining of the classical conditioned register holds if and only if z = α. Finally, we establish rigidity of entropic duality by showing that any universal duality relation for finite-dimensional tripartite pure states must satisfy the known parameter relations. Thus, the data-processing region, the club-sandwiched subfamily, and the duality transformation are each uniquely characterized by their respective universal properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在Commun. Math. Phys. 407, 180 (2026)中引入的三参数量子条件Rényi熵Hα,z^λ族，并证明了先前建立的数据处理区域是精确的。研究人员通过经典粗粒化原理表征了“俱乐部夹心”族：在完整数据处理区域内，当且仅当z = α时，经典条件寄存器的确定性粗粒化下的普适单调性成立。最后，通过证明有限维三方纯态的任何普适对偶关系都必须满足已知的参数关系，确立了熵对偶的刚性。
authors: Milad M. Goodarzi, Yucheng Bao, Marco Tomamichel

articles.title: Adaptive Dissipative State Preparation through Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 基于强化学习的自适应耗散态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dissipative algorithms approach the problem of ground state preparation by mimicking the natural thermalization of a quantum system in contact with a large, low-temperature thermal environment. The environment can be efficiently simulated by a single ancilla qubit with a variable energy gap that is repeatedly coupled to the system qubits to generate a dissipative channel, and then reset after each interaction. Here we present an adaptive implementation of the dissipative algorithm, RL-Adapt, that uses single-shot reinforcement learning to optimize the selection of ancilla frequency and system-bath interaction operator to maximize energy dissipation without relying on a priori knowledge of the system spectrum. The adaptive implementation results in significantly reduced convergence times and can successfully find the ground state even for non-ideal operator pools that fail to converge using non-adaptive, uniform random operator and ancilla frequency selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗散算法通过模拟量子系统与低温热环境的自然热化来解决基态制备问题。本文提出了一种自适应耗散算法RL-Adapt，它利用单次强化学习来优化辅助量子比特频率和系统-浴相互作用算符的选择，以最大化能量耗散，而无需先验知识。这种自适应实现显著缩短了收敛时间，即使对于非理想算符池也能成功找到基态，克服了非自适应方法在收敛性上的不足。
authors: Nathan M. Myers, Chenxu Liu, Yulong Dong, Nicholas P. Bauman, Karol Kowalski

articles.title: Quantum algorithms for the exponentiation of Toeplitz matrices and applications in partial differential equations
articles.title_zh: Toeplitz矩阵指数化的量子算法及其在偏微分方程中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31372v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present quantum algorithms to approximate the exponential of banded Toeplitz matrices. These matrices have central importance in many PDE related problems, but their quantum implementation is hindered by their possibly large norms. Constructing directly the exponential we can circumvent this limitation. By relating the lower/upper shift operators to circulant and skewcirculant generators, which are diagonalised by the QFT, we construct (i) an LCU-based block encoding of banded Toeplitz matrices, (ii) an efficient, controllably truncated Pauli-string decomposition of the circulant eigenphases with a closed-form error bound, and (iii) a specialized QFT-Trotter product formula. As an application we build a block encoding of the propagator of the discretised heat equation with periodic, Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, using a frequency cutoff.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了近似带状Toeplitz矩阵指数化的量子算法。通过将下/上移位算符与循环和斜循环生成器相关联，研究人员构建了基于LCU的带状Toeplitz矩阵块编码、循环本征相位的有效可控截断Pa利串分解以及专门的QFT-Trotter乘积公式。作为应用，该工作利用频率截止构建了具有周期性、Dirichlet和Neumann边界条件的离散热方程传播子的块编码。
authors: Xabier Gutiérrez, Nicola Mariella, Javier González-Conde, Sergiy Zhuk, Mikel Sanz

articles.title: Shaping of the finite-size chaos crossover in Floquet circuits by coherent-mismatch architecture
articles.title_zh: 相干失配架构对Floquet电路有限尺寸混沌交叉的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how the spatial profile of a deterministic coherent gate perturbation affects finite-size quasienergy statistics and operator dynamics in U(1)-symmetric XXZ Floquet circuits. Using a shared homogeneous reference, we compare a single modified bond with an alternating perturbation applied across the whole chain. After separating symmetry sectors and checking several known integrable forms, we find that the alternating circuits move toward circular orthogonal ensemble level statistics and change operator-space entanglement and out-of-time-order correlations at smaller local amplitudes than the single defects. For intermediate numbers of modified bonds, the response is nonmonotonic and also depends on where the bonds are placed, so bond density alone is not enough. A perturbative analysis identifies the additive weight of many modified bonds, while coherent spatial interference reshapes the coupling between nearby eigenstates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了确定性相干门微扰的空间分布如何影响U(1)对称XXZ Floquet电路中的有限尺寸准能量统计和算符动力学。通过比较单一修改键与交替微扰，研究发现交替电路在较小局部振幅下能更有效地使能级统计趋向圆正交系，并改变算符空间纠缠和非时序关联。研究还发现，中间数量的修改键的响应是非单调的，且取决于键的位置，表明键密度并非唯一决定因素。
authors: Xiangjun Tan, Wenqi Liu, Hanjie Zhu, Wenkai Bai, Zhanning Wang

articles.title: A Three-Party W-State Quantum Secret Sharing Protocol with X-Gate Encoding and Forbidden-Outcome Detection
articles.title_zh: 一种基于X门编码和禁忌结果检测的三方W态量子秘密共享协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a new three-party quantum secret-sharing (QSS) protocol based on a three-qubit W state. This protocol encodes the secret-sequence bits using X gates and employs randomly selected Hadamard operations and measurement bases to generate information and security-test rounds. We evaluate the efficiency of the proposed protocol and analyze its security against an internal adversary performing intercept-and-resend and entangle-and-measure attacks, deriving the corresponding detection probabilities. The analysis of the entangle-and-measure attack shows that extracting information through an ancillary system leads to a nonzero probability of forbidden outcomes in the test rounds, thereby enabling the detection of the attack. The proposed protocol is implemented in Python using the Qsikit framework and executed on quantum processors. Its performance is evaluated in terms of the quantum bit error rate (QBER) for information rounds under different secret-bit encoding configurations. The experimental results demonstrate that the QBER depends noticeably on the quantum processor used.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的三方量子秘密共享（QSS）协议，该协议基于三量子比特W态，并使用X门编码秘密序列比特。协议通过随机选择的Hadamard操作和测量基来生成信息和安全测试轮次。研究评估了协议的效率，并分析了其对抗内部窃听者进行截获重发和纠缠测量攻击的安全性，发现纠缠测量攻击会导致测试轮次中出现禁忌结果，从而实现攻击检测。该协议已在Python中实现并运行于量子处理器上，实验结果显示量子比特错误率（QBER）显著依赖于所使用的量子处理器。
authors: Timur R. Teregulov, Elena R. Loubenets

articles.title: Connes Distance in Discrete-Time Quantum Walks
articles.title_zh: 离散时间量子行走中的Connes距离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31488v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the geometric spread of discrete-time quantum walks using Connes' distance formula. We introduce its discrete analogue by adapting the continuous spectral metric to the lattice, with the Dirac operator replaced by the unitary step operator. Focusing first on a (2+1)-dimensional quantum walk, we evaluate the dynamical spread of localized wavepackets to compare propagation in free space against that under a uniform magnetic field. We find that while the free walk shows linear ballistic growth, gauge-induced phases in the magnetic walk constrain the admissible test operators, suppressing the long-time geometric expansion. Furthermore, we apply this discrete framework to a (1+1)-dimensional plastic quantum walk simulating an inhomogeneous spatial metric. The results demonstrate that the discrete Connes distance naturally captures the underlying spatially varying metric, providing a robust measure of the wavepacket's spread that adapts directly to the local simulated geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Connes距离公式研究了离散时间量子行走的几何扩散。通过将连续谱度量适应到格点上，并用酉步进算符替换狄拉克算符，引入了其离散模拟。研究发现，在(2+1)维量子行走中，自由行走表现出线性弹道增长，而均匀磁场下的磁性行走则抑制了长期几何扩展。此外，将此离散框架应用于模拟非均匀空间度量的(1+1)维塑性量子行走，结果表明离散Connes距离能自然地捕捉底层空间变化的度量，为波包扩散提供了一种稳健的测量方法。
authors: Rayan Trabelsi, A. F. Reyes-Lega, Pablo Arrighi

articles.title: Parallel and Distributed Fermionic Simulation via Dynamic Encoding
articles.title_zh: 基于动态编码的费米子模拟并行与分布式方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a simple and efficient method to parallelize and distribute Trotterized Hamiltonian simulation of fermionic systems across multiple QPUs. Using combinatorial covering designs to define a minimal set of fermion-qubit encodings, we demonstrate communication cost scaling as O(M r) for a system of M fermionic modes and Trotter number r, improving on the static encoding bound for q QPUs, O(M⁴ q r). We compare this approach to dynamic encoding using a randomised method, Pauli-weight based optimisation and hypergraph partitioning. Applying this to the Hamiltonians of a range of molecular systems, we find the combinatorial covering approach results in the lowest communication cost in all but the sparsest Hamiltonians.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种简单高效的方法，用于在多个QPU上并行和分布式地进行费米子系统的Trotter化哈密顿量模拟。通过使用组合覆盖设计定义最小的费米子-量子比特编码集，该方法将通信成本降低至O(M r)，显著优于静态编码的O(M⁴ q r)界限。与随机方法、基于泡利权重的优化和超图划分等动态编码方法相比，组合覆盖方法在大多数分子系统的哈密顿量模拟中实现了最低的通信成本。
authors: Michael Williams de la Bastida, Peter V. Coveney

articles.title: Complexity Barriers to State Preparation in Quantum Approximate Optimization
articles.title_zh: 量子近似优化中态制备的复杂性障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For many important optimization problems we are restricted to approximate solutions in practice due to computational complexity. Distinct from the exact optimization setting, approximate optimization admits performance measures beyond whether the optimum is found, with different tradeoffs and complexity. For MaxCut, a near-unity (ordinary) approximation ratio can coexist with near-zero improvement (gain) over a random cut. For the standard encoding, the unconditional classical MaxCut-Gain hardness gap implies that emph{any uniformly efficient quantum or hybrid procedure recovering a fixed positive fraction of the optimal classical gain on every input, with at least inverse-polynomial success probability, would place} NP emphin BQP. Such a procedure is therefore believed impossible under standard assumptions. We broadly address where our worst-case barriers do or do not apply across the quantum algorithm landscape. We prove that the barrier survives quantum random access optimization (QRAO) compression and applies between the classical and relaxed optimal values. For every input, a product state attains the classical optimum. Thus the barrier to reaching the classical threshold does not arise from a need for entanglement. For din2,3 variables per qubit, the known decoder transfers encoded energy gain to decoded mean gain by the exact factor 1/d². Combining this identity with MaxCut-Gain hardness gives an operational preparation barrier for QRAO. We also construct hard n-qubit families with relative quantum relaxation excess Θ(1/n), while the maximally mixed state has energy approximation ratio 1-Θ(1/n), zero encoded energy gain, and hence zero decoded mean gain. Our results separate the effects of relaxation tightness and energy approximation from operational accessibility, motivating more comprehensive accounting in benchmarking and performance assessment.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多重要优化问题在实践中受限于计算复杂性，只能寻求近似解。对于MaxCut问题，接近统一的近似比可能与相对于随机割的接近零的改进（增益）并存。研究表明，无条件经典MaxCut-增益硬度差距意味着，任何能以固定正分数恢复最优经典增益的统一高效量子或混合过程，都将把NP置于BQP中，这在标准假设下被认为是不可行的。本文证明了这一障碍在量子随机访问优化（QRAO）压缩中依然存在，并适用于经典和松弛最优值之间。
authors: Stuart Hadfield

articles.title: Quantum-HPC Workflows Across Multiple Quantum Computing Platforms: Two Case Studies
articles.title_zh: 跨多个量子计算平台的量子-HPC工作流：两个案例研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe the Quantum-HPC hybrid system comprising the supercomputer Fugaku, the QPUs Quantinuum Reimei and ibmₖₒbe, and the Tierkreis hybrid workflow software. We present two demonstrations of the system at work. In the first, we compute the excited states of a biomolecular system using Fugaku and Reimei (simulator) to handle classical and quantum parts of the workflow respectively. In the second, Fugaku coordinates Reimei and ibmₖₒbe working together in a combined VQE + QPE workflow to compute the ground state energy of a simple system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个由超级计算机富岳、Quantinuum Reimei和ibmₖₒbe量子处理器以及Tierkreis混合工作流软件组成的量子-HPC混合系统。文章展示了该系统的两个应用案例：首先，利用富岳和Reimei（模拟器）分别处理生物分子系统激发态计算的经典和量子部分；其次，富岳协调Reimei和ibmₖₒbe共同执行VQE+QPE工作流，计算简单系统的基态能量。
authors: Philipp Seitz, Miwako Tsuji, John Children, Yuta Kikuchi, Riku Masui, Juan Pedersen, Kentaro Yamamoto, Ross Duncan

articles.title: Measurement-Based Uncomputation from an Error Correction Perspective
articles.title_zh: 从纠错角度看基于测量的反计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent uncomputation can be as costly as the computation itself, creating substantial spacetime overheads that can be prohibitive on early fault-tolerant quantum computers. We develop an algebraic framework for measurement-based uncomputation (MBU) through a quantum error-correction picture: measurements of the garbage register induce relative phases analogous to errors causing non-trivial syndromes. Accepting only zero-syndrome outcomes achieves post-selected MBU, removing the need for an uncomputation oracle at the cost of a probabilistic success rate determined by the affine rank of the populated garbage support. This rank can be much smaller than the number of garbage qubits, as illustrated through an example of the HHL algorithm. We then derive a structural condition under which the original uncomputation oracle can be reused to correct the phase for all measurement outcomes. No correction is required for the zero syndrome, while corrections for non-zero syndromes can be further adapted to individual measurement outcomes for simpler circuits, as illustrated by existing modular-arithmetic, QROM, and QRAM MBU constructions. Phase-correction circuits can be further simplified by co-optimising their implementation with the representation of the measurement-induced phases. Selecting which syndrome classes to correct interpolates between post-selected, partially corrected, and deterministic MBU, enabling trade-offs among correction cost, workspace, and repetitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干反计算的成本可能与计算本身相当，在早期容错量子计算机上会产生巨大的时空开销。本文通过量子纠错视角，为基于测量的反计算（MBU）开发了一个代数框架。研究表明，垃圾寄存器的测量会引入类似于导致非平凡综合征的相对相位，接受零综合征结果可实现后选择MBU，从而消除了对反计算预言机的需求。文章还推导了一个结构条件，在此条件下原始反计算预言机可用于校正所有测量结果的相位。
authors: Minjun Jeon, Po-Wei Huang, Zhenyu Cai

articles.title: Exact series formulas for the capacities of the amplitude damping channel
articles.title_zh: 振幅阻尼信道容量的精确级数公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive explicit, absolutely convergent series formulas for the quantum, unassisted classical, and entanglement-assisted classical capacities of the qubit amplitude damping channel, eliminating residual optimizations and implicit roots. We also obtain analytical upper and lower bounds on two-way assisted quantum and private communication capacities by evaluating a balanced-squashing bound and optimizing the reverse coherent information. Our results characterize the optimal input populations, establish convergence and truncation properties, and provide analytical benchmarks for quantum and classical communication over dissipative channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了量子比特振幅阻尼信道的量子容量、无辅助经典容量和纠缠辅助经典容量的显式、绝对收敛级数公式，消除了残余优化和隐式根。通过评估平衡挤压界限和优化逆相干信息，还获得了双向辅助量子和私密通信容量的解析上下界。这些结果表征了最优输入态分布，建立了收敛和截断性质，并为耗散信道上的量子和经典通信提供了分析基准。
authors: Stefano Pirandola

articles.title: Generators of stability-preserving semigroups, spectral gaps, and classical ground-state computation
articles.title_zh: 稳定性保持半群的生成元、谱隙和经典基态计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.26802v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We classify the generators of stability-preserving semigroups on polynomial spaces with bounded coordinate degrees. The generators have differential order at most two, with principal coefficients characterized by low-degree nonnegativity conditions. In disk coordinates, positive degree damping gives strict zero-freeness and a sharp spectral gap, extending the Hermitian gap of Bravyi, Gosset, Liu, and Wong to complex generators. The resulting analytic domain yields deterministic classical algorithms for ground energies and stable product-state queries for bounded-degree Suzuki-Fisher Hamiltonians with bounded local strength and fixed positive fields. Field perturbation gives zero-field energy-value approximation schemes for bounded-degree unweighted EPR and bipartite Quantum MaxCut. We also prove that, up to scalars, the Hermitian qubit Hamiltonians whose full Gibbs tensors are Lee-Yang at every temperature in a fixed basis are precisely the edgewise phase-rotated Suzuki-Fisher family. With strictly positive longitudinal fields, these tensors are zero-free on a polydisk of radius greater than one at each positive inverse temperature. These two statements answer questions of Wong, Bravyi, Gosset, and Liu. Degree-preserving, coefficient-positive stability semigroups have concave sector growth rates, yielding token-graph concavity. We also give a counterexample to a proposed explicit ground-state radius.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对有界坐标度多项式空间上稳定性保持半群的生成元进行了分类，发现其微分阶数至多为二，主系数由低阶非负条件表征。在盘坐标系中，正度阻尼提供了严格的无零点性和尖锐的谱隙，将Bravyi等人提出的厄米谱隙扩展到复数生成元。由此产生的解析域为具有有界局部强度和固定正场的有界度Suzuki-Fisher哈密顿量的基态能量和稳定乘积态查询提供了确定性经典算法。
authors: Dongsheng Wei

articles.title: Seasonal and Quantum-inspired Models for Neutron Monitor Time Series Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 中子监测时间序列预测的季节性和量子启发模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30281v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a focused and reproducible study of multi-horizon forecasting on the Lomnicky Stit neutron monitor (LMKS) time series. Our evaluation suite covers simple seasonal baselines, modern deep sequence models, and functional and quantum-inspired architectures, including Seasonal Naive, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), N-BEATS, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), and two quantum-inspired variants, QiLSTM and QiKAN. We describe the dataset characteristics, diagnostic analysis, preprocessing pipeline, and training procedures, and report aggregate point-forecast performance using mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) for all evaluated models. Our quick-run results indicate that the quantum-inspired KAN variant, QiKAN, achieves the lowest aggregate forecasting error among the evaluated configurations, while the simple Seasonal Naive baseline remains remarkably competitive. These results suggest that, for highly periodic scientific monitoring time series, models incorporating strong seasonal or low-dimensional functional priors can match or outperform substantially more complex sequence architectures. The findings motivate further investigation of parsimonious and decomposable function approximators for forecasting periodic scientific signals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对Lomnicky Stit中子监测（LMKS）时间序列的多步预测进行了深入研究。评估套件涵盖了简单的季节性基线、现代深度序列模型以及函数式和量子启发式架构，包括Seasonal Naive、LSTM、TCN、N-BEATS、KAN以及两种量子启发变体QiLSTM和QiKAN。研究结果表明，量子启发式KAN变体QiKAN在所有评估配置中实现了最低的聚合预测误差，而简单的Seasonal Naive基线也表现出显著的竞争力。这些结果表明，对于高度周期性的科学监测时间序列，结合强季节性或低维函数先验的模型可以与更复杂的模型相媲美或超越。
authors: Krishna Bhatia, Shalini Devendrababu, Srinjoy Ganguly

articles.title: Von Neumann's Two Quantum Entropies
articles.title_zh: 冯·诺依曼的两种量子熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30284v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Von Neumann proposed two quantum entropies, one in 1927 and the other in 1929. He intended to define thermodynamic entropy for quantum states in both cases. The 1927 entropy is the well-known von Neumann entropy, which is zero for all pure states. The 1929 entropy, which is nonzero for almost all pure states, has largely been ignored. After reviewing the history and properties of both entropies, we argue that the 1927 entropy is not thermodynamic entropy and should be used simply as a measure of entanglement, whereas the 1929 entropy is the true thermodynamic entropy for quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 冯·诺依曼在1927年和1929年分别提出了两种量子熵，旨在为量子态定义热力学熵。1927年的熵是众所周知的冯·诺依曼熵，纯态下为零；而1929年的熵对几乎所有纯态都非零，但却在很大程度上被忽视。本文回顾了这两种熵的历史和性质，并认为1927年的熵并非热力学熵，应仅作为纠缠的度量，而1929年的熵才是量子态真正的热力学熵。
authors: Biao Wu

articles.title: Synchronizing Spectral and Interference Criticalities at an Exceptional Point
articles.title_zh: 在奇异点处同步谱临界性和干涉临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30311v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are spectral singularities, but whether they can be used to control a distinct criticality of coherent interference remains largely unexplored. Here we show in nonlocal superconducting transport how spectral and interference criticalities can be controllably synchronized. In a minimal superconducting double-quantum-dot system, loss imbalance selectively drives one Bogoliubov sector through an EP. The spectral EP and the CAR-ECT interference criticality form distinct structures in control space whose relative ordering can be continuously tuned. At their synchronization point, the interference boundaries between crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) and elastic cotunneling (ECT) coalesce at the EP and bifurcate beyond it, creating a finite CAR-dominated window. The resulting interference window opens with a square-root critical law, whose exponent also governs the finite-temperature observability scale. Detuning unfolds the two criticalities, while retuning restores their intersection, establishing the synchronization as controlled rather than generic. The bifurcation is directly observable in nonlocal conductance. Our results establish exceptional points as spectral control points for independently defined interference criticalities, opening a route to non-Hermitian control of critical quantum interference.
articles.abstract_zh: 奇异点（EPs）是谱奇点，但其能否用于控制相干干涉的独特临界性仍未被充分探索。本文在非局域超导输运中展示了如何可控地同步谱临界性和干涉临界性。在一个最小的超导双量子点系统中，损耗不平衡选择性地驱动一个Bogoliubov扇区通过EP。在同步点，交叉安德烈夫反射（CAR）和弹性共隧穿（ECT）之间的干涉边界在EP处合并并在此之外分叉，形成一个有限的CAR主导窗口。
authors: Zeng-Zhao Li, Xiao Xue

articles.title: Disentangling the Toric Code
articles.title_zh: 解缠结环面码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Commuting-projector Hamiltonians with integer spectrum such as the 1+1d Ising ferromagnet and the 2+1d toric code may be regarded as the generators of non-on-site U(1) symmetries. In this paper we study whether these symmetries can be made on-site in the presence of finite and infinite-dimensional ancillae. In the finite-dimensional case, we prove that the fractionalized excitations, such as domain walls and anyons, make it impossible to on-site these Hamiltonians. On the other hand, we show that when infinite dimensional ancillae (e.g., rotors) are allowed, both the 1+1d Ising ferromagnet and the 2+1d toric code can be disentangled, yielding on-site symmetries. This is not in contradiction with the non-trivial ground state order of these Hamiltonians, since the ancilla Hamiltonians are no longer bounded from below. Our results indicate agreement between lattice and quantum field theory anomalies in the presence of infinite-dimensional ancillae, while with finite-dimensional ancillae the obstruction to on-siteability may even be non-invertible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有整数谱的对易投影哈密顿量（如1+1维伊辛铁磁体和2+1维环面码）所生成的非局域U(1)对称性，在有限维和无限维辅助比特存在下是否能变为局域对称性。研究发现，在有限维辅助比特情况下，分数化激发使得这些哈密顿量无法局域化。然而，当允许无限维辅助比特时，1+1维伊辛铁磁体和2+1维环面码均可被解缠结，从而产生局域对称性。这些结果表明，在无限维辅助比特存在下，格点和量子场论异常之间存在一致性。
authors: Lei Gioia, Salvatore D. Pace, Ruben Verresen, Shu-Heng Shao, Ryan Thorngren

articles.title: Entanglement transitions in holographic conformal interfaces
articles.title_zh: 全息共形界面中的纠缠相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30369v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study entanglement transitions for pairs of disjoint intervals in two-dimensional holographic interface conformal field theories. We consider several holographic models with equal central charges on the two sides of the interface: thin-wall geometries with one and two branes, the Janus solution, and the super-Janus solution. We first discuss the finite interface contribution to the entanglement entropy of a single interval, distinguishing intervals that cross the interface from those that lie entirely on one side. We then use the mutual information to locate the transition between connected and disconnected Ryu--Takayanagi geodesic configurations for two intervals. When the interface lies between the two intervals, increasing the boundary entropy łog g, which provides a measure of interface strength in the models considered here, generally decreases the critical separation at which the connected configuration ceases to dominate. When both intervals lie on the same side of the interface, the behavior is model dependent: the connected phase persists to larger separations in the Janus and super-Janus models, while the critical separation is unchanged in the thin-wall models. Thus, as diagnosed by the two-interval transition, the interface weakens correlations across the interface while preserving or enhancing correlations between regions on the same side. We also identify a universal ``Silver Blaze'' configuration, in which the interface lies inside one of the intervals and the transition occurs at the same location as in a CFT without an interface, independently of the interface parameters and of the holographic model. This universality follows from a cancellation between crossing and non-crossing interface contributions to the mutual information.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维全息界面共形场论中，一对不相交区间之间的纠缠相变。研究了多种具有相等中心荷的全息模型，包括薄壁几何、Janus解和超Janus解。作者首先讨论了单个区间的纠缠熵中有限界面贡献，并利用互信息确定了两个区间之间Ryu-Takayanagi测地线构型从连接到断开的转变。结果表明，当界面位于两个区间之间时，增加边界熵通常会降低连接构型不再占主导的临界分离距离。
authors: Evangelos Afxonidis, Rotem Berman, Ignacio Carreño Bolla, Shira Chapman, Carlos Hoyos, Osher Shoval

articles.title: Measurement protocol for non-adiabatic geometric phases of Floquet states
articles.title_zh: Floquet态非绝热几何相位的测量方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31052v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Periodically time-dependent quantum systems have Floquet solutions. They consist of a phase factor and a Floquet mode which shares the periodicity of the driving. Consequently, any such solution possesses a non adiabatic geometric phase known as the Aharonov-Anandan (AA) phase. It is gauge-invariant and, therefore, is experimentally accessible. We propose a protocol for the measurement of AA phases based on the adiabatic change of the phase of the non-adiabatic driving. We argue that the experimental requirements of the protocol are those of previous measurements of adiabatic phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性时变量子系统具有Floquet解，其中包含一个相位因子和一个与驱动周期性相同的Floquet模式，从而产生非绝热几何相位，即Aharonov-Anandan (AA) 相位。本文提出了一种基于非绝热驱动相位绝热变化的AA相位测量方案。该方案的实验要求与之前绝热相位的测量要求相似，使得AA相位的实验测量成为可能。
authors: Carlos Martín-Fernández, Gloria Platero, Sigmund Kohler

articles.title: Feedback cooling of a levitated nanoparticle in a radially polarized vector beam trap
articles.title_zh: 径向偏振矢量光束陷阱中悬浮纳米粒子的反馈冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31068v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We demonstrate optical levitation and feedback cooling of a silica nanoparticle (radius = 78~nm) trapped within a radial vector beam (RVB) in high vacuum. Radial vector beams, when focused by a high-NA lens, produce a smaller focal spot than conventional Gaussian beams, yielding tighter optical potentials and potentially reduced photon-recoil heating rates. A vortex wave plate was used to generate the RVB using an aspheric lens (NA = 0.77) to form the trap. Cold-damping feedback was used to cool the center of mass motion in the radial and axial trap directions to temperatures in the mK range. At higher temperatures and pressures, additional trap frequencies arising from the nonlinear RVB optical potential are observed. This demonstration is a step toward exploiting structured light for levitated quantum optomechanics where these traps can be used to suppress bulk and motional heating.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在高真空环境下，利用径向偏振矢量光束（RVB）陷阱对二氧化硅纳米粒子（半径78纳米）进行光学悬浮和反馈冷却。RVB在聚焦时能产生比传统高斯光束更小的焦点，从而提供更紧密的势阱和潜在的更低光子反冲加热率。通过冷阻尼反馈，研究人员将纳米粒子质心运动在径向和轴向冷却至毫开尔文范围。这项工作为利用结构光进行悬浮量子光力学研究迈出了重要一步。
authors: Felipe Almeida, M. Rademacher, J. M. H. Gosling, P. F. Barker

articles.title: COFI-DQI: Curve-based Optimal Function Intersection via Decoded Quantum Interferometry
